epochs.name: 破土而出
epochs.summary: Claude Code 作为研究预览与 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 一同出现。那几周里，一个住在终端里的模型第一次自己写代码、跑命令，社区在惊讶中写出了第一份《Best Practices》。
epochs.summary_en: Claude Code ships as a research preview alongside Claude 3.7 Sonnet. For a few weeks that spring, a model living in your terminal started writing code and running commands on its own — and the community wrote the first Best Practices guide in real time.

epochs.name: 工具化
epochs.summary: v1.0 在五月末到来，随之而来的是 Claude Code SDK、hooks 机制、Sonnet 4 与 Opus 4，以及第一次让用户不安的限额调整。方法论开始成型，分歧也是。
epochs.summary_en: v1.0 lands in late May, bringing the Claude Code SDK, the hooks system, Sonnet 4 and Opus 4 — and the first usage-limit changes that caught users off guard. Methodology started taking shape. So did disagreement.

epochs.name: 生态扩张
epochs.summary: v2.0 把 Claude Code 推进 VS Code、Zed、Emacs，SDK 被重命名为 Agent SDK。社区一边吐槽它张口就来的 "You're absolutely right"，一边用它修起了二十五年老的内核驱动。
epochs.summary_en: v2.0 brings Claude Code into VS Code, Zed, and Emacs, and the SDK is renamed Agent SDK. The community starts mocking its eager "You're absolutely right" reflex — and in the same weeks, uses it to modernize 25-year-old kernel drivers.

epochs.name: 平台化
epochs.summary: 2.1 把插件、技能、权限治理一齐推到前台。Cowork 扩出了代码之外的地盘，Anthropic 同时悄悄收紧了第三方使用订阅这件事。平台化往往是一次权力的再分配。
epochs.summary_en: 2.1 pushes plugins, skills, and permission governance to the foreground. Cowork extends the brand beyond code, while Anthropic quietly clamps down on third-party use of subscriptions. Platformization, as always, is a redistribution of power.

epochs.name: 自主化
epochs.summary: 源代码经由 npm map file 一夜之间泄漏，社区把它拆解成了一门学问。adaptive thinking 把推理深度交给模型自己决定，worktree 隔离和 1M 上下文把代理推到了可长时运行的边界——从 Opus 4.6 到 4.8，每一代都在加速这条路。
epochs.summary_en: The source code leaks overnight via an npm map file, and the community turns the teardown into sport. Adaptive thinking hands reasoning depth to the model itself, while worktree isolation and 1M context push the agent toward hours-long unattended runs — from Opus 4.6 through 4.8, each generation accelerates the path.

changes.raw: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
changes.summary: 修复Bug并提升可靠性
changes.summary_en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
changes.why_matters: 提升工具稳定性，减少使用中的错误
changes.why_matters_en: Improves tool stability and reduces errors during use

changes.raw: Added Claude Opus 5 (`claude-opus-5`), now the default Opus model — 1M context, fast mode at $10/$50 per Mtok
changes.summary: 新增Claude Opus 5模型，支持1M上下文
changes.summary_en: Added Claude Opus 5 model with 1M context, fast mode pricing
changes.why_matters: 新默认模型大幅提升上下文容量和性价比，直接影响所有用户的核心体验
changes.why_matters_en: New default model with 1M context and better pricing directly impacts every user's core experience.

changes.raw: Added `sandbox.network.strictAllowlist` setting to deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting
changes.summary: 新增沙箱网络严格白名单设置
changes.summary_en: Added sandbox.network.strictAllowlist to deny non-allowlisted hosts
changes.why_matters: 允许无提示地拒绝非白名单主机，增强沙箱命令的网络安全管控
changes.why_matters_en: Denying non-allowlisted hosts without prompting strengthens sandbox network security control.

changes.raw: Added `DirectoryAdded` hook that fires after `/add-dir` or the SDK `register_repo_root` control request registers a new working directory mid-session
changes.summary: 新增目录注册后的DirectoryAdded钩子
changes.summary_en: Added DirectoryAdded hook firing after /add-dir or register_repo_root
changes.why_matters: 为自动化工作流提供目录变更事件钩子，便于扩展自定义行为
changes.why_matters_en: Provides a hook for directory registration events, enabling custom automation extensions.

changes.raw: Added `mcp_server_errors` to the headless stream-json init event, listing `--mcp-config` entries skipped by config validation; terminal runs print a startup warning
changes.summary: MCP配置错误现在在启动时可见提示
changes.summary_en: MCP config errors now surfaced in headless init event and startup warning
changes.why_matters: 让用户能快速发现并修复被跳过的MCP服务器配置问题，减少调试时间
changes.why_matters_en: Surfaces skipped MCP config entries early, reducing debugging time for integration issues.

changes.raw: Added the `workflowSizeGuideline` settings key so the advisory Dynamic workflow size guideline can be set from any settings file; the `/config` row is hidden while one does
changes.summary: 支持从设置文件配置工作流大小建议
changes.summary_en: workflowSizeGuideline setting key now configurable from any settings file
changes.why_matters: 允许通过配置文件管理工作流大小建议，提升配置灵活性
changes.why_matters_en: Enables managing workflow size advisory from config files, improving configuration flexibility.

changes.raw: Added nested subagent forwarding in stream-json: subagents spawned at depth-2+ now appear when `--forward-subagent-text` is set, keyed by their spawning Agent `tool_use` id
changes.summary: 支持嵌套子代理在stream-json中转发
changes.summary_en: Nested subagent forwarding in stream-json for depth-2+ subagents
changes.why_matters: 使深度嵌套的子代理输出可见，增强复杂多代理工作流的可观测性
changes.why_matters_en: Makes deeply nested subagent output visible, improving observability of complex multi-agent workflows.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude -p` text output dropping the answer already produced when a turn dies on a mid-stream API error
changes.summary: 修复流式API错误时已生成回答丢失
changes.summary_en: Fixed claude -p dropping already-produced answer on mid-stream API error
changes.why_matters: 避免因中途API错误丢失已有输出，对长任务的用户体验至关重要
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents loss of already-generated output on mid-stream API errors, critical for long tasks.

changes.raw: Added HTTP status and error text to `claude mcp list` and `/mcp` when a server fails to connect, and a warning for MCP config values with hidden leading or trailing whitespace
changes.summary: MCP列表显示连接错误状态和空白警告
changes.summary_en: MCP list now shows HTTP status/error text and warns on whitespace in config
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户快速定位MCP连接失败原因及配置中的隐蔽空格问题
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users quickly diagnose MCP connection failures and hidden whitespace in config values.

changes.raw: Fixed the Fable model row showing "Requires usage credits" for plans that include it, when a stale cache had baked the label in
changes.summary: 修复Fable模型行缓存导致的错误标签
changes.summary_en: Fixed stale cache showing wrong 'Requires usage credits' label for Fable model
changes.why_matters: 消除过期缓存导致的误导性标签，避免用户对模型可用性产生困惑
changes.why_matters_en: Removes misleading label from stale cache, preventing confusion about model availability.

changes.raw: Fixed the `/model` picker showing the merged Opus row as plain "Opus" instead of "Opus (1M context)"
changes.summary: 修复模型选择器中Opus名称显示不全
changes.summary_en: Fixed /model picker showing 'Opus' instead of 'Opus (1M context)'
changes.why_matters: 确保用户在模型选择时能看到完整上下文容量信息
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures users see full context capacity info when selecting a model.

changes.raw: Fixed copy-on-select inside GNU screen printing base64 into the terminal instead of copying the selection
changes.summary: 修复GNU screen中复制选中粘贴base64问题
changes.summary_en: Fixed copy-on-select in GNU screen printing base64 instead of copying
changes.why_matters: 解决GNU screen用户复制功能的严重障碍，影响日常操作效率
changes.why_matters_en: Resolves a serious copy functionality issue for GNU screen users, affecting daily workflow.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control clients keeping a stale fast-mode status after a model switch, reconnect, or failed org check
changes.summary: 修复远程控制客户端模型切换后状态过期
changes.summary_en: Fixed Remote Control clients keeping stale fast-mode status after model switch
changes.why_matters: 确保远程控制场景下模型切换后状态正确同步，避免错误操作
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures correct status sync after model switches in remote control scenarios.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` on Windows exiting or being used as bash when the path isn't a bash/sh binary; it's now ignored with a warning
changes.summary: 修复Windows下无效Git Bash路径被误用
changes.summary_en: Fixed CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH being used when path isn't a bash/sh binary
changes.why_matters: 避免因错误bash路径导致Windows环境下命令执行异常
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents command execution failures on Windows from invalid bash path configuration.

changes.raw: Fixed Vim mode: pressing ← on an empty prompt now returns to the agent view from NORMAL mode, not just INSERT
changes.summary: 修复Vim模式空提示行下左键返回行为
changes.summary_en: Fixed Vim mode: left arrow on empty prompt returns to agent view from NORMAL mode
changes.why_matters: 改善Vim模式用户的导航体验，使其行为更符合预期
changes.why_matters_en: Improves Vim mode navigation behavior to match user expectations.

changes.raw: Fixed screen-reader mode rewriting the entire input line on every keystroke instead of echoing only the typed character
changes.summary: 修复屏幕阅读器模式每次按键重写整行
changes.summary_en: Fixed screen-reader mode rewriting entire input line on every keystroke
changes.why_matters: 显著改善屏幕阅读器用户的输入体验，避免冗余语音输出
changes.why_matters_en: Significantly improves screen-reader users' input experience by reducing redundant audio output.

changes.raw: Improved the "Remote Control is only available via api.anthropic.com" error to name the specific setting that caused it
changes.summary: 远程控制错误提示具体设置项
changes.summary_en: Remote control error now names the specific setting
changes.why_matters: 更精确的错误信息帮助用户快速定位并修复配置问题。
changes.why_matters_en: More precise error messages help users quickly locate and fix configuration issues.

changes.raw: Improved `claude --teleport` to show which repo your current checkout points at when it doesn't match the session's repo
changes.summary: teleport显示当前检出指向的仓库
changes.summary_en: Teleport shows which repo the current checkout points at
changes.why_matters: 在仓库不匹配时明确显示目标仓库，避免用户在错误的代码库上操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Showing the target repo when mismatched prevents users from operating on the wrong codebase.

changes.raw: Changed dynamic workflows to default to a medium size guideline (aim for fewer than 15 agents); pick another size or unrestricted with Dynamic workflow size in `/config`
changes.summary: 动态工作流默认中等规模(少于15代理)
changes.summary_en: Dynamic workflows default to medium size (under 15 agents)
changes.why_matters: 合理的默认规模在功能丰富与资源消耗之间取得平衡，降低新用户使用门槛。
changes.why_matters_en: A sensible default size balances capability and resource cost, lowering the barrier for new users.

changes.raw: Changed managed MCP allowlist/denylist `${VAR}` entries to resolve from the startup environment and managed-settings env instead of settings-file env
changes.summary: MCP变量解析改用启动环境
changes.summary_en: MCP variable resolution uses startup env and managed-settings
changes.why_matters: 变量解析来源的变更可能影响现有MCP配置的行为，升级时需验证。
changes.why_matters_en: Changing variable resolution sources may affect existing MCP configs and needs verification on upgrade.

changes.raw: Changed the `/model` picker to highlight only the newest model's name, so the highlight marks the new release rather than an arbitrary subset of the list
changes.summary: 模型选择器仅高亮最新模型
changes.summary_en: Model picker highlights only the newest model name
changes.why_matters: 清晰标注最新发布模型，帮助用户快速识别推荐选项。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearly marking the newest release helps users quickly identify the recommended option.

changes.raw: Added the current default workflow size to the running-workflow status line, with a pointer to `/config` for changing it
changes.summary: 运行状态行显示工作流规模
changes.summary_en: Running-workflow status line shows current workflow size
changes.why_matters: 在运行时可见当前规模设置并提供修改入口，提升可操作性。
changes.why_matters_en: Showing the current size at runtime with a config pointer improves operability.

changes.raw: Removed Opus 4.7 from fast mode; `/fast` now applies to Opus 5 and Opus 4.8
changes.summary: 快速模式移除Opus 4.7支持
changes.summary_en: Opus 4.7 removed from fast mode
changes.why_matters: 依赖Opus 4.7快速模式的用户需要迁移到Opus 5或4.8。
changes.why_matters_en: Users relying on Opus 4.7 fast mode need to migrate to Opus 5 or 4.8.

changes.raw: Updated the claude-api skill to default to Claude Opus 5, with a migration path from Opus 4.8
changes.summary: claude-api技能默认使用Opus 5
changes.summary_en: claude-api skill defaults to Claude Opus 5
changes.why_matters: 默认升级到最新模型并提供迁移路径，确保用户获得更强能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Defaulting to the latest model with a migration path ensures users get stronger capabilities.

changes.raw: Subagents can now spawn nested subagents up to depth 3 by default (was 1); set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1 to disable nesting
changes.summary: 子代理支持嵌套至深度3
changes.summary_en: Subagents can spawn nested subagents up to depth 3
changes.why_matters: 多层嵌套使复杂任务可分解为更细粒度的子任务，大幅增强自动化能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Multi-level nesting enables finer task decomposition, greatly enhancing automation capability.

changes.raw: Changed `/code-review` to run as a background subagent, so review work no longer fills your conversation and keeps stacked slash commands as its review target
changes.summary: 代码审查改为后台子代理运行
changes.summary_en: Code review runs as background subagent
changes.why_matters: 避免审查内容淹没主对话，提升交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents review output from cluttering the main conversation, improving UX.

changes.raw: Added screen-reader announcements of deleted text for word and line deletions (`Option+Delete`, `Ctrl+W`, `Cmd+Backspace`, `Ctrl+U`, `Ctrl+K`) in `--ax-screen-reader` mode
changes.summary: 屏幕阅读器播报删除文本操作
changes.summary_en: Screen reader announces deleted text for word/line deletions
changes.why_matters: 提升视障用户对文本删除操作的感知能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves accessibility for visually impaired users during text deletions.

changes.raw: Fixed Windows paths with `\u`-prefixed segments (like `C:\Users\unicorn`) being corrupted into CJK characters in tool inputs, which made those files inaccessible
changes.summary: 修复Windows含\u路径被转成中日韩字符
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows paths with \u segments corrupted to CJK chars
changes.why_matters: 该bug导致Windows用户无法访问含特定路径的文件，影响严重。
changes.why_matters_en: This bug made files with certain Windows paths completely inaccessible.

changes.raw: Fixed the left arrow key discarding the conversation with no undo: presses right after editing now ask to confirm, and Esc in the agent view returns to the conversation it backgrounded
changes.summary: 修复左箭头键误删对话且无法撤销
changes.summary_en: Fix left arrow key discarding conversation with no undo
changes.why_matters: 防止用户因误按左箭头丢失整个对话历史。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents users from losing entire conversation history via accidental key press.

changes.raw: Fixed multi-line paste collapsing into one line with `j` in place of newlines in terminals that encode pasted newlines as Ctrl+J
changes.summary: 修复多行粘贴在部分终端变为单行
changes.summary_en: Fix multi-line paste collapsing to one line in some terminals
changes.why_matters: 多行粘贴丢失换行会导致代码格式错乱，影响输入准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Losing newlines on paste corrupts code formatting and input accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed `/context` reporting stale pre-compact token usage after compacting from the message picker
changes.summary: 修复压缩后token用量显示过期
changes.summary_en: Fix /context showing stale token usage after compaction
changes.why_matters: 确保用户看到的上下文用量信息准确可靠。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures users see accurate context usage information after compaction.

changes.raw: Fixed `/ultrareview` failing on descriptive arguments like "review my auth changes" — they now run a review of your current branch with the text applied as a note to the findings
changes.summary: 修复/ultrareview对描述性参数报错
changes.summary_en: Fix /ultrareview failing on descriptive arguments
changes.why_matters: 用户可以用自然语言描述审查意图，提升易用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can describe review intent in natural language, improving usability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/code-review ultra` silently running a local review in non-interactive sessions — it now launches the cloud review
changes.summary: 修复非交互下/code-review ultra未启动云端审查
changes.summary_en: Fix /code-review ultra silently running local review in non-interactive mode
changes.why_matters: 确保非交互场景下正确触发云端审查，避免结果不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures cloud review is correctly triggered in non-interactive sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed gateway spend metering to price Bedrock application-inference-profile ARNs and other config-mapped upstream model IDs at the configured model's rates
changes.summary: 修复网关计费对Bedrock推理配置ARN定价错误
changes.summary_en: Fix gateway spend metering for Bedrock inference profile ARNs
changes.why_matters: 错误的计费会导致成本统计不准确，影响预算管理。
changes.why_matters_en: Incorrect metering leads to inaccurate cost tracking and budget management.

changes.raw: Fixed mojibake when a long IDE selection was truncated mid-emoji, and a case where a tool executor error could be silently dropped
changes.summary: 修复长IDE选区截断emoji及工具错误被吞
changes.summary_en: Fix mojibake on truncated emoji and silently dropped tool errors
changes.why_matters: 避免乱码和静默错误导致用户无法察觉工具执行失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents garbled text and silent tool failures from going unnoticed.

changes.raw: Fixed an engine teardown race that could start and abandon a phantom turn, and made input pushed after close consistently rejected
changes.summary: 修复引擎关闭竞态产生幽灵轮次
changes.summary_en: Fix engine teardown race causing phantom turns
changes.why_matters: 消除关闭后仍启动无效轮次的竞态，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates race condition that starts invalid turns after shutdown.

changes.raw: Fixed spurious "[Request interrupted by user]" messages after interrupted tool calls, and an unpaired `tool_use` block left in the transcript when a tool aborted mid-response
changes.summary: 修复工具中断后虚假中断消息及残留块
changes.summary_en: Fix spurious interrupt messages and orphaned tool_use blocks
changes.why_matters: 避免误导性消息和残留数据影响后续对话质量。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misleading messages and orphaned data from degrading conversations.

changes.raw: Fixed VoiceOver reading "new line" instead of echoing the typed space at the end of the input in `--ax-screen-reader` mode
changes.summary: 修复VoiceOver将空格读为换行
changes.summary_en: Fix VoiceOver reading space as newline in screen reader mode
changes.why_matters: 提升屏幕阅读器模式下输入反馈的准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves input feedback accuracy in screen reader mode.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin and settings panels not moving the terminal cursor to the focused row, so screen readers and magnifiers can follow arrow-key navigation
changes.summary: 修复插件/设置面板光标未跟随焦点行
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin/settings panel cursor not following focused row
changes.why_matters: 确保屏幕阅读器和放大镜能正确跟踪键盘导航。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures screen readers and magnifiers can track keyboard navigation.

changes.raw: Fixed crashes (maximum call stack exceeded) when a deeply nested watched directory tree was deleted or moved, and when rendering deeply nested UI trees
changes.summary: 修复深层嵌套目录删除及UI渲染崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crashes on deeply nested directory deletion and UI rendering
changes.why_matters: 深层嵌套结构下崩溃会中断工作流程，影响可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Crashes on deeply nested structures interrupt workflows and hurt reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed pull request events occasionally being lost when a session exited immediately after creating or linking a PR
changes.summary: 修复会话退出时PR事件丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix PR events lost when session exits immediately
changes.why_matters: 防止用户创建PR后因会话退出导致事件丢失，保障工作流完整性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents loss of PR events that would break CI/CD workflow continuity.

changes.raw: Fixed the Bedrock setup wizard failing profile verification for assume-role profiles in partitioned AWS regions and on proxy-only networks
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock在分区AWS区域的配置验证
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock setup wizard for partitioned AWS regions and proxies
changes.why_matters: 使分区域和代理网络用户能正确完成Bedrock配置，扩大可用范围。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables Bedrock users in partitioned AWS regions and proxy networks to configure correctly.

changes.raw: Fixed rare negative or incorrect turn duration measurements after a system clock adjustment by timing turns with a monotonic clock
changes.summary: 使用单调时钟修复回合时长测量错误
changes.summary_en: Fix incorrect turn duration via monotonic clock timing
changes.why_matters: 消除系统时钟调整导致的负值或错误时长，提升监控数据可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates negative or incorrect timing caused by system clock adjustments.

changes.raw: Fixed the "N MCP servers need authentication" startup notice over-counting claude.ai connectors that aren't connected in claude.ai
changes.summary: 修复MCP服务器认证提示计数错误
changes.summary_en: Fix over-counting of MCP servers needing authentication
changes.why_matters: 避免误导用户以为有过多未认证连接器，减少困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misleading users about how many connectors actually need authentication.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt history entries being dropped or duplicated when history writes raced or failed
changes.summary: 修复提示历史条目丢失或重复
changes.summary_en: Fix prompt history entries dropped or duplicated on race/failure
changes.why_matters: 确保用户历史记录完整一致，避免丢失重要上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures prompt history integrity so users don't lose or see duplicated context.

changes.raw: Fixed a retry loop that re-sent identical doomed requests after a context-overflow error with a large thinking budget; `Ctrl+B` backgrounding now applies the same background-shell caps as other paths
changes.summary: 修复上下文溢出后无效重试循环
changes.summary_en: Fix doomed retry loop after context-overflow with large thinking budget
changes.why_matters: 避免在上下文溢出后反复发送注定失败的请求，节省时间和资源。
changes.why_matters_en: Stops wasteful repeated doomed requests after context overflow, saving time and tokens.

changes.raw: Fixed agent frontmatter hooks running from untrusted folders: hooks now require the agent file's own folder to have accepted workspace trust
changes.summary: 修复不受信任文件夹的agent钩子执行
changes.summary_en: Fix agent frontmatter hooks running from untrusted folders
changes.why_matters: 防止在未受信任目录中执行钩子，提升安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents untrusted hooks from executing, closing a security gap.

changes.raw: Fixed fork-session lineage being lost after compaction in headless and SDK sessions
changes.summary: 修复压缩后fork会话谱系丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix fork-session lineage lost after compaction in headless/SDK
changes.why_matters: 保持会话分支关系在压缩后不丢失，维护会话管理一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Preserves fork lineage through compaction so session relationships stay intact.

changes.raw: Fixed a resumed session failing every turn, or crashing on resume, when its history held a malformed delta attachment
changes.summary: 修复恢复含畸形附件会话时崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix resume crash/failure with malformed delta attachment
changes.why_matters: 避免因历史中畸形数据导致会话恢复失败，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents session resume failures caused by malformed attachments in history.

changes.raw: Improved `/ultrareview` error feedback so Claude can correct an invalid argument instead of retrying it unchanged
changes.summary: 改进ultrareview错误反馈可自我修正
changes.summary_en: Improve ultrareview error feedback for self-correction
changes.why_matters: 让Claude能根据错误信息修正参数而非盲目重试，提升效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets Claude correct invalid arguments instead of blindly retrying, improving efficiency.

changes.raw: Improved auto mode: the dangerous-rm, background-`&`, and suspicious-Windows-path checks no longer open permission dialogs; the auto-mode classifier adjudicates them instead
changes.summary: auto模式危险操作改为分类器裁决
changes.summary_en: Auto mode: dangerous ops adjudicated by classifier, no dialogs
changes.why_matters: 减少权限弹窗打断，使auto模式更流畅且仍安全。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces permission dialog interruptions while keeping auto mode safe.

changes.raw: Improved sandbox command restrictions for IDE interactions
changes.summary: 改进IDE交互的沙箱命令限制
changes.summary_en: Improve sandbox command restrictions for IDE interactions
changes.why_matters: 收紧IDE交互的沙箱限制，降低未授权操作风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Tightens sandbox restrictions for IDE interactions, reducing unauthorized action risk.

changes.raw: Improved trust dialogs to name the repository root the grant covers
changes.summary: 信任对话框显示所覆盖的仓库根
changes.summary_en: Trust dialogs now name the repository root covered
changes.why_matters: 让用户清楚知道信任授权的范围，减少误授权风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Clarifies trust grant scope so users know exactly which repo root is covered.

changes.raw: Changed `/deep-research` to start only when invoked manually; Claude no longer launches it on its own
changes.summary: deep-research改为仅手动调用
changes.summary_en: Deep-research now only starts on manual invocation
changes.why_matters: 防止Claude自动启动耗时研究流程，给予用户更多控制。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives users control over when deep-research runs, preventing unexpected long operations.

changes.raw: Changed plan mode with auto to no longer prompt for Bash commands the static analyzer can't prove read-only; the auto-mode classifier judges them instead
changes.summary: auto模式plan模式改由分类器判断命令
changes.summary_en: Plan+auto: classifier judges unprovable read-only Bash commands
changes.why_matters: 减少无法静态证明的命令弹窗，使auto模式更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces prompts for commands the static analyzer can't prove safe, smoothing auto mode.

changes.raw: Added an announcement when fast mode changes as a result of switching models via `/config model=<x>` or Remote Control
changes.summary: 切换模型时提示fast模式变化
changes.summary_en: Announce fast mode changes when switching models
changes.why_matters: 让用户在切换模型时清楚了解fast模式状态，避免混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps users informed about fast mode state when switching models, avoiding confusion.

changes.raw: Changed server-managed settings so benign feature and cost toggles no longer trigger the settings-approval prompt
changes.summary: 良性设置切换不再触发审批提示
changes.summary_en: Benign settings toggles no longer trigger approval prompt
changes.why_matters: 减少不必要的审批中断，提升日常配置操作的流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces unnecessary approval interruptions, improving flow for routine config changes.

changes.raw: Changed agent markdown files to reject agent names containing `:`, which is reserved for plugin namespacing
changes.summary: agent名称禁止包含冒号字符
changes.summary_en: Agent names with colons are now rejected
changes.why_matters: 冒号被保留用于插件命名空间，防止命名冲突导致解析错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Colons are reserved for plugin namespacing, preventing naming conflicts and parse errors.

changes.raw: Changed skills with `context: fork` to run in the background by default; opt out per skill with `background: false`
changes.summary: fork技能默认后台运行
changes.summary_en: Fork-context skills now run in background by default
changes.why_matters: 改变默认行为可能影响依赖前台执行的现有技能流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Changed default behavior may affect existing skills that depend on foreground execution.

changes.raw: Added `yes`/`no`/`on`/`off`/`1`/`0` (case-insensitive) as accepted values for skill and plugin frontmatter booleans, alongside `true`/`false`
changes.summary: 布尔值支持更多写法
changes.summary_en: Boolean frontmatter accepts yes/no/on/off/1/0 values
changes.why_matters: 降低配置书写门槛，让用户用更自然的方式设置布尔参数。
changes.why_matters_en: Lowers configuration barrier by accepting more intuitive boolean value formats.

changes.raw: Fixed remote sessions continuing to send heartbeats after their worker was replaced, which left long-lived desktop and IDE processes retrying a rejected request every few seconds forever
changes.summary: 修复远程会话心跳泄漏问题
changes.summary_en: Fix remote sessions sending heartbeats after worker replacement
changes.why_matters: 消除长时间运行进程的无意义重试，避免资源浪费和潜在卡顿。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates pointless retries in long-lived processes, preventing resource waste and stalls.

signals.title: Show HN: Bento - An entire PowerPoint in one HTML file (edit+view+data+collab)
Claude Code uses Bun written in Rust now
The new rules of context engineering for Claude 5 generation models
Setting up your spare Mac for Claude Code to control, a step-by-step guide
Show HN: Palmier Pro – Open-source macOS video editor built for AI

changes.raw: Added emoji shortcode autocomplete in the prompt input: type `:heart:` to insert ❤️, or `:hea` for suggestions — disable with the `emojiCompletionEnabled` setting
changes.summary: 提示输入支持emoji短代码自动补全
changes.summary_en: Emoji shortcode autocomplete in prompt input
changes.why_matters: 提升用户输入体验，方便快速插入表情符号。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves input UX by making emoji insertion faster and more discoverable.

changes.raw: Added warnings when transcript writes are failing (e.g. disk full) or when session saving is off due to an inherited environment variable, instead of losing transcripts silently
changes.summary: 转录写入失败时显示警告而非静默丢失
changes.summary_en: Warn on transcript write failures instead of silent loss
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在不知情下丢失会话记录，确保数据可追溯。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents silent data loss so users can take corrective action on session transcripts.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak where truncated MCP tool outputs kept the full untruncated result in memory for the rest of the session
changes.summary: 修复MCP工具输出截断后内存泄漏问题
changes.summary_en: Fix memory leak from truncated MCP tool outputs
changes.why_matters: 避免长会话中内存持续增长导致性能下降或崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents progressive memory bloat that could degrade performance in long sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed Windows auto-update failures that could leave `claude.exe` missing; failed updates now restore the preserved executable automatically
changes.summary: 修复Windows自动更新失败导致可执行文件丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows auto-update leaving claude.exe missing
changes.why_matters: 更新失败后工具完全不可用，自动恢复可执行文件至关重要。
changes.why_matters_en: A failed update could leave the CLI completely unusable; auto-restore is critical.

changes.raw: Fixed background session isolation not canonicalizing symlinked working directories, which could let sessions escape their workspace folder
changes.summary: 修复符号链接目录导致会话逃逸工作区
changes.summary_en: Fix symlinked dirs allowing sessions to escape workspace
changes.why_matters: 工作区隔离失效可能导致后台会话访问不该访问的目录，存在安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Broken workspace isolation could let background sessions access files outside their scope.

changes.raw: Fixed auto-compact never triggering for Claude Opus 4.8 on Bedrock and `/compact` failing once over the limit
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock上Opus 4.8自动压缩不触发
changes.summary_en: Fix auto-compact not triggering for Opus 4.8 on Bedrock
changes.why_matters: 上下文超限后无法压缩会导致会话功能失效，影响核心使用流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Without auto-compact, sessions exceed context limits and become unusable.

changes.raw: Fixed corporate mTLS, TLS-verify, OAuth scope, and proxy settings being ignored in Claude Desktop sessions
changes.summary: 修复Claude Desktop忽略企业mTLS和代理设置
changes.summary_en: Fix corporate mTLS/TLS/proxy settings ignored in Desktop
changes.why_matters: 企业环境网络配置被忽略会导致连接失败或安全合规问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Ignoring enterprise network settings breaks connectivity and compliance in corporate envs.

changes.raw: Fixed screen reader mode's startup announcement being cut off by the first prompt render, and the thinking status row re-rendering every few seconds to update elapsed time and token counts
changes.summary: 修复屏幕阅读器模式启动播报被截断
changes.summary_en: Fix screen reader startup announcement being cut off
changes.why_matters: 改善无障碍体验，确保辅助技术用户能获取完整启动信息。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves accessibility by ensuring screen reader users get complete startup info.

changes.raw: Fixed managed settings that set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` not governing all signals — lower-scope signal-specific overrides no longer redirect telemetry away from the managed endpoint
changes.summary: 修复托管OTEL端点设置可被低范围覆盖绕过
changes.summary_en: Fix managed OTEL endpoint overrides bypassing governance
changes.why_matters: 遥测数据可被重定向到非托管端点，违反企业数据治理策略。
changes.why_matters_en: Telemetry could be redirected away from managed endpoints, violating data governance policies.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume`/`--continue` and `/resume` failing with a TypeError when a transcript has a malformed attachment entry
changes.summary: 修复畸形附件导致恢复会话时TypeError
changes.summary_en: Fix resume failing on malformed transcript attachments
changes.why_matters: 无法恢复历史会话会打断用户工作流，影响连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Resume failures disrupt user workflows when prior sessions can't be restored.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control sessions not showing a pending permission prompt or dialog to viewers that connected after it appeared
changes.summary: 修复远程控制权限提示后连接者看不到弹窗
changes.summary_en: Fix late Remote Control viewers missing permission prompts
changes.why_matters: 后加入的协作者看不到权限请求可能导致协作盲区和决策延误。
changes.why_matters_en: Late-joining collaborators missing prompts creates blind spots in shared sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed background shells sometimes becoming impossible to stop after a session is sent to the background (`/background` or `←`) or when the session exits on a heavily loaded machine, most visible on Windows
changes.summary: 修复后台shell无法停止的问题
changes.summary_en: Fix background shells becoming impossible to stop
changes.why_matters: 无法停止的后台进程会持续消耗资源，在高负载机器上尤其严重。
changes.why_matters_en: Unstoppable background processes waste resources and are especially harmful on loaded machines.

changes.raw: Fixed a `CLAUDE.md` or `SKILL.md` paths frontmatter value with many brace groups OOM-killing or stalling the CLI at startup — brace expansion is now budget-bounded
changes.summary: 修复frontmatter大括号展开导致OOM崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix brace expansion OOM in CLAUDE.md/SKILL.md frontmatter
changes.why_matters: 恶意或意外的复杂路径配置可导致CLI启动崩溃，影响可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Complex path configs could crash the CLI at startup, blocking all usage.

changes.raw: Fixed the transcript preview sitting flush against the input area when attaching to a starting background session; it now leaves the same one-line gap as the live layout, so the transcript no longer shifts when the session takes over
changes.summary: 修复后台会话转录预览与输入区间距不一致
changes.summary_en: Fix transcript preview spacing mismatch with input area
changes.why_matters: 界面布局抖动影响视觉一致性，虽为小问题但降低体验质量。
changes.why_matters_en: Layout shift on session takeover is a minor but noticeable visual inconsistency.

changes.raw: Improved footer PR badge links to be clickable hyperlinks even when terminal support can't be detected (e.g. over ssh/tmux); set `FORCE_HYPERLINK=0` to opt out
changes.summary: PR徽章链接在SSH/tmux下也可点击
changes.summary_en: PR badge links clickable even over SSH/tmux
changes.why_matters: 在远程终端环境中保持超链接可用性，提升跨环境一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Maintains hyperlink usability in remote terminal sessions for consistent UX.

changes.raw: Changed the login-expiry warning to appear 3 days before expiry instead of 5
changes.summary: 登录过期提醒提前3天显示
changes.summary_en: Login expiry warning now 3 days before expiry
changes.why_matters: 调整提醒时机让用户有更合理的窗口处理登录续期。
changes.why_matters_en: Adjusts warning timing for a more reasonable window to renew login.

changes.raw: Capped the frontend-design plugin suggestion tip at 3 lifetime impressions instead of repeating indefinitely
changes.summary: 前端设计插件提示最多显示3次
changes.summary_en: Frontend-design plugin tip capped at 3 impressions
changes.why_matters: 避免重复提示打扰用户，提升使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents repetitive tips from annoying users, improving UX.

changes.raw: Added a cap on concurrently-running subagents (default 20, override with `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS`) so one message can't fan out unbounded background agents
changes.summary: 限制并发子代理数量防止资源失控
changes.summary_en: Cap concurrent subagents to prevent runaway resources
changes.why_matters: 防止单条消息无限扇出后台代理导致资源耗尽或成本失控。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents a single message from fanning out unbounded agents, avoiding resource exhaustion.

changes.raw: Changed subagents to no longer spawn nested subagents by default; set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` to allow deeper nesting
changes.summary: 子代理默认不再嵌套生成子代理
changes.summary_en: Subagents no longer spawn nested subagents by default
changes.why_matters: 默认禁止嵌套可避免代理层级失控，同时保留可配置的深度控制。
changes.why_matters_en: Disabling nesting by default prevents runaway agent hierarchies while keeping configurable depth.

changes.raw: Fixed `--max-budget-usd` not stopping background subagents: once the cap is reached, new spawns are denied and running background agents are halted
changes.summary: 修复预算上限未停止后台子代理
changes.summary_en: Fix budget cap not stopping background subagents
changes.why_matters: 确保预算上限真正生效，防止成本超支是用户信任的关键。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensuring budget caps actually halt agents is critical to prevent cost overruns.

signals.title: Show HN: Bento - An entire PowerPoint in one HTML file (edit+view+data+collab)
Claude Code uses Bun written in Rust now
The new rules of context engineering for Claude 5 generation models
Setting up your spare Mac for Claude Code to control, a step-by-step guide
Show HN: Palmier Pro – Open-source macOS video editor built for AI

changes.raw: Added `sandbox.filesystem.disabled` setting to skip filesystem isolation while keeping network egress control
changes.summary: 新增跳过文件系统隔离但保留网络出口控制的设置
changes.summary_en: Add setting to skip filesystem isolation, keep network egress control
changes.why_matters: 允许用户在需要文件系统访问时灵活关闭隔离，同时保留网络安全控制。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives users flexibility to disable filesystem isolation while keeping network security controls.

changes.raw: Fixed a slowdown in long sessions where message normalization cost grew quadratically with the number of turns, causing multi-second stalls and slow resumes
changes.summary: 修复长会话中消息归一化导致的二次方性能下降
changes.summary_en: Fix quadratic message normalization slowdown in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 长会话不再出现多秒卡顿和恢复缓慢，显著提升用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates multi-second stalls and slow resumes in long sessions, greatly improving UX.

changes.raw: Fixed auto mode denying commands with "HTTP 401" classifier errors after the OAuth token expired or rotated mid-session
changes.summary: 修复OAuth令牌过期后自动模式拒绝命令的问题
changes.summary_en: Fix auto mode denying commands after OAuth token expiry mid-session
changes.why_matters: 避免会话中令牌轮换导致命令被误拒，保障自动化流程连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents token rotation mid-session from breaking automated command execution.

changes.raw: Fixed AskUserQuestion telling Claude to continue even when your answer asked it to wait or explain first — free-text answers now get neutral wording
changes.summary: 修复自由文本回答被误判为继续指令的问题
changes.summary_en: Fix free-text answers misinterpreted as continue instructions
changes.why_matters: 用户让Claude等待或解释时不再被忽略，交互更准确。
changes.why_matters_en: User requests to wait or explain are no longer ignored, improving interaction accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude Code on the web re-asking the same question and dropping your answer after the session sat idle for a few minutes
changes.summary: 修复Web版空闲后重复提问并丢失回答的问题
changes.summary_en: Fix web re-asking questions and dropping answers after idle
changes.why_matters: 避免空闲后用户回答丢失，提升Web版会话可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents user answers from being lost after idle periods on the web client.

changes.raw: Fixed @-mentions silently attaching nothing after file-modifying hooks, vim dot-repeat of `c`-operators and paste, statusline running twice on resume, and resume-picker hangs on failure
changes.summary: 修复@提及、vim操作、状态栏及恢复选择器等多个问题
changes.summary_en: Fix @-mentions, vim dot-repeat, statusline, and resume-picker bugs
changes.why_matters: 修复多个影响日常使用的细节问题，提升整体稳定性和体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes several daily-use bugs, improving overall stability and experience.

changes.raw: Fixed resumed background agent sessions reverting to the default agent: the agent's prompt and tool restrictions are now restored
changes.summary: 修复恢复后台代理会话时丢失提示词和工具限制
changes.summary_en: Fix resumed background agents losing prompt and tool restrictions
changes.why_matters: 恢复后台代理时保留原始配置，确保代理行为一致和安全。
changes.why_matters_en: Restoring agent prompts and tool restrictions ensures consistent, safe agent behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed worktree-isolated subagents redirecting git into the shared checkout via `git -C`, `--git-dir`, or `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE`
changes.summary: 修复工作树隔离子代理通过git参数逃逸到共享检出
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree-isolated subagents escaping to shared checkout via git flags
changes.why_matters: 防止子代理绕过工作树隔离访问共享仓库，保障隔离安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents subagents from bypassing worktree isolation to access shared checkouts.

changes.raw: Fixed worktree sessions landing in another project's leftover worktree when the working directory did not match the selected project
changes.summary: 修复工作树会话落入其他项目残留工作树的问题
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree sessions landing in another project's leftover worktree
changes.why_matters: 避免会话在错误项目工作树中运行，防止潜在数据混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents sessions from running in wrong project worktrees, avoiding data confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions whose worktree has no git repository being undeletable
changes.summary: 修复无git仓库的工作树后台会话无法删除
changes.summary_en: Fix undeletable background sessions with non-git worktrees
changes.why_matters: 无git仓库的工作树会话现在可以正常删除，避免残留。
changes.why_matters_en: Sessions without git repos can now be deleted properly, avoiding leftovers.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude daemon stop --any` potentially terminating an unrelated process via a stale legacy daemon lockfile
changes.summary: 修复daemon stop可能误杀无关进程的安全隐患
changes.summary_en: Fix daemon stop potentially killing unrelated process via stale lockfile
changes.why_matters: 避免过期锁文件导致误终止无关进程，消除安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates risk of terminating unrelated processes via stale daemon lockfiles.

changes.raw: Fixed Esc-Esc at an idle prompt not opening the rewind picker in long-running sessions with background tasks
changes.summary: 修复长会话中Esc-Esc无法打开回溯选择器
changes.summary_en: Fix Esc-Esc not opening rewind picker in long sessions with background tasks
changes.why_matters: 长会话用户可正常使用回溯功能，恢复历史操作点。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can access rewind functionality in long sessions with background tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash command permission checking for compound statements with redirects inside `&&` lists or negations
changes.summary: 修复复合语句中重定向的Bash权限检查问题
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash permission checking for compound statements with redirects
changes.why_matters: 确保复合命令中的重定向操作被正确检查，防止权限绕过。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures redirects in compound commands are properly checked, preventing permission bypass.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing Ctrl+X twice in the agent list failing to delete a session, and deleted sessions reappearing when their background worker had died
changes.summary: 修复Ctrl+X双击删除会话失败及已删除会话重现
changes.summary_en: Fix Ctrl+X double-press failing to delete sessions and deleted ones reappearing
changes.why_matters: 会话删除操作现在可靠执行，避免已删除会话重新出现造成困扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Session deletion now works reliably, preventing deleted sessions from reappearing.

changes.raw: Fixed background subagents getting cancelled when a high-priority message arrives during their startup window
changes.summary: 修复后台子代理在启动窗口期被高优先级消息取消
changes.summary_en: Fix background subagents cancelled by high-priority messages during startup
changes.why_matters: 后台子代理不再因启动期间的高优先级消息被意外取消，保障任务完成。
changes.why_matters_en: Background subagents no longer get cancelled during startup by high-priority messages.

changes.raw: Fixed mouse and focus garbage in the terminal while a GUI editor from `/memory`, `/plan`, `/keybindings`, or Ctrl+G is open; `/memory` no longer waits for the editor to close
changes.summary: 修复GUI编辑器打开时终端鼠标焦点问题
changes.summary_en: Fix terminal mouse/focus issues while GUI editor open
changes.why_matters: 编辑器与终端交互时的焦点混乱会严重影响用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Focus garbage during editor use disrupts the terminal UX significantly.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude-in-Chrome 403-looping on reconnect when the session's OAuth token lacks a required scope
changes.summary: 修复Chrome扩展OAuth重连403循环
changes.summary_en: Fix Claude-in-Chrome 403 loop on OAuth reconnect
changes.why_matters: OAuth令牌缺少scope导致无限403循环，用户无法正常重连。
changes.why_matters_en: A 403 loop on reconnect prevents users from restoring their session.

changes.raw: Fixed workflow saves and scheduled-task writes following a symlink at `.claude`, which could redirect writes outside the project
changes.summary: 修复符号链接导致写入逃逸项目目录
changes.summary_en: Fix symlink redirect writes outside project via .claude
changes.why_matters: 符号链接可被利用将工作流和计划任务写入项目外，存在安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Symlink exploitation could redirect writes outside the project, posing a security risk.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP re-authenticate revoking working credentials before the new sign-in succeeds, and the reconnect needs-auth message in background sessions pointing at an unusable command
changes.summary: 修复MCP重认证撤销有效凭据问题
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP re-auth revoking working credentials prematurely
changes.why_matters: 重认证时先撤销旧凭据会导致认证失败时无法回退。
changes.why_matters_en: Revoking credentials before new auth succeeds leaves users locked out on failure.

changes.raw: Fixed read-only commands on Windows accessing network paths without a permission prompt
changes.summary: 修复Windows网络路径缺少权限提示
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows network path access without permission prompt
changes.why_matters: 只读命令访问网络路径无权限提示，可能造成未授权访问。
changes.why_matters_en: Missing permission prompts for network paths could allow unauthorized access.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash command parsing of non-ASCII characters to match real shell word boundaries
changes.summary: 修复非ASCII字符Bash命令解析边界
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash parsing of non-ASCII to match shell word boundaries
changes.why_matters: 非ASCII字符解析不正确会导致命令执行出错。
changes.why_matters_en: Incorrect non-ASCII parsing causes command execution errors.

changes.raw: Fixed PowerShell tool permission validation of commands containing invisible Unicode characters
changes.summary: 修复PowerShell不可见Unicode字符权限校验
changes.summary_en: Fix PowerShell permission validation with invisible Unicode
changes.why_matters: 不可见Unicode字符可绕过权限校验，存在命令注入风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Invisible Unicode characters could bypass permission validation, risking injection.

changes.raw: Fixed dialogs in fullscreen mode stretching past the right-hand edge of their panel
changes.summary: 修复全屏模式对话框超出面板边界
changes.summary_en: Fix fullscreen dialogs stretching past panel edge
changes.why_matters: 对话框溢出影响全屏模式下的界面可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Dialog overflow degrades usability in fullscreen mode.

changes.raw: Fixed the `/config` settings list in fullscreen mode clipping its keyboard-hint footer
changes.summary: 修复全屏模式配置列表裁剪快捷键提示
changes.summary_en: Fix /config list clipping keyboard hints in fullscreen
changes.why_matters: 快捷键提示被裁剪影响用户发现功能。
changes.why_matters_en: Clipped keyboard hints prevent users from discovering shortcuts.

changes.raw: Fixed the transcript-mode (Ctrl+O) footer hint wrapping on terminals narrower than 104 columns
changes.summary: 修复窄终端下转录模式提示换行
changes.summary_en: Fix transcript-mode footer hint wrapping on narrow terminals
changes.why_matters: 窄终端下提示换行影响界面整洁度。
changes.why_matters_en: Hint wrapping on narrow terminals affects interface readability.

changes.raw: Fixed the Prometheus metrics endpoint (`OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=prometheus`) emitting invalid `# UNIT` lines
changes.summary: 修复Prometheus指标端点无效UNIT行
changes.summary_en: Fix Prometheus endpoint emitting invalid # UNIT lines
changes.why_matters: 无效的UNIT行会导致监控系统解析失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Invalid UNIT lines cause monitoring systems to fail parsing metrics.

changes.raw: Fixed skills and commands changed during a session not appearing in the slash menu until restart
changes.summary: 修复会话中变更的技能需重启才显示
changes.summary_en: Fix skills/commands not appearing in slash menu until restart
changes.why_matters: 会话中新增技能无法即时使用，影响工作流连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: New skills not appearing live disrupts workflow continuity.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin skills with a `name` frontmatter field losing their plugin prefix in slash-command autocomplete
changes.summary: 修复插件技能丢失前缀的自动补全
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin skills losing prefix in slash autocomplete
changes.why_matters: 插件前缀丢失会导致命令歧义和调用错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Missing plugin prefix causes command ambiguity and invocation errors.

changes.raw: Fixed telemetry misreporting permission denials: failed permission-prompt requests no longer count as user rejections, and user interrupts are now reported as user aborts instead of rejections
changes.summary: 修复遥测误报权限拒绝统计
changes.summary_en: Fix telemetry misreporting permission denials and aborts
changes.why_matters: 遥测数据不准确会误导权限策略分析和优化决策。
changes.why_matters_en: Inaccurate telemetry misleads permission policy analysis and optimization.

changes.raw: Improved the `/fork` confirmation to one line with the new session's name, `claude attach` id, and a note when the copy shares your checkout
changes.summary: 优化fork确认提示为单行简洁格式
changes.summary_en: Improve /fork confirmation to concise one-line format
changes.why_matters: 简洁的确认提示提升信息获取效率。
changes.why_matters_en: A concise confirmation improves information clarity and user efficiency.

changes.raw: Improved validation of `git` and `gh` command arguments in the PowerShell tool
changes.summary: 改进PowerShell中git和gh命令参数校验
changes.summary_en: Improved validation of git and gh args in PowerShell tool
changes.why_matters: 减少因参数校验不足导致的命令执行错误或安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces command execution errors and security risks from insufficient argument validation.

changes.raw: Improved the `/ultrareview` diff-too-large error to show configured limits, measured diff size, and largest contributing files
changes.summary: 超大型diff错误提示显示限制值和最大文件
changes.summary_en: Diff-too-large error now shows limits, measured size, and top files
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户快速定位导致diff过大的文件并调整配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users quickly identify files causing oversized diffs and adjust configuration.

changes.raw: Improved `/code-review ultra` empty-diff message to name the exact base ref and suggest passing an explicit base
changes.summary: 空diff提示指明base ref并建议显式指定
changes.summary_en: Empty-diff message names exact base ref and suggests explicit base
changes.why_matters: 让用户明确比较基准，避免代码审查因基准不明而无法执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Clarifies the comparison base so code review doesn't fail due to ambiguous refs.

changes.raw: Improved the spend limit adjustment prompt to show the server's reason when a spend limit change is rejected
changes.summary: 额度限制被拒时显示服务器原因
changes.summary_en: Spend limit rejection prompt now shows server's reason
changes.why_matters: 提升用户对额度调整失败原因的可见性，便于排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves visibility into why spend limit changes are rejected for easier troubleshooting.

changes.raw: `/context` now shows an explicit warning when the conversation exceeds the context window, and a failed `/compact` displays as an error
changes.summary: /context超窗口时显式警告并标记compact失败
changes.summary_en: /context warns on context window overflow and marks failed /compact
changes.why_matters: 让用户及时感知上下文溢出和压缩失败，避免对话质量下降。
changes.why_matters_en: Alerts users to context overflow and compaction failures before conversation quality degrades.

changes.raw: `/rewind` no longer restores or deletes files through symlinks or hard links at tracked paths and reports how many paths it skipped
changes.summary: /rewind不再通过符号链接恢复文件并报告跳过数
changes.summary_en: /rewind skips symlinks/hardlinks and reports skipped path count
changes.why_matters: 防止通过链接路径意外覆盖或删除文件，提升操作安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental file overwrite or deletion through link paths, improving safety.

changes.raw: Background sessions: `/mcp` and `/install-github-app` now park a "needs input" request in the agent view when no client is attached
changes.summary: 后台会话无客户端时挂起需输入请求
changes.summary_en: Background sessions park needs-input requests when no client attached
changes.why_matters: 确保后台会话在无客户端时不会丢失交互请求，提升异步协作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures background sessions don't lose interaction requests when no client is attached.

changes.raw: Updated the bundled dataviz skill: reordered the default chart palette and fixed guidance that suggested direct labels for four-series charts
changes.summary: 更新内置数据可视化技能调色板和图表指引
changes.summary_en: Updated bundled dataviz skill palette and fixed chart guidance
changes.why_matters: 修正图表生成建议，提升数据可视化输出的准确性和美观度。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes chart guidance to improve accuracy and aesthetics of generated visualizations.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed right-to-left text (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian) rendering in the wrong order when mixed with English or code
changes.summary: 修复VSCode中RTL文本与英文混排渲染顺序错误
changes.summary_en: Fixed RTL text rendering order when mixed with English or code in VSCode
changes.why_matters: 解决阿拉伯语、希伯来语等RTL语言用户的显示问题，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Resolves display issues for Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian users mixing RTL text with code.

changes.raw: Fixed cloud sessions dropping the in-flight message when the session's container restarts mid-turn — the interrupted turn now re-runs on resume instead of leaving the session unresponsive
changes.summary: 修复云会话容器重启时丢失消息并自动重跑
changes.summary_en: Cloud sessions re-run interrupted turn on container restart instead of hanging
changes.why_matters: 防止容器重启导致会话无响应，保障云端长会话的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unresponsive cloud sessions after container restarts, ensuring reliability.

changes.raw: Claude no longer runs the `/verify` and `/code-review` skills on its own; invoke them with `/verify` or `/code-review` when you want them
changes.summary: 不再自动运行验证和代码审查技能
changes.summary_en: No longer auto-runs /verify and /code-review skills
changes.why_matters: 用户需手动触发验证流程，避免不必要的自动执行带来的干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Users must manually trigger verification, avoiding unwanted autonomous execution.

Claude Code uses Bun written in Rust now
The new rules of context engineering for Claude 5 generation models
