changes.raw: Fixed single-segment `dir/**` allow rules like `Edit(src/**)` auto-approving writes to nested `dir/` directories anywhere in the tree instead of only `<cwd>/dir`
changes.summary: 修复单段dir/**允许规则范围过宽问题
changes.summary_en: Fix single-segment dir/** allow rules over-scoping
changes.why_matters: 防止权限规则意外放宽到目录树外的路径，避免越权写入。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents permission rules from accidentally widening to paths outside the intended directory.

changes.raw: Fixed a permission-check bypass affecting commands run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 sessions
changes.summary: 修复Windows PowerShell会话权限绕过
changes.summary_en: Fix permission-check bypass in Windows PowerShell 5.1
changes.why_matters: PowerShell会话中的权限绕过可能导致未授权命令执行，属于严重安全问题。
changes.why_matters_en: A permission bypass in PowerShell sessions could allow unauthorized command execution.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash permission checks to fail closed on file-descriptor redirect forms that bash parses differently than the permission analyzer
changes.summary: 修复文件描述符重定向的权限检查
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash permission checks for fd redirect forms
changes.why_matters: 确保复杂重定向命令不会绕过权限分析，防止未审批执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures complex redirect commands cannot bypass permission analysis.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash permission checks misjudging very long commands — commands over 10,000 characters now always prompt instead of running automatically
changes.summary: 超长命令改为始终提示审批
changes.summary_en: Very long Bash commands now always prompt for approval
changes.why_matters: 超长命令可能超出分析器能力，强制提示避免误判自动执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Overlong commands may exceed analyzer capacity; forcing prompts avoids misjudged auto-execution.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash permission checks treating zsh variable subscripts and modifiers in `[[ ]]` comparisons as inert text — these commands now prompt for approval
changes.summary: 修复zsh变量下标比较被误判为惰性文本
changes.summary_en: Fix zsh subscript/modifier in [[ ]] misjudged as inert
changes.why_matters: 防止zsh特定语法绕过权限检查导致未审批命令执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents zsh-specific syntax from bypassing permission checks.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash permission checks to no longer auto-approve certain `help` and `man` commands that could run unsafe options, command substitutions, or backslash paths
changes.summary: 修复help/man命令被误自动批准问题
changes.summary_en: Fix help/man commands auto-approved with unsafe options
changes.why_matters: 某些help/man命令可携带危险选项或命令替换，不应自动放行。
changes.why_matters_en: Some help/man commands can carry unsafe options or substitutions and should not be auto-approved.

changes.raw: Fixed permission prompts on remote sessions that could proceed before the local confirmation dialog
changes.summary: 修复远程会话权限提示时序问题
changes.summary_en: Fix remote session permission prompts proceeding early
changes.why_matters: 远程会话在本地确认前执行命令可能导致未授权操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Remote sessions executing before local confirmation could lead to unauthorized actions.

changes.raw: Added the EndConversation tool: Claude can end sessions with highly abusive users or jailbreak attempts, as on claude.ai since 2025 — see https://www.anthropic.com/research/end-subset-conversations
changes.summary: 新增EndConversation工具应对滥用用户
changes.summary_en: Add EndConversation tool for abusive users/jailbreaks
changes.why_matters: 允许Claude主动终止恶意会话，提升安全治理能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows Claude to proactively terminate malicious sessions, improving safety governance.

changes.raw: Added a periodic progress heartbeat for long-running tool calls that previously went silent
changes.summary: 长时间工具调用新增进度心跳
changes.summary_en: Add periodic progress heartbeat for long tool calls
changes.why_matters: 长时间运行的工具调用不再静默，用户可感知进度。
changes.why_matters_en: Long-running tool calls are no longer silent; users can track progress.

changes.raw: Added an ISO `modified` timestamp to memory file frontmatter
changes.summary: 记忆文件新增ISO修改时间戳
changes.summary_en: Add ISO modified timestamp to memory file frontmatter
changes.why_matters: 为记忆文件提供标准化时间戳，便于追踪和排序。
changes.why_matters_en: Provides standardized timestamps for memory files, aiding tracking and sorting.

changes.raw: Added `message.uuid`, `client_request_id`, and `tool_source` attributes to OpenTelemetry log events for message-level correlation and tool provenance
changes.summary: OTel日志新增消息级关联属性
changes.summary_en: Add message UUID, request ID, tool source to OTel logs
changes.why_matters: 增强可观测性，支持消息级关联和工具来源追踪。
changes.why_matters_en: Enhances observability with message-level correlation and tool provenance tracking.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_CONTENT_MAX_LENGTH` to configure the 60 KB truncation limit on OpenTelemetry content attributes
changes.summary: 新增OTel内容截断长度配置项
changes.summary_en: Add OTEL_CONTENT_MAX_LENGTH config for truncation
changes.why_matters: 允许用户自定义OTel内容截断上限，适配不同后端需求。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users customize OTel content truncation limits for different backends.

changes.raw: Added reasoning effort to the `subagentStatusLine` payload, so custom agent rows can render model and effort
changes.summary: 子代理状态行新增推理努力信息
changes.summary_en: Add reasoning effort to subagentStatusLine payload
changes.why_matters: 自定义代理行可渲染模型和推理努力，提升可视化体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Custom agent rows can render model and effort, improving visualization.

changes.raw: Added permission prompts for `docker` commands (including the Podman `docker` shim) carrying daemon-redirect flags (`--url`, `--connection`, `--identity`, and Podman's remote mode) that previously ran without one
changes.summary: docker守护进程重定向命令新增权限提示
changes.summary_en: Add permission prompts for docker daemon-redirect flags
changes.why_matters: 带远程守护进程标志的docker命令可能执行远程操作，需审批。
changes.why_matters_en: Docker commands with remote daemon flags could perform remote operations and need approval.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash when a GrowthBook feature evaluates to null, and a bug where a malformed flag payload could wipe the cached feature flags
changes.summary: 修复GrowthBook空值崩溃和标志缓存丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix GrowthBook null crash and malformed flag cache wipe
changes.why_matters: 防止功能标志异常导致崩溃或缓存被清空，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents feature flag anomalies from causing crashes or cache loss, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash tool killing the Claude session when a `pkill -f` pattern accidentally matched the CLI's own process (Linux)
changes.summary: 修复pkill误杀自身进程导致会话崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix pkill -f accidentally killing the CLI's own process
changes.why_matters: 用户执行常见进程管理命令时会意外终止Claude会话，严重影响工作连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Running common process management commands could accidentally terminate the Claude session, severely disrupting workflow.

changes.raw: Fixed unbounded memory growth when `--settings` points at a device file or multi-GB file; oversized (>2 MiB) settings files now fail at startup with a clear error
changes.summary: 修复超大设置文件导致内存无限增长
changes.summary_en: Fix unbounded memory growth from oversized settings files
changes.why_matters: 防止因误指向大文件而造成内存耗尽或启动失败，提升启动健壮性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents memory exhaustion from accidentally pointing settings at large or device files, improving startup robustness.

changes.raw: Fixed streaming turns failing with "Socket is closed" behind corporate proxies on Windows
changes.summary: 修复企业代理下流式请求Socket关闭错误
changes.summary_en: Fix streaming failures behind corporate proxies on Windows
changes.why_matters: 企业代理环境是大量用户的使用场景，此问题直接阻断正常交互。
changes.why_matters_en: Corporate proxy environments are common for many users; this issue directly blocked normal interaction.

changes.raw: Fixed stream-json output truncation at exit for slow-reading SDK/pipeline consumers; the exit drain now scales with queued bytes instead of a flat 2s cap
changes.summary: 修复SDK消费者流式输出被截断问题
changes.summary_en: Fix stream-json output truncation for slow SDK consumers
changes.why_matters: SDK和管道消费者读取较慢时会丢失输出数据，影响自动化集成可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Slow-reading SDK and pipeline consumers could lose output data, undermining automation integration reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed scheduled tasks refusing their own configured prompt as untrusted input — the fired prompt is now delivered as the session's assigned task
changes.summary: 修复定时任务拒绝自身已配置的提示词
changes.summary_en: Fix scheduled tasks rejecting their own configured prompt
changes.why_matters: 定时任务无法使用预设提示词会导致自动化调度功能完全失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Scheduled tasks being unable to use their configured prompts rendered the automation scheduling feature completely broken.

changes.raw: Fixed PowerShell tool commands hanging until timeout when a child process waited on standard input (Windows)
changes.summary: 修复PowerShell子进程等待stdin导致挂起
changes.summary_en: Fix PowerShell tool hanging when child process waits on stdin
changes.why_matters: 子进程等待标准输入时工具会一直挂起直到超时，降低Windows用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Child processes waiting on stdin caused the tool to hang until timeout, degrading the Windows user experience.

changes.raw: Fixed Python scripts under the PowerShell tool crashing with UnicodeDecodeError when reading non-UTF-8 data from standard input (Windows)
changes.summary: 修复PowerShell下Python读取非UTF-8数据崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix Python UnicodeDecodeError reading non-UTF-8 stdin in PowerShell
changes.why_matters: 非UTF-8编码的输入数据会导致Python脚本崩溃，影响Windows多语言环境兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Non-UTF-8 input data caused Python scripts to crash, affecting Windows multilingual environment compatibility.

changes.raw: Fixed Python scripts run via the PowerShell tool crashing with UnicodeEncodeError on non-ASCII output, and PowerShell 7 error messages containing raw ANSI escape sequences (Windows)
changes.summary: 修复PowerShell下Python输出非ASCII字符崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix Python UnicodeEncodeError on non-ASCII output in PowerShell
changes.why_matters: 非ASCII输出和ANSI转义序列问题影响Windows下脚本执行的可靠性和可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Non-ASCII output and raw ANSI escape issues affected script execution reliability and readability on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed the PowerShell tool reporting `where.exe`, `fc.exe`, and `diff.exe` as errors when they return a valid negative answer (Windows)
changes.summary: 修复PowerShell误报where.exe等命令为错误
changes.summary_en: Fix PowerShell false errors for where.exe, fc.exe, diff.exe
changes.why_matters: 返回有效负结果（如未找到）被误报为错误，干扰用户判断和自动化流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Valid negative results (e.g., not found) were falsely reported as errors, misleading users and disrupting automation.

changes.raw: Fixed `>` and `>>` under the PowerShell tool on Windows PowerShell 5.1 writing UTF-16LE files that other tools couldn't read as UTF-8
changes.summary: 修复PowerShell重定向写入UTF-16LE文件问题
changes.summary_en: Fix PowerShell redirection writing UTF-16LE files unreadable by other tools
changes.why_matters: 重定向生成的UTF-16LE文件无法被其他工具以UTF-8读取，导致跨工具数据断裂。
changes.why_matters_en: Redirection produced UTF-16LE files that other tools couldn't read as UTF-8, breaking cross-tool data flow.

changes.raw: Fixed a displaced background daemon deleting its successor's control socket on shutdown, which made the next client kill the healthy replacement daemon
changes.summary: 修复后台守护进程误删后继进程控制套接字
changes.summary_en: Fix displaced daemon deleting successor's control socket on shutdown
changes.why_matters: 旧守护进程关闭时删除新守护进程的套接字，导致后续客户端杀死健康进程，严重影响稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Old daemon deleting the new daemon's socket caused subsequent clients to kill the healthy replacement, severely impacting stability.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions parked with `←` or `/background` and left idle keeping the background daemon and a worker process alive indefinitely
changes.summary: 修复空闲后台会话无限占用守护进程
changes.summary_en: Fix idle background sessions keeping daemon and worker alive indefinitely
changes.why_matters: 挂起的后台会话不释放资源会导致进程和内存长期占用，影响系统性能。
changes.why_matters_en: Suspended background sessions not releasing resources caused long-running process and memory occupation, impacting system performance.

changes.raw: Fixed completed background sessions being impossible to remove via `claude rm` or the agent view once the background service had gone idle
changes.summary: 修复完成后台会话无法删除问题
changes.summary_en: Fix completed background sessions impossible to remove via claude rm
changes.why_matters: 已完成的后台会话无法清理会导致会话列表堆积，影响管理体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Inability to clean up completed background sessions caused session list accumulation, degrading management experience.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions dispatched from a non-git folder being impossible to delete from the agents view
changes.summary: 修复非git目录后台会话无法删除
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions from non-git folders impossible to delete
changes.why_matters: 非git目录发起的后台会话无法从agents视图删除，影响会话管理完整性。
changes.why_matters_en: Background sessions dispatched from non-git folders couldn't be deleted from the agents view, affecting session management completeness.

changes.raw: Fixed reopening a stopped background session failing to restore its saved conversation when an unreadable folder exists in the session store
changes.summary: 修复存在不可读目录时重开后台会话失败
changes.summary_en: Fix reopening stopped background session failing with unreadable folders
changes.why_matters: 会话存储中存在不可读目录时无法恢复对话历史，影响后台会话连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Unreadable folders in the session store prevented conversation restoration, undermining background session continuity.

changes.raw: Fixed the Remote Control "session ready" push notification firing for sessions where Remote Control was not explicitly enabled
changes.summary: 修复远程控制误发会话就绪通知
changes.summary_en: Fix spurious Remote Control session-ready notification
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在未启用远程控制时收到误导性通知。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misleading notifications when Remote Control is not enabled.

changes.raw: Fixed `/install-github-app` and the `/mcp` settings menu being blocked in agent-view sessions — they're now refused only in background sessions with no terminal attached
changes.summary: 修复agent-view会话中菜单被误拦截
changes.summary_en: Fix install-github-app and mcp menu blocked in agent-view
changes.why_matters: 确保前台agent会话能正常使用GitHub App和MCP设置。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures agent-view sessions can access GitHub App and MCP settings.

changes.raw: Fixed plugins enabled via the `--settings` CLI flag not loading (regression since v2.1.181)
changes.summary: 修复--settings启用的插件未加载
changes.summary_en: Fix plugins via --settings flag not loading (regression)
changes.why_matters: 恢复通过CLI标志启用插件的关键功能，消除回归问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores key plugin-loading functionality broken since v2.1.181.

changes.raw: Fixed feature flags going stale in long-running sessions after the OAuth token rotates
changes.summary: 修复长会话中功能标志过期问题
changes.summary_en: Fix stale feature flags after OAuth token rotation
changes.why_matters: 防止长时间运行会话因令牌轮换导致功能标志失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents long-running sessions from losing feature flags after token rotation.

changes.raw: Fixed `/ultrareview` refusing to run in repos with no merge base — it now offers to review all tracked files
changes.summary: 修复无合并基仓库中ultrareview报错
changes.summary_en: Fix ultrareview failing in repos with no merge base
changes.why_matters: 让无合并基的仓库也能使用代码审查功能。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables ultrareview in repositories lacking a merge base.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude update` and `claude doctor` hanging silently, and the `/status` System diagnostics section going blank, when a shell-config path is a directory
changes.summary: 修复shell配置为目录时命令挂起
changes.summary_en: Fix update/doctor/status hanging when shell-config is a directory
changes.why_matters: 避免因shell配置路径异常导致诊断和更新命令无响应。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents silent hangs in update/doctor/status due to directory shell-config paths.

changes.raw: Fixed memory frontmatter values being silently truncated at an inline `#` when memory files are saved
changes.summary: 修复记忆frontmatter值被#截断
changes.summary_en: Fix memory frontmatter values truncated at inline #
changes.why_matters: 防止记忆文件中含#的元数据被静默截断，避免数据丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents silent truncation of memory metadata containing # characters.

changes.raw: Fixed session cost and token telemetry double-counting on streams that emit multiple cumulative `message_delta` frames
changes.summary: 修复会话成本和token重复计数
changes.summary_en: Fix session cost/token telemetry double-counting
changes.why_matters: 确保用量遥测数据准确，避免成本统计虚高。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures accurate usage telemetry and avoids inflated cost reporting.

changes.raw: Fixed a spurious "check your network" warning that appeared while the advisor was thinking
changes.summary: 修复advisor思考时误显网络警告
changes.summary_en: Fix spurious network warning while advisor is thinking
changes.why_matters: 消除误导性的网络警告，提升用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes a misleading network warning that confused users.

changes.raw: Fixed hooks with exit code 2 not blocking as documented when the hook's stdout JSON fails schema validation
changes.summary: 修复钩子退出码2未按文档阻止执行
changes.summary_en: Fix hooks exit code 2 not blocking on invalid JSON schema
changes.why_matters: 确保钩子行为与文档一致，维护安全拦截能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures hooks block as documented, preserving safety guarantees.

changes.raw: Fixed OTel log events emitted outside the turn's async context missing the interaction span's trace context
changes.summary: 修复OTel日志事件缺失追踪上下文
changes.summary_en: Fix OTel log events missing trace context outside turn
changes.why_matters: 保证可观测性数据链路完整，便于问题排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures complete trace context for reliable observability and debugging.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP transient errors during prompts/resources refresh clearing the server's slash commands and resources
changes.summary: 修复MCP瞬态错误清除斜杠命令
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP transient errors clearing slash commands/resources
changes.why_matters: 避免临时网络错误导致MCP服务器命令和资源被永久清除。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents transient MCP errors from permanently wiping slash commands and resources.

changes.raw: Improved the `claude rc` workspace-trust error in the home directory to say trust there is never saved and to suggest running from a project directory
changes.summary: 改进rc工作区信任错误提示
changes.summary_en: Improve rc workspace-trust error in home directory
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户理解在主目录运行rc的限制并引导正确使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Guides users to run rc from project directories instead of home.

changes.raw: Changed single-segment `dir/**` hook `if:` conditions to match only `<cwd>/dir`; write `**/dir/**` for any-depth matching. `deny`/`ask` permission rules keep their any-depth match.
changes.summary: 变更单段dir/**钩子匹配为仅当前目录
changes.summary_en: Single-segment dir/** hook now matches cwd only
changes.why_matters: 影响钩子匹配行为，用户需更新条件语法以适配新规则。
changes.why_matters_en: Changes hook matching behavior; users must update condition syntax accordingly.

changes.raw: Changed `file` commands using `-m`/`--magic-file` or `-f`/`--files-from` to require permission instead of being auto-allowed as read-only
changes.summary: file命令-m/-f选项改为需权限
changes.summary_en: file commands with -m/-f now require permission
changes.why_matters: 收紧自动放行范围，防止通过选项间接读取敏感文件。
changes.why_matters_en: Tightens auto-allow scope to prevent indirect sensitive file reads.

changes.raw: Changed keep-alive connection pooling to disable after a stale-connection error, so retries open a fresh socket
changes.summary: 修复连接池过期连接导致重试失败
changes.summary_en: Fix stale keep-alive connections causing retry failures
changes.why_matters: 避免过期连接导致重试时复用坏连接而失败
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents retries from reusing stale sockets that would fail again.

changes.raw: Changed SessionStart hooks to report source `"fork"` when a session begins as a fork instead of `"resume"`
changes.summary: SessionStart钩子区分fork与resume来源
changes.summary_en: SessionStart hooks now distinguish fork from resume source
changes.why_matters: 让钩子能根据会话来源执行更精确的逻辑
changes.why_matters_en: Enables hooks to apply more precise logic based on session origin.

signals.title: Show HN: Bento - An entire PowerPoint in one HTML file (edit+view+data+collab)
Claude Code sends 33k tokens before reading the prompt; OpenCode sends 7k
Claude Code uses Bun written in Rust now
The new rules of context engineering for Claude 5 generation models
Show HN: Juggler – an open-source GUI coding agent, by the creator of JUCE

changes.raw: `/fork` now copies your conversation into a new background session (its own row in `claude agents`) while you keep working; the in-session subagent it used to launch is now `/subtask`
changes.summary: /fork将对话复制到后台新会话，原会话继续工作
changes.summary_en: /fork copies conversation to background session, keep working
changes.why_matters: 让用户可以并行探索分支思路而不中断当前工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users explore branches in parallel without interrupting current work.

changes.raw: Added `claude auto-mode reset` to restore the default auto-mode configuration, with a confirmation prompt (pass `--yes` to skip)
changes.summary: 新增auto-mode重置命令，带确认提示
changes.summary_en: Added auto-mode reset command with confirmation prompt
changes.why_matters: 用户可一键恢复默认自动模式配置，避免误配置带来的困扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can restore default auto-mode config, avoiding misconfiguration issues.

changes.raw: Added a session-wide limit on WebSearch tool calls (default 200, tunable via `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION`) to stop runaway search loops
changes.summary: 限制每会话WebSearch调用次数，防止搜索死循环
changes.summary_en: Per-session WebSearch call cap prevents runaway search loops
changes.why_matters: 防止失控的搜索循环消耗大量资源和时间，保护用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents runaway search loops from consuming resources and degrading experience.

changes.raw: Added a per-session cap on subagent spawns (default 200, override with `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENTS_PER_SESSION`) to stop runaway delegation loops; `/clear` resets the budget
changes.summary: 限制每会话子代理生成数，防止委派死循环
changes.summary_en: Per-session subagent spawn cap prevents runaway delegation loops
changes.why_matters: 防止失控的子代理递归生成导致资源耗尽和会话卡死。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents runaway recursive subagent spawning from exhausting resources.

changes.raw: MCP tool calls running longer than 2 minutes now move to the background automatically so the session stays usable; configure the threshold or disable with `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS`
changes.summary: MCP工具超2分钟自动转后台，会话保持可用
changes.summary_en: MCP calls over 2min auto-background, session stays usable
changes.why_matters: 长时间MCP调用不再阻塞会话，用户可继续其他操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Long MCP calls no longer block the session, keeping users productive.

changes.raw: Typing `/resume` in the agent view now opens a picker of past sessions — including sessions deleted from the list — and resumes your pick as a background session
changes.summary: /resume可从历史会话列表中选择并恢复为后台会话
changes.summary_en: /resume opens picker of past sessions, resumes as background
changes.why_matters: 用户可恢复已删除的会话，避免意外丢失工作进度。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can recover deleted sessions, avoiding accidental work loss.

changes.raw: Fixed plan mode auto-running file-modifying Bash commands (e.g. `touch`, `rm`) without a permission prompt or SDK `canUseTool` callback
changes.summary: 修复plan模式自动执行文件修改命令无权限提示
changes.summary_en: Fixed plan mode auto-running file-modifying commands without prompt
changes.why_matters: 计划模式下未经授权执行破坏性命令是严重安全隐患。
changes.why_matters_en: Running destructive commands without authorization in plan mode is a critical security risk.

changes.raw: Fixed worktree creation following a repository-committed symlink at `.claude/worktrees`, which could create files outside the repository
changes.summary: 修复worktree跟随符号链接在仓库外创建文件
changes.summary_en: Fixed worktree creation following symlinks outside repository
changes.why_matters: 符号链接可能导致文件在仓库外创建，存在安全和数据风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Symlinks could cause files outside the repo, posing security and data risks.

changes.raw: Fixed a `continue:false` hook's halt being dropped when the tool fails or completes mid-stream, and hook infrastructure errors being misreported as user rejections
changes.summary: 修复hook中断信号丢失及错误误报为用户拒绝
changes.summary_en: Fixed hook halt being dropped and errors misreported as user rejections
changes.why_matters: 钩子中断逻辑错误可能导致工具执行未被正确阻止或误导调试。
changes.why_matters_en: Broken hook halt logic may fail to stop tools or mislead debugging.

changes.raw: Fixed SIGTERM during a running Bash tool orphaning the command's process tree in print/SDK mode; the CLI now aborts the turn, kills the tree, and exits 143
changes.summary: 修复SIGTERM导致Bash进程树孤立，现正确终止并退出
changes.summary_en: Fixed SIGTERM orphaning Bash process tree; now kills and exits 143
changes.why_matters: 孤立进程会持续消耗资源，正确清理对系统稳定性至关重要。
changes.why_matters_en: Orphaned processes waste resources; proper cleanup is critical for stability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/background` and `claude --bg` failing with "EUNKNOWN: unknown error, uv_spawn" on Windows when Group Policy blocks PowerShell 5.1; the daemon now prefers PowerShell 7
changes.summary: 修复Windows组策略阻止PowerShell时后台模式失败
changes.summary_en: Fixed background mode failing on Windows with Group Policy blocking PS5.1
changes.why_matters: Windows企业用户常受组策略限制，优先使用PowerShell 7提升兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Windows enterprise users often face Group Policy limits; preferring PS7 improves compatibility.

changes.raw: Fixed shell mode (`!`) not executing commands containing file paths while the path autocomplete popup was open
changes.summary: 修复shell模式路径补全弹窗时命令无法执行
changes.summary_en: Fixed shell mode not executing commands with autocomplete popup open
changes.why_matters: 路径补全弹窗干扰命令执行影响日常使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Autocomplete popup interfering with command execution affects daily usability.

changes.raw: Fixed auto-mode denial notifications rendering broken characters when a long denial reason was truncated mid-emoji
changes.summary: 修复auto-mode拒绝通知中emoji截断导致乱码
changes.summary_en: Fixed broken characters when denial reason truncated mid-emoji
changes.why_matters: 界面乱码影响可读性，虽属小问题但降低专业感。
changes.why_matters_en: Broken characters hurt readability; minor but reduces polish.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+J not inserting a newline in the agent view dispatch input on terminals with extended key reporting, and surfaced the newline shortcut in the `?` help overlay
changes.summary: 修复Ctrl+J无法在agent视图插入换行并显示快捷键
changes.summary_en: Fixed Ctrl+J not inserting newline in agent view, added to help overlay
changes.why_matters: 换行是基础编辑功能，修复后提升多行输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Newline is a basic editing function; fix improves multi-line input experience.

changes.raw: Fixed `/ultrareview` rejecting PR references like `#123`, `PR 123`, and pasted PR URLs; error hints now name the command you actually typed
changes.summary: 修复/ultrareview拒绝PR引用格式，错误提示更准确
changes.summary_en: Fixed /ultrareview rejecting PR references like #123 and URLs
changes.why_matters: PR引用是常见操作，支持多种格式提升代码审查流程效率。
changes.why_matters_en: PR references are common; supporting multiple formats improves review workflow.

changes.raw: Fixed `/ultrareview <branch>` not fetching the branch from origin when it exists remotely; it now suggests the closest branch name on typos
changes.summary: 修复ultrareview远程分支获取及拼写建议
changes.summary_en: Fix ultrareview remote branch fetch and typo suggestions
changes.why_matters: 确保用户能正确拉取远程分支进行代码审查，减少因拼写错误导致的失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures users can correctly fetch remote branches for review and reduces failures from typos.

changes.raw: Fixed `/ultrareview` skipping the billing confirmation in a new conversation after `/clear`
changes.summary: 修复clear后ultrareview跳过计费确认
changes.summary_en: Fix ultrareview skipping billing confirmation after /clear
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在清除会话后意外产生计费，保障使用透明度。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unexpected billing after clearing a session, ensuring usage transparency.

changes.raw: Fixed `/ultrareview`'s "not a git repository" error on Claude Desktop now suggesting the project's repository folder instead of terminal commands
changes.summary: 修复Desktop下非git仓库错误提示
changes.summary_en: Fix non-git repo error on Desktop to suggest project folder
changes.why_matters: 帮助Desktop用户更直观地定位项目仓库目录，降低使用门槛。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps Desktop users locate the project repo folder more intuitively, lowering barriers.

changes.raw: Fixed hosted (host-managed) sessions failing at startup when repository settings configured mTLS certs, extra CA bundles, or OAuth scopes; these transport settings are now ignored with a warning
changes.summary: 修复托管会话因mTLS等配置启动失败
changes.summary_en: Fix hosted sessions failing on mTLS/CA/OAuth transport settings
changes.why_matters: 避免企业级安全配置导致托管会话无法启动，保障远程协作可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents enterprise security configs from blocking hosted session startup, ensuring remote collaboration.

changes.raw: Fixed a spurious "File has not been read yet" error when editing a file that had been read with offset/limit before resuming a session
changes.summary: 修复分页读取文件后编辑报未读错误
changes.summary_en: Fix false 'File not read yet' error after partial read on resume
changes.why_matters: 消除会话恢复后编辑已读文件时的误报，提升编辑流程连贯性。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates false errors when editing partially-read files after session resume, improving flow.

changes.raw: Fixed `ExitWorktree` failing with "no active EnterWorktree session" after resuming a session with `--continue`/`--resume` in print/SDK mode
changes.summary: 修复恢复会话后ExitWorktree失败
changes.summary_en: Fix ExitWorktree failing after session resume in print/SDK mode
changes.why_matters: 确保会话恢复后工作树管理操作正常，避免工作区残留。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures worktree management works after session resume, avoiding workspace leftovers.

changes.raw: Fixed the workflow agent grid staying empty for Remote Control clients that join a session mid-run
changes.summary: 修复远程控制客户端加入时代理网格为空
changes.summary_en: Fix empty agent grid for Remote Control clients joining mid-run
changes.why_matters: 确保中途加入的远程客户端能看到代理状态，保障协作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures mid-run remote clients can see agent status, maintaining collaboration UX.

changes.raw: Fixed streaming-mode control requests being marked complete before their handler finished, which could lose the request on session restart
changes.summary: 修复流式控制请求提前标记完成致丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix streaming control requests marked complete before handler finishes
changes.why_matters: 防止会话重启时控制请求丢失，保障自动化任务可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents control request loss on session restart, ensuring automation reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions created with `/fork` losing their live-parent protection after a state write failure
changes.summary: 修复fork后台会话状态写入失败后失去保护
changes.summary_en: Fix forked background sessions losing live-parent protection on state write failure
changes.why_matters: 避免后台会话在异常后失去父会话保护，防止意外终止或资源泄漏。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents background sessions from losing parent protection after errors, avoiding leaks or kills.

changes.raw: Fixed reopening a stopped background session from the agent view failing silently — it now resumes the session, or shows why it can't and lets you force a restart
changes.summary: 修复从代理视图重开已停止会话静默失败
changes.summary_en: Fix silent failure when reopening stopped background session from agent view
changes.why_matters: 让用户能恢复或了解无法恢复的原因，提升后台会话管理体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users resume or understand why they can't, improving background session management.

changes.raw: Fixed agent teams: a stopping teammate could send the leader duplicate idle notifications when team initialization re-ran within a session
changes.summary: 修复代理团队停止时重复空闲通知
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate idle notifications when a stopping teammate re-inits team
changes.why_matters: 避免重复通知干扰团队协作流程，减少误导性状态信号。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids duplicate notifications disrupting team coordination and misleading status signals.

changes.raw: Fixed the plan-approval dialog footer splitting "ctrl+g to edit in <editor>" apart when the file path is long
changes.summary: 修复长路径时计划审批对话框底部布局错乱
changes.summary_en: Fix plan-approval dialog footer splitting on long file paths
changes.why_matters: 改善长文件路径下的界面显示，避免编辑快捷键提示被截断。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves UI display for long file paths, preventing editor shortcut hints from breaking.

changes.raw: Fixed the welcome banner keeping its old panel widths after a combined width+height terminal resize in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 修复全屏模式下终端调整大小后面板宽度异常
changes.summary_en: Fix welcome banner keeping old panel widths after terminal resize
changes.why_matters: 确保终端窗口大小变化后面板布局正确，提升界面一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures correct panel layout after terminal resize, improving UI consistency.

changes.raw: Fixed diff previews losing their line numbers and +/- markers in narrow layouts
changes.summary: 修复窄布局下diff预览丢失行号和标记
changes.summary_en: Fix diff previews losing line numbers and +/- markers in narrow layouts
changes.why_matters: 保证窄屏环境下代码差异可读性，避免关键信息丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Preserves diff readability in narrow layouts, preventing loss of key markers.

changes.raw: Fixed @-mentions attaching nothing after a partial file read, plugin uninstall targeting the wrong marketplace, and false "Command timed out" on exit code 143
changes.summary: 修复@提及、插件卸载及退出码143误报超时
changes.summary_en: Fix @-mention after partial read, plugin uninstall target, false timeout on exit 143
changes.why_matters: 一次性解决多个影响日常使用的交互与插件问题，提升整体稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Resolves multiple daily-use interaction and plugin issues at once, improving overall stability.

changes.raw: Fixed OpenTelemetry HTTP exports being rejected with 411/400 by Azure Monitor and other endpoints that don't accept chunked transfer encoding
changes.summary: 修复OTLP导出被Azure Monitor拒绝的问题
changes.summary_en: Fix OTLP HTTP exports rejected by Azure Monitor
changes.why_matters: 确保遥测数据能成功导出到不支持分块传输的端点。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures telemetry data exports successfully to endpoints that reject chunked encoding.

changes.raw: Fixed OTLP event log records missing `trace_id`/`span_id` when `TRACEPARENT` is set in SDK/headless mode
changes.summary: 修复OTLP事件日志缺失trace_id/span_id
changes.summary_en: Fix OTLP event logs missing trace_id/span_id in SDK mode
changes.why_matters: 保证链路追踪在SDK/headless模式下可正确关联。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures trace correlation works correctly in SDK and headless modes.

changes.raw: Fixed conversations with many images incorrectly failing with "Request too large" errors, and improved the error message to explain the actual cause
changes.summary: 修复多图片对话报错Request too large
changes.summary_en: Fix multi-image conversations failing with 'Request too large'
changes.why_matters: 多图片场景常见，修复后用户体验显著提升。
changes.why_matters_en: Multi-image scenarios are common; fixing this significantly improves user experience.

changes.raw: Fixed web search and web fetch returning "API Error" text as search results or page content when the API was overloaded
changes.summary: 修复web搜索过载时返回错误文本
changes.summary_en: Fix web search/fetch returning error text as results
changes.why_matters: 避免API过载时将错误信息误当作搜索结果呈现给用户。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents API overload errors from being presented as actual search results to users.

changes.raw: Improved web search and web fetch reliability by retrying 529 errors and rate-limited requests with bounded backoff
changes.summary: 提升web搜索可靠性，增加重试与退避
changes.summary_en: Improve web search reliability with retry and backoff
changes.why_matters: 在API过载或限流时自动重试，减少搜索失败率。
changes.why_matters_en: Automatic retries during overload or rate-limiting reduce search failure rates.

changes.raw: Improved prompt caching: the mid-conversation system block now works behind LLM gateways and custom base URLs (Bedrock, Vertex, 1P)
changes.summary: 提示缓存支持LLM网关和自定义base URL
changes.summary_en: Prompt caching works behind LLM gateways and custom URLs
changes.why_matters: 使Bedrock、Vertex等平台用户也能享受缓存带来的成本和延迟优化。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets Bedrock, Vertex, and other gateway users benefit from caching cost and latency savings.

changes.raw: Improved background agent attach: cold-attaching now instantly shows the formatted transcript while the session boots, instead of a blank wait
changes.summary: 后台代理冷附加时即时显示转录
changes.summary_en: Background agent cold-attach instantly shows transcript
changes.why_matters: 消除冷附加时的空白等待，提升交互流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates blank wait during cold-attach, improving interaction smoothness.

changes.raw: Reduced token usage in inter-agent messaging: `SendMessage` bodies are no longer duplicated into replayed history and tool results
changes.summary: 减少代理间消息的token重复消耗
changes.summary_en: Reduce token usage in inter-agent messaging
changes.why_matters: 避免消息体在历史和工具结果中重复，显著降低token成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates message body duplication in history and tool results, cutting token costs.

changes.raw: Changed `/fork` to name the copy after your prompt when the session has no title, so the row is recognizable in the agent view
changes.summary: /fork无标题时以提示命名副本
changes.summary_en: /fork names copy after prompt when untitled
changes.why_matters: 使分叉会话在代理视图中更易识别。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes forked sessions recognizable in the agent view.

changes.raw: Changed bare `/btw` to reopen the side-question panel on your most recent exchange so you can browse earlier answers
changes.summary: 裸/btw重新打开最近侧问面板
changes.summary_en: Bare /btw reopens side-question panel on last exchange
changes.why_matters: 方便用户浏览之前的侧问回答。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users conveniently browse earlier side-question answers.

changes.raw: Changed the `←` footer hint to pulse `N done` for a moment when a background agent finishes while nothing needs your input
changes.summary: 后台代理完成时页脚提示脉冲显示
changes.summary_en: Footer hint pulses when background agent finishes
changes.why_matters: 在无需用户输入时以视觉提示通知后台任务完成。
changes.why_matters_en: Provides a visual cue when background tasks complete without requiring user input.

changes.raw: Deprecated the Task tool's `mode` parameter (now ignored); subagents inherit the parent session's permission mode by default
changes.summary: 废弃Task工具mode参数，继承父权限
changes.summary_en: Deprecate Task tool mode param; subagents inherit parent perms
changes.why_matters: 简化权限模型，子代理默认继承父会话权限模式。
changes.why_matters_en: Simplifies permission model; subagents inherit parent session permissions by default.

changes.raw: Changed Enterprise `forceLoginMethod` to be enforced for VS Code extension, SDK, `setup-token`, and `install-github-app` logins, not just the terminal
changes.summary: 企业forceLoginMethod扩展至所有登录入口
changes.summary_en: Enterprise forceLoginMethod enforced across all login paths
changes.why_matters: 确保VS Code、SDK等非终端入口也遵守企业登录策略。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures VS Code, SDK, and other non-terminal entry points comply with enterprise login policy.

changes.raw: Changed session transcripts to record the reasoning effort level on each assistant message
changes.summary: 会话转录记录每条消息的推理强度
changes.summary_en: Transcripts record reasoning effort per assistant message
changes.why_matters: 便于审计和回溯每轮对话的推理配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables auditing and tracing of reasoning configuration per conversation turn.

changes.raw: Changed headless/SDK sessions to apply a `set_model` control request mid-turn; the next model round-trip uses the new model instead of waiting for the next turn
changes.summary: SDK/headless会话支持中途切换模型
changes.summary_en: Headless/SDK sessions apply mid-turn model switching
changes.why_matters: 允许在对话中途切换模型，下一轮即生效，无需等待新回合。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows mid-conversation model switching that takes effect on the next round-trip.

changes.raw: Changed agent view / `claude agents --json`: sessions waiting on a sandbox, MCP-input, or managed-settings prompt now show as "Needs input" instead of "Working"
changes.summary: 代理视图区分等待输入与运行中状态
changes.summary_en: Agent view distinguishes waiting-for-input from working
changes.why_matters: 让用户能准确识别需要人工介入的会话，减少误判等待时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users accurately identify sessions needing human input, reducing misjudged wait times.

changes.raw: Updated the auth status panel title from "Cloud authentication" to "Authentication"
changes.summary: 认证面板标题简化为"认证"
changes.summary_en: Auth panel title simplified to "Authentication"
changes.why_matters: 仅是措辞调整，对实际使用体验影响极小。
changes.why_matters_en: A minor wording adjustment with negligible impact on actual usage.

changes.raw: Corrected an earlier release note (2.1.200): tmux through the 3.6 series lacks synchronized output; newer tmux with support is detected automatically
changes.summary: 更正tmux同步输出相关的发布说明
changes.summary_en: Corrected release note about tmux synchronized output
changes.why_matters: 修正文档信息以确保用户对tmux兼容性的理解准确。
changes.why_matters_en: Corrects documentation so users understand tmux compatibility accurately.

signals.title: Show HN: Bento - An entire PowerPoint in one HTML file (edit+view+data+collab)
Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
Claude Code sends 33k tokens before reading the prompt; OpenCode sends 7k
Claude Code uses Bun written in Rust now
Show HN: Juggler – an open-source GUI coding agent, by the creator of JUCE

changes.raw: Added `--forward-subagent-text` flag and `CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT` environment variable to include subagent text and thinking in stream-json output
changes.summary: 支持转发子代理文本到流式JSON输出
changes.summary_en: Forward subagent text and thinking to stream-json output
changes.why_matters: 使自动化流程能获取子代理的完整推理过程。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables automation pipelines to capture subagent reasoning and text.

changes.raw: Fixed permission previews relayed to chat channels not neutralizing bidirectional-override, zero-width, and look-alike quote characters, so tool inputs cannot visually alter the approval message
changes.summary: 修复权限预览中的Unicode注入漏洞
changes.summary_en: Fix Unicode bidi/zero-width injection in permission previews
changes.why_matters: 防止攻击者通过特殊字符篡改审批消息的视觉显示。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents attackers from visually altering approval messages via special characters.

changes.raw: Fixed auto mode overriding a PreToolUse hook's `ask` decision for unsandboxed Bash — a hook `ask` now floors the decision at a prompt
changes.summary: 修复自动模式覆盖钩子的ask决策
changes.summary_en: Fix auto mode overriding PreToolUse hook ask decision for Bash
changes.why_matters: 确保安全钩子的审批决策不会被自动模式绕过。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures security hook ask decisions are respected even in auto mode.

changes.raw: Fixed parallel Claude Code sessions all logging out simultaneously after wake-from-sleep when many sessions share one credential store
changes.summary: 修复多会话唤醒后同时登出问题
changes.summary_en: Fix parallel sessions all logging out after wake-from-sleep
changes.why_matters: 避免多会话共享凭证时唤醒后全部掉线影响工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents disruptive mass logouts when many sessions share one credential store.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin MCP servers not reconnecting after an idle web session woke, leaving MCP calls failing until the next message
changes.summary: 修复空闲唤醒后MCP服务器断连
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin MCP servers not reconnecting after idle session wake
changes.why_matters: 确保唤醒后MCP工具调用能正常恢复工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures MCP tool calls resume normally after idle session wakes.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude Code on Vertex and Bedrock attempting the default Opus model at startup and printing a spurious fallback notice when a model is explicitly configured
changes.summary: 修复Vertex/Bedrock启动时误报模型回退
changes.summary_en: Fix spurious Opus fallback notice on Vertex/Bedrock with explicit model
changes.why_matters: 消除显式配置模型时的误导性回退提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes confusing fallback notices when a model is explicitly configured.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents spawned with an explicit model override reverting to the parent's model when resumed or sent a follow-up message
changes.summary: 修复子代理模型覆盖在恢复时丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent model override reverting on resume or follow-up
changes.why_matters: 确保子代理在恢复或追问时保持指定的模型配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures subagents retain their explicit model override across resume and follow-ups.

changes.raw: Fixed nested `.claude/rules/*.md` files loading even when setting sources exclude project settings
changes.summary: 修复排除项目设置时仍加载嵌套规则
changes.summary_en: Fix nested .claude/rules loading when settings exclude project config
changes.why_matters: 尊重设置排除项，避免加载不应加载的规则文件。
changes.why_matters_en: Respects setting exclusion sources so unwanted nested rules are not loaded.

changes.raw: Fixed file upload validation: filenames ending in a DOS device suffix (`.prn`) or trailing dot are now accepted, and files with multiple hard links are refused
changes.summary: 修复文件上传校验对DOS设备名和硬链接
changes.summary_en: Fix file upload validation for DOS device suffixes and hard links
changes.why_matters: 正确处理特殊文件名并拒绝多硬链接文件以避免歧义。
changes.why_matters_en: Correctly handles special filenames and refuses multi-hard-link files to avoid ambiguity.

changes.raw: Fixed file uploads to Claude in Chrome from remote and CLI sessions
changes.summary: 修复Chrome扩展远程和CLI文件上传
changes.summary_en: Fix file uploads to Claude in Chrome from remote and CLI sessions
changes.why_matters: 恢复远程和CLI会话中文件上传的正常功能。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores file upload functionality in remote and CLI sessions via Chrome.

changes.raw: Fixed edits that leave the input as "?" being silently swallowed and toggling the shortcuts panel
changes.summary: 修复问号输入被吞并触发快捷键面板
changes.summary_en: Fix '?' input edits being swallowed and toggling shortcuts panel
changes.why_matters: 避免用户编辑输入为问号时的意外行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unexpected behavior when user edits input to a single question mark.

changes.raw: Fixed a startup hang when the Claude in Chrome extension is enabled but Chrome is not running
changes.summary: 修复Chrome未运行时扩展导致启动挂起
changes.summary_en: Fix startup hang when Chrome extension enabled but Chrome not running
changes.why_matters: 避免Chrome未运行时Claude Code启动卡死。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents Claude Code from hanging at startup when Chrome is not running.

changes.raw: Fixed a 300ms delay revealing async content (Settings tabs, Stats, diff views, and other loading states)
changes.summary: 修复300ms延迟导致异步内容闪现
changes.summary_en: Fix 300ms delay revealing async loading states prematurely
changes.why_matters: 消除加载状态闪烁，提升界面响应体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates premature loading state flicker for smoother UI experience.

changes.raw: Fixed reopening a just-stopped background session from the agents view starting a blank conversation under the same session id
changes.summary: 修复重开后台会话启动空白对话
changes.summary_en: Fix reopening stopped background session starting blank conversation
changes.why_matters: 避免重开已停止会话时丢失历史对话内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents loss of conversation history when reopening a stopped background session.

changes.raw: Fixed `/loop` hiding the session from `/resume` after a single use
changes.summary: 修复/loop使用后会话从/resume消失
changes.summary_en: Fix /loop hiding session from /resume after single use
changes.why_matters: 确保循环会话仍可通过resume恢复，不丢失工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures looped sessions remain resumable so users don't lose work.

changes.raw: Fixed screen reader users losing the audible terminal bell after `/terminal-setup` or onboarding terminal setup
changes.summary: 修复终端设置后屏幕阅读器丢失铃声
changes.summary_en: Fix screen reader bell loss after terminal setup
changes.why_matters: 无障碍体验对依赖屏幕阅读器的用户至关重要。
changes.why_matters_en: Accessibility is critical for screen reader users.

changes.raw: Fixed background jobs on LLM gateway auth (`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` + `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) coming back "Not logged in" after the daemon respawns them
changes.summary: 修复LLM网关后台任务认证失效问题
changes.summary_en: Fix background job auth failure on LLM gateway after daemon respawn
changes.why_matters: 使用自定义网关的后台任务认证中断会导致任务无法执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Auth failures on custom gateways break background task execution.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` jobs becoming permanently undeletable when git no longer recognizes their worktree — the row now shows why the delete was refused instead of silently reappearing
changes.summary: 修复git无法识别worktree时代理任务无法删除
changes.summary_en: Fix undeletable agent jobs when git loses worktree recognition
changes.why_matters: 任务无法删除且无提示会严重干扰用户的工作流管理。
changes.why_matters_en: Silently undeletable jobs severely disrupt workflow management.

changes.raw: Fixed `/clear` not resetting the session cost counter — the statusline's cost now starts at $0 after `/clear`
changes.summary: 修复/clear后费用计数器未重置
changes.summary_en: Fix session cost counter not resetting after /clear
changes.why_matters: 费用显示不准确会误导用户对成本的判断。
changes.why_matters_en: Inaccurate cost display misleads users about spending.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude in Chrome setup pages failing to open in the browser on Windows
changes.summary: 修复Windows上浏览器无法打开Claude设置页
changes.summary_en: Fix Claude in Chrome setup pages not opening on Windows
changes.why_matters: Windows用户无法完成浏览器集成设置会阻断使用流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Windows users are blocked from completing browser integration setup.

changes.raw: Fixed headless print-mode sessions on Windows crashing or silently exiting when stdin is unreadable
changes.summary: 修复Windows无头模式stdin不可读时崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix headless print-mode crash on Windows when stdin is unreadable
changes.why_matters: 无头模式崩溃会中断自动化和CI/CD流水线中的使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Headless crashes disrupt automation and CI/CD pipeline usage.

changes.raw: Fixed background session titles in the agents view showing the naming model's refusal text when the prompt contains a link
changes.summary: 修复后台代理标题显示模型拒绝文本
changes.summary_en: Fix background agent titles showing model refusal text
changes.why_matters: 标题显示错误信息会降低代理视图的可读性和可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Refusal text in titles degrades agent view readability and usability.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents killed by the user auto-respawning, and revived agents re-running stale prompts from old sessions
changes.summary: 修复被用户终止的后台代理自动重启并重跑旧提示
changes.summary_en: Fix killed background agents auto-respawning and re-running stale prompts
changes.why_matters: 用户终止的代理自动重启并执行旧指令可能导致意外操作和资源浪费。
changes.why_matters_en: Auto-reviving killed agents with stale prompts risks unintended actions and wasted resources.

changes.raw: Fixed routines with no schedule reporting a next run time in the year 1
changes.summary: 修复无计划例程显示公元1年的下次运行时间
changes.summary_en: Fix unscheduled routines showing year 1 next run time
changes.why_matters: 显示荒谬的时间戳会降低用户对调度系统的信任。
changes.why_matters_en: Absurd timestamps undermine user trust in the scheduling system.

changes.raw: Hardened synced skill/plugin directory naming on Windows and kept CCR web fetch/search proxies working after `/clear`
changes.summary: 加固Windows插件目录命名并修复/clear后代理失效
changes.summary_en: Harden plugin dir naming on Windows and keep proxies working after /clear
changes.why_matters: 目录命名安全性和代理持久性直接影响插件和搜索功能的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Directory naming safety and proxy persistence directly affect plugin and search reliability.

changes.raw: Improved terminal layout and rendering performance
changes.summary: 提升终端布局和渲染性能
changes.summary_en: Improve terminal layout and rendering performance
changes.why_matters: 更流畅的终端渲染显著改善用户交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Smoother terminal rendering significantly improves user interaction experience.

changes.raw: Improved background agent result reporting — Claude now reports the status of still-running agents and waits for the real completion instead of fabricating results
changes.summary: 改进后台代理结果报告，不再编造结果
changes.summary_en: Improve background agent reporting to wait for real completion
changes.why_matters: 编造结果会误导用户决策，等待真实完成确保结果可信。
changes.why_matters_en: Fabricated results mislead decisions; waiting for real completion ensures trustworthiness.

changes.raw: Improved the memory index over-limit warning to measure only loaded content, excluding frontmatter and HTML comments
changes.summary: 改进内存索引超限警告，排除元数据
changes.summary_en: Improve memory index over-limit warning to exclude frontmatter
changes.why_matters: 更准确的超限测量避免误报警告，减少用户困扰。
changes.why_matters_en: More accurate limit measurement avoids false warnings and reduces user friction.

changes.raw: Updated integer environment variables (timeouts, token budgets, retry counts) to accept scientific notation and digit-separator spellings like `1e6` and `64_000`
changes.summary: 环境变量支持科学计数法和数字分隔符
changes.summary_en: Integer env vars now accept scientific notation and digit separators
changes.why_matters: 更灵活的数值格式提升配置便捷性和可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Flexible number formats improve configuration convenience and readability.

changes.raw: Updated documentation links to the current docs sites
changes.summary: 更新文档链接至最新文档站点
changes.summary_en: Update documentation links to current docs sites
changes.why_matters: 确保用户访问最新文档，避免链接失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures users access current documentation and avoids broken links.

changes.raw: Changed "always allow" permission rules to save at the repository root, so approvals granted in a git worktree persist across sessions and worktrees
changes.summary: 允许规则保存至仓库根目录，跨工作树持久化
changes.summary_en: Permission rules saved at repo root, persist across worktrees
changes.why_matters: 用户在git worktree中授权后无需重复操作，提升多工作树场景下的效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users don't need to re-approve permissions in each worktree, improving multi-worktree workflows.

changes.raw: Changed `/usage-credits` to ask for confirmation before sending a request to organization admins
changes.summary: 使用额度请求前需确认，避免误发管理员
changes.summary_en: Usage credits request now asks confirmation before contacting admins
changes.why_matters: 防止用户意外向组织管理员发送请求，减少不必要的打扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental requests being sent to organization admins, reducing unnecessary interruptions.

changes.raw: Changed Vim mode `s` and `S` (substitute char/line) to work in NORMAL mode, matching vim behavior
changes.summary: 修复Vim模式s/S替换命令，匹配标准行为
changes.summary_en: Fixed Vim mode s/S substitute commands to match standard vim behavior
changes.why_matters: Vim用户可获得符合预期的编辑体验，减少操作困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Vim users get expected editing behavior, reducing confusion during use.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Updated the Remote Control banner to describe what it does
changes.summary: 更新VSCode远程控制横幅说明
changes.summary_en: Updated VSCode Remote Control banner description
changes.why_matters: 用户能更好理解远程控制功能的用途，提升使用透明度。
changes.why_matters_en: Users better understand what Remote Control does, improving feature transparency.

changes.raw: Claude in Chrome: hardened file-upload path validation
changes.summary: 强化Chrome扩展文件上传路径校验
changes.summary_en: Hardened file-upload path validation in Claude in Chrome
changes.why_matters: 防止路径遍历等安全风险，保护用户文件系统安全。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents path traversal and other security risks, protecting user filesystem integrity.

changes.raw: Claude in Chrome: `save_to_disk` on screenshot actions now writes the image to disk and returns the path; previously it did nothing
changes.summary: 修复截图保存到磁盘功能，之前无效
changes.summary_en: Fixed save_to_disk on screenshots; now writes image and returns path
changes.why_matters: 截图保存功能现在可正常使用，之前完全不起作用。
changes.why_matters_en: Screenshot saving now works as expected; previously the action did nothing.

changes.raw: Fixed a prompt-caching regression on Bedrock, Vertex, Mantle, and Foundry that billed the trailing system context block as fresh input tokens on every request.
changes.summary: 修复多平台提示缓存回归，避免重复计费
changes.summary_en: Fixed prompt-caching regression causing repeated billing on Bedrock/Vertex/etc
changes.why_matters: 避免用户因缓存失效在每次请求中产生额外token费用，显著降低使用成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unnecessary token costs from caching regression, significantly reducing usage expenses.

Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
Claude Code sends 33k tokens before reading the prompt; OpenCode sends 7k
Claude Code uses Bun written in Rust now
Show HN: Juggler – an open-source GUI coding agent, by the creator of JUCE

changes.raw: Added a live elapsed-time counter to the collapsed tool summary line so long-running tool calls visibly tick instead of looking stuck
changes.summary: 折叠工具栏显示实时计时器
changes.summary_en: Live elapsed-time counter on collapsed tool summary
changes.why_matters: 让用户能直观看到长时间运行的工具调用仍在执行，避免误以为卡死。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users see long-running tool calls are still active instead of appearing stuck.

changes.raw: Added a startup warning for `Write(path)`, `NotebookEdit(path)`, and `Glob(path)` permission rules — use `Edit(path)` or `Read(path)` instead
changes.summary: 启动时警告过时权限规则
changes.summary_en: Startup warning for outdated permission rules
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户及时纠正已废弃的权限配置，避免权限规则静默失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users correct deprecated permission rules before they silently fail.

changes.raw: Fixed `isolation: 'worktree'` subagents being able to run git-mutating commands against the main repo checkout instead of their own isolated worktree
changes.summary: 修复worktree子代理可操作主仓库
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree subagents mutating main repo checkout
changes.why_matters: 隔离子代理原本可能绕过隔离边界修改主仓库，存在严重安全和数据风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Isolated subagents could bypass isolation and mutate the main repo, a serious security risk.

changes.raw: Fixed the `ultracode` keyword opt-in firing on non-human-originated input such as webhook payloads and relayed PR comments
changes.summary: 修复ultracode关键词被非人类输入触发
changes.summary_en: Fix ultracode keyword firing on non-human input
changes.why_matters: 防止webhook和PR评论等自动化输入意外触发高能力模式，避免不可控行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents automated inputs like webhooks from unexpectedly triggering high-capability mode.

changes.raw: Fixed a rendered text fragment leaking into crash telemetry when a UI component returned content outside a styled text element
changes.summary: 修复文本片段泄漏到崩溃遥测
changes.summary_en: Fix text fragment leaking into crash telemetry
changes.why_matters: 避免无关渲染内容污染崩溃报告，提升遥测数据质量和隐私保护。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stray rendered content from polluting crash reports, improving telemetry quality.

changes.raw: Fixed paste markers leaking into external editors opened from Claude Code, which could appear as stray È/É characters around pasted text
changes.summary: 修复粘贴标记泄漏到外部编辑器
changes.summary_en: Fix paste markers leaking into external editors
changes.why_matters: 消除外部编辑器中出现的乱码字符，提升跨工具编辑体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates stray characters in external editors, improving cross-tool editing experience.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude attach` sometimes failing with "job not found" or "agent is still starting" errors during session transitions — attach now waits for the daemon to settle, and terminal resizes during a slow attach are applied once it completes
changes.summary: 修复claude attach会话切换失败
changes.summary_en: Fix claude attach failures during session transitions
changes.why_matters: 会话切换时attach失败严重影响多会话工作流，修复后连接更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Attach failures during session transitions disrupt workflows; fix makes connections reliable.

changes.raw: Fixed a session crash when a tool's result renderer returned a numeric bigint value or plain text instead of a UI element
changes.summary: 修复bigint返回值导致会话崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix session crash on bigint tool result renderer
changes.why_matters: 工具返回非常规类型时不再崩溃，提升工具结果渲染的健壮性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes when tools return non-standard types, improving renderer robustness.

changes.raw: Fixed a hook callback timeout being misreported to the model as a user rejection, which made unattended sessions stop and wait
changes.summary: 修复hook超时被误报为用户拒绝
changes.summary_en: Fix hook timeout misreported as user rejection
changes.why_matters: 无人值守会话因误报而停止等待，修复后自动化流程不再中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Unattended sessions no longer stop due to misreported timeouts, keeping automation running.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude assuming a `cd` took effect after its command was moved to the background; the tool result now states the working directory is unchanged
changes.summary: 修复后台cd后工作目录未改变的误判
changes.summary_en: Fix cd assumed effective after backgrounding
changes.why_matters: 避免Claude在错误目录下执行后续操作，防止文件路径混乱和潜在损坏。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents Claude from operating in wrong directory after backgrounded cd, avoiding path confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin-provided MCP servers being torn down when MCP servers are re-synced mid-session
changes.summary: 修复会话中MCP服务器被误销毁
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin MCP servers torn down on re-sync
changes.why_matters: 会话中途MCP服务器被销毁会导致插件功能中断，修复后集成更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP servers being destroyed mid-session breaks plugin functionality; fix stabilizes integrations.

changes.raw: Fixed plan approvals without edits being labeled "(edited by user)" and overwriting the plan file with a stale snapshot
changes.summary: 修复计划审批误标为已编辑
changes.summary_en: Fix plan approvals mislabeled as user-edited
changes.why_matters: 防止计划文件被过期快照覆盖，确保审批流程的准确性和可追溯性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents plan files from being overwritten by stale snapshots, ensuring approval accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed `/doctor` skipping its auto-mode-default proposal on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, where auto mode no longer needs an opt-in
changes.summary: 修复/doctor在Bedrock等跳过提议
changes.summary_en: Fix /doctor skipping auto-mode proposal on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry
changes.why_matters: 确保各平台用户都能正确获取自动模式配置建议，提升跨平台一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures users on all platforms get correct auto-mode configuration guidance.

changes.raw: Fixed Grep content mode claiming "No matches found" when paginating past the end of results
changes.summary: 修复Grep分页末尾误报无匹配
changes.summary_en: Fix Grep falsely reporting no matches past end of results
changes.why_matters: 消除分页浏览搜索结果时的误导性提示，改善搜索体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates misleading 'no matches' message when paginating past results, improving search UX.

changes.raw: Fixed unmatched `$1`/`$2` positional placeholders in skills and commands being silently stripped; they are now preserved verbatim
changes.summary: 修复位置占位符被静默删除
changes.summary_en: Fix positional placeholders silently stripped in skills/commands
changes.why_matters: 保留$1/$2占位符确保自定义技能和命令的参数传递正确无误。
changes.why_matters_en: Preserving $1/$2 placeholders ensures correct parameter passing in custom skills and commands.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin cache writes leaving temp files behind on failure and failing on locked-file renames on Windows and network filesystems
changes.summary: 修复插件缓存写入遗留临时文件问题
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin cache temp file leaks on write failure
changes.why_matters: 避免Windows和网络文件系统上因文件锁定导致的缓存写入失败和临时文件堆积。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents temp file accumulation and write failures on Windows and network filesystems.

changes.raw: Fixed background workers crash-looping when a client resets its connection to the background service
changes.summary: 修复后台worker在连接重置时崩溃循环
changes.summary_en: Fix background worker crash-loop on client connection reset
changes.why_matters: 连接重置不再导致后台服务崩溃循环，提升了后台任务稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents background service crash loops when clients reset connections, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents --effort ultracode` not reaching dispatched sessions; the value was silently dropped
changes.summary: 修复agents的ultracode effort值被静默丢弃
changes.summary_en: Fix ultracode effort value silently dropped for agents
changes.why_matters: 用户指定的effort参数现在能正确传递到派发会话，确保推理深度符合预期。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures the specified effort level reaches dispatched sessions so reasoning depth matches user intent.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing ← to open the agents view dropping the task tracker when returning to the session
changes.summary: 修复左箭头打开agents视图丢失任务跟踪器
changes.summary_en: Fix task tracker lost when opening agents view via left arrow
changes.why_matters: 返回会话时任务跟踪器不再丢失，避免用户丢失任务进度上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents loss of task tracking context when navigating between agents view and session.

changes.raw: Fixed the agents dashboard retaining pasted images from abandoned reply drafts after their session was deleted
changes.summary: 修复agents仪表板残留已删除会话的粘贴图片
changes.summary_en: Fix agents dashboard retaining pasted images from deleted sessions
changes.why_matters: 已删除会话的草稿图片不再残留，避免隐私泄露和界面混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stale pasted images from abandoned drafts lingering after session deletion.

changes.raw: Fixed killed background sessions leaving a permanent `git worktree lock` behind; the periodic sweep now releases locks whose owning process is gone
changes.summary: 修复被杀后台会话遗留git worktree锁
changes.summary_en: Fix killed background sessions leaving permanent git worktree locks
changes.why_matters: 周期性清理现在释放无主进程的worktree锁，避免git操作永久阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: Periodic sweep releases orphaned worktree locks, preventing permanent git operation blockage.

changes.raw: Fixed SDK MCP servers registered via an `initialize` control request waiting until the next turn to start connecting
changes.summary: 修复SDK MCP服务器连接启动延迟
changes.summary_en: Fix SDK MCP server connection delayed until next turn
changes.why_matters: 通过initialize注册的MCP服务器现在立即开始连接，减少首次交互延迟。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP servers registered via initialize now connect immediately instead of waiting a turn.

changes.raw: Fixed returning to the agents view from a session leaving overlapping ghost frames with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN=1`
changes.summary: 修复禁用交替屏时agents视图残留重影帧
changes.summary_en: Fix ghost frames when returning from session with alt screen disabled
changes.why_matters: 在禁用交替屏模式下不再出现重叠重影帧，改善终端渲染体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates overlapping ghost frames in non-alternate-screen mode for cleaner terminal rendering.

changes.raw: Fixed late-appearing `.claude/*` symlinks not being reconciled into the sandbox deny-write list
changes.summary: 修复.claude符号链接未纳入沙箱写入拒绝列表
changes.summary_en: Fix late .claude symlinks not reconciled into sandbox deny-write list
changes.why_matters: 后出现的.claude符号链接现在被正确纳入沙箱写入限制，防止安全绕过。
changes.why_matters_en: Late-appearing symlinks are now caught by the sandbox, preventing security bypass via symlinks.

changes.raw: Hardened the Agent tool against indirect prompt injection via content a subagent read
changes.summary: 加固Agent工具防止间接提示注入攻击
changes.summary_en: Harden Agent tool against indirect prompt injection via subagent reads
changes.why_matters: 子代理读取的内容不再能间接注入恶意指令，这是关键的安全防护。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents malicious content read by subagents from injecting prompts, a critical security hardening.

changes.raw: Improved the Bash/PowerShell tool message when a command hits its timeout and is auto-backgrounded, so the model can distinguish a hang from an explicit background request
changes.summary: 改进命令超时自动后台化的提示信息
changes.summary_en: Improve timeout auto-background message for Bash/PowerShell tool
changes.why_matters: 模型现在能区分命令挂起和显式后台请求，做出更准确的后续决策。
changes.why_matters_en: Model can now distinguish a hang from an explicit background request, enabling better decisions.

changes.raw: Improved auto mode: the permission classifier now defaults to Sonnet 5 for external sessions, validated on the session's first request and pinned for the session
changes.summary: auto模式权限分类器默认使用Sonnet 5
changes.summary_en: Auto mode permission classifier defaults to Sonnet 5 for external sessions
changes.why_matters: 外部会话的权限分类更准确且在会话内固定，提升自动化安全性和一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: More accurate permission classification pinned per session improves auto mode safety and consistency.

changes.raw: Improved the bundled dataviz skill's chart color validation with perceptual OKLab color difference and recalibrated color-blindness thresholds
changes.summary: 改进数据可视化技能的图表颜色验证
changes.summary_en: Improve dataviz chart color validation with OKLab perceptual difference
changes.why_matters: 使用OKLab感知差异和色盲阈值校准，图表颜色对比度更准确且更友好。
changes.why_matters_en: OKLab perceptual color difference and color-blind thresholds yield more accessible charts.

changes.raw: Memory writes that leave a MEMORY.md index over its read limit now produce an explicit error instead of silent truncation
changes.summary: MEMORY.md超出读取限制时显式报错
changes.summary_en: Memory writes exceeding read limit now error instead of silent truncation
changes.why_matters: 不再静默截断超限的MEMORY.md索引，用户能及时发现并处理记忆溢出问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Explicit errors replace silent truncation, letting users catch memory index overflow promptly.

changes.raw: Screen reader mode now announces permission mode changes aloud when cycling modes with Shift+Tab
changes.summary: 屏幕阅读器模式播报权限模式切换
changes.summary_en: Screen reader mode announces permission mode changes aloud
changes.why_matters: 视障用户在使用Shift+Tab切换权限模式时能听到语音播报，提升无障碍体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Visually impaired users hear permission mode changes announced, improving accessibility.

changes.raw: The agents footer hint now shows how many background agents are waiting on your input, with a brief color emphasis when the count changes
changes.summary: 显示等待输入的后台代理数量
changes.summary_en: Show count of background agents awaiting input
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户及时了解有多少后台代理需要关注，避免遗漏。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users track how many background agents need attention, preventing missed interactions.

changes.raw: Agent view: the session you pressed ← from stays visibly marked even after mouse hover or arrow keys move the selection
changes.summary: 修复来源会话标记在操作后丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix origin session mark lost after hover/navigation
changes.why_matters: 保持用户从哪个会话返回的视觉上下文，提升导航体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Preserves visual context of which session the user navigated back from, improving navigation UX.

changes.raw: Fable temporarily shows as unavailable in the advisor picker while a server-side issue causing Fable advisor failures is fixed
changes.summary: 临时禁用Fable顾问选项
changes.summary_en: Temporarily disable Fable advisor in picker
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在服务端修复期间遇到Fable顾问调用失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents users from encountering Fable advisor failures while server-side issues are being fixed.
