changes.raw: Fixed /model and other dialogs being blocked in `claude agents` background sessions (reverts an overly broad guard)
changes.summary: 修复后台代理会话中对话框被阻止问题
changes.summary_en: Fix dialogs blocked in background agent sessions
changes.why_matters: 恢复后台代理会话中切换模型等交互功能，避免误拦截。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores interactive commands like model switching in background agent sessions.

signals.title: Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
Claude Code sends 33k tokens before reading the prompt; OpenCode sends 7k
Claude Code uses Bun written in Rust now
Show HN: Juggler – an open-source GUI coding agent, by the creator of JUCE
Setting up your spare Mac for Claude Code to control, a step-by-step guide

changes.raw: Added screen reader mode: opt-in plain-text rendering for screen reader users. Run `claude --ax-screen-reader`, set CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER=1, or add "axScreenReader": true to settings.
changes.summary: 新增屏幕阅读器模式，支持纯文本渲染
changes.summary_en: Added screen reader mode with plain-text rendering
changes.why_matters: 让视障用户也能无障碍使用Claude Code，显著扩展用户群体。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables visually impaired users to use Claude Code, significantly expanding accessibility.

changes.raw: Added `vimInsertModeRemaps` setting: map two-key insert-mode sequences like `jj` to Escape in vim mode
changes.summary: 支持vim插入模式自定义双键映射
changes.summary_en: Added vimInsertModeRemaps for two-key insert-mode remapping
changes.why_matters: 让vim用户可以按习惯将双键序列映射为Escape，提升编辑效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets vim users remap two-key sequences to Escape, improving editing efficiency.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER`: agent view and the background service now honor a corporate launcher by running every Claude Code self-spawn through a required wrapper executable
changes.summary: 支持企业启动器包装进程的自生成调用
changes.summary_en: Added CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER for corporate launcher support
changes.why_matters: 满足企业合规要求，确保所有子进程通过指定包装器启动。
changes.why_matters_en: Meets enterprise compliance by routing all self-spawned processes through a required wrapper.

changes.raw: Added mouse-click support for multi-select menus and "Other" input rows in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 全屏模式支持鼠标点击多选菜单
changes.summary_en: Added mouse-click support for multi-select menus in fullscreen mode
changes.why_matters: 降低交互门槛，用户无需键盘即可完成菜单选择。
changes.why_matters_en: Lowers interaction barrier by allowing mouse-based menu selection without keyboard.

changes.raw: Fixed fast mode staying off after switching back to a model that supports it — it now restores automatically when enabled in settings
changes.summary: 修复切换模型后fast模式未自动恢复
changes.summary_en: Fixed fast mode not restoring after switching back to a supporting model
changes.why_matters: 避免用户每次切换模型后手动重新开启fast模式，减少摩擦。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents users from manually re-enabling fast mode after model switches, reducing friction.

changes.raw: Fixed replies typed to a background agent being lost when delivery fails — the text is now saved and delivered when the session restarts
changes.summary: 修复后台代理消息投递失败后内容丢失
changes.summary_en: Fixed replies to background agents being lost on delivery failure
changes.why_matters: 防止用户输入的重要指令因网络问题永久丢失，保障协作连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents important user instructions from being permanently lost due to network issues.

changes.raw: Fixed background-session attach failing permanently ("Couldn't start the background daemon") after an update replaced the binary a running `claude agents` process was launched from
changes.summary: 修复更新后后台会话永久无法附加的问题
changes.summary_en: Fixed background-session attach failing permanently after binary update
changes.why_matters: 避免自动更新导致正在运行的后台会话不可用，影响长时间任务。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents auto-updates from breaking running background sessions, protecting long-running tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed the context window (and auto-compact indicator) briefly resetting to 200k after the CLI auto-updates, causing a false "100% context used" when resuming long-context sessions
changes.summary: 修复自动更新后上下文窗口误重置为200k
changes.summary_en: Fixed context window resetting to 200k after CLI auto-update
changes.why_matters: 防止长上下文会话因误报100%占用而触发不必要的压缩，保护对话历史。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents false 100% context-used alerts from triggering unnecessary compaction in long sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed supervised and background sessions crashing when a server closed an HTTP/2 connection with a GOAWAY while requests were in flight
changes.summary: 修复HTTP/2 GOAWAY导致会话崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fixed session crashes on HTTP/2 GOAWAY from server
changes.why_matters: 提升网络不稳定环境下的会话健壮性，避免任务中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves session robustness under unstable network conditions, preventing task interruption.

changes.raw: Fixed truncated stream-json/JSON output and missing result message when piping large responses from `claude -p`
changes.summary: 修复管道大响应时stream-json输出截断
changes.summary_en: Fixed truncated stream-json output when piping large responses
changes.why_matters: 确保管道模式下完整输出，保障自动化脚本的数据完整性。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures complete output in pipe mode, preserving data integrity for automation scripts.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` and similar env vars silently using the mantissa of scientific-notation values (`1e6` became `1`)
changes.summary: 修复环境变量科学计数法解析错误
changes.summary_en: Fixed env vars silently truncating scientific-notation values
changes.why_matters: 防止用户用1e6等写法时token限制被静默设为错误值，避免隐蔽bug。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents token limits from being silently mis-set when users use scientific notation like 1e6.

changes.raw: Fixed very large markdown tables stalling rendering or using excessive memory; tables over 200 rows show the first 200 with a "… N more rows" notice
changes.summary: 修复超大Markdown表格渲染卡顿和内存过高
changes.summary_en: Fixed large markdown tables stalling rendering and using excessive memory
changes.why_matters: 避免大表格导致界面卡死，通过截断显示保障可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents large tables from freezing the UI, maintaining usability via row truncation.

changes.raw: Fixed the Edit tool failing on files modified after reading when the target text still matches uniquely
changes.summary: 修复文件被修改后Edit工具误报失败
changes.summary_en: Fixed Edit tool failing on files modified after reading when text still matches
changes.why_matters: 避免在目标文本仍唯一匹配时因文件变动而拒绝编辑，减少不必要的重读。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids rejecting edits when target text still matches uniquely, reducing unnecessary re-reads.

changes.raw: Fixed Read reporting empty files as "shorter than offset", Grep silently returning "No files found" for invalid regex patterns, Grep count mode under-reporting totals when paginated, and Glob crashing with an unclear error when the pattern, path, or working directory contained a null byte
changes.summary: 修复Read/Grep/Glob多项边界错误
changes.summary_en: Fixed multiple edge-case bugs in Read, Grep, and Glob tools
changes.why_matters: 修复多个文件操作工具的静默错误和崩溃，提升核心工具可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes silent errors and crashes in core file operation tools, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `apiKeyHelper` script failures being hidden behind a generic 401 after ~10 silent retries; the script's own error is now shown within 3 attempts
changes.summary: 修复apiKeyHelper错误被401掩盖的问题
changes.summary_en: Fixed apiKeyHelper script errors hidden behind generic 401
changes.why_matters: 让用户能快速看到认证脚本的真实错误，避免长时间无意义重试。
changes.why_matters_en: Surfaces real auth script errors quickly, avoiding prolonged silent retry confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock streaming requests failing with a misleading "Truncated event message received" when a gateway transforms the response — the error now names the content-type and points at the proxy
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock流式请求经网关转换时的误导性错误
changes.summary_en: Fix misleading Bedrock streaming error when gateway transforms response
changes.why_matters: 让用户在代理环境下能准确定位流式请求失败的原因。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users accurately diagnose streaming request failures behind proxies.

changes.raw: Fixed `/upgrade` showing a login flow instead of the upgrade URL when the browser fails to open
changes.summary: 修复浏览器无法打开时/upgrade显示登录流程
changes.summary_en: Fix /upgrade showing login flow instead of URL when browser won't open
changes.why_matters: 确保无浏览器环境下用户仍能正确访问升级链接。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures users can still reach the upgrade URL in headless environments.

changes.raw: Fixed stream-json input killing the session on blank CRLF or whitespace-only lines from Windows-style SDK hosts
changes.summary: 修复空白CRLF行导致stream-json会话崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix stream-json session crash on blank CRLF/whitespace lines from Windows SDKs
changes.why_matters: 避免Windows SDK主机发送空行时意外中断会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental session termination from Windows SDK blank line input.

changes.raw: Fixed headless stream-json sessions hanging permanently when a `control_request` carried a non-string `set_model` payload; the CLI now answers with an error response
changes.summary: 修复非字符串set_model导致无头会话永久挂起
changes.summary_en: Fix headless session hang on non-string set_model in control_request
changes.why_matters: 防止无效模型设置请求让无头会话永久卡死。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents invalid model-setting payloads from permanently hanging headless sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed repeated "No completion record was found" notices on session resume — orphaned background tasks now collapse into a single summary
changes.summary: 修复会话恢复时重复的未找到完成记录提示
changes.summary_en: Fix repeated 'No completion record' notices on session resume
changes.why_matters: 减少恢复会话时的噪音提示，提升用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces noisy repeated notices when resuming sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control clients attaching to a terminal-hosted session not seeing background agents and workflow progress until a task started or stopped
changes.summary: 修复远程控制客户端看不到后台代理进度
changes.summary_en: Fix Remote Control clients missing background agent/workflow progress
changes.why_matters: 确保远程客户端能实时查看后台代理和工作流状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures remote clients see real-time background agent and workflow progress.

changes.raw: Fixed the Agent tool launching with no tools when a subagent's `tools` list resolves to nothing — it now returns a clear error naming the unrecognized entries
changes.summary: 修复子代理工具列表为空时无工具启动的问题
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent launching with no tools when tools list resolves to nothing
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理在无工具状态下启动并给出清晰错误提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents subagents from launching toolless and gives a clear error instead.

changes.raw: Fixed `/usage` showing stale cached bars over fresher data, and `/mcp` not reclassifying placeholder servers after config edits
changes.summary: 修复/usage显示过期缓存及/mcp不更新占位服务器
changes.summary_en: Fix /usage stale cached bars and /mcp not reclassifying placeholder servers
changes.why_matters: 确保用量和MCP服务器状态展示与实际配置一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps usage bars and MCP server status consistent with actual config.

changes.raw: Fixed "Change directory" in SDK hosts (e.g. Claude Desktop) failing with "A turn is in progress" on idle sessions that have a running background task
changes.summary: 修复SDK空闲会话有后台任务时切换目录失败
changes.summary_en: Fix 'Change directory' failing on idle SDK sessions with background tasks
changes.why_matters: 避免后台任务运行时阻止SDK主机执行目录切换操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents background tasks from blocking directory changes in SDK hosts.

changes.raw: Fixed the workflow save dialog showing `~/.claude/workflows/` instead of the `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` location for user-scope saves
changes.summary: 修复工作流保存对话框显示错误路径
changes.summary_en: Fix workflow save dialog showing wrong path instead of CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
changes.why_matters: 确保自定义配置目录下工作流保存到正确位置。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures workflows save to the correct user-configured directory.

changes.raw: Fixed `/release-notes` adding the viewed notes to the model's context — "Show all" previously injected the entire changelog into every subsequent request
changes.summary: 修复查看全部发布说明注入完整变更日志到上下文
changes.summary_en: Fix /release-notes 'Show all' injecting entire changelog into context
changes.why_matters: 避免大量无关文本污染后续请求的模型上下文，节省token。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents bloating model context with full changelog on every subsequent request.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak in the agent view where pasted images were retained for the screen's lifetime after sending peek replies
changes.summary: 修复代理视图中粘贴图片的内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix memory leak retaining pasted images in agent view after peek replies
changes.why_matters: 减少长时间使用中的内存占用。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces memory consumption during prolonged agent view usage.

changes.raw: Fixed SDK sessions losing agents defined via the initialize request when a plugin refresh ran before the client attached
changes.summary: 修复插件刷新导致SDK会话丢失已定义代理
changes.summary_en: Fix SDK sessions losing agents defined via initialize on plugin refresh
changes.why_matters: 防止插件刷新在客户端附加前清除已注册的代理配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents plugin refresh from wiping agent definitions before client attaches.

changes.raw: Fixed several memory leaks in long sessions: MCP stdio server stderr accumulating up to 64 MB per server, LSP documents staying open indefinitely (now LRU with 50-doc cap), async hook output retained after backgrounding, and unbounded growth in headless/SDK sessions from large tool-result payloads
changes.summary: 修复长会话多处内存泄漏(MCP/LSP/钩子/工具结果)
changes.summary_en: Fix multiple memory leaks in long sessions: MCP stderr, LSP docs, hooks, tool results
changes.why_matters: 显著降低长时间运行会话的内存增长，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Significantly reduces memory growth in long-running sessions, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory blowup when reading files with extremely long single lines using offset/limit — the read now returns a clean error instead of loading the whole line
changes.summary: 修复读取超长单行文件时的内存爆炸问题
changes.summary_en: Fix memory blowup reading files with extremely long single lines via offset/limit
changes.why_matters: 防止读取特殊格式文件时因加载整行导致内存耗尽。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents out-of-memory crashes when reading files with extremely long lines.

changes.raw: Fixed multi-second per-turn slowdowns in sessions with many permission deny/ask rules — rule matchers are now compiled once and cached
changes.summary: 修复权限规则过多时的每轮延迟
changes.summary_en: Fix multi-second per-turn slowdowns with many permission rules
changes.why_matters: 权限规则数量多时严重影响交互流畅度，缓存编译后的匹配器可大幅提升响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Large permission rule sets caused severe per-turn latency; caching compiled matchers restores responsiveness.

changes.raw: Improved input responsiveness while agent task lists update — task updates no longer re-render the entire UI
changes.summary: 改善任务列表更新时的输入响应
changes.summary_en: Improve input responsiveness during task list updates
changes.why_matters: 任务更新不再全量重渲染UI，避免输入卡顿影响用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Task updates no longer re-render the entire UI, preventing input lag during agent work.

changes.raw: Reduced per-tool-call CPU overhead in print/SDK sessions with many MCP tools by caching tool-pool assembly (up to 7x faster tool rounds at high tool counts)
changes.summary: 缓存工具池组装，工具调用提速7倍
changes.summary_en: Cache tool-pool assembly for up to 7x faster tool rounds
changes.why_matters: MCP工具数量多时每轮工具调用开销显著降低，提升高工具密度场景的执行效率。
changes.why_matters_en: High MCP tool counts caused heavy per-call overhead; caching assembly yields major speedups.

changes.raw: Reduced memory usage by bounding the file edit read cache to 16 MB instead of pinning up to 1,000 full files
changes.summary: 限制文件编辑缓存为16MB降低内存
changes.summary_en: Bound file edit cache to 16 MB to reduce memory usage
changes.why_matters: 原先缓存多达1000个完整文件导致内存占用过高，限制后避免OOM风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Pinning up to 1,000 full files risked excessive memory; bounding the cache prevents OOM scenarios.

changes.raw: Reduced session transcript size (up to 79x in edit-heavy sessions) and bounded checkpoint disk usage by pruning superseded file-history backups
changes.summary: 裁剪历史备份，会话记录最多缩减79倍
changes.summary_en: Prune superseded backups, transcript size up to 79x smaller
changes.why_matters: 编辑密集型会话的磁盘占用大幅降低，提升长期使用的可持续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Edit-heavy sessions saw massive disk bloat; pruning superseded backups keeps storage manageable.

changes.raw: Reduced memory usage when resuming sessions with background agents or forks spawned from large conversations
changes.summary: 降低恢复大型会话时的内存占用
changes.summary_en: Reduce memory when resuming large sessions with background agents
changes.why_matters: 恢复含后台代理或分支的大型会话时内存占用过高，优化后避免崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Resuming large forked sessions previously consumed excessive memory, risking crashes.

changes.raw: Completed background agents now stay listed in `/tasks` until cleanup instead of vanishing the moment they finish
changes.summary: 已完成后台代理保留在任务列表中
changes.summary_en: Completed background agents stay listed in /tasks until cleanup
changes.why_matters: 后台代理完成后不再立即消失，用户可查看结果，避免信息丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Agents no longer vanish on completion, letting users review results before cleanup.

changes.raw: Attaching to a stopped background agent now shows its transcript immediately while the session warms up, instead of a blank "Session is starting" screen
changes.summary: 附加已停止后台代理时立即显示记录
changes.summary_en: Attaching to stopped agent shows transcript immediately
changes.why_matters: 附加到已停止的后台代理时不再显示空白屏幕，提升调试和回顾体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Users no longer see a blank screen when attaching to stopped agents, improving review UX.

changes.raw: Background sessions: an older daemon no longer silently restarts workers spawned by a newer version onto the older binary
changes.summary: 防止旧守护进程重启新版本工作进程
changes.summary_en: Older daemon no longer restarts workers on older binary
changes.why_matters: 旧守护进程静默降级工作进程可能导致兼容性问题，修复后避免版本冲突。
changes.why_matters_en: Silent version downgrades of workers could cause subtle incompatibilities; now prevented.

changes.raw: Agent view: Ctrl+X now deletes renamed-branch worktrees, never destroys unpushed commits, keeps the session row when a worktree is kept, and reused worktree names reset to the current base
changes.summary: Ctrl+X安全删除工作树，保护未推送提交
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+X safely deletes worktrees, preserves unpushed commits
changes.why_matters: 防止误删未推送的提交和分支工作树，避免代码丢失的灾难性后果。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents catastrophic loss of unpushed commits when deleting worktrees via Ctrl+X.

changes.raw: Catastrophic removals (e.g. `rm -rf ~`) in commands containing `$(…)`/backticks/`<(…)` now prompt in `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and auto mode, matching the plain form
changes.summary: 危险删除命令在跳过权限模式也需确认
changes.summary_en: Catastrophic removals now prompt even in skip-permissions mode
changes.why_matters: 防止在自动或跳过权限模式下执行rm -rf等灾难性命令，保护用户数据安全。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents catastrophic data loss from commands like rm -rf even when permissions are skipped.

changes.raw: `/install-github-app` and the `/mcp` settings menu no longer open in background sessions
changes.summary: 禁止后台会话打开安装和MCP菜单
changes.summary_en: install-github-app and /mcp menu disabled in background sessions
changes.why_matters: 后台会话中打开这些交互式菜单无意义且可能导致异常，修复后行为更合理。
changes.why_matters_en: Opening interactive menus in background sessions was nonsensical and could cause errors.

changes.raw: MCP servers configured with an empty URL now show as "not configured" in `/mcp` instead of a config error
changes.summary: 空URL的MCP服务器显示为未配置
changes.summary_en: MCP servers with empty URL show as not configured instead of error
changes.why_matters: 避免配置错误提示误导用户，提升MCP配置界面的用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves MCP config UX by showing a clear status instead of a confusing error.

changes.raw: `/usage` now shows your last-known usage bars with an "as of" note when the usage endpoint is rate-limited, instead of an error screen
changes.summary: 用量端点限流时显示最近已知用量
changes.summary_en: /usage shows last-known bars when endpoint is rate-limited
changes.why_matters: 限流时不再显示错误页面，用户仍可查看用量信息，体验更友好。
changes.why_matters_en: Users still see usage info during rate limiting instead of a frustrating error screen.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock auth failing with "Session token not found or invalid" for AWS SSO profiles whose sso_region differs from the Bedrock region (2.1.207 regression)
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock SSO跨区域认证失败
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock auth failure for SSO profiles with differing sso_region
changes.why_matters: AWS SSO区域与Bedrock区域不同时认证失败，影响跨区域用户的正常使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Cross-region SSO users were locked out of Bedrock due to a token validation regression.

changes.raw: Auto mode is now available without `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE` opt-in on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry; disable via `disableAutoMode` in settings
changes.summary: Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry默认启用自动模式
changes.summary_en: Auto mode enabled by default on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry
changes.why_matters: 降低企业用户使用自动模式的门槛，无需额外配置环境变量。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces friction for enterprise users wanting auto mode without extra env config.

changes.raw: Fixed the terminal freezing and keystrokes lagging while streaming responses containing very long lists, tables, paragraphs, or code blocks
changes.summary: 修复长内容流式输出时终端卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix terminal freeze and keystroke lag during long streamed responses
changes.why_matters: 终端卡顿严重影响交互体验，此修复恢复流畅操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Terminal freezing severely impacts usability; this fix restores smooth interaction.

changes.raw: Fixed remote managed settings from a non-interactive run (`claude -p`, the SDK) being permanently recorded as consented without ever showing the security consent dialog
changes.summary: 修复非交互运行时安全同意被跳过
changes.summary_en: Fix remote managed settings silently bypassing security consent in non-interactive runs
changes.why_matters: 安全同意对话框被永久跳过是严重的安全漏洞，可能导致未授权操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Silently bypassing the security consent dialog is a critical security vulnerability.

changes.raw: Fixed spurious prompt-injection warnings triggered by benign system-generated conversation updates
changes.summary: 修复误报的提示注入警告
changes.summary_en: Fix spurious prompt-injection warnings from benign system updates
changes.why_matters: 误报警告会干扰用户判断，降低对真实安全风险的警觉性。
changes.why_matters_en: False warnings distract users and reduce alertness to genuine security risks.

changes.raw: Fixed the auto-updater overwriting a custom launcher script or symlink at `~/.local/bin/claude` on every release; `/doctor` now reports an externally managed launcher
changes.summary: 修复自动更新覆盖自定义启动脚本
changes.summary_en: Fix auto-updater overwriting custom launcher script or symlink
changes.why_matters: 每次更新覆盖用户自定义配置会破坏工作流，造成不必要的困扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Overwriting user customizations on every update disrupts workflows unnecessarily.

changes.raw: Fixed compound commands with `cd` prompting for permission when the only output redirect was to `/dev/null`
changes.summary: 修复cd复合命令重定向到/dev/null时误请求权限
changes.summary_en: Fix cd compound commands with /dev/null redirect prompting for permission
changes.why_matters: 无害命令反复请求权限会打断自动化流程，降低效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Unnecessary permission prompts for harmless commands interrupt automation flow.

changes.raw: Fixed the transcript jumping above the start of the answer when a response finishes streaming
changes.summary: 修复响应完成后转录跳转到答案上方
changes.summary_en: Fix transcript jumping above answer start after streaming completes
changes.why_matters: 转录位置错误影响用户阅读和回顾对话内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Incorrect transcript positioning hampers reading and reviewing conversation content.

changes.raw: Fixed `extensions.worktreeConfig` being left in the repo's `.git/config` (breaking go-git tools like `tea`) after the last `worktree.sparsePaths` worktree was removed
changes.summary: 修复worktree移除后残留git配置破坏go-git
changes.summary_en: Fix leftover git config breaking go-git tools after worktree removal
changes.why_matters: 残留配置破坏第三方工具兼容性，可能导致仓库操作异常。
changes.why_matters_en: Leftover config breaks third-party tool compatibility and can corrupt repo operations.

changes.raw: Fixed malformed bracket patterns in rules globs, skill paths, `.ignore`, and `.worktreeinclude` breaking file reads, file suggestions, and worktree creation
changes.summary: 修复规则通配符格式错误导致文件读取失败
changes.summary_en: Fix malformed bracket patterns breaking file reads and worktree creation
changes.why_matters: 格式错误导致核心文件操作和工作树创建失败，严重影响可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Malformed patterns break core file operations and worktree creation, severely impacting usability.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash loop in agent teams where a malformed teammate mailbox message caused repeated errors every second until the mailbox file was manually deleted
changes.summary: 修复畸形邮箱消息导致代理团队崩溃循环
changes.summary_en: Fix crash loop from malformed teammate mailbox message in agent teams
changes.why_matters: 崩溃循环每秒报错直到手动删除文件，严重影响团队协作稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Crash loop spamming errors every second severely destabilizes agent team collaboration.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions auto-named by accepting a plan not showing that name on their agent-view row
changes.summary: 修复后台会话接受计划后名称未显示
changes.summary_en: Fix background session auto-name not showing on agent-view row
changes.why_matters: 会话名称未显示影响用户识别和管理后台任务。
changes.why_matters_en: Missing session names hinder users from identifying and managing background tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions that entered a git worktree resuming blank after a cold reopen from the agent list
changes.summary: 修复后台会话进入worktree后冷重开空白
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions in git worktree resuming blank after cold reopen
changes.why_matters: 冷重开后会话内容丢失会导致工作进度丢失，影响用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Losing session content after cold reopen causes work progress loss and frustrates users.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control task status updates being lost when the connection recovered from a network interruption or credential refresh
changes.summary: 修复网络中断后Remote Control任务状态丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix Remote Control task status lost after network interruption recovery
changes.why_matters: 网络恢复后状态丢失会导致任务追踪中断，影响远程协作可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Status loss after network recovery disrupts task tracking and remote collaboration reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control sessions hosted by the desktop app not showing background agent and workflow progress on mobile and web
changes.summary: 修复桌面端Remote Control会话在移动端不显示进度
changes.summary_en: Fix desktop-hosted Remote Control sessions not showing progress on mobile/web
changes.why_matters: 跨平台进度不可见会降低多设备协作体验和任务透明度。
changes.why_matters_en: Cross-platform progress invisibility reduces multi-device collaboration and task transparency.

changes.raw: Fixed Deep research runs labeling every Fetch-phase agent "unknown" — chips now show the source hostname
changes.summary: 修复Deep研究Fetch阶段代理显示为unknown
changes.summary_en: Fix Deep research Fetch-phase agents labeled as unknown; chips show hostname
changes.why_matters: 来源标识缺失影响用户理解研究结果的来源和可信度。
changes.why_matters_en: Missing source labels hinder users from understanding research provenance and credibility.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock repeatedly requesting fresh AWS SSO credentials from IAM Identity Center on every API request
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock重复请求AWS SSO凭证问题
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock repeatedly requesting fresh AWS SSO credentials
changes.why_matters: 避免每次API请求都重新获取凭证，显著提升Bedrock用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents redundant credential requests on every API call, improving Bedrock UX.

changes.raw: Improved agent view: pasting the same text again now expands the collapsed `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder instead of adding a second one
changes.summary: 粘贴相同文本时展开已有占位符
changes.summary_en: Pasting same text expands existing placeholder instead of duplicating
changes.why_matters: 减少重复占位符，让代理视图更整洁易读。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces duplicate placeholders, keeping agent view cleaner and more readable.

changes.raw: Improved agent view: blocked session peeks now lead with the question and show a worded staleness clock (`waiting 3m`) instead of the same timestamp twice
changes.summary: 阻塞会话预览改为显示问题和等待时长
changes.summary_en: Blocked session peeks now show question and human-readable wait time
changes.why_matters: 用更直观的等待时长替代重复时间戳，提升可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Replaces duplicate timestamps with a human-readable staleness clock for clarity.

changes.raw: Changed Bedrock, Vertex, and Claude Platform on AWS to default to Claude Opus 4.8
changes.summary: Bedrock/Vertex/AWS默认切换为Opus 4.8
changes.summary_en: Bedrock, Vertex, Claude on AWS now default to Claude Opus 4.8
changes.why_matters: 默认模型升级影响所有用户，可能改变输出质量和成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Default model upgrade affects all users, impacting output quality and cost.

changes.raw: Changed auto mode to no longer read `autoMode` from `.claude/settings.local.json` (repo-resident); use `~/.claude/settings.json` instead
changes.summary: auto模式配置改为读取用户级设置文件
changes.summary_en: Auto mode config moved from repo-resident to user-level settings
changes.why_matters: 将配置从仓库级移至用户级，避免仓库文件影响个人自动模式偏好。
changes.why_matters_en: Moves config out of repo-level files to prevent repo settings from overriding personal preferences.

changes.raw: Fixed an indefinite hang on Windows when AWS credential resolution stalls (e.g. a stuck `credential_process`): the 60-second stall guard now fires instead of waiting forever.
changes.summary: 修复Windows上AWS凭证解析卡死挂起
changes.summary_en: Fix indefinite hang on Windows when AWS credential resolution stalls
changes.why_matters: 60秒超时保护避免无限等待，提升Windows平台稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: 60-second stall guard prevents infinite waits, improving Windows stability.

changes.raw: Plugin hooks/monitors/MCP headersHelper: `${user_config.*}` in shell-form commands is now rejected (shell-injection fix). Hooks: use exec form (`args` array) or `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY>`; monitors and headersHelper: read the value inside the script (config file or the server's `env` block).
changes.summary: 修复插件shell命令的注入漏洞
changes.summary_en: Fix shell-injection vulnerability in plugin shell-form commands
changes.why_matters: 阻止通过用户配置值进行shell注入攻击，是关键安全修复。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents shell-injection attacks via user config values, a critical security fix.

changes.raw: Plugin option values (`pluginConfigs`) are no longer read from project-level `.claude/settings.json`; only user, `--settings`, and managed settings are honored
changes.summary: 插件配置不再从项目级设置读取
changes.summary_en: Plugin configs no longer read from project-level settings files
changes.why_matters: 防止项目级配置注入恶意插件选项，提升安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents project-level files from injecting malicious plugin options, improving security.

changes.raw: Fixed `/usage-credits` amount inputs silently stripping malformed values (e.g. a pasted timestamp) to digits; malformed amounts are now rejected with an error, and amounts over $1,000 require a typed confirmation
changes.summary: 修复额度输入静默截断错误值的问题
changes.summary_en: Fix usage-credits inputs silently stripping malformed values to digits
changes.why_matters: 避免错误金额被静默截断导致意外费用，增加确认机制。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents malformed amounts from being silently truncated, adding confirmation for large values.

signals.title: Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
Claude Code sends 33k tokens before reading the prompt; OpenCode sends 7k
Alibaba to ban Claude Code in workplace over alleged backdoor risks, source says
Potential session/cache leakage between workspace instances or consumer accounts
Show HN: Juggler – an open-source GUI coding agent, by the creator of JUCE

changes.raw: Added directory path suggestions to `/cd`, matching `/add-dir` behavior
changes.summary: 为/cd添加目录路径建议
changes.summary_en: Add directory path suggestions to /cd
changes.why_matters: 提升目录切换操作的便捷性和一致性体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves convenience and consistency of directory switching.

changes.raw: Added a `/doctor` check that proposes trimming checked-in `CLAUDE.md` files by cutting content Claude could derive from the codebase
changes.summary: /doctor检查建议精简CLAUDE.md
changes.summary_en: /doctor suggests trimming checked-in CLAUDE.md files
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户减少冗余上下文，提升Claude理解效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users reduce redundant context, improving Claude's comprehension efficiency.

changes.raw: `/commit-push-pr` now auto-allows `git push` to the repo's configured push remote (`remote.pushDefault`, or the sole remote when only one is configured) in addition to `origin`
changes.summary: /commit-push-pr自动允许git push到配置远程
changes.summary_en: /commit-push-pr auto-allows git push to configured remote
changes.why_matters: 减少多远程仓库场景下手动确认push的摩擦。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces friction of manual push confirmation in multi-remote scenarios.

changes.raw: Gateway: `/login` now supports Anthropic-operated public gateway endpoints
changes.summary: /login支持Anthropic公共网关端点
changes.summary_en: /login supports Anthropic-operated public gateway endpoints
changes.why_matters: 扩展了用户可用的认证和接入方式。
changes.why_matters_en: Expands authentication and access options available to users.

changes.raw: `EnterWorktree` now asks for confirmation before entering a git worktree outside the project's `.claude/worktrees/` directory
changes.summary: 进入项目外worktree前需确认
changes.summary_en: Confirm before entering worktree outside project dir
changes.why_matters: 防止用户意外进入非预期目录，增强操作安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents users from accidentally entering unexpected directories, enhancing safety.

changes.raw: Background agents now upgrade to a new version in the background right after a Claude Code update, instead of paying a slow stale-session upgrade when you attach
changes.summary: 后台代理更新后自动升级版本
changes.summary_en: Background agents auto-upgrade after Claude Code update
changes.why_matters: 消除附加会话时的慢速升级延迟，提升响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates slow upgrade latency when attaching sessions, improving responsiveness.

changes.raw: Fixed an expired login failing every model with a misleading "There's an issue with the selected model" error instead of prompting to run `/login`
changes.summary: 修复登录过期时误导性模型错误提示
changes.summary_en: Fix misleading model error on expired login
changes.why_matters: 避免用户误判为模型故障，正确引导重新登录。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents users from misjudging it as a model failure and guides re-login correctly.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --resume` and `--continue` not responding to keyboard input on startup
changes.summary: 修复--resume/--continue启动时键盘无响应
changes.summary_en: Fix --resume/--continue not responding to keyboard input
changes.why_matters: 恢复会话功能是常用操作，键盘无响应严重影响使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Session resume is a common operation; unresponsive keyboard severely impacts usability.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP servers configured via `--mcp-config` or `.mcp.json` ignoring a per-server `request_timeout_ms`, which caused long-running MCP tool calls to time out at the 60s default in fresh sessions
changes.summary: 修复MCP服务器忽略超时配置导致调用超时
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP servers ignoring per-server request_timeout_ms
changes.why_matters: 长时间MCP工具调用因默认60秒超时失败，影响集成可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Long-running MCP tool calls fail due to default 60s timeout, impacting integration usability.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY` being silently ignored by `claude agents` / `--bg` background workers; the shell-exported override now follows the dispatching session
changes.summary: 修复后台代理忽略EXTRA_BODY环境变量
changes.summary_en: Fix background agents ignoring CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY
changes.why_matters: 确保后台代理继承调度会话的自定义配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures background agents inherit custom config from the dispatching session.

changes.raw: Fixed OAuth MCP servers requiring manual re-authentication after a single failed token refresh
changes.summary: 修复OAuth MCP服务器刷新失败需重新认证
changes.summary_en: Fix OAuth MCP servers requiring re-auth after refresh fail
changes.why_matters: 单次令牌刷新失败不应强制重新认证，减少用户中断。
changes.why_matters_en: A single token refresh failure should not force re-authentication, reducing user disruption.

changes.raw: Fixed `--permission-prompt-tool` pointing at an MCP server crashing with "MCP tool not found" on cold start before the server finishes connecting
changes.summary: 修复冷启动时MCP权限提示工具崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix --permission-prompt-tool MCP crash on cold start
changes.why_matters: 冷启动阶段服务器未就绪导致崩溃，影响自动化流程启动。
changes.why_matters_en: Server not ready during cold start causes crashes, disrupting automation startup.

changes.raw: Fixed `/model` picker rows printing a price for a different model than the row named, and stopped quoting first-party list prices on providers that don't bill them
changes.summary: 修复/model选择器显示错误价格
changes.summary_en: Fix /model picker showing wrong prices for models
changes.why_matters: 错误的价格信息会误导用户选择模型，影响成本决策。
changes.why_matters_en: Incorrect pricing misleads model selection and affects cost decisions.

changes.raw: Fixed server-provided model rows being misplaced in the `/model` picker when an entitlement or allowlist restriction drops the row they were positioned against
changes.summary: 修复/model选择器中模型行错位
changes.summary_en: Fix model rows misplaced in /model picker
changes.why_matters: 权限限制导致模型行位置错乱，影响选择体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Entitlement restrictions cause row misplacement, affecting selection experience.

changes.raw: Fixed desktop sessions getting stuck showing "running" after a slash command was sent mid-turn
changes.summary: 修复桌面会话中途发送命令卡在running状态
changes.summary_en: Fix desktop sessions stuck showing running after mid-turn command
changes.why_matters: 会话状态卡住导致用户无法继续操作，影响工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Stuck session state prevents users from continuing, disrupting workflows.

changes.raw: Fixed keyboard input being ignored in the agents view when a setup prompt appeared before a bare `claude --resume` on Windows
changes.summary: 修复Windows下resume时键盘输入失效
changes.summary_en: Fix keyboard input ignored in agents view on Windows resume
changes.why_matters: Windows用户恢复会话时无法操作界面，影响基本可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Windows users could not interact with the UI when resuming sessions, blocking basic usability.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude rm` leaving the removed job in the daemon roster, causing the row to reappear in `claude agents`
changes.summary: 修复rm后后台任务仍残留在agent列表
changes.summary_en: Fix claude rm leaving removed job reappearing in agents roster
changes.why_matters: 已删除任务反复出现会误导用户并破坏后台管理信任度。
changes.why_matters_en: Deleted jobs reappearing misleads users and undermines trust in background task management.

changes.raw: Fixed `/remote-control` showing "Unknown command" when logged out — it now explains how to sign in
changes.summary: 未登录时remote-control提示登录方式
changes.summary_en: Remote-control now explains sign-in instead of unknown command
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在未登录时遇到无意义的错误提示而产生困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents user confusion from a meaningless error when not logged in.

changes.raw: Fixed left arrow not stepping back out of a phase or agent in the workflow detail view
changes.summary: 修复工作流详情左箭头无法回退
changes.summary_en: Fix left arrow not stepping back in workflow detail view
changes.why_matters: 导航键失效会阻碍用户在工作流视图中高效浏览。
changes.why_matters_en: Broken navigation keys hinder efficient browsing in the workflow detail view.

changes.raw: Fixed `/status` listing the same broken-install warning twice
changes.summary: 修复status重复显示安装警告
changes.summary_en: Fix /status listing broken-install warning twice
changes.why_matters: 重复警告会造成视觉噪音，虽不影响功能但降低体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Duplicate warnings add visual noise without affecting functionality.

changes.raw: Fixed false "disused plugin" tips and skewed disuse telemetry for LSP plugins
changes.summary: 修复LSP插件误报未使用及遥测偏差
changes.summary_en: Fix false disused-plugin tips and skewed telemetry for LSP plugins
changes.why_matters: 误报会误导用户卸载有用插件，遥测偏差影响产品决策。
changes.why_matters_en: False tips may cause users to remove useful plugins, and skewed telemetry affects decisions.

changes.raw: Fixed `/doctor`'s update check to compare Homebrew installs against their cask's channel instead of the settings channel
changes.summary: 修复doctor对Homebrew版本的更新检查
changes.summary_en: Fix /doctor update check to compare Homebrew cask channel
changes.why_matters: 错误的更新检查会导致Homebrew用户收到不准确的升级建议。
changes.why_matters_en: Incorrect update checks give Homebrew users inaccurate upgrade guidance.

changes.raw: Fixed the fullscreen jump-to-bottom pill suggesting Ctrl+End on macOS, not showing rebound chords, and wrapping over the transcript
changes.summary: 修复全屏跳转底部提示在macOS的显示
changes.summary_en: Fix fullscreen jump-to-bottom pill display on macOS
changes.why_matters: 快捷键提示错误和布局溢出影响macOS用户的操作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Wrong shortcut hints and layout overflow hurt macOS user efficiency.

changes.raw: Bedrock: fixed a multi-minute startup hang when using an `awsCredentialExport` helper on networks with restricted egress
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock受限网络下数分钟启动卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix multi-minute Bedrock startup hang on restricted egress networks
changes.why_matters: 受限网络环境下数分钟的启动挂起严重影响企业用户可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Multi-minute startup hangs severely impact enterprise users on restricted networks.

changes.raw: Improved `/code-review` findings quality on claude-opus-4-8 across all effort levels
changes.summary: 提升opus-4-8代码审查质量
changes.summary_en: Improve /code-review findings quality on claude-opus-4-8
changes.why_matters: 代码审查是核心功能，审查质量提升直接提高用户代码可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Code review is a core feature; better findings directly improve code reliability.

changes.raw: Improved agents view: status column now uses full terminal width instead of truncating at 64 characters
changes.summary: agent状态列充分利用终端宽度
changes.summary_en: Agents view status column uses full terminal width
changes.why_matters: 避免状态信息被截断，让用户看到更完整的任务描述。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents truncated status info so users see fuller task descriptions.

changes.raw: Changed agents view: Ctrl+X now permanently removes a completed session, and sessions no longer render twice; deleted background jobs stay deleted
changes.summary: Ctrl+X永久删除已完成会话并修复重复
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+X permanently removes completed sessions, fixes duplicates
changes.why_matters: 让用户能真正清理已完成任务，避免列表冗余和混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users truly clean up completed tasks, avoiding roster clutter and confusion.

signals.title: Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
Claude Code sends 33k tokens before reading the prompt; OpenCode sends 7k
Alibaba to ban Claude Code in workplace over alleged backdoor risks, source says
Potential session/cache leakage between workspace instances or consumer accounts
Show HN: Juggler – an open-source GUI coding agent, by the creator of JUCE

changes.raw: Added an auto mode rule that blocks tampering with session transcript files
changes.summary: 阻止篡改会话记录文件
changes.summary_en: Blocks tampering with session transcript files
changes.why_matters: 防止用户或脚本篡改会话记录，保障审计可信度。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents tampering with session transcripts, ensuring audit integrity.

changes.raw: Fixed `--json-schema` silently producing unstructured output when the schema was invalid, and schemas using the `format` keyword being rejected
changes.summary: 修复无效JSON Schema静默输出非结构化结果
changes.summary_en: Fixes invalid JSON schema silently producing unstructured output
changes.why_matters: 避免用户因Schema错误而获得不可用的结构化输出却无任何提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents users from silently receiving unusable output due to invalid schemas.

changes.raw: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being silently lost when the turn ended at the `--max-turns` limit
changes.summary: 修复max-turns限制下用户消息丢失
changes.summary_en: Fixes user messages lost when turn ends at --max-turns limit
changes.why_matters: 用户在Claude工作时发送的消息不应被静默丢弃。
changes.why_matters_en: User messages sent during work should not be silently dropped.

changes.raw: Fixed Windows worktree removal deleting files outside the worktree when an NTFS junction or directory symlink existed inside it
changes.summary: 修复Windows worktree删除越界文件
changes.summary_en: Fixes Windows worktree removal deleting files outside worktree
changes.why_matters: NTFS junction或符号链接导致删除工作区外的文件，存在严重数据丢失风险。
changes.why_matters_en: NTFS junctions or symlinks could cause deletion of files outside the worktree, risking severe data loss.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents staying shown as "failed" or "completed" in the agent list after being resumed with `SendMessage`
changes.summary: 修复后台Agent恢复后状态显示错误
changes.summary_en: Fixes background agents showing stale status after resume
changes.why_matters: 恢复后的Agent仍显示失败或完成状态会误导用户判断任务进度。
changes.why_matters_en: Stale status after resume misleads users about actual task progress.

changes.raw: Fixed background jobs flipping from "needs input" back to "working" in the agent list when the agent's turn contained no readable text
changes.summary: 修复后台任务状态在无文本输出时错误回退
changes.summary_en: Fixes background jobs reverting from needs-input to working
changes.why_matters: 状态错误回退导致用户误以为任务正在运行而错过输入请求。
changes.why_matters_en: Incorrect state reversion causes users to miss input requests.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude attach` erroring when a background agent was mid-upgrade restart instead of waiting for it to come back
changes.summary: 修复Agent升级重启时attach报错
changes.summary_en: Fixes claude attach erroring during agent upgrade restart
changes.why_matters: 升级重启是常见场景，attach应等待而非直接报错。
changes.why_matters_en: Attach should wait for restart rather than erroring, since upgrades are common.

changes.raw: Fixed session-to-PR linking missing a PR created in a Bash call whose output exceeded the 30K inline limit
changes.summary: 修复大输出Bash调用中PR链接丢失
changes.summary_en: Fixes session-to-PR linking missing PRs from large Bash output
changes.why_matters: 超过30K内联限制的Bash输出中创建的PR不会被关联，影响追踪。
changes.why_matters_en: PRs created in Bash calls exceeding the 30K limit were not linked, breaking traceability.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude mcp add-from-claude-desktop` getting stuck when a server name contains unsupported characters; invalid names are now reported and remaining servers still import
changes.summary: 修复MCP导入因非法服务器名卡住
changes.summary_en: Fixes MCP import hanging on invalid server names
changes.why_matters: 一个非法名称不应阻塞其余服务器的导入流程。
changes.why_matters_en: One invalid server name should not block importing remaining servers.

changes.raw: Fixed a plugin LSP server that fails to initialize preventing a valid LSP server from another plugin handling the same file extension
changes.summary: 修复插件LSP初始化失败阻塞其他插件
changes.summary_en: Fixes failed plugin LSP blocking other plugins for same extension
changes.why_matters: 一个插件LSP失败不应阻止另一个有效插件处理相同文件类型。
changes.why_matters_en: A failed plugin LSP should not block another valid plugin from handling the same extension.

changes.raw: Fixed a Windows crash when the directory Claude was launched from is deleted, locked, or unmounted while a command is running
changes.summary: 修复Windows工作目录被删时崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fixes Windows crash when launch directory is deleted
changes.why_matters: 工作目录在运行期间被删除或锁定是常见场景，不应导致崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Launch directory being deleted or locked during runtime should not crash the tool.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash when a file watcher was closed while a directory scan was still in flight
changes.summary: 修复文件监视器关闭时崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fixes crash when file watcher closed during directory scan
changes.why_matters: 竞态条件导致的崩溃影响运行稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Race condition crash affects runtime stability.

changes.raw: Fixed project verify skills being rewritten on every session instead of only when a documented command changed
changes.summary: 修复验证技能每次会话重复写入
changes.summary_en: Fixes verify skills rewritten on every session
changes.why_matters: 每次会话重复重写技能文件造成不必要的开销和潜在干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Rewriting skills every session causes unnecessary overhead and potential interference.

changes.raw: Fixed the agent view rendering one line too high and clipping its header when the job list slightly overflowed the screen
changes.summary: 修复Agent视图标题被裁剪显示
changes.summary_en: Fixes agent view header clipping on overflow
changes.why_matters: UI渲染偏移影响用户体验和信息可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Rendering offset affects user experience and information readability.

changes.raw: Fixed background tasks in the web and mobile Remote Control panels showing stale "Running" status by forwarding full task state on every membership change
changes.summary: 修复远程控制面板后台任务状态过期
changes.summary_en: Fixes stale Running status in Remote Control panels
changes.why_matters: 移动端和Web端显示过期的运行状态会误导用户对任务进度的判断。
changes.why_matters_en: Stale Running status on web and mobile misleads users about task progress.

changes.raw: Improved auto mode to ask before running `rm -rf` on a variable it can't resolve from context
changes.summary: 自动模式对无法解析的rm -rf增加确认
changes.summary_en: Auto mode asks before rm -rf on unresolved vars
changes.why_matters: 防止因变量未解析而误删重要文件或目录。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental deletion of important files when variables can't be resolved.

changes.raw: Auto-update binary downloads now stream to disk instead of buffering in memory, cutting the updater's peak memory usage by roughly 400 MB
changes.summary: 自动更新改为流式写入磁盘，降低内存约400MB
changes.summary_en: Auto-update streams to disk, cutting peak memory ~400MB
changes.why_matters: 显著降低更新时的内存峰值，避免在资源受限环境中崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Significantly reduces update memory peaks, avoiding crashes in constrained environments.

changes.raw: Background task notifications now explicitly state that no human input has occurred, preventing fabricated in-transcript approvals from being acted on
changes.summary: 后台任务通知明确标注无人工输入，防伪造审批
changes.summary_en: Background notifications state no human input, blocking fake approvals
changes.why_matters: 防止伪造的转录内审批被误执行，是关键安全防护。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents fabricated in-transcript approvals from being acted on, a critical safety guard.

changes.raw: Improved agent view: sessions that edit, merge, comment on, or push to an existing PR now link it in `claude agents`
changes.summary: Agent视图关联已有PR，便于追踪协作
changes.summary_en: Agent view links existing PRs for easier tracking
changes.why_matters: 让用户能直观看到哪些会话涉及已有PR，提升协作可追踪性。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users see which sessions touch existing PRs, improving collaboration traceability.

changes.raw: Improved agent view: rows now show a colored state word and a classifier-written headline instead of raw tool call text, and the peek opens with full status including the exact ask for blocked sessions
changes.summary: Agent视图显示状态标签和摘要标题
changes.summary_en: Agent view shows colored state and headline summaries
changes.why_matters: 用可读的状态和摘要替代原始工具调用文本，提升可理解性。
changes.why_matters_en: Replaces raw tool call text with readable state and headlines, improving clarity.

changes.raw: `/doctor` is now a full setup checkup that can diagnose and fix issues; `/checkup` is its alias
changes.summary: /doctor升级为完整诊断与修复工具
changes.summary_en: /doctor becomes full setup checkup with auto-fix
changes.why_matters: 用户可一键诊断并修复环境问题，减少排障时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can diagnose and fix environment issues in one step, reducing troubleshooting time.

changes.raw: Reserved the "Claude Browser" MCP server name (alongside "Claude Preview") ahead of the Claude Desktop pane rename; user-configured MCP servers can no longer register under either name
changes.summary: 保留Claude Browser/Preview名称，禁止用户MCP注册
changes.summary_en: Reserves Claude Browser/Preview MCP names from user config
changes.why_matters: 防止用户配置的MCP服务器冒用保留名称，避免命名冲突和安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents user MCP servers from hijacking reserved names, avoiding conflicts and security risks.

changes.raw: Fixed Cowork VM-mode local-agent sessions failing to start with "Not logged in · Please run /login" on CLI 2.1.203+
changes.summary: 修复Cowork VM模式本地Agent启动失败问题
changes.summary_en: Fixes Cowork VM-mode local-agent startup failure
changes.why_matters: 解决了2.1.203+版本中Cowork VM模式无法启动的关键阻塞问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Resolves a critical blocking issue where Cowork VM-mode agents couldn't start on CLI 2.1.203+.

changes.summary_en: Fixed hook events not streaming in headless sessions, preventing worker reaping
changes.why_matters: 防止远程自动化任务在启动阶段因心跳缺失而被意外终止。

signals.title: Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
Claude Code sends 33k tokens before reading the prompt; OpenCode sends 7k
Alibaba to ban Claude Code in workplace over alleged backdoor risks, source says
Potential session/cache leakage between workspace instances or consumer accounts
Show HN: Juggler – an open-source GUI coding agent, by the creator of JUCE

changes.raw: Added a warning when your login is about to expire, so you can re-authenticate before background sessions are interrupted
changes.summary: 登录即将过期时发出警告
changes.summary_en: Warn before login expiry to prevent session interruption
changes.why_matters: 避免后台会话因登录过期而意外中断，提升长时间任务的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unexpected interruption of long-running background sessions due to expired authentication.

changes.raw: Added a grey ⏸ badge to the footer when in manual permission mode, making the active mode always visible
changes.summary: 手动权限模式下显示暂停徽章
changes.summary_en: Show pause badge in footer during manual permission mode
changes.why_matters: 让用户始终清楚当前所处的权限模式，减少误操作风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the active permission mode visible at all times, reducing the risk of unintended actions.

changes.raw: Added the session's additional working directories to MCP `roots/list`, with `notifications/roots/list_changed` sent when the set changes
changes.summary: 将额外工作目录加入MCP roots列表
changes.summary_en: Expose additional working directories via MCP roots/list
changes.why_matters: 使MCP服务器能感知会话的全部工作目录，提升集成协作能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows MCP servers to be aware of all session working directories, improving integration capabilities.

changes.raw: Fixed opening or switching background agent sessions on macOS stalling for 15–20 seconds due to a false low-memory detection (regression in 2.1.196)
changes.summary: 修复macOS后台会话因误报低内存卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS background sessions stalling 15-20s from false low-memory detection
changes.why_matters: 消除了macOS上后台会话切换时长达20秒的卡顿，显著改善用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates a 15-20 second stall when switching background sessions on macOS, significantly improving UX.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions becoming permanently unresponsive to attach, replies, and stop when the daemon's session token went stale — the session now recovers automatically
changes.summary: 修复后台会话因令牌过期永久无响应
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions becoming permanently unresponsive when daemon token goes stale
changes.why_matters: 此前后台会话会永久卡死且无法恢复，现在可自动恢复，避免工作丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Previously sessions would permanently hang with no recovery; now they auto-recover, preventing work loss.

changes.raw: Fixed returning to `claude agents` silently stopping running subagents and re-running the prompt from scratch — their work now carries over
changes.summary: 修复返回agents视图时子代理工作丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix returning to agent view discarding subagent progress and re-running prompt
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理已完成的工作被丢弃并从头重跑，节省时间和资源。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents subagent progress from being discarded and prompts re-run from scratch, saving time and resources.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory and per-turn CPU regression in interactive sessions: the context-usage indicator no longer re-analyzes the entire transcript after every turn
changes.summary: 修复上下文指示器每轮重复分析导致性能回退
changes.summary_en: Fix context-usage indicator re-analyzing entire transcript every turn
changes.why_matters: 消除了每轮对话后对完整记录的重复分析，降低内存和CPU开销。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates redundant full-transcript analysis after every turn, reducing memory and CPU overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents inheriting a stale `PATH` from the daemon instead of the dispatching shell, causing missing tools on Windows
changes.summary: 修复Windows后台代理继承过期PATH
changes.summary_en: Fix background agents inheriting stale PATH from daemon on Windows
changes.why_matters: 此前后台代理因PATH过期导致工具缺失，修复后可正常执行命令。
changes.why_matters_en: Background agents were missing tools due to a stale PATH; now they inherit the correct environment.

changes.raw: Fixed background and agent-view sessions dropping a shell-exported `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, which sent API keys to the default endpoint and failed with 401
changes.summary: 修复后台会话丢失API端点配置导致401
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions dropping ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL causing 401 failures
changes.why_matters: 此前API密钥被发送到错误端点导致认证失败，可能影响所有后台任务。
changes.why_matters_en: API keys were sent to the wrong endpoint causing 401 failures, potentially breaking all background tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash failing with "argument list too long" in repos with many git worktrees
changes.summary: 修复多worktree仓库中Bash参数过长错误
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash 'argument list too long' in repos with many git worktrees
changes.why_matters: 使拥有大量worktree的仓库也能正常执行Bash命令。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows Bash commands to run normally in repositories with many git worktrees.

changes.raw: Fixed worktree-isolated subagents sometimes running shell commands in the parent checkout instead of their own worktree
changes.summary: 修复worktree子代理在父目录执行命令
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree-isolated subagents running commands in parent checkout
changes.why_matters: 防止子代理在错误的代码副本中操作，避免隔离失效和数据污染。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents subagents from operating in the wrong checkout, ensuring worktree isolation is respected.

changes.raw: Fixed worktree creation rejecting nested repositories in multi-repo workspaces, leaving background sessions unable to isolate and edit
changes.summary: 修复worktree创建拒绝嵌套仓库导致无法隔离
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree creation rejecting nested repos in multi-repo workspaces
changes.why_matters: 此前多仓库工作区中后台会话无法创建隔离环境，修复后可正常编辑。
changes.why_matters_en: Background sessions in multi-repo workspaces can now properly isolate and edit nested repositories.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents crash-looping when their working directory was deleted, replaced by a file, or became an invalid path — they now fail once with a clear error
changes.summary: 修复工作目录被删除时代理崩溃循环
changes.summary_en: Fix background agents crash-looping when working directory is deleted or invalid
changes.why_matters: 将无限崩溃循环改为一次性明确报错，便于用户快速定位和修复问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Replaces an infinite crash loop with a single clear error, making the issue easy to diagnose and fix.

changes.raw: Fixed a background daemon auto-upgrade failure silently killing all running background sessions
changes.summary: 修复守护进程自动升级失败杀死所有会话
changes.summary_en: Fix daemon auto-upgrade failure silently killing all background sessions
changes.why_matters: 此前自动升级失败会静默终止所有后台会话，可能导致大量工作丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Auto-upgrade failures previously killed all running sessions silently, potentially causing major work loss.

changes.raw: Fixed `TaskStop` and `TaskOutput` failing to find background agents spawned by another agent — errors now list running agents by id and description
changes.summary: 修复跨代理查找后台代理失败并给出列表
changes.summary_en: Fix TaskStop/TaskOutput failing to find agents spawned by another agent
changes.why_matters: 使代理间能正确管理彼此创建的后台任务，错误信息更清晰可操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables agents to correctly manage background tasks spawned by other agents with clearer error messages.

changes.raw: Fixed the `claude agents` composer discarding your typed message when a slash command isn't available there
changes.summary: 修复agents编辑器丢失输入消息
changes.summary_en: Fix agents composer discarding typed message
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在slash命令不可用时丢失已输入的内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents users from losing typed content when a slash command is unavailable.

changes.raw: Fixed the agent list crashing when opening a stopped session whose conversation was already open in another session
changes.summary: 修复打开已停止会话时agent列表崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix agent list crash opening stopped session open elsewhere
changes.why_matters: 避免多会话场景下agent列表意外崩溃影响工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unexpected agent list crashes in multi-session workflows.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions showing "Needs input" in the agent list after the question was already answered
changes.summary: 修复后台会话错误显示需要输入状态
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions showing Needs input after answered
changes.why_matters: 消除误导性的状态提示，减少用户不必要的检查操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes misleading status indicators that cause unnecessary user checks.

changes.raw: Fixed background agent startup failures showing only "exit_with_message" instead of the actual error
changes.summary: 修复后台agent启动失败仅显示无效错误
changes.summary_en: Fix background agent startup showing exit_with_message only
changes.why_matters: 显示真实错误信息才能帮助用户快速定位和解决启动问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Showing the actual error helps users quickly diagnose and resolve startup failures.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions ignoring `effortLevel` changes in settings.json when forked through the daemon
changes.summary: 修复后台会话忽略effortLevel设置变更
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions ignoring effortLevel changes on fork
changes.why_matters: 确保通过daemon fork的后台会话能正确应用用户配置的推理强度。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures forked background sessions respect user-configured effort level settings.

changes.raw: Fixed attached background sessions ignoring `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE` and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS` opt-outs
changes.summary: 修复后台会话忽略鼠标禁用环境变量
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions ignoring mouse disable env vars
changes.why_matters: 尊重用户的鼠标禁用偏好，避免在后台会话中产生意外交互。
changes.why_matters_en: Respects user mouse-disable preferences to avoid unintended interactions in background sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed `/exit` incorrectly warning about running background agents after all named agents had completed
changes.summary: 修复exit对已完成agent的误警告
changes.summary_en: Fix /exit false warning about running completed agents
changes.why_matters: 避免用户退出时收到不必要的警告，提升退出流程的顺畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids unnecessary exit warnings when all named agents have already completed.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions started from a non-git directory unable to edit files when a `WorktreeCreate` hook was configured
changes.summary: 修复非git目录后台会话无法编辑文件
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions from non-git dir unable to edit files
changes.why_matters: 确保配置了WorktreeCreate钩子时非git目录下的后台会话仍可正常编辑文件。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures background sessions from non-git directories can edit files with WorktreeCreate hooks.

changes.raw: Fixed the `@` directory picker in `claude agents` not showing registered git worktrees
changes.summary: 修复@目录选择器不显示git worktree
changes.summary_en: Fix @ directory picker not showing registered git worktrees
changes.why_matters: 让用户能在agents中选择已注册的git worktree作为工作目录。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users select registered git worktrees as working directories in agents.

changes.raw: Fixed background task output on Windows being permanently replaced by an empty file after `/clear`
changes.summary: 修复Windows后台任务输出被清空
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows background task output replaced by empty file
changes.why_matters: 防止/clear后后台任务输出永久丢失，避免关键日志信息丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents permanent loss of background task output after /clear on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed content jumping when scrolling up through long transcript history
changes.summary: 修复滚动长对话记录时内容跳动
changes.summary_en: Fix content jumping when scrolling long transcript history
changes.why_matters: 提升浏览长对话历史时的视觉稳定性和用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves visual stability when browsing long conversation history.

changes.raw: Fixed the terminal flickering and jumping while typing in bash mode when a shell-history suggestion was shown
changes.summary: 修复bash模式下终端闪烁跳动
changes.summary_en: Fix terminal flickering in bash mode with history suggestions
changes.why_matters: 消除shell历史建议显示时的终端闪烁，提升输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates terminal flicker when shell history suggestions are displayed.

changes.raw: Fixed literal `^[[I` / `^[[O` escape codes being printed when reattaching to a background session
changes.summary: 修复重连后台会话时打印转义码
changes.summary_en: Fix literal escape codes printed when reattaching to session
changes.why_matters: 避免重连后台会话时出现乱码转义字符，保持终端输出整洁。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents raw escape codes from cluttering terminal output when reattaching to sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed LSP-only plugins being incorrectly flagged for disuse when their language servers deliver diagnostics or answer navigation requests
changes.summary: 修复LSP插件被误标记为未使用
changes.summary_en: Fix LSP-only plugins incorrectly flagged for disuse
changes.why_matters: 避免活跃的LSP插件被错误清理，保障代码诊断和导航功能正常。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents active LSP plugins from being incorrectly flagged and potentially removed.

changes.raw: Improved responsiveness while long responses stream: live-preview updates no longer re-render the whole screen
changes.summary: 优化长响应流式输出的渲染性能
changes.summary_en: Improve streaming responsiveness, avoid full screen re-render
changes.why_matters: 减少流式输出时的全屏重绘，显著提升长响应过程中的界面响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces full-screen re-renders during streaming, significantly improving UI responsiveness.

changes.raw: Improved subagent behavior: agents are now less likely to re-delegate their entire task to another subagent
changes.summary: 子代理不再过度委派整个任务
changes.summary_en: Subagents less likely to re-delegate entire tasks
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理无限委派链，提升多代理任务执行效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents infinite delegation chains and improves multi-agent task efficiency.

changes.raw: Reduced binary size by ~7 MB and startup memory by ~7 MB by loading a large bundled dependency lazily instead of inlining it
changes.summary: 二进制和启动内存各减约7MB
changes.summary_en: Binary size and startup memory reduced by ~7MB each
changes.why_matters: 延迟加载大型依赖降低资源占用，提升启动速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Lazy-loading large dependency reduces resource usage and speeds up startup.

changes.raw: Changed left arrow to no longer close the background tasks, diff, and workflow detail views — press Esc instead
changes.summary: 左箭头不再关闭视图，改用Esc
changes.summary_en: Left arrow no longer closes views; use Esc instead
changes.why_matters: 改变既有交互习惯，用户需适应新的关闭方式。
changes.why_matters_en: Changes existing interaction habit; users must adapt to new close behavior.

changes.raw: Changed the empty `claude agents` view to always show the organized sections (Needs input / Working / Completed) with descriptions
changes.summary: 空代理视图始终显示分区说明
changes.summary_en: Empty agents view always shows organized sections
changes.why_matters: 空状态下提供清晰引导，帮助用户理解代理工作流结构。
changes.why_matters_en: Provides clear guidance in empty state to help users understand agent workflow structure.

changes.raw: Removed the startup "claude command missing or broken" warnings — they now appear in `/doctor` and `/status` instead
changes.summary: 启动警告移至/doctor和/status
changes.summary_en: Startup warnings moved to /doctor and /status
changes.why_matters: 减少启动噪音，将诊断信息集中到专用命令中。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces startup noise by consolidating diagnostics into dedicated commands.

changes.raw: Removed a redundant navigation hint from the `claude agents` footer
changes.summary: 移除代理页脚冗余导航提示
changes.summary_en: Removed redundant navigation hint from agents footer
changes.why_matters: 清理冗余UI元素，减少界面干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Cleans up redundant UI element to reduce interface clutter.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added a Settings toggle for "Enable Remote Control for all sessions"
changes.summary: VSCode新增远程控制全局开关
changes.summary_en: VSCode adds toggle for Remote Control across all sessions
changes.why_matters: 方便用户统一管理远程控制权限，提升安全可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users centrally manage remote control permissions for better security control.

signals.title: Claude Code is steganographically marking requests
Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
Claude Code sends 33k tokens before reading the prompt; OpenCode sends 7k
Alibaba to ban Claude Code in workplace over alleged backdoor risks, source says
Potential session/cache leakage between workspace instances or consumer accounts

changes.raw: Added a "Dynamic workflow size" setting in `/config` for controlling how large Claude generally makes dynamic workflows (small/medium/large agent counts) — an advisory guideline, not an enforced cap
changes.summary: 新增动态工作流规模配置项
changes.summary_en: Add dynamic workflow size setting in /config
changes.why_matters: 让用户能控制动态工作流的代理数量规模，平衡成本与能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users control agent count in dynamic workflows, balancing cost and capability.

changes.raw: Added `workflow.run_id` and `workflow.name` OpenTelemetry attributes to telemetry emitted by workflow-spawned agents, so a workflow run's activity can be reconstructed from OTel data
changes.summary: 工作流代理新增OTel追踪属性
changes.summary_en: Add workflow run_id and name OTel attributes
changes.why_matters: 使工作流运行的活动可从OpenTelemetry数据中重建，提升可观测性。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables reconstruction of workflow run activity from OTel data, improving observability.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash in the inline Ctrl+R history search when accepting or cancelling while the search was still scanning the history file
changes.summary: 修复内联历史搜索崩溃问题
changes.summary_en: Fix crash in inline Ctrl+R history search
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在历史搜索扫描过程中操作导致崩溃，提升交互稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes when accepting or cancelling during history search scanning.

changes.raw: Fixed `/rename` on background sessions being reverted when the job restarts, which broke addressing the session by its new name
changes.summary: 修复后台会话重命名被回滚的问题
changes.summary_en: Fix /rename on background sessions being reverted on restart
changes.why_matters: 确保后台会话重命名后能通过新名称正确寻址，避免会话管理混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures renamed background sessions remain addressable by their new name after restart.

changes.raw: Fixed transient mTLS handshake failures when settings were re-applied during an in-place client certificate rotation
changes.summary: 修复证书轮转时mTLS握手失败
changes.summary_en: Fix transient mTLS handshake failures during cert rotation
changes.why_matters: 保证客户端证书轮转期间连接不中断，对安全通信连续性至关重要。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures uninterrupted secure connections during in-place client certificate rotation.

changes.raw: Fixed commands sent from Remote Control (mobile/web) into an interactive session failing with "Unknown command"
changes.summary: 修复远程控制发送命令失败问题
changes.summary_en: Fix Remote Control commands failing with Unknown command
changes.why_matters: 恢复远程控制向交互会话发送命令的能力，保障移动端/网页端操控体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores ability to send commands from Remote Control into interactive sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed images and files sent from the Remote Control mobile or web app without a caption being silently dropped
changes.summary: 修复远程控制无标题图片被丢弃
changes.summary_en: Fix images/files without caption dropped from Remote Control
changes.why_matters: 避免用户通过移动端发送的图片和文件被静默丢弃，保障多模态输入完整性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents silent dropping of images/files sent from Remote Control without captions.

changes.raw: Fixed the sign-in URL printed by `claude auth login` and `claude mcp login --no-browser` not being reliably clickable when it wraps over SSH — it is now emitted as a single hyperlink
changes.summary: 修复SSH下登录URL不可点击问题
changes.summary_en: Fix sign-in URL not clickable over SSH
changes.why_matters: 使SSH环境下的登录链接可靠可点击，改善远程终端登录体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes sign-in URLs reliably clickable in SSH environments as a single hyperlink.

changes.raw: Fixed opening a chat from `claude agents` sometimes failing with "currently running as a background agent" followed by a worker crash/respawn loop
changes.summary: 修复从agents打开聊天崩溃循环
changes.summary_en: Fix chat open from claude agents causing worker crash loop
changes.why_matters: 避免后台代理会话打开聊天时触发崩溃循环，影响核心可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents worker crash/respawn loops when opening chats from claude agents.

changes.raw: Fixed workflow scripts with unicode quote escapes in strings being corrupted before parsing; workflow parse errors now show the offending line instead of always blaming TypeScript
changes.summary: 修复工作流脚本Unicode引号解析损坏
changes.summary_en: Fix workflow scripts with unicode quote escapes corrupted
changes.why_matters: 确保含Unicode引号的工作流脚本能正确解析，并显示准确错误信息。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures workflow scripts with unicode quotes parse correctly with accurate error messages.

changes.raw: Fixed voice dictation retrying in an unbounded loop when the microphone or audio recorder fails — repeated capture failures now pause voice input
changes.summary: 修复语音输入失败时无限重试
changes.summary_en: Fix voice dictation unbounded retry on mic failure
changes.why_matters: 避免麦克风故障时语音输入无限重试导致资源浪费，改为暂停输入。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unbounded voice dictation retry loops on microphone failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `/remote-control` sessions showing the wrong permission mode in the mobile and web apps
changes.summary: 修复远程控制权限模式显示错误
changes.summary_en: Fix /remote-control showing wrong permission mode
changes.why_matters: 确保移动端和网页端正确显示权限模式，避免用户误判安全状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures correct permission mode display in mobile and web Remote Control apps.

changes.raw: Fixed resuming a session by name, or opening the resume picker, taking minutes and using a large amount of memory in repositories with many git worktrees
changes.summary: 优化多worktree仓库会话恢复性能
changes.summary_en: Fix slow, memory-heavy session resume with many git worktrees
changes.why_matters: 大幅减少多worktree仓库中恢复会话的时间和内存消耗，提升用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Greatly reduces time and memory usage when resuming sessions in repos with many worktrees.

changes.raw: Fixed installer and updater downloads failing immediately with "aborted" when a proxy or network drops the connection mid-download — transient connection drops now retry
changes.summary: 修复网络中断时下载失败不重试
changes.summary_en: Fix installer/updater download failure on connection drop
changes.why_matters: 使安装和更新下载在网络瞬断时自动重试，提高安装可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Adds retry on transient connection drops for installer and updater downloads.

changes.raw: Fixed re-invoking an already-loaded skill appending a duplicate copy of its instructions to context
changes.summary: 修复重复加载技能导致指令重复
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate skill instructions appended on re-load
changes.why_matters: 避免重复调用已加载技能时上下文出现重复指令，节省token并减少干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents duplicate skill instructions from polluting context on re-invocation.

changes.raw: Improved `/workflows` agent list layout: wider titles, a dedicated time column, shorter model names, and no per-row tool-call counts
changes.summary: 优化工作流代理列表布局
changes.summary_en: Improved workflows agent list layout
changes.why_matters: 提升用户查看代理列表的体验和可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves readability and user experience when viewing agent lists.

changes.raw: Improved MCP error messages: clearer error when a server config has `url` but no `type`, suggesting `"type": "http"` instead of the misleading "command: expected string"
changes.summary: 修复MCP配置错误提示
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP config error message for missing type
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户更准确地定位并修复MCP服务器配置问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users accurately identify and fix MCP server config issues.

changes.raw: Changed `/review <pr>` back to a fast single-pass review; use `/code-review <level> <pr#>` for the multi-agent review at a chosen effort level
changes.summary: 拆分PR审查命令以区分快慢模式
changes.summary_en: Split PR review commands for fast vs multi-agent review
changes.why_matters: 让用户能根据需求选择快速审查或深度多代理审查。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows users to choose between fast review or deep multi-agent review.

changes.summary_en: Fix mid-conversation system role reminders in Sonnet 5
