changes.raw: Changed `AskUserQuestion` dialogs to no longer auto-continue by default; opt into an idle timeout via `/config`
changes.summary: 问答对话框不再默认自动继续
changes.summary_en: AskUserQuestion dialogs no longer auto-continue by default
changes.why_matters: 避免用户不在时对话自动继续导致意外操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unintended actions when users are away from the dialog.

changes.raw: Changed the "default" permission mode to "Manual" across the CLI, `--help`, VS Code, and JetBrains; `--permission-mode manual` and `"defaultMode": "manual"` are accepted alongside `default`
changes.summary: 默认权限模式改为手动
changes.summary_en: Default permission mode changed to Manual across all surfaces
changes.why_matters: 提升安全性，用户需手动确认操作，减少误执行风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves safety by requiring manual confirmation, reducing risk of unintended execution.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash at startup when `disabledMcpServers` or `enabledMcpServers` in `.claude.json` is set to a non-array value
changes.summary: 修复MCP服务器配置非数组值导致启动崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix startup crash when MCP server config is non-array
changes.why_matters: 防止用户配置错误时工具无法启动。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the tool from failing to start due to user configuration errors.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions silently stopping mid-turn after sleep/wake or when reopening a stalled session
changes.summary: 修复后台会话休眠后静默中断
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions silently stopping after sleep/wake
changes.why_matters: 确保长时间任务在系统休眠后能可靠恢复。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures long-running tasks reliably resume after system sleep/wake.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions re-running a turn cancelled with Esc after a stall respawn
changes.summary: 修复后台会话重运行已取消的回合
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions re-running cancelled turns after respawn
changes.why_matters: 避免已取消操作被重复执行，浪费资源和产生混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids duplicate execution of cancelled operations, saving resources and preventing confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents never starting again after a crash left a stale `daemon.lock` whose PID the OS reused
changes.summary: 修复残留daemon.lock导致后台代理无法重启
changes.summary_en: Fix stale daemon.lock preventing background agents from restarting
changes.why_matters: 消除因PID复用导致的死锁，保障后台代理可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates deadlock from PID reuse, ensuring background agent availability.

changes.raw: Fixed background-agent daemon handover so a reinstalled older build can no longer take over the daemon; build recency is now judged by the version's embedded build timestamp
changes.summary: 修复旧版本可劫持后台代理守护进程
changes.summary_en: Fix older builds hijacking background-agent daemon via version check
changes.why_matters: 防止旧版本意外接管守护进程导致行为不一致或安全问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents older versions from unexpectedly taking over the daemon, avoiding inconsistency or security issues.

changes.raw: Fixed background-agent roster issues: transient corruption permanently disabling orphan cleanup, older binaries not preserving fields written by newer versions, and socket auth tokens being stripped during daemon restarts
changes.summary: 修复后台代理多个稳定性与安全问题
changes.summary_en: Fix multiple background-agent roster stability and security issues
changes.why_matters: 解决令牌丢失、数据损坏等问题，提升后台代理整体可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Resolves token stripping and data corruption, improving overall background agent reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents cut off by a rate limit before producing any text output returning an empty result instead of failing cleanly
changes.summary: 修复子代理限流后返回空结果
changes.summary_en: Fix subagents returning empty result when rate-limited before output
changes.why_matters: 使限流场景下子代理明确失败，避免上层误判空结果为有效。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes rate-limited subagents fail cleanly, preventing callers from mistaking empty results as valid.

changes.raw: Fixed control bytes from background-agent output reaching the terminal in the agent view
changes.summary: 修复后台代理控制字节泄漏到终端
changes.summary_en: Fix control bytes from background-agent output reaching terminal
changes.why_matters: 防止终端显示乱码或被控制字符干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents terminal display corruption from control characters.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents --plugin-dir <dir>` not showing the plugin's agents and skills in the agent view when the flag is placed after `agents`
changes.summary: 修复--plugin-dir置于agents后时不显示插件
changes.summary_en: Fix --plugin-dir flag not loading plugin agents when placed after agents
changes.why_matters: 确保命令行参数顺序不影响插件加载，提升用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures flag order doesn't affect plugin loading, improving user experience.

changes.raw: Fixed project-scoped plugins not loading correctly from git worktrees of the same repository
changes.summary: 修复git worktree中项目插件无法加载
changes.summary_en: Fix project-scoped plugins not loading from git worktrees
changes.why_matters: 支持worktree工作流用户正确使用项目级插件。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables worktree-based workflows to correctly use project-scoped plugins.

changes.raw: Fixed `/mcp` server list not tracking focus for screen readers and magnifiers
changes.summary: 修复/mcp列表缺少屏幕阅读器焦点追踪
changes.summary_en: Fix /mcp server list missing focus tracking for screen readers
changes.why_matters: 提升无障碍访问体验，帮助视障用户使用MCP列表。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves accessibility, helping visually impaired users navigate the MCP list.

changes.raw: Fixed voice dictation showing a misleading "Voice connection failed" message when a recording captures no audio
changes.summary: 修复无音频录音时语音提示误导
changes.summary_en: Fix misleading voice connection error when recording captures no audio
changes.why_matters: 避免误导性错误信息让用户误以为连接故障。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misleading error messages that make users think the connection failed.

changes.raw: Fixed rendering flicker under tmux 3.4+ by enabling synchronized terminal output
changes.summary: 修复tmux 3.4+下终端渲染闪烁
changes.summary_en: Fix rendering flicker under tmux 3.4+ via synchronized output
changes.why_matters: 改善tmux用户界面稳定性，消除视觉闪烁干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves UI stability for tmux users by eliminating visual flicker.

changes.raw: Improved screen-reader output: decorative glyphs are now hidden, transcript symbols read as short labels, and nested tables read as `Header: value.` lines
changes.summary: 改善屏幕阅读器输出，隐藏装饰符号并优化表格朗读
changes.summary_en: Improved screen-reader output by hiding glyphs and optimizing tables
changes.why_matters: 提升了视障用户的使用体验，使输出更易听懂。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves usability for visually impaired users by making output easier to understand.

changes.raw: Improved the install script to explain when installation is killed by the system running out of memory
changes.summary: 安装脚本在内存不足终止时提供明确提示
changes.summary_en: Install script explains when killed by out of memory errors
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户快速诊断安装失败的原因，减少困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users quickly diagnose installation failures caused by memory exhaustion.

signals.title: Claude Code is steganographically marking requests
Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
I used Claude Code to get a second opinion on my MRI
Alibaba to ban Claude Code in workplace over alleged backdoor risks, source says
Potential session/cache leakage between workspace instances or consumer accounts

changes.raw: Stacked slash-skill invocations like `/skill-a /skill-b do XYZ` now load all leading skills (up to 5), not just the first
changes.summary: 支持堆叠调用多个斜杠技能
changes.summary_en: Stacked slash-skill invocations load up to 5 skills
changes.why_matters: 让用户能一次性组合多个技能，提升工作流效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users combine multiple skills in one invocation for better workflows.

changes.raw: Fixed SSL certificate errors (TLS-inspecting proxies, missing `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`, expired certs) burning retries before showing actionable guidance — they now fail immediately with the fix hint
changes.summary: SSL证书错误立即失败并提示修复
changes.summary_en: SSL cert errors fail immediately with actionable fix hint
changes.why_matters: 避免无谓重试浪费时间，帮助用户快速定位证书问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents wasted retries and helps users quickly resolve certificate issues.

changes.raw: Fixed streaming responses being discarded when the API emits a mid-stream overloaded/server error after partial output — the partial is now kept with an incomplete-response notice
changes.summary: 保留流式响应的部分输出
changes.summary_en: Partial streaming output kept on mid-stream server errors
changes.why_matters: 避免因中途服务器错误丢失已有内容，减少用户重复工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents loss of already-generated content when server errors occur mid-stream.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents cut off by a rate limit or server error silently failing instead of returning their partial work to the parent
changes.summary: 子代理被截断时返回部分结果
changes.summary_en: Subagents cut off by errors return partial work to parent
changes.why_matters: 确保子代理中断时父代理仍能利用已完成的部分工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures parent agents can use partial work when subagents are interrupted.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents reporting API errors (e.g. usage limit reached) as successful results — the error is now reported to the parent agent
changes.summary: 子代理API错误不再误报为成功
changes.summary_en: Subagent API errors no longer falsely reported as success
changes.why_matters: 防止错误被掩盖，确保父代理获得真实的执行状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents errors from being masked, ensuring parent agents get true status.

changes.raw: Fixed the background-agent daemon on Linux killing itself and every running agent every ~50 seconds after an unclean shutdown left a corrupted worker record
changes.summary: 修复Linux后台守护进程周期性自毁
changes.summary_en: Fix Linux daemon killing itself and all agents every ~50s
changes.why_matters: 此严重bug会导致所有运行中的代理被意外终止，影响极大。
changes.why_matters_en: This critical bug killed all running agents, causing major disruption.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents failing to cold-start over SSH on macOS with "Could not switch to audit session" (regression in 2.1.196)
changes.summary: 修复macOS SSH冷启动后台代理失败
changes.summary_en: Fix background agents failing to cold-start over SSH on macOS
changes.why_matters: 恢复macOS上通过SSH启动后台代理的正常功能。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores ability to start background agents over SSH on macOS.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude stop` being silently undone when it raced a background-agent respawn — the respawn now honors the stop
changes.summary: 修复stop命令被后台重生竞态覆盖
changes.summary_en: Fix claude stop being undone by background-agent respawn race
changes.why_matters: 确保停止命令被正确执行，避免代理意外重启。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures stop commands are honored and agents don't unexpectedly restart.

changes.raw: Fixed background job progress indicators stalling for minutes while the job ran long commands
changes.summary: 修复后台任务进度指示器长时间卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix background job progress indicators stalling during long commands
changes.why_matters: 让用户能准确了解后台任务执行进度，减少困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives users accurate visibility into background job progress.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions on memory-starved machines showing a generic error — they now indicate low memory and suggest freeing resources
changes.summary: 内存不足时显示明确提示
changes.summary_en: Low-memory sessions now show clear error and suggestions
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户快速识别内存问题并采取行动，而非面对模糊报错。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users quickly identify and resolve memory issues instead of vague errors.

changes.raw: Fixed remote sessions briefly flapping between Working and Idle in the agent view when a background agent completes
changes.summary: 修复远程会话状态短暂闪烁
changes.summary_en: Fix remote sessions flapping between Working and Idle states
changes.why_matters: 消除状态闪烁，提升代理视图的稳定性和用户体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates status flicker for a more stable agent view experience.

changes.raw: Fixed idle subagents vanishing from the agent panel while other subagents were still working; surplus idle agents now collapse into an expandable summary row
changes.summary: 空闲子代理折叠为可展开摘要行
changes.summary_en: Idle subagents collapse into expandable summary row
changes.why_matters: 保持代理面板整洁，避免空闲代理干扰活跃代理的查看。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the agent panel clean and focuses attention on active subagents.

changes.raw: Fixed typing `/model` or `/fast` while viewing a subagent silently opening the lead's model picker — a notice now explains the command applies to the lead
changes.summary: 修复查看子代理时模型选择器误开
changes.summary_en: Fix /model and /fast opening lead's picker while viewing subagent
changes.why_matters: 避免用户混淆命令作用于哪个代理，提升交互清晰度。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents confusion about which agent a command applies to.

changes.raw: Fixed `SessionStart`, `Setup`, and `SubagentStart` hooks silently hiding stderr when exiting with code 2 — the error is now shown in the transcript
changes.summary: 钩子退出码2时显示stderr错误
changes.summary_en: Hooks exiting with code 2 now show stderr in transcript
changes.why_matters: 确保钩子错误信息可见，帮助用户调试配置问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures hook error messages are visible for debugging configuration issues.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions daemon <subcommand>` being treated as a chat prompt instead of running the subcommand
changes.summary: 修复守护子命令被误当聊天输入
changes.summary_en: Fix daemon subcommand being treated as chat prompt
changes.why_matters: 确保守护进程子命令正确执行，而非被误解析为对话。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures daemon subcommands execute correctly instead of being parsed as chat.

changes.raw: Fixed `SendMessage` silently misrouting when a re-spawned agent reuses a previous agent's name — the tool now detects the mismatch and asks the caller to retarget
changes.summary: 修复重用代理名导致消息误路由问题
changes.summary_en: Fix message misrouting when respawned agent reuses a name
changes.why_matters: 消息发送到错误代理会导致任务执行偏差，检测并提示重定向可避免静默错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Silent message misrouting causes tasks to go to the wrong agent; detection prevents subtle failures.

changes.raw: Fixed opening or resuming a session with no new messages needlessly growing the transcript file
changes.summary: 修复无新消息时会话文件不必要增长
changes.summary_en: Fix transcript file growing unnecessarily with no new messages
changes.why_matters: 避免会话文件无意义膨胀，减少磁盘占用和加载开销。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents pointless transcript bloat, reducing disk usage and load overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed backgrounding a session with `←` or `/background` dropping its `/color` from the agent view row
changes.summary: 修复后台会话丢失颜色标签显示
changes.summary_en: Fix backgrounded sessions losing color tag in agent view
changes.why_matters: 颜色标签帮助用户区分多个会话，丢失会降低多会话管理体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Color tags help distinguish sessions; losing them degrades multi-session management.

changes.raw: Fixed resetting a corrupted config file from the startup recovery dialog destroying it unrecoverably — it now backs up the file first
changes.summary: 修复重置损坏配置时先备份避免不可恢复
changes.summary_en: Fix config reset destroying file; now backs up first
changes.why_matters: 配置文件被不可恢复地销毁会导致用户所有设置丢失，备份是关键安全网。
changes.why_matters_en: Unrecoverable config destruction loses all user settings; backup is a critical safety net.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude in Chrome repeatedly opening the reconnect page when sessions run from different builds or config directories
changes.summary: 修复Chrome中不同构建会话反复打开重连页
changes.summary_en: Fix Chrome reconnect page loop with different builds/config dirs
changes.why_matters: 反复弹出重连页面严重干扰使用体验，修复后多环境切换更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Repeated reconnect popups severely disrupt usage; fix enables smoother multi-env switching.

changes.raw: Fixed plan mode not prompting for state-changing browser tool calls; read-only `browser_batch` calls are now correctly auto-allowed
changes.summary: 修复计划模式未提示浏览器状态变更操作
changes.summary_en: Fix plan mode not prompting for state-changing browser calls
changes.why_matters: 计划模式下未确认状态变更操作可能导致意外网页修改，影响安全性和可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: Unconfirmed state-changing browser actions in plan mode risk unintended web modifications.

changes.raw: Transient server rate-limit errors (429s unrelated to your usage limit) are now retried automatically with backoff for subscribers instead of failing the turn
changes.summary: 订阅用户429限流错误自动重试退避
changes.summary_en: Auto-retry transient 429 errors with backoff for subscribers
changes.why_matters: 瞬时服务器限流不应中断用户工作流，自动重试显著提升使用连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Transient rate limits shouldn't interrupt workflows; auto-retry improves continuity.

changes.raw: `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` now raises the default retry count for non-capacity transient errors to 300 and lifts the cap of 15 on `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES`
changes.summary: 提升瞬时错误默认重试次数至300并取消上限
changes.summary_en: Raise default retry count to 300 and lift max-retries cap
changes.why_matters: 更高的重试上限让长时间运行的任务在服务波动下更鲁棒地完成。
changes.why_matters_en: Higher retry limits make long-running tasks more resilient to service fluctuations.

changes.raw: `claude agents` session rows now show pull-request links as bare `#N` without the redundant "PR" label
changes.summary: 代理会话行PR链接简化为#N格式
changes.summary_en: Simplify PR links to bare #N in agent session rows
changes.why_matters: 去除冗余标签使界面更简洁，属于轻微的显示优化。
changes.why_matters_en: Removing redundant labels cleans up the UI; a minor cosmetic improvement.

changes.summary_en: Added /dataviz skill with color-palette validator for charts
changes.why_matters: 为图表和仪表盘设计提供专业指导，提升可视化质量。
changes.why_matters_en: Provides professional guidance for chart and dashboard design, improving visualization quality.

changes.raw: Gateway: added Claude Platform on AWS (anthropicAws) as an upstream provider; model-not-found responses now advance the failover chain
changes.summary: 网关支持AWS Claude Platform并改进故障转移
changes.summary_en: Gateway supports AWS Claude Platform with improved failover chain
changes.why_matters: 增加云提供商选项并提升模型调用的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Adds cloud provider options and improves reliability of model calls.

changes.raw: Background agents launched from `claude agents` now commit, push, and open a draft PR when they finish code work in a worktree, instead of stopping to ask
changes.summary: 后台代理完成后自动提交并创建草稿PR
changes.summary_en: Background agents auto-commit, push, and open draft PR on completion
changes.why_matters: 减少人工干预，实现后台代码工作的端到端自动化。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces manual intervention, enabling end-to-end automation of background code work.

changes.raw: The built-in Explore agent now inherits the main session's model (capped at opus) instead of running on haiku
changes.summary: 内置Explore代理继承主会话模型
changes.summary_en: Built-in Explore agent inherits main session model instead of haiku
changes.why_matters: 提升探索任务的输出质量，与主会话保持一致能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves output quality of exploration tasks, matching main session capability.

changes.raw: Subagents and context compaction now inherit the session's extended thinking configuration, improving output quality on delegated tasks
changes.summary: 子代理和上下文压缩继承扩展思考配置
changes.summary_en: Subagents and context compaction inherit extended thinking config
changes.why_matters: 确保委派任务也受益于深度思考，提升整体输出质量。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures delegated tasks benefit from extended thinking, improving overall output quality.

changes.raw: Fixed brief network drops mid-response aborting the turn — transient errors like ECONNRESET now retry with backoff instead of failing
changes.summary: 修复网络瞬断导致回复中断的问题
changes.summary_en: Fixed transient network errors aborting responses with retry backoff
changes.why_matters: 避免因短暂网络波动丢失长回复，显著提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents losing long responses to brief network blips, significantly improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed excessive background classifier requests when sandboxed processes repeatedly accessed the same network host
changes.summary: 减少沙箱进程重复访问同主机的分类器请求
changes.summary_en: Reduced excessive background classifier requests for repeated host access
changes.why_matters: 降低不必要的网络开销，提升沙箱环境性能。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces unnecessary network overhead, improving sandboxed environment performance.

changes.raw: Fixed background tasks in web, desktop, and VS Code task panels getting stuck on "Running" after they finish or after resuming a session
changes.summary: 修复后台任务面板卡在运行状态的问题
changes.summary_en: Fixed background tasks stuck on Running status after completion
changes.why_matters: 避免任务状态显示错误导致用户困惑和误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misleading task status display that confuses users and causes misoperation.

changes.raw: Fixed agent teams: a teammate that dies on an API error now reports "failed" to the lead, and messaging a stuck teammate wakes it to retry immediately
changes.summary: 修复代理团队中崩溃队友的报告与唤醒机制
changes.summary_en: Fixed agent teams: crashed teammates report failed and can be woken to retry
changes.why_matters: 确保多代理协作中故障能被及时发现和恢复，提升可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures failures in multi-agent collaboration are detected and recovered, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed the `/diff` panel not refreshing when you switch branches or commit outside the session
changes.summary: 修复切换分支或外部提交后diff面板不刷新
changes.summary_en: Fixed /diff panel not refreshing on branch switch or external commit
changes.why_matters: 确保diff视图与实际代码状态同步，避免误导用户。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps diff view in sync with actual code state, avoiding misleading users.

changes.raw: Fixed markdown tables overflowing and wrapping their right border when rendered in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 修复全屏模式下Markdown表格溢出问题
changes.summary_en: Fixed markdown tables overflowing right border in fullscreen mode
changes.why_matters: 改善全屏模式下的表格渲染体验，避免视觉错乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves table rendering in fullscreen mode, avoiding visual glitches.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude Platform on AWS and Mantle sessions dead-ending with "Please run /login" when the STS token expires — `awsAuthRefresh` now runs automatically
changes.summary: 修复AWS和Mantle会话STS令牌过期后的登录死锁
changes.summary_en: Fixed AWS/Mantle sessions dead-ending on STS token expiry with auto-refresh
changes.why_matters: 避免令牌过期后会话中断，保障长时间任务的连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents session interruption on token expiry, ensuring continuity of long-running tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed "no route to host" for local-network hosts in macOS background agent sessions by declaring Local Network entitlements
changes.summary: 修复macOS后台代理无法访问本地网络主机
changes.summary_en: Fixed no route to host for local network in macOS background agents
changes.why_matters: 使后台代理能正常访问局域网资源，扩展可用环境。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables background agents to access local network resources, expanding usable environments.

changes.raw: Fixed `/desktop` failing with "Cannot determine working directory" after entering and exiting a worktree
changes.summary: 修复worktree切换后/desktop命令报错
changes.summary_en: Fix /desktop failing after worktree enter/exit
changes.why_matters: 消除用户在worktree操作后使用桌面命令的阻断性错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes a blocking error when using the desktop command after worktree operations.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents repeatedly showing "Reconnecting…" every ~52 seconds on macOS while the agents view was open
changes.summary: 修复macOS后台代理反复显示重连
changes.summary_en: Fix background agents repeatedly showing Reconnecting on macOS
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在代理视图中被无意义的重连提示干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misleading reconnection spam from distracting users in the agents view.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing `←` inside `claude attach <id>` exiting to the shell instead of opening the agent view
changes.summary: 修复attach中左箭头误退出到shell
changes.summary_en: Fix left arrow in claude attach exiting to shell
changes.why_matters: 确保用户在attach会话中按左箭头能正确进入代理视图而非意外退出。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures left arrow in attach opens the agent view instead of unexpectedly quitting.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --bg` silently creating an unattachable session when combined with `--print`/`-p`; the conflicting flags are now rejected up front
changes.summary: 修复--bg与-p冲突时静默创建不可附加会话
changes.summary_en: Fix --bg with --print silently creating unattachable sessions
changes.why_matters: 提前拒绝冲突参数，避免用户浪费资源创建无法使用的会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Rejecting conflicting flags upfront prevents wasted resources on unusable sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed the workflow progress view dropping the earliest agents from the list while the phase counter stayed correct in SDK and desktop-app sessions
changes.summary: 修复工作流进度视图丢失早期代理
changes.summary_en: Fix workflow progress view dropping earliest agents
changes.why_matters: 确保用户在SDK和桌面会话中能看到完整的工作流代理列表。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures users see the complete agent list in workflow progress views.

changes.raw: Fixed `.claude/rules/` conditional rules not loading when the target file is reached via a symlinked path
changes.summary: 修复符号链接路径下条件规则不加载
changes.summary_en: Fix conditional rules not loading via symlinked paths
changes.why_matters: 确保通过符号链接访问的文件也能正确触发对应的规则配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures rules are correctly applied even when files are accessed via symlinks.

changes.raw: Fixed Cmd+click not opening URLs in fullscreen mode in Warp on macOS
changes.summary: 修复Warp全屏模式下Cmd+click无法打开URL
changes.summary_en: Fix Cmd+click not opening URLs in fullscreen in Warp
changes.why_matters: 恢复Warp全屏模式下用户点击链接的基本交互能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores basic URL-clicking functionality in Warp fullscreen mode.

changes.raw: Fixed double-click word selection in fullscreen mode to select the entire URL including the scheme
changes.summary: 修复全屏模式双击选词未包含URL协议
changes.summary_en: Fix double-click word selection to include URL scheme
changes.why_matters: 让用户在全屏模式下双击能完整选中URL，提升复制效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows users to select entire URLs with double-click, improving copy efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed plan mode not auto-allowing read-only tool calls when a session starts in plan mode
changes.summary: 修复plan模式未自动允许只读工具调用
changes.summary_en: Fix plan mode not auto-allowing read-only tool calls
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在plan模式下被不必要的只读操作确认打断流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unnecessary confirmation prompts for read-only operations in plan mode.

changes.raw: Fixed `/branch` deriving its default fork name from the compaction summary instead of the first real prompt
changes.summary: 修复/branch默认名称取自压缩摘要
changes.summary_en: Fix /branch default name from compaction summary
changes.why_matters: 让分支默认名称基于真实首条提示，提升可识别性和可追溯性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes branch default names based on the real first prompt for better traceability.

changes.raw: Improved focus mode: subagents launched in a turn now appear in its activity summary, and completed background notifications fold into a single count
changes.summary: 改进专注模式活动摘要与通知合并
changes.summary_en: Improve focus mode activity summary and notification folding
changes.why_matters: 让用户在专注模式下更清晰地了解子代理活动和后台通知。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives users clearer visibility into subagent activity and background notifications.

changes.raw: Improved syntax highlighting accuracy in code blocks, diffs, and file previews by upgrading to highlight.js 11
changes.summary: 升级highlight.js提升语法高亮准确性
changes.summary_en: Upgrade to highlight.js 11 for better syntax highlighting
changes.why_matters: 提升代码块、diff和文件预览的可读性和准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves readability and accuracy of code blocks, diffs, and file previews.

changes.raw: Keyboard shortcut hints now show opt/cmd instead of alt/super when connected from a Mac over SSH
changes.summary: SSH连接Mac时快捷键提示显示opt/cmd
changes.summary_en: Show opt/cmd hints when SSH from Mac
changes.why_matters: 让Mac用户在SSH场景下看到更熟悉的快捷键标识。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows familiar key labels for Mac users over SSH connections.

changes.raw: Improved API retry UX: the error reason is now shown after the second attempt, and a status page link replaces the spinner tip when the API is overloaded
changes.summary: 改进API重试UX，显示错误原因和状态页
changes.summary_en: Improve API retry UX with error reason and status page link
changes.why_matters: 在API过载时让用户更快了解问题原因并获取状态信息。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users understand API failures faster and access status information.

changes.raw: `/login` now opens the sign-in dialog from the `claude agents` view instead of saying it isn't available
changes.summary: 修复agents视图中/login无法打开登录
changes.summary_en: Fix /login not opening from agents view
changes.why_matters: 让用户在代理视图中也能直接发起登录，减少上下文切换。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows users to log in directly from the agents view without context switching.

changes.raw: Subagents now treat messages from the agent that launched them as normal task direction; an agent's message is still never treated as the user's approval
changes.summary: 子代理正确处理父代理消息，不再误判为用户批准
changes.summary_en: Subagents treat parent agent messages as task direction, not user approval
changes.why_matters: 确保子代理在委派任务时不会将代理消息错误地视为用户授权，避免越权操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents subagents from mistakenly treating agent messages as user approval, avoiding unauthorized actions.

changes.raw: Removed the `/agents` wizard; ask Claude to create or manage subagents, or edit `.claude/agents/` directly
changes.summary: 移除/agents向导，改为直接对话或编辑配置文件
changes.summary_en: Removed /agents wizard; manage subagents via chat or config files
changes.why_matters: 简化了子代理管理方式，用户需适应新的交互流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Simplifies subagent management workflow, requiring users to adapt to new interaction patterns.

changes.raw: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5: now the default model in Claude Code, with a native 1M-token context window and promotional pricing of $2/$10 per Mtok through August 31. Update to version 2.1.197 for access. https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-5
changes.summary: 默认模型升级为Sonnet 5，支持100万上下文
changes.summary_en: Default model upgraded to Sonnet 5 with 1M context
changes.why_matters: 大幅提升默认模型的上下文处理能力和推理表现，影响所有用户。
changes.why_matters_en: Significantly improves default context capacity and reasoning for all users.

signals.title: Claude Code is steganographically marking requests
Anthropic says Alibaba illicitly extracted Claude AI model capabilities
I used Claude Code to get a second opinion on my MRI
Show HN: OpenKnowledge – open source AI-first alternative to Obsidian/Notion
Alibaba to ban Claude Code in workplace over alleged backdoor risks, source says

changes.raw: Added support for organization default models — admins set it in the org console; it shows as "Org default" (or "Role default") in `/model` when you haven't picked one yourself
changes.summary: 支持组织默认模型，管理员可统一配置
changes.summary_en: Org admins can set default models for members
changes.why_matters: 团队管理员可统一模型策略，减少成员手动选择成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Org admins can enforce model policy and reduce manual selection overhead.

changes.raw: Added readable default names for sessions at start, making them easier to identify and message
changes.summary: 会话默认名称更可读，便于识别和管理
changes.summary_en: Sessions get readable default names for easier identification
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快定位和区分不同会话，提升多会话管理效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly locate and distinguish sessions, improving multi-session management.

changes.raw: Added clickable file attachments in chat — Cmd/Ctrl-click reveals the file in Finder/Explorer
changes.summary: 聊天中文件附件可点击，直接在系统中打开
changes.summary_en: Clickable file attachments open in Finder/Explorer
changes.why_matters: 用户可快速跳转到文件所在位置，减少手动查找步骤。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly jump to file locations, reducing manual navigation steps.

changes.raw: Security: `claude mcp list`/`get` no longer spawn `.mcp.json` servers that a repo self-approved via a committed `.claude/settings.json`; untrusted workspaces show `⏸ Pending approval`
changes.summary: MCP列表不再自动启动仓库自批准的服务器
changes.summary_en: MCP list/get no longer auto-spawns repo-self-approved servers
changes.why_matters: 防止不受信任仓库通过提交的配置文件自动启动潜在恶意MCP服务器。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents untrusted repos from auto-launching potentially malicious MCP servers via committed config.

changes.raw: Fixed waking a background job permanently deleting its conversation and re-running the original prompt when the transcript probe misread a real transcript; the file is now set aside, never deleted
changes.summary: 修复唤醒后台任务误删对话并重跑原始提示
changes.summary_en: Fix waking background job deleting conversation and re-running prompt
changes.why_matters: 避免用户重要对话数据被意外删除，保障后台任务恢复可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental deletion of important conversation data during background job recovery.

changes.raw: Fixed the rate-limit warning flickering off and rate-limit telemetry being over-counted when multiple parallel requests were in flight at the moment a usage limit was hit
changes.summary: 修复并行请求时限流警告闪烁和遥测多计
changes.summary_en: Fix rate-limit warning flicker and telemetry over-count with parallel requests
changes.why_matters: 确保限流提示准确稳定，避免遥测数据误导用户和系统。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures stable rate-limit indicators and accurate telemetry data for users and systems.

changes.raw: Fixed duplicate recap lines after a background session's turn: a schema-rejected StructuredOutput attempt no longer renders alongside its retry
changes.summary: 修复后台会话回合后重复显示摘要行
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate recap lines after background session turn
changes.why_matters: 消除冗余输出，提升后台会话输出的清晰度和可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates redundant output, improving clarity of background session results.

changes.raw: Fixed PowerShell `git diff`/`git grep`, `egrep`/`fgrep`, and quoted search patterns containing `|` being reported as failures when they exit 1, matching Bash behavior
changes.summary: 修复PowerShell下git diff/grep等误报失败
changes.summary_en: Fix PowerShell git diff/grep false failures on exit code 1
changes.why_matters: PowerShell用户不再因退出码差异被误判为命令失败，与Bash行为一致。
changes.why_matters_en: PowerShell users no longer get false failure reports due to exit code differences, matching Bash behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed multiple `claude agents` side panel issues: keyboard focus getting stuck when opening an agent, background jobs losing their subagent types on every open, and sessions showing incorrect status while actively running
changes.summary: 修复agents侧面板多项焦点和状态显示问题
changes.summary_en: Fix multiple agents side panel focus and status display issues
changes.why_matters: 提升多智能体管理界面的交互稳定性和状态准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves interaction stability and status accuracy in the multi-agent management panel.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents --dangerously-skip-permissions` silently falling back to auto mode instead of showing the bypass disclaimer and applying bypass mode to spawned agents
changes.summary: 修复agents跳过权限选项静默回退自动模式
changes.summary_en: Fix agents --dangerously-skip-permissions silently falling back to auto mode
changes.why_matters: 确保权限跳过模式正确生效，避免子智能体在未授权模式下运行的安全隐患。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures bypass mode is correctly applied to spawned agents, avoiding silent security fallbacks.

changes.raw: Fixed mid-turn crash recovery for Remote sessions — sessions interrupted by a server restart now auto-resume on the next worker
changes.summary: 修复远程会话中途崩溃后自动恢复
changes.summary_en: Fix mid-turn crash auto-resume for Remote sessions
changes.why_matters: 远程会话在服务器重启后可自动恢复，避免用户工作丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Remote sessions auto-resume after server restarts, preventing loss of user work.

changes.raw: Fixed sessions moved with `/cd` reappearing in the old directory's resume list after a non-graceful exit when the old path contained special characters
changes.summary: 修复/cd移动会话后旧目录恢复列表残留
changes.summary_en: Fix /cd-moved sessions reappearing in old directory resume list
changes.why_matters: 消除含特殊字符路径下会话恢复列表的冗余条目，避免混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes stale resume entries for sessions moved via /cd, avoiding confusion with special-character paths.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude plugin validate` skipping local plugins whose source is "." and stopping after the first error class
changes.summary: 修复plugin validate跳过本地插件且仅报首类错误
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin validate skipping local plugins and stopping at first error class
changes.why_matters: 插件开发者能获得更完整的验证反馈，提升本地插件开发效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin developers get more complete validation feedback, improving local plugin development efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed Esc Esc at an idle prompt not opening the rewind menu (regression); use Ctrl+C or Ctrl+X Ctrl+K to stop background agents
changes.summary: 修复空闲时Esc Esc未打开回退菜单的回归
changes.summary_en: Fix Esc Esc at idle prompt not opening rewind menu (regression)
changes.why_matters: 恢复常用快捷键交互，避免用户依赖的回退功能不可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores a commonly used keyboard shortcut, ensuring the rewind menu remains accessible.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP OAuth requesting the authorization server's full `scopes_supported` catalog when no scope is specified, causing `invalid_scope` failures on GitLab self-hosted and other enterprise IdPs
changes.summary: 修复MCP OAuth未指定scope时请求全部导致失败
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP OAuth requesting full scope catalog when no scope specified
changes.why_matters: 企业自托管GitLab等IdP的MCP OAuth认证不再因scope问题失败。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP OAuth authentication no longer fails on enterprise IdPs like self-hosted GitLab due to scope issues.

changes.raw: Fixed `/context` showing 0 tokens for all tool groups on Bedrock
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock下/context显示0 token问题
changes.summary_en: Fix /context showing 0 tokens on Bedrock
changes.why_matters: Bedrock用户无法正确查看上下文token用量，影响成本管理。
changes.why_matters_en: Bedrock users couldn't see context token usage, impacting cost management.

changes.raw: Fixed `/deep-research` misreporting verifier failures as "all claims refuted" instead of `unverified`
changes.summary: 修复深度研究验证失败误报为全部被驳斥
changes.summary_en: Fix /deep-research misreporting verifier failures as refuted
changes.why_matters: 错误的验证结论会误导用户对研究结果的信任判断。
changes.why_matters_en: Incorrect verification conclusions mislead user trust in research results.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin dependency version pins not being honored when the marketplace was added as a local folder path backed by a git repo
changes.summary: 修复本地git仓库插件依赖版本锁定失效
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin dependency version pins ignored for local git folder
changes.why_matters: 版本锁定失效可能导致插件加载不兼容版本引发错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Unhonored version pins could load incompatible plugin versions causing errors.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` session status: completed rows no longer flip between "Done" and "Needs your input", stalled agents are now labeled "Needs attention", and results that mention a PR show a clickable link
changes.summary: 修复agents会话状态显示不稳定问题
changes.summary_en: Fix agents session status flickering and add PR links
changes.why_matters: 状态显示混乱会误导用户对多智能体任务进度的判断。
changes.why_matters_en: Unstable status display misleads users about multi-agent task progress.

changes.raw: Fixed voice dictation swallowing spaces and spuriously starting a recording during very fast typing when voice mode is enabled
changes.summary: 修复语音模式吞空格和误触发录音
changes.summary_en: Fix voice mode swallowing spaces and spurious recording
changes.why_matters: 语音与快速打字同时使用时输入体验严重受损。
changes.why_matters_en: Input experience degrades severely when voice and fast typing overlap.

changes.raw: Improved background session reliability: long-running commands and workflows now survive the session's process being stopped, restarted, or updated — including on Windows, where background shells are handed off instead of being killed
changes.summary: 后台会话在进程停止/重启/更新后仍存活
changes.summary_en: Background sessions survive process stop/restart/update
changes.why_matters: 长时间运行的任务不再因更新或重启而丢失，大幅提升可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Long-running tasks no longer lost on update or restart, greatly improving reliability.

changes.raw: Improved background agents: workers killed by a daemon restart are now automatically resumed from where they left off the next time the agents view opens
changes.summary: 后台agent被守护进程杀死后自动恢复
changes.summary_en: Background agents auto-resume after daemon restart kill
changes.why_matters: 守护进程重启不再导致后台agent任务丢失，减少用户手动恢复负担。
changes.why_matters_en: Daemon restarts no longer lose background agent work, reducing manual recovery burden.

changes.raw: Improved `/code-review` workflow: merged five cleanup finders into one, cutting token usage by roughly 25%
changes.summary: 合并代码审查清理查找器，token减少25%
changes.summary_en: Merge code-review cleanup finders, cut tokens ~25%
changes.why_matters: 减少token消耗直接降低使用成本并加快审查速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Reducing token usage directly lowers cost and speeds up review.

changes.raw: Reduced per-frame rendering work in the terminal UI by skipping no-op subtree walks during streaming
changes.summary: 流式输出时跳过无操作子树遍历减少渲染
changes.summary_en: Skip no-op subtree walks during streaming to reduce rendering
changes.why_matters: 降低终端UI渲染开销，提升大输出场景的流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces terminal UI rendering overhead for smoother large output scenarios.

changes.raw: The streaming idle watchdog is now on by default for all providers — it aborts and retries when a response stream produces no events for 5 minutes. Set `CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG=0` to disable.
changes.summary: 流式空闲看门狗默认开启，5分钟无事件自动重试
changes.summary_en: Streaming idle watchdog on by default, retries after 5min idle
changes.why_matters: 防止响应流卡死导致用户无限等待，提升可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stuck response streams from causing infinite user waits, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Remote Control is now disabled when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at a non-Anthropic host, matching the existing behavior under `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK`/`_VERTEX`/`_FOUNDRY`
changes.summary: 非Anthropic主机时禁用远程控制功能
changes.summary_en: Disable Remote Control for non-Anthropic base URLs
changes.why_matters: 防止远程控制功能在第三方端点上意外启用带来的安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents security risk of Remote Control activating on third-party endpoints.

changes.raw: Changed opening the agents view from a foreground session to require a single `←` press instead of two, matching the behavior in background sessions
changes.summary: 前台会话打开agents视图改为单次←键
changes.summary_en: Opening agents view in foreground now needs single ← press
changes.why_matters: 统一前后台交互方式，减少按键摩擦提升操作一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Unifies foreground/background interaction, reducing key friction for consistency.

changes.summary_en: Disable mouse clicks/drag/hover in fullscreen mode
changes.why_matters: 让全屏终端用户避免误触鼠标干扰操作。

changes.raw: Fixed hook matchers with hyphenated identifiers (e.g. `code-reviewer`, `mcp__brave-search`) accidentally substring-matching — they now exact-match. Use `mcp__brave-search__.*` to match all tools from a hyphenated MCP server.
changes.summary: 修复含连字符钩子匹配器的误匹配问题
changes.summary_en: Fix hyphenated hook matchers substring-matching incorrectly
changes.why_matters: 精确匹配避免钩子规则意外触发错误工具，影响自动化流程安全。
changes.why_matters_en: Exact matching prevents hook rules from accidentally triggering wrong tools, protecting automation correctness.

changes.raw: Fixed voice dictation on macOS capturing silence in long-running sessions after the default input device changes
changes.summary: 修复macOS语音听录长时间运行后录到静音
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS voice dictation capturing silence after device change
changes.why_matters: 设备切换后语音输入失效会中断用户工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice input breaking after device changes disrupts user workflows significantly.

changes.raw: Fixed voice dictation auto-submit never firing for languages written without spaces (Japanese, Chinese, Thai)
changes.summary: 修复中日泰等无空格语言语音不自动提交
changes.summary_en: Fix voice auto-submit for spaceless languages (JP/CN/TH)
changes.why_matters: 大量亚洲用户无法正常使用语音自动提交，严重影响体验。
changes.why_matters_en: A large population of Asian language users could not use voice auto-submit properly.

changes.raw: Fixed external plugins enabled only by project `.claude/settings.json` not requiring explicit install consent on every loader path
changes.summary: 修复项目插件未要求安装确认的安全漏洞
changes.summary_en: Fix project-only plugins bypassing install consent on some paths
changes.why_matters: 部分加载路径跳过安装确认，存在插件未经授权执行的安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Skipping install consent on some paths poses a security risk of unauthorized plugin execution.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin` Enable/Disable not working when a plugin's `plugin.json` `name` differs from its marketplace entry name
changes.summary: 修复插件名不一致时启用禁用失效
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin enable/disable when name differs from marketplace entry
changes.why_matters: 插件名不一致导致用户无法正常管理插件，影响扩展可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Name mismatch prevented users from managing plugins, hurting extensibility usability.

changes.raw: Fixed background jobs disappearing from `claude agents` or losing data when written by a newer Claude Code version
changes.summary: 修复新版本写入的后台任务数据丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix background jobs disappearing or losing data from newer versions
changes.why_matters: 版本兼容问题导致后台任务数据丢失，可能造成工作成果丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Version compatibility issues causing data loss can destroy background work results.

changes.raw: Fixed reopening a crashed background task showing a blank screen for up to 5 seconds instead of its restart
changes.summary: 修复崩溃后台任务重开时短暂白屏
changes.summary_en: Fix blank screen when reopening crashed background task
changes.why_matters: 白屏等待让用户误以为任务完全失败，影响恢复体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Blank screen waiting makes users think the task fully failed, degrading recovery experience.

changes.raw: Fixed background agent daemons running unreachable when the control socket fails to start, blocking restarts
changes.summary: 修复控制套接字失败导致后台守护不可达
changes.summary_en: Fix background agent daemons unreachable when control socket fails
changes.why_matters: 守护进程不可达会阻止重启，导致后台代理完全无法恢复。
changes.why_matters_en: Unreachable daemons block restarts, making background agents completely unrecoverable.

changes.raw: Improved voice mode on Linux: now distinguishes "no microphone" from "SoX not installed" when SoX is present but no audio capture device exists
changes.summary: Linux语音模式区分无麦克风与SoX未安装
changes.summary_en: Linux voice mode distinguishes no-mic from SoX-not-installed
changes.why_matters: 更清晰的错误提示帮助用户快速定位并解决音频问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearer error messages help users quickly diagnose and resolve audio issues.

changes.raw: Improved `claude agents` completed list to fill available vertical space; on short terminals the header compacts so live sessions stay visible
changes.summary: 优化agents列表布局以适配短终端
changes.summary_en: Improve agents list layout to fit short terminals
changes.why_matters: 短终端下仍能查看活跃会话，提升小窗口使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Live sessions remain visible on short terminals, improving small-window usability.

changes.raw: Improved Remote session startup with a provisioning checklist while the container starts
changes.summary: 远程会话启动时显示配置检查清单
changes.summary_en: Show provisioning checklist during remote session startup
changes.why_matters: 启动过程透明化让用户了解容器准备进度，减少等待焦虑。
changes.why_matters_en: Transparent startup progress reduces user anxiety while waiting for container provisioning.

changes.raw: Added `autoMode.classifyAllShell` setting to route all Bash/PowerShell commands through the auto-mode classifier instead of only arbitrary-code-execution patterns
changes.summary: 所有Shell命令经自动模式分类器路由
changes.summary_en: Route all shell commands through auto-mode classifier
changes.why_matters: 让所有Shell命令都经过安全分类，提升自动化执行的安全管控粒度。
changes.why_matters_en: All shell commands now pass through the security classifier, improving automated execution safety.

changes.raw: Added auto-mode denial reasons to the transcript, the denial toast, and `/permissions` recent denials
changes.summary: 自动模式拒绝原因显示在多处UI
changes.summary_en: Auto-mode denial reasons shown in transcript, toast, and permissions
changes.why_matters: 用户能清楚了解命令被拒绝的具体原因，便于排查和调整权限配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see exactly why commands were denied, making it easier to troubleshoot and adjust permissions.

changes.raw: Added `claude_code.assistant_response` OpenTelemetry log event containing the model's response text. Redacted unless `OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1`; when that var is unset it follows `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`, so deployments that already log prompt content will start receiving response content on upgrade — set `OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0` to keep prompts-only.
changes.summary: 新增助手响应OTel日志事件
changes.summary_en: Add assistant_response OpenTelemetry log event
changes.why_matters: 支持可观测性平台记录模型响应内容，便于审计和调试，但默认脱敏保护隐私。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables observability platforms to log model responses for auditing and debugging, with redaction by default.

changes.raw: Added live file path autocomplete to bash mode (`!`)
changes.summary: Bash模式新增文件路径自动补全
changes.summary_en: Live file path autocomplete in bash mode
changes.why_matters: 在bash模式中输入命令时自动补全文件路径，减少手动输入错误并提升效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Autocompleting file paths in bash mode reduces manual typing errors and improves productivity.

changes.raw: Added a startup notice when MCP servers need authentication, pointing at `/mcp`
changes.summary: MCP服务器需认证时显示启动提示
changes.summary_en: Startup notice when MCP servers need authentication
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户及时发现MCP服务器认证需求，避免工具调用因未认证而失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users notice MCP server auth requirements early, avoiding tool call failures from missing authentication.

changes.raw: Added automatic memory-pressure reaping for idle background shell commands (disable with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP=1`)
changes.summary: 内存压力时自动清理空闲后台Shell
changes.summary_en: Auto-reap idle background shells under memory pressure
changes.why_matters: 在内存紧张时自动回收空闲后台命令，防止系统资源耗尽影响正常使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Automatically reclaims idle background shells under memory pressure, preventing resource exhaustion.

changes.raw: Fixed `/model` and other client-data-gated UI showing stale/empty state immediately after `/login`
changes.summary: 修复登录后UI显示过期/空状态
changes.summary_en: Fix stale/empty UI state after login
changes.why_matters: 登录后界面不再显示过期数据，确保用户看到正确的模型和配置信息。
changes.why_matters_en: UI no longer shows stale data after login, ensuring users see correct model and config info.

changes.raw: Fixed backgrounding (←←) spuriously cancelling with "N background tasks would be abandoned" when all running tasks carry over to the new session
changes.summary: 修复后台任务误报会被放弃的取消提示
changes.summary_en: Fix spurious cancellation warning for background tasks
changes.why_matters: 后台任务在新会话中可正常延续时不再误报将被放弃，避免用户困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Background tasks that carry over to new sessions no longer trigger false abandonment warnings.

changes.raw: Fixed pinned background agents being re-prompted to "Continue from where you left off" after every auto-update
changes.summary: 修复固定后台代理更新后重复提示
changes.summary_en: Fix pinned background agents re-prompted after auto-update
changes.why_matters: 固定的后台代理不再在每次自动更新后被重复要求继续，减少不必要的干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Pinned background agents no longer get repeatedly prompted to continue after every auto-update.

changes.raw: Fixed backgrounding the main turn spawning a phantom "general-purpose (resumed)" subagent that re-ran the main conversation
changes.summary: 修复后台化主轮次产生幽灵子代理
changes.summary_en: Fix phantom subagent spawned when backgrounding main turn
changes.why_matters: 消除后台化主对话时产生的重复运行幽灵子代理，避免资源浪费和对话混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates a phantom subagent that re-ran the main conversation when backgrounding, preventing wasted resources.

changes.raw: Fixed agent panel hiding sibling agents when viewing a subagent
changes.summary: 修复查看子代理时隐藏同级代理
changes.summary_en: Fix agent panel hiding sibling agents when viewing subagent
changes.why_matters: 查看子代理时不再隐藏同级代理，让用户能同时掌握所有代理的状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Sibling agents remain visible when viewing a subagent, letting users track all agents at once.

changes.raw: Improved background agents: the launch result no longer instructs Claude to "end your response" — it keeps working on other tasks while the agent runs
changes.summary: 后台代理启动后不再要求结束响应
changes.summary_en: Background agents no longer told to end response
changes.why_matters: 启动后台代理后Claude可继续处理其他任务，显著提升并行工作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Claude can keep working on other tasks after launching a background agent, significantly improving parallel efficiency.

changes.raw: Improved MCP `headersHelper` auth: the helper now re-runs and reconnects automatically when a tool call returns 401/403
changes.summary: MCP认证助手在401/403时自动重连
changes.summary_en: MCP auth helper auto-reconnects on 401/403
changes.why_matters: 工具调用遇到认证失效时自动重新认证并重连，减少手动干预提升使用连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Automatically re-authenticates and reconnects when tool calls fail with auth errors, reducing manual intervention.

changes.raw: Improved plugin auto-rename: marketplace `renames` maps are now followed automatically, updating your settings to the new name
changes.summary: 插件自动跟随市场重命名映射
changes.summary_en: Plugin auto-rename follows marketplace rename maps
changes.why_matters: 插件重命名后自动更新用户设置，避免因名称变更导致配置失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Automatically updates user settings when plugins are renamed, preventing config breakage from name changes.

changes.raw: Improved `/add-dir` message when the directory is already a working directory
changes.summary: 改进目录已存在时的提示信息
changes.summary_en: Better message when directory already added
changes.why_matters: 当目录已是工作目录时给出更清晰的提示，减少用户困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Provides a clearer message when the directory is already a working directory, reducing user confusion.

changes.why_matters: 用户在阅读历史输出时不会被新内容打断，提升阅读体验。

changes.raw: Fixed background agents resurrecting after being stopped — stopping an agent from the tasks panel is now permanent
changes.summary: 修复已停止的后台代理被复活的问题
changes.summary_en: Fixed background agents resurrecting after being stopped
changes.why_matters: 确保用户停止后台代理的操作真正生效，避免资源浪费和意外行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures stopping a background agent is permanent, preventing resource waste and unexpected behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed `/voice` showing a generic "not available" message when disabled by an organization's policy — it now explains the restriction
changes.summary: 修复/voice被组织策略禁用时提示不明确
changes.summary_en: Fixed /voice showing generic message when disabled by policy
changes.why_matters: 用户能清楚了解功能被禁用的原因，减少困惑和支持请求。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get a clear explanation of why the feature is restricted, reducing confusion and support requests.

changes.raw: Fixed `/login` URL opening truncated in Windows Terminal when it wraps across lines
changes.summary: 修复Windows终端中/login URL换行截断
changes.summary_en: Fixed /login URL truncated when wrapping in Windows Terminal
changes.why_matters: Windows用户能完整复制登录URL，避免登录失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Windows users can copy the full login URL, avoiding authentication failures.

changes.raw: Fixed Cmd+click on links in fullscreen mode for Ghostty over ssh/tmux
changes.summary: 修复Ghostty通过ssh/tmux全屏时Cmd+点击链接
changes.summary_en: Fixed Cmd+click on links in fullscreen for Ghostty over ssh/tmux
changes.why_matters: 远程终端用户在全屏模式下可正常点击链接，提升远程工作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Remote terminal users can click links properly in fullscreen mode, improving remote workflow.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` sending builtin slash commands like `/usage` to background sessions as prompt text instead of showing a hint
changes.summary: 修复claude agents将内置命令作为提示发送
changes.summary_en: Fixed claude agents sending builtin slash commands as prompt text
changes.why_matters: 避免内置斜杠命令被误当作提示文本发送到后台会话，防止错误执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents builtin slash commands from being sent as prompt text to background sessions, avoiding incorrect execution.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` job rows showing full filesystem paths for pasted images instead of the `[Image #N]` placeholder
changes.summary: 修复代理面板图片路径显示为占位符
changes.summary_en: Fixed agent panel showing full paths instead of [Image #N] placeholder
changes.why_matters: 代理任务列表显示更简洁，避免长路径影响可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Agent task list displays more cleanly, avoiding long filesystem paths that hurt readability.

changes.raw: Fixed hooks with comma-separated matchers (e.g. `"Bash,PowerShell"`) silently never firing
changes.summary: 修复逗号分隔匹配器的hooks不触发
changes.summary_en: Fixed hooks with comma-separated matchers silently never firing
changes.why_matters: 用户配置的多匹配器hooks现在能正常工作，避免自动化流程静默失败。
changes.why_matters_en: User-configured multi-matcher hooks now work correctly, preventing silent automation failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `/permissions` Recently-denied tab: approving a denial now persists on close instead of being silently discarded
changes.summary: 修复权限最近拒绝标签页审批未持久化
changes.summary_en: Fixed /permissions Recently-denied tab discarding approvals on close
changes.why_matters: 用户批准的权限不再被静默丢弃，确保权限管理操作可靠生效。
changes.why_matters_en: User-approved permissions are no longer silently discarded, ensuring reliable permission management.

changes.raw: Fixed the agent panel jumping by one row when scrolling the roster past the overflow cap
changes.summary: 修复代理面板滚动时跳行问题
changes.summary_en: Fixed agent panel jumping by one row when scrolling past overflow
changes.why_matters: 消除代理列表滚动时的视觉跳动，提升界面流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates visual jumping when scrolling the agent roster, improving UI smoothness.

changes.raw: Fixed the welcome splash art overflowing the default 80×24 macOS Terminal window
changes.summary: 修复欢迎界面在80x24终端溢出
changes.summary_en: Fixed welcome splash art overflowing 80x24 macOS Terminal
changes.why_matters: 默认终端窗口下欢迎界面不再错位，提升首次使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Welcome splash no longer overflows in the default terminal window, improving first-run experience.

changes.raw: Fixed managed settings: `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` now takes effect when set via MDM or file policy, and the fetch sends `Cache-Control: no-cache` to prevent proxies from serving stale responses
changes.summary: 修复MDM强制远程设置刷新不生效
changes.summary_en: Fixed managed settings forceRemoteSettingsRefresh via MDM/file policy
changes.why_matters: 企业管理员通过MDM推送的设置能即时生效，并防止代理缓存返回旧响应。

changes.raw: Improved sandbox network permission dialog: hosts you allow with "Yes" are now remembered for the rest of the session instead of re-prompting on every connection
changes.summary: 沙箱网络权限对话框允许后本会话内记忆
changes.summary_en: Sandbox network permission dialog remembers allowed hosts per session
changes.why_matters: 用户无需每次连接重复确认网络权限，大幅减少操作摩擦。
changes.why_matters_en: Users no longer need to re-confirm network permissions on every connection, greatly reducing friction.

changes.raw: Improved MCP server reliability: capability discovery (`tools/list`, `prompts/list`, `resources/list`) now retries transient network errors with short backoff
changes.summary: MCP服务器能力发现增加重试机制
changes.summary_en: MCP capability discovery now retries transient network errors
changes.why_matters: 短暂网络故障不再导致MCP工具列表加载失败，提升集成稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Transient network errors no longer cause MCP tool discovery to fail, improving integration reliability.

changes.raw: Improved MCP OAuth: discovery and token requests now retry once after transient network errors, and headless environments skip the browser popup and go straight to the paste-the-URL prompt
changes.summary: MCP OAuth支持重试与无头环境适配
changes.summary_en: MCP OAuth retries transient errors and adapts to headless
changes.why_matters: 网络抖动和无头环境下OAuth认证更可靠，减少认证失败中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes OAuth authentication more reliable under network flakiness and headless setups.

changes.raw: Improved MCP error messages: HTTP 404 errors now show the URL and point to your MCP config
changes.summary: MCP 404错误提示URL及配置指引
changes.summary_en: MCP 404 errors now show URL and point to config
changes.why_matters: 更清晰的错误信息帮助用户快速定位MCP配置问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearer error messages help users quickly diagnose MCP configuration issues.

changes.raw: Improved vim mode prompt-history search (NORMAL `/`) to hint how to reach slash commands
changes.summary: Vim模式历史搜索提示斜杠命令入口
changes.summary_en: Vim mode history search hints at slash command access
changes.why_matters: 帮助vim用户发现斜杠命令功能，提升交互效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps vim users discover slash commands, improving interaction efficiency.

changes.raw: Reduced CPU usage during streaming responses by ~37% by coalescing text updates to 100ms
changes.summary: 流式响应CPU占用降低约37%
changes.summary_en: Streaming response CPU usage reduced ~37%
changes.why_matters: 显著降低CPU开销，改善长会话和低配设备的流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Significantly reduces CPU overhead, improving smoothness on long sessions and low-spec devices.

changes.raw: Reduced long-session memory growth from terminal output cache
changes.summary: 减少长会话终端输出缓存内存增长
changes.summary_en: Reduced long-session memory growth from terminal cache
changes.why_matters: 缓解长时间运行会话的内存膨胀，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Mitigates memory bloat in long-running sessions, improving stability.

changes.raw: Added `sandbox.credentials` setting to block sandboxed commands from reading credential files and secret environment variables
changes.summary: 沙箱凭证隔离，阻止读取密钥文件
changes.summary_en: Sandbox credential isolation blocks reading secret files
changes.why_matters: 防止沙箱内命令意外或恶意读取凭证，提升安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents sandboxed commands from accidentally or maliciously reading credentials.

changes.raw: Added org-configured model restrictions to the model picker, `--model`, `/model`, and `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`, with a "restricted by your organization's settings" message when a restricted model is selected
changes.summary: 组织级模型限制，选择受限模型时提示
changes.summary_en: Org-level model restrictions with restricted message on selection
changes.why_matters: 让组织能统一管控可用模型，满足合规与成本管理需求。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows organizations to enforce model usage policies for compliance and cost control.

changes.raw: Added mouse click support to select menus (permission prompts, `/model`, `/config`, etc.) in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 全屏模式下选择菜单支持鼠标点击
changes.summary_en: Mouse click support for select menus in fullscreen mode
changes.why_matters: 提升全屏交互体验，让用户操作更直观便捷。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves fullscreen interaction by enabling more intuitive mouse-based selection.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` failing with "No conversation found" when the original `-p` run produced no model turns
changes.summary: 修复无模型轮次时--resume报错
changes.summary_en: Fix --resume failing when original run had no model turns
changes.why_matters: 避免空对话场景下恢复功能误报错误，提升可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents false errors when resuming conversations that produced no model output.

changes.raw: Fixed `--json-schema` and workflow `agent({schema})` structured output: the model can no longer re-call `StructuredOutput` indefinitely after a successful call, and follow-up turns now reliably return structured output
changes.summary: 修复结构化输出无限重调用问题
changes.summary_en: Fix structured output infinite re-call and follow-up reliability
changes.why_matters: 确保结构化输出只调用一次且后续轮次稳定返回，避免浪费和错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures structured output is called once and follow-up turns reliably return structured data.

changes.raw: Fixed remote MCP tool calls that hang with no response for 5 minutes — they now abort with an error instead of blocking indefinitely (override with `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT`)
changes.summary: 修复远程MCP工具调用5分钟无响应挂起
changes.summary_en: Fix remote MCP tool calls hanging for 5 minutes with no response
changes.why_matters: 避免MCP工具无响应时无限阻塞，提升远程调用可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents indefinite blocking when MCP tools fail to respond, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude Code Remote sessions taking ~2.7s longer to start after the agent proxy CA system-trust install was added
changes.summary: 修复远程会话启动慢2.7秒的问题
changes.summary_en: Fix remote session startup taking ~2.7s longer than expected
changes.why_matters: 减少远程会话启动延迟，提升用户体验和效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces remote session startup latency for a smoother user experience.

changes.raw: Fixed pasted Korean/CJK text turning into mojibake in terminals that deliver paste as per-byte extended-key events
changes.summary: 修复粘贴韩文/中日韩文字乱码问题
changes.summary_en: Fix pasted Korean/CJK text becoming mojibake in some terminals
changes.why_matters: 确保CJK用户正确粘贴文本，避免输入损坏影响工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures CJK users can paste text correctly without character corruption.

changes.raw: Fixed `/update` over Remote Control hanging when a startup trust dialog would have shown
changes.summary: 修复远程控制下/update因信任对话框挂起
changes.summary_en: Fix /update hanging over Remote Control due to trust dialog
changes.why_matters: 避免远程更新流程被信任对话框阻塞，确保更新可正常执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents remote update flow from being blocked by startup trust dialogs.

changes.raw: Fixed background jobs in the agents view getting stuck in "working" indefinitely when the agent ended a turn without producing structured output
changes.summary: 修复后台任务无结构化输出时卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix background jobs stuck in working when no structured output produced
changes.why_matters: 避免后台代理任务状态永久卡住，确保状态准确反映实际进度。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents background agent jobs from being permanently stuck in working state.

changes.raw: Fixed channel connections dropping after navigating to the agents view and back, and after `/bg`, `/tui`, or `/update`
changes.summary: 修复导航后频道连接断开问题
changes.summary_en: Fix channel connections dropping after navigating agents view
changes.why_matters: 确保视图切换后连接稳定，避免代理通信中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures stable connections after view navigation, preventing agent communication drops.

changes.raw: Fixed agent stop notifications not correctly attributing who stopped the agent, and improved wording ("finished"/"stopped" instead of "came to rest")
changes.summary: 修复代理停止通知归属及措辞
changes.summary_en: Fix agent stop notification attribution and improve wording
changes.why_matters: 让停止通知更清晰准确，帮助用户了解代理状态变化。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes stop notifications clearer and more accurate about who stopped the agent.

changes.raw: Fixed subagent depth tracking: resumed subagents now restore their original spawn depth, and forked subagents now count toward the depth cap
changes.summary: 修复子代理深度跟踪：恢复与fork计数
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent depth tracking for resumed and forked subagents
changes.why_matters: 确保子代理深度限制正确执行，防止无限递归消耗资源。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures subagent depth limits are correctly enforced, preventing resource overuse.

changes.raw: Fixed leaked agent worktree registrations: locked `.git/worktrees/` entries from killed agents are now cleaned up automatically
changes.summary: 自动清理被杀代理的git worktree锁
changes.summary_en: Auto-clean leaked git worktree registrations from killed agents
changes.why_matters: 避免残留worktree锁导致git操作异常，维护工作区整洁。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents leaked worktree locks from causing git issues, keeping workspaces clean.

changes.raw: Fixed Cmd+click not opening URLs in fullscreen mode in Ghostty on macOS
changes.summary: 修复Ghostty全屏下Cmd+点击无法打开链接
changes.summary_en: Fix Cmd+click not opening URLs in fullscreen in Ghostty on macOS
changes.why_matters: 让Ghostty用户在全屏模式下正常点击链接，提升细节体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows Ghostty users to click URLs normally in fullscreen mode.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --help` not listing the `--bg`/`--background` flag
changes.summary: 修复帮助信息缺少后台运行标志
changes.summary_en: Fix help text missing --bg/--background flag
changes.why_matters: 帮助信息不完整会影响用户发现后台运行功能。
changes.why_matters_en: Incomplete help text prevents users from discovering background execution.

changes.raw: Fixed Esc, Ctrl-C, and Ctrl-D not working while `/share` is uploading
changes.summary: 修复分享上传时无法用快捷键中断
changes.summary_en: Fix Esc/Ctrl-C/Ctrl-D not working during share upload
changes.why_matters: 上传卡住时用户无法取消，严重影响体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Users unable to cancel a stuck upload is a frustrating experience.

changes.raw: Improved `/install-github-app`: GitHub Actions workflow setup is now optional — you can install just the GitHub App and skip the workflow/secret steps
changes.summary: GitHub应用安装支持跳过工作流配置
changes.summary_en: GitHub App install now allows skipping workflow setup
changes.why_matters: 简化安装流程，降低使用门槛，让用户按需配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Simplifies onboarding by making workflow setup optional for users.

changes.raw: Improved `/btw` with ←/→ arrow navigation to step through earlier answers
changes.summary: /btw支持左右键浏览历史回答
changes.summary_en: /btw supports arrow key navigation through past answers
changes.why_matters: 方便用户快速回顾之前的回答内容，提升交互效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes it easier to review previous answers quickly and efficiently.

changes.raw: Improved `/plugin` to surface plugins you haven't used recently so you can clean them up
changes.summary: 插件管理显示近期未使用的插件
changes.summary_en: Plugin manager surfaces unused plugins for cleanup
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户清理不活跃的插件，保持环境整洁。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users identify and remove inactive plugins to keep things tidy.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed extension becoming unresponsive when resuming a large session
changes.summary: 修复恢复大型会话时VSCode扩展无响应
changes.summary_en: Fix VSCode extension freezing on large session resume
changes.why_matters: 大型会话恢复卡死严重影响工作效率，是高频痛点。
changes.why_matters_en: Freezing on large sessions severely impacts productivity for power users.
