changes.raw: Added `claude mcp login <name>` and `claude mcp logout <name>` to authenticate MCP servers from the CLI without opening the interactive `/mcp` menu, with `--no-browser` stdin redirect support for completing over SSH
changes.summary: 支持CLI直接登录登出MCP服务器
changes.summary_en: MCP server login/logout via CLI without interactive menu
changes.why_matters: 让SSH等无浏览器环境也能完成MCP认证，提升自动化场景可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables MCP authentication over SSH and headless environments without browser access.

changes.raw: Added status filtering (press `f`) to the `/workflows` agent detail view
changes.summary: 工作流详情视图支持状态过滤
changes.summary_en: Status filtering in /workflows agent detail view
changes.why_matters: 用户可按状态快速筛选工作流，提升多任务管理效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users quickly filter workflows by status, improving multi-task management.

changes.raw: Added a "Skills" section to the `/plugin` Installed tab
changes.summary: 插件页新增Skills分区
changes.summary_en: Skills section added to /plugin Installed tab
changes.why_matters: 让用户更清晰地查看已安装技能，增强插件管理体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Provides clearer visibility of installed skills, improving plugin management UX.

changes.raw: Added `teammateMode: "iterm2"` setting with a warning when auto mode cannot find the `it2` CLI
changes.summary: 新增iTerm2队友模式设置
changes.summary_en: teammateMode iterm2 setting with it2 CLI warning
changes.why_matters: 支持iTerm2作为队友模式终端，扩展多终端协作场景。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables iTerm2 as a teammate terminal, expanding multi-terminal collaboration options.

changes.raw: Added "Claude Platform on AWS - refresh credentials" option to `/login` when `awsAuthRefresh` is configured
changes.summary: 支持AWS平台凭证刷新登录
changes.summary_en: AWS credential refresh option in /login for Claude Platform
changes.why_matters: 方便AWS用户在凭证过期时快速刷新，减少认证中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets AWS users quickly refresh expired credentials, reducing auth interruptions.

changes.raw: `!` bash commands now trigger Claude to respond to the output automatically; set `"respondToBashCommands": false` in settings.json to keep the previous context-only behavior
changes.summary: Bash命令输出自动触发Claude响应
changes.summary_en: Bash command output now auto-triggers Claude response
changes.why_matters: 让Claude能主动响应命令结果，提升交互流畅度，同时保留可关闭选项。
changes.why_matters_en: Claude now proactively responds to bash output, improving interactivity with opt-out.

changes.raw: Fixed streaming requests failing with "Content block not found" or JSON parse errors after the machine wakes from sleep
changes.summary: 修复休眠唤醒后流式请求解析错误
changes.summary_en: Fix streaming parse errors after machine wakes from sleep
changes.why_matters: 解决休眠后常见连接失败问题，避免用户需重启会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Resolves common post-sleep connection failures, avoiding session restarts.

changes.raw: Fixed subagent transcript scroll position bleeding into the main transcript on exit
changes.summary: 修复子代理滚动位置影响主界面
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent scroll position bleeding into main transcript
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理退出后主界面滚动位置异常，提升视觉一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents scroll position artifacts from subagents affecting the main transcript view.

changes.raw: Fixed background task previews flashing raw tool names before the agent's plan loaded
changes.summary: 修复后台任务预览闪烁原始工具名
changes.summary_en: Fix background task previews flashing raw tool names
changes.why_matters: 消除加载前的闪烁噪音，提升后台任务预览的视觉体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates distracting raw tool name flashes before agent plans load.

changes.raw: Fixed Chrome tab-group isolation not applying when the in-product permissions gate is off for concurrent CLI sessions
changes.summary: 修复权限门关闭时Chrome标签隔离失效
changes.summary_en: Fix Chrome tab-group isolation when permissions gate is off
changes.why_matters: 确保并发CLI会话的浏览器标签隔离始终生效，防止会话串扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures browser tab isolation works for concurrent CLI sessions regardless of gate state.

changes.raw: Fixed background session recaps being duplicated; the agent's own end-of-turn summary now shows as the recap line
changes.summary: 修复后台会话摘要重复显示
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicated background session recaps
changes.why_matters: 避免重复摘要造成信息冗余，让会话回顾更清晰。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes duplicate recap lines, making session summaries cleaner.

changes.raw: Fixed opening a background session from `claude agents` leaving the previous screen painted behind it
changes.summary: 修复从agents打开后台会话残留旧画面
changes.summary_en: Fix stale screen paint when opening background session from agents
changes.why_matters: 消除界面切换时的残留渲染，提升视觉整洁度。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes stale screen artifacts when switching to background sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed `Agent(type)` deny rules and `Agent(x,y)` allowed-types restrictions not being enforced for named subagent spawns
changes.summary: 修复命名子代理的权限规则未生效
changes.summary_en: Fix Agent(type) deny/allow rules not enforced for named subagents
changes.why_matters: 修复安全策略绕过漏洞，确保子代理生成时权限控制正确执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Closes a security gap where subagent spawn rules were bypassed, enforcing proper access control.

changes.raw: Fixed Esc and Ctrl+C not responding while background agents are still running after the main turn ends
changes.summary: 修复后台代理运行时Esc和Ctrl+C无响应
changes.summary_en: Fix Esc/Ctrl+C unresponsive while background agents run
changes.why_matters: 恢复用户对后台代理的中断控制能力，避免无法停止的卡死状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores user ability to interrupt background agents, preventing stuck states.

changes.raw: Fixed misaligned option numbers in permission prompts when the option text overflows
changes.summary: 修复权限提示选项编号错位
changes.summary_en: Fix misaligned option numbers in permission prompts
changes.why_matters: 修正长文本溢出时的编号对齐，提升权限提示可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Corrects option number alignment in permission prompts when text overflows.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing `x` on a finished subagent in the agent panel not dismissing it
changes.summary: 修复子代理完成后按x无法关闭
changes.summary_en: Fix x key not dismissing finished subagent in panel
changes.why_matters: 用户无法快速清理已完成的子代理面板，影响操作流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Users couldn't quickly dismiss completed subagents, hurting workflow fluidity.

changes.raw: Fixed a misleading "MCP server disconnected" notice for intentionally retired tools when resuming older sessions
changes.summary: 修复恢复旧会话时的误导性断连提示
changes.summary_en: Fix misleading MCP disconnected notice for retired tools
changes.why_matters: 避免用户误以为连接异常而进行不必要的排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents users from mistakenly thinking connections are broken.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin` Installed showing a "more above" indicator when already scrolled to the top
changes.summary: 修复插件列表顶部多余的滚动指示
changes.summary_en: Fix false 'more above' indicator in /plugin view
changes.why_matters: 消除界面中的误导性视觉元素，提升细节体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes a misleading visual element for polish.

changes.raw: Fixed `~~strikethrough~~` showing literal tildes in assistant messages instead of rendering as strikethrough
changes.summary: 修复删除线未正确渲染显示波浪号
changes.summary_en: Fix strikethrough rendering showing literal tildes
changes.why_matters: 消息格式正确渲染有助于用户理解内容语义。
changes.why_matters_en: Correct markdown rendering helps users understand message semantics.

changes.raw: Fixed `--tools` allowing feature-gated tools to slip through before flags loaded on a cold first launch
changes.summary: 修复冷启动时特性门控工具被绕过
changes.summary_en: Fix feature-gated tools bypassing flags on cold launch
changes.why_matters: 防止未授权工具在首次冷启动时被意外启用，涉及安全与权限。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unauthorized tools from being enabled on first launch, a security concern.

changes.raw: Fixed background job status in `claude agents` showing a stale "needs input" message after replying
changes.summary: 修复代理后台任务回复后仍显示需输入
changes.summary_en: Fix stale 'needs input' status after replying to agents
changes.why_matters: 过时状态信息会误导用户重复操作或误判任务状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Stale status messages mislead users about task state.

changes.raw: Fixed a dark-theme flash when opening a background session from `claude agents` on a light terminal
changes.summary: 修复浅色终端打开会话时暗色主题闪烁
changes.summary_en: Fix dark-theme flash when opening session on light terminal
changes.why_matters: 消除视觉闪烁，提升终端主题一致性体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates visual flash for consistent terminal theming.

changes.raw: Fixed mouse-selected text staying highlighted after deleting it in `claude agents`
changes.summary: 修复删除选中文字后高亮残留
changes.summary_en: Fix text highlight persisting after deletion in agents
changes.why_matters: 消除编辑器中残留高亮带来的视觉困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes lingering highlight that confuses the editing experience.

changes.raw: Fixed session cost not showing for usage-based Enterprise and Team subscribers
changes.summary: 修复企业版用户会话费用不显示
changes.summary_en: Fix session cost not showing for Enterprise/Team users
changes.why_matters: 费用可见性对企业用户管理成本至关重要。
changes.why_matters_en: Cost visibility is essential for enterprise users managing budgets.

changes.raw: Fixed agent teams: teammates spawned via tmux/pane backends now inherit the leader's `--effort` level
changes.summary: 修复队友未继承领导者effort级别
changes.summary_en: Fix teammates not inheriting leader's --effort level
changes.why_matters: 确保代理团队行为一致，避免子代理执行策略偏离预期。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures consistent agent team behavior and expected effort levels.

changes.raw: Fixed Workflow `agent({schema})` subagents looping forever on repeated schema validation failures instead of aborting after 5 attempts
changes.summary: 修复子代理校验失败后无限循环
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent infinite loop on repeated schema failures
changes.why_matters: 无限循环会浪费大量资源和时间，需及时中止。
changes.why_matters_en: Infinite loops waste significant resources and must abort gracefully.

changes.raw: Improved `claude mcp get` and `claude mcp remove` to suggest the closest configured server name on a typo and truncate long server lists
changes.summary: MCP命令支持拼写建议和列表截断
changes.summary_en: MCP commands suggest closest server name on typo
changes.why_matters: 减少用户因拼写错误导致的操作失败，提升易用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces failures from typos and improves usability.

changes.raw: Improved memory: the agent is now reminded to compact its `MEMORY.md` index when nearing the size limit
changes.summary: 接近大小限制时提醒压缩记忆索引
changes.summary_en: Agent reminded to compact MEMORY.md near size limit
changes.why_matters: 防止记忆文件溢出导致上下文丢失，保障长期记忆连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents memory overflow and loss of context continuity.

changes.raw: Improved skill frontmatter: `display-name`, `default-enabled`, `fallback`, and `metadata.*` keys now accept kebab-case, snake_case, and camelCase
changes.summary: 技能frontmatter支持多种命名风格
changes.summary_en: Skill frontmatter accepts kebab-case, snake_case, camelCase
changes.why_matters: 降低用户编写技能配置时的格式出错率。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces configuration errors when authoring skills.

changes.raw: Improved malformed `SKILL.md` YAML frontmatter handling: loads the skill body with empty metadata instead of failing silently
changes.summary: 损坏的技能YAML改为加载空元数据
changes.summary_en: Malformed skill YAML loads body with empty metadata
changes.why_matters: 避免因格式错误导致技能完全失效，提升容错能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents total skill failure from malformed YAML, improving resilience.

changes.raw: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES` to cap at 15; for unattended sessions, use `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` instead
changes.summary: 重试上限改为15，无人值守会话改用看门狗变量
changes.summary_en: Retry cap set to 15; unattended sessions use watchdog var
changes.why_matters: 明确区分交互式与无人值守场景的重试策略，避免无限重试。
changes.why_matters_en: Separates retry strategies for interactive vs unattended sessions, preventing infinite retries.

changes.raw: Changed background subagents to surface permission prompts in the main session instead of auto-denying; the dialog shows which agent is asking, and Esc denies just that tool
changes.summary: 后台子代理权限提示改为在主会话中显示
changes.summary_en: Background subagent permission prompts now surface in main session
changes.why_matters: 用户可对后台代理的权限请求做出知情决策，而非被自动拒绝。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can make informed decisions on background agent permission requests instead of auto-denial.

changes.raw: Changed `/review <pr>` to use the same review engine as `/code-review medium`
changes.summary: PR审查统一使用与/code-review相同的引擎
changes.summary_en: PR review now uses same engine as /code-review medium
changes.why_matters: 统一审查引擎确保不同入口的代码审查质量一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Unifying the review engine ensures consistent code review quality across entry points.

changes.summary: 优化流式卡顿提示
changes.summary_en: Improved stream stall hint

Show HN: Smart model routing directly in Claude, Codex and Cursor

changes.raw: Improved auto mode safety: destructive git commands (`git reset --hard`, `git checkout -- .`, `git clean -fd`, `git stash drop`) are now blocked when you didn't ask to discard local work, `git commit --amend` is blocked when the commit wasn't made by the agent this session, and `terraform destroy`/`pulumi destroy`/`cdk destroy` are blocked unless you asked for the specific stack
changes.summary: 自动模式更安全，阻止破坏性命令
changes.summary_en: Safer auto mode blocks destructive commands
changes.why_matters: 这能避免代理在未明确授权时误删本地改动或销毁基础设施，显著降低数据和环境损失风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents the agent from accidentally deleting local work or destroying infrastructure without explicit permission, greatly reducing data and environment loss risk.

changes.raw: Added a warning when the requested model is deprecated or automatically updated to a newer model, shown on stderr in print mode (`-p`) and now also covering models set in agent frontmatter
changes.summary: 模型弃用或升级时提示警告
changes.summary_en: Warn when model is deprecated or upgraded
changes.why_matters: 这让用户及时发现模型变更，避免因为模型替换而影响输出一致性或预期行为。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users notice model changes early, avoiding surprises from model replacement that can affect output consistency or behavior.

changes.raw: Added `attribution.sessionUrl` setting to omit the claude.ai session link from commits and PRs in web and Remote Control sessions
changes.summary: 提交和PR可隐藏会话链接
changes.summary_en: Option to omit session links from commits
changes.why_matters: 这能减少在提交和PR中泄露会话链接的风险，提升隐私和合规性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces the risk of exposing session links in commits and PRs, improving privacy and compliance.

changes.raw: Added `/config --help` to list all available shorthand keys for `/config key=value`
changes.summary: 新增 /config 帮助查看快捷键
changes.summary_en: Add /config help for shorthand keys
changes.why_matters: 这能帮助用户更快找到可用配置项，降低学习和使用成本。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users discover available config keys faster and lowers the learning curve.

changes.raw: Changed `/config` toggle behavior: Enter and Space both change the selected setting, and Esc now saves and closes instead of reverting
changes.summary: 优化 /config 切换操作
changes.summary_en: Improve /config toggle controls
changes.why_matters: 这让配置界面操作更顺手，减少误操作并提升编辑效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes the config UI easier to use, reducing mistakes and improving editing speed.

changes.raw: Removed the startup "setup issues" line under the logo — run `/doctor` to see configuration issues or use `--debug`
changes.summary: 启动时不再显示配置问题提示
changes.summary_en: Remove startup setup issues line
changes.why_matters: 这减少了启动界面的噪音，让用户更专注于实际工作。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces startup noise and keeps the interface focused on the task at hand.

changes.raw: Fixed `thinking.disabled.display: Extra inputs are not permitted` 400 errors on subagent spawns and session-title generation for affected configurations
changes.summary: 修复子代理与标题生成报错
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent spawn and title generation errors
changes.why_matters: 这修复了特定配置下的 400 错误，避免子代理和会话标题功能失效。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes 400 errors in affected configurations, preventing subagent spawning and session-title generation from breaking.

changes.raw: Fixed WebSearch returning empty results in subagents
changes.summary: 修复子代理 WebSearch 空结果
changes.summary_en: Fix empty WebSearch results in subagents
changes.why_matters: 这恢复了子代理的联网检索能力，避免它们因为拿不到结果而卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores web search for subagents so they do not stall due to missing results.

changes.raw: Fixed the terminal cursor being stranded above the prompt after navigating history in vim mode with the native cursor enabled
changes.summary: 修复 vim 历史导航光标错位
changes.summary_en: Fix cursor stranded after history nav
changes.why_matters: 这改善了终端编辑体验，避免光标位置异常影响输入。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves terminal editing by preventing cursor misplacement that disrupts typing.

changes.raw: Fixed fullscreen TUI corruption (statusline mid-screen, duplicated spinner rows, merged text) in Windows Terminal under heavy nested-subagent load
changes.summary: 修复 Windows Terminal 全屏界面损坏
changes.summary_en: Fix fullscreen TUI corruption in Windows Terminal
changes.why_matters: 这解决了高负载嵌套子代理下的界面错乱，保障 Windows 用户可正常使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes severe UI corruption under heavy nested-subagent load, keeping Windows users productive.

changes.raw: Fixed turns silently completing with no visible output when the model returned only a thinking block; Claude now re-prompts once
changes.summary: 修复仅思考块导致无输出
changes.summary_en: Fix silent completion on thinking-only output
changes.why_matters: 这避免模型只返回思考内容时任务悄然结束，提升结果可见性和可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents turns from ending silently when the model returns only thinking content, improving visibility and reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed user-level skills appearing multiple times in slash-command autocomplete when multiple plugins are enabled
changes.summary: 修复技能重复出现在补全中
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate skills in slash autocomplete
changes.why_matters: 这让命令补全更干净，减少用户在多个插件下看到重复项的困扰。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps command autocomplete clean and avoids duplicate entries when multiple plugins are enabled.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP servers requiring authentication exposing auth-stub tools to the model in headless/SDK mode
changes.summary: 修复认证 MCP 暴露假工具
changes.summary_en: Fix auth MCP exposing stub tools
changes.why_matters: 这防止在无头或 SDK 场景下向模型暴露不该使用的认证占位工具，降低误用和安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents unauthenticated stub tools from being exposed to the model in headless or SDK mode, reducing misuse and security risk.

changes.raw: Fixed tmux teammate panes failing to launch when the shell has slow rc-file initialization, and keystrokes typed during agent spawn leaking into the new tmux pane instead of the leader prompt
changes.summary: 修复 tmux 队友窗格启动与输入泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix tmux teammate pane launch and input leak
changes.why_matters: 这确保慢启动 shell 下队友窗格能正常打开，并避免用户输入被错误送入新窗格。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures teammate panes launch correctly with slow shell startup and prevents keystrokes from leaking into the wrong pane.

changes.raw: Fixed background tasks started by a teammate being killed when the teammate finishes a turn
changes.summary: 修复队友后台任务被误杀
changes.summary_en: Fix teammate background tasks being killed
changes.why_matters: 这保证队友完成回合后后台任务仍能继续运行，避免协作流程中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps teammate-started background tasks alive after a turn ends, preventing collaboration workflows from being interrupted.

changes.raw: Fixed scheduled task and webhook trigger deliveries being treated as keyboard input; they now classify as task notifications and can no longer approve a pending action or set the session title in auto mode
changes.summary: 修复任务通知误当键盘输入
changes.summary_en: Fix task notifications misread as input
changes.why_matters: 避免自动任务和 webhook 触发被误判为人工输入，减少误操作并提升自动化可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents scheduled and webhook-triggered events from being mistaken for user input, reducing misfires and improving automation reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed focus mode showing "Ran N PostToolUse hooks" timing lines under each response
changes.summary: 修复专注模式多余钩子时间行
changes.summary_en: Fix extra hook timing lines in focus mode
changes.why_matters: 让专注模式输出更干净，减少干扰，提升阅读体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps focus mode output cleaner and less distracting for a better reading experience.

changes.raw: Added `/config key=value` syntax to set any setting from the prompt (e.g. `/config thinking=false`) — works in interactive, `-p`, and Remote Control
changes.summary: 支持提示词内配置任意设置
changes.summary_en: Set any config from prompt
changes.why_matters: 用户可以在对话中直接调整配置，减少切换到命令行参数或配置文件的成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can change settings directly in chat, reducing friction from switching to flags or config files.

changes.raw: Added `sandbox.allowAppleEvents` opt-in setting that lets sandboxed commands send Apple Events on macOS
changes.summary: 沙箱命令可发 Apple Events
changes.summary_en: Allow Apple Events in sandbox
changes.why_matters: 这让受沙箱限制的命令在 macOS 上也能调用系统自动化能力，扩展了可执行任务范围。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets sandboxed commands use macOS automation features, expanding what tasks can be executed.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE` environment variable: point it at a marker file to suppress mobile push notifications while you're at the machine
changes.summary: 在机时可静默手机推送
changes.summary_en: Suppress mobile push when present
changes.why_matters: 用户在本机使用时不会被重复通知打扰，减少噪音并改善体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Users avoid duplicate notifications while actively at the machine, reducing noise and improving UX.

changes.raw: Upgraded the bundled Bun runtime to 1.4
changes.summary: 内置 Bun 升级到 1.4
changes.summary_en: Bundle Bun runtime 1.4
changes.why_matters: 这是底层运行时更新，通常主要影响兼容性和内部实现，而非直接用户功能。
changes.why_matters_en: This is a runtime upgrade that mainly affects compatibility and internals rather than user-facing features.

changes.raw: Improved streaming of long paragraphs: text now appears line-by-line instead of waiting for the first line break
changes.summary: 长段文本逐行流式显示
changes.summary_en: Stream long paragraphs line by line
changes.why_matters: 输出会更快出现在屏幕上，用户能更早看到结果并感知更流畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Text appears sooner on screen, so users get faster feedback and a smoother experience.

changes.raw: Improved auto-retry: API connection drops mid-thinking now automatically retry instead of showing "Connection closed while thinking"
changes.summary: 断线思考中自动重试
changes.summary_en: Auto-retry on mid-think disconnect
changes.why_matters: 网络中断时不必手动重试，能减少任务失败和上下文中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Users no longer need to retry manually after transient disconnects, reducing failed runs and context loss.

changes.raw: Improved the subagent panel: idle subagents auto-hide after 30s, the list caps at 5 rows with scroll hints, and keyboard hints now show in the footer
changes.summary: 子代理面板更紧凑易读
changes.summary_en: Make subagent panel more compact
changes.why_matters: 面板占用更少空间，状态信息更清晰，便于同时关注主对话和子代理。
changes.why_matters_en: The panel uses less space and is easier to scan, making it simpler to follow both the main chat and subagents.

changes.raw: Improved the MCP OAuth browser page to match Claude Code's visual style and auto-close on success
changes.summary: MCP OAuth 页面更顺滑
changes.summary_en: Polish MCP OAuth browser flow
changes.why_matters: 认证流程更像原生体验，成功后自动关闭也减少了手动收尾操作。
changes.why_matters_en: The auth flow feels more native, and auto-closing on success removes extra manual cleanup.

changes.raw: Changed fullscreen mode URL opening to require Cmd+click (macOS) / Ctrl+click, matching native terminal behavior
changes.summary: 全屏模式链接需修饰键点击
changes.summary_en: Require modifier-click for links
changes.why_matters: 降低误触打开链接的概率，符合终端常见交互习惯。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces accidental link openings and matches common terminal interaction patterns.

changes.raw: Changed the `Improved N memories` line to no longer list individual files outside verbose mode
changes.summary: 记忆更新不再列出文件名
changes.summary_en: Hide file list in memory updates
changes.why_matters: 减少非详细模式下的输出噪音，让日志更简洁。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces output noise in non-verbose mode and keeps logs cleaner.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt caching not reading on custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and on Foundry due to a per-request attestation token changing every turn
changes.summary: 自定义端点缓存恢复正常
changes.summary_en: Fix prompt caching on custom endpoints
changes.why_matters: 缓存能重新生效，减少重复请求并提升响应速度与成本效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Caching works again, reducing duplicate requests and improving speed and cost efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed Write/Edit producing 0-byte or truncated files on network drives and cloud-synced folders
changes.summary: 修复网络盘写入损坏文件
changes.summary_en: Fix truncated writes on network drives
changes.why_matters: 避免生成 0 字节或截断文件，直接保护用户代码和数据完整性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents 0-byte or truncated files, directly protecting user code and data integrity.

changes.raw: Fixed `open`, `osascript`, and browser-based auth flows failing with error -600 on macOS by adding the Apple Events entitlement
changes.summary: macOS 授权流程不再报错
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS auth flows with Apple Events
changes.why_matters: 修复系统自动化和浏览器授权失败，确保关键登录与授权流程可用。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores system automation and browser auth flows, keeping critical login and authorization paths working.

changes.raw: Fixed a startup regression (~120ms per launch in fresh environments, introduced in 2.1.169): the first prompt no longer waits for the managed-settings fetch when no MCP servers are configured
changes.summary: 冷启动更快，不再等设置
changes.summary_en: Faster startup without settings wait
changes.why_matters: 首次启动延迟更低，用户能更快开始工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Startup latency is lower, so users can begin working sooner.

changes.raw: Fixed startup blocking with a blank terminal for up to 15 seconds when the account settings fetch is slow on a degraded network
changes.summary: 网络差时不再卡空白启动
changes.summary_en: Avoid blank startup on slow networks
changes.why_matters: 在网络不佳时也能尽快进入可用状态，减少长时间无响应。
changes.why_matters_en: The app becomes usable sooner even on poor networks, avoiding long periods of apparent hangs.

changes.raw: Fixed startup crash (`TypeError: Cannot read properties of null`) when `.claude.json` contains corrupted null project entries
changes.summary: 修复损坏项目配置启动崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix startup crash from corrupted project entries
changes.why_matters: 避免 `.claude.json` 损坏时直接崩溃，提升启动稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents startup crashes when `.claude.json` is corrupted, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed macOS TUI freezing at session start (Ctrl+C unresponsive) when Spotlight is busy reindexing
changes.summary: 修复 macOS 启动卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS startup freeze under Spotlight load
changes.why_matters: 避免 Spotlight 重建索引时 TUI 卡死且无法中断，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the TUI from freezing and ignoring Ctrl+C during Spotlight reindexing.

changes.raw: Fixed long-running idle sessions losing their history when another Claude Code process ran the 30-day transcript cleanup
changes.summary: 修复空闲会话历史丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix idle session history loss during cleanup
changes.why_matters: 防止长时间空闲会话在清理任务中丢失历史记录。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents long-running idle sessions from losing history during transcript cleanup.

changes.raw: Fixed foreground subagents spawning unbounded nested chains; they now respect the same 5-level depth limit as background subagents
changes.summary: 限制前台子代理递归深度
changes.summary_en: Limit foreground subagent nesting depth
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理无限嵌套导致资源耗尽或任务失控。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unbounded subagent nesting that can exhaust resources or run away.

changes.raw: Fixed `/recap` and conversation forks using the previous model immediately after a model switch
changes.summary: 修复切换模型后仍用旧模型
changes.summary_en: Fix recap/forks using stale model after switch
changes.why_matters: 确保 `/recap` 和分叉会话立即使用最新模型设置。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures `/recap` and conversation forks use the newly selected model right away.

changes.raw: Fixed subagent "Thinking" duration showing the parent agent's elapsed time instead of the subagent's own
changes.summary: 修复子代理思考时长显示
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent thinking time display
changes.why_matters: 让用户看到子代理真实耗时，便于判断执行进度。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows the subagent's actual elapsed time so progress is easier to judge.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents blocked on a nested agent showing a ticking elapsed time instead of "waiting" in the agent panel
changes.summary: 修复子代理等待状态显示
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent waiting state display
changes.why_matters: 避免阻塞中的子代理误显示为持续计时，提升状态可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents blocked subagents from appearing to keep running, improving status clarity.

changes.raw: Fixed the API retry indicator ("Retrying in 0s · attempt N/10") staying on screen after the retry succeeded
changes.summary: 修复重试成功后提示残留
changes.summary_en: Fix retry indicator lingering after success
changes.why_matters: 减少误导性状态残留，让界面反馈更准确。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes stale retry status so the UI reflects the real request state.

changes.raw: Fixed AWS `awsCredentialExport` credentials with a short remaining lifetime causing credential refreshes every minute, and now accepts the JSON shape from `aws configure export-credentials`
changes.summary: 修复 AWS 凭证频繁刷新
changes.summary_en: Fix frequent AWS credential refreshes
changes.why_matters: 避免短期凭证被过度刷新，并支持新的导出格式。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids excessive refreshes for short-lived credentials and supports the new export format.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude mcp get`/`list` showing `✓ Connected` when tools/list fails; they now show `! Connected · tools fetch failed` with the error detail
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 连接状态误报
changes.summary_en: Fix false connected state in MCP listing
changes.why_matters: 当工具列表获取失败时能正确暴露错误，便于排障。
changes.why_matters_en: Surfaces tool-list failures correctly so connection issues are easier to diagnose.

changes.raw: Fixed `/remote-control` leaving a stale "connecting…" line; it now confirms in the transcript once connected
changes.summary: 修复远程控制连接残留
changes.summary_en: Fix stale remote-control connecting line
changes.why_matters: 连接成功后会在记录中正确确认，避免状态残留。
changes.why_matters_en: Confirms remote-control connection in the transcript and removes stale connecting text.

changes.raw: Fixed ExitWorktree refusing to remove a clean worktree with "Could not verify worktree state" when bare `git` cannot be resolved on Windows
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 工作树删除失败
changes.summary_en: Fix ExitWorktree on Windows git lookup
changes.why_matters: 在 Windows 上可正常移除干净工作树，避免误报失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows clean worktrees to be removed on Windows even when bare git is not resolvable.

changes.raw: Fixed settings changes (such as `/effort` or `/model`) failing with ENOENT when `~/.claude/settings.json` is a relative symlink under a symlinked `~/.claude`
changes.summary: 修复相对软链设置写入失败
changes.summary_en: Fix settings write with relative symlink
changes.why_matters: 确保 `/effort`、`/model` 等设置在软链环境下也能正常保存。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures settings like `/effort` and `/model` save correctly under symlinked configs.

changes.raw: Fixed IDE selection line numbers in context reminders being off by one (IntelliJ and VS Code)
changes.summary: 修复 IDE 行号偏移
changes.summary_en: Fix off-by-one IDE line numbers
changes.why_matters: 让上下文提醒中的行号与实际代码位置一致，减少跳转错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps reminder line numbers aligned with the real code location, reducing misnavigation.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+C in fullscreen after a native terminal selection (modifier+drag) overwriting the clipboard with the app's prior selection
changes.summary: 修复全屏 Ctrl+C 剪贴板覆盖
changes.summary_en: Fix clipboard overwrite on fullscreen Ctrl+C
changes.why_matters: 避免在原生终端选择后中断操作时意外覆盖剪贴板内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents Ctrl+C from overwriting clipboard contents after native terminal selection.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+V showing "No image found in clipboard" instead of pasting when the clipboard contains text
changes.summary: 修复文本粘贴误判图片
changes.summary_en: Fix text paste misread as image
changes.why_matters: 用户复制文本时不再被误提示没有图片，粘贴体验更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can paste text without being incorrectly told no image is present, making clipboard use more reliable.

changes.raw: Fixed agent creation failing with "EEXIST: file already exists" when the agents directory already exists (Windows/OneDrive)
changes.summary: 修复代理目录创建失败
changes.summary_en: Fix agent directory creation failure
changes.why_matters: 在 Windows/OneDrive 等环境下创建代理不再因目录已存在而失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Agent creation now works in Windows/OneDrive setups even when the agents directory already exists.

changes.raw: Fixed AskUserQuestion preview content being cut off at the dialog edge instead of word-wrapping
changes.summary: 修复提问预览被截断
changes.summary_en: Fix AskUserQuestion preview truncation
changes.why_matters: 长内容会自动换行，用户能完整查看提问预览。
changes.why_matters_en: Long content now wraps properly so users can read the full question preview.

changes.raw: Fixed AskUserQuestion multi-select questions silently dropping a typed "Other" free-text answer when submitting
changes.summary: 修复多选其他文本丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix lost free-text in multi-select
changes.why_matters: 选择“其他”并输入补充说明时，提交后不会再丢失内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Typed details for an "Other" option are preserved when submitting multi-select questions.

changes.raw: Fixed `/stats` "Most active day" and daily token chart dates showing one day early in UTC-negative timezones
changes.summary: 修复统计日期时区偏移
changes.summary_en: Fix stats dates in negative timezones
changes.why_matters: UTC 负时区用户看到的活跃日和日统计不再提前一天。
changes.why_matters_en: Users in UTC-negative timezones now see accurate active-day and daily token dates.

changes.raw: Fixed `/copy` and copy-on-select on Linux not detecting a clipboard utility installed after Claude Code started
changes.summary: 修复 Linux 剪贴板检测
changes.summary_en: Fix Linux clipboard utility detection
changes.why_matters: Claude Code 启动后再安装剪贴板工具也能正常复制。
changes.why_matters_en: Copying works even if a clipboard utility is installed after Claude Code starts.

changes.raw: Fixed tab-indented code rendering with incorrect indentation in the Write (create-file) preview
changes.summary: 修复制表缩进预览错误
changes.summary_en: Fix tab indentation preview rendering
changes.why_matters: 创建文件预览中的缩进显示更准确，减少代码格式误解。
changes.why_matters_en: Create-file previews now render tab-indented code correctly, reducing formatting confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed user prompts queued mid-turn not showing a full-width background highlight in the transcript
changes.summary: 修复中途提示高亮缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix missing highlight for queued prompts
changes.why_matters: 排队中的用户提示在对话中更醒目，状态更清晰。
changes.why_matters_en: Queued user prompts are now highlighted clearly in the transcript, improving visibility.

changes.raw: Fixed the activity spinner's pulse dwelling on the wrong glyph size in Ghostty
changes.summary: 修复 Ghostty 动画图标尺寸
changes.summary_en: Fix spinner glyph size in Ghostty
changes.why_matters: 在 Ghostty 终端中活动指示器显示更一致。
changes.why_matters_en: The activity spinner now renders consistently in Ghostty.

changes.raw: Fixed mid-stream connection drops: partial responses are now preserved instead of showing a raw error, and the spinner no longer gets stuck at "running tool"
changes.summary: 断线保留部分回复
changes.summary_en: Preserve partial replies on disconnect
changes.why_matters: 中途断线时不再丢失已生成内容，用户能继续查看结果而不是只看到错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Users keep the generated partial response after a disconnect instead of losing it to a raw error.

changes.raw: Fixed mouse-wheel scrolling in WSL2 under Windows Terminal and VS Code (regression in 2.1.172)
changes.summary: 修复WSL滚轮失效
changes.summary_en: Fix mouse wheel scrolling in WSL2
changes.why_matters: 在 Windows Terminal 和 VS Code 的 WSL2 环境中滚动恢复正常，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Scrolling works again in WSL2 on Windows Terminal and VS Code, improving usability.

changes.raw: Fixed a sandbox `denyRead`/`allowRead` glob over a large directory tree making the Bash tool description enormous and the session unusable on Linux
changes.summary: 修复沙箱读权限膨胀
changes.summary_en: Fix sandbox read glob description blowup
changes.why_matters: 避免大目录下的权限描述膨胀到不可用，防止 Bash 工具会话被拖垮。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents huge permission descriptions from making the Bash tool unusable in large directory trees.

changes.raw: Fixed the feedback survey capturing a single-digit reply as a session rating immediately after a turn completes
changes.summary: 修复单数字反馈误判
changes.summary_en: Fix single-digit feedback misread
changes.why_matters: 单个数字回复不再被误当作会话评分，避免反馈数据被错误记录。
changes.why_matters_en: A single-digit reply is no longer misclassified as a session rating, preventing bad feedback data.

changes.raw: Fixed the welcome screen stacking multiple promotional banners — at most one promo now shows per session
changes.summary: 欢迎页仅显示一个推广
changes.summary_en: Show only one promo on welcome screen
changes.why_matters: 减少欢迎页广告堆叠，让界面更清爽、干扰更少。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the welcome screen cleaner by preventing stacked promotional banners.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+O not showing the subagent's transcript when viewing a subagent
changes.summary: 可查看子代理转录
changes.summary_en: Show subagent transcript with Ctrl+O
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接查看子代理完整对话，便于理解和排查子任务结果。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can view the subagent transcript directly, making subtask results easier to inspect.

changes.raw: Fixed clicking the prompt input not returning focus from the subagent/footer panel
changes.summary: 点击输入框可恢复焦点
changes.summary_en: Restore focus when clicking prompt input
changes.why_matters: 在子代理或底部面板后点击输入框即可继续输入，交互更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Clicking the prompt input now returns focus properly, making interaction smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed remote session background tasks appearing stuck as "still running" between turns
changes.summary: 远程任务不再假卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix stuck remote background tasks
changes.why_matters: 远程会话中后台任务状态显示更准确，减少误以为任务卡死的困扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Background task status in remote sessions is now accurate, reducing false stuck-state confusion.

changes.raw: Improved plugin loading performance in remote sessions
changes.summary: 远程会话插件加载更快
changes.summary_en: Faster plugin loading in remote sessions
changes.why_matters: 远程会话启动和切换插件更快，整体响应体验更好。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin loading is faster in remote sessions, improving overall responsiveness.

The text in Claude Code’s “Extended Thinking” output
Launch HN: Adam (YC W25) – Open-Source AI CAD
Show HN: Recall – Local project memory for Claude Code
Ask HN: How do you get into a flow state when using AI to code?

changes.raw: Agent teams: removed the `TeamCreate` and `TeamDelete` tools. With `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1` set, every session now has one implicit team — spawn teammates directly with the Agent tool's `name` parameter, no setup step needed. The `team_name` parameter on the Agent tool is still accepted but ignored.
changes.summary: 代理团队改为隐式单团队
changes.summary_en: Implicit single team for agent teams
changes.why_matters: 移除了 TeamCreate 和 TeamDelete 工具，现有依赖显式建队的自动化流程需要调整。
changes.why_matters_en: Removing TeamCreate and TeamDelete changes existing workflows that relied on explicit team setup.

changes.raw: Added `Tool(param:value)` syntax for permission rules to match a tool's input parameters (with `*` wildcard), e.g. `Agent(model:opus)` to block Opus subagents
changes.summary: 权限规则支持参数匹配
changes.summary_en: Permission rules can match tool params
changes.why_matters: 可以按工具参数精确限制行为，提升权限控制的灵活性和安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: This enables finer-grained control over tool usage and improves safety.

changes.raw: Skills in nested `.claude/skills` directories now load when working on files there; on a name clash, the nested skill appears as `<dir>:<name>` so both stay available
changes.summary: 嵌套技能目录自动加载
changes.summary_en: Load skills from nested skill dirs
changes.why_matters: 在子目录工作时也能自动发现对应技能，减少手动切换和遗漏。
changes.why_matters_en: Skills are discovered more reliably in nested project areas, reducing manual setup.

changes.raw: Nested `.claude/` directories: the agent, workflow, and output-style closest to the working directory now wins when names collide; project-scope workflow saves now target the closest existing `.claude/workflows/`
changes.summary: 就近优先解析嵌套配置
changes.summary_en: Closest nested .claude config wins
changes.why_matters: 让当前工作目录附近的配置优先生效，减少命名冲突带来的意外行为。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes local configuration resolution more predictable when names collide.

changes.raw: Improved auto mode: subagent spawns are now evaluated by the classifier before launch, closing a gap where a subagent could request a blocked action without review
changes.summary: 自动模式先审查子代理
changes.summary_en: Auto mode reviews subagent launches
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理绕过审查直接执行受限操作，降低自动化带来的安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This closes a gap where subagents could bypass review and perform blocked actions.

changes.raw: Improved `/doctor` with consistent flat tree layout across all sections, clearer section status icons, and highlighted command names
changes.summary: /doctor 输出更清晰
changes.summary_en: Cleaner /doctor output layout
changes.why_matters: 诊断信息更易读，帮助用户更快定位环境和配置问题。
changes.why_matters_en: The diagnostics are easier to scan, making troubleshooting faster.

changes.raw: Improved the skill listing truncation warning to show how many skill descriptions are affected
changes.summary: 技能截断提示更明确
changes.summary_en: Clearer skill truncation warning
changes.why_matters: 用户能知道有多少技能描述被截断，便于判断信息是否足够。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see how many skill descriptions were truncated and judge completeness.

changes.raw: Changed the workflow prompt keyword to use a purple shimmer highlight and trigger only on explicit phrases like "run a workflow" or "workflow:", not on any mention of the word
changes.summary: 工作流触发更精准
changes.summary_en: More precise workflow trigger
changes.why_matters: 减少误触发工作流提示，让交互更符合用户明确意图。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces accidental workflow prompts and makes activation more intentional.

changes.raw: Improved Remote Control error messages: connection failures now show a persistent red "/rc failed" indicator in the footer, and the "not yet enabled" error now explains whether it's a gate, a check failure, stale entitlement, or org policy
changes.summary: 远程控制错误更可见
changes.summary_en: Clearer Remote Control errors
changes.why_matters: 连接失败和未启用原因更清楚，便于快速排查权限、门禁或组织策略问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearer failure states help users diagnose gates, checks, entitlement, or policy issues faster.

changes.raw: `/bug` now requires a description before submitting, and no longer uses model-refusal text as the GitHub issue title
changes.summary: /bug 提交前需写描述
changes.summary_en: Require /bug description before submit
changes.why_matters: 避免提交空洞问题单，并提升 GitHub issue 标题质量。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents low-quality bug reports and improves issue titles.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash (out-of-memory) when the CLI inherits a stale websocket/OAuth file-descriptor environment variable from a parent process
changes.summary: 修复旧 WebSocket/OAuth 崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash from stale websocket/OAuth FD
changes.why_matters: 避免 CLI 因继承异常环境变量而直接崩溃，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents crashes caused by inherited stale environment state and improves reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude in Chrome silently failing to connect when the OAuth token belongs to a different account than the Claude Code login
changes.summary: 修复 Chrome 登录账号不一致
changes.summary_en: Fix Chrome OAuth account mismatch
changes.why_matters: 解决 Claude in Chrome 因账号不匹配而无法连接的问题，减少登录故障。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes silent connection failures when the OAuth account differs from the CLI login.

changes.raw: Fixed nested `.claude/skills` skills with directory-qualified names being blocked by permission prompts in non-interactive runs
changes.summary: 嵌套技能非交互权限修复
changes.summary_en: Fix permissions for nested skills
changes.why_matters: 让目录限定的嵌套技能在非交互运行中可正常使用，避免误拦截。
changes.why_matters_en: Directory-qualified nested skills now work in non-interactive runs without being blocked.

changes.raw: Fixed several subagent issues: viewing a subagent's transcript now shows tool results and live progress, messages sent while it finishes its turn are no longer dropped, and backgrounding a running subagent (ctrl+b) no longer restarts it from scratch
changes.summary: 修复子代理转录与后台恢复
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent transcript and resume
changes.why_matters: 子代理的进度、消息和后台恢复更可靠，提升长任务协作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Subagent progress, messages, and backgrounding now behave more reliably for long-running work.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` workers failing with `401 Invalid bearer token` when the daemon was started from a shell with a custom API gateway via `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`
changes.summary: 修复自定义网关鉴权失败
changes.summary_en: Fix worker auth with custom gateway
changes.why_matters: 使用自定义 API 网关时 workers 不再因 token 失效而报 401。
changes.why_matters_en: Workers now authenticate correctly when launched with a custom API gateway.

changes.raw: Fixed compaction not honoring `--fallback-model`: compaction now falls back to the configured fallback model chain on overload or model-availability errors
changes.summary: 补全压缩回退模型链
changes.summary_en: Compaction now honors fallback model chain
changes.why_matters: 在模型过载或不可用时，压缩流程会自动切换到备用模型，减少任务中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Compaction now falls back to configured models when the primary model is overloaded or unavailable, reducing task interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed model requests continuing to fail with auth errors after credentials were refreshed outside the session, due to a stale cached request configuration
changes.summary: 刷新凭据后恢复请求
changes.summary_en: Requests recover after refreshed credentials
changes.why_matters: 外部刷新登录凭据后，模型请求不再因旧缓存配置持续失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Model requests no longer keep failing after credentials are refreshed outside the session due to stale cached config.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions created with `/bg` or `←←` after a turn finished showing "Working" forever in the agents list
changes.summary: 后台会话状态不再卡住
changes.summary_en: Background sessions no longer stay stuck
changes.why_matters: 新建后台会话后，代理列表能正确显示运行状态，避免误以为任务卡死。
changes.why_matters_en: Background sessions now show the correct running state in the agents list instead of appearing stuck.

changes.raw: Fixed Linux sandbox failing to start when `.claude/skills` or `.claude/hooks` is a symlink
changes.summary: Linux 沙箱支持符号链接
changes.summary_en: Linux sandbox supports symlinked skill paths
changes.why_matters: 当技能或钩子目录是符号链接时，Linux 沙箱也能正常启动。
changes.why_matters_en: The Linux sandbox can start successfully even when skills or hooks directories are symlinked.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE=1` preventing fresh marketplace installs from cloning
changes.summary: 插件市场失败后可重装
changes.summary_en: Marketplace installs work after failures
changes.why_matters: 即使保留失败状态，也不会阻止后续从头重新克隆安装市场插件。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeping failed marketplace state no longer blocks fresh installs from cloning again.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP server-level specs (`mcp__server`, `mcp__server__*`, `mcp__*`) in subagent `disallowedTools` being silently ignored
changes.summary: 子代理禁用 MCP 规则生效
changes.summary_en: Subagent MCP disallowed tools now apply
changes.why_matters: 子代理的禁用工具配置现在会正确限制 MCP 服务器级工具，避免越权调用。
changes.why_matters_en: Subagent disallowed-tools settings now correctly restrict MCP server-level tools, preventing unauthorized use.

changes.raw: Fixed vim mode undo: `u` now steps through NORMAL/VISUAL-mode commands one at a time instead of merging commands in quick succession into a single undo step
changes.summary: vim 撤销按命令逐步回退
changes.summary_en: Vim undo steps through commands one by one
changes.why_matters: 在 vim 模式下撤销操作更符合预期，便于逐步回退编辑动作。
changes.why_matters_en: Undo in vim mode now behaves more predictably by stepping through commands one at a time.

changes.raw: Fixed statusline links with custom URI schemes (e.g. `vscode://`) not opening when clicked in `claude agents`
changes.summary: 状态栏链接可正常打开
changes.summary_en: Statusline links open custom URIs
changes.why_matters: 在 agents 视图中点击自定义 URI 链接时，能正确跳转到外部应用。
changes.why_matters_en: Custom URI links in the agents statusline now open correctly in external apps.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed pressing Esc to dismiss a CJK IME candidate window canceling the running Claude task
changes.summary: VSCode 里 Esc 不再误取消任务
changes.summary_en: Esc no longer cancels tasks during CJK IME
changes.why_matters: 使用中文等输入法时关闭候选窗不会误触发任务取消，减少编辑中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Pressing Esc to dismiss a CJK IME candidate window no longer cancels the running task, reducing interruptions.

signals.title: Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use
The text in Claude Code’s “Extended Thinking” output
Launch HN: Adam (YC W25) – Open-Source AI CAD
Show HN: Recall – Local project memory for Claude Code
Launch HN: Intuned (YC S22) – Build and run reliable browser automations as code

changes.raw: Session titles are now generated in the language of your conversation (set the `language` setting to pin a specific language)
changes.summary: 会话标题自动匹配对话语言
changes.summary_en: Session titles match conversation language
changes.why_matters: 让会话标题更自然，便于按当前语言快速识别和整理记录。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes session titles feel more natural and easier to scan in the language you are using.

changes.raw: Added `footerLinksRegexes` setting for regex-matched link badges in the footer row, configurable via user or managed settings
changes.summary: 支持页脚链接正则徽章配置
changes.summary_en: Configurable regex footer link badges
changes.why_matters: 用户或托管配置可以更灵活地在页脚展示匹配链接徽章。
changes.why_matters_en: Users or managed settings can now flexibly show footer badges for links matched by regex.

changes.raw: Improved Bedrock credential caching: credentials from `awsCredentialExport` are now cached until their `Expiration` instead of a fixed 1 hour
changes.summary: Bedrock 凭证缓存更持久
changes.summary_en: Bedrock creds cache until expiration
changes.why_matters: 按真实过期时间缓存可减少重复取证和不必要的认证开销。
changes.why_matters_en: Caching until the real expiration reduces repeated credential refreshes and auth overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed `availableModels` enforcement: alias model picks can no longer be redirected to a blocked model via `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL` environment variables, and `/fast` now refuses to toggle when it would switch to a model outside the allowlist
changes.summary: 模型白名单限制更严格
changes.summary_en: Stricter model allowlist enforcement
changes.why_matters: 防止通过环境变量或快捷切换绕过允许列表访问被禁用的模型。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents environment variables or quick toggles from bypassing the allowlist and reaching blocked models.

changes.raw: Fixed auto mode failing on Fable 5 for organizations without Opus 4.8 enabled — the classifier now falls back to the best available Opus model
changes.summary: 自动模式回退到可用 Opus
changes.summary_en: Auto mode falls back to available Opus
changes.why_matters: 在部分组织未启用指定模型时，自动模式仍能正常选择最佳可用模型。
changes.why_matters_en: Auto mode keeps working by selecting the best available model when the preferred one is unavailable.

changes.raw: Fixed hook `if` conditions for Read/Edit/Write tool paths: documented patterns like `Edit(src/**)`, `Read(~/.ssh/**)`, and `Read(.env)` now match correctly
changes.summary: 工具路径条件匹配修复
changes.summary_en: Fixed tool path condition matching
changes.why_matters: 像 `Edit(src/**)`、`Read(~/.ssh/**)` 这类规则现在能按预期生效。
changes.why_matters_en: Rules like `Edit(src/**)` and `Read(~/.ssh/**)` now match as documented.

changes.raw: Fixed Linux sandbox failing to start when `.claude/settings.json` is a symlink with an absolute target
changes.summary: Linux 沙箱支持绝对目标符号链接
changes.summary_en: Linux sandbox handles absolute symlink
changes.why_matters: 避免配置文件是绝对路径符号链接时沙箱启动失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents sandbox startup failures when the settings file is a symlink to an absolute target.

changes.raw: Fixed `/copy` and mouse-selection copy not reaching the system clipboard inside tmux over SSH, and tmux paste buffer not loading on versions older than 3.2
changes.summary: tmux/SSH 复制可进系统剪贴板
changes.summary_en: Clipboard copy works in tmux over SSH
changes.why_matters: 在远程终端里复制和粘贴更可靠，减少手动转移文本的麻烦。
changes.why_matters_en: Copying and pasting is now reliable in remote terminal setups, reducing manual text transfer.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control connecting from web/mobile silently switching the session's model
changes.summary: 远控连接不再悄改模型
changes.summary_en: Remote Control no longer changes model
changes.why_matters: 从网页或移动端接入时不会意外切换会话模型，避免行为不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Connecting from web or mobile no longer unexpectedly changes the session model, avoiding inconsistent behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control disconnect notifications showing a bare numeric code instead of a human-readable reason, and connection failures adding a duplicate line to the conversation transcript
changes.summary: 远控断开提示更清晰
changes.summary_en: Clearer Remote Control disconnect reasons
changes.why_matters: 断开原因可读性更好，且不会在转录中重复写入失败信息。
changes.why_matters_en: Disconnect reasons are now human-readable and failures no longer add duplicate transcript lines.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control sessions not disconnecting when you sign in to a different account
changes.summary: 切换账号会断开远控会话
changes.summary_en: Remote sessions disconnect on account switch
changes.why_matters: 避免不同账号之间的远程控制连接意外保持在线，提升会话隔离。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents remote control connections from staying alive across accounts and improves session isolation.

changes.raw: Fixed `/cd` and worktree moves leaving the session reporting the previous directory's git branch
changes.summary: 切目录后分支显示正确
changes.summary_en: Git branch updates after cd/worktree move
changes.why_matters: 会话状态能正确反映当前目录的 git 分支，减少误判。
changes.why_matters_en: The session now reflects the correct git branch for the current directory, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents`: pressing back in one window no longer detaches other windows attached to the same session
changes.summary: agents 返回不再连带断开其他窗
changes.summary_en: Back no longer detaches other agent windows
changes.why_matters: 一个窗口返回不会影响同会话的其他窗口，协作更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Going back in one window no longer affects other windows attached to the same session, making collaboration more stable.

changes.raw: Fixed backgrounded sessions showing "Working" forever when `/bg` mid-turn had nothing left to continue
changes.summary: 后台任务状态不再卡在 Working
changes.summary_en: Background sessions no longer stuck Working
changes.why_matters: 当 `/bg` 没有可继续内容时，状态会正确结束而不是一直显示工作中。
changes.why_matters_en: When `/bg` has nothing left to continue, the status now ends correctly instead of staying on Working.

changes.raw: Fixed background agent search by PR URL: PRs opened during scheduled wakeups or while a job was blocked now appear in `claude agents` search
changes.summary: PR 搜索能找到唤醒期创建项
changes.summary_en: PR search finds wakeup-created jobs
changes.why_matters: 后台代理按 PR URL 搜索时，更多真实存在的任务都能被检索到。
changes.why_matters_en: Searching background agents by PR URL now finds more real jobs, including those created during wakeups or while blocked.

changes.raw: Fixed the agents view input showing no text cursor on Windows
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 输入光标显示
changes.summary_en: Fix missing cursor in Windows input
changes.why_matters: Windows 上代理视图输入框能正常显示光标，减少误操作和输入困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: The agents view input now shows a cursor on Windows, reducing confusion and input errors.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --bg -cn <name>` not seeding the session name
changes.summary: 修复后台会话名称预设
changes.summary_en: Fix seeding session name for bg mode
changes.why_matters: 使用 `claude --bg -cn` 时会正确带入会话名，便于识别和管理后台任务。
changes.why_matters_en: Using `claude --bg -cn` now seeds the session name correctly, making background tasks easier to identify and manage.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions to neutralize Windows network paths in persisted state before respawn
changes.summary: 修复后台状态中的网络路径
changes.summary_en: Neutralize Windows network paths in state
changes.why_matters: 在持久化状态里处理 Windows 网络路径可避免重启时路径被错误解析或泄露。
changes.why_matters_en: Neutralizing Windows network paths in persisted state helps prevent misparsing or leakage when sessions respawn.

changes.raw: Fixed background-session respawn rejecting malformed resume IDs from corrupted state files
changes.summary: 拒绝损坏的恢复 ID
changes.summary_en: Reject malformed resume IDs on respawn
changes.why_matters: 损坏状态文件中的异常恢复 ID 不会再导致后台会话重启失败或行为异常。
changes.why_matters_en: Malformed resume IDs from corrupted state files no longer break background-session respawn.

changes.raw: Fixed the Windows background-service daemon not starting when `~/.claude/daemon` has the ReadOnly attribute set
changes.summary: 修复只读目录下守护进程启动
changes.summary_en: Fix daemon start with read-only dir
changes.why_matters: Windows 上即使 `~/.claude/daemon` 被标记为只读，后台服务也能正常启动。
changes.why_matters_en: The Windows background-service daemon can now start even when `~/.claude/daemon` is marked read-only.

changes.raw: Fixed cloud sessions failing with "Could not resolve authentication method" when idle for too long before being claimed
changes.summary: 修复云会话认证失效
changes.summary_en: Fix cloud session auth after long idle
changes.why_matters: 云会话长时间空闲后再接管时，不会再因认证方式解析失败而中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Cloud sessions no longer fail with auth-method resolution errors after being idle too long before claim.

changes.raw: Background sessions now show clearer guidance when a window left open across an auto-update can't submit a reply, and `claude daemon status` explains version-skew behavior
changes.summary: 改进后台会话提示与状态说明
changes.summary_en: Improve guidance and daemon status text
changes.why_matters: 自动更新后窗口无法回复时会给出更清晰指引，`claude daemon status` 也更易理解版本不一致行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get clearer guidance when an open window can't reply after auto-update, and `claude daemon status` better explains version skew.

changes.raw: Added `enforceAvailableModels` managed setting — when enabled, the `availableModels` allowlist also constrains the Default model (a Default that would resolve to a disallowed model now falls back to the first allowed model), and user or project settings can no longer widen a managed `availableModels` list
changes.summary: 限制默认模型与可用模型白名单
changes.summary_en: Default model now obeys availableModels
changes.why_matters: 这能防止默认模型或本地配置绕过受管控的模型白名单，提升组织级合规与安全控制。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents the default model or local settings from bypassing a managed model allowlist, improving org-level compliance and control.

signals.title: Anthropic, please ship an official Claude Desktop for Linux
Ask HN: Why is the HN crowd so anti-AI?
Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use
Show HN: Lathe – Use LLMs to learn a new domain, not skip past it
I design with Claude more than Figma now

changes.raw: Added `wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled` setting to disable mouse-wheel scroll acceleration in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 全屏滚轮可关闭加速
changes.summary_en: Disable fullscreen wheel acceleration
changes.why_matters: 让全屏模式下的鼠标滚轮行为更可控，提升滚动体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes fullscreen scrolling behavior more predictable and usable.

changes.raw: Fixed the `/model` picker hiding the model family that Default resolves to — Opus now appears as its own row on Max/Team Premium/Enterprise plans, Sonnet on Pro/Team plans, and Opus on pay-as-you-go API accounts
changes.summary: 修复模型选择器显示
changes.summary_en: Fix /model picker model display
changes.why_matters: 避免默认模型被隐藏，帮助用户正确选择可用模型。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents the default-resolved model from being hidden and makes model selection accurate.

changes.raw: Fixed `/model` picker showing a hardcoded Sonnet version label when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` pins a different Sonnet
changes.summary: 修复默认 Sonnet 标签错误
changes.summary_en: Fix hardcoded Sonnet label in /model
changes.why_matters: 确保当默认 Sonnet 被固定时，界面显示与实际配置一致。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps the UI label aligned with the pinned Sonnet model configuration.

changes.raw: Fixed the "Fable 5 is now consuming usage credits" banner incorrectly showing for enterprise accounts with usage-based billing
changes.summary: 修复企业版错误用量提示
changes.summary_en: Fix incorrect usage banner for enterprise
changes.why_matters: 避免企业账户看到误导性的额度告警，减少混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids misleading quota warnings for enterprise users and reduces confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock GovCloud regions (`us-gov-*`) deriving the wrong inference profile prefix (`global` instead of `us-gov`), causing 400 errors on derived model IDs
changes.summary: 修复GovCloud推理前缀
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock GovCloud inference prefix
changes.why_matters: 修正后可避免模型 ID 派生失败导致的 400 错误。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents derived model IDs from failing with 400 errors in GovCloud regions.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions inheriting another session's `ANTHROPIC_*` provider env (gateway URL, custom headers, `/model` aliases) from the shell that started the background daemon
changes.summary: 修复后台会话串用环境变量
changes.summary_en: Fix background sessions env leakage
changes.why_matters: 避免不同会话之间互相污染提供方配置，防止连接到错误的服务。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents provider settings from leaking across sessions and avoids connecting to the wrong service.

changes.raw: Fixed a 1-2 second pause when exiting Claude Code shortly after a shell command was interrupted or killed on macOS and Linux
changes.summary: 退出时减少卡顿
changes.summary_en: Reduce exit pause after interrupted commands
changes.why_matters: 让用户在中断命令后退出应用更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes exiting the app smoother after interrupted commands.

changes.raw: Fixed git commit co-author attribution showing an incorrect model name for some models
changes.summary: 修复提交协作者模型名
changes.summary_en: Fix commit co-author model name
changes.why_matters: 让 git 提交中的协作者信息更准确。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes co-author attribution in git commits more accurate.

changes.raw: Fixed the `/advisor` dialog pre-selecting a saved advisor model that is blocked by the `availableModels` allowlist
changes.summary: 修复Advisor预选被禁模型
changes.summary_en: Fix /advisor preselect allowlist
changes.why_matters: 避免对话框默认选中不可用模型，减少操作失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents the dialog from preselecting a blocked model and reduces failed actions.

changes.raw: Fixed skill hot-reload re-sending the entire skill listing when a single skill changed; only changed skills are now re-announced
changes.summary: 技能热更新只播报变更
changes.summary_en: Announce only changed skills on hot reload
changes.why_matters: 减少重复通知，降低技能更新时的噪音和开销。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces redundant notifications and lowers noise and overhead during skill updates.

changes.raw: Fixed Workflow tool `agent()` subagents missing per-agent attribution headers
changes.summary: 修复子代理归属头缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix missing attribution headers for agent()
changes.why_matters: 确保子代理调用带上正确归属信息，便于审计和追踪。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures subagent calls carry proper attribution for auditing and traceability.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added usage attribution to the Account & usage dialog (`/usage`) showing cache misses, long context, subagents, and per-skill/agent/plugin/MCP breakdowns over the last 24h or 7d
changes.summary: 用量页新增归因明细
changes.summary_en: Add usage attribution breakdown in /usage
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户在用量页面查看缓存、长上下文、子代理及各类插件的消耗来源。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users see where usage comes from across cache misses, long context, subagents, and plugins.

changes.raw: Fixed pre-warmed background workers failing with "Could not resolve authentication method" when claimed after sitting idle
changes.summary: 修复空闲后台工人认证失败
changes.summary_en: Fix auth failure for idle pre-warmed workers
changes.why_matters: 避免后台工人在被领取时因认证失效而无法使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents pre-warmed background workers from failing when claimed after being idle.

signals.title: Anthropic, please ship an official Claude Desktop for Linux
Ask HN: Why is the HN crowd so anti-AI?
Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use
Show HN: Lathe – Use LLMs to learn a new domain, not skip past it
I design with Claude more than Figma now

changes.raw: Fixed Fable 5 model names with a `[1m]` suffix not being normalized — Fable 5 includes 1M context by default, so the suffix is now stripped automatically
changes.summary: 自动去除Fable 5模型1M后缀
changes.summary_en: Auto-strip Fable 5 1M suffix
changes.why_matters: 避免模型名显示异常，减少因上下文后缀导致的识别和配置错误。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents model name mismatches and avoids configuration errors caused by the context suffix.

changes.raw: Fixed a spurious "sandbox dependencies missing" startup warning on Windows when sandbox was enabled in settings
changes.summary: 修复Windows沙箱依赖误报
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows sandbox dependency warning
changes.why_matters: 消除无意义的启动警告，减少用户对沙箱状态的误判。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes a misleading startup warning and reduces confusion about sandbox status.

signals.title: Anthropic, please ship an official Claude Desktop for Linux
Ask HN: Why is the HN crowd so anti-AI?
Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use
Show HN: Lathe – Use LLMs to learn a new domain, not skip past it
I design with Claude more than Figma now

changes.raw: Sub-agents can now spawn their own sub-agents (up to 5 levels deep)
changes.summary: 子代理可再生成子代理
changes.summary_en: Sub-agents can spawn sub-agents
changes.why_matters: 这让复杂任务可以更深层次地分解和并行执行，提升自动化处理能力。
changes.why_matters_en: This enables deeper task decomposition and parallel execution for more complex workflows.

changes.raw: Amazon Bedrock now reads the AWS region from `~/.aws` config files when `AWS_REGION` isn't set, matching AWS SDK precedence; `/status` shows where the region came from
changes.summary: Bedrock自动读取AWS区域
changes.summary_en: Bedrock reads AWS region from config
changes.why_matters: 这减少了环境变量配置依赖，并让区域解析行为更符合 AWS SDK 习惯。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces environment setup friction and aligns region resolution with AWS SDK precedence.

changes.raw: Added a search bar when browsing a marketplace's plugins in `/plugin`
changes.summary: 插件市场新增搜索栏
changes.summary_en: Added plugin marketplace search bar
changes.why_matters: 这能帮助用户更快找到需要的插件，提升浏览和选择效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users find plugins faster and improves browsing efficiency.

changes.raw: Added `model` attribute to the `claude_code.lines_of_code.count` OTEL metric
changes.summary: OTEL代码指标加模型标签
changes.summary_en: OTEL code metric now includes model
changes.why_matters: 这让监控数据可以按模型维度分析，便于排查和优化使用情况。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes telemetry easier to analyze by model, improving observability and troubleshooting.

changes.raw: Fixed sessions using 1M context without usage credits getting permanently stuck — the session now automatically compacts back under the standard context limit
changes.summary: 1M上下文无额度不再卡死
changes.summary_en: 1M context sessions no longer get stuck
changes.why_matters: 这修复了会话永久卡住的严重问题，避免用户工作流中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes a severe stuck-session issue that could interrupt user workflows indefinitely.

changes.raw: Fixed a repeating "an image in the conversation could not be processed and was removed" error when the conversation contained multiple images
changes.summary: 修复多图消息重复报错
changes.summary_en: Fixed repeated multi-image processing error
changes.why_matters: 这消除了多图片对话中的重复错误提示，提升多模态交互稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes repeated error noise in multi-image conversations and improves multimodal stability.

changes.raw: Fixed the agents view keeping a session under Working with a busy spinner for up to 30 seconds after the worker replied
changes.summary: 代理视图不再长时间转圈
changes.summary_en: Agents view no longer spins after reply
changes.why_matters: 这让代理状态更快恢复正常，减少用户误以为任务未完成的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes agent status update promptly and avoids confusion when work is already done.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents potentially reading another directory's project settings (`.mcp.json` approvals, trust) when dispatched onto a pre-warmed worker
changes.summary: 修复后台代理目录串读
changes.summary_en: Fixed background agents reading wrong settings
changes.why_matters: 这避免了不同项目的信任和审批配置被错误读取，防止权限与隔离问题。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents cross-project trust and approval settings from being misread, reducing isolation and permission risks.

changes.raw: Fixed background-session attach failing with EAUTH for sessions started on an older version after the daemon auto-updated
changes.summary: 后台会话自动更新后可附加
changes.summary_en: Background session attach works after update
changes.why_matters: 这修复了自动升级后无法继续连接旧会话的问题，减少工作中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes attachment failures after daemon auto-updates, reducing workflow disruption.

changes.raw: Fixed a background sub-agent staying stuck as "active" in the agent panel after a nested agent it spawned was stopped
changes.summary: 停止嵌套代理后状态可恢复
changes.summary_en: Nested agent status clears when stopped
changes.why_matters: 这避免代理面板显示错误的活动状态，提升任务可见性和管理准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents stale active states in the agent panel and improves task visibility.

changes.raw: Fixed `/model` suggestions in the `claude agents` dispatch input rendering with a misleading slash prefix and showing models disabled for your org
changes.summary: 模型建议不再误导显示
changes.summary_en: Model suggestions no longer show misleading slash
changes.why_matters: 这改善了输入提示的准确性，减少用户在派发代理时的误解。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves prompt clarity and reduces confusion when dispatching agents.

changes.raw: Fixed `availableModels` restrictions not being applied to subagent model overrides, the agent dispatch model picker, and the advisor model
changes.summary: 模型限制正确应用到子代理
changes.summary_en: Model allowlists now apply to subagents
changes.why_matters: 这确保组织的模型策略在所有相关入口都生效，避免越权使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures org model policies are enforced across all relevant entry points and prevents unauthorized usage.

changes.raw: Fixed `availableModels` allowlists hiding the `/model` picker's Opus and Sonnet 1M rows when entries use version-specific IDs like `claude-opus-4-8`
changes.summary: 版本化模型ID不再隐藏选项
changes.summary_en: Versioned model IDs no longer hide picker rows
changes.why_matters: 这让符合允许列表的模型能正常显示，避免用户误以为模型不可用。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures allowed models remain visible, preventing users from thinking they are unavailable.

changes.raw: Fixed the `/model` picker on Bedrock offering models the provider doesn't serve — selecting one silently switched the session model and lit the selection marker on multiple rows
changes.summary: Bedrock模型选择不再越界
changes.summary_en: Bedrock model picker now shows valid models only
changes.why_matters: 这避免用户选到提供方不支持的模型，减少会话模型混乱和误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents users from selecting unsupported models and avoids session model confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed model IDs getting a doubled 1M-context suffix (e.g. `[1M][1m]`) when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` already includes one
changes.summary: 模型ID不再重复加1M后缀
changes.summary_en: Model IDs no longer get duplicate 1M suffixes
changes.why_matters: 这修复了模型名称显示错误，提升配置可读性和一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes incorrect model naming and improves configuration readability and consistency.

changes.raw: Fixed `opusplan` model setting not shipping with 1M context in plan mode for entitled users; the `opusplan[1m]` workaround now also correctly switches to Opus in plan mode
changes.summary: 修复 Opus 1M 计划模式
changes.summary_en: Fix Opus 1M plan mode shipping
changes.why_matters: 让有权限的用户在计划模式下正确使用 1M 上下文的 Opus 模型，避免能力降级。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures entitled users can use Opus with 1M context in plan mode instead of falling back incorrectly.

changes.raw: Fixed `WebFetch(domain:*.example.com)` wildcard domain rules never matching subdomains in allow, deny, and ask position, and file permission rules with mid-pattern wildcards (e.g. `Read(secrets-*/config.json)`) being rejected at startup
changes.summary: 修复通配权限匹配规则
changes.summary_en: Fix wildcard permission matching
changes.why_matters: 修复域名和文件权限规则的匹配与启动校验，避免权限配置失效或被误拒。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes domain and file permission matching so access rules work as intended and valid configs are not rejected.

changes.raw: Fixed up-arrow prompt history showing the main agent's prompts while a subagent's chat tab is open
changes.summary: 修复子代理历史记录错乱
changes.summary_en: Fix prompt history in subagent tabs
changes.why_matters: 在子代理聊天页查看历史时能看到正确提示词，减少上下文混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows the correct prompt history in subagent tabs, reducing confusion when reviewing context.

changes.raw: Fixed memory recall not finding mounted team memory stores (`CLAUDE_MEMORY_STORES`) in remote sessions
changes.summary: 修复远程会话记忆挂载
changes.summary_en: Fix mounted memory in remote sessions
changes.why_matters: 让远程会话也能找到团队记忆库，保证长期上下文可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows remote sessions to access mounted team memory stores so shared context remains available.

changes.raw: Fixed workflow validation rejecting scripts whose prompt strings or comments merely mention `Date.now()`/`Math.random()`
changes.summary: 放宽脚本验证误报
changes.summary_en: Fix false script validation failures
changes.why_matters: 避免仅因注释或字符串提到危险 API 就误判脚本不合法，减少无谓阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents scripts from being rejected just because comments or prompt strings mention risky APIs.

changes.raw: Disable mouse tracking on Windows consoles that don't fully support it
changes.summary: 关闭不兼容终端鼠标跟踪
changes.summary_en: Disable mouse tracking on unsupported Windows consoles
changes.why_matters: 减少在不支持鼠标跟踪的 Windows 终端上的异常和交互问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids glitches on Windows consoles that do not fully support mouse tracking.

changes.raw: Fixed the `/plugin` marketplace list losing its cursor after backing out of a long plugin list, and Esc from the plugin browser returning to the wrong tab
changes.summary: 修复插件市场返回定位
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin browser cursor and tab return
changes.why_matters: 让长插件列表浏览和返回操作保持正确位置，提升插件发现体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the cursor and tab state correct when browsing long plugin lists, improving marketplace navigation.

changes.raw: Improved performance in long conversations by removing redundant message normalization and avoiding full message-history transforms when streaming tool-use state is unchanged
changes.summary: 提升长对话流式性能
changes.summary_en: Improve long-conversation streaming performance
changes.why_matters: 减少长对话中的重复处理，降低延迟并提升响应流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Cuts redundant processing in long conversations to reduce latency and improve responsiveness.

changes.raw: Reduced idle CPU usage: `/goal` status chip no longer re-renders the terminal at 5 Hz while idle, and fewer UI re-renders while subagents run in parallel
changes.summary: 降低空闲 CPU 占用
changes.summary_en: Reduce idle CPU usage
changes.why_matters: 在空闲和并行子代理运行时减少终端重绘，节省资源并延长电池续航。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces terminal redraws while idle or running parallel subagents, saving resources and battery.

changes.raw: Improved Claude in Chrome tool loading: browser tools now load in a single batched call instead of one per tool
changes.summary: 加速 Chrome 工具加载
changes.summary_en: Batch Chrome tool loading
changes.why_matters: 浏览器工具一次批量加载，减少初始化开销并更快可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Loads browser tools in one batch to reduce startup overhead and make them available sooner.

changes.raw: Improved the non-interactive Usage Policy refusal message to suggest starting a new session or changing your model
changes.summary: 优化拒绝提示文案
changes.summary_en: Improve refusal guidance text
changes.why_matters: 在被拒绝时给出更清晰的下一步建议，帮助用户更快恢复工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Provides clearer next-step guidance when a request is refused, helping users recover faster.

changes.raw: `/code-review` now keeps the `ultra` option visible when you're not signed in to claude.ai, with an explanation that the cloud review requires a claude.ai account
changes.summary: 未登录也显示 ultra 选项
changes.summary_en: Show ultra option when signed out
changes.why_matters: 让用户清楚看到云端代码审查能力及其账号要求，减少功能发现障碍。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes the cloud review option visible with its account requirement, improving feature discoverability.

changes.raw: Shortened the Remote Control footer indicator to "/rc active" and hid it on narrow terminals
changes.summary: 精简远控状态提示
changes.summary_en: Shorten remote control status indicator
changes.why_matters: 节省状态栏空间，在窄终端上更易读。
changes.why_matters_en: Saves status-bar space and improves readability on narrow terminals.

changes.raw: Stopped promoting `/loop` in remote sessions, where pending loops don't keep the container alive
changes.summary: 远程会话不再推广 loop
changes.summary_en: Stop promoting /loop in remote sessions
changes.why_matters: 避免在远程环境中引导用户使用无效流程，减少误导。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids suggesting a workflow that does not keep remote containers alive, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed PowerShell tool calls rendering as raw JSON instead of a proper command display and permission dialog, and stripped ANSI escape codes from displayed shell output
changes.summary: 修复 VSCode PowerShell 显示
changes.summary_en: Fix VSCode PowerShell command display
changes.why_matters: 让 PowerShell 工具调用和输出在 VSCode 中正确显示，提升可读性与授权体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Renders PowerShell tool calls and shell output correctly in VSCode, improving readability and permission prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed sessions not saving transcripts (and not appearing in --resume) when launched from the VS Code integrated terminal or any shell that inherited Claude Code environment variables.
changes.summary: 修复会话转录丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix missing session transcripts
changes.why_matters: 现在在 VS Code 终端或继承环境变量的 shell 中启动时，会话能正常保存并支持 --resume。
changes.why_matters_en: Sessions now save correctly and can be resumed when launched from VS Code terminal or inherited shells.
