changes.raw: Self-hosted runner: added a `post-session` lifecycle hook that runs after the session ends and before the workspace is deleted, so you can snapshot uncommitted work or export logs; also made the child-process SIGTERM→SIGKILL window configurable (default unchanged at 5s)
changes.summary: 会话结束后可执行清理钩子
changes.summary_en: Add post-session hook before workspace deletion
changes.why_matters: 可在工作区删除前导出日志或快照未提交修改，降低会话结束后的数据丢失风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets users snapshot uncommitted work or export logs before the workspace is deleted, reducing post-session data loss risk.

changes.raw: Added `--safe-mode` flag (and `CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE`) to start Claude Code with all customizations (CLAUDE.md, plugins, skills, hooks, MCP servers) disabled for troubleshooting
changes.summary: 安全模式禁用所有自定义项
changes.summary_en: Safe mode disables all customizations
changes.why_matters: 排障时可排除配置、插件和钩子的干扰，更快定位问题根因。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps isolate issues by disabling configs, plugins, hooks, and servers during troubleshooting.

changes.raw: Added `/cd` command to move a session to a new working directory without breaking the prompt cache mid-session
changes.summary: 支持会话中切换工作目录
changes.summary_en: Move a session to a new working directory
changes.why_matters: 用户可在不中断上下文的情况下切换目录，提升长会话中的操作灵活性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can switch directories without breaking session context, improving flexibility in long-running sessions.

changes.raw: Added a `disableBundledSkills` setting and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS` environment variable to hide bundled skills, workflows, and built-in slash commands from the model
changes.summary: 可隐藏内置技能与命令
changes.summary_en: Hide bundled skills and built-in commands
changes.why_matters: 减少模型可见的内置能力，便于控制行为边界并避免误用。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces the model's visible built-in surface, helping control behavior and avoid misuse.

changes.raw: Fixed Up/Down arrows jumping to command history past the wrapped rows of a long input line — they now move through each visual row first, and history recall enters at the near edge
changes.summary: 修复长输入上下键导航
changes.summary_en: Fix up/down navigation in wrapped input
changes.why_matters: 长命令输入时历史导航更符合视觉行预期，减少误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: History navigation now matches wrapped visual rows, reducing mistakes when editing long commands.

changes.raw: Fixed enterprise managed MCP policies (`allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers`) not being enforced on reconnect, IDE-typed configs, `--mcp-config` servers during the first session after install, or before remote settings loaded; also fixed slow cold starts for orgs without remote settings
changes.summary: 修复企业 MCP 策略生效问题
changes.summary_en: Fix enterprise MCP policy enforcement
changes.why_matters: 确保受管 MCP 服务器策略在重连、首次安装和远程设置未加载时也能正确执行。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures managed MCP server policies are enforced on reconnect, first install, and before remote settings load.

changes.raw: Fixed a ~30-50ms UI stall at the start of each turn for macOS users logged in with claude.ai credentials
changes.summary: 修复 macOS 每轮开头卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS turn-start UI stall
changes.why_matters: 降低每轮开始时的界面停顿，让交互更流畅。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes a small stall at the start of each turn, making the UI feel smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude -p` being slow or appearing to hang on Windows while waiting for the slash-command/skill scan (regression in 2.1.161)
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 版 p 命令卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix slow claude -p on Windows
changes.why_matters: 避免等待扫描时看似挂起，提升 Windows 上的非交互执行可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents apparent hangs during scan time, improving reliability for non-interactive runs on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control getting stuck on "reconnecting" after resuming a session when an OAuth token refresh happened at the same time
changes.summary: 修复远控恢复后重连卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix Remote Control reconnect hang
changes.why_matters: 会话恢复时不再因令牌刷新而卡在重连状态，提升远程接入稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Session resume no longer gets stuck reconnecting during token refresh, improving remote access stability.

changes.raw: Fixed Git Credential Manager's "Connect to GitHub" popup appearing on Windows at startup when background git commands ran without cached credentials
changes.summary: 修复启动时 Git 弹窗误触发
changes.summary_en: Fix Git Credential Manager popup on startup
changes.why_matters: 减少后台 Git 命令引发的无关弹窗，避免打断工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: It avoids unnecessary popups from background Git commands, preventing workflow interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed footer hints (e.g. "esc to interrupt") not showing for users with a custom statusline
changes.summary: 自定义状态栏下显示提示
changes.summary_en: Show footer hints with custom statusline
changes.why_matters: 让快捷提示在自定义状态栏场景下仍可见，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Footer hints remain visible with custom statuslines, improving usability.

changes.raw: Fixed stale permission and dialog prompts reappearing every time you reattached to a remote session whose worker had died while waiting on them
changes.summary: 修复远程会话重复提示
changes.summary_en: Fix stale prompts on remote reattach
changes.why_matters: 重新连接远程会话时不再反复出现过期权限或对话框，减少干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Reattaching to a remote session no longer re-shows stale permission or dialog prompts, reducing interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents --json` omitting blocked and just-dispatched background sessions; added `--all` to include completed sessions, plus new `id` and `state` fields
changes.summary: agents JSON 增加完整状态
changes.summary_en: Improve agents JSON with all sessions
changes.why_matters: 更完整的状态字段和会话列表便于脚本化监控与自动化集成。
changes.why_matters_en: Richer state fields and fuller session listings make scripting, monitoring, and automation easier.

changes.raw: Fixed agents view leaving a stale/garbled frame after navigating back from an agent on WSL in Windows Terminal
changes.summary: 修复 WSL agents 视图残影
changes.summary_en: Fix stale agents view on WSL
changes.why_matters: 返回列表页时界面不再残留乱码或旧帧，提升视觉稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: The agents view no longer leaves stale or garbled frames when navigating back, improving visual stability.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents ignoring project-level settings `env` values (e.g. `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`) when dispatched onto a pre-warmed worker
changes.summary: 背景代理继承项目环境变量
changes.summary_en: Background agents now inherit project env
changes.why_matters: 预热 worker 上运行的后台代理也能正确使用项目配置，避免模型或环境不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Background agents on pre-warmed workers now respect project env settings, avoiding model or environment mismatches.

changes.raw: Fixed MCPB plugin cache being spuriously invalidated on Windows, causing unnecessary re-extraction
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 插件缓存误失效
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows plugin cache invalidation
changes.why_matters: 避免在 Windows 上重复解压插件，减少启动和运行时开销。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unnecessary plugin re-extraction on Windows, reducing startup and runtime overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin `.in_use` PID lock files accumulating without bound; stale markers from crashed sessions are now swept once per day
changes.summary: 清理失效插件锁文件
changes.summary_en: Sweep stale plugin lock files
changes.why_matters: 防止崩溃后残留锁文件无限增长，减少磁盘污染和状态混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stale lock files from accumulating after crashes, reducing disk clutter and state confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed untrusted project settings being able to set OTEL client-certificate paths without trust confirmation
changes.summary: 限制未信任设置改证书路径
changes.summary_en: Block cert paths from untrusted settings
changes.why_matters: 阻止未受信任的项目配置绕过确认修改 OTEL 客户端证书路径，降低安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents untrusted project settings from changing OTEL client certificate paths without confirmation, reducing security risk.

changes.raw: `/workflows` now opens immediately even while a turn is in progress
changes.summary: /workflows 可立即打开
changes.summary_en: /workflows opens immediately
changes.why_matters: 即使当前轮次未结束，也能更快查看工作流，提升交互流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users open workflows immediately even mid-turn, improving interaction responsiveness.

changes.raw: Improved `TaskCreate` reliability: malformed inputs are repaired automatically and validation errors for unloaded tools include the schema
changes.summary: 增强 TaskCreate 输入修复
changes.summary_en: Improve TaskCreate input repair
changes.why_matters: 自动修复格式错误并返回完整 schema，能减少任务创建失败并帮助排查工具问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Auto-repairing malformed inputs and including schema in errors reduces task creation failures and aids debugging.

changes.raw: Improved the error message shown when your organization has disabled API key authentication, with guidance based on where the active API key comes from
changes.summary: 优化禁用 API Key 的提示
changes.summary_en: Better message for disabled API keys
changes.why_matters: 让用户更快知道该从哪里处理认证问题，减少登录和配置困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users quickly understand where to fix authentication issues, reducing login and configuration confusion.

changes.raw: Reduced CPU usage while responses stream and during spinner animations
changes.summary: 降低流式输出 CPU 占用
changes.summary_en: Reduce CPU during streaming
changes.why_matters: 在响应流和动画期间减少 CPU 消耗，可提升续航并降低系统负载。
changes.why_matters_en: Lower CPU usage during streaming and animations improves battery life and reduces system load.

changes.raw: Restored a default 5-minute idle timeout on Vertex/Foundry so a stalled stream aborts instead of hanging indefinitely; set `API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT=0` to opt out
changes.summary: 恢复 Vertex/Foundry 空闲超时
changes.summary_en: Restore Vertex/Foundry idle timeout
changes.why_matters: 避免卡住的流式请求无限挂起，提升稳定性并减少人工干预。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stalled streams from hanging indefinitely, improving reliability and reducing manual intervention.

changes.raw: Remote-managed settings with an invalid entry now apply their remaining valid policies and surface the validation error, instead of silently dropping the whole payload
changes.summary: 保留远程设置有效策略
changes.summary_en: Keep valid remote policies
changes.why_matters: 无效项不再拖垮整包配置，能让可用策略继续生效并暴露错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Invalid entries no longer discard the whole payload, so valid policies still apply and errors are surfaced.

changes.raw: Background sessions now preserve `--ide`, `--chrome`, `--bare`, `--remote-control`, and other flags across retire→wake, and respawn state validation was hardened
changes.summary: 后台会话保留启动参数
changes.summary_en: Preserve flags across background wake
changes.why_matters: 后台会话唤醒后仍保持原有运行参数，减少状态丢失和异常重启。
changes.why_matters_en: Background sessions retain their launch flags after wake, reducing state loss and bad respawns.

changes.raw: Background sessions are now told that shared-checkout edits are blocked until they enter a worktree, avoiding a wasted rejected edit before `EnterWorktree`
changes.summary: 避免共享工作区无效编辑
changes.summary_en: Avoid rejected edits before worktree
changes.why_matters: 提前告知共享检出限制，减少一次注定失败的编辑尝试。
changes.why_matters_en: Warns about shared-checkout limits earlier, avoiding a wasted rejected edit attempt.

changes.raw: The "CLAUDE.md is too long" warning threshold now scales with the model's context window
changes.summary: 长 CLAUDE.md 阈值随模型调整
changes.summary_en: Scale CLAUDE.md warning with context
changes.why_matters: 更贴合模型上下文大小，减少不必要的长度警告。
changes.why_matters_en: Aligns the warning threshold with model context size, reducing unnecessary length warnings.

changes.raw: Auto-updater on Windows now stops retrying within a session once `claude.exe` is held by another process
changes.summary: Windows 自动更新减少重试
changes.summary_en: Stop Windows updater retry loops
changes.why_matters: 当文件被占用时及时停止重试，避免无意义等待和资源浪费。
changes.why_matters_en: Stops retrying when the executable is locked, avoiding pointless waiting and wasted resources.

changes.raw: Improved color contrast for skill tags in the slash-command menu
changes.summary: 提升技能标签对比度
changes.summary_en: Improve skill tag contrast
changes.why_matters: 让菜单中的标签更易读，改善可访问性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes slash-command menu tags easier to read and improves accessibility.

changes.raw: Promo credit claims for Apple/Google-billed subscribers without a payment method now explain where to add one
changes.summary: 提示如何添加付款方式
changes.summary_en: Explain where to add payment method
changes.why_matters: 让订阅用户更容易完成促销积分领取所需的支付设置。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps subscribed users complete the payment setup needed to claim promo credits.

changes.raw: Added a tip suggesting `claude agents` when running multiple concurrent sessions
changes.summary: 多会话时提示使用 agents
changes.summary_en: Suggest claude agents for concurrent sessions
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户在同时运行多个会话时采用更合适的协作方式，减少混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users choose a better workflow when running multiple sessions at once, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Added `fallbackModel` setting to configure up to three fallback models tried in order when the primary model is overloaded or unavailable; `--fallback-model` now also applies to interactive sessions
changes.summary: 支持主模型故障自动切换
changes.summary_en: Add configurable fallback models
changes.why_matters: 主模型不可用时可自动切换到备用模型，减少中断并提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: It keeps sessions running when the primary model is overloaded or unavailable.

changes.raw: Added glob pattern support in deny rule tool-name position (`"*"` denies all tools); allow rules reject non-MCP globs, and unknown tool names in deny rules warn at startup
changes.summary: 拒绝规则支持通配模式
changes.summary_en: Support glob patterns in deny rules
changes.why_matters: 可以更灵活地批量限制工具使用，同时减少配置维护成本。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes tool access policies more flexible and easier to manage.

changes.raw: Hardened cross-session messaging: messages relayed via `SendMessage` from other Claude sessions no longer carry user authority — receivers refuse relayed permission requests, and auto mode blocks them
changes.summary: 跨会话消息去除用户权限
changes.summary_en: Strip user authority from relayed messages
changes.why_matters: 防止其他会话借用用户权限发起请求，降低越权和误授权风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents other sessions from abusing user authority and reduces privilege-escalation risk.

changes.raw: `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0`, `--thinking disabled`, and the per-model thinking toggle now disable thinking on models that think by default via the Claude API (3P providers unchanged)
changes.summary: 可关闭默认思考模式
changes.summary_en: Disable default thinking on supported models
changes.why_matters: 用户可以真正关闭思考流程，减少不必要的延迟和 token 消耗。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now truly disable thinking, reducing latency and token usage.

changes.raw: Claude Code now retries a turn once on the fallback model when the API rejects an unexpected non-retryable error; auth, rate-limit, request-size, and transport errors still surface immediately
changes.summary: 异常时自动切备用模型重试
changes.summary_en: Retry unexpected API errors on fallback model
changes.why_matters: 遇到非致命异常时可自动恢复，提升任务完成率和稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves task completion by recovering from unexpected API failures automatically.

changes.raw: `claude update` now announces the target version before downloading instead of going silent
changes.summary: 更新前提示目标版本
changes.summary_en: Announce target version before update
changes.why_matters: 让用户在下载前知道将升级到哪个版本，提升可预期性。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes updates more transparent by showing the target version before download.

changes.raw: `claude agents`: typing a URL into the list now filters to the session whose first prompt contained it
changes.summary: 按 URL 过滤 agents 会话
changes.summary_en: Filter agent sessions by URL
changes.why_matters: 输入 URL 就能更快定位相关会话，提升多会话管理效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users quickly find the relevant session in a crowded list.

changes.raw: Fixed a recurring "image could not be processed" error and extra token usage when an unprocessable image was sent in a session
changes.summary: 修复图片处理失败误报
changes.summary_en: Fix unprocessable image errors
changes.why_matters: 避免图片无法处理时反复报错并浪费额外 token。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents recurring errors and unnecessary token usage on bad images.

changes.raw: Fixed remote sessions becoming permanently stuck when a brief backend disruption occurred during worker registration at startup
changes.summary: 修复远程会话启动卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix remote sessions stuck at startup
changes.why_matters: 短暂后端故障后会话不再永久卡住，提升启动可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents remote sessions from getting permanently stuck after brief backend issues.

changes.raw: Fixed flickering in JetBrains IDE terminals (IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, etc.) on 2026.1+ by enabling synchronized output
changes.summary: JetBrains 终端闪烁已修复
changes.summary_en: Fix JetBrains terminal flicker
changes.why_matters: 在新版 JetBrains IDE 里终端显示更稳定，减少视觉干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes terminals in JetBrains IDEs visually stable and less distracting.

changes.raw: Fixed Shift+non-ASCII characters (e.g. Shift+ä → Ä) being dropped in terminals using the Kitty keyboard protocol (WezTerm, Ghostty, kitty)
changes.summary: 修复 Kitty 协议按键丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix dropped Shift+non-ASCII keys
changes.why_matters: 在支持 Kitty 协议的终端里，非 ASCII 大写输入更可靠。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes Shift-modified non-ASCII input reliable in Kitty-protocol terminals.

changes.raw: Fixed PowerShell command validation occasionally hanging far past its time budget on Windows when a killed process's children held its output pipes
changes.summary: 修复 PowerShell 校验卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix PowerShell validation hangs
changes.why_matters: 避免 Windows 上命令校验因子进程占管道而超时卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents command validation from hanging on Windows when child processes hold pipes open.

changes.raw: Fixed orphaned `claude --bg-pty-host` processes spinning at 100% CPU after the daemon dies while connected on macOS
changes.summary: 修复守护进程退出后高 CPU
changes.summary_en: Fix bg-pty-host CPU spin after daemon exit
changes.why_matters: 减少后台孤儿进程空转占用 CPU，提升系统资源利用率。
changes.why_matters_en: It stops orphaned background processes from burning CPU after daemon failure.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode requiring `/login` to clear a stale auth check after toggling `/voice`
changes.summary: 修复语音模式登录状态异常
changes.summary_en: Fix stale auth check in voice mode
changes.why_matters: 切换语音模式后不再需要额外登录，减少认证困扰。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes the need to re-login after toggling voice mode.

changes.raw: Fixed managed settings with an invalid entry silently disabling enforcement of their remaining valid policies
changes.summary: 无效策略不再拖垮整组配置
changes.summary_en: Keep valid managed policies enforced
changes.why_matters: 单条配置错误不会导致其他有效管控失效，提升安全策略可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: One bad entry no longer disables the rest of the managed policy set.

changes.raw: Fixed managed-settings `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` predicates not matching when they use `${VAR}` references
changes.summary: 修复MCP变量匹配
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP var-based policy matching
changes.why_matters: 管理设置中的允许/拒绝规则现在能正确匹配变量引用，避免MCP服务器被误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Managed allow/deny rules now match variable references correctly, preventing MCP servers from being misclassified.

changes.raw: Fixed background agent sessions that entered a git worktree crash-looping with "No conversation found" when reopened from `claude agents`
changes.summary: 修复工作树会话崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree session crash loop
changes.why_matters: 重新打开后台代理会话时不再因找不到对话而反复崩溃，保证任务可继续恢复。
changes.why_matters_en: Reopening background agent sessions no longer crash-loops on missing conversations, so work can be resumed reliably.

changes.raw: Fixed duplicated thinking text in the Ctrl+O transcript view while streaming
changes.summary: 修复思考文本重复显示
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicated thinking text
changes.why_matters: 流式输出时的转录视图更干净，减少重复内容带来的阅读干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: The transcript view stays cleaner during streaming, reducing distraction from duplicated content.

changes.raw: Fixed `/doctor` showing a contradictory failed "Not inside a remote session" check when run inside a remote session
changes.summary: 修复远程会话检测冲突
changes.summary_en: Fix remote session check conflict
changes.why_matters: 诊断命令不再给出自相矛盾的结果，提升排障可信度。
changes.why_matters_en: The diagnostic command no longer reports contradictory results, improving troubleshooting trust.

changes.raw: Fixed the cursor sticking at the end of the first line when typing a multiline prompt in the `claude agents` dispatch and reply inputs
changes.summary: 修复多行输入光标卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix multiline input cursor sticking
changes.why_matters: 在 `claude agents` 的派发和回复输入中，多行提示可正常编辑，输入体验更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Multiline prompts in `claude agents` dispatch and reply inputs can now be edited normally, making input smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed blank lines appearing between background agent rows in the task list on terminals without Unicode support
changes.summary: 修复无Unicode终端空行
changes.summary_en: Fix blank rows on non-Unicode terminals
changes.why_matters: 在不支持 Unicode 的终端里，任务列表显示更紧凑，不会出现多余空行。
changes.why_matters_en: Task lists render more compactly on terminals without Unicode support, avoiding extra blank lines.

changes.raw: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
changes.summary: 修复错误并提升稳定性
changes.summary_en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
changes.why_matters: 减少使用过程中的故障和异常，让工具更稳定可用。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces failures and unexpected behavior, making the tool more stable and usable.

signals.title: Please don't spam people looking for employment. It's just cruel
Anthropic, please ship an official Claude Desktop for Linux
Ask HN: Why is the HN crowd so anti-AI?
Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use
Show HN: Lathe – Use LLMs to learn a new domain, not skip past it

changes.raw: Added `requiredMinimumVersion` and `requiredMaximumVersion` managed settings — Claude Code refuses to start if its version is outside the allowed range and directs the user to an approved version
changes.summary: 强制版本范围启动限制
changes.summary_en: Enforce allowed version range at startup
changes.why_matters: 可确保 Claude Code 只在批准版本上运行，降低不兼容或未审核版本带来的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures Claude Code only runs on approved versions, reducing risk from incompatible or unreviewed releases.

changes.raw: Added `/plugin list` command to list installed plugins, with `--enabled`/`--disabled` filters
changes.summary: 新增插件列表命令
changes.summary_en: Add plugin list command
changes.why_matters: 用户可以快速查看已安装插件及启用状态，便于管理扩展生态。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly inspect installed plugins and their enabled state, making extension management easier.

changes.raw: Added a "c to copy" shortcut to `/btw` that copies the raw markdown answer to the clipboard, preserving formatting when pasted elsewhere
changes.summary: 复制原始 Markdown 回复
changes.summary_en: Copy raw Markdown response
changes.why_matters: 复制时保留 Markdown 格式，方便将回答直接粘贴到支持格式的工具中。
changes.why_matters_en: Copying preserves Markdown formatting, making it easier to paste responses into tools that support rich text.

changes.raw: Hooks: Stop and SubagentStop hooks can now return `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` to give Claude feedback and keep the turn going without being labeled a hook error
changes.summary: Hook 可回传上下文继续执行
changes.summary_en: Hooks can return extra context
changes.why_matters: Hook 可以提供额外反馈而不被视为错误，从而让对话流程更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Hooks can provide extra feedback without being treated as errors, keeping the conversation flow smooth.

changes.raw: Skills: added `\$` escape syntax to include a literal `$` before a digit in command bodies
changes.summary: 技能命令支持字面量美元符
changes.summary_en: Support literal $ escape in skills
changes.why_matters: 避免技能命令体中 `$` 被误解析，提升脚本编写可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents `$` from being misparsed in skill command bodies, improving script reliability.

changes.raw: stdio MCP servers now receive the same `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` as hooks/Bash on `--resume`
changes.summary: 恢复会话 ID 传给 MCP
changes.summary_en: Pass session ID to stdio MCP on resume
changes.why_matters: 让 MCP 服务器在恢复会话时保持与 hooks/Bash 一致的会话标识，便于关联上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps stdio MCP servers aligned with hooks/Bash session identity on resume, improving context correlation.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude -p` hanging forever after its final result when a backgrounded command never exits — background shells are now stopped ~5s after the result once stdin closes
changes.summary: 避免 -p 结果后无限挂起
changes.summary_en: Fix -p hanging after final result
changes.why_matters: 防止后台命令不退出时导致命令行卡死，提升自动化执行的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents the CLI from hanging when background commands never exit, improving automation reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude -p` failing with "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY required" on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry when `CI=true` and no Anthropic API key is set
changes.summary: 修复 CI 下 API 密钥报错
changes.summary_en: Fix API key error on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry
changes.why_matters: 在非 Anthropic 后端和 CI 环境中避免误报缺少密钥，减少部署阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids false missing-key errors in CI and non-Anthropic backends, reducing deployment blockers.

changes.raw: Fixed bash commands failing under bazel and EDR-protected Go workflows: `$TMPDIR` was overridden to `/tmp/claude-{uid}` for all commands instead of only sandboxed ones (regression in 2.1.154)
changes.summary: 修复 Bazel/EDR 下 Bash 失败
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash failures under Bazel/EDR
changes.why_matters: 纠正临时目录处理，恢复在受限企业环境和 Bazel 工作流中的命令执行。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes temp-dir handling so commands work again in restricted enterprise environments and Bazel workflows.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash commands failing on Windows with "EEXIST: file already exists" on the session-env directory when it has the read-only attribute or is inside OneDrive
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 会话目录报错
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows session-env directory error
changes.why_matters: 解决只读属性或 OneDrive 场景下的目录创建失败，提升 Windows 可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This resolves directory creation failures on read-only or OneDrive paths, improving Windows reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed org-managed permission rules not applying for the entire session when the managed settings fetch completed during startup on a fresh config directory
changes.summary: 组织权限规则全程生效
changes.summary_en: Apply org permission rules for whole session
changes.why_matters: 确保受管权限在启动期间也能正确应用，避免会话中出现权限绕过窗口。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures managed permissions apply even during startup, avoiding a window where rules could be bypassed.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions in `claude agents` losing their running background tasks when reattached after a Claude Code update
changes.summary: 更新后保留后台会话任务
changes.summary_en: Keep background tasks after update
changes.why_matters: 重新附加会话时不会丢失正在运行的后台任务，减少中断和重复工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Background tasks are preserved when reattaching after an update, reducing interruptions and rework.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal misalignment and a multi-second hang when exiting the agent view by pressing Esc
changes.summary: 退出 Agent 视图更流畅
changes.summary_en: Smoother exit from agent view
changes.why_matters: 修复退出时的错位和卡顿，改善交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes misalignment and lag on exit, improving the interactive experience.

changes.raw: Fixed clicking Stop on a background-task chip in the desktop app not clearing the chip when the underlying process was already gone
changes.summary: 停止后台任务后清除芯片
changes.summary_en: Clear stopped background-task chip
changes.why_matters: 避免界面残留过期状态，让用户更清楚任务是否已结束。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents stale UI state, making it clearer whether a task has actually ended.

changes.raw: Fixed keyboard input becoming permanently unresponsive after a paste operation whose end marker is dropped by the terminal
changes.summary: 修复粘贴后键盘失灵
changes.summary_en: Fix keyboard freeze after paste
changes.why_matters: 避免终端在异常粘贴场景下失去输入能力，防止工作流中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents the terminal from losing input after malformed paste events, avoiding workflow interruption.

changes.raw: Fixed hook `if: "Bash(...)"` conditions firing on every Bash command containing `$()` or `$VAR`; the pattern now matches against commands inside subshells and backticks too
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 条件误触发
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash hook condition matching
changes.why_matters: 避免钩子在不该触发的命令上误执行，减少自动化规则的误报和干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents hooks from firing on the wrong commands, reducing false positives and workflow disruption.

changes.raw: Fixed deny rules on home-directory paths (e.g. `Read(~/Desktop/**)`) not blocking Bash commands that reference the path via `$HOME`
changes.summary: 修复 HOME 路径拒绝规则
changes.summary_en: Fix deny rules for $HOME paths
changes.why_matters: 确保安全拒绝规则能真正拦住通过环境变量绕过的路径访问。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures deny rules actually block path access even when referenced through environment variables.

changes.raw: Fixed a stray "(no content)" line left in the transcript after closing panel dialogs like /mcp and /plugins
changes.summary: 清理面板关闭残留文本
changes.summary_en: Remove stray transcript placeholder
changes.why_matters: 让转录内容更干净，避免界面中出现无意义的残留行。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps transcripts clean and avoids confusing leftover lines in the UI.

changes.raw: Background agent sessions now update to a new Claude Code version in the background, so opening a session after an update no longer waits on a cold restart
changes.summary: 后台会话自动更新版本
changes.summary_en: Background sessions auto-update
changes.why_matters: 减少更新后重新进入会话的等待时间，让后台代理更连续可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces wait time after updates so background agent sessions stay available without a cold restart.

changes.raw: Clearer descriptions for built-in commands and skills in the / menu
changes.summary: 菜单命令与技能说明更清晰
changes.summary_en: Clearer / menu command and skill descriptions
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户更快理解可用功能，降低发现和使用成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users understand available features faster and lowers discovery friction.

changes.raw: The subscription-switch suggestion now shows in the startup announcement slot instead of a toast
changes.summary: 订阅切换提示改为启动公告
changes.summary_en: Show subscription switch in startup notice
changes.why_matters: 把重要提示放到更显眼的位置，提升用户及时看到的概率。
changes.why_matters_en: Moves an important prompt to a more visible place so users are more likely to notice it.

changes.raw: `claude agents` dispatching from the state-grouped view now starts the session in the directory the agent view was opened from
changes.summary: agents 从原目录启动会话
changes.summary_en: Start agents in the opened directory
changes.why_matters: 确保从分组视图派发代理时上下文目录正确，减少路径相关错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures agents launched from the grouped view use the correct working directory and avoid path-related mistakes.

signals.title: Please don't spam people looking for employment. It's just cruel
Anthropic, please ship an official Claude Desktop for Linux
Ask HN: Why is the HN crowd so anti-AI?
Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use
Show HN: Lathe – Use LLMs to learn a new domain, not skip past it

changes.raw: `claude agents --json` now includes `waitingFor` showing what a waiting session is blocked on (e.g. permission prompt)
changes.summary: 显示等待原因
changes.summary_en: Show what a session is waiting on
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更快判断代理会话卡在什么地方，便于及时处理权限或交互阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly see what is blocking a session, making it easier to resolve permission or interaction waits.

changes.raw: `--tools`: explicitly listing Grep/Glob now provides the dedicated search tools on native builds with embedded search (previously these names were silently ignored)
changes.summary: 显式启用搜索工具
changes.summary_en: Explicit Grep/Glob now enables search tools
changes.why_matters: 在原生构建中显式指定 Grep/Glob 现在会真正生效，避免工具配置被静默忽略。
changes.why_matters_en: Explicitly listing Grep/Glob now works on native builds, preventing tool configuration from being silently ignored.

changes.raw: `/effort` now confirms when your chosen level will persist as the default for new sessions
changes.summary: 确认努力级别会持久化
changes.summary_en: Confirm effort level persists as default
changes.why_matters: 用户能明确知道当前选择会成为新会话默认值，减少重复设置。
changes.why_matters_en: Users now know their chosen effort level will persist for new sessions, reducing repeated setup.

changes.raw: Clicking a slash command in the autocomplete menu now fills it into your prompt instead of running it immediately; press Enter to run
changes.summary: 补全命令而非直接执行
changes.summary_en: Autocomplete fills slash commands before run
changes.why_matters: 误触自动补全时不会立刻执行命令，降低意外操作风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Autocomplete no longer runs slash commands immediately, reducing the risk of accidental execution.

changes.raw: Remote Control now shows as a persistent footer pill (with a link to the session) instead of a startup message
changes.summary: 远程控制常驻显示
changes.summary_en: Remote Control now stays visible in footer
changes.why_matters: 远程控制状态更稳定可见，用户可随时进入对应会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Remote Control is now persistently visible, making it easier to access the linked session.

changes.raw: Renamed Windsurf to Devin Desktop in the `/ide` menu, `/terminal-setup`, and `/scroll-speed`, following the editor's rebrand
changes.summary: 编辑器重命名同步更新
changes.summary_en: Update editor name to Devin Desktop
changes.why_matters: 界面文案与编辑器新品牌保持一致，减少混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: UI labels now match the editor's new brand, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed a silent startup hang when the config directory is read-only or unwritable — Claude Code now starts with in-memory config and surfaces startup errors instead of showing a blank screen
changes.summary: 只读配置也能启动
changes.summary_en: Start even when config dir is read-only
changes.why_matters: 即使配置目录不可写，Claude Code 也能正常启动并显示错误，而不是卡在空白界面。
changes.why_matters_en: Claude Code now starts with in-memory config and shows startup errors instead of hanging on a blank screen.

changes.raw: Fixed WebFetch permission rules not being applied to built-in preapproved domains; explicit `WebFetch(domain:...)` deny/ask/allow rules now take precedence over the preapproved-host auto-allow
changes.summary: WebFetch规则优先生效
changes.summary_en: WebFetch domain rules now take precedence
changes.why_matters: 显式的 WebFetch 域名规则现在会覆盖预批准域名的自动放行，避免越权访问。
changes.why_matters_en: Explicit WebFetch domain rules now override auto-allow behavior for preapproved domains, preventing unintended access.

changes.raw: Fixed Windows permission rules never matching when spelled with backslashes (`~\`, `\\server\share`) or case-variant paths, and Read deny rules not hiding files from Glob/Grep results
changes.summary: Windows权限匹配修复
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows permission path matching
changes.why_matters: Windows 下的权限规则现在能正确匹配反斜杠和大小写路径，且读取拒绝会从搜索结果中隐藏文件。
changes.why_matters_en: Windows permission rules now match backslash and case-variant paths correctly, and read-deny rules hide files from search results.

changes.raw: Fixed an interrupt (Esc) sent at the very start of a turn being silently dropped in stream-json/SDK sessions, leaving the turn running with no "Interrupted" feedback
changes.summary: 开局中断不再丢失
changes.summary_en: Esc interrupts now work at turn start
changes.why_matters: 在 SDK/stream-json 会话中，开局按 Esc 现在能真正中断当前轮次并给出反馈。
changes.why_matters_en: In SDK/stream-json sessions, pressing Esc at the start of a turn now properly interrupts it and shows feedback.

changes.raw: Fixed API 400 `no low surrogate in string` errors for classifier side-queries and MCP server descriptions containing emoji near a truncation boundary
changes.summary: 修复表情导致的400错误
changes.summary_en: Fix 400 errors from emoji truncation
changes.why_matters: 包含 emoji 的分类器查询和 MCP 描述不再因截断边界问题而报错。
changes.why_matters_en: Classifier side-queries and MCP descriptions with emoji no longer fail with truncation-related 400 errors.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP per-server `timeout` config values below 1000 ms being floored to a 1-second watchdog that aborted every tool call; sub-1000 ms values are now ignored (falling back to `MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT` or default), and `claude mcp get` annotates them accordingly
changes.summary: MCP超时配置修正
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP timeout values below 1s
changes.why_matters: 小于 1 秒的 MCP 超时不再错误触发看门狗，工具调用更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Sub-1000 ms MCP timeouts no longer incorrectly trigger the watchdog, making tool calls more reliable.

changes.raw: Fixed the LSP tool's `workspaceSymbol` operation returning no results; it now accepts a `query` parameter and passes it to the language server
changes.summary: LSP工作区符号可用
changes.summary_en: workspaceSymbol now returns results
changes.why_matters: LSP 的 workspaceSymbol 现在能正确按查询返回结果，提升代码导航能力。
changes.why_matters_en: LSP workspaceSymbol now accepts a query and returns results correctly, improving code navigation.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` cutting live status text (tool args, replies, prompts, exec output) at 60–120 columns on wide terminals; the status detail now uses the full terminal width
changes.summary: 状态信息不再截断
changes.summary_en: Show full live status text in agents
changes.why_matters: 在宽屏终端里，代理状态细节能完整显示，便于查看工具参数和输出。
changes.why_matters_en: Live agent status details now use the full terminal width, making tool args and output easier to read.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` truncating long session names at 40 columns; the name column now grows with terminal width
changes.summary: 会话名显示更完整
changes.summary_en: Show longer session names in agents
changes.why_matters: 长会话名不再过早截断，宽终端下更容易识别不同会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Long session names are no longer truncated too early, making sessions easier to distinguish on wide terminals.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` attach occasionally bouncing straight back to the session list on the first try after a background-service restart
changes.summary: 修复 agents 附加回跳列表
changes.summary_en: Fix agents attach bouncing back
changes.why_matters: 避免后台服务重启后首次附加失败，减少用户反复操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the first attach attempt from failing after a background-service restart, reducing repeated user effort.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` Ctrl+V image paste doing nothing in the dispatch input and the session reply box; pasting with no image now shows a hint
changes.summary: 修复 agents 图片粘贴失效
changes.summary_en: Fix image paste in agents input
changes.why_matters: 让用户能在调度输入和回复框中正常粘贴图片，并获得无图提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores image pasting in dispatch and reply inputs, with a hint when no image is present.

changes.raw: Fixed backgrounding a session with ← silently losing the conversation when the background service cannot start; the session stays in the list as a failed row you can wake with Enter
changes.summary: 后台失败不再丢失会话
changes.summary_en: Keep session after backgrounding fails
changes.why_matters: 即使后台服务无法启动，会话也会保留为失败状态，避免对话内容丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: If the background service cannot start, the session is preserved as failed instead of losing the conversation.

changes.raw: Fixed replies from the agents view that fail to send being lost; they are now queued for delivery on the next session start
changes.summary: 修复 agents 发送失败丢消息
changes.summary_en: Queue failed agents replies for retry
changes.why_matters: 发送失败的回复会在下次会话启动时重试，降低消息丢失风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Replies that fail to send are queued and retried on the next session start, reducing message loss.

changes.raw: Fixed cross-session messaging (`SendMessage`) silently breaking when `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` or `$TMPDIR` points at a deep directory
changes.summary: 修复深层临时目录消息断链
changes.summary_en: Fix SendMessage with deep tmp dirs
changes.why_matters: 避免临时目录路径过深时跨会话消息静默失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents cross-session messaging from silently breaking when temp paths are too deep.

changes.raw: Fixed opening a running background session from `claude agents` stalling for 5 seconds before attaching
changes.summary: 修复后台会话附加卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix 5s stall when attaching sessions
changes.why_matters: 打开运行中的后台会话更快，减少等待和卡顿感。
changes.why_matters_en: Attaching to a running background session becomes faster and feels more responsive.

changes.raw: Quieter startup: notices group by severity, and session info and announcements share a single line per launch
changes.summary: 启动信息更安静更整洁
changes.summary_en: Quieter, cleaner startup notices
changes.why_matters: 减少启动时噪音，让关键信息更容易被看到。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces startup noise so important information is easier to notice.

changes.raw: Startup warnings rewritten to be shorter and clearer, each with a concrete fix
changes.summary: 启动警告更短更清晰
changes.summary_en: Shorter, clearer startup warnings
changes.why_matters: 用户更容易理解问题并快速采取修复措施。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can understand issues faster and take corrective action more easily.

changes.raw: Launch-prompt warnings (deep link/pre-filled prompt) now stay pinned below the input until you act instead of scrolling away
changes.summary: 提示固定在输入下方
changes.summary_en: Keep launch prompts pinned below input
changes.why_matters: 深链或预填提示不会被滚走，用户更不容易错过待处理事项。
changes.why_matters_en: Deep-link or prefilled prompts stay visible until acted on, so they are less likely to be missed.

changes.raw: Failed turns now show a compact warning line instead of a multi-line red error block
changes.summary: 失败回复改为紧凑提示
changes.summary_en: Compact warning for failed turns
changes.why_matters: 错误展示更简洁，减少界面干扰并保留关键信息。
changes.why_matters_en: Failures are shown more compactly, reducing clutter while keeping the key signal.

changes.raw: Improved background service startup and `claude update` verification to wait out endpoint-security scanning of new binaries instead of failing after 5 seconds
changes.summary: 等待安全扫描再启动
changes.summary_en: Wait for security scan before startup
changes.why_matters: 避免新二进制被端点安全扫描误判导致启动或更新验证失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents startup and update verification from failing due to endpoint-security scanning of new binaries.

changes.raw: Background dispatch spawn failures now report the error class name when no errno is available
changes.summary: 调度失败显示错误类型
changes.summary_en: Show error class on dispatch failure
changes.why_matters: 即使没有 errno，也能更快判断失败原因，便于排障。
changes.why_matters_en: Even without errno, the error class helps diagnose dispatch failures faster.

changes.raw: Removed the "Claude in Chrome enabled" and "marketplace installed" startup messages; model auto-updates and the team-onboarding tip now show as quiet notices under the logo
changes.summary: 减少启动杂项提示
changes.summary_en: Remove extra startup messages
changes.why_matters: 启动界面更干净，保留更有价值的静默通知。
changes.why_matters_en: Startup becomes cleaner while keeping useful notices in a quieter form.

signals.title: Please don't spam people looking for employment. It's just cruel
Anthropic, please ship an official Claude Desktop for Linux
Ask HN: Why is the HN crowd so anti-AI?
Claude Code as a Daily Driver: Claude.md, Skills, Subagents, Plugins, and MCPs
Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use

changes.raw: `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` values are now included as labels on metric datapoints, so you can slice usage metrics by custom dimensions like team or repo
changes.summary: 指标支持按团队/仓库切片
changes.summary_en: Slice usage metrics by team/repo
changes.why_matters: 这让用户可以按自定义维度分析使用情况，更容易做成本归因和团队级监控。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets users analyze usage by custom dimensions, making cost attribution and team-level monitoring easier.

changes.raw: `claude agents` rows now show `done/total` before the detail when work is fanned out; peek shows the longest-running item
changes.summary: 并行任务显示完成进度
changes.summary_en: Show done/total for fan-out work
changes.why_matters: 这能让用户更快判断分发任务的整体进度，并定位最耗时的子任务。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users gauge fan-out progress at a glance and spot the slowest subtask.

changes.raw: `/mcp` now collapses claude.ai connectors you've never signed in to behind a "Show unused connectors" row
changes.summary: 隐藏未用 MCP 连接器
changes.summary_en: Collapse unused MCP connectors
changes.why_matters: 这减少了 `/mcp` 列表的噪音，让用户更容易找到已配置且常用的连接器。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces noise in the `/mcp` list, making configured and commonly used connectors easier to find.

changes.raw: Parallel tool calls: a failed Bash command no longer cancels other calls in the same batch — each tool returns its own result independently
changes.summary: 并行工具失败不再连带取消
changes.summary_en: One failed tool no longer cancels others
changes.why_matters: 这避免单个 Bash 失败拖垮整批并行调用，提高批处理任务的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents one Bash failure from aborting the whole batch, improving reliability for parallel work.

changes.raw: Fullscreen mode: clipboard now uses `wl-copy`/`xclip`/`xsel` on Linux when available, copies to both the clipboard and PRIMARY selection for middle-click paste, and the "hold {key} for native selection" hint now shows the correct key per terminal
changes.summary: Linux 剪贴板与中键粘贴优化
changes.summary_en: Better Linux clipboard and middle-click paste
changes.why_matters: 这让全屏模式下的复制粘贴更稳定，也更符合 Linux 终端用户习惯。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes copy/paste in fullscreen mode more reliable and better aligned with Linux terminal workflows.

changes.raw: Fixed the `/effort` dialog, workflow animations, and prompt keyword shimmer not honoring the "Reduce motion" setting
changes.summary: 减少动态效果设置生效
changes.summary_en: Respect Reduce motion setting
changes.why_matters: 这修复了无障碍偏好未被遵守的问题，提升了对动画敏感用户的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes an accessibility preference being ignored, improving usability for motion-sensitive users.

changes.raw: Fixed `forceLoginOrgUUID`/`forceLoginMethod` managed-settings policies blocking third-party provider sessions (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Mantle) alongside the org pin (regression in 2.1.146)
changes.summary: 管理策略不再误拦第三方登录
changes.summary_en: Managed policies no longer block third-party sessions
changes.why_matters: 这修复了组织登录策略对 Bedrock、Vertex 等会话的误伤，避免企业用户无法正常使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes managed login policies incorrectly blocking Bedrock, Vertex, and similar sessions, preventing enterprise lockouts.

changes.raw: Fixed background subagent output corrupting `claude -p` stdout when using `--output-format text` or `json`
changes.summary: 后台子代理不再污染标准输出
changes.summary_en: Background subagent output no longer corrupts stdout
changes.why_matters: 这保证 `claude -p` 的文本和 JSON 输出可被脚本稳定解析，避免自动化流程出错。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps `claude -p` text and JSON output parseable for scripts, preventing automation breakage.

changes.raw: Fixed `/usage-credits` starting a re-login for Team and Enterprise admins instead of pointing to the organization's usage settings page
changes.summary: 用量积分页改为设置入口
changes.summary_en: Usage credits now open org settings
changes.why_matters: 这减少了管理员误触重新登录的困扰，并直接引导到正确的组织设置页面。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids unnecessary re-login prompts for admins and sends them directly to the correct org settings page.

changes.raw: Fixed `/autofix-pr` reporting "cannot run on the default branch" when the session is inside a git worktree or another repository
changes.summary: 自动修复支持工作树仓库
changes.summary_en: Autofix works in worktrees and nested repos
changes.why_matters: 这让 `/autofix-pr` 在更复杂的 Git 结构中也能正常运行，减少误报失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets `/autofix-pr` work correctly in more complex Git layouts and reduces false failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` picker not showing sessions from the current directory when it isn't a git worktree (e.g., jj workspaces)
changes.summary: 恢复会话列表支持当前目录
changes.summary_en: Resume picker now includes current directory sessions
changes.why_matters: 这修复了在非 git worktree 环境下找不到会话的问题，提升了续接工作的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes missing sessions outside git worktrees, making it easier to resume ongoing work.

changes.raw: Fixed Windows hooks that invoke bash explicitly (e.g., `/usr/bin/bash script.sh`) failing with "command not found" or "cannot execute binary file"
changes.summary: Windows Bash hook 执行修复
changes.summary_en: Windows bash hooks now run correctly
changes.why_matters: 这让显式调用 bash 的 hooks 在 Windows 上可正常执行，避免脚本自动化中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This allows hooks that explicitly invoke bash to run on Windows, preventing automation failures.

changes.raw: Fixed OpenTelemetry log events (`user_prompt`, `api_request`, `tool_result`, `tool_decision`) being silently dropped when emitted before telemetry initialization completed
changes.summary: OTel 日志不再静默丢失
changes.summary_en: OTel log events are no longer dropped
changes.why_matters: 这确保关键遥测事件被完整记录，便于排障、审计和性能分析。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures critical telemetry events are recorded, improving debugging, auditing, and performance analysis.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude mcp` list/get/add printing secrets to the terminal: `${VAR}` references are no longer expanded, and credential headers and URL secrets are redacted
changes.summary: MCP 命令不再泄露密钥
changes.summary_en: MCP commands no longer print secrets
changes.why_matters: 这修复了终端输出泄露凭据的高危安全问题，避免敏感信息外泄。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes a high-risk security issue where terminal output could leak credentials and other sensitive data.

changes.raw: Fixed Workflow agents spawned with `isolation: "worktree"` in background sessions being blocked from editing files inside their own worktree
changes.summary: 工作树子代理可正常改文件
changes.summary_en: Worktree subagents can edit their files
changes.why_matters: 这恢复了隔离工作树中的后台代理编辑能力，保证分工式工作流能继续推进。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores editing ability for isolated worktree agents, keeping delegated workflows moving.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions dispatched from `claude agents` booting on a stale model from the daemon's environment instead of the model in `settings.json`
changes.summary: 修复代理会话模型过期
changes.summary_en: Fix agents using stale daemon model
changes.why_matters: 确保后台代理会话使用配置中的正确模型，避免行为与用户设置不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures background agent sessions use the model from settings, avoiding behavior that conflicts with user configuration.

changes.raw: Fixed a potential crash when rendering Write tool results after resuming a session
changes.summary: 修复恢复后写入结果崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash rendering Write results after resume
changes.why_matters: 避免恢复会话后渲染写入结果时崩溃，提升会话连续性和稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes when rendering write results after resuming a session, improving continuity and stability.

changes.raw: Fixed completed subagents getting stuck showing as running when an error occurs while finalizing their result
changes.summary: 修复子代理完成状态卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix subagents stuck as running on finalize error
changes.why_matters: 让子代理状态正确结束，避免界面误导和任务进度判断错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps subagent status accurate, preventing misleading UI state and progress tracking errors.

changes.raw: Fixed `EADDRINUSE` errors from tools that bind Unix sockets under `$TMPDIR` when `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` is set to a deep path
changes.summary: 修复临时目录套接字冲突
changes.summary_en: Fix Unix socket EADDRINUSE under deep TMPDIR
changes.why_matters: 减少工具在深层临时目录下绑定 Unix socket 失败的问题，提升环境兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces Unix socket binding failures for tools under deep temp paths, improving environment compatibility.

changes.raw: Improved terminal rendering performance by stabilizing the layout engine's JIT compilation profile
changes.summary: 提升终端渲染性能
changes.summary_en: Improve terminal rendering performance
changes.why_matters: 让终端界面更流畅，降低大输出场景下的卡顿和延迟。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes the terminal UI smoother and reduces lag in heavy-output scenarios.

changes.raw: Improved rendering performance for large file writes
changes.summary: 提升大文件写入渲染性能
changes.summary_en: Improve rendering for large file writes
changes.why_matters: 在处理大文件写入时减少渲染开销，提升响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Cuts rendering overhead for large file writes, improving responsiveness.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added a tip suggesting disabling terminal GPU acceleration (or running `/terminal-setup`) to fix garbled glyphs
changes.summary: 提示修复 VSCode 字形乱码
changes.summary_en: Add tip for fixing garbled VSCode glyphs
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户快速排查 VSCode 终端乱码问题，减少使用障碍。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users quickly resolve garbled glyph issues in VSCode terminal, reducing friction.

signals.title: Please don't spam people looking for employment. It's just cruel
Anthropic, please ship an official Claude Desktop for Linux
Ask HN: Why is the HN crowd so anti-AI?
Claude Code as a Daily Driver: Claude.md, Skills, Subagents, Plugins, and MCPs
Show HN: Lathe – Use LLMs to learn a new domain, not skip past it

changes.raw: Added a prompt before writing to shell startup files (`.zshenv`, `.zlogin`, `.bash_login`) and `~/.config/git/`, which could otherwise lead to unintended command execution
changes.summary: 写入高风险配置前先确认
changes.summary_en: Prompt before risky startup/config writes
changes.why_matters: 这能避免工具在写入可能触发命令执行的启动或构建配置时造成意外执行风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces the risk of unintended command execution when writing startup or build config files.

changes.raw: `acceptEdits` mode now prompts before writing build-tool config files that grant code execution (`.npmrc`, `.yarnrc*`, `bunfig.toml`, `.bazelrc`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `.devcontainer/`, etc.)
changes.summary: 编辑构建配置前先确认
changes.summary_en: Prompt before editing exec-capable configs
changes.why_matters: 这能防止在接受编辑时无意修改会授予代码执行权限的配置文件。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents accidental edits to config files that can grant code execution.

changes.raw: Edit no longer requires a separate Read after viewing a file with `grep`: single-file `grep`/`egrep`/`fgrep` commands now satisfy the read-before-edit check
changes.summary: grep 预览后可直接编辑
changes.summary_en: Grep view now counts as read before edit
changes.why_matters: 这减少了单文件查看后的重复读取步骤，让编辑流程更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes an extra read step after single-file grep previews, making edits smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed copy-on-select not writing to the Windows clipboard on WSL — now uses PowerShell interop instead of OSC 52, which terminals like MobaXterm don't support
changes.summary: WSL 复制可写入剪贴板
changes.summary_en: Copy-on-select now works on WSL clipboard
changes.why_matters: 这修复了在 WSL 和部分终端中选中文本无法复制到系统剪贴板的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes copy-on-select so selected text reaches the system clipboard on WSL and supported terminals.

changes.raw: Fixed restoring a completed session from `claude agents` dropping chat history and re-running the original prompt
changes.summary: 恢复会话不再丢历史
changes.summary_en: Restored sessions keep chat history
changes.why_matters: 这避免恢复已完成会话时丢失上下文并重复执行原始提示词。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents restored completed sessions from losing context and rerunning the original prompt.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions re-attached after overnight retire losing their conversation and re-running the original prompt
changes.summary: 后台会话恢复不丢对话
changes.summary_en: Background session resume keeps history
changes.why_matters: 这确保后台会话在长时间挂起后恢复时仍保留完整对话上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures background sessions retain their conversation context after long suspensions.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --bg` occasionally failing with "socket missing" when the background daemon was cold-starting on a loaded machine
changes.summary: 冷启动时后台模式更稳
changes.summary_en: Background mode no longer socket-missing
changes.why_matters: 这减少了机器繁忙或守护进程冷启动时 `claude --bg` 失败的情况。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces `claude --bg` failures when the daemon is cold-starting on a busy machine.

changes.raw: Fixed an issue on Windows where the directory a background session was started in could not be deleted after `claude rm` until the background daemon exited
changes.summary: Windows 可删除后台会话目录
changes.summary_en: Windows background session dirs delete cleanly
changes.why_matters: 这修复了后台会话结束后目录仍被占用、无法删除的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes background session directories staying locked on Windows after removal.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents that resumed work being shown under Completed in the agents list
changes.summary: 恢复运行的代理状态正确
changes.summary_en: Resumed agents show correct status
changes.why_matters: 这让代理列表中的状态更准确，避免已恢复工作的代理被误标为已完成。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps the agent list accurate by avoiding resumed agents being mislabeled as completed.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` freezing for several seconds when returning to the session list due to the auto-updater re-checking on every exit
changes.summary: 代理列表退出更流畅
changes.summary_en: Agent list exits faster
changes.why_matters: 这减少了返回会话列表时因重复检查更新而产生的卡顿。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes a delay when returning to the session list by avoiding repeated update checks.

changes.raw: Fixed Esc, arrow keys, and typing becoming unresponsive on Windows when attached to a background session or in the agent view while the host is under heavy CPU load
changes.summary: Windows 低负载下更不卡键
changes.summary_en: Windows input stays responsive under load
changes.why_matters: 这避免在高 CPU 负载下附着后台会话时键盘输入失去响应。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents keyboard input from freezing when attached to background sessions under heavy CPU load.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents emitting terminal sync-output markers to terminals that don't support them (Apple Terminal, tmux), causing render artifacts when entering a running agent
changes.summary: 不支持的终端不再乱标记
changes.summary_en: Unsupported terminals no longer show sync markers
changes.why_matters: 这避免在不支持同步输出标记的终端中出现渲染异常。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents rendering artifacts in terminals that do not support sync-output markers.

changes.raw: Fixed mouse wheel scrolling prompt history instead of the transcript right after opening a session from the agents list
changes.summary: 鼠标滚轮不再误翻历史
changes.summary_en: Mouse wheel no longer scrolls prompt history
changes.why_matters: 这让刚打开会话后的滚轮行为符合预期，避免误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes mouse wheel behavior after opening a session match expectations and avoids mis-scrolling.

changes.raw: Fixed CJK IME composition appearing at the bottom-left of the screen instead of at the input caret in the `claude agents` view
changes.summary: 中文输入法定位正确
changes.summary_en: CJK IME now appears at the caret
changes.why_matters: 这改善了中文等输入法在代理视图中的输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves IME input experience for CJK users in the agents view.

changes.raw: Fixed valid `file:///C:/...` links being rewritten to a broken path on Windows terminals with hyperlink support
changes.summary: Windows 文件链接不再损坏
changes.summary_en: Windows file links stay valid
changes.why_matters: 这确保 Windows 终端中的本地文件链接能正确打开而不是被改写成错误路径。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures local file links on Windows open correctly instead of being rewritten to broken paths.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode failing to connect when the project directory or branch name contains non-ASCII or special characters
changes.summary: 修复语音模式特殊字符连接失败
changes.summary_en: Fix voice mode connect with special chars
changes.why_matters: 项目路径或分支名含特殊字符时不再导致语音模式无法连接，提升跨语言和复杂仓库的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice mode now works even when project paths or branch names contain special characters, improving reliability across repositories.

changes.raw: Fixed the auto mode unavailability message on third-party providers (Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry) to point to the `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE` opt-in instead of incorrectly blaming the model
changes.summary: 修正自动模式提示文案
changes.summary_en: Fix auto mode message for third-party providers
changes.why_matters: 第三方模型提供方的自动模式不可用提示现在会指向正确的启用方式，减少误导和排查成本。
changes.why_matters_en: The auto mode unavailable message now points to the correct opt-in setting, reducing confusion and support friction.

changes.raw: Fixed `/effort ultracode` incorrectly blaming the dynamic workflows setting when the model cannot run xhigh; ultracode is no longer offered on models that do not support it
changes.summary: 修正 ultracode 不支持提示
changes.summary_en: Fix ultracode unsupported-model messaging
changes.why_matters: 当模型不支持 xhigh 时不再误导用户去改动态工作流设置，避免无效排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Users are no longer misled into changing workflow settings when the model simply does not support xhigh.

changes.raw: Fixed model-not-found errors suggesting `--model` when running via the SDK or other hosts where the CLI flag doesn't apply
changes.summary: 修正 SDK 模式下模型缺失提示
changes.summary_en: Fix model-not-found hint for SDK hosts
changes.why_matters: 在 SDK 或其他宿主环境中不会再建议无效的 CLI 参数，减少错误引导。
changes.why_matters_en: The error message no longer suggests an irrelevant CLI flag in SDK or host environments, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude's past replies disappearing from scrollback when resuming a brief mode session with brief mode turned off
changes.summary: 修复恢复会话后历史回复丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix missing scrollback after resuming brief mode
changes.why_matters: 恢复 brief mode 会话时不会丢失之前的回复，便于继续上下文阅读和审查。
changes.why_matters_en: Past replies remain visible when resuming a brief-mode session, preserving context for review and continuation.

changes.raw: Fixed vim mode `p` pasting on the line below instead of at the cursor when the register was yanked with `v$`
changes.summary: 修复 vim 粘贴位置错误
changes.summary_en: Fix vim paste position after v$ yank
changes.why_matters: vim 模式下的粘贴行为更符合预期，减少编辑时的手动修正。
changes.why_matters_en: Paste now lands at the expected cursor position in vim mode, reducing editing friction.

changes.raw: Improved performance of opening recently-inactive background agent sessions in `claude agents`
changes.summary: 加快后台会话打开速度
changes.summary_en: Speed up opening inactive agent sessions
changes.why_matters: 打开最近不活跃的后台代理会话更快，提升多会话工作流效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Recently inactive background agent sessions open faster, improving multi-session productivity.

changes.raw: Improved auto mode classifier latency by reducing reasoning on routine actions, lowering the chance of "could not evaluate this action" blocks
changes.summary: 降低自动模式分类延迟
changes.summary_en: Reduce auto mode classifier latency
changes.why_matters: 自动模式对常规操作判断更快，且更少出现无法评估动作的阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: Auto mode classifies routine actions faster and is less likely to block with evaluation failures.

changes.raw: Improved background-session teardown (`claude rm`/`stop`, idle reap) to send SIGTERM to running shell subprocesses before SIGKILL, so cleanup handlers run
changes.summary: 改进后台会话退出清理
changes.summary_en: Improve background session shutdown cleanup
changes.why_matters: 退出或回收后台会话时会先发 SIGTERM，让清理逻辑有机会执行，减少残留进程。
changes.why_matters_en: Background session shutdown now sends SIGTERM before SIGKILL so cleanup handlers can run and processes exit cleanly.

changes.raw: Removed `CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE`; the environment variable is now a no-op
changes.summary: 移除快速模式覆盖变量
changes.summary_en: Remove fast mode override env var
changes.why_matters: 相关环境变量已失效，依赖它的配置将不再生效，需要用户调整脚本或环境设置。
changes.why_matters_en: The environment variable is now a no-op, so any setup depending on it will no longer have an effect.

changes.raw: Removed the JetBrains plugin install suggestion from startup
changes.summary: 移除 JetBrains 安装提示
changes.summary_en: Remove JetBrains plugin install suggestion
changes.why_matters: 启动时少了一个不必要的安装建议，减少干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Startup is less noisy because an unnecessary plugin install suggestion was removed.

changes.raw: Renamed the dynamic-workflow trigger keyword from `workflow` to `ultracode`. The word "workflow" no longer triggers a run; asking for one in your own words still works. The trigger keyword is highlighted in violet in the prompt input
changes.summary: 工作流触发词改为 ultracode
changes.summary_en: Rename workflow trigger keyword to ultracode
changes.why_matters: 旧触发词不再自动触发，用户需要改用新关键词，避免自动化入口失效。
changes.why_matters_en: The old trigger word no longer starts a run, so users must switch to the new keyword to keep automation working.

changes.raw: Plugins in `.claude/skills` directories are now automatically loaded, no marketplace required
changes.summary: 自动加载技能插件
changes.summary_en: Auto-load skills from .claude/skills
changes.why_matters: 用户无需再依赖 marketplace 就能直接启用本地技能插件，降低配置和分发成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can use local skill plugins without a marketplace, reducing setup and distribution friction.

changes.raw: Added `claude plugin init <name>` to scaffold a new plugin in `.claude/skills`
changes.summary: 新增插件初始化命令
changes.summary_en: Add plugin scaffolding command
changes.why_matters: 一条命令即可生成插件骨架，提升创建插件的效率和一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: A single command scaffolds a new plugin, making plugin creation faster and more consistent.

changes.raw: Added autocomplete for `/plugin` arguments: subcommands, installed plugin names, and plugins from known marketplaces
changes.summary: 插件参数补全
changes.summary_en: Autocomplete /plugin arguments
changes.why_matters: 补全子命令和插件名可减少输入错误并加快插件操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Autocomplete reduces typing errors and speeds up plugin-related commands.

changes.raw: `claude agents`: the `agent` field in `settings.json` is now honored for dispatched sessions, with `--agent <name>` to override it
changes.summary: 支持会话代理配置
changes.summary_en: Honor agent setting for dispatched sessions
changes.why_matters: 用户可在配置中指定默认代理并按需覆盖，提升多代理工作流的可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can set a default agent and override it when needed, improving control over multi-agent workflows.

changes.raw: `EnterWorktree` can now switch between Claude-managed worktrees mid-session
changes.summary: 会话中切换工作树
changes.summary_en: Switch Claude worktrees mid-session
changes.why_matters: 在同一会话里切换工作树更灵活，便于在多个任务分支间继续工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Switching worktrees mid-session makes it easier to continue work across multiple task branches.

changes.raw: `tool_decision` telemetry events now include `tool_parameters` (bash commands, MCP/skill names) when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`
changes.summary: 工具遥测带参数详情
changes.summary_en: Add tool parameters to telemetry
changes.why_matters: 遥测可记录更完整的工具调用信息，便于排查和分析使用情况。
changes.why_matters_en: Telemetry now captures richer tool-call details, improving debugging and usage analysis.

changes.raw: Worktrees managed by Claude are now left unlocked when the agent finishes, so `git worktree remove`/`prune` can clean them up
changes.summary: 工作树完成后自动解锁
changes.summary_en: Leave managed worktrees unlocked
changes.why_matters: 任务结束后工作树可被清理工具正常回收，减少残留和维护负担。
changes.why_matters_en: Finished worktrees can now be cleaned up normally, reducing leftovers and maintenance overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed unprocessable images (zero-byte, corrupt) attached via paste, MCP, or dialog crashing the request instead of becoming a text placeholder
changes.summary: 损坏图片不再崩溃
changes.summary_en: Handle corrupt pasted images safely
changes.why_matters: 避免无效图片导致请求崩溃，提升稳定性和容错性。
changes.why_matters_en: Invalid images no longer crash requests, improving stability and fault tolerance.

changes.raw: Fixed sandbox network permission prompts appearing in auto and bypass-permissions mode when using the desktop app, IDE extensions, or SDK
changes.summary: 绕过权限模式不再误弹网络提示
changes.summary_en: Stop network prompts in bypass mode
changes.why_matters: 在自动或绕过权限模式下减少错误提示，避免打断桌面端、IDE 和 SDK 工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents spurious prompts in auto/bypass modes, avoiding interruptions in desktop, IDE, and SDK workflows.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` completed sessions not retiring when an idle subagent was still parked or had leaked a backgrounded shell
changes.summary: 完成会话正确回收
changes.summary_en: Retire completed agent sessions correctly
changes.why_matters: 避免已完成会话因后台残留而一直占用状态，提升会话管理准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Completed sessions now retire properly even with lingering background state, improving session management accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` pressing Esc not cancelling a slow "opening…", leaving the list unresponsive
changes.summary: Esc 可取消慢速打开
changes.summary_en: Esc cancels slow opening state
changes.why_matters: 用户可以及时退出卡住的打开流程，减少界面无响应感。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now cancel a slow opening flow, reducing the feeling of a frozen UI.

changes.raw: Fixed background agent worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` being orphaned after the 30-day job retention sweep
changes.summary: 后台工作树不再孤儿化
changes.summary_en: Prevent orphaned background worktrees
changes.why_matters: 保留后台任务对应的工作树，避免磁盘垃圾和状态丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeping background-task worktrees prevents disk clutter and lost state.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions re-attached after a sleep/wake not telling the model the correct date
changes.summary: 恢复后日期正确
changes.summary_en: Use correct date after sleep/wake
changes.why_matters: 后台会话在睡眠唤醒后能获得正确日期，减少时间感知错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Background sessions now get the correct date after sleep/wake, reducing time-awareness errors.

changes.raw: Fixed copy-on-select in `claude agents` not reaching the system clipboard inside tmux with `set-clipboard on` (regression in 2.1.153)
changes.summary: tmux 复制到系统剪贴板
changes.summary_en: Copy selection to system clipboard in tmux
changes.why_matters: 在 tmux 中选择内容后能正常复制到系统剪贴板，改善交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Selection now copies to the system clipboard inside tmux, improving usability.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` not reporting background subagents that were running when the previous Claude Code process exited
changes.summary: 恢复时显示后台子代理
changes.summary_en: Show running background subagents on resume
changes.why_matters: 重新接入会话时能看到仍在运行的子代理，避免重复操作和状态误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Resuming now reports still-running background subagents, preventing duplicate work and state confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed the `--resume` session picker leaving its contents on the terminal after exiting in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 修复恢复会话选择器残留
changes.summary_en: Fix resume picker leaving terminal residue
changes.why_matters: 退出全屏后不再残留界面内容，减少终端显示污染。
changes.why_matters_en: Exiting fullscreen no longer leaves UI residue in the terminal, reducing display clutter.

changes.raw: Fixed `--worktree` and `--worktree --tmux` returning to the canonical repo root instead of the current linked worktree
changes.summary: 修复 worktree 返回根目录
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree returning to repo root
changes.why_matters: 在 linked worktree 中操作时会保持正确目录，避免上下文跑偏。
changes.why_matters_en: Operations in linked worktrees now stay in the correct directory, avoiding context drift.

changes.raw: Fixed the `/model` picker showing an incorrect "Newer version available" hint when the selected model is already the newest in its family; the pinned-model row now shows the model's description instead of its raw ID
changes.summary: 修复模型选择提示错误
changes.summary_en: Fix incorrect model update hint
changes.why_matters: 模型列表提示更准确，避免用户误以为当前模型需要升级。
changes.why_matters_en: Model picker hints are now accurate, preventing users from thinking an update is needed.

changes.raw: Fixed literal markdown markers (backticks, asterisks) appearing in the in-progress message text in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 修复全屏进度消息乱码标记
changes.summary_en: Fix markdown markers in progress text
changes.why_matters: 进度消息显示更干净，提升全屏终端中的可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Progress messages render more cleanly, improving readability in fullscreen terminals.

changes.raw: Fixed the terminal freezing after approving the managed-settings security dialog at startup
changes.summary: 修复启动安全弹窗后卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix freeze after security dialog approval
changes.why_matters: 避免启动时在安全确认后卡住，直接影响可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents startup freezes after security approval, which directly impacts usability.

changes.raw: Fixed a rare duplicate line appearing in scrollback after the terminal UI redraws
changes.summary: 修复滚动回溯重复行
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate line in scrollback
changes.why_matters: 终端历史记录更稳定，减少 UI 重绘带来的视觉错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Terminal history is more stable, reducing visual glitches from UI redraws.

changes.raw: Fixed right-click paste duplicating the clipboard in the VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf integrated terminals
changes.summary: 修复集成终端右键粘贴重复
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate paste in integrated terminals
changes.why_matters: 在 IDE 集成终端中粘贴不会重复输入，避免命令被意外执行两次。
changes.why_matters_en: Pasting in IDE integrated terminals no longer duplicates input, avoiding accidental double execution.

changes.raw: WSL: fixed image paste (`alt+v` keybinding), screenshot paste on Windows 11, and added support for dragging images from Windows Explorer
changes.summary: 支持 WSL 图片粘贴与拖拽
changes.summary_en: Add WSL image paste and drag-drop support
changes.why_matters: WSL 下可以更方便地导入截图和图片，提升多模态工作流效率。
changes.why_matters_en: WSL users can import screenshots and images more easily, improving multimodal workflows.

changes.raw: Improved performance of long and resumed conversations by eliminating redundant message-rendering recomputations
changes.summary: 提升长对话与续聊性能
changes.summary_en: Improve long and resumed conversation performance
changes.why_matters: 减少重复渲染计算后，长会话响应更快、资源占用更低。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminating redundant rendering work makes long sessions faster and lighter on resources.

changes.raw: `/terminal-setup` now disables GPU acceleration in VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf integrated terminals to prevent garbled-text rendering
changes.summary: 禁用集成终端 GPU 加速
changes.summary_en: Disable GPU acceleration in integrated terminals
changes.why_matters: 可避免 VS Code 等集成终端出现乱码渲染问题，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids garbled text rendering in VS Code-style integrated terminals and improves stability.

changes.raw: The Feature of the Week credit-claim status now appears as a notification in the status area instead of a line above the prompt
changes.summary: 奖励状态改为状态区通知
changes.summary_en: Move reward status to status-area notification
changes.why_matters: 状态展示更不打扰，减少提示对主工作流的干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Status updates are less intrusive, reducing distraction from the main workflow.

changes.raw: `claude agents`: slash-command autocomplete in the dispatch input now matches substrings
changes.summary: 子命令自动补全支持子串
changes.summary_en: Autocomplete slash commands by substring
changes.why_matters: 在 dispatch 输入中更容易找到目标命令，提升操作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It becomes easier to find the right command in dispatch input, improving efficiency.

changes.raw: Removed the "bash commands will be sandboxed" startup banner — sandbox status still shows in `/status` and when a command is blocked
changes.summary: 移除沙箱启动横幅
changes.summary_en: Remove sandbox startup banner
changes.why_matters: 减少启动时噪音信息，但关键沙箱状态仍可查看。
changes.why_matters_en: Startup noise is reduced while sandbox status remains available when needed.

changes.raw: Removed the "/ide for …" startup hint toast
changes.summary: 移除 IDE 启动提示
changes.summary_en: Remove IDE startup hint toast
changes.why_matters: 启动界面更简洁，减少无关提示干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: The startup experience is cleaner with fewer distracting hints.

changes.raw: [IDE] Fixed clicking Stop while a background subagent is running not actually stopping it
changes.summary: 修复停止按钮无法停子代理
changes.summary_en: Fix Stop not stopping background subagent
changes.why_matters: 用户可以真正中止后台子代理，避免任务继续占用资源。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now actually stop background subagents, preventing unnecessary resource use.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed the fast mode indicator not appearing on Opus 4.8
changes.summary: 修复 Opus 4.8 快速模式指示器
changes.summary_en: Fix fast mode indicator on Opus 4.8
changes.why_matters: 让用户在 VSCode 中能正确看到当前模式状态，减少误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can correctly see the current mode state in VSCode, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Pressing backspace right after a workflow trigger keyword now dismisses the workflow request (same as alt+w) instead of deleting a character
changes.summary: 退格可关闭工作流请求
changes.summary_en: Backspace dismisses workflow request
changes.why_matters: 提升触发工作流后的撤销体验，避免误删字符。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves the undo experience after a workflow trigger and avoids accidental character deletion.

changes.raw: Added a "Workflow keyword trigger" setting in /config to stop the word "workflow" in a prompt from triggering a dynamic workflow
changes.summary: 新增工作流关键词触发开关
changes.summary_en: Add workflow keyword trigger setting
changes.why_matters: 用户可关闭关键词自动触发，减少提示词中的误触发。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can disable keyword-based auto-triggering to reduce accidental workflow activation in prompts.

changes.summary_en: Fix Opus 4.8 thinking block mutation
