Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
Claude Code as a Daily Driver: Claude.md, Skills, Subagents, Plugins, and MCPs
Claude Code – Everything you can configure that the docs don't tell you
Dynamic Workflows in Claude Code

changes.raw: Opus 4.8 is here! Now defaults to high effort · /effort xhigh for your hardest tasks
changes.summary: 默认高努力模式
changes.summary_en: Default to high effort
changes.why_matters: 让 Claude 在复杂任务上默认投入更多推理资源，提升难题处理质量。
changes.why_matters_en: Claude now uses more reasoning by default on hard tasks, improving quality on complex work.

changes.raw: Introducing dynamic workflows: ask Claude to create a workflow and it orchestrates work across tens to hundreds of agents in the background, so you can take on larger, more complex tasks. Run `/workflows` to view your runs
changes.summary: 动态工作流编排多代理
changes.summary_en: Dynamic workflows across many agents
changes.why_matters: 可自动协调大量代理并行处理大任务，显著扩展可处理的问题规模。
changes.why_matters_en: It can orchestrate many agents in parallel, enabling much larger and more complex tasks.

changes.raw: Fast mode on Opus 4.8 is now available at a fraction of its previous cost: 2x the standard rate for 2.5x the speed
changes.summary: 高速模式更便宜更快
changes.summary_en: Faster mode at lower cost
changes.why_matters: 在保持更高速度的同时降低使用成本，适合高频交互和批量任务。
changes.why_matters_en: It delivers higher speed at lower cost, making frequent and batch usage more practical.

changes.raw: The lean system prompt is now the default for all models except Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus 4.7 and earlier
changes.summary: 默认使用精简系统提示
changes.summary_en: Lean system prompt by default
changes.why_matters: 减少默认提示开销，可能让响应更简洁并改善整体效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces default prompt overhead, which can improve efficiency and keep responses leaner.

changes.raw: Claude now reserves the multiple-choice question prompt for decisions it genuinely cannot make itself, instead of asking when it already has enough context to proceed
changes.summary: 减少不必要的多选提问
changes.summary_en: Ask fewer unnecessary multiple-choice questions
changes.why_matters: Claude 会在已有足够上下文时直接继续，减少打断并提升任务流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Claude proceeds when it already has enough context, reducing interruptions and improving flow.

changes.raw: `/simplify` now runs a cleanup-only review (reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude) and applies the fixes, instead of running the full `/code-review --fix` bug-hunting review
changes.summary: /simplify 仅做清理优化
changes.summary_en: /simplify now does cleanup-only review
changes.why_matters: 让该命令更符合预期，专注重用、简化和效率优化，而不是混入 bug 排查。
changes.why_matters_en: The command now matches its intent by focusing on cleanup and optimization instead of bug hunting.

changes.raw: Renamed the `/effort` slider labels from "Speed"/"Intelligence" to "Faster"/"Smarter" for clarity
changes.summary: 调整努力滑块文案
changes.summary_en: Rename effort slider labels
changes.why_matters: 更清晰的标签有助于用户更快理解不同努力档位的含义。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearer labels help users understand effort levels more quickly.

changes.raw: `claude agents`: type `! <command>` to run a shell command as a background session you can attach to and detach from. Also available as `claude --bg --exec '<command>'`
changes.summary: 后台运行 shell 命令
changes.summary_en: Run shell commands in background
changes.why_matters: 支持把长任务放到后台并随时接入/退出，提高并行操作能力。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets users run long commands in the background and attach/detach as needed for better parallelism.

changes.raw: `claude agents`: `/logout` now signs you out instead of being sent to a background session
changes.summary: /logout 现在正常登出
changes.summary_en: /logout now logs you out
changes.why_matters: 修复命令行为错误，避免用户误入后台会话而无法完成退出。
changes.why_matters_en: It fixes a command behavior bug so users can actually sign out instead of being redirected.

changes.raw: `←←` to open the agents view now works on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and with telemetry disabled
changes.summary: 代理视图兼容更多环境
changes.summary_en: Agents view works in more environments
changes.why_matters: 在更多云与隐私配置下可用，减少功能不可达的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: The feature now works across more cloud and privacy setups, reducing accessibility issues.

changes.raw: Claude in Chrome: pick which connected browser to use via `/chrome` → "Select browser…", or in-chat when a browser action runs with multiple connected
changes.summary: 可选择连接的浏览器
changes.summary_en: Choose which connected browser to use
changes.why_matters: 当连接多个浏览器时，用户可以明确指定目标，减少误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: When multiple browsers are connected, users can target the right one and avoid mistakes.

changes.raw: Plugins can now declare `defaultEnabled: false` in `plugin.json` or a marketplace entry; enable them with `/plugin` or `claude plugin enable`. Dependencies of enabled plugins are still enabled automatically
changes.summary: 插件可默认关闭
changes.summary_en: Plugins can be default-disabled
changes.why_matters: 让插件按需启用，降低默认暴露面并提升安装控制力。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins can now be opt-in by default, improving control and reducing unnecessary exposure.

changes.raw: The `/plugin` Discover tab now pins plugins whose relevance signals match the current directory with a "suggested for this directory" annotation
changes.summary: 推荐当前目录相关插件
changes.summary_en: Suggest plugins for this directory
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户更快发现与当前项目相关的插件，提升插件发现效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users discover plugins relevant to the current project faster.

changes.raw: Streaming tool execution is now always enabled, including when telemetry is disabled or on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry (previously behind a feature flag)
changes.summary: 始终启用流式工具执行
changes.summary_en: Always enable streaming tool execution
changes.why_matters: 工具执行反馈更及时，即使在受限环境中也能获得更好的交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Tool execution now streams consistently, improving responsiveness even in restricted environments.

changes.raw: Stdio MCP server subprocesses now receive `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` and `CLAUDECODE=1` in their environment
changes.summary: MCP 子进程带会话环境
changes.summary_en: MCP subprocesses get session env
changes.why_matters: 让外部 MCP 服务能识别当前会话，便于集成与调试。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets external MCP services identify the current session, improving integration and debugging.

changes.raw: `claude mcp list`/`get` now show unapproved `.mcp.json` servers as `⏸ Pending approval` instead of auto-approving and connecting when output is piped
changes.summary: 未批准MCP服务器改为待审批
changes.summary_en: Show unapproved MCP servers as pending
changes.why_matters: 避免在输出被管道重定向时误自动连接未批准的服务器，提升安全性与可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents auto-connecting unapproved servers when output is piped, improving safety and control.

changes.raw: `/remote-control` autocomplete now shows "Disconnect Remote Control" when Remote Control is already active
changes.summary: 远程控制已启用时显示断开
changes.summary_en: Show Disconnect when Remote Control is active
changes.why_matters: 让自动补全更贴合当前状态，减少误操作并提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes autocomplete reflect the current state, reducing mistakes and improving usability.

changes.raw: Added Claude Opus 4.8 support and 4.7 → 4.8 migration guidance to the `/claude-api` skill
changes.summary: 支持Opus 4.8并提供迁移指引
changes.summary_en: Add Opus 4.8 support and migration guidance
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户顺利升级到新模型版本，减少迁移成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users upgrade to the new model version with less migration friction.

changes.raw: Deprecated `CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE` (will be removed on 06/01). To use fast mode on Opus 4.6, switch with `/model claude-opus-4-6[1m]` and then `/fast on`
changes.summary: 弃用Opus 4.6快速模式开关
changes.summary_en: Deprecate Opus 4.6 fast mode override
changes.why_matters: 现有配置将逐步失效，用户需要尽快切换到新的操作方式以避免中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Existing configuration will stop working soon, so users need to migrate to avoid disruption.

changes.raw: Improved the auto-mode classifier's detection of data exfiltration, particularly bulk transfers of repository contents
changes.summary: 增强数据外泄检测
changes.summary_en: Improve data exfiltration detection
changes.why_matters: 更好识别批量仓库内容外传等风险行为，降低敏感数据泄露风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Better detects risky bulk repository transfers, reducing the chance of sensitive data leakage.

changes.raw: Fixed `rm -rf $HOME` not being blocked as a dangerous path when `HOME` has a trailing slash
changes.summary: 修复危险路径拦截失效
changes.summary_en: Fix dangerous path blocking for rm -rf
changes.why_matters: 避免误判导致危险删除命令绕过保护，直接提升数据安全。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents dangerous delete commands from bypassing protection, directly improving data safety.

changes.raw: Fixed `$TMPDIR` resolving to different directories in sandboxed vs unsandboxed Bash commands within the same session
changes.summary: 修复TMPDIR沙箱路径不一致
changes.summary_en: Fix TMPDIR path mismatch in sandbox
changes.why_matters: 保证同一会话内临时目录行为一致，减少脚本和工具链异常。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps temp directory behavior consistent within a session, reducing script and toolchain issues.

changes.raw: Fixed unreadable highlighted-row text in `claude agents` when the Claude Code theme doesn't match the terminal background
changes.summary: 修复代理列表高亮文字难读
changes.summary_en: Fix unreadable highlighted text in agents list
changes.why_matters: 改善主题不匹配时的可读性，提升终端使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves readability when themes mismatch, enhancing terminal usability.

changes.raw: Fixed background-agent completion notifications triggering premature "out of context" behavior on some 1M-context models
changes.summary: 修复后台完成通知误触上下文耗尽
changes.summary_en: Fix premature out-of-context on completion
changes.why_matters: 避免后台任务完成后错误触发上下文耗尽状态，减少任务中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents background task completion from wrongly triggering out-of-context behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed background-session classifier losing the user's goal when a scheduled `/command` fires
changes.summary: 修复定时命令丢失目标
changes.summary_en: Fix goal loss when scheduled command fires
changes.why_matters: 确保后台会话在定时命令执行时仍保留原始目标，提升任务连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures background sessions retain the original goal when scheduled commands run.

changes.raw: Fixed pinned background sessions respawning every minute after a Claude Code update, causing repeated agent-start notifications and process churn at idle
changes.summary: 修复后台会话更新后反复重启
changes.summary_en: Fix pinned background sessions respawning
changes.why_matters: 避免空闲时重复启动代理和通知刷屏，减少资源浪费与干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents repeated agent restarts and notifications at idle, reducing churn and noise.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions stuck at "blocked", "running", or "working" not retiring after the idle grace period
changes.summary: 修复后台会话卡住不退出
changes.summary_en: Fix stuck background sessions not retiring
changes.why_matters: 让卡住的后台任务能按预期回收，避免资源长期占用。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows stuck background tasks to retire as expected, avoiding prolonged resource usage.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents in background sessions bypassing the worktree-isolation guard and writing to the shared checkout
changes.summary: 修复后台子代理绕过隔离
changes.summary_en: Fix subagents bypassing worktree isolation
changes.why_matters: 防止后台子代理写入共享工作区，避免越权修改和污染代码库。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents background subagents from writing to the shared checkout, avoiding unauthorized changes.

changes.raw: Fixed orphaned `claude --bg-pty-host` processes spinning at 100% CPU after the daemon exits on macOS
changes.summary: 修复macOS孤儿PTY进程空转
changes.summary_en: Fix orphaned bg-pty-host CPU spin on macOS
changes.why_matters: 避免守护进程退出后残留高CPU进程，提升稳定性并节省资源。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents orphaned high-CPU processes after daemon exit, improving stability and saving resources.

changes.raw: Fixed number key shortcuts not working for options shown below the divider in option dialogs
changes.summary: 修复数字快捷键失效
changes.summary_en: Fix number shortcuts in option dialogs
changes.why_matters: 让选项对话框的快捷操作恢复正常，提升交互效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores shortcut-based selection in option dialogs, improving interaction speed.

changes.raw: Fixed `worktree.baseRef: "head"` resolving to the main checkout's HEAD instead of the current worktree's HEAD when spawning subagents or calling `EnterWorktree` from inside a linked worktree
changes.summary: 修正子工作树基准分支
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree baseRef in linked worktrees
changes.why_matters: 确保在链接工作树中创建子代理或进入工作树时使用正确的 HEAD，避免分支上下文错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures subagents and worktree actions use the correct HEAD in linked worktrees, avoiding branch-context mistakes.

changes.raw: Fixed a stray leading space on wrapped lines when the previous line ended exactly at the terminal width
changes.summary: 修复换行多余空格
changes.summary_en: Fix stray space on wrapped lines
changes.why_matters: 改善终端文本排版，避免换行后出现多余空格影响阅读。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves terminal text formatting by removing an extra space that could appear after wrapped lines.

changes.raw: Fixed intermittent terminal rendering corruption in VS Code by capping the number of distinct colors the thinking spinner produces
changes.summary: 修复VS Code渲染乱码
changes.summary_en: Fix VS Code rendering corruption
changes.why_matters: 减少思考动画产生过多颜色导致的终端渲染异常，提升编辑器内稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents rendering corruption in VS Code by limiting spinner colors, improving stability in-editor.

changes.raw: Fixed plan file names including `[Image #N]` / `[Pasted text #N]` placeholders when a plan-mode prompt starts with pasted images or text
changes.summary: 修正计划文件名占位符
changes.summary_en: Fix plan filenames with image/text placeholders
changes.why_matters: 避免计划模式在包含粘贴图片或文本时生成难看的占位符文件名，提升可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents ugly placeholder text from leaking into plan filenames when pasted images or text are used.

changes.raw: Fixed a phantom expand/click affordance on colored tool output: short ANSI-colored lines that fit on screen no longer show a "ctrl+o to expand" hint
changes.summary: 修复工具输出误显展开提示
changes.summary_en: Fix false expand hint on colored output
changes.why_matters: 避免短的彩色工具输出误显示展开提示，减少界面噪音和误导。
changes.why_matters_en: Stops short colored tool output from showing a misleading expand hint, reducing UI noise.

changes.raw: Fixed a single invalid `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` entry in managed settings discarding all managed-settings policy; the bad entry is now dropped with a `claude doctor` warning
changes.summary: 修复受管设置策略失效
changes.summary_en: Fix managed settings policy fallback
changes.why_matters: 防止单个错误的 MCP 服务器条目导致整套受管策略失效，提升安全与管理可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents one bad MCP server entry from disabling all managed policy, improving security and admin reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed API 400 errors on models that don't support the effort parameter when `CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT` is set
changes.summary: 修复不支持模型的API报错
changes.summary_en: Fix API 400s on unsupported effort models
changes.why_matters: 避免在不支持 effort 参数的模型上因环境变量强制开启而直接报 400 错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids 400 errors on models that do not support the effort parameter when it is forced on.

changes.raw: Windows: Fixed update failures caused by `claude.exe` being in use showing a generic error instead of telling you to close other sessions and retry
changes.summary: 优化Windows更新失败提示
changes.summary_en: Improve Windows update failure message
changes.why_matters: 让 Windows 用户在更新被占用阻塞时得到明确操作指引，而不是泛化错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives Windows users clear next steps when updates fail because claude.exe is in use.

changes.raw: Removed the stale "& for background" hint from the shortcuts help panel
changes.summary: 移除过时后台提示
changes.summary_en: Remove stale background shortcut hint
changes.why_matters: 清理过时帮助文案，让快捷键面板更简洁。
changes.why_matters_en: Cleans up outdated help text and makes the shortcuts panel less cluttered.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Auto mode no longer requires the bypass-permissions setting to appear in the mode picker, and a dismissable notice on the new-session screen explains auto mode the first time it's active
changes.summary: Auto模式提示更清晰
changes.summary_en: Clarify Auto mode availability and notice
changes.why_matters: 降低用户对 Auto 模式入口和首次启用提示的困惑，提升可发现性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes Auto mode easier to discover and understand with clearer entry and first-use messaging.

changes.raw: Fixed the task panel below the prompt showing a stray unselectable "main" row when only a workflow is running
changes.summary: 修复任务面板多余行
changes.summary_en: Fix stray task panel row
changes.why_matters: 避免任务面板在仅运行工作流时显示不可选的多余行，提升界面整洁度。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes an unselectable extra row in the task panel when only a workflow is running.

changes.raw: Fixed /mcp tools list and tool detail rendering when MCP servers have long or multi-line tool names or long descriptions
changes.summary: 修复MCP工具列表显示
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP tool list rendering
changes.why_matters: 让长名称或多行描述的 MCP 工具在列表和详情页中正确显示，便于使用集成。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures MCP tools with long names or descriptions render correctly in lists and details.

changes.raw: Fixed the /model picker not showing fast mode pricing on the Default option for API (pay-as-you-go) users when fast mode is on
changes.summary: 显示默认档位价格
changes.summary_en: Show fast-mode pricing on Default option
changes.why_matters: 帮助按量付费用户在选择模型时更准确地了解默认选项的 fast mode 成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps pay-as-you-go users see the correct fast-mode pricing on the Default model option.

changes.raw: Fixed auto mode incorrectly blocking actions with "could not evaluate this action" when the safety classifier ran out of output tokens while reasoning
changes.summary: 修复Auto模式误拦截
changes.summary_en: Fix false blocks in Auto mode
changes.why_matters: 避免安全分类器输出不足时误判动作不可执行，减少 Auto 模式的错误阻断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents Auto mode from falsely blocking actions when the safety classifier runs out of tokens.

signals.title: Please don't spam people looking for employment. It's just cruel
Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
Claude Code as a Daily Driver: Claude.md, Skills, Subagents, Plugins, and MCPs
Claude Code – Everything you can configure that the docs don't tell you
Dynamic Workflows in Claude Code

changes.raw: Added `skipLfs` option to `github`/`git` plugin marketplace sources to skip Git LFS downloads during clone and update
changes.summary: 插件支持跳过LFS下载
changes.summary_en: Add skipLfs to skip Git LFS downloads
changes.why_matters: 可减少克隆和更新时的额外下载流量，提升大仓库使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces unnecessary downloads during clone and update, improving large-repo workflows.

changes.raw: Claude Code now shows a one-time notice when your npm global install can't auto-update; `/doctor` lists the fixes
changes.summary: 提示npm全局更新受限
changes.summary_en: Warn when npm global auto-update fails
changes.why_matters: 让用户及时知道无法自动更新，并通过 /doctor 找到修复方法。
changes.why_matters_en: Users are informed when auto-update is unavailable and can use /doctor to find fixes.

changes.raw: Status line commands now receive `COLUMNS` and `LINES` environment variables so scripts can size output to the terminal width
changes.summary: 状态栏命令获终端尺寸
changes.summary_en: Pass terminal size to status line commands
changes.why_matters: 脚本可以根据终端宽高自适应输出，减少显示错乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Scripts can adapt output to terminal dimensions, reducing layout issues.

changes.raw: `claude agents`: autocomplete in the dispatch input now suggests native slash commands and bundled skills, not just project skills
changes.summary: agents补全含内置命令技能
changes.summary_en: Autocomplete native slash commands and skills
changes.why_matters: 让分发输入更容易找到可用能力，提升 agents 使用效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes it easier to discover available actions and speeds up agent dispatch.

changes.raw: `claude agents`: PR column now shows `PR #N` for a single PR or `N PRs` for multiple
changes.summary: PR列显示更清晰
changes.summary_en: Show clearer PR counts in agents
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快判断当前关联的是单个 PR 还是多个 PR。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly tell whether an item refers to one PR or many.

changes.raw: `claude doctor` now shows the result of your last update attempt
changes.summary: doctor显示上次更新结果
changes.summary_en: Show last update attempt in doctor
changes.why_matters: 便于排查更新失败原因，减少反复试错。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps diagnose update failures faster and reduces trial-and-error.

changes.raw: Combined the separate "needs authentication" startup notifications for MCP servers and connectors into a single message
changes.summary: 认证提示合并为一条
changes.summary_en: Combine auth startup notices into one
changes.why_matters: 减少启动时提示噪音，让需要认证的项更容易看懂。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces startup noise and makes required authentication clearer.

changes.raw: macOS: background agents now appear as "Claude Code" in Privacy & Security and keep their permission grants across upgrades
changes.summary: macOS后台代理保留权限
changes.summary_en: Keep macOS background agent permissions
changes.why_matters: 升级后无需重新授权，避免后台代理权限中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Permissions persist across upgrades, preventing background agent interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed stateful MCP servers without the optional GET SSE stream reconnect-looping on `tools/list` (regression in v2.1.147)
changes.summary: 修复MCP服务器重连死循环
changes.summary_en: Fix reconnect loop for stateful MCP servers
changes.why_matters: 避免工具列表请求卡死，恢复状态型 MCP 服务器可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents tools/list from looping indefinitely and restores MCP server usability.

changes.raw: Fixed a regression where a custom API gateway could receive the user's Anthropic OAuth credential instead of the gateway's own token
changes.summary: 修复网关OAuth凭证串用
changes.summary_en: Fix OAuth token leakage to custom gateway
changes.why_matters: 防止把用户的 Anthropic OAuth 凭证误发给自定义网关，避免严重安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents sending the user's Anthropic OAuth credential to the wrong gateway, avoiding a serious security risk.

changes.raw: Fixed subagent (Agent tool) frontmatter MCP servers ignoring `--strict-mcp-config`, `--bare`, remote mode, enterprise managed MCP config, and managed-settings MCP server allow/deny policies
changes.summary: 子代理MCP配置限制失效修复
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent MCP config policy enforcement
changes.why_matters: 确保严格配置、远程模式和管理策略真正生效，避免越权访问。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures strict config, remote mode, and managed policies are enforced to prevent unauthorized access.

changes.raw: `--strict-mcp-config` no longer strips inline `mcpServers` from explicitly-passed agent definitions (`--agents` / SDK `agents`), and blocked subagent MCP servers now surface a visible warning
changes.summary: 严格MCP配置保留内联定义
changes.summary_en: Keep inline MCP servers under strict config
changes.why_matters: 避免显式传入的代理定义被错误裁剪，并让被阻止的服务器有可见警告。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents explicitly passed agent definitions from being stripped and surfaces warnings for blocked servers.

changes.raw: Fixed the Windows PowerShell installer reporting "Installation complete!" when installation actually failed
changes.summary: 修复Windows安装误报成功
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows installer false success message
changes.why_matters: 避免安装失败却显示成功，减少用户误判和后续排障成本。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids false success reports on failed installs and reduces confusion during setup.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude update` installing the latest version instead of the configured release channel's version for npm installations
changes.summary: 修复npm更新通道版本错误
changes.summary_en: Fix npm update channel version selection
changes.why_matters: 确保更新到配置的发布通道版本，而不是错误地装到最新版本。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures npm installs follow the configured release channel instead of always taking latest.

changes.raw: Fixed excessive memory usage (multiple GB) when resuming a session by transcript file path on machines with many stored sessions
changes.summary: 修复恢复会话内存暴涨
changes.summary_en: Fix high memory use when resuming sessions
changes.why_matters: 在会话很多的机器上恢复历史记录时更稳定，避免占用数 GB 内存。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes session resume stable on machines with many sessions and avoids multi-GB memory spikes.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` and `claude --bg` running on a stale daemon started before binary-takeover support, even after upgrading
changes.summary: 修复旧守护进程兼容问题
changes.summary_en: Fix stale daemon compatibility after upgrade
changes.why_matters: 升级后仍能正常运行后台命令，避免用户被旧守护进程卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can keep using background commands after upgrading without being blocked by an old daemon.

changes.raw: Fixed a hang where the CLI could fail to exit when stdin was closed without EOF in stream-json mode, leaving a stale session marker behind
changes.summary: 修复关闭输入时卡死退出
changes.summary_en: Fix CLI hang on stdin close in stream-json
changes.why_matters: 避免 CLI 无法退出并残留会话标记，减少后台状态污染。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the CLI from hanging on exit and leaving stale session markers behind.

changes.raw: Fixed malformed `file://` links in Claude's responses not being clickable in the terminal
changes.summary: 修复 file 链接不可点击
changes.summary_en: Fix clickable file:// links in terminal
changes.why_matters: 让终端中的文件链接可直接打开，提升查看引用的效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes file links clickable in the terminal so users can open references faster.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --help` rendering unwrapped output on terminals narrower than 92 columns
changes.summary: 修复窄屏帮助文档换行
changes.summary_en: Wrap help output on narrow terminals
changes.why_matters: 在窄终端上也能正常阅读帮助信息，不会出现截断。
changes.why_matters_en: Help text remains readable on narrow terminals instead of rendering as a single unwrapped line.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tool progress notifications not rendering in the collapsed tool view
changes.summary: 修复折叠视图进度提示
changes.summary_en: Show MCP progress in collapsed tool view
changes.why_matters: 让用户在简洁视图里也能看到工具执行进度，减少误判卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see tool progress even in collapsed views, reducing confusion about whether work is stalled.

changes.raw: Fixed `Agent` tool with `subagent_type: 'claude'` running in an undocumented temporary worktree, which could silently discard outputs written to gitignored paths
changes.summary: 修复子代理临时工作区丢输出
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent temp worktree losing outputs
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理写入的结果被静默丢失，防止代码或文件修改不可恢复。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents subagent outputs from being silently discarded, avoiding lost or unrecoverable file changes.

changes.raw: `/bg` while Claude is responding now continues the response in the background session instead of dropping it
changes.summary: 后台继续当前回复
changes.summary_en: Continue response in background session
changes.why_matters: 用户切到后台后仍能让 Claude 把当前回答完成，提高连续工作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can move a response into the background and let Claude finish it without interrupting flow.

changes.raw: Fixed `/btw` keyboard shortcuts becoming unresponsive in background sessions while a task is running
changes.summary: 修复后台快捷键失灵
changes.summary_en: Fix /btw shortcuts in background sessions
changes.why_matters: 保证后台任务运行时仍可正常使用快捷键控制会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps keyboard shortcuts responsive in background sessions while tasks are running.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions writing temp files to `$CLAUDE_JOB_DIR` triggering a "sensitive file" permission prompt
changes.summary: 修复后台临时文件权限提示
changes.summary_en: Avoid sensitive-file prompt for temp files
changes.why_matters: 减少后台会话因临时文件触发误报权限提示，提升自动化顺畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces false sensitive-file permission prompts caused by background temp files.

changes.raw: Fixed recovering a background agent whose working directory was deleted showing a truncated stack trace instead of a clear error message
changes.summary: 修复删除目录后的清晰报错
changes.summary_en: Show clear error when workdir is deleted
changes.why_matters: 工作目录被删时能直接看到明确错误，而不是难读的截断堆栈。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get a clear error when the working directory is deleted instead of a truncated stack trace.

changes.raw: Fixed `EnterWorktree` not being available immediately in background sessions (previously required `ToolSearch` first)
changes.summary: 后台立即可用 EnterWorktree
changes.summary_en: Make EnterWorktree available immediately
changes.why_matters: 后台会话一开始就能切换工作区，减少额外步骤。
changes.why_matters_en: Background sessions can enter a worktree immediately without needing a prior search step.

changes.raw: Fixed `cmd+k` in iTerm2/Terminal.app not repainting attached background sessions
changes.summary: 修复附加后台会话重绘
changes.summary_en: Fix repainting attached background sessions
changes.why_matters: 在终端里附加后台会话时界面能及时刷新，避免显示过时内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Attached background sessions repaint correctly so the terminal view stays up to date.

changes.raw: Fixed the IME candidate window appearing at the bottom of the screen instead of next to the input caret in attached background sessions on Windows
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 输入法候选窗位置
changes.summary_en: Fix IME candidate window position on Windows
changes.why_matters: 中文等输入法在后台会话中能正确贴近光标显示，输入更自然。
changes.why_matters_en: IME candidate windows appear near the caret in attached background sessions, improving text entry.

changes.raw: Fixed background-color bleed when attaching to a background agent from 256-color-only terminals after the agent had rendered file diffs
changes.summary: 修复 256 色终端背景串色
changes.summary_en: Fix background color bleed in 256-color terminals
changes.why_matters: 改善低色彩终端的显示效果，避免附件后台会话界面脏乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents color bleed in 256-color terminals so attached sessions render cleanly.

changes.raw: Fixed `/copy` and copy-on-select silently failing to update the system clipboard when attached to a background session inside tmux
changes.summary: 修复 tmux 中复制失败
changes.summary_en: Fix clipboard copy in tmux attached sessions
changes.why_matters: 在 tmux 里也能正常复制内容到系统剪贴板，方便带走结果。
changes.why_matters_en: Copying now updates the system clipboard correctly even when attached through tmux.

changes.raw: Fixed opening `claude agents` with Remote Control enabled leaving zombie session entries on the Code tab after exiting
changes.summary: 修复远控代理退出残留会话
changes.summary_en: Fix zombie sessions after remote-control agents exit
changes.why_matters: 避免 Code 标签页残留无效会话，减少界面混乱和资源占用。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stale sessions from cluttering the Code tab and wasting resources.

changes.raw: Fixed `/rename` in background sessions not updating the session banner immediately
changes.summary: 修复后台重命名不即时刷新
changes.summary_en: Fix background rename not updating banner
changes.why_matters: 让会话名称变更能立即反映，减少用户对状态是否生效的疑惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes session renames appear immediately so users can trust the current state.

changes.raw: Fixed Windows update rollback: if a Windows update fails, Claude Code now restores the original executable by copy and tells you how to recover
changes.summary: Windows更新失败可自动回滚恢复
changes.summary_en: Restore original executable after failed Windows update
changes.why_matters: 在更新失败时自动恢复可执行文件，降低工具损坏导致无法使用的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Automatically restoring the executable reduces the risk of the tool becoming unusable after a failed update.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed Claude Code processes not shutting down cleanly when VS Code closed on Windows, causing false "unclean exit" reports and orphaned MCP servers
changes.summary: 修复VS Code关闭时进程未清理
changes.summary_en: Fix clean shutdown on VS Code close on Windows
changes.why_matters: 避免误报异常退出并清理遗留 MCP 服务，提升稳定性和诊断准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents false unclean-exit reports and cleans up orphaned MCP servers for better stability.

changes.raw: `/model` now saves your selection as the default for new sessions (matching the IDE). Press `s` in the picker to switch models for the current session only.
changes.summary: 模型选择默认保存到新会话
changes.summary_en: Save /model choice as default for new sessions
changes.why_matters: 减少每次新建会话重复选择模型的成本，提升使用连贯性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces repeated model selection and makes the experience more consistent across sessions.

changes.raw: If you customized the `modelPicker:setAsDefault` keybinding, rename it to `modelPicker:thisSessionOnly` in keybindings.json (the `d` action was replaced by `s`)
changes.summary: 模型选择快捷键配置需改名
changes.summary_en: Rename model picker keybinding action
changes.why_matters: 现有自定义快捷键需要更新，否则相关按键可能失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Existing custom keybindings must be updated or the shortcut may stop working.

signals.title: Please don't spam people looking for employment. It's just cruel
Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
Claude Code as a Daily Driver: Claude.md, Skills, Subagents, Plugins, and MCPs
Claude Code – Everything you can configure that the docs don't tell you
Dynamic Workflows in Claude Code

changes.raw: `/code-review --fix` now applies review findings to your working tree after the review, surfacing reuse, simplification, and efficiency suggestions; `/simplify` now invokes `/code-review --fix`
changes.summary: 代码审查可直接应用修复
changes.summary_en: Code review can apply fixes directly
changes.why_matters: 用户可以在审查后直接把改进建议落到工作区，减少手动修改成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can apply review suggestions directly to the working tree, reducing manual follow-up work.

changes.raw: Skills and slash commands can now set `disallowed-tools` in frontmatter to remove tools from the model while the skill is active
changes.summary: 技能可禁用指定工具
changes.summary_en: Skills can disable specific tools
changes.why_matters: 技能和命令能临时收紧可用工具范围，提升安全性和任务专注度。
changes.why_matters_en: Skills and commands can temporarily narrow available tools, improving safety and focus.

changes.raw: Added `/reload-skills` command to re-scan skill directories without restarting the session
changes.summary: 可热重载技能目录
changes.summary_en: Reload skills without restarting
changes.why_matters: 用户无需重启会话就能加载新技能，提升迭代效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can pick up new skills without restarting the session, speeding iteration.

changes.raw: `SessionStart` hooks can now return `reloadSkills: true` to re-scan skill directories, making skills installed by the hook available in the same session
changes.summary: 启动钩子可重载技能
changes.summary_en: Session hooks can reload skills
changes.why_matters: 钩子安装的技能可在同一会话内立即生效，减少等待和重启。
changes.why_matters_en: Skills installed by hooks can become available in the same session, avoiding restarts.

changes.raw: `SessionStart` hooks can now set the session title via `hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle` on startup and resume
changes.summary: 启动时可设置会话标题
changes.summary_en: Hooks can set session title on start
changes.why_matters: 会话标题更易自动化管理和识别，方便回顾与切换。
changes.why_matters_en: Session titles become easier to automate and identify for review and switching.

changes.raw: Added a `MessageDisplay` hook event that lets hooks transform or hide assistant message text as it is displayed
changes.summary: 消息显示可由钩子改写
changes.summary_en: Hooks can transform displayed messages
changes.why_matters: 钩子可隐藏或改写助手消息展示，便于定制输出和控制信息暴露。
changes.why_matters_en: Hooks can hide or rewrite assistant output as displayed, enabling custom presentation and control.

changes.raw: Added `pluginSuggestionMarketplaces` managed setting: admins can allowlist org marketplaces whose plugins may be suggested via context-aware tips
changes.summary: 可限制插件推荐市场
changes.summary_en: Admins can allowlist plugin marketplaces
changes.why_matters: 管理员能控制哪些市场可被推荐，降低不受信插件带来的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Admins can control which marketplaces are suggested, reducing risk from untrusted plugins.

changes.raw: `claude plugin marketplace remove` now accepts `--scope user|project|local` for symmetry with `marketplace add`, `install`, and `uninstall`
changes.summary: 插件市场移除支持范围参数
changes.summary_en: Marketplace remove now supports scope
changes.why_matters: 命令参数与其他插件操作保持一致，提升可用性和一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: The command now matches other plugin operations, improving consistency and usability.

changes.raw: Claude Code now switches to your configured `--fallback-model` for the rest of the session when the primary model is not found, instead of failing every request
changes.summary: 主模型缺失时自动切换备用模型
changes.summary_en: Fallback model used when primary is missing
changes.why_matters: 主模型不可用时会话不再反复失败，能继续完成任务。
changes.why_matters_en: When the primary model is unavailable, the session keeps working instead of failing repeatedly.

changes.raw: Auto mode no longer requires opt-in consent
changes.summary: 自动模式不再需要同意
changes.summary_en: Auto mode no longer needs opt-in consent
changes.why_matters: 默认行为和权限边界发生变化，可能影响既有安全预期与工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: This changes default behavior and consent expectations, which can affect existing safety assumptions and workflows.

changes.raw: Vim mode: `/` in NORMAL mode now opens reverse history search (like Ctrl+R), matching bash/zsh vi-mode
changes.summary: Vim 正常模式支持反向历史搜寻
changes.summary_en: Vim normal mode gets reverse history search
changes.why_matters: Vim 用户可以更快回找历史命令，提升键盘操作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Vim users can search command history faster, improving keyboard-driven efficiency.

changes.raw: The `/usage` breakdown now includes large session files; files are scanned with a streaming read so memory usage stays flat
changes.summary: usage 统计支持大会话文件
changes.summary_en: Usage breakdown now includes large files
changes.why_matters: 大会话文件也能被统计且内存更稳定，提升可观测性与可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Large session files are now included with flat memory usage, improving observability and reliability.

changes.raw: Thinking summaries in the collapsed group now stay readable for at least 3 seconds, render as markdown, and cap at 10 lines (`Ctrl+O` shows the full thinking)
changes.summary: 思考摘要更易读更完整
changes.summary_en: Thinking summaries are more readable
changes.why_matters: 折叠思考内容更清晰且保留更久，便于快速理解模型推理。
changes.why_matters_en: Collapsed thinking content is clearer and stays visible longer, making model reasoning easier to follow.

changes.raw: In fullscreen mode, the "Thinking for Ns" indicator now counts up live while the model is thinking, and keeps its value if you interrupt mid-thought
changes.summary: 全屏模式思考计时实时更新
changes.summary_en: Fullscreen thinking timer updates live
changes.why_matters: 用户能更准确感知模型思考时长，且中断后状态更一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get a more accurate sense of thinking time, with more consistent state after interruption.

changes.raw: Simplified the Workflow tool's inline progress display — live agent counts now show only in the persistent workflow status row below the prompt
changes.summary: 工作流进度显示更简洁
changes.summary_en: Workflow progress display is simplified
changes.why_matters: 减少提示区噪音，把关键进度集中到固定状态行，提升可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces prompt-area noise and keeps key progress in a stable status row, improving readability.

changes.raw: The post-response timer now shows "Waiting for N background agents/workflows to finish" when backgrounded agents or workflows are still running, and reports the cumulative time once their results are processed
changes.summary: 后台任务完成时显示等待状态
changes.summary_en: Show waiting status for background tasks
changes.why_matters: 让用户更清楚地知道后台代理或工作流仍在运行，并能看到累计耗时，减少对结果状态的误判。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes it clear that background agents or workflows are still running and shows cumulative time, reducing confusion about result status.

changes.raw: Added the session entrypoint as an OpenTelemetry metric attribute (`app.entrypoint`, opt-in via `OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ENTRYPOINT=true`)
changes.summary: OTel 指标加入入口点属性
changes.summary_en: Add entrypoint attribute to OTel metrics
changes.why_matters: 便于在可观测性系统中按会话入口点分析指标，提升排查和统计能力。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves observability by letting teams analyze metrics by session entrypoint for better debugging and reporting.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal styling degrading in very long sessions by recycling the renderer's style pool
changes.summary: 长会话终端样式不再退化
changes.summary_en: Prevent style degradation in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 修复长时间使用后终端样式异常的问题，保证输出可读性和界面一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: It fixes style corruption in long-running sessions, preserving readability and UI consistency.

changes.raw: Fixed the sandbox-enabled warning not appearing in condensed startup mode — it now shows in every layout
changes.summary: 压缩启动也显示沙箱警告
changes.summary_en: Show sandbox warning in condensed startup
changes.why_matters: 确保无论界面布局如何，用户都能看到关键的沙箱提示，避免误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures the sandbox warning is visible in every layout, helping users avoid unsafe assumptions.

changes.raw: Fixed the loading spinner showing "still thinking"/"almost done thinking" while a tool is running, and reset the thinking status to "thinking" after each tool
changes.summary: 工具运行时不再误显示思考状态
changes.summary_en: Stop thinking status from showing during tools
changes.why_matters: 修复状态提示混乱，让用户更准确地理解模型是在思考还是在执行工具。
changes.why_matters_en: It fixes misleading status text so users can tell when the model is thinking versus running a tool.

changes.raw: Fixed focus mode showing a spurious "N messages hidden" count on turns with no hidden activity
changes.summary: 焦点模式隐藏计数更准确
changes.summary_en: Fix hidden message count in focus mode
changes.why_matters: 避免在没有隐藏内容时显示错误计数，减少界面噪音。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes a false hidden-message count when nothing is hidden, reducing UI noise.

changes.raw: Fixed clicking a link inside an expanded tool result collapsing the section instead of opening the link
changes.summary: 展开工具结果内链接可正常打开
changes.summary_en: Links open correctly inside expanded tool results
changes.why_matters: 修复点击链接导致内容折叠的问题，提升查看工具输出时的交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It fixes a click interaction bug so links inside tool results open normally without collapsing the section.

changes.raw: Fixed markdown table cell borders inheriting the color of inline code, wrapped continuation lines losing their style, and empty header cells showing a label in the narrow-terminal stacked layout
changes.summary: 修复表格与窄屏 Markdown 样式
changes.summary_en: Fix markdown table styling in narrow layouts
changes.why_matters: 让 Markdown 表格在各种终端宽度下保持正确显示，避免内容错位或样式串色。
changes.why_matters_en: It keeps markdown tables rendering correctly across terminal widths, avoiding misaligned or color-broken output.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin MCP servers with the same command but different environment variables being incorrectly deduplicated
changes.summary: 同命令不同环境的 MCP 不再误合并
changes.summary_en: Avoid deduping MCP servers with different envs
changes.why_matters: 确保配置不同的插件 MCP 服务能被正确区分，避免连接到错误的服务实例。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures MCP servers with different environments are treated as distinct, preventing incorrect service reuse.

changes.raw: Fixed `/doctor` reporting "marketplace not found" or "plugin not found" for stale `enabledPlugins` entries referencing removed marketplaces or dropped plugins
changes.summary: /doctor 不再误报缺失插件
changes.summary_en: Fix false missing-plugin reports in /doctor
changes.why_matters: 减少因过期配置导致的误报，让诊断结果更可信、更易排查。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces false alarms from stale plugin entries, making diagnostics more trustworthy and actionable.

changes.raw: Fixed plugins that track a git branch silently no longer receiving updates after the plugin registry was rebuilt
changes.summary: 重建注册表后插件更新不中断
changes.summary_en: Keep branch-tracking plugins updating
changes.why_matters: 修复插件在注册表重建后静默停止更新的问题，保证用户持续获得最新版本。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents branch-tracking plugins from silently stopping updates after registry rebuilds, keeping them current.

changes.raw: Fixed remote MCP servers failing to connect in Claude Code Remote sessions when the egress proxy is enabled
changes.summary: 远程会话代理环境下可连 MCP
changes.summary_en: Allow remote MCP connections with egress proxy
changes.why_matters: 修复远程会话无法连接外部 MCP 服务的问题，恢复核心集成能力。
changes.why_matters_en: It restores remote session connectivity to MCP servers when an egress proxy is enabled, preserving core integrations.

changes.raw: Fixed the effort-change confirmation dialog appearing when the conversation has no messages or when switching between effort levels that resolve to the same underlying value
changes.summary: 努力级别切换不再误弹确认框
changes.summary_en: Avoid spurious effort-change confirmations
changes.why_matters: 减少无意义的确认弹窗，提升空会话或等价切换时的操作流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes unnecessary confirmation dialogs, making effort-level changes smoother and less distracting.

changes.raw: Fixed the Agent tool description referencing an agent list that is never delivered when running with `--bare` or with attachments disabled
changes.summary: 裸模式下 Agent 描述不再误导
changes.summary_en: Fix Agent tool description in bare mode
changes.why_matters: 避免在不提供代理列表时引用不存在的信息，减少用户困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: It avoids referencing an agent list that is not available, preventing misleading tool descriptions.

changes.raw: Fixed a background worker crash in `claude agents` when accepting a stale permission prompt after a subagent was cancelled
changes.summary: 子代理取消后不再崩溃
changes.summary_en: Prevent crash after cancelled subagent
changes.why_matters: 修复权限提示过期后接受导致的崩溃，提升代理工作流的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It fixes a crash caused by accepting a stale permission prompt after subagent cancellation, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed `cache_creation_input_tokens` reporting as 0 in transcript and result usage when the API reports cache writes only via the nested `cache_creation` breakdown
changes.summary: 修正缓存写入令牌统计
changes.summary_en: Fix cache write token reporting
changes.why_matters: 避免转录和结果中的用量统计显示为 0，提升计费与使用情况的准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents usage metrics from showing 0 and keeps billing and consumption reporting accurate.

changes.raw: Fixed the PushNotification tool incorrectly reporting "Mobile push not sent (Remote Control inactive)" in SDK-hosted sessions when Remote Control is enabled
changes.summary: 修正推送通知误报失败
changes.summary_en: Fix false push notification failure
changes.why_matters: 避免在远程控制已启用时误提示未发送，减少 SDK 托管会话中的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids false failure messages when Remote Control is enabled, reducing confusion in SDK-hosted sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed sessions getting stuck after a model or login switch left stale thinking-block signatures in history; now stripped proactively with a retry safety-net
changes.summary: 修复切换后会话卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix session hangs after switching
changes.why_matters: 防止模型或登录切换后会话因历史残留而卡住，提升稳定性和可恢复性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents sessions from hanging after model or login switches due to stale history, improving stability and recovery.

changes.summary_en: Internal infrastructure improvements

signals.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
Claude Code as a Daily Driver: Claude.md, Skills, Subagents, Plugins, and MCPs

Claude Code – Everything you can configure that the docs don't tell you

changes.raw: `/usage` now shows a per-category breakdown of what's driving your limits usage — skills, subagents, plugins, and per-MCP-server cost
changes.summary: 按类别显示用量来源
changes.summary_en: Show usage by cost category
changes.why_matters: 用户能更清楚地看到额度消耗来自哪里，便于优化使用方式。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see what is driving limit usage and optimize their workflow.

changes.raw: `/diff` detail view can now be scrolled with the keyboard (arrows, `j`/`k`, `PgUp`/`PgDn`, `Space`, `Home`/`End`)
changes.summary: 键盘可滚动差异详情
changes.summary_en: Keyboard scroll for diff details
changes.why_matters: 无需鼠标即可浏览更长的 diff 详情，提升终端可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can navigate long diff details without a mouse, improving terminal usability.

changes.raw: Markdown output now renders GFM task list checkboxes (`- [ ] todo` / `- [x] done`) instead of plain bullets
changes.summary: 任务列表复选框正确渲染
changes.summary_en: Render GFM task checkboxes
changes.why_matters: Markdown 输出更符合预期，任务状态展示更清晰。
changes.why_matters_en: Markdown output now matches expectations and shows task status more clearly.

changes.raw: Enterprise: added the `allowAllClaudeAiMcps` managed setting to load claude.ai cloud MCP connectors alongside `managed-mcp.json`
changes.summary: 支持加载云端 MCP 连接器
changes.summary_en: Load cloud MCP connectors
changes.why_matters: 企业可在受管配置下接入更多 Claude.ai MCP 能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Enterprises can enable additional Claude.ai MCP capabilities under managed settings.

changes.raw: Fixed a PowerShell permission bypass: built-in `cd` functions (`cd..`, `cd\`, `cd~`, `X:`) changed the working directory undetected, letting a later command read outside the workspace
changes.summary: 修复 PowerShell 目录逃逸绕过
changes.summary_en: Fix PowerShell cd permission bypass
changes.why_matters: 这会阻止命令通过内建切目录绕过工作区限制读取敏感文件。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents commands from bypassing workspace restrictions via built-in directory changes.

changes.raw: Fixed the sandbox write allowlist in git worktrees covering the entire main repository root instead of only the shared `.git` directory (with `hooks/` and `config` denied)
changes.summary: 修复 worktree 写入范围过宽
changes.summary_en: Fix overly broad worktree write scope
changes.why_matters: 避免沙箱把整个仓库都当作可写区域，降低越权修改风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids treating the whole repo as writable and reduces unauthorized modification risk.

changes.raw: Fixed PowerShell prefix/wildcard allow rules (e.g. `PowerShell(dotnet.exe build *)`) not pre-approving native executables and scripts
changes.summary: 修复 PowerShell 通配规则预批失效
changes.summary_en: Fix PowerShell wildcard approval rules
changes.why_matters: 通配允许规则现在能正确覆盖原生程序和脚本，减少误拦截与绕过。
changes.why_matters_en: Wildcard allow rules now correctly cover native executables and scripts, reducing false blocks and bypasses.

changes.raw: Fixed a permission-analysis gap where the parser trusted stale variable-tracking values for `PWD`/`OLDPWD`/`DIRSTACK` across `cd`/`pushd`/`popd`
changes.summary: 修复目录变量状态分析错误
changes.summary_en: Fix stale directory variable analysis
changes.why_matters: 权限分析不再依赖过期的目录变量状态，减少错误放行。
changes.why_matters_en: Permission analysis no longer relies on stale directory variable state, reducing incorrect approvals.

changes.raw: Fixed `find` in the Bash tool exhausting the macOS system file/vnode table and crashing the host on large directory trees
changes.summary: 修复 Bash find 资源耗尽崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash find resource exhaustion crash
changes.why_matters: 在大型目录树上运行更安全，避免宿主机因资源耗尽而崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Large directory traversals are safer and less likely to crash the host from resource exhaustion.

changes.raw: Fixed the managed-settings approval dialog leaving the terminal frozen after accepting at startup
changes.summary: 修复启动审批后终端卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix frozen terminal after startup approval
changes.why_matters: 用户接受受管设置后不会再卡住，启动流程更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Users no longer get stuck after accepting managed settings, making startup smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed `/ultraplan` and remote session creation failing with "Could not capture uncommitted changes" when the working tree has no real changes
changes.summary: 修复无改动时超计划失败
changes.summary_en: Fix ultraplan on clean worktree
changes.why_matters: 即使工作区没有实际改动，也能正常创建远程会话和计划。
changes.why_matters_en: Remote sessions and planning now work even when the worktree has no real changes.

changes.raw: Fixed `otelHeadersHelper` failing silently when the script path contains spaces; helper failures are now reported in `/doctor` and the debug log
changes.summary: 修复带空格路径的诊断失败
changes.summary_en: Fix otel helper failures with spaces
changes.why_matters: 脚本路径含空格时也能正确上报问题，便于排障。
changes.why_matters_en: Helper failures are now surfaced properly even when script paths contain spaces, improving troubleshooting.

changes.raw: Fixed the thinking spinner staying amber across tool calls and onto fresh thinking bursts
changes.summary: 修复思考状态指示颜色异常
changes.summary_en: Fix thinking spinner color state
changes.why_matters: 状态提示更准确，减少对当前推理阶段的误解。
changes.why_matters_en: Status indicators are more accurate, reducing confusion about the current thinking phase.

changes.raw: Fixed collapsed Bash output reporting the wrong hidden-line count for outputs with many short lines
changes.summary: 修复折叠输出隐藏行数错误
changes.summary_en: Fix hidden line count in collapsed output
changes.why_matters: 折叠日志的行数显示更准确，便于查看输出规模。
changes.why_matters_en: Collapsed output now reports the correct hidden line count, making logs easier to read.

changes.raw: Fixed slash-command argument-hint clipping trailing typed characters when the hint overflows the input box
changes.summary: 修复命令提示遮挡输入尾部
changes.summary_en: Fix hint clipping typed characters
changes.why_matters: 输入长参数时不会被提示框截断，减少误输入。
changes.why_matters_en: Typed slash-command arguments are no longer clipped by overflow hints, reducing input errors.

changes.raw: Fixed argument-hint and progressive arg suggestions not appearing after Tab-completing a skill whose frontmatter `name:` differs from its directory basename
changes.summary: 修复技能补全后提示缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix arg hints after skill completion
changes.why_matters: 用户在补全技能后能继续看到参数提示，减少误用和来回试错。
changes.why_matters_en: Users keep getting argument hints after skill completion, reducing mistakes and back-and-forth trial.

changes.raw: Fixed the status bar showing the user's baseline `/effort` setting instead of the effort level applied by skill/agent `effort:` frontmatter
changes.summary: 状态栏显示实际努力等级
changes.summary_en: Show applied effort level in status bar
changes.why_matters: 状态栏现在反映技能或代理实际生效的 effort，避免用户误判当前行为强度。
changes.why_matters_en: The status bar now reflects the effort level actually applied by a skill or agent, avoiding confusion about current behavior intensity.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+O transcript view freezing at the moment it was opened instead of tailing new messages
changes.summary: 修复 Ctrl+O 记录视图卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix Ctrl+O transcript view freezing
changes.why_matters: 打开记录视图后可继续实时尾随新消息，保证查看过程不中断。
changes.why_matters_en: The transcript view now keeps tailing new messages after opening, so review stays live.

changes.raw: Fixed editing a recalled prompt-history entry losing the edit when navigating further up/down with arrow keys
changes.summary: 修复历史提示编辑丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix edited prompt history being lost
changes.why_matters: 用户编辑过的历史提示在上下浏览时能保留，提升重用历史输入的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Edited prompt history now persists while navigating, making reuse of past prompts reliable.

changes.raw: Fixed `/config` exit summary reporting phantom changes to auto-compact and theme when toggling unrelated settings
changes.summary: 修复配置退出摘要误报
changes.summary_en: Fix /config exit summary false changes
changes.why_matters: 退出摘要不再显示无关的虚假变更，减少配置检查时的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: The exit summary no longer shows unrelated phantom changes, reducing confusion during config review.

changes.raw: Fixed `/insights` crashing when cached session-meta files are missing optional fields
changes.summary: 修复 /insights 缓存缺字段崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix /insights crash on missing fields
changes.why_matters: 即使缓存会话元数据不完整，/insights 也能正常打开，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: /insights now works even when cached session metadata is incomplete, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed malformed PowerShell and History tool calls with missing input being misclassified as reads in transcript collapsing
changes.summary: 修复工具调用折叠误判
changes.summary_en: Fix malformed tool calls misclassified
changes.why_matters: 转录折叠时对缺失输入的工具调用判断更准确，避免日志展示错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Transcript collapsing now classifies malformed tool calls more accurately, avoiding incorrect log display.

changes.raw: Fixed renaming a Remote Control session from claude.ai or the Claude mobile app not updating the local session name for `claude --resume`
changes.summary: 远程会话重命名同步本地
changes.summary_en: Sync remote session rename locally
changes.why_matters: 从网页或手机改名后，本地 `claude --resume` 能看到一致的会话名。
changes.why_matters_en: After renaming from web or mobile, local `claude --resume` sees the same session name.

changes.raw: Fixed a race where a just-submitted prompt could appear twice in the up-arrow history
changes.summary: 修复刚发送提示重复入历史
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate prompt in history
changes.why_matters: 上箭头历史里不会再出现重复的刚发送提示，减少导航干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: The up-arrow history no longer shows a duplicate of the just-submitted prompt, reducing navigation noise.

changes.raw: Fixed tapping the "Jump to bottom" pill in fullscreen mode not dismissing it immediately
changes.summary: 全屏底部提示可立即关闭
changes.summary_en: Dismiss jump-to-bottom pill immediately
changes.why_matters: 用户点“跳到底部”后提示会立刻消失，界面反馈更顺手。
changes.why_matters_en: Tapping “Jump to bottom” now dismisses the pill immediately, making the UI feel more responsive.

changes.raw: Improved `/feedback` reports to include the conversation that happened before context compaction, making issues from earlier in long sessions easier to triage
changes.summary: 反馈包含压缩前对话
changes.summary_en: Include pre-compaction conversation in feedback
changes.why_matters: 反馈能带上上下文压缩前的对话，便于排查长会话早期出现的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Feedback now includes the conversation before context compaction, making early issues in long sessions easier to triage.

signals.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
Claude Code as a Daily Driver: Claude.md, Skills, Subagents, Plugins, and MCPs
Show HN: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
Claude Code – Everything you can configure that the docs don't tell you

changes.raw: Fixed the Bash tool returning exit code 127 on every command for some users (a regression introduced in 2.1.147)
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 工具退出码异常
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash tool exit code regression
changes.why_matters: 修复后部分用户的 Bash 命令可正常执行，避免所有命令都失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores normal Bash command execution for affected users and prevents every command from failing.

signals.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
Claude Code as a Daily Driver: Claude.md, Skills, Subagents, Plugins, and MCPs
Show HN: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
Claude Code – Everything you can configure that the docs don't tell you

changes.raw: Pinned background sessions (`Ctrl+T` in `claude agents`) now stay alive when idle, are restarted in place to apply Claude Code updates, and are shed under memory pressure only after non-pinned sessions
changes.summary: 后台会话常驻并原地更新
changes.summary_en: Pinned sessions stay alive and update in place
changes.why_matters: 这让常用后台会话在空闲时不被回收，并能无缝应用更新，减少中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps pinned background sessions alive and updates them in place, reducing interruptions.

changes.raw: Renamed `/simplify` to `/code-review`. It now reports correctness bugs at a chosen effort level (e.g., `/code-review high`); pass `--comment` to post findings as inline GitHub PR comments. The old cleanup-and-fix behavior has been removed
changes.summary: 重命名代码审查命令
changes.summary_en: Renamed to /code-review with new behavior
changes.why_matters: 旧的 `/simplify` 行为已移除，用户需要改用新命令和新参数来完成代码审查。
changes.why_matters_en: The old `/simplify` behavior was removed, so users must switch to the new command and options.

changes.raw: Improved auto-updater: retries transient network failures, reports specific error categories and OS error codes on failure, and shows the current version when an update fails
changes.summary: 更新失败更清晰更稳
changes.summary_en: More reliable updater with clearer failures
changes.why_matters: 自动更新在网络波动时更不容易失败，而且报错信息更具体，便于排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Auto-updates are more resilient to transient network issues and failures are easier to diagnose.

changes.raw: Improved diff rendering performance for large file edits
changes.summary: 大文件 diff 渲染更快
changes.summary_en: Faster diff rendering for large edits
changes.why_matters: 在处理大文件改动时界面响应更快，减少等待时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Large file edits render faster, improving responsiveness and reducing wait time.

changes.raw: Prompt history no longer records consecutive duplicate entries — recalling a prompt with arrow-up and submitting it again won't add another copy
changes.summary: 历史记录不再重复堆积
changes.summary_en: Prompt history skips consecutive duplicates
changes.why_matters: 避免上下箭头重复提交同一提示时把历史记录刷满，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents repeated prompt recalls from cluttering history, making navigation cleaner.

changes.raw: Fixed enterprise login restrictions (`forceLoginOrgUUID` and `forceLoginMethod` managed-settings) not being enforced against third-party-provider and API-key sessions
changes.summary: 企业登录限制生效
changes.summary_en: Enterprise login restrictions now enforced
changes.why_matters: 修复后可确保企业管理策略真正限制第三方登录和 API key 会话，避免绕过管控。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures enterprise policies actually restrict third-party and API-key sessions, preventing policy bypass.

changes.raw: Fixed `&` in `!` command output displaying as `&`, which broke copy-pasting URLs from commands like `gcloud auth login` on headless machines
changes.summary: 命令输出不再转义乱码
changes.summary_en: Command output no longer HTML-escapes ampersands
changes.why_matters: 修复后可正确复制命令输出中的 URL 和文本，避免 `&` 破坏内容。
changes.why_matters_en: This preserves command output text and URLs correctly, avoiding broken copy-paste from escaped entities.

changes.raw: Fixed unknown slash commands silently doing nothing in headless/SDK mode — they now show an error message
changes.summary: 未知命令会明确报错
changes.summary_en: Unknown slash commands now show errors
changes.why_matters: 在无头或 SDK 场景下，用户能立即知道命令无效，而不是静默失败。
changes.why_matters_en: In headless or SDK mode, users now get an explicit error instead of a silent no-op.

changes.raw: Fixed `/help` rendering a broken tab header and showing only one command per page on small terminals when not in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 小终端帮助页显示正常
changes.summary_en: Help UI renders correctly on small terminals
changes.why_matters: 修复后在小屏终端里帮助信息更完整，减少界面错乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Help pages now render properly on small terminals, reducing layout issues.

changes.raw: Fixed shell snapshot dropping user functions whose names start with a single underscore, which broke aliases referencing them
changes.summary: 保留以下划线开头函数
changes.summary_en: Shell snapshot keeps underscore-prefixed functions
changes.why_matters: 这避免了别名和脚本依赖的 shell 函数在快照中丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents shell functions used by aliases and scripts from being dropped in snapshots.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin agents that declare multiple `Agent(...)` types in `tools:` frontmatter dropping all but the last entry
changes.summary: 插件可保留多个 Agent
changes.summary_en: Plugin agents keep multiple Agent entries
changes.why_matters: 插件作者可以同时声明多个代理类型，不会再被错误截断。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin authors can declare multiple agent types without losing all but the last one.

changes.raw: Fixed hook `if` conditions like `PowerShell(git push*)` never matching — only `PowerShell(*)` worked
changes.summary: Hook 条件匹配更准确
changes.summary_en: Hook conditions now match correctly
changes.why_matters: 修复后更复杂的 hook 规则可以按预期触发，提升自动化可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: More specific hook rules now trigger as expected, improving automation reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed PowerShell tool dropping output for commands that rely on the default formatter
changes.summary: PowerShell 输出不再丢失
changes.summary_en: PowerShell tool preserves default output
changes.why_matters: 某些依赖默认格式化器的命令现在能正常显示输出，减少信息缺失。
changes.why_matters_en: Commands that rely on the default formatter now show output correctly, avoiding missing information.

changes.raw: Fixed: on Windows, "Yes, and don't ask again" for a PowerShell script invocation now writes a rule that actually matches on subsequent runs
changes.summary: Windows 免询问规则可生效
changes.summary_en: Windows 'don't ask again' rule now matches
changes.why_matters: 用户选择不再询问后，后续同类 PowerShell 脚本会真正按规则执行。
changes.why_matters_en: After choosing not to ask again, subsequent matching PowerShell scripts now follow the rule correctly.

changes.raw: Fixed PowerShell tool failing on Windows with exit code 1 when `pwsh` is installed via winget or the Microsoft Store
changes.summary: Windows PowerShell 安装兼容
changes.summary_en: Windows PowerShell works with Store/winget installs
changes.why_matters: 修复后通过 winget 或商店安装的 pwsh 也能正常运行，减少 Windows 用户故障。
changes.why_matters_en: pwsh installed via winget or the Microsoft Store now works properly, reducing Windows failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `/effort` opening with the slider on the wrong level — it now starts at your current effort
changes.summary: 修正 /effort 默认档位错误
changes.summary_en: Fix /effort opening at current level
changes.why_matters: 用户打开 /effort 时会直接看到正确的努力档位，减少误操作和重复调整。
changes.why_matters_en: Users now see the correct effort level immediately, reducing confusion and extra clicks.

changes.raw: Fixed paginating MCP servers dropping resources, templates, and prompts past page 1
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 分页资源丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP pagination dropping items
changes.why_matters: 浏览多个 MCP 服务器时不会再漏掉资源、模板和提示词，保证信息完整。
changes.why_matters_en: Users no longer miss resources, templates, or prompts when paging through MCP servers.

changes.raw: Fixed full-screen strobing in attached background sessions on Windows Terminal while Claude is streaming
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 全屏闪烁
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows full-screen strobing
changes.why_matters: 在 Windows Terminal 中流式输出更稳定，减少视觉干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Streaming in Windows Terminal is now visually stable and less distracting.

changes.raw: Fixed: on Windows, removing a background-job worktree no longer follows NTFS junctions into the main repo
changes.summary: 修复删除 worktree 误跟随链接
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree removal following junctions
changes.why_matters: 删除后台任务工作区时不会误删主仓库内容，降低数据破坏风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Removing a background worktree no longer risks traversing into the main repo and causing damage.

changes.raw: Fixed `/background` refusing sessions whose only typed input was a skill or custom slash command
changes.summary: 修复 /background 误拒绝会话
changes.summary_en: Fix /background rejecting valid sessions
changes.why_matters: 包含技能或自定义命令的输入也能正常进入后台会话，流程更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Sessions started from skills or custom slash commands now work correctly in the background.

changes.raw: Fixed auto mode suppressing `AskUserQuestion` when the user or a skill explicitly relies on it; the auto-mode classifier now sees the user's answers as intent signal
changes.summary: 修复自动模式误屏蔽提问
changes.summary_en: Fix auto mode suppressing user questions
changes.why_matters: 自动模式能正确保留需要用户确认的交互，避免错误自动化决策。
changes.why_matters_en: Auto mode now preserves necessary user prompts, preventing incorrect autonomous decisions.

changes.raw: Fixed `/theme` "New custom theme" and color editor dialogs not responding to Esc
changes.summary: 修复主题对话框 Esc 无响应
changes.summary_en: Fix theme dialogs not closing on Esc
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更方便地退出主题编辑对话框，提升操作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now dismiss theme dialogs with Esc, making the UI easier to use.

changes.raw: Fixed an uncaught exception at the end of streaming sessions when running via the Agent SDK
changes.summary: 修复 Agent SDK 流结束异常
changes.summary_en: Fix end-of-stream exception in Agent SDK
changes.why_matters: 通过 Agent SDK 运行时不会在会话结束时崩溃，提升集成稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Agent SDK runs no longer throw at stream end, improving integration reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed a rare hang when waiting for scroll to settle on Windows
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 等待滚动卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix rare Windows scroll settle hang
changes.why_matters: 在 Windows 上滚动等待更可靠，减少偶发卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: Scroll settling on Windows is now more reliable, reducing rare hangs.

changes.raw: Fixed stale and doubled rows in the agent view list on Windows when background session results contain wide (CJK) characters
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 代理列表错乱
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows agent list row corruption
changes.why_matters: 后台会话结果含 CJK 字符时，代理视图列表显示更准确。
changes.why_matters_en: The agent view list now renders correctly on Windows even with wide CJK output.

changes.raw: Fixed pasted text being delivered to agents as an unreadable `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder instead of the actual content
changes.summary: 修复粘贴内容被占位符替代
changes.summary_en: Fix pasted text sent as placeholder
changes.why_matters: 粘贴文本会按原文发送给代理，不再丢失实际内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Pasted text is now delivered as the real content instead of an unreadable placeholder.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin component counts in `claude plugin details` and `/plugin` being doubled when a plugin's manifest listed paths overlapping its default directories
changes.summary: 修复插件数量重复统计
changes.summary_en: Fix double-counted plugin components
changes.why_matters: 查看插件详情时组件数量更准确，避免误判插件规模。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin details now show accurate component counts, avoiding misleading totals.

changes.raw: Fixed backgrounded sessions re-prompting for tool permissions you already granted with "don't ask again"
changes.summary: 修复后台会话重复要权限
changes.summary_en: Fix repeated permission prompts
changes.why_matters: 已选“不再询问”的权限不会被反复打断，后台任务更连贯。
changes.why_matters_en: Background sessions no longer re-prompt for permissions you already allowed permanently.

changes.raw: Fixed GNOME Terminal right-click and middle-click paste not inserting text
changes.summary: 修复 GNOME 终端粘贴失效
changes.summary_en: Fix GNOME Terminal paste actions
changes.why_matters: 在 GNOME Terminal 中右键和中键粘贴可正常输入文本。
changes.why_matters_en: Right-click and middle-click paste now work correctly in GNOME Terminal.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` not applying to teammate processes spawned by agent teams
changes.summary: 修复子代理模型环境变量失效
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent model env var propagation
changes.why_matters: 团队派生的子进程会正确继承模型配置，保证子代理行为一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Teammate processes now inherit the configured subagent model as expected.

changes.raw: Fixed slash commands followed by a tab or newline being treated as an unknown command
changes.summary: 修复斜杠命令误判为未知命令
changes.summary_en: Fix slash commands misread as unknown
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在输入命令后接制表符或换行时被错误拦截，提升命令可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents valid slash commands from being rejected when followed by a tab or newline, improving command reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed several spacing and layout glitches in the `/plugin`, `/status`, `/mobile`, `/sandbox`, and `/permissions` menus
changes.summary: 修复菜单间距与布局问题
changes.summary_en: Fix spacing and layout glitches in menus
changes.why_matters: 让多个菜单显示更稳定、更易读，减少界面错位带来的使用干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes several menus render more consistently and readably, reducing UI friction.

changes.raw: Fixed stripped images prompting the model to repeatedly re-read media that was no longer present
changes.summary: 修复图片缺失导致重复读取
changes.summary_en: Fix repeated rereads of missing images
changes.why_matters: 避免模型对已不存在的媒体反复尝试读取，减少无效调用和上下文浪费。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the model from repeatedly trying to read media that is no longer available, reducing wasted calls and context churn.

Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
