A Claude Code and Codex Skill for Deliberate Skill Development

changes.raw: Added `claude agents --json` to list live Claude sessions as JSON for scripting (tmux-resurrect, status bars, session pickers)
changes.summary: 支持JSON列出活跃会话
changes.summary_en: List live sessions as JSON
changes.why_matters: 方便脚本和外部工具自动发现并管理 Claude 会话。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes it easy for scripts and external tools to discover and manage Claude sessions.

changes.raw: Added `agent_id` and `parent_agent_id` attributes to `claude_code.tool` OTEL spans, and fixed trace parenting so background subagent spans nest under the dispatching Agent tool span
changes.summary: 补充OTEL子代理追踪关系
changes.summary_en: Add agent IDs to OTEL spans
changes.why_matters: 更完整的链路追踪能帮助排查后台子代理的执行关系和问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Better trace relationships make it easier to debug background subagent execution and issues.

changes.raw: Status line JSON input now includes GitHub repo and PR information when detected
changes.summary: 状态栏可显示GitHub信息
changes.summary_en: Show GitHub repo and PR info
changes.why_matters: 状态栏能直接展示仓库和 PR 上下文，减少切换查看的成本。
changes.why_matters_en: The status line can surface repo and PR context directly, reducing the need to switch views.

changes.raw: `/plugin` Discover and Browse screens now show a plugin's commands, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP/LSP servers before installation
changes.summary: 安装前可预览插件内容
changes.summary_en: Preview plugin contents before install
changes.why_matters: 安装前查看命令、代理和钩子等内容，有助于更安全地选择插件。
changes.why_matters_en: Seeing commands, agents, hooks, and servers before install helps users choose plugins more safely.

changes.raw: `claude agents` terminal tab title now shows the awaiting-input count so an alt-tabbed window tells you when an agent needs attention
changes.summary: 会话标签显示待处理数
changes.summary_en: Show pending count in tab title
changes.why_matters: 用户切换窗口时能更快判断哪个会话需要处理。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can tell more quickly which session needs attention when switching windows.

changes.raw: Slash command and @-mention suggestion list now supports mouse hover and click in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 全屏建议支持鼠标操作
changes.summary_en: Enable mouse hover and click in suggestions
changes.why_matters: 在全屏模式下可用鼠标选择建议，提升交互便利性。
changes.why_matters_en: Mouse selection in fullscreen mode makes suggestion picking more convenient.

changes.raw: Stop and SubagentStop hook input now includes `background_tasks` and `session_crons` fields
changes.summary: Hook输入新增后台任务信息
changes.summary_en: Add background task fields to hook input
changes.why_matters: Hook 可以获得更多运行上下文，从而做出更准确的自动化处理。
changes.why_matters_en: Hooks get richer runtime context, enabling more accurate automation handling.

changes.raw: Fixed a permission-prompt bypass where bare variable assignments to non-allowlisted environment variables in Bash commands were auto-approved
changes.summary: 修复环境变量审批绕过
changes.summary_en: Fix env var approval bypass
changes.why_matters: 这修复了可能导致未授权环境变量被自动批准的安全漏洞。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes a security flaw that could auto-approve unauthorized environment variables.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP prompt slash commands showing raw server validation errors when a required argument is omitted — the error now names the missing argument and shows expected usage
changes.summary: 缺参时显示更清晰报错
changes.summary_en: Show clearer missing-arg errors
changes.why_matters: 用户少传参数时能直接看到缺失项和正确用法，减少排错时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Users see the missing argument and correct usage immediately, reducing debugging time.

changes.raw: Fixed the spinner and elapsed-time display freezing until a keypress after the terminal was resized or refocused
changes.summary: 修复缩放后进度冻结
changes.summary_en: Fix spinner freeze after resize/refocus
changes.why_matters: 终端重绘后进度显示恢复正常，避免界面看起来卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: Progress indicators keep updating after terminal resize or refocus, avoiding a frozen UI feel.

changes.raw: Fixed the cross-project resume hint failing in default Windows PowerShell 5.1 — Windows now uses `;` as the command separator
changes.summary: 修复Windows恢复提示兼容性
changes.summary_en: Fix resume hint on Windows PowerShell
changes.why_matters: Windows 默认 PowerShell 下的恢复命令现在可以正常运行。
changes.why_matters_en: The resume hint now works correctly in default Windows PowerShell.

changes.raw: Fixed voice push-to-talk not working in the agent view's reply pane
changes.summary: 修复语音按住说话失效
changes.summary_en: Fix push-to-talk in reply pane
changes.why_matters: 语音输入在代理视图中恢复可用，提升无键盘交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice input works again in the agent view, improving hands-free interaction.

changes.raw: Fixed task lists rendering in random order when several tasks are created at once
changes.summary: 修复任务列表顺序错乱
changes.summary_en: Fix task list ordering
changes.why_matters: 多个任务同时创建时，列表会按正确顺序显示，便于跟踪。
changes.why_matters_en: Task lists now render in the correct order when multiple tasks are created at once.

changes.raw: Fixed stale "Failed to install Anthropic marketplace" banner showing when the marketplace is already installed
changes.summary: 修复市场已安装提示残留
changes.summary_en: Fix stale marketplace banner
changes.why_matters: 避免已安装后仍显示错误横幅，减少界面误导。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents a stale error banner from misleading users after installation.

changes.raw: Fixed the PR badge in the footer not updating immediately after `gh pr create` and other PR-state-changing commands run in-session
changes.summary: PR状态徽标即时刷新
changes.summary_en: Refresh PR badge immediately
changes.why_matters: 在会话内创建或变更 PR 后，界面能立刻反映最新状态。
changes.why_matters_en: The UI now reflects PR state changes immediately after in-session commands.

changes.raw: Fixed Agent Teams teammates with non-ASCII names failing every API call due to invalid header encoding
changes.summary: 修复非ASCII队友API失败
changes.summary_en: Fix API failures for non-ASCII teammates
changes.why_matters: 避免团队成员因姓名编码问题导致所有接口调用失败，提升协作稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents teammates with non-ASCII names from failing every API call, improving collaboration reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/review` using a deprecated `projectCards` GraphQL query that errored on repos with Classic Projects
changes.summary: 修复/review在旧项目上报错
changes.summary_en: Fix /review errors on Classic Projects
changes.why_matters: 让代码审查命令兼容旧版 GitHub 项目，减少在常见仓库上的失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the review command compatible with legacy GitHub Projects and avoids failures on common repos.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude plugin validate` not flagging `skills:` entries that point at a file instead of a directory — the error now suggests the parent directory
changes.summary: 修复技能路径校验提示
changes.summary_en: Fix skill path validation guidance
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户更快定位 skills 配置错误，减少插件校验失败的排查成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users quickly locate skills config mistakes and reduces debugging cost for plugin validation.

changes.raw: Fixed an infinite loop where a skill using `context: fork` could repeatedly re-invoke itself instead of running
changes.summary: 修复fork技能无限递归
changes.summary_en: Fix infinite self-invocation loop
changes.why_matters: 避免技能反复自调用导致任务卡死，是影响执行可靠性的严重问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents skills from recursively re-invoking themselves and hanging execution, a serious reliability issue.

changes.raw: Improved the Read tool to return a truncated first page with a "PARTIAL view" notice instead of a hard error when a whole-file read exceeds the token limit
changes.summary: 大文件读取改为部分返回
changes.summary_en: Return partial reads for oversized files
changes.why_matters: 当文件过大时仍能先看到部分内容，减少硬失败并提升阅读体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users see part of a large file instead of failing outright, improving usability and continuity.

signals.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
Show HN: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
Tell HN: Dont use Claude Design, lost access to my projects after unsubscribing
A Claude Code and Codex Skill for Deliberate Skill Development

changes.raw: Added `/resume` support for background sessions — sessions started via `claude --bg` or agent view now appear alongside interactive ones, marked with `bg`
changes.summary: 支持后台会话 /resume
changes.summary_en: Add /resume for background sessions
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接恢复后台运行的会话，提升连续工作和多任务切换效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can resume background sessions directly, improving continuity and multitasking.

changes.raw: Added elapsed duration to background subagent completion notifications (e.g. "Agent completed · 3h 2m 5s")
changes.summary: 通知显示子代理耗时
changes.summary_en: Show subagent completion duration
changes.why_matters: 用户能更清楚了解后台任务耗时，便于判断进度和性能。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can better understand how long background tasks take, helping track progress and performance.

changes.raw: The `/plugin` browse and discover panes now show when a plugin was last updated
changes.summary: 插件列表显示更新时间
changes.summary_en: Show plugin last updated time
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更快判断插件是否新鲜、是否需要更新或审查。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly judge whether a plugin is current and whether it may need updating or review.

changes.raw: `/model` now changes the model for the current session only; press `d` in the model picker to set a default for new sessions
changes.summary: 模型切换仅影响当前会话
changes.summary_en: Model changes now apply to current session only
changes.why_matters: 避免误把临时模型选择写成全局设置，让会话级控制更清晰。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents temporary model choices from affecting global defaults and makes session-level control clearer.

changes.raw: Renamed "extra usage" to "usage credits" across CLI copy; `/extra-usage` is now `/usage-credits` (old name still works)
changes.summary: 术语改为 usage credits
changes.summary_en: Rename extra usage to usage credits
changes.why_matters: 命令和文案发生重命名，用户需要适应新术语和新命令名。
changes.why_matters_en: The command and UI terminology changed, so users need to adapt to the new names.

changes.raw: Fixed startup hanging up to 75s when `api.anthropic.com` is unreachable (captive portal, firewall, VPN issues) — side-channel API calls now time out after 15s
changes.summary: 启动不再因网络不可达卡住
changes.summary_en: Startup no longer hangs on unreachable API
changes.why_matters: 在防火墙、VPN 或门户拦截场景下，启动会更快失败并恢复可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Startup now fails fast and stays usable when firewalls, VPNs, or captive portals block access.

changes.raw: Fixed garbled terminal output after a missed window-resize event (e.g. dragging a VS Code split-pane divider) — now self-heals on the next frame instead of requiring Ctrl+L
changes.summary: 窗口缩放后终端自动修复
changes.summary_en: Terminal self-heals after resize glitches
changes.why_matters: 减少界面乱码和手动刷新操作，提升编辑器内使用稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces garbled output and manual refreshes, improving stability inside the editor.

changes.raw: Fixed progressive terminal display corruption (stale/garbled glyphs) that could appear in very long sessions and only cleared on terminal resize or restart
changes.summary: 长会话终端乱码问题修复
changes.summary_en: Fix terminal corruption in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 长时间运行时输出更可靠，避免因显示损坏影响判断和操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Output stays reliable in long-running sessions, avoiding display corruption that can disrupt work.

changes.raw: Reduced terminal rendering glitches in VS Code by reducing spinner animation color count
changes.summary: VS Code 终端闪烁更少
changes.summary_en: Reduce VS Code terminal rendering glitches
changes.why_matters: 界面更平滑，减少在 VS Code 中使用时的视觉干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: The UI becomes smoother, reducing visual noise while using Claude Code in VS Code.

changes.raw: Fixed macOS background sessions crashing with "exit 1 before init" when the project lives under a Full Disk Access-protected folder (regression in 2.1.143)
changes.summary: 修复 macOS 后台会话崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS background session crash
changes.why_matters: 避免受 Full Disk Access 保护目录下的后台任务直接失败，恢复可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents background tasks from crashing under Full Disk Access-protected folders, restoring usability.

changes.raw: Fixed an unrecoverable conversation when reading a file whose image extension doesn't match its contents (e.g. HTML saved as .png) — now falls back to text
changes.summary: 图片扩展名不符时回退文本
changes.summary_en: Fallback to text when image type mismatches
changes.why_matters: 避免因文件内容与扩展名不一致而中断对话，提高文件处理鲁棒性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents conversations from breaking when file contents and extensions mismatch, improving robustness.

changes.raw: Fewer spurious tool errors during search: `head`/`tail` file views now satisfy the read-before-edit check, and a "no matches" result (exit code 1) from `egrep`, `fgrep`, `git grep`, or `git diff` is no longer reported as a command failure
changes.summary: 减少搜索中的误报工具错误
changes.summary_en: Reduce false tool errors during search
changes.why_matters: 搜索和查看文件时更少出现假错误，降低噪音并提升工作流顺畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Search and file-view operations produce fewer false errors, reducing noise and smoothing the workflow.

changes.raw: Fixed `/branch` failing with "No conversation to branch" after entering a worktree or in some background sessions
changes.summary: /branch 在工作区后可用
changes.summary_en: Fix /branch after entering worktrees
changes.why_matters: 用户在工作区或后台会话中也能正常分支，避免流程中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can branch normally in worktrees and background sessions, avoiding workflow interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing Escape in the AskUserQuestion notes field aborting the turn instead of returning to answer selection
changes.summary: Esc 不再误中断问答流程
changes.summary_en: Escape no longer aborts AskUserQuestion
changes.why_matters: 减少误操作导致的任务中断，让交互式确认更可靠。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents accidental turn aborts and makes interactive confirmation more reliable.

changes.raw: Fixed model selection not applying when changed via the IDE model picker or `applyFlagSettings` after startup
changes.summary: 修复 IDE 模型选择失效
changes.summary_en: Fix IDE model picker settings application
changes.why_matters: 确保在 IDE 或启动后修改模型设置能真正生效，避免模型不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures model changes made in the IDE or after startup actually take effect, preventing mismatches.

changes.raw: Resumed sessions now keep the model they were using instead of picking up another session's `/model` choice
changes.summary: 恢复会话保留原模型
changes.summary_en: Resumed sessions keep their model
changes.why_matters: 避免恢复会话时模型被错误切换，保证对话连续性和预期行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents resumed sessions from switching models unexpectedly, preserving continuity and expected behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock and Vertex users unable to select "Opus (1M context)" from the `/model` picker (regression in v2.1.129)
changes.summary: 修复模型选择器可选项
changes.summary_en: Fix Opus 1M model selection
changes.why_matters: 让 Bedrock 和 Vertex 用户能正常选择大上下文模型，避免功能缺失。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores access to the large-context model for Bedrock and Vertex users, avoiding a broken picker.

changes.raw: Fixed remote-session login failing with "Can't access this organization" for users with `forceLoginMethod` and `forceLoginOrgUUID` set
changes.summary: 修复远程会话登录失败
changes.summary_en: Fix remote-session login failure
changes.why_matters: 解决强制登录配置下无法进入组织的问题，避免用户被阻断。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes an access-blocking login issue for users with enforced org and login settings.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP servers with paginated `tools/list` responses only returning the first page, silently dropping tools
changes.summary: 修复分页 MCP 工具丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix paginated MCP tools listing
changes.why_matters: 确保分页返回的所有工具都能被发现和使用，避免能力静默缺失。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures all paginated tools are discovered and usable instead of being silently dropped.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP images with unsupported MIME types (e.g. SVG) breaking the conversation — now saved to disk and referenced in the tool result
changes.summary: 支持不兼容 MCP 图片
changes.summary_en: Handle unsupported MCP image MIME
changes.why_matters: 避免图片类型不兼容导致对话中断，提高工具结果的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unsupported image types from breaking conversations and improves tool-result robustness.

changes.raw: Fixed file descriptor exhaustion when a build runs inside a skill directory — non-`.md` files no longer trigger skill reloads
changes.summary: 修复构建触发句柄耗尽
changes.summary_en: Fix file descriptor exhaustion
changes.why_matters: 减少在技能目录中运行构建时的资源耗尽风险，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids resource exhaustion when builds run inside skill directories, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed session title being generated from plugin monitor output instead of the user's first prompt
changes.summary: 会话标题改为首条提问
changes.summary_en: Title from first user prompt
changes.why_matters: 让会话标题更准确反映用户意图，便于后续查找和管理。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes session titles reflect the user's intent, improving search and organization.

changes.raw: Fixed Skill tool failing with permission error in headless mode (regression in v2.1.141)
changes.summary: 修复无头模式 Skill 权限
changes.summary_en: Fix Skill permissions in headless mode
changes.why_matters: 让自动化/无头场景下的 Skill 能正常运行，避免回归导致任务失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps Skills working in headless automation scenarios and prevents regression failures.

changes.raw: Fixed plugins enabled in your own settings showing "not cached" errors after first load on a fresh machine; plugins enabled only by a project's `.claude/settings.json` now show an actionable `claude plugin install` hint
changes.summary: 插件缓存提示更可操作
changes.summary_en: Better plugin cache/install hints
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户快速修复插件未缓存问题，减少新机器上的配置困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users resolve plugin cache issues faster and reduces setup confusion on fresh machines.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude mcp list` silently reporting no servers when `.mcp.json` can't be parsed (e.g. using VS Code's `"servers"` key instead of `"mcpServers"`) — now shows configuration errors
changes.summary: mcp list 显示配置错误
changes.summary_en: Show MCP config parse errors
changes.why_matters: 当 MCP 配置写错时能直接暴露问题，避免误以为没有服务器。
changes.why_matters_en: Surfaces MCP configuration errors directly so users don't mistake them for missing servers.

changes.raw: Fixed background side-queries on custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` setups and Bedrock Mantle not using Haiku — now falls back correctly when a first-party API key is configured or no Haiku model is set
changes.summary: 修复后台查询模型回退
changes.summary_en: Fix background query model fallback
changes.why_matters: 确保自定义 API 或 Bedrock 环境下后台查询仍能正常工作，不会卡在模型选择上。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures background queries still work in custom API or Bedrock setups by falling back correctly.

changes.raw: Fixed scrolling in attached background sessions on Windows — PgUp/PgDn, mouse wheel, and Ctrl+O transcript navigation now work
changes.summary: Windows 附加会话可滚动
changes.summary_en: Fix scrolling in attached sessions on Windows
changes.why_matters: 改善 Windows 上查看后台会话历史的可用性，减少操作受限。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves usability for reviewing attached background sessions on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash when closing the terminal while attached to a background session
changes.summary: 关闭终端不再崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash when closing terminal
changes.why_matters: 避免附加后台会话时关闭终端引发崩溃，提升整体稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes when closing the terminal during an attached background session.

changes.raw: Fixed on Windows, pressing ← in `claude agents` leaving the list unresponsive to keyboard input
changes.summary: 修复 agents 键盘失灵
changes.summary_en: Fix keyboard input in claude agents
changes.why_matters: 让 Windows 下的 agents 列表可继续用键盘操作，避免界面卡死感。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores keyboard navigation in claude agents on Windows, preventing the UI from becoming unusable.

changes.raw: Fixed ghost characters at the left edge when switching panes in Agent View on Windows Terminal with CJK content
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 侧边残影
changes.summary_en: Fix pane ghosting on Windows Terminal
changes.why_matters: 减少中文内容切换面板时的显示异常，提升界面清晰度。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes visual artifacts when switching panes with CJK content, improving display clarity.

changes.raw: `/bg` and `←`-detach now preserve directories added via `/add-dir`
changes.summary: 保留 /add-dir 目录到后台
changes.summary_en: Preserve /add-dir dirs in background
changes.why_matters: 用户切换到后台会话后仍能访问之前添加的目录，减少重复配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Users keep access to added directories after detaching, avoiding reconfiguration.

changes.raw: Fixed Edit/Write refusing with "background session hasn't isolated its changes yet" right after detaching a session that was already editing in place
changes.summary: 修复分离后编辑拒绝问题
changes.summary_en: Fix edit/write after detach refusal
changes.why_matters: 避免刚分离会话后无法继续编辑，保证后台工作流不中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents edits from being blocked right after detaching, keeping background work uninterrupted.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude respawn <id>` on a stopped background session showing "stopped" instead of running
changes.summary: 修复 respawn 状态显示错误
changes.summary_en: Fix respawn showing wrong status
changes.why_matters: 让用户准确判断后台会话是否可恢复，减少误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives accurate session status so users can tell whether a background session can be resumed.

changes.raw: Fixed `/resume` picker not showing sessions forked from a background session
changes.summary: 修复 /resume 漏显示分叉会话
changes.summary_en: Fix /resume missing forked sessions
changes.why_matters: 确保用户能在恢复列表中找到所有相关会话，便于继续工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures all relevant sessions appear in resume lists so work can continue smoothly.

changes.raw: Fixed opening a session from `claude agents` or running `claude logs <id>` hanging when the background service is unresponsive — now times out after 10s with a recovery hint
changes.summary: 后台无响应时打开不再卡死
changes.summary_en: Avoid hangs when background service stalls
changes.why_matters: 后台服务异常时会超时并给出恢复提示，避免界面永久卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: When the background service is unresponsive, it now times out with recovery guidance instead of hanging.

changes.raw: Fixed background Bash tasks spawned by subagents staying "Running" in SDK task panels after the process exits
changes.summary: 修复子代理后台任务状态
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent background task status
changes.why_matters: 任务结束后状态会正确更新，避免面板里显示错误的运行中状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Task panels now reflect completion correctly instead of leaving exited tasks marked running.

changes.raw: Fixed completed or stopped background sessions briefly failing to wake being permanently marked as a startup crash
changes.summary: 修复后台会话唤醒误报崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix false startup-crash marking
changes.why_matters: 减少已完成或已停止会话被错误标记为崩溃，提升状态可信度。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents completed or stopped sessions from being mislabeled as crashes, improving status reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed markdown links in `claude agents` attached sessions rendering as plain text instead of clickable hyperlinks
changes.summary: 修复会话链接显示为纯文本
changes.summary_en: Fix session links rendering as text
changes.why_matters: 让附加会话中的 Markdown 链接可点击，提升可读性和导航效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Markdown links in attached sessions are clickable again, improving readability and navigation.

changes.raw: Fixed custom `spinnerVerbs` applying to the post-turn duration message — past-tense built-ins like "Worked for 5s" are restored there
changes.summary: 恢复结束时长文案为过去式
changes.summary_en: Restore past-tense duration message
changes.why_matters: 让完成后的状态文案更自然一致，避免自定义配置影响关键提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps completion messages natural and consistent even when custom spinner verbs are configured.

changes.raw: `claude agents` / `--bg` rejection messages now name the specific gate (non-TTY, env var, or setting) instead of a generic message
changes.summary: 拒绝后台时提示具体原因
changes.summary_en: Show specific reason for bg rejection
changes.why_matters: 用户能直接看到是 TTY、环境变量还是设置导致失败，更容易排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see whether TTY, env vars, or settings caused the rejection, making troubleshooting easier.

changes.raw: `claude --bg --name <label>` now echoes the name in the post-spawn confirmation
changes.summary: 后台启动确认显示名称
changes.summary_en: Echo background session name on spawn
changes.why_matters: 启动后立即确认会话名称，便于区分和管理多个后台任务。
changes.why_matters_en: The spawned session name is echoed back, making multiple background tasks easier to identify.

changes.raw: `claude agents`: renaming a background session with Ctrl+R now updates the attached session's banner immediately
changes.summary: 重命名后台会话后立即刷新
changes.summary_en: Refresh banner after renaming session
changes.why_matters: 重命名后界面立刻同步，避免看到旧名称造成混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: The UI updates immediately after renaming, preventing confusion from stale names.

changes.raw: Background session worktree isolation guard now applies for non-git VCS users with `WorktreeCreate` hooks configured
changes.summary: 非 git 也支持工作区隔离保护
changes.summary_en: Apply isolation guard for non-git VCS
changes.why_matters: 在配置了相关钩子的非 git 版本控制环境中也能防止工作区隔离失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Isolation protection now works for non-git VCS setups with hooks, reducing unsafe workspace changes.

changes.raw: Plugin marketplace add/update now respects `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS`
changes.summary: 插件市场优先用 HTTPS
changes.summary_en: Respect HTTPS preference for plugins
changes.why_matters: 让插件安装和更新遵循 HTTPS 偏好，提升传输安全与一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin add/update now follows the HTTPS preference, improving transport security and consistency.

changes.raw: `/plugin` now returns to the Installed list after enabling, disabling, or uninstalling a plugin
changes.summary: /plugin 操作后回到已安装列表
changes.summary_en: Return to Installed after /plugin actions
changes.why_matters: 启用、禁用或卸载后自动回到已安装页，减少额外导航。
changes.why_matters_en: After enabling, disabling, or uninstalling, /plugin returns to Installed to reduce extra navigation.

changes.raw: `/doctor` now shows an exec-form example when a command hook is missing the `command` field
changes.summary: /doctor补全缺失命令示例
changes.summary_en: Doctor shows exec-form example for missing command
changes.why_matters: 当命令钩子缺少 command 字段时，用户能更快看懂正确配置方式并修复问题。
changes.why_matters_en: When a command hook lacks the command field, users can quickly see the correct exec-form setup and fix it.

changes.raw: Skill-listing truncation is no longer shown as a startup notification — run `/doctor` for the full breakdown
changes.summary: 不再显示技能截断启动提示
changes.summary_en: Startup no longer shows skill truncation notice
changes.why_matters: 减少了无关启动提示，让用户更专注于真正需要处理的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes a noisy startup notice so users can focus on issues that actually need attention.

changes.raw: Improved recovery from rare pre-response stream stalls — now retries streaming once instead of falling back to a slower non-streaming request
changes.summary: 流式响应卡顿可自动重试
changes.summary_en: Retries stalled streaming before falling back
changes.why_matters: 遇到罕见流式卡顿时可先自动重试，减少变慢并提升响应稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Rare streaming stalls now retry once first, reducing slowdowns and improving response reliability.

changes.raw: Improved SDK/headless MCP startup: pre-wait now overlaps startup instead of blocking before the first turn (up to 2s faster with slow MCP servers)
changes.summary: MCP启动更快，等待可并行
changes.summary_en: MCP startup is faster with overlapping pre-wait
changes.why_matters: 在慢速 MCP 服务下首次交互等待更短，整体启动体验更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: First-turn latency is lower with slow MCP servers, making startup feel smoother.

changes.raw: The post-survey follow-up hint now appears after every non-dismiss survey response with context-aware copy, making it easier to share more detail via /feedback.
changes.summary: 调查后提示更易继续反馈
changes.summary_en: Post-survey prompt better guides more feedback
changes.why_matters: 在每次非拒绝回答后提供更贴切的引导，能更容易收集更完整的用户反馈。
changes.why_matters_en: Context-aware follow-up after non-dismiss responses makes it easier to collect richer user feedback.

signals.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
Show HN: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
Tell HN: Dont use Claude Design, lost access to my projects after unsubscribing
A Claude Code and Codex Skill for Deliberate Skill Development

changes.raw: Added plugin dependency enforcement: `claude plugin disable` now refuses when another enabled plugin depends on the target (with a copy-pasteable disable-chain hint), and `claude plugin enable` force-enables transitive dependencies
changes.summary: 插件依赖自动校验与联动启用
changes.summary_en: Plugin dependency checks and auto-enable
changes.why_matters: 避免禁用依赖插件导致功能损坏，并减少手动处理依赖链的操作成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents breaking dependent plugins and reduces manual dependency handling.

changes.raw: Added projected context cost (per-turn and per-invocation token estimates) to the `/plugin` marketplace browse pane
changes.summary: 显示插件上下文成本预估
changes.summary_en: Show projected plugin context cost
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户在安装或浏览插件时评估其对上下文预算的影响。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users judge a plugin's impact on context budget before using it.

changes.raw: Added `worktree.bgIsolation: "none"` setting to let background sessions edit the working copy directly without `EnterWorktree`, for repos where worktrees are impractical
changes.summary: 后台会话可直写工作区
changes.summary_en: Background sessions can edit workspace directly
changes.why_matters: 在不适合使用 worktree 的仓库中，也能更方便地让后台会话修改当前工作副本。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes background sessions usable in repos where worktrees are impractical.

changes.raw: PowerShell tool now passes `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`. Opt out with `CLAUDE_CODE_POWERSHELL_RESPECT_EXECUTION_POLICY=1`
changes.summary: PowerShell 执行策略兼容修复
changes.summary_en: PowerShell execution policy compatibility fix
changes.why_matters: 减少 PowerShell 脚本因执行策略限制而失败的概率，提升 Windows 可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces PowerShell failures caused by execution policy restrictions on Windows.

changes.raw: Background sessions now preserve the model and effort level you set after waking from idle
changes.summary: 后台会话唤醒后保留模型设置
changes.summary_en: Background sessions keep model settings after wake
changes.why_matters: 避免后台会话恢复后悄悄切回默认配置，保证行为一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents background sessions from silently reverting to defaults after waking.

changes.raw: Shift+Tab in attached agent sessions now includes auto mode in the cycle
changes.summary: 附加代理切换加入自动模式
changes.summary_en: Attached agent cycle now includes auto mode
changes.why_matters: 让快捷切换更完整，减少在不同代理模式间来回操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes mode switching smoother by including auto mode in the cycle.

changes.raw: Fixed a corrupt `.credentials.json` with a non-array `scopes` value hanging the CLI on startup or silently aborting OAuth token refresh
changes.summary: 损坏凭据不再卡死启动
changes.summary_en: Corrupt credentials no longer hang startup
changes.why_matters: 修复认证文件异常导致的启动卡死或 OAuth 刷新失败，直接影响登录和使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes startup hangs and OAuth refresh failures caused by malformed credentials, which directly block usage.

changes.raw: Fixed right-click paste in `claude agents` on Windows Terminal and WSL
changes.summary: Windows 终端右键粘贴修复
changes.summary_en: Fixed right-click paste on Windows Terminal
changes.why_matters: 改善 Windows/WSL 下的基础交互体验，减少粘贴操作失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves basic interaction reliability for Windows and WSL users.

changes.raw: Fixed stop hooks that block repeatedly looping forever — the turn now ends with a warning after 8 consecutive blocks (override via `CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP`)
changes.summary: 停止钩子死循环自动中止
changes.summary_en: Stop-hook loops now auto-stop with warning
changes.why_matters: 防止阻塞型钩子无限循环拖死会话，提升稳定性和可恢复性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents blocking hooks from looping forever and degrading session stability.

changes.raw: Fixed Esc/Ctrl+C not cancelling a pending `/loop` wakeup while Claude is idle between iterations
changes.summary: 空闲唤醒可被 Esc/Ctrl+C 取消
changes.summary_en: Esc/Ctrl+C can cancel pending loop wakeups
changes.why_matters: 让用户在迭代间隙能及时打断等待中的自动唤醒，控制更灵活。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users interrupt pending wakeups during idle loops for better control.

changes.raw: Fixed `/goal` evaluator firing while background shells or delegated subagents are still running
changes.summary: /goal 不再抢跑后台任务
changes.summary_en: /goal no longer fires before background work ends
changes.why_matters: 避免在后台 shell 或委派子代理未完成时过早评估目标，减少错误结论。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents premature goal evaluation while background shells or delegated subagents are still running.

changes.raw: Fixed `NO_COLOR`/`FORCE_COLOR` in settings.json `env` stripping Claude Code's own UI colors — they now apply to subprocesses only
changes.summary: 环境色彩变量不再污染界面
changes.summary_en: Color env vars no longer affect UI colors
changes.why_matters: 保留 Claude Code 自身界面配色，同时让子进程按环境变量继承颜色设置。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps Claude Code UI colors intact while still passing color settings to subprocesses.

changes.raw: Fixed agent view spawning repeated PowerShell processes on Windows when listing sessions
changes.summary: Windows 会话列表不再反复起进程
changes.summary_en: Agent view no longer spawns repeated PowerShell
changes.why_matters: 减少 Windows 上查看会话时的额外开销和异常进程噪音。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces overhead and process noise when listing sessions on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed `/bg` without a prompt sending "continue" to the forked session — the fork now waits for input
changes.summary: /bg 空提示不再自动续写
changes.summary_en: /bg without prompt now waits for input
changes.why_matters: 避免 fork 出来的后台会话在没有明确指令时误继续执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents forked background sessions from continuing without an explicit prompt.

changes.raw: Fixed `--agent <name>` not finding plugin-contributed agents without the `plugin:` prefix
changes.summary: 插件代理可直接被 --agent 发现
changes.summary_en: --agent finds plugin-contributed agents
changes.why_matters: 让插件提供的代理无需额外前缀即可被调用，提升集成可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes plugin-provided agents discoverable without requiring a special prefix.

changes.raw: Fixed deleting a session from agent view not removing its transcript file
changes.summary: 删除会话时同步清理转写文件
changes.summary_en: Delete session now removes transcript file
changes.why_matters: 避免会话已删但转写文件残留，减少磁盘垃圾和数据不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents deleted sessions from leaving orphaned transcript files and keeps data consistent.

changes.raw: Fixed stale-fragment rendering when scrolling in attached background sessions on Windows Terminal
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 终端滚动渲染错位
changes.summary_en: Fix stale fragment rendering on scroll
changes.why_matters: 提升后台会话在 Windows Terminal 中滚动查看时的显示正确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves rendering correctness when scrolling attached background sessions in Windows Terminal.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents false-positive worker-stall detection storm after host sleep or macOS App Nap
changes.summary: 修复睡眠后后台任务误判卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix false worker-stall alerts after sleep
changes.why_matters: 减少系统休眠或 App Nap 后的误报风暴，避免后台代理被错误干预。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces alert storms after sleep or App Nap and prevents unnecessary intervention on background agents.

changes.raw: Fixed 5xx error messages pointing at status.claude.com instead of naming the configured gateway or cloud provider
changes.summary: 5xx 错误改显示实际网关
changes.summary_en: 5xx errors now name the configured provider
changes.why_matters: 让用户更快定位是自定义网关还是云厂商侧的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users quickly identify whether the issue is with their configured gateway or cloud provider.

changes.raw: The PowerShell tool is now enabled by default on Windows for Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry users. Opt out with `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=0`.
changes.summary: Windows 默认启用 PowerShell 工具
changes.summary_en: PowerShell tool enabled by default on Windows
changes.why_matters: 让 Windows 上的 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 用户开箱即可使用更合适的命令工具。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives Windows users on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry a better out-of-the-box command tool.

changes.raw: `claude agents` now accepts `--add-dir`, `--settings`, `--mcp-config`, and `--plugin-dir` and applies them to the dashboard and to background sessions dispatched from it
changes.summary: agents 支持继承目录与配置
changes.summary_en: agents now accepts dir and config flags
changes.why_matters: 让仪表盘和其派生后台会话继承工作目录、设置和 MCP 配置，减少重复配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets the dashboard and spawned background sessions inherit directories, settings, and MCP config with less setup.

changes.raw: `claude agents` accepts `--permission-mode`, `--model`, `--effort`, and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to set defaults for sessions dispatched from the view
changes.summary: agents 可预设权限与模型
changes.summary_en: agents can set default permissions and model
changes.why_matters: 方便从会话视图派生的任务统一使用指定模型、努力级别和权限模式。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes it easier to launch sessions from the view with consistent model, effort, and permission defaults.

changes.raw: `claude --bg --dangerously-skip-permissions` now persists across retire→wake
changes.summary: bg 权限跳过标志可跨唤醒保留
changes.summary_en: bg skip-permissions now survives retire/wake
changes.why_matters: 避免后台会话在退役再唤醒后丢失关键权限设置。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents background sessions from losing an important permission setting after retire and wake.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions silently capturing IDE file references into the warm spare's input, which caused the reference to be prepended to the next prompt dispatched from `claude agents`
changes.summary: 修复后台会话污染下一次输入
changes.summary_en: Fix IDE refs leaking into next prompt
changes.why_matters: 防止后台会话把 IDE 文件引用悄悄带入 warm spare，影响后续提示词。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents background sessions from leaking IDE file references into the warm spare and corrupting the next prompt.

changes.raw: Worktree cleanup no longer falls back to `rm -rf` when `git worktree remove` fails, preventing loss of gitignored or in-progress files
changes.summary: 修复 worktree 清理误删文件
changes.summary_en: Worktree cleanup no longer falls back to rm -rf
changes.why_matters: 避免 worktree 删除失败时误用强制删除导致 gitignored 或未完成文件丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental data loss when worktree removal fails by avoiding a destructive rm -rf fallback.

changes.raw: Fixed background-job sessions on macOS getting "Operation not permitted" errors when reading files under `~/Documents`, `~/Desktop`, or `~/Downloads`, even with Full Disk Access granted.
changes.summary: 修复 macOS 文档目录读权限问题
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS file access under Documents/Desktop/Downloads
changes.why_matters: 让后台任务在已授予完全磁盘访问时也能正常读取常见用户目录。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows background jobs to read common user folders on macOS even with Full Disk Access granted.

changes.raw: `/bg` now preserves `--mcp-config`, `--settings`, `--add-dir`, `--plugin-dir`, and `--strict-mcp-config`, so backgrounded sessions keep their MCP servers and settings across respawn.
changes.summary: bg 保留 MCP 与设置配置
changes.summary_en: bg now preserves MCP and settings flags
changes.why_matters: 确保后台化后仍保留 MCP 服务器和设置，避免会话重启后能力丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps MCP servers and settings intact after backgrounding so sessions retain their capabilities across respawn.

changes.raw: Background sessions launched from `claude agents` now honor `permissions.defaultMode` from settings.json (was previously overridden to auto mode)
changes.summary: 后台会话遵循默认权限模式
changes.summary_en: Background sessions now honor defaultMode
changes.why_matters: 修复从 agents 启动的后台会话被强制改成 auto 模式的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes background sessions launched from agents being incorrectly forced into auto mode.

changes.raw: Fixed: on Windows, pressing ← in `claude agents` while a response was streaming could leave the agents list unresponsive to all input
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 左键卡死列表
changes.summary_en: Fix agents list freeze on left arrow
changes.why_matters: 避免流式响应中切换视图后 agents 列表失去输入响应。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the agents list from becoming unresponsive after detaching during a streaming response.

changes.raw: `/bg` and `←`-detach now preserve `--fallback-model`, so backgrounded workers degrade to the fallback model on overload instead of hard-failing.
changes.summary: 后台会话保留降级模型
changes.summary_en: bg and detach preserve fallback model
changes.why_matters: 让后台 worker 在主模型过载时能自动降级而不是直接失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets background workers fall back to a backup model under load instead of hard-failing.

changes.raw: `/bg` and `←`-detach now preserve `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`, so the forked worker keeps bypass-permissions available in its Shift+Tab cycle.
changes.summary: 后台分离保留跳过权限
changes.summary_en: Preserve skip-permissions after detach
changes.why_matters: 分离到后台后仍能在权限循环中使用跳过权限，避免工作流中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Detached background workers can still access skip-permissions in the permission cycle, avoiding workflow interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed: background daemon spawn now falls back to the running binary when the `~/.local/bin/claude` launcher is missing or non-executable
changes.summary: 守护进程启动回退到当前二进制
changes.summary_en: Fallback to running binary for daemon spawn
changes.why_matters: 当本地启动器缺失或不可执行时，后台守护进程仍能正常启动。
changes.why_matters_en: Background daemon startup still works when the local launcher is missing or not executable.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` defaulting dispatched sessions to bypass mode instead of making it available in the permission cycle
changes.summary: agents 保留权限循环选项
changes.summary_en: Keep bypass option in agents permission cycle
changes.why_matters: 避免会话直接进入绕过模式，确保权限选择仍可控且符合预期。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents sessions from defaulting into bypass mode and keeps permission choices controllable as expected.

signals.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
Using Claude Code: The unreasonable effectiveness of HTML
Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
Show HN: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
Tell HN: Dont use Claude Design, lost access to my projects after unsubscribing

changes.raw: Added new `claude agents` flags: `--add-dir`, `--settings`, `--mcp-config`, `--plugin-dir`, `--permission-mode`, `--model`, `--effort`, and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to configure dispatched background sessions
changes.summary: 新增后台会话配置参数
changes.summary_en: Add flags to configure background sessions
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更灵活地定制派发到后台的会话行为，适配不同项目和权限需求。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can more flexibly tailor dispatched background sessions to different projects and permission needs.

changes.raw: Fast mode now uses Opus 4.7 by default (previously Opus 4.6). Set `CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE=1` to pin fast mode to Opus 4.6
changes.summary: 快速模式默认升级到Opus 4.7
changes.summary_en: Fast mode now defaults to Opus 4.7
changes.why_matters: 默认模型升级可带来更好的输出质量和任务表现，同时保留回退到旧版本的选项。
changes.why_matters_en: The default model upgrade can improve output quality and task performance while still allowing pinning to the older version.

changes.raw: Plugins with a root-level `SKILL.md` and no `skills/` subdirectory are now surfaced as a skill
changes.summary: 根级SKILL.md也能识别为技能
changes.summary_en: Root-level SKILL.md now surfaces as a skill
changes.why_matters: 插件作者无需额外目录结构即可暴露技能，降低了发布和组织成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin authors can expose skills without extra directory structure, reducing packaging and organization overhead.

changes.raw: The `/plugin` details pane and `claude plugin details` now show LSP servers a plugin provides
changes.summary: 插件详情显示LSP服务器
changes.summary_en: Plugin details now show provided LSP servers
changes.why_matters: 用户能更清楚了解插件提供的开发工具能力，便于选择和排查集成。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can better understand a plugin's developer tooling capabilities, making selection and troubleshooting easier.

changes.raw: `/web-setup` warns before replacing an existing GitHub App connection
changes.summary: 替换GitHub连接前先警告
changes.summary_en: Warn before replacing an existing GitHub App connection
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在网页设置中误覆盖现有连接，减少配置丢失风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps prevent accidental overwrites of existing connections in web setup and reduces configuration loss risk.

changes.raw: Fixed `MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT` not raising the per-request fetch timeout for remote HTTP and SSE MCP servers, which capped tool calls at 60 seconds regardless of the configured value
changes.summary: 修复远程MCP超时上限问题
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP timeout for remote HTTP/SSE servers
changes.why_matters: 远程工具调用不再被错误限制在60秒内，能稳定处理更慢的请求。
changes.why_matters_en: Remote tool calls are no longer incorrectly capped at 60 seconds, allowing slower requests to complete reliably.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions not recognizing pre-existing git worktrees, blocking Edit while EnterWorktree refused to create a duplicate
changes.summary: 后台会话识别现有git worktree
changes.summary_en: Background sessions now detect existing git worktrees
changes.why_matters: 避免重复创建工作区并阻塞编辑操作，提升后台任务的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents duplicate worktree creation and blocked edits, improving the usability of background tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed background sessions disappearing and daemon reconnect failing after macOS sleep/wake — the daemon now detects clock jumps instead of treating them as elapsed idle time
changes.summary: 修复睡眠唤醒后守护进程断连
changes.summary_en: Fix daemon reconnect after macOS sleep/wake
changes.why_matters: 系统休眠后后台会话能恢复连接，不会因时钟跳变而意外消失。
changes.why_matters_en: Background sessions can reconnect after sleep instead of disappearing due to clock jumps.

changes.raw: Fixed daemon not exiting cleanly after the binary is upgraded (e.g. `brew upgrade`), causing dispatched agents to crash-loop on the deleted path
changes.summary: 升级后守护进程可正常退出
changes.summary_en: Daemon now exits cleanly after upgrades
changes.why_matters: 避免升级后代理因旧路径失效而崩溃循环，保障后台自动化持续运行。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents crash loops after upgrades when the old binary path disappears, keeping background automation running.

changes.raw: Fixed background agents crash-looping when the Claude-in-Chrome extension is connected without a shared tab
changes.summary: 修复Chrome扩展连接崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash loop when Chrome extension is connected
changes.why_matters: 后台代理在特定浏览器连接场景下不再反复崩溃，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Background agents no longer crash-loop in a specific browser connection scenario, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed clicking links in an attached `claude agents` session — the background worker's headless browser shim no longer applies while attached
changes.summary: 附加会话点击链接恢复正常
changes.summary_en: Fix link clicks in attached agent sessions
changes.why_matters: 附加到后台会话时，链接交互不再被错误的浏览器 shim 干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: When attached to a background session, link interactions are no longer disrupted by the wrong browser shim.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` "v to open in editor" using the daemon's default editor instead of your shell's `$EDITOR`/`$VISUAL`
changes.summary: 打开编辑器使用正确环境变量
changes.summary_en: Use shell EDITOR/VISUAL for open-in-editor
changes.why_matters: 用户按下 v 打开编辑器时会遵循自己的终端配置，减少意外。
changes.why_matters_en: Pressing v to open an editor now respects the user's terminal configuration, reducing surprises.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` deadlocking on Windows with network-drive working directories; Ctrl+C now works during startup
changes.summary: 修复Windows网络盘死锁
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows deadlock on network-drive paths
changes.why_matters: Windows 上使用网络盘工作目录时不再卡死，且启动时可正常中断。
changes.why_matters_en: On Windows, network-drive working directories no longer deadlock and startup can be interrupted normally.

changes.raw: Fixed background-color bleed when attaching to a `claude agents` session from Apple Terminal or other 256-color-only terminals
changes.summary: 修复256色终端背景串色
changes.summary_en: Fix background color bleed in 256-color terminals
changes.why_matters: 在旧式终端附加会话时界面显示更正常，不会污染后续颜色。
changes.why_matters_en: Attached sessions render more correctly in 256-color terminals without bleeding colors into later output.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --bg --dangerously-skip-permissions` not persisting across retire/wake
changes.summary: bg跳过权限标志可保留
changes.summary_en: Persist --dangerously-skip-permissions across retire/wake
changes.why_matters: 后台会话在休眠和唤醒后仍保持原有权限状态，避免行为不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Background sessions retain their permission state across retire/wake cycles, avoiding inconsistent behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed session titles being derived from the URL when the first message is a link
changes.summary: 修复链接首条消息标题误判
changes.summary_en: Fix session title from first-link messages
changes.why_matters: 避免会话标题被首条链接内容错误污染，提升记录可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents session titles from being incorrectly derived from a link, improving transcript readability.

changes.raw: Fixed redundant `set_model` requests from remote clients injecting duplicate `/model` breadcrumbs into the transcript
changes.summary: 修复远端重复模型请求
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate model requests from remotes
changes.why_matters: 减少重复的模型切换请求和多余面包屑，避免转录内容混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces duplicate model-switch requests and transcript clutter from repeated breadcrumbs.

changes.raw: Fixed plugins using `skills: ["./"]` showing a false "path escapes plugin directory" error
changes.summary: 修复插件路径误报越界
changes.summary_en: Fix false plugin path escape error
changes.why_matters: 让合法的插件技能路径正常工作，减少误报带来的安装阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows valid plugin skill paths to work correctly and avoids unnecessary install blockers.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin cache cleanup deleting the active plugin version directory when no installation metadata is present
changes.summary: 修复插件缓存误删当前版本
changes.summary_en: Fix cache cleanup deleting active plugin
changes.why_matters: 防止清理缓存时误删正在使用的插件版本，避免插件突然失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents cache cleanup from deleting the active plugin version and breaking plugins unexpectedly.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin` browse pane showing "0 installs" for newly published plugins
changes.summary: 修复新插件安装数显示
changes.summary_en: Fix install count for new plugins
changes.why_matters: 让插件浏览页显示准确安装量，提升插件发现与信任度。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows accurate install counts in the plugin browser, improving discovery and trust.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin advisories not naming every `plugin.json` key that shadows a default folder
changes.summary: 修复插件告警缺少字段名
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin advisory missing shadowed keys
changes.why_matters: 帮助开发者准确定位被默认目录覆盖的配置项，便于修复插件。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps developers identify which config keys are shadowing defaults so they can fix plugins faster.

changes.raw: Improved reactive compaction: the first summarize attempt now seeds from the original request's overflow size, avoiding a wasted near-full-context retry
changes.summary: 优化压缩首轮摘要起点
changes.summary_en: Improve first compaction summarize seed
changes.why_matters: 减少近满上下文下的无效重试，加快压缩并提升长对话稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids wasted retries near context limits, making compaction faster and long chats more stable.

changes.raw: Improved hook configuration error: configuring a prompt- or agent-type hook for `SessionStart`/`Setup`/`SubagentStart` now shows a clear "use a command-type hook instead" error
changes.summary: 优化钩子配置报错提示
changes.summary_en: Improve hook config error guidance
changes.why_matters: 当钩子类型配置错误时给出明确修正建议，减少排查时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Provides a clearer fix when hook types are misconfigured, reducing debugging time.

changes.raw: Removed stale `/model claude-sonnet-4-20250514` suggestion from Usage Policy refusal messages
changes.summary: 移除过时模型建议
changes.summary_en: Remove stale model suggestion
changes.why_matters: 避免拒绝提示中出现过时模型名，减少用户困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents outdated model names from appearing in refusal messages and confusing users.

signals.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
Using Claude Code: The unreasonable effectiveness of HTML
Show HN: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
Tell HN: Dont use Claude Design, lost access to my projects after unsubscribing
A Claude Code and Codex Skill for Deliberate Skill Development

changes.raw: Added `terminalSequence` field to hook JSON output so hooks can emit desktop notifications, window titles, and bells without a controlling terminal
changes.summary: 钩子支持无终端通知输出
changes.summary_en: Hooks can emit notifications without a TTY
changes.why_matters: 让 hooks 在没有控制终端时也能触发桌面通知、窗口标题和铃声，提升自动化可见性。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets hooks trigger desktop notifications, window titles, and bells even without a controlling terminal, improving automation visibility.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS` to clone GitHub plugin sources over HTTPS instead of SSH, for environments without a GitHub SSH key
changes.summary: 插件可用 HTTPS 克隆
changes.summary_en: Clone GitHub plugins over HTTPS
changes.why_matters: 在没有 GitHub SSH key 的环境中也能安装插件，减少企业和受限环境的接入障碍。
changes.why_matters_en: This enables plugin installation in environments without a GitHub SSH key, reducing setup friction in restricted or enterprise setups.

changes.raw: Added `ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID` environment variable for workload identity federation — scopes the minted token to a specific workspace when the federation rule covers more than one
changes.summary: 联邦身份可限定工作区
changes.summary_en: Scope federated tokens to a workspace
changes.why_matters: 把签发令牌限制到特定工作区，降低多工作区联邦身份场景下的权限扩散风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This scopes minted tokens to a specific workspace, reducing privilege spread in multi-workspace federation setups.

changes.raw: Added `claude agents --cwd <path>` to scope the session list to a directory
changes.summary: agents 支持按目录筛选
changes.summary_en: Filter agent sessions by directory
changes.why_matters: 可以只查看某个目录下的会话，便于在大型仓库里定位相关代理活动。
changes.why_matters_en: You can scope the session list to a directory, making it easier to find relevant agent activity in large repos.

changes.raw: `/feedback` can now include recent sessions (last 24 hours or 7 days) for issues spanning more than the current session
changes.summary: 反馈可附带近期会话
changes.summary_en: Feedback can include recent sessions
changes.why_matters: 提交问题时可带上最近会话，帮助描述跨会话复现的问题并提高排查效率。
changes.why_matters_en: You can include recent sessions when filing feedback, which helps report issues that span multiple sessions and speeds debugging.

changes.raw: Rewind menu: added "Summarize up to here" to compress earlier context while keeping recent turns intact
changes.summary: 回溯可压缩前文上下文
changes.summary_en: Summarize earlier context in rewind
changes.why_matters: 在保留最近对话的同时压缩前文，能延长可用上下文并减少重读成本。
changes.why_matters_en: This compresses earlier context while keeping recent turns, extending usable context and reducing rereading overhead.

changes.raw: Auto mode permission dialog now explains when a `permissions.ask` rule caused the prompt
changes.summary: 权限弹窗说明规则来源
changes.summary_en: Permission prompts explain rule source
changes.why_matters: 用户能看懂为什么会被询问权限，减少自动模式下的困惑和误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see why a permission prompt appeared, reducing confusion and misinterpretation in auto mode.

changes.raw: Restored the "view diff in your IDE" option on file-edit permission prompts when an IDE is connected
changes.summary: 恢复 IDE 查看 diff 选项
changes.summary_en: Restore IDE diff viewing option
changes.why_matters: 连接 IDE 时可以直接在编辑器里查看差异，提升代码审查和确认修改的效率。
changes.why_matters_en: When an IDE is connected, you can view diffs directly in the editor, improving review and confirmation speed.

changes.raw: Background agents launched via `/bg` or `←←` now preserve the current permission mode instead of reverting to default
changes.summary: 后台代理保留原权限模式
changes.summary_en: Background agents keep current permission mode
changes.why_matters: 避免后台任务启动后权限模式回退，减少意外阻塞或权限行为不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents background tasks from reverting permission mode, avoiding unexpected blocking and inconsistent behavior.

changes.raw: `claude agents`: agents that finish work but leave a background shell running now move to Completed instead of staying under Working
changes.summary: 完成但挂起的代理归档
changes.summary_en: Agents with lingering shells move to Completed
changes.why_matters: 状态更准确，用户更容易判断代理是否已完成主要工作。
changes.why_matters_en: The status is more accurate, making it easier to tell whether an agent has finished its main work.

changes.raw: Improved spinner feedback during long thinking periods — the spinner now warms to amber after 10 seconds to signal Claude is still working
changes.summary: 长思考时旋转提示变暖色
changes.summary_en: Spinner warms to amber during long thinking
changes.why_matters: 更清楚地提示模型仍在运行，减少用户误以为卡住的焦虑。
changes.why_matters_en: It gives a clearer signal that Claude is still working, reducing the chance users think it has stalled.

changes.raw: Improved plugin menu navigation: `→`/Tab switch tabs, `↑` moves to the tab strip, and tab headers and search box are clickable in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 插件菜单导航更顺手
changes.summary_en: Improved plugin menu navigation
changes.why_matters: 更快切换标签和点击搜索区，降低插件浏览和查找成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Faster tab switching and clickable search areas reduce friction when browsing and finding plugins.

changes.raw: Fixed background side-queries sending an unavailable Haiku model ID on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/gateway when no `ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL` override is set — now falls back to the main-loop model
changes.summary: 后台侧问询回退可用模型
changes.summary_en: Background side-queries fall back to main model
changes.why_matters: 避免在特定云环境中因模型 ID 不可用而导致后台查询失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents background queries from failing in certain cloud environments due to an unavailable model ID.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude daemon status` and `/doctor` on Windows throwing when the daemon pipe key file is locked or unreadable — now shows the underlying error instead of an opaque failure
changes.summary: Windows 诊断显示真实错误
changes.summary_en: Windows daemon status shows real errors
changes.why_matters: 当守护进程文件被锁定或不可读时，能看到底层原因，便于排障。
changes.why_matters_en: When the daemon file is locked or unreadable, users now see the underlying cause, making troubleshooting easier.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` showing the agent-type list instead of the dashboard when launched through a wrapper that adds flags
changes.summary: agents wrapper 启动显示正确页
changes.summary_en: Agents launched via wrapper show dashboard
changes.why_matters: 通过包装器加参数启动时不再误进类型列表，减少入口混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Launching through a wrapper with extra flags no longer opens the wrong view, reducing navigation confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude agents` opening a crashed session firing redundant dispatches when the working directory was deleted
changes.summary: 修复删目录后重复派发
changes.summary_en: Fix redundant dispatches after deleted dir
changes.why_matters: 避免崩溃会话在工作目录被删除后重复触发操作，减少异常和资源浪费。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashed sessions from repeatedly dispatching actions after the working directory is deleted.

changes.raw: Fixed background jobs on a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway not getting auto-named — the namer now uses the main model when no Haiku model is configured
changes.summary: 后台任务自动命名修复
changes.summary_en: Fix auto-naming for background jobs
changes.why_matters: 让后台任务在自定义网关下也能正确命名，提升可读性和管理效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures background jobs are named correctly on custom gateways, improving readability and management.

changes.raw: Fixed `/model` in one session silently changing the autocompact threshold in other concurrent sessions
changes.summary: 修复模型切换串扰阈值
changes.summary_en: Fix model switch affecting other sessions
changes.why_matters: 避免一个会话改模型时影响其他并发会话的自动压缩阈值，防止状态串扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents one session's model change from altering autocompact thresholds in other concurrent sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed switching permission mode while a tool-permission prompt is open not auto-dismissing the prompt when the new setting permits the tool
changes.summary: 权限变更后自动关闭提示
changes.summary_en: Auto-dismiss permission prompt on mode change
changes.why_matters: 当新权限已允许工具时自动关闭提示，减少无效阻塞并提升交互流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Automatically dismisses stale prompts when the new permission mode allows the tool, reducing friction.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing Enter while a permission/dialog prompt is open also submitting text in the input box
changes.summary: 回车不再误提交输入
changes.summary_en: Enter no longer submits input accidentally
changes.why_matters: 防止权限对话框打开时误把输入框内容提交出去，降低误操作风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental submission of input while a permission dialog is open, reducing user mistakes.

changes.raw: Fixed hooks receiving a non-existent `transcript_path` after `EnterWorktree` switches the working directory
changes.summary: 修复工作树切换后钩子路径
changes.summary_en: Fix hook transcript path after worktree switch
changes.why_matters: 确保钩子拿到真实存在的 transcript 路径，避免工作目录切换后集成失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures hooks receive a valid transcript path after worktree switches, preventing integration breakage.

changes.raw: Fixed markdown tables with cell wrapping falling back to the vertical key-value layout instead of rendering as a bordered grid (regression in 2.1.136)
changes.summary: 表格换行恢复边框渲染
changes.summary_en: Restore bordered table rendering on wrap
changes.why_matters: 让换行表格继续以网格形式显示，提升文档可读性和输出一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps wrapped markdown tables rendered as bordered grids, improving readability and consistency.

changes.raw: Fixed cancelled prompts being removed from Up-arrow history when auto-restored into the input box, avoiding duplicate entries
changes.summary: 取消提示不再丢失历史
changes.summary_en: Keep cancelled prompts in history
changes.why_matters: 避免自动恢复的取消提示从历史中消失，减少重复输入和历史混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents auto-restored cancelled prompts from disappearing from history, avoiding duplicates and confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed prompts cancelled with Ctrl+C/Esc before any response being dropped from Up-arrow history
changes.summary: Ctrl+C 前取消也保留历史
changes.summary_en: Keep pre-response cancellations in history
changes.why_matters: 即使在收到回复前取消，也能保留提示记录，方便回溯和重试。
changes.why_matters_en: Preserves prompts cancelled before any response, making it easier to review and retry.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+C not interrupting a running turn while in vim INSERT/VISUAL mode
changes.summary: vim 模式下可中断运行
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+C interrupts turns in vim mode
changes.why_matters: 修复 vim 插入/可视模式下无法中断运行的问题，提升可控性和安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores interruption control in vim INSERT/VISUAL mode, improving responsiveness and safety.

changes.raw: Fixed alternative `chat:submit` keybindings (e.g. `meta+enter`, `ctrl+enter`) not working when `enter` is rebound to `chat:newline`
changes.summary: 替代提交快捷键恢复可用
changes.summary_en: Alt submit keybindings work again
changes.why_matters: 当回车被改成换行时，仍可用其他提交快捷键正常发送消息，避免键位冲突。
changes.why_matters_en: Alternative submit shortcuts still work when Enter is rebound to newline, avoiding keybinding conflicts.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt suggestions being silently disabled when an output style was configured
changes.summary: 输出样式不再禁用建议
changes.summary_en: Prompt suggestions stay enabled with output styles
changes.why_matters: 保留提示建议功能，减少因配置输出样式而意外失去辅助输入。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps prompt suggestions available even with output styles configured, preserving input assistance.

changes.raw: Fixed `spinnerVerbs` setting not being honored in turn-completion messages
changes.summary: 完成消息词汇可配置
changes.summary_en: Honor spinnerVerbs in completion messages
changes.why_matters: 让完成提示文案遵循用户配置，增强一致性和可定制性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes completion messages respect user configuration, improving consistency and customization.

changes.raw: Fixed AskUserQuestion popup hiding the last line of preceding chat content
changes.summary: 问答弹窗不遮挡上一行
changes.summary_en: AskUserQuestion popup no longer hides text
changes.why_matters: 避免弹窗遮住前文最后一行，提升上下文可见性和阅读体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the popup from covering the last line of prior chat content, improving context visibility.

changes.raw: Fixed Web Search status showing "Did 0 searches" when searches returned errors
changes.summary: 搜索错误时状态更准确
changes.summary_en: Web Search status reflects errors
changes.why_matters: 搜索失败时不再显示误导性的成功统计，帮助用户更快判断问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids misleading search counts when errors occur, helping users diagnose issues faster.

changes.raw: Fixed multi-line statusline output dropping or corrupting rows when any line exceeds terminal width
changes.summary: 修复多行状态栏截断错行
changes.summary_en: Fix multi-line statusline row corruption
changes.why_matters: 避免状态栏在宽度不足时显示错乱，提升终端界面稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents statusline corruption on narrow terminals and improves UI stability.

changes.raw: Fixed light-ansi theme using invisible white for diff context lines on light backgrounds — now uses black
changes.summary: 修复浅色主题差异行不可见
changes.summary_en: Fix invisible diff context on light themes
changes.why_matters: 让浅色背景下的 diff 上下文更清晰，减少阅读代码变更时的视觉问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes diff context readable on light backgrounds and reduces visual confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed error overlay dumping minified bundle source that hid the original error message
changes.summary: 修复错误页隐藏原始报错
changes.summary_en: Fix error overlay hiding original error
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户直接看到真实错误信息，便于排查问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users see the real error message directly, making debugging easier.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing Enter after typing a feedback survey rating digit submitting it as a chat message instead of the rating
changes.summary: 修复评分回车误发聊天消息
changes.summary_en: Fix survey rating Enter sending chat
changes.why_matters: 避免反馈评分被误提交为聊天内容，减少交互误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents survey ratings from being sent as chat messages by mistake.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing `x` on a selected subagent in the agent panel typing into the prompt instead of stopping the agent
changes.summary: 修复子代理停止键输入失效
changes.summary_en: Fix x key not stopping selected subagent
changes.why_matters: 让用户能正确停止子代理，提升代理面板的可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores the ability to stop a selected subagent, improving control in the agent panel.

changes.raw: Fixed session title being derived from plugin monitor notifications before the user's first prompt
changes.summary: 修复会话标题过早取自插件通知
changes.summary_en: Fix session title using plugin notices too early
changes.why_matters: 避免会话标题在首条用户输入前被错误命名，提升历史记录可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents session titles from being misnamed before the first user prompt, improving history clarity.

changes.raw: Fixed "Allowed by PermissionRequest hook" repeating once per tool call under a collapsed read/search group
changes.summary: 修复权限提示重复显示
changes.summary_en: Fix repeated permission hook messages
changes.why_matters: 减少折叠分组下的重复提示噪音，让权限状态更易读。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces noisy repeated permission messages and makes permission state easier to read.

changes.raw: Fixed `/tui` silently dropping running background shells and subagents — now refuses and asks to wait for them to finish
changes.summary: 修复/tui误丢后台任务
changes.summary_en: Fix /tui dropping running background tasks
changes.why_matters: 避免切换 TUI 时丢失正在运行的 shell 和子代理，防止工作中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents losing active shells and subagents when switching TUI, avoiding workflow interruption.

changes.raw: Fixed welcome banner showing "API Usage Billing" on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and other third-party providers — now shows the provider name
changes.summary: 修复欢迎语显示错误计费名
changes.summary_en: Fix welcome banner showing wrong billing label
changes.why_matters: 让第三方模型提供商的欢迎信息更准确，减少用户困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes welcome messaging accurate for third-party providers and reduces confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed `/mcp` server list not keeping the focused server visible in short terminals in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 修复短屏幕MCP列表焦点丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP list focus visibility in short terminals
changes.why_matters: 确保全屏模式下仍能看到当前选中的服务器，便于管理 MCP 配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the focused server visible in fullscreen mode, making MCP management easier.

changes.raw: Fixed redaction in `/feedback` bundles producing invalid JSON for quoted values like session IDs
changes.summary: 修复反馈包JSON转义错误
changes.summary_en: Fix invalid JSON in feedback bundles
changes.why_matters: 保证反馈导出可被正确解析，避免因格式错误导致上报失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures feedback exports remain parseable and avoids failures caused by malformed JSON.

changes.raw: Fixed desktop and third-party provider sessions incorrectly inheriting `apiKeyHelper`/`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` from host managed-settings
changes.summary: 修复继承宿主认证环境变量
changes.summary_en: Fix inherited auth env vars in provider sessions
changes.why_matters: 防止第三方或桌面会话错误使用宿主机凭据，避免认证串用和安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents provider sessions from reusing host credentials incorrectly, reducing auth mix-ups and security risk.

changes.raw: Fixed early analytics events being silently dropped when fired before logger initialization
changes.summary: 修复早期分析事件丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix early analytics events being dropped
changes.why_matters: 确保初始化前触发的埋点也能被记录，提升数据完整性。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures events fired before logger initialization are still captured, improving analytics completeness.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for plugins whose marketplace `ref` no longer exists upstream when a `sha` is also pinned
changes.summary: 修复插件安装找不到上游引用
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin install when upstream ref is missing
changes.why_matters: 让已固定 SHA 的插件在上游 ref 失效时仍可安装，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows pinned-SHA plugins to install even if the upstream ref disappears, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin details pane showing 0 MCP servers for plugins that declare them via `.mcp.json`
changes.summary: 修复插件详情MCP数量为零
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin details showing zero MCP servers
changes.why_matters: 正确展示插件声明的 MCP 服务数量，避免信息误导。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows the correct number of declared MCP servers and avoids misleading plugin details.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin MCP servers with unset config variables showing a generic connection failure instead of a "config issue" message with a fix-it hint; malformed `.mcp.json` entries no longer drop other MCP servers
changes.summary: 修复MCP配置错误提示与解析
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP config error handling and parsing
changes.why_matters: 让用户更快定位配置问题，并避免一个损坏条目影响其他服务器。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users diagnose config issues faster and prevents one bad entry from breaking other servers.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP server configs using POSIX shell parameter expansions (e.g. `${var%pattern}`) being incorrectly flagged as missing environment variables
changes.summary: 修复MCP环境变量误报缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix false missing-env detection in MCP configs
changes.why_matters: 避免把合法的 shell 参数展开误判为缺失变量，减少配置误报。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents valid shell parameter expansions from being misclassified as missing variables.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP HTTP/SSE servers returning 403 on connect showing as "failed" instead of "needs auth"
changes.summary: 修复MCP 403认证状态提示
changes.summary_en: Show auth-needed state for MCP 403 responses
changes.why_matters: 让用户知道是需要认证而不是连接失败，便于正确处理访问问题。
changes.why_matters_en: This tells users they need authentication instead of treating the issue as a generic connection failure.

changes.raw: Fixed remote MCP servers disconnecting unnecessarily when the optional server-events stream failed to reconnect — tool calls continue over POST
changes.summary: 修复远程MCP断线重连过度
changes.summary_en: Keep remote MCP tools working after stream failure
changes.why_matters: 即使事件流重连失败，工具调用仍可继续，提升远程集成稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Tool calls keep working even if the event stream cannot reconnect, improving remote integration reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control MCP connectors all failing with 401 when the worker session token rotated mid-session
changes.summary: 修复远程控制会话令牌轮换
changes.summary_en: Fix Remote Control auth after session token rotation
changes.why_matters: 避免会话中途因令牌刷新导致所有连接失败，保障远程控制可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents all connectors from failing when the session token rotates mid-session, preserving remote control availability.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control automatically re-enrolling a trusted device when the server rejects a stale token, instead of looping through `/login`
changes.summary: 修复远程控制过期令牌重登记
changes.summary_en: Re-enroll trusted devices on stale token rejection
changes.why_matters: 减少反复登录循环，让受信设备在令牌过期后能自动恢复。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids repeated login loops and lets trusted devices recover automatically after token expiry.

changes.raw: Fixed a race where early OTel spans could be silently dropped in SDK/headless mode with beta tracing enabled
changes.summary: 修复早期OTel埋点丢失
changes.summary_en: Prevent early OTel spans from being dropped
changes.why_matters: 确保调试和可观测性数据更完整，便于排查头less/SDK场景问题。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps observability data complete, making headless and SDK debugging more reliable.

changes.raw: Fixed custom `voice:pushToTalk` keybindings and `"space": null` unbinds being silently ignored
changes.summary: 修复语音按键绑定被忽略
changes.summary_en: Respect custom voice keybindings and unbinds
changes.why_matters: 让用户自定义语音快捷键真正生效，提升交互可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes custom voice shortcuts work as expected, improving interaction control.

changes.raw: Fixed Windows Alt+V image paste reporting "no image found" when the clipboard contains a screenshot
changes.summary: 修复Windows截图粘贴识别
changes.summary_en: Detect pasted screenshots on Windows Alt+V
changes.why_matters: 避免截图明明在剪贴板里却被误报为空，提升图片输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents screenshots from being falsely reported as missing, improving image paste reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed SDK "Claude Code native binary not found" on Linux when both glibc and musl platform packages are installed
changes.summary: 修复Linux原生二进制缺失误报
changes.summary_en: Fix Linux native binary detection with glibc/musl
changes.why_matters: 避免在同时安装不同平台包时误判缺少二进制，减少SDK启动失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents false missing-binary errors when both platform packages are installed, reducing SDK startup failures.

changes.raw: Bedrock: `awsCredentialExport` now always runs when configured instead of being skipped when ambient AWS credentials resolve, fixing auth for cross-account access
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock跨账号认证导出
changes.summary_en: Always run awsCredentialExport for Bedrock auth
changes.why_matters: 确保跨账号访问时正确使用导出的AWS凭证，避免认证失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures exported AWS credentials are used for cross-account access, preventing auth failures.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed in-chat mic showing no feedback when the microphone produced only silence — now shows "No audio detected"
changes.summary: 修复VSCode语音静音反馈
changes.summary_en: Show no-audio feedback in VSCode mic flow
changes.why_matters: 当麦克风只有静音时给出明确提示，减少用户困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: This gives clear feedback when the mic captures silence, reducing user confusion.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Voice mode: the WSL error now suggests installing `sox libsox-fmt-pulse` for WSLg users
changes.summary: 改进WSL语音错误提示
changes.summary_en: Suggest WSLg audio packages in voice errors
changes.why_matters: 为WSL用户提供更具体的修复建议，缩短排障时间。
changes.why_matters_en: This gives WSL users a more actionable fix, shortening troubleshooting time.

changes.raw: `claude agents`: launching a session no longer fails when the pre-warmed background worker is unhealthy — now falls back to a fresh launch
changes.summary: 修复agents预热失败回退
changes.summary_en: Fallback to fresh launch when worker is unhealthy
changes.why_matters: 即使预热后台 worker 异常，仍能正常启动会话，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Sessions can still start when the pre-warmed worker is unhealthy, improving availability.

changes.raw: `claude agents` no longer shows empty placeholder sessions left over from backgrounding a fresh REPL, and shows onboarding text when entered via ← with no other agents
changes.summary: 修复agents空占位会话显示
changes.summary_en: Hide empty placeholder sessions in claude agents
changes.why_matters: 让会话列表更干净，并在首次进入时显示正确引导内容。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps the session list clean and shows the right onboarding text on first entry.

changes.raw: Empty idle background sessions left over from `←` are now automatically retired by the daemon after 5 minutes
changes.summary: 自动回收空闲后台会话
changes.summary_en: Auto-retire idle background sessions
changes.why_matters: 减少因返回后台后遗留的空闲会话占用资源，保持环境更整洁。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces resource waste from idle sessions left behind after returning to the background.
