changes.raw: Improved Agent tool `subagent_type` matching to accept case- and separator-insensitive values (e.g. `"Code Reviewer"` resolves to `code-reviewer`)
changes.summary: 子代理类型匹配更宽松
changes.summary_en: More flexible subagent type matching
changes.why_matters: 用户可以用更自然的名称配置子代理，减少因大小写或分隔符差异导致的失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can configure subagents with more natural names, avoiding failures from case or separator differences.

changes.raw: Updated agent color palette
changes.summary: 更新代理颜色配色
changes.summary_en: Updated agent color palette
changes.why_matters: 界面视觉效果更统一，提升日常使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: The UI looks more consistent and polished, improving everyday usability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/goal` silently hanging when `disableAllHooks` or `allowManagedHooksOnly` is set — now shows a clear message instead of an indicator that never resolves
changes.summary: /goal 不再无提示卡住
changes.summary_en: /goal no longer hangs silently
changes.why_matters: 当 hooks 配置限制了行为时，用户会得到明确反馈，避免命令看似无响应。
changes.why_matters_en: Users now get a clear message when hooks settings block behavior, instead of a command that appears stuck.

changes.raw: Fixed a regression in settings hot-reload where symlinked settings files caused misattributed change events and spurious `ConfigChange` hooks
changes.summary: 修复热重载误触发钩子
changes.summary_en: Fixed hot-reload misfiring hooks
changes.why_matters: 避免符号链接设置文件引发错误变更事件和多余的配置钩子执行。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents symlinked settings files from causing false change events and spurious config hooks.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --bg` failing with "connection dropped mid-request" when the background service was about to idle-exit
changes.summary: 修复后台模式连接中断
changes.summary_en: Fixed background mode connection drop
changes.why_matters: 后台任务在接近空闲退出时也能稳定完成请求，减少失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Background jobs can now finish reliably even when the service is about to idle-exit.

changes.raw: Fixed background service startup failing on machines with enterprise endpoint security by allowing more time
changes.summary: 提升后台服务启动容错
changes.summary_en: Improved background service startup reliability
changes.why_matters: 在企业终端安全软件环境下更容易启动，减少安装后不可用的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: The service starts more reliably on machines with enterprise endpoint security, reducing post-install failures.

changes.raw: Fixed remote managed settings not retrying on 401 — now retries once with a force-refreshed token
changes.summary: 远程受管设置 401 自动重试
changes.summary_en: Remote managed settings retry on 401
changes.why_matters: 令牌过期时会自动刷新并重试一次，减少人工排障。
changes.why_matters_en: When a token expires, the client now refreshes and retries once, reducing manual troubleshooting.

changes.raw: Fixed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` auto-update policy not being persisted to `known_marketplaces.json`
changes.summary: 受管市场自动更新可持久化
changes.summary_en: Managed marketplace updates now persist
changes.why_matters: 自动更新策略会正确保存，避免重启后配置丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: The auto-update policy is now saved correctly, so it won't be lost after restart.

changes.raw: Fixed `/loop` scheduling redundant wakeups to poll for background tasks that already notify on completion
changes.summary: 减少循环任务冗余唤醒
changes.summary_en: Reduced redundant wakeups in /loop
changes.why_matters: 后台任务完成后不再重复轮询，降低资源浪费。
changes.why_matters_en: The CLI no longer polls unnecessarily for tasks that already notify on completion, saving resources.

changes.raw: Fixed a recurring event-loop stall on Windows when a missing executable (e.g. `gh`) triggered synchronous `where.exe` re-spawns on every check
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 事件循环卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fixed Windows event-loop stalls
changes.why_matters: 缺少可执行文件时不再反复同步重启检查，显著提升 Windows 响应性。
changes.why_matters_en: Missing executables no longer trigger repeated synchronous checks, greatly improving Windows responsiveness.

changes.raw: Fixed `Read` tool calls failing validation when `offset` is passed as a whitespace-padded or `+`-prefixed string
changes.summary: Read 偏移参数校验更宽松
changes.summary_en: Read offset validation is more tolerant
changes.why_matters: 带空格或加号前缀的偏移值也能正常解析，减少工具调用失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Offsets with whitespace or a plus sign now validate correctly, reducing tool-call failures.

changes.raw: Fixed native terminal cursor not staying at the input caret when the terminal loses focus
changes.summary: 终端失焦后光标保持正确
changes.summary_en: Cursor stays at caret after focus loss
changes.why_matters: 输入光标位置更稳定，减少编辑时的视觉错位。
changes.why_matters_en: The input cursor stays stable, reducing visual misalignment while typing.

changes.raw: Plugins now warn when a default component folder (e.g. `commands/`) is silently ignored because `plugin.json` sets the matching key. Shown in `/doctor`, `claude plugin list`, and `/plugin`.
changes.summary: 插件忽略项现在会提示
changes.summary_en: Plugins now warn on ignored folders
changes.why_matters: 用户能及时发现默认组件目录被配置覆盖而未生效，避免插件行为不符合预期。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now see when a default component folder is ignored due to plugin.json settings, preventing surprises.

changes.raw: Added agent view (Research Preview): a single list of every Claude Code session — running, blocked on you, or done. Run `claude agents` to get started. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-view
changes.summary: 新增 Agent 视图总览会话
changes.summary_en: Added agent view for all sessions
changes.why_matters: 让用户能一眼查看所有 Claude Code 会话状态，便于管理正在运行、被阻塞和已完成的任务。
changes.why_matters_en: It gives users a single place to monitor running, blocked, and completed sessions.

changes.raw: Added `/goal` command: set a completion condition and Claude keeps working across turns until it's met. Works in interactive, `-p`, and Remote Control. Shows live elapsed/turns/tokens as an overlay panel
changes.summary: 新增 /goal 持续完成目标
changes.summary_en: Added /goal to keep working until done
changes.why_matters: 用户可以定义完成条件，让 Claude 跨轮次持续推进直到达成目标，显著提升自动化执行能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can define a completion condition and let Claude keep working across turns until it is met.

changes.raw: Added `/scroll-speed` command to tune mouse wheel scroll speed with a live preview
changes.summary: 新增滚轮速度调节命令
changes.summary_en: Added /scroll-speed to tune wheel speed
changes.why_matters: 让用户更方便地按个人习惯调整界面滚动体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets users tune the scrolling experience to their preference.

changes.raw: Added `claude plugin details <name>` to show a plugin's component inventory and projected per-session token cost
changes.summary: 查看插件详情与成本
changes.summary_en: Added plugin details with token cost
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户在安装或使用插件前了解其组件和预估 token 成本，便于决策。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users inspect a plugin's components and estimated token cost before using it.

changes.raw: Added transcript view navigation: `?` for keyboard shortcuts, `{`/`}` to jump between user prompts, `v` to toggle shortcut panel
changes.summary: 增强转录视图导航
changes.summary_en: Improved transcript navigation shortcuts
changes.why_matters: 让用户在长对话中更快跳转和查看快捷键，提高阅读效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes long transcripts easier to navigate and inspect.

changes.raw: Added hook `args: string[]` field (exec form) that spawns the command directly without a shell, so path placeholders never need quoting
changes.summary: Hook 直执行免 shell 转义
changes.summary_en: Hooks now run directly without shell
changes.why_matters: 避免路径占位符因 shell 引号问题出错，提高 hook 执行可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: It avoids shell quoting issues for path placeholders and makes hook execution more reliable.

changes.raw: Added hook `continueOnBlock` config option for `PostToolUse` — set to `true` to feed the hook's rejection reason back to Claude and continue the turn
changes.summary: Hook 可回传阻塞原因继续
changes.summary_en: Added continueOnBlock for PostToolUse
changes.why_matters: 当 hook 拒绝操作时，Claude 可以接收原因并继续当前轮次，减少中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Claude can receive the rejection reason and continue the turn instead of stopping.

changes.raw: MCP stdio servers now receive `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` in their environment, matching hooks. Plugin configs can reference `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}` in commands
changes.summary: MCP 与插件支持项目目录变量
changes.summary_en: MCP and plugins now get project dir env
changes.why_matters: 让 MCP 服务和插件命令更容易引用当前项目路径，提升配置一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes MCP servers and plugin commands easier to configure with the current project path.

changes.raw: Compaction prompt now asks the model to preserve sensitive user instructions
changes.summary: 压缩提示保留敏感指令
changes.summary_en: Compaction now preserves sensitive instructions
changes.why_matters: 减少上下文压缩后丢失关键安全或敏感指令的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces the risk of losing important sensitive instructions during compaction.

changes.raw: `/mcp` Reconnect now picks up `.mcp.json` edits without a restart, and shows the HTTP status and URL when reconnecting fails
changes.summary: MCP 重连可热加载配置
changes.summary_en: MCP reconnect now reloads config edits
changes.why_matters: 用户修改 `.mcp.json` 后无需重启即可生效，并能更快定位重连失败原因。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can apply `.mcp.json` changes without restarting and diagnose reconnect failures faster.

changes.raw: `/context all` per-skill token estimates now account for the model's tokenizer and show rounded values
changes.summary: /context 估算更准确
changes.summary_en: Improved per-skill token estimates
changes.why_matters: 更准确的 token 估算帮助用户更好控制上下文预算。
changes.why_matters_en: More accurate token estimates help users manage context budget better.

changes.raw: `claude plugin install <name>@<marketplace>` now auto-refreshes the marketplace and retries before reporting a plugin as not found
changes.summary: 插件安装失败自动重试
changes.summary_en: Plugin install now auto-refreshes and retries
changes.why_matters: 减少因市场信息过期导致的插件安装失败，提高安装成功率。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces plugin install failures caused by stale marketplace data.

changes.raw: `/plugin` installed-plugin details now show hook event names and MCP server names cleanly
changes.summary: 插件详情展示更清晰
changes.summary_en: Improved plugin detail display
changes.why_matters: 让用户更容易看懂已安装插件的 hook 和 MCP 组件信息。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes installed plugin hooks and MCP server names easier to read.

changes.raw: `/context` now shows the providing plugin's name for plugin-sourced skills
changes.summary: 显示技能来源插件名
changes.summary_en: Context now shows skill source plugin
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户追踪某个技能来自哪个插件，便于排查和管理。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users trace which plugin provided a skill for easier management.

changes.raw: Remote MCP server reconnect retry on transient failures is now enabled for all users
changes.summary: 远程 MCP 自动重连增强
changes.summary_en: Remote MCP reconnect retry enabled for all
changes.why_matters: 提升远程 MCP 在临时故障下的可用性，减少连接中断。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves remote MCP availability by retrying transient failures automatically.

changes.raw: API requests from subagents now carry `x-claude-code-agent-id` / `x-claude-code-parent-agent-id` headers, and `claude_code.llm_request` OTEL spans include `agent_id` / `parent_agent_id` attributes
changes.summary: 子代理请求可追踪
changes.summary_en: Trace subagent requests
changes.why_matters: 为子代理请求和 OTEL span 增加代理标识，便于排查多代理协作中的调用链路。
changes.why_matters_en: Adds agent identifiers to subagent requests and OTEL spans, making multi-agent call chains easier to trace.

changes.raw: Remote Control, `/schedule`, claude.ai MCP connectors, and notification preferences are now disabled when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `apiKeyHelper` / `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` is set, even if a Claude.ai login also exists. Unset the API key to use these features
changes.summary: API模式禁用部分云功能
changes.summary_en: API mode disables some cloud features
changes.why_matters: 当设置了 API 凭据时会禁用远程控制和部分 Claude.ai 功能，可能改变现有工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: When API credentials are set, remote control and some Claude.ai features are disabled, which can change existing workflows.

changes.raw: Fixed a deadlock where expired credentials and the `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` policy setting blocked `claude auth login`/`logout`/`status` with no way to recover
changes.summary: 修复登录退出死锁
changes.summary_en: Fix auth login/logout deadlock
changes.why_matters: 修复过期凭据与远程设置刷新导致的死锁，避免认证功能完全卡死且无法恢复。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes a deadlock caused by expired credentials and remote settings refresh, preventing auth flows from getting stuck with no recovery.

changes.raw: Fixed `autoAllowBashIfSandboxed` not auto-approving commands with shell expansions like `$VAR` and `$(cmd)`
changes.summary: 沙箱下自动放行更准确
changes.summary_en: Better auto-allow in sandbox
changes.why_matters: 修复带变量展开的命令无法自动批准的问题，减少沙箱环境下的手动确认。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes auto-approval for commands with shell expansions, reducing manual prompts in sandboxed workflows.

changes.raw: Fixed a bug where a hook writing to the terminal could corrupt an on-screen interactive prompt; hooks now run without terminal access
changes.summary: Hook不再干扰终端提示
changes.summary_en: Hooks no longer corrupt prompts
changes.why_matters: 限制 hook 访问终端，避免其输出破坏交互式提示界面。
changes.why_matters_en: Hooks no longer access the terminal, preventing their output from corrupting interactive prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed unbounded memory growth when an HTTP/SSE MCP server streams non-protocol data — response bodies now capped at 16 MB per SSE frame
changes.summary: 限制SSE内存占用
changes.summary_en: Cap SSE memory usage
changes.why_matters: 为异常 SSE 数据设置 16 MB 上限，防止 MCP 流式连接导致内存无限增长。
changes.why_matters_en: Caps malformed SSE frame bodies at 16 MB to prevent unbounded memory growth from streaming MCP servers.

changes.raw: Fixed `Skill(name *)` permission rules — the wildcard form now works as a prefix match, matching `Bash(ls *)` behavior
changes.summary: Skill通配规则修正
changes.summary_en: Fix Skill wildcard matching
changes.why_matters: 让 Skill 的 `*` 规则按前缀匹配生效，权限行为更符合预期。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes `Skill(name *)` work as a prefix match, aligning permission behavior with expectations.

changes.raw: Fixed settings hot-reload not detecting edits to symlinked `~/.claude/settings.json`
changes.summary: 支持软链设置热更新
changes.summary_en: Hot-reload symlinked settings
changes.why_matters: 编辑软链接指向的设置文件后也能被及时检测并热重载。
changes.why_matters_en: Edits to symlinked settings files are now detected and hot-reloaded correctly.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin details failing to load when the marketplace key differs from the manifest name
changes.summary: 插件详情加载更稳定
changes.summary_en: Plugin details load reliably
changes.why_matters: 当市场 key 与 manifest 名称不一致时也能正常加载插件详情。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin details now load even when the marketplace key differs from the manifest name.

changes.raw: Fixed `/model` picker "Default" row not reflecting `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`/`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` overrides
changes.summary: 模型默认项显示正确
changes.summary_en: Default model row shows overrides
changes.why_matters: 模型选择器中的默认项会正确反映环境变量覆盖值，减少误选。
changes.why_matters_en: The model picker's Default row now reflects environment variable overrides, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed spurious "stream idle timeout" 5 minutes after a response completed, caused by the watchdog timer not being cleared on stream cancellation
changes.summary: 修复流空闲误报
changes.summary_en: Fix false stream idle timeout
changes.why_matters: 避免响应结束后仍触发超时告警，减少误报和不必要的中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents a timeout warning from firing after a response has already completed, reducing false alarms and interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed silent `exit 1` when 10+ MCP servers are configured and the cache directory is unwritable — the error message now includes the underlying cause
changes.summary: MCP服务器报错更清晰
changes.summary_en: Clearer MCP server errors
changes.why_matters: 缓存目录不可写时会显示真实原因，便于定位多服务器配置下的退出问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows the underlying cause when the cache directory is unwritable, making multi-server failures easier to diagnose.

changes.raw: Fixed a typing cursor blinking on tab names, list pointers, and select rows in dialogs
changes.summary: 界面光标闪烁修复
changes.summary_en: Fix cursor blinking artifacts
changes.why_matters: 修复标签页、列表和选择框中的光标闪烁显示问题，提升界面观感。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes cursor blinking artifacts in tabs, lists, and dialogs for a cleaner UI.

changes.raw: Fixed transcript view letter shortcuts not working after mouse click
changes.summary: 转录视图快捷键恢复
changes.summary_en: Transcript shortcuts work again
changes.why_matters: 鼠标点击后字母快捷键仍可使用，提升转录视图操作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Letter shortcuts keep working after mouse clicks, improving transcript navigation efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash-mode up-arrow history repeating the first entry and clobbering the in-progress draft
changes.summary: Bash历史导航不再覆盖草稿
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash history draft overwrite
changes.why_matters: 上箭头浏览历史时不会再重复首条记录并覆盖当前输入草稿。
changes.why_matters_en: Up-arrow history navigation no longer repeats the first entry or clobbers the in-progress draft.

changes.raw: Fixed pasting or dropping multiple images only inserting the last one
changes.summary: 修复多图粘贴/拖拽只插入最后一张
changes.summary_en: Fix multi-image paste/drop inserting only last image
changes.why_matters: 用户一次添加多张图片时不再丢失内容，提升多模态输入的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now paste or drop multiple images without losing earlier ones, improving multimodal input reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed hyperlinks using unreadable dark navy on dark themes — they now adapt to the active theme
changes.summary: 修复深色主题链接颜色过暗
changes.summary_en: Fix hyperlink color on dark themes
changes.why_matters: 链接在深色主题下更易辨认，减少阅读和点击困难。
changes.why_matters_en: Hyperlinks are now readable on dark themes, reducing visual strain and missed clicks.

changes.raw: Fixed model picker showing a redundant "Current model" row for third-party users whose model is set to the `opus` alias
changes.summary: 修复第三方模型选择器重复当前模型
changes.summary_en: Fix redundant current-model row for 3P users
changes.why_matters: 模型列表更简洁，避免用户对当前模型状态产生混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: The model picker is less confusing because it no longer shows a duplicate current-model entry.

changes.raw: Fixed legacy Opus picker entry on PAYG 3P providers resolving to the same model as the default entry
changes.summary: 修复 PAYG 3P Opus 入口指向重复模型
changes.summary_en: Fix legacy Opus entry resolving to duplicate model
changes.why_matters: 用户选择旧版入口时会得到正确模型，减少第三方接入歧义。
changes.why_matters_en: Legacy provider entries now resolve correctly, avoiding confusion in third-party model selection.

changes.raw: Fixed mouse wheel scrolling speed in Cursor and VS Code 1.92–1.104; the trackpad now scrolls at a steady rate and the mouse wheel keeps ~3 lines per notch
changes.summary: 修复鼠标滚轮与触控板滚动异常
changes.summary_en: Fix mouse wheel and trackpad scrolling behavior
changes.why_matters: 在常用编辑器中滚动更稳定，提升长文档和代码浏览体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Scrolling is now consistent in common editors, improving navigation through long code and output.

changes.raw: Fixed scroll behavior in Windows Terminal and VS Code when attached to background sessions
changes.summary: 修复后台会话中的滚动行为
changes.summary_en: Fix scrolling in background sessions
changes.why_matters: 在终端里查看后台会话输出时，滚动交互更符合预期。
changes.why_matters_en: Scrolling works correctly when attached to background sessions, making terminal output easier to inspect.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP resources from disconnected servers lingering in `@server:` autocomplete
changes.summary: 修复断开 MCP 资源仍留在补全中
changes.summary_en: Fix stale MCP resources in autocomplete
changes.why_matters: 自动补全不会再显示失效资源，减少误选和无效操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Autocomplete no longer suggests disconnected resources, reducing mistaken selections.

changes.raw: Fixed two-file diff snippets over-reporting the number of truncated lines by one
changes.summary: 修复双文件 diff 截断行数偏差
changes.summary_en: Fix off-by-one truncated lines in two-file diffs
changes.why_matters: 差异预览的行数更准确，帮助用户正确判断内容是否被截断。
changes.why_matters_en: Diff previews now report truncation accurately, helping users judge what was omitted.

changes.raw: Fixed Grep results not relativizing Windows drive-letter paths and count mode reporting wrong totals for single-file paths
changes.summary: 修复 Grep 路径与计数统计错误
changes.summary_en: Fix Grep path relativization and count totals
changes.why_matters: 搜索结果路径和数量更准确，便于在 Windows 上定位文件。
changes.why_matters_en: Grep results are now more accurate on Windows, making file location and counts reliable.

changes.raw: Fixed border-embedded text overflowing on CJK/emoji due to visual cell width miscalculation
changes.summary: 修复 CJK/emoji 边框文本溢出
changes.summary_en: Fix border text overflow for CJK and emoji
changes.why_matters: 包含中文或表情的界面文本显示更整齐，不会被边框挤出。
changes.why_matters_en: UI text with CJK or emoji now fits correctly inside borders, preventing visual overflow.

changes.raw: Fixed fuzzy-match highlighting splitting emoji and astral-plane characters mid-pair
changes.summary: 修复 emoji 高亮切断字符对
changes.summary_en: Fix fuzzy-match highlighting splitting emoji
changes.why_matters: 高亮不会破坏复杂字符显示，避免乱码和视觉错位。
changes.why_matters_en: Highlighting no longer splits emoji or astral characters, preventing rendering glitches.

changes.raw: Fixed skill argument names containing regex metacharacters breaking argument substitution
changes.summary: 修复技能参数替换遇到特殊字符失败
changes.summary_en: Fix skill arg substitution with regex metacharacters
changes.why_matters: 包含特殊符号的参数也能正确传递，提升技能调用可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Skill arguments with special characters now substitute correctly, improving invocation reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed ProgressBar rendering a full block for an almost-full fractional cell
changes.summary: 修复进度条接近满格时显示异常
changes.summary_en: Fix progress bar rendering near full
changes.why_matters: 进度显示更准确，避免用户误判任务完成状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Progress bars now render correctly near completion, reducing confusion about task status.

changes.raw: Fixed task polling and `fs.watch` being resurrected when the last subscriber leaves while a fetch is in flight
changes.summary: 修复最后订阅者离开后任务仍被唤醒
changes.summary_en: Fix polling and fs.watch reviving after last subscriber leaves
changes.why_matters: 减少无用后台活动，降低资源浪费和意外唤醒。
changes.why_matters_en: Background polling and file watching now stop properly, saving resources and avoiding stray activity.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin dependency resolution leaving a stale count when the manifest name differs from the source identifier
changes.summary: 修复插件依赖计数残留错误
changes.summary_en: Fix stale plugin dependency count
changes.why_matters: 插件依赖状态显示更准确，便于排查和管理扩展。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin dependency counts are now accurate, making extension management and troubleshooting easier.

changes.raw: Fixed Insights Time-of-Day chart skewing when a session has an unparseable timestamp
changes.summary: 修复洞察时间图表偏斜
changes.summary_en: Fix Insights time chart skew
changes.why_matters: 避免单个无法解析的时间戳影响统计展示，提升洞察数据准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents one bad timestamp from distorting analytics and improves insight accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed keybindings using only the cmd/super/win modifier being flagged as unparseable
changes.summary: 修复单独修饰键快捷键解析
changes.summary_en: Fix single-modifier keybinding parsing
changes.why_matters: 让仅使用 cmd/super/win 的快捷键能被正确识别，减少配置报错。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows single-modifier shortcuts to be recognized correctly and avoids config errors.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude_code.active_time.total` OpenTelemetry metric not being emitted in `--print` mode
changes.summary: 补发打印模式活跃时长指标
changes.summary_en: Emit active time metric in print mode
changes.why_matters: 确保 `--print` 模式下也能上报关键遥测指标，便于完整监控使用情况。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures key telemetry is emitted in `--print` mode for complete usage monitoring.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude plugin update` not preserving cross-plugin symlinks inside a marketplace
changes.summary: 更新插件保留跨插件符号链接
changes.summary_en: Preserve cross-plugin symlinks on update
changes.why_matters: 避免市场内插件更新后链接失效，减少插件依赖被破坏的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents marketplace plugin updates from breaking symlinked dependencies.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T to reopen the most recently closed session tab, configurable via `claudeCode.enableReopenClosedSessionShortcut`
changes.summary: 支持重开最近关闭会话标签
changes.summary_en: Reopen recently closed session tab
changes.why_matters: 让 VSCode 中误关的会话更容易恢复，提升多会话操作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes it easier to recover accidentally closed sessions and improves multi-session workflow efficiency.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY_FOR_OTEL` to re-enable the session quality survey for enterprises capturing responses through OpenTelemetry
changes.summary: 恢复企业反馈问卷采集
changes.summary_en: Re-enable enterprise feedback survey
changes.why_matters: 让企业通过 OpenTelemetry 继续收集会话质量反馈，便于评估和改进产品体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets enterprises keep collecting session-quality feedback via OpenTelemetry to improve product experience.

changes.raw: Added `settings.autoMode.hard_deny` for auto mode classifier rules that block unconditionally regardless of user intent or allow exceptions
changes.summary: 自动模式新增硬拒绝规则
changes.summary_en: Add hard-deny rules for auto mode
changes.why_matters: 可对自动模式的分类结果进行强制拦截，提升策略控制力和安全边界。
changes.why_matters_en: It enables unconditional blocking in auto mode, strengthening policy control and safety boundaries.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP servers configured in `.mcp.json`, plugins, and claude.ai connectors silently disappearing after `/clear` in the VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, and Agent SDK
changes.summary: 修复清空后配置消失
changes.summary_en: Fix configs disappearing after /clear
changes.why_matters: 避免 MCP、插件和连接器配置在清空会话后丢失，防止工作流中断。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents MCP, plugin, and connector configs from disappearing after clearing, avoiding workflow disruption.

changes.raw: Fixed a rare login loop where a concurrent credential write could overwrite a freshly-rotated OAuth token and force re-login
changes.summary: 修复登录循环问题
changes.summary_en: Fix rare login loop on token write
changes.why_matters: 避免凭据并发写入导致 OAuth 令牌被覆盖，从而反复要求用户重新登录。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents concurrent credential writes from overwriting OAuth tokens and forcing repeated re-login.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP OAuth refresh tokens being lost when multiple servers refresh concurrently — users with several remote MCP servers should no longer need daily re-authentication
changes.summary: 修复多 MCP 刷新丢令牌
changes.summary_en: Fix lost refresh tokens for MCP servers
changes.why_matters: 减少多个远程 MCP 服务并发刷新时的认证丢失，避免用户频繁重新授权。
changes.why_matters_en: It stops refresh-token loss during concurrent MCP refreshes, reducing repeated re-authentication.

changes.raw: Fixed an API error (400) when extended thinking emitted a redacted thinking block after a tool call
changes.summary: 修复思考块 API 400 错误
changes.summary_en: Fix 400 error after redacted thinking
changes.why_matters: 避免扩展思考在工具调用后输出被红acted思考块时触发接口错误。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents API failures when extended thinking emits a redacted block after a tool call.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` / `--continue` not finding sessions when the project path contains underscores
changes.summary: 修复续会话路径下划线问题
changes.summary_en: Fix resume/continue with underscores
changes.why_matters: 让 `--resume` 和 `--continue` 在项目路径含下划线时也能正确找到会话。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures `--resume` and `--continue` can find sessions even when project paths contain underscores.

changes.raw: Fixed plan mode not blocking file writes when a matching `Edit(...)` allow rule exists
changes.summary: 修复计划模式写文件失效
changes.summary_en: Fix plan mode file-write blocking
changes.why_matters: 确保计划模式在存在匹配允许规则时仍能阻止文件写入，避免越权修改。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures plan mode still blocks file writes when an allow rule matches, preventing unauthorized edits.

changes.raw: WSL2: image paste from Windows clipboard now works via a PowerShell fallback when xclip/wl-paste cannot read image data
changes.summary: WSL2 支持 Windows 剪贴板图片
changes.summary_en: Add WSL2 Windows clipboard image paste
changes.why_matters: 在 xclip 或 wl-paste 失效时仍可粘贴图片，提升跨平台使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It keeps image paste working on WSL2 when xclip or wl-paste cannot read image data.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin `Stop`/`UserPromptSubmit` hooks failing when cache cleanup deletes a version still in use by a running session
changes.summary: 修复插件钩子版本清理崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin hooks after cache cleanup
changes.why_matters: 避免缓存清理误删运行中会话仍在使用的插件版本，保证钩子稳定执行。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents cache cleanup from deleting plugin versions still used by active sessions, keeping hooks stable.

changes.raw: Improved visual consistency across slash command dialogs: standardized footer hints, dialog spacing, and arrow-key styling, and the dialog frame now appears immediately during loading instead of popping in after
changes.summary: 统一斜杠命令对话框样式
changes.summary_en: Polish slash-command dialog styling
changes.why_matters: 提升对话框视觉一致性和加载反馈，让界面更顺滑易用。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves visual consistency and loading feedback, making dialogs feel smoother and easier to use.

changes.raw: Fixed colors appearing at wrong positions in bash command output and markdown code blocks
changes.summary: 修复命令输出颜色错位
changes.summary_en: Fix color misplacement in output
changes.why_matters: 让 bash 输出和 Markdown 代码块的颜色渲染位置正确，提升可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: It restores correct color rendering in bash output and Markdown code blocks, improving readability.

changes.raw: Fixed ReasonML diffs rendering corrupted "undefined" text artifacts at word-diff boundaries
changes.summary: 修复 ReasonML diff 乱码
changes.summary_en: Fix corrupted ReasonML diff artifacts
changes.why_matters: 避免词级 diff 边界出现错误文本，提升代码审阅准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes corrupted text artifacts at word-diff boundaries, improving code review accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed worktree exit dialog warning about uncommitted files in the wrong directory after worktree removal
changes.summary: 修复 worktree 退出提示路径错误
changes.summary_en: Fix wrong worktree exit warning path
changes.why_matters: 确保提示检查的是正确目录，避免误导用户处理未提交文件。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes the warning inspect the correct directory, avoiding misleading uncommitted-file prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed `@` file picker not matching files created mid-session in small non-git directories
changes.summary: 修复 @ 文件选择器漏新文件
changes.summary_en: Fix @ picker missing new files
changes.why_matters: 让会话中新增的文件也能被及时匹配，提升文件引用的完整性。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets newly created files be matched during a session, improving file-reference completeness.

changes.raw: Fixed `@`-mention file picker not finding files in directories with more than 100 entries
changes.summary: @提及文件选择更可靠
changes.summary_en: Fix @-mention file picker in large dirs
changes.why_matters: 避免在文件较多的目录里无法快速选中文件，提升日常补全体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents file picking from failing in large directories, improving everyday completion flow.

changes.raw: Fixed failed tool calls not being click-to-expand in fullscreen mode when their output was truncated
changes.summary: 失败工具输出可展开
changes.summary_en: Failed tool calls expand correctly in fullscreen
changes.why_matters: 用户可以查看被截断的失败详情，便于排查问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can inspect truncated failure details, making debugging easier.

changes.raw: Fixed Backspace and Ctrl+Backspace getting swapped after using Ctrl+G to open an external editor on terminals with persistent extended-key modes
changes.summary: 修复外部编辑器按键错位
changes.summary_en: Fix swapped Backspace keys after external editor
changes.why_matters: 避免终端按键行为异常，减少编辑时的误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents broken key behavior in terminals and reduces editing mistakes.

changes.raw: Fixed `/usage` weekly reset showing time of day instead of the calendar date
changes.summary: /usage 周重置显示日期
changes.summary_en: Show calendar date for /usage weekly reset
changes.why_matters: 让配额重置时间更清晰，减少理解成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes quota reset timing clearer and easier to understand.

changes.raw: Fixed welcome banner ellipsis causing column overflow on CJK terminals
changes.summary: 欢迎横幅适配中文终端
changes.summary_en: Fix welcome banner overflow on CJK terminals
changes.why_matters: 避免中文终端界面错位，提升显示美观度。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents layout overflow on CJK terminals and improves visual polish.

changes.raw: Fixed `/insights` crash when session history contains tool calls with malformed input fields
changes.summary: /insights 崩溃问题修复
changes.summary_en: Fix /insights crash on malformed tool inputs
changes.why_matters: 防止会话历史异常导致核心分析功能直接崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents malformed session history from crashing a key analysis command.

changes.raw: Fixed a renderer crash when a tool's collapsibility classification changes mid-session
changes.summary: 修复工具折叠状态渲染崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix renderer crash when tool collapsibility changes
changes.why_matters: 提升长会话稳定性，避免界面在状态变化时崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves long-session stability by preventing renderer crashes on state changes.

changes.raw: Fixed a `skills` entry in `plugin.json` hiding the plugin's default `skills/` directory, and listing a file path now shows an error instead of failing silently
changes.summary: 插件技能目录识别修复
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin skills directory handling and errors
changes.why_matters: 避免插件配置误隐藏默认技能目录，并让错误更可见。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents plugin config from hiding the default skills directory and surfaces errors clearly.

changes.raw: Fixed IDE shell-integration lock files not respecting `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`
changes.summary: IDE 锁文件遵循配置目录
changes.summary_en: IDE shell-integration locks respect config dir
changes.why_matters: 确保不同配置目录下的 IDE 集成行为一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures IDE integration behaves consistently across custom config directories.

changes.raw: Fixed trailing whitespace in copied terminal output during streaming
changes.summary: 复制流式输出去掉尾空格
changes.summary_en: Remove trailing spaces from copied output
changes.why_matters: 减少复制结果中的脏字符，方便直接粘贴使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes stray whitespace from copied output, making pasted results cleaner.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin uninstall and enable/disable not matching slugs case-insensitively
changes.summary: 插件启停支持大小写匹配
changes.summary_en: Case-insensitive plugin uninstall/enable matching
changes.why_matters: 避免因大小写不一致导致插件管理失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents plugin management from failing due to slug casing differences.

changes.raw: Fixed tool error truncation marker showing a negative count for surrogate-pair strings
changes.summary: 修复错误截断计数异常
changes.summary_en: Fix negative truncation counts for surrogate pairs
changes.why_matters: 让错误提示中的截断信息准确可靠，避免误导用户。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps truncation indicators accurate in error messages and avoids confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed env vars from `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` SessionStart hooks going stale after `/resume` or `/clear`
changes.summary: 环境变量在恢复后保持更新
changes.summary_en: Keep CLAUDE_ENV_FILE vars fresh after resume/clear
changes.why_matters: 确保恢复会话后环境配置仍然正确生效。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures environment configuration remains correct after resuming or clearing a session.

changes.raw: Fixed `/branch` saving a multi-line session title when given a pasted multi-line name
changes.summary: /branch 多行标题处理修复
changes.summary_en: Fix /branch saving pasted multiline titles
changes.why_matters: 避免粘贴标题时意外保存成多行，提升命令可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents pasted branch names from being saved as multiline titles.

changes.raw: Fixed a stray leading space on the second line of wrapped text at the column boundary
changes.summary: 修复换行边界多余空格
changes.summary_en: Fix stray leading space on wrapped lines
changes.why_matters: 改善终端排版细节，减少文本显示瑕疵。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves terminal text rendering by removing a small wrapping artifact.

changes.raw: Fixed Esc not dismissing dialogs in `/install-github-app`, `/desktop`, `/resume`, and `/web-setup`
changes.summary: 修复 Esc 关闭对话框失效
changes.summary_en: Fix Esc not dismissing dialogs
changes.why_matters: 用户现在可以用 Esc 可靠关闭多个设置和恢复对话框，提升键盘操作流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can reliably dismiss setup and resume dialogs with Esc, improving keyboard-driven workflow.

changes.raw: Fixed `/doctor` MCP schema errors not naming the missing field or showing the source file path
changes.summary: 修复 /doctor 缺字段提示
changes.summary_en: Fix /doctor missing-field schema errors
changes.why_matters: 错误信息会直接指出缺失字段和来源文件，帮助用户更快定位 MCP 配置问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Error messages now point to the missing field and source file, helping users debug MCP config issues faster.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash permission prompts showing an internal parser diagnostic instead of a user-readable explanation
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 权限提示可读性
changes.summary_en: Fix readable Bash permission prompts
changes.why_matters: 用户看到的是可理解的权限说明而不是内部诊断信息，减少困惑并提升信任。
changes.why_matters_en: Users now see a readable permission explanation instead of an internal diagnostic, reducing confusion and improving trust.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin slash commands with spaces (e.g. `/myplugin review`) not resolving to their namespaced form
changes.summary: 修复插件命令空格解析
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin slash commands with spaces
changes.why_matters: 带空格的插件命令能正确映射到命名空间形式，避免命令无法执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin commands with spaces now resolve correctly to their namespaced form, preventing command failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `AskUserQuestion` discarding multi-select answers when supplied as an array
changes.summary: 修复多选答案丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix multi-select answers being dropped
changes.why_matters: AskUserQuestion 现在能保留数组形式的多选结果，避免用户选择被意外丢弃。
changes.why_matters_en: AskUserQuestion now preserves array-based multi-select results, so user choices are not lost.

changes.raw: Fixed `/clear <name>` not labeling the cleared session for `/resume`
changes.summary: 修复清空会话标签缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix /clear session labeling for /resume
changes.why_matters: 清空后的会话会被正确标记，方便后续在 /resume 中识别和恢复。
changes.why_matters_en: Cleared sessions are now labeled correctly, making them easier to identify and resume later.

changes.raw: Fixed `CronList` output missing qualifiers and the scheduled prompt
changes.summary: 修复 CronList 输出信息缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix missing CronList qualifiers
changes.why_matters: 定时任务列表会显示更完整的提示内容，便于理解每个任务的实际行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Cron task listings now show fuller prompt details, making each scheduled job easier to understand.

changes.raw: Fixed "Jump to bottom" overlay leaving color artifacts on CJK characters in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 修复底部浮层残影
changes.summary_en: Fix bottom overlay color artifacts
changes.why_matters: 全屏模式下的中文字符显示更干净，减少界面残影和视觉干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: CJK text renders more cleanly in fullscreen mode, reducing visual artifacts and distraction.

changes.raw: Fixed wide markdown tables leaving a stale bordered render in terminal scrollback while streaming
changes.summary: 修复表格滚动残留边框
changes.summary_en: Fix stale table borders in scrollback
changes.why_matters: 流式输出时终端回滚区不会再留下过时表格边框，提升阅读体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Terminal scrollback no longer keeps stale table borders during streaming, improving readability.

changes.raw: Fixed pasted text being silently dropped when a long prompt with a pasted-text placeholder was auto-truncated
changes.summary: 修复长提示截断丢贴入文本
changes.summary_en: Fix pasted text lost on truncation
changes.why_matters: 即使提示词被自动截断，粘贴内容也不会静默丢失，避免任务输入不完整。
changes.why_matters_en: Pasted content is no longer silently dropped when prompts are auto-truncated, preventing incomplete inputs.

changes.raw: Fixed `/release-notes` getting stuck on an old version after a failed changelog refresh
changes.summary: 修复发布说明版本卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix /release-notes version refresh
changes.why_matters: 刷新失败后不会一直停留在旧版本，用户能看到更准确的发布信息。
changes.why_matters_en: After a failed refresh, /release-notes no longer sticks to an old version, so users see accurate release info.

changes.raw: Fixed `/mcp` server list not scrolling when there are more servers than fit in the terminal
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 列表无法滚动
changes.summary_en: Fix /mcp server list scrolling
changes.why_matters: 当服务器很多时，用户可以滚动查看完整列表，不会被界面截断。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can scroll through long server lists instead of being cut off by the terminal viewport.

changes.raw: Fixed mid-input slash command autocomplete not working after an initial slash command
changes.summary: 修复中途补全失效
changes.summary_en: Fix mid-input slash autocomplete
changes.why_matters: 输入过程中再次使用斜杠命令补全会正常工作，减少重复输入和操作中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Slash command autocomplete works again mid-input, reducing retyping and workflow interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed scrolling to bottom re-engaging auto-follow with `autoScrollEnabled: false`
changes.summary: 修复底部跟随被误开启
changes.summary_en: Fix auto-follow re-enabling on bottom
changes.why_matters: 关闭自动滚动后，滚到末尾也不会意外恢复跟随，保持用户控制权。
changes.why_matters_en: With auto-scroll disabled, reaching the bottom no longer re-enables follow mode, preserving user control.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt suggestions being auto-submitted by Enter on an empty input instead of requiring Tab or arrow to accept
changes.summary: 修复空输入误提交建议
changes.summary_en: Fix Enter auto-submitting suggestions
changes.why_matters: 用户在空输入时不会被 Enter 误触发建议提交，减少误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Enter no longer auto-submits suggestions on empty input, reducing accidental actions.

changes.raw: Fixed keyboard shortcut hints not reflecting rebound keys from `keybindings.json`
changes.summary: 快捷键提示同步重绑定键位
changes.summary_en: Shortcut hints now reflect rebound keys
changes.why_matters: 用户自定义快捷键后，界面提示会正确显示实际按键，减少误操作和困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: After rebinding shortcuts, the UI now shows the real keys, reducing confusion and mistakes.

changes.raw: Fixed `/settings` language change being reverted on Escape after confirming
changes.summary: 设置语言确认后不再回退
changes.summary_en: Language changes in /settings now persist
changes.why_matters: 用户在 `/settings` 中切换语言后，确认结果会被保留，不会因按 Esc 意外回退。
changes.why_matters_en: Language changes made in `/settings` now stick instead of being accidentally reverted by Esc.

changes.raw: Fixed `/terminal-setup` only appearing in autocomplete on exact name match instead of partial prefixes
changes.summary: /terminal-setup 支持前缀补全
changes.summary_en: /terminal-setup now autocompletes on prefixes
changes.why_matters: 命令补全更符合用户输入习惯，能更快找到并执行 `/terminal-setup`。
changes.why_matters_en: Autocomplete now matches user typing patterns, making `/terminal-setup` easier and faster to find.

changes.raw: Fixed "Chat about this" on an `AskUserQuestion` dialog erasing the question text
changes.summary: 对话提问文本不再被清空
changes.summary_en: "Chat about this" keeps AskUserQuestion text
changes.why_matters: 用户从询问对话跳转到聊天时，问题内容会保留，避免上下文丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: When jumping from a question dialog to chat, the question text is preserved so context is not lost.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tool results being invisible when the server returns content blocks
changes.summary: MCP 工具结果可正常显示
changes.summary_en: MCP tool results now show content blocks
changes.why_matters: 当 MCP 服务返回 content blocks 时，用户可以看到工具输出，避免结果“消失”。
changes.why_matters_en: When an MCP server returns content blocks, users can now see the tool output instead of losing it.

changes.raw: Improved error message when `--worktree` collides with an existing or stale worktree
changes.summary: --worktree 冲突报错更清晰
changes.summary_en: Better error when --worktree collides
changes.why_matters: 用户遇到已有或残留 worktree 冲突时，更容易理解问题并快速处理。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can better understand and resolve existing or stale worktree collisions more quickly.

changes.raw: Changed plugin marketplace removal key to `d` (matching delete elsewhere) instead of `r` which collided with retry
changes.summary: 插件删除键改为 d
changes.summary_en: Plugin marketplace delete key changed to d
changes.why_matters: 删除操作按键与其他界面保持一致，并避免与重试键冲突，但会影响旧习惯。
changes.why_matters_en: The delete action is now consistent with other UI patterns and avoids retry conflicts, but it changes an existing shortcut.

signals.title: DeepClaude – Claude Code agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro
Using Claude Code: The unreasonable effectiveness of HTML
Uber torches 2026 AI budget on Claude Code in four months
Tell HN: Dont use Claude Design, lost access to my projects after unsubscribing
A Claude Code and Codex Skill for Deliberate Skill Development

changes.raw: Added `worktree.baseRef` setting (`fresh` | `head`) to choose whether `--worktree`, `EnterWorktree`, and agent-isolation worktrees branch from `origin/<default>` or local `HEAD`. **Note:** the default `fresh` changes `EnterWorktree`'s base back to `origin/<default>` (it has been local `HEAD` since 2.1.128) — set `worktree.baseRef: "head"` to keep unpushed commits in new worktrees
changes.summary: 可选工作树基准来源
changes.summary_en: Choose worktree base ref
changes.why_matters: 用户可以决定新工作树从远端默认分支还是本地 HEAD 分叉，避免丢失未推送提交。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can choose whether new worktrees branch from the remote default or local HEAD, avoiding loss of unpushed commits.

changes.raw: Added `sandbox.bwrapPath` and `sandbox.socatPath` managed settings (Linux/WSL) to specify custom bubblewrap and socat binary locations
changes.summary: 可自定义沙箱二进制路径
changes.summary_en: Custom sandbox binary paths
changes.why_matters: Linux/WSL 用户可以指定 bubblewrap 和 socat 路径，提升在非标准环境中的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Linux/WSL users can point to custom bubblewrap and socat binaries, improving usability in nonstandard setups.

changes.raw: Added `parentSettingsBehavior` admin-tier key (`'first-wins' | 'merge'`) to let admins opt SDK `managedSettings` (parent tier) into the policy merge
changes.summary: 管理员可合并父级策略
changes.summary_en: Admins can merge parent policy
changes.why_matters: 管理员可以让 SDK 的托管设置参与策略合并，增强多层配置的一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Admins can include SDK managed settings in policy merging, improving consistency across configuration layers.

changes.raw: Hooks now receive the active effort level via the `effort.level` JSON input field and the `$CLAUDE_EFFORT` environment variable, and Bash tool commands can read `$CLAUDE_EFFORT`
changes.summary: Hook 可读取努力等级
changes.summary_en: Hooks can read effort level
changes.why_matters: Hook 和 Bash 工具能感知当前努力等级，从而更好地适配不同任务强度。
changes.why_matters_en: Hooks and Bash tools can detect the current effort level and adapt behavior to task intensity.

changes.raw: Improved focus mode behavior
changes.summary: 优化专注模式体验
changes.summary_en: Improved focus mode behavior
changes.why_matters: 专注模式更稳定顺手，能减少使用过程中的干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Focus mode is now smoother and more reliable, reducing distractions during use.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage by releasing warm-spare background workers under memory pressure
changes.summary: 内存压力下释放备用 worker
changes.summary_en: Release spare workers under pressure
changes.why_matters: 在内存紧张时释放后台备用 worker，可降低资源占用并减少卡顿。
changes.why_matters_en: Releasing warm-spare workers under memory pressure lowers resource usage and reduces sluggishness.

changes.raw: Fixed parallel sessions all dead-ending at 401 after a refresh-token race wiped shared credentials
changes.summary: 修复刷新令牌竞态掉线
changes.summary_en: Fix refresh-token race logout
changes.why_matters: 并行会话不再因凭据被误清空而全部 401 失败，避免严重中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Parallel sessions no longer all fail with 401 due to shared credentials being wiped, preventing major interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed `Edit`/`Write` allow rules scoped to a drive root (`C:\`) or POSIX `/` matching incorrectly and always prompting
changes.summary: 修复根路径权限误判
changes.summary_en: Fix root-path allow rule matching
changes.why_matters: 对 `C:\` 和 `/` 的读写编辑权限判断恢复正确，减少不必要的授权提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Read/write/edit permission checks for `C:\` and `/` now work correctly, avoiding unnecessary prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed an unhandled rejection (`ECOMPROMISED`) when a history or session-log file lock is compromised by clock skew or slow disk
changes.summary: 修复锁冲突未处理崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix unhandled lock-compromise error
changes.why_matters: 历史或会话日志锁异常时不再触发未处理拒绝，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Compromised history or session-log locks no longer cause unhandled rejections, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing Esc during conversation compaction showing a spurious "Error compacting conversation" notification
changes.summary: 修复压缩取消误报错
changes.summary_en: Fix false compaction error on Esc
changes.why_matters: 按 Esc 取消对话压缩时不再弹出误导性的错误通知。
changes.why_matters_en: Pressing Esc during conversation compaction no longer shows a misleading error notification.

changes.raw: Fixed `HTTP(S)_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY` / mTLS not being respected for the full MCP OAuth flow including discovery, dynamic client registration, token exchange, and token refresh
changes.summary: 修复 MCP OAuth 代理与 mTLS
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP OAuth proxy and mTLS support
changes.why_matters: 完整 MCP OAuth 流程现在会正确遵循代理和 mTLS 配置，提升企业网络兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: The full MCP OAuth flow now respects proxy and mTLS settings, improving compatibility in enterprise networks.

changes.raw: Fixed Read/Write/Edit being denied on mapped network drives passed via `--add-dir` / SDK `additionalDirectories`
changes.summary: 修复网络盘读写权限
changes.summary_en: Fix mapped drive permissions
changes.why_matters: 通过 `--add-dir` 或 SDK 配置加入的网络映射盘现在可正常读写编辑。
changes.why_matters_en: Mapped network drives added via `--add-dir` or SDK config now work correctly for read/write/edit.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control stop/interrupt from claude.ai not fully canceling the CLI session the same way local Esc does, causing queued messages to never advance after interrupting a stuck tool or prompt
changes.summary: 修复远程中断无法彻底取消
changes.summary_en: Fix remote stop not fully canceling
changes.why_matters: 来自 claude.ai 的停止/中断现在与本地 Esc 一致，避免卡住会话无法继续。
changes.why_matters_en: Remote stop/interrupt from claude.ai now cancels like local Esc, preventing stuck sessions from hanging.

changes.raw: Fixed `/effort` in one session unexpectedly changing the effort level of other concurrent sessions, and a related issue where an IDE effort change could be silently dropped
changes.summary: 修复努力等级串会话
changes.summary_en: Fix effort level leaking across sessions
changes.why_matters: 不同会话的 `/effort` 设置不再互相影响，IDE 修改也不会被静默丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Effort settings no longer leak across sessions, and IDE changes are no longer silently dropped.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents not discovering project, user, or plugin skills via the Skill tool
changes.summary: 修复子代理技能发现
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent skill discovery
changes.why_matters: 子代理现在能正确发现项目、用户和插件技能，提升任务执行能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Subagents can now discover project, user, and plugin skills correctly, improving task execution.

changes.raw: `claude --help` now lists `--remote-control` alongside `--remote-control-session-name-prefix`
changes.summary: 新增远程控制参数说明
changes.summary_en: Adds remote control flag to help
changes.why_matters: 用户在帮助信息中能直接发现并理解新的远程控制选项，降低使用门槛。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can discover the new remote control option directly in help output, lowering the barrier to use.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed `claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` failing with "Unsupported platform" when the extension build doesn't bundle a Claude binary
changes.summary: 修复VSCode无二进制报错
changes.summary_en: Fixes VSCode wrapper unsupported platform error
changes.why_matters: 当扩展包未捆绑 Claude 二进制时，VSCode 扩展不再因平台不支持而失败。
changes.why_matters_en: The VSCode extension no longer fails with an unsupported platform error when no Claude binary is bundled.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` environment variable to the Bash tool subprocess environment, matching the `session_id` passed to hooks
changes.summary: Bash子进程带会话ID
changes.summary_en: Pass session ID to Bash subprocess
changes.why_matters: 让 Bash 工具子进程能关联到当前会话，便于 hooks 和调试保持一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets Bash subprocesses stay tied to the current session for consistent hooks and debugging.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN=1` env var to opt out of the fullscreen alternate-screen renderer and keep the conversation in the terminal's native scrollback
changes.summary: 可关闭全屏替代屏幕
changes.summary_en: Option to disable alternate-screen UI
changes.why_matters: 用户可以保留终端原生滚动回溯，提升可读性和历史查看体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can keep native terminal scrollback, improving readability and history access.

changes.raw: Added a "Pasting…" footer hint while a Ctrl+V image paste is being read from the clipboard
changes.summary: 粘贴时显示提示
changes.summary_en: Show hint while pasting image
changes.why_matters: 让用户知道剪贴板图片正在读取，减少误以为卡住的情况。
changes.why_matters_en: This reassures users that clipboard image input is being processed instead of frozen.

changes.raw: Fixed external SIGINT (e.g. IDE stop button, `kill -INT`) not running graceful shutdown — terminal modes are now restored and the `--resume` hint is printed instead of an abrupt exit
changes.summary: 中断后优雅退出恢复终端
changes.summary_en: Graceful shutdown on external SIGINT
changes.why_matters: IDE 停止或 kill 中断时能正确恢复终端状态并提示续接，避免环境损坏。
changes.why_matters_en: External interrupts now restore terminal state and show a resume hint instead of leaving the session broken.

changes.raw: Fixed an uncaught exception when the terminal is closed or SSH disconnects mid-session under the native build
changes.summary: 关闭终端不再崩溃
changes.summary_en: No crash on terminal close or SSH drop
changes.why_matters: 在终端关闭或 SSH 断开时避免未捕获异常，提高会话稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents uncaught exceptions when the terminal closes or SSH disconnects mid-session.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` failing with `no low surrogate in string` when a tool error truncation split an emoji; pre-corrupted sessions are sanitized on load
changes.summary: 损坏会话可正常恢复
changes.summary_en: Resume works after emoji truncation
changes.why_matters: 即使历史中有被截断的表情字符，恢复会话也不会因为编码错误失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Resume no longer fails on corrupted sessions caused by truncated emoji surrogate pairs.

changes.raw: Fixed `--permission-mode` flag being ignored when resuming a plan-mode session with `-p --continue`/`--resume`, and plan mode not being re-applied after `ExitPlanMode` within the same session
changes.summary: 恢复时保留计划模式
changes.summary_en: Plan mode now persists on resume
changes.why_matters: 恢复计划模式会话时能正确应用权限与模式，避免行为和预期不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Resumed plan-mode sessions now keep the right permission and mode behavior, avoiding surprises.

changes.raw: Fixed fullscreen mode showing a blank screen after laptop sleep/wake or Ctrl+Z/`fg` until the next keystroke or stream output
changes.summary: 睡眠唤醒后不再黑屏
changes.summary_en: Fix blank screen after sleep or fg
changes.why_matters: 从睡眠、暂停恢复后界面能立即正常显示，减少卡死感和误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: The UI now redraws correctly after sleep or job control resume, preventing a blank screen.

changes.raw: Fixed cursor landing mid-grapheme on Ctrl+E/A/K/U/arrow keys when an Indic conjunct or ZWJ emoji wraps across lines
changes.summary: 修复复杂字符光标定位
changes.summary_en: Fix cursor movement for complex graphemes
changes.why_matters: 处理印地语连字和 ZWJ 表情时，光标不会落在字符中间，编辑更准确。
changes.why_matters_en: Cursor movement now respects wrapped grapheme clusters, improving editing accuracy for complex text.

changes.raw: Fixed vim operators corrupting text containing decomposed (NFD) accented characters
changes.summary: 修复分解重音字符编辑
changes.summary_en: Fix editing of decomposed accented text
changes.why_matters: Vim 操作不会再破坏 NFD 重音字符，避免文本被意外改坏。
changes.why_matters_en: Vim operators no longer corrupt decomposed accented characters, preserving text integrity.

changes.raw: Fixed pasting text starting with `/` silently swallowing the input or triggering an unknown-command reply
changes.summary: 以斜杠开头粘贴正常
changes.summary_en: Pasting text starting with / works
changes.why_matters: 用户粘贴命令样文本时不会被误判为指令，减少输入丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Pasted text that starts with / is no longer mistaken for a command, preventing input loss.

changes.raw: Fixed pasting dumping stray escape sequences into the prompt when focus events or mouse-tracking reports interleave with the bracketed paste
changes.summary: 粘贴不再混入转义串
changes.summary_en: No stray escape codes during paste
changes.why_matters: 焦点事件或鼠标报告与粘贴交错时，输入内容更干净可靠。
changes.why_matters_en: Paste input stays clean even when focus or mouse-tracking events interleave with bracketed paste.

changes.raw: Fixed mouse wheel scrolling being too fast in Cursor and VS Code 1.92–1.104 due to an upstream xterm.js bug
changes.summary: 修复鼠标滚轮过快
changes.summary_en: Fix overly fast mouse wheel scrolling
changes.why_matters: 在 Cursor 和 VS Code 中滚动更符合预期，浏览内容更顺手。
changes.why_matters_en: Mouse wheel scrolling now behaves normally in affected editors, making navigation usable again.

changes.raw: Fixed scroll-wheel handling in JetBrains IDE 2025.2 terminals (spurious arrow keys, wrong-direction events, runaway acceleration)
changes.summary: JetBrains 终端滚轮修复
changes.summary_en: Fix JetBrains terminal scroll wheel
changes.why_matters: JetBrains 终端里滚轮方向和速度恢复正常，避免误滚和失控加速。
changes.why_matters_en: Scrolling in JetBrains terminals now has the correct direction and speed, preventing erratic behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed `/usage` Ctrl+S hanging when copying the stats screenshot to the clipboard on Linux/X11
changes.summary: /usage 截图复制不再卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix /usage screenshot copy hang
changes.why_matters: 在 Linux/X11 下复制统计截图时不会挂起，提升命令可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Copying the usage stats screenshot on Linux/X11 no longer hangs, improving command reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/terminal-setup` showing a contradictory error in Windows Terminal — Shift+Enter is natively supported there
changes.summary: 修正终端设置误报
changes.summary_en: Fix contradictory terminal setup error
changes.why_matters: 避免在 Windows Terminal 中给出错误提示，减少用户困惑并提升命令可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misleading guidance in Windows Terminal and reduces user confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed `/effort` picker not reflecting the `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` env var override
changes.summary: 修正努力等级覆盖显示
changes.summary_en: Respect effort env override in picker
changes.why_matters: 让界面正确反映环境变量配置，避免用户误以为设置未生效。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures the UI reflects the configured override so users know their setting is applied.

changes.raw: Fixed `/status` showing the wrong default model for some users
changes.summary: 修正状态页默认模型
changes.summary_en: Show the correct default model in /status
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户准确确认当前模型配置，避免排查和使用时产生误解。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users verify the active model accurately and avoids confusion during troubleshooting.

changes.raw: Fixed slash command autocomplete popup being capped at ~3–5 visible commands instead of scaling with terminal height
changes.summary: 补全命令自动补全列表
changes.summary_en: Scale slash autocomplete with terminal height
changes.why_matters: 让更多命令可见，提升长列表场景下的查找效率和交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes more commands visible and improves discoverability in larger terminals.

changes.raw: Fixed statusline `context_window` token counts reflecting cumulative session totals instead of current context usage
changes.summary: 修正上下文窗口统计
changes.summary_en: Show current context usage, not total
changes.why_matters: 让状态栏显示真实可用上下文，便于用户判断是否接近上下文上限。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows the real current context usage so users can judge proximity to the limit.

changes.raw: Fixed Alt+T (thinking toggle) not working on macOS terminals without "Option as Meta" enabled (iTerm2, Terminal.app defaults)
changes.summary: 修正 macOS 思考切换键
changes.summary_en: Fix Alt+T on macOS terminals
changes.why_matters: 恢复快捷键在默认 macOS 终端中的可用性，减少操作中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores the shortcut in default macOS terminals and prevents workflow interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed dead keyboard input on Windows after re-opening a background session from `claude agents`
changes.summary: 修正后台会话键盘失效
changes.summary_en: Fix dead keyboard input after reopening session
changes.why_matters: 避免重新打开后台会话后无法输入，直接影响继续工作和会话恢复。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents input loss after reopening a background session, which blocks continued work.

changes.raw: Fixed unbounded memory growth (10GB+ RSS) when a stdio MCP server writes non-protocol data to stdout
changes.summary: 修正 MCP 异常内存暴涨
changes.summary_en: Prevent huge memory growth from bad MCP stdout
changes.why_matters: 防止异常 MCP 输出导致进程占用内存失控，避免崩溃或系统资源耗尽。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents malformed MCP output from causing runaway memory use and potential crashes.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP servers that connect but fail `tools/list` silently showing 0 tools — they now retry once and show "connected · tools fetch failed" in `/mcp`
changes.summary: 修正 MCP 工具获取失败提示
changes.summary_en: Retry tools/list and show fetch failure
changes.why_matters: 让连接失败更可见并减少误判，帮助用户更快定位 MCP 问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes tool-fetch failures visible and reduces false zero-tool states for faster diagnosis.

changes.raw: Fixed unauthorized claude.ai MCP connectors showing as "failed" instead of "needs auth", and headless `-p` mode retrying non-transient 4xx connection failures
changes.summary: 修正授权状态与重试
changes.summary_en: Mark unauthorized connectors as needs auth
changes.why_matters: 更准确地区分授权失败与连接失败，并避免无意义重试非瞬时 4xx 错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Distinguishes auth failures from connection failures and avoids pointless retries on 4xx errors.

changes.raw: Improved visual consistency in slash command dialogs and `/login`, `/upgrade`, `/extra-usage` dialog spacing
changes.summary: 优化对话框间距一致性
changes.summary_en: Improve dialog spacing consistency
changes.why_matters: 提升界面视觉一致性，让常用对话框更易读、更专业。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves visual consistency so common dialogs feel cleaner and easier to read.

changes.raw: Updated the `/tui fullscreen` startup banner to describe additional renderer benefits (lower memory usage, mouse support, auto-copy on select)
changes.summary: 更新全屏模式说明
changes.summary_en: Update fullscreen banner benefits
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户更快了解全屏渲染器的额外收益，便于选择合适模式。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users understand the renderer benefits and choose the right mode faster.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock and Vertex 400 errors when `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H` is set
changes.summary: 修正 Bedrock/Vertex 400 错误
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock and Vertex 400 errors with caching
changes.why_matters: 确保启用 1 小时提示缓存时请求仍可正常发送，避免模型调用失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps requests working when 1h prompt caching is enabled and prevents model call failures.

changes.raw: Fixed VS Code extension failing to activate on Windows due to a hardcoded build path in the bundled SDK (`createRequire` polyfill bug)
changes.summary: 修复 VS Code 扩展 Windows 启动失败
changes.summary_en: Fix VS Code extension activation on Windows
changes.why_matters: 修复 Windows 上因硬编码构建路径导致的扩展无法激活问题，恢复本地开发体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes a Windows-specific activation failure caused by a hardcoded build path, restoring the local dev experience.

changes.raw: Fixed Mantle endpoint authentication failing with missing `x-api-key` header
changes.summary: 修复 Mantle 认证缺少 API Key
changes.summary_en: Fix Mantle auth missing x-api-key header
changes.why_matters: 修复认证请求缺少 x-api-key 导致的接口失败，恢复对 Mantle 服务的正常访问。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes failed authentication requests caused by a missing x-api-key header, restoring access to Mantle services.

signals.title: Claude Code refuses requests or charges extra if your commits mention "OpenClaw"
HERMES.md in commit messages causes requests to route to extra usage billing
DeepClaude – Claude Code agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro
Using Claude Code: The unreasonable effectiveness of HTML
