changes.raw: Added `--plugin-url <url>` flag to fetch a plugin `.zip` archive from a URL for the current session
changes.summary: 支持从URL加载插件
changes.summary_en: Load plugin ZIP from a URL
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接从远程地址获取插件，安装和临时使用更方便。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can fetch a plugin directly from a remote URL, making installation and temporary use easier.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SYNC_OUTPUT=1` env var to force-enable synchronized output on terminals that auto-detection misses (e.g. Emacs `eat`)
changes.summary: 强制启用同步输出
changes.summary_en: Force synchronized terminal output
changes.why_matters: 在自动检测失败的终端中也能获得稳定输出，减少显示异常。
changes.why_matters_en: It keeps output stable even in terminals where auto-detection fails, reducing display issues.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PACKAGE_MANAGER_AUTO_UPDATE`: when set on Homebrew or WinGet installations, Claude Code runs the upgrade command in the background and prompts to restart
changes.summary: 支持后台自动更新包管理器
changes.summary_en: Auto-update package manager installs
changes.why_matters: 用户可更快获得新版本，同时减少手动升级操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get updates sooner while avoiding manual upgrade steps.

changes.raw: Plugin manifests: `themes` and `monitors` should now be declared under `"experimental": { ... }`. Top-level declarations still work but `claude plugin validate` will warn
changes.summary: 插件清单实验项改为新位置
changes.summary_en: Move plugin manifest fields under experimental
changes.why_matters: 现有插件清单需要调整结构，否则验证会开始警告。
changes.why_matters_en: Existing plugin manifests need updating, or validation will start warning.

changes.raw: Gateway `/v1/models` discovery for the `/model` picker is now opt-in via `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1` (was automatic in 2.1.126–2.1.128)
changes.summary: 模型发现改为可选开启
changes.summary_en: Make gateway model discovery opt-in
changes.why_matters: 减少自动访问网关模型列表带来的意外行为，提升可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces unexpected access to gateway model lists and improves control.

changes.raw: Ctrl+R history picker now defaults to searching all prompts across all projects, matching pre-2.1.124 behavior. Press Ctrl+S to narrow to the current project or session
changes.summary: 历史搜索默认覆盖全部项目
changes.summary_en: History search now spans all projects
changes.why_matters: 用户能更容易找到旧提示词，搜索体验恢复到更符合预期的行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can find older prompts more easily, restoring the expected search behavior.

changes.raw: Third-party deployments (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway) no longer see spinner tips pointing at first-party Anthropic surfaces
changes.summary: 第三方部署不再显示错误提示
changes.summary_en: Hide first-party spinner tips on third-party deployments
changes.why_matters: 避免在非 Anthropic 环境中显示误导性提示，减少困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: It avoids misleading tips in non-Anthropic environments and reduces confusion.

changes.raw: `skillOverrides` setting now works: `off` hides from model and `/`, `user-invocable-only` hides from model only, `name-only` collapses description
changes.summary: 支持技能覆盖配置
changes.summary_en: Add skillOverrides behavior controls
changes.why_matters: 管理员或用户可以更精细地控制技能在模型和界面中的可见性。
changes.why_matters_en: Admins or users can more precisely control skill visibility in the model and UI.

changes.raw: The `claude_code.pull_request.count` OTel metric now counts PRs/MRs created via MCP tools, not just shell commands
changes.summary: PR指标统计更完整
changes.summary_en: PR metric now includes MCP-created PRs
changes.why_matters: 监控数据更准确，能更全面反映实际使用情况。
changes.why_matters_en: Telemetry is more accurate and better reflects real usage.

changes.raw: Policy refusal error messages now include the API Request ID for easier support debugging
changes.summary: 拒绝错误带上请求ID
changes.summary_en: Include request ID in refusal errors
changes.why_matters: 支持排查时更容易定位具体请求，缩短问题处理时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Support can pinpoint the exact request more easily, reducing time to resolution.

changes.raw: Fixed API errors with unrecognized 400 status codes showing raw JSON instead of the underlying error message
changes.summary: 400错误显示真实报错
changes.summary_en: Show underlying error for unknown 400s
changes.why_matters: 用户能看到更有用的错误信息，而不是难以理解的原始 JSON。
changes.why_matters_en: Users see a more useful error message instead of raw, hard-to-read JSON.

changes.raw: Fixed `/clear` not resetting the terminal tab title after a conversation
changes.summary: 清空后恢复标题
changes.summary_en: Reset terminal title after /clear
changes.why_matters: 终端标签标题会正确更新，减少界面残留状态。
changes.why_matters_en: The terminal tab title updates correctly, reducing stale UI state.

changes.raw: Fixed session title chip from `/rename` disappearing while a permission or other dialog is active
changes.summary: 重命名标题在弹窗时不消失
changes.summary_en: Keep renamed session title visible in dialogs
changes.why_matters: 在权限弹窗等场景下仍能看到会话标题，界面更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: The session title remains visible during dialogs, making the UI more stable.

changes.raw: Fixed agent panel below the prompt being hidden when subagents are running (regression in 2.1.122)
changes.summary: 子代理运行时显示面板
changes.summary_en: Show agent panel while subagents run
changes.why_matters: 用户能持续看到子代理状态，避免误以为界面卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can keep seeing subagent status, avoiding the impression that the UI is frozen.

changes.raw: Fixed external-editor handoff (Ctrl+G) blanking the conversation history above the prompt
changes.summary: 外部编辑器不再清空历史
changes.summary_en: Preserve history when handing off to external editor
changes.why_matters: 切换到外部编辑器时不会丢失上方对话内容，避免上下文断裂。
changes.why_matters_en: Switching to an external editor no longer loses conversation history, preserving context.

changes.raw: Fixed `/context` dumping its rendered ASCII visualization grid into the conversation, wasting ~1.6k tokens per call
changes.summary: 修复/context浪费上下文
changes.summary_en: Stop /context from wasting tokens
changes.why_matters: 避免每次调用都白白消耗大量上下文 token，提升可用性和成本效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents unnecessary token waste on every call, improving usability and cost efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed `/agents` Library list arrow-key navigation: the highlighted agent now stays visible when the list exceeds the viewport
changes.summary: 修复agents列表滚动可见性
changes.summary_en: Keep highlighted agent visible in /agents
changes.why_matters: 长列表导航时高亮项不会跑出视口，减少误操作并提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: The highlighted item stays visible in long lists, reducing misnavigation and improving usability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/branch` success message not including the new branch's session id for `/resume`
changes.summary: 修复branch会话ID缺失
changes.summary_en: Include session id in /branch success
changes.why_matters: 让用户能直接用新分支的会话 ID 继续 `/resume`，避免手动查找。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can resume the new branch directly with its session ID instead of searching for it manually.

changes.raw: Fixed bold headers with keycap/ZWJ/skin-tone emoji losing trailing characters in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 修复全屏表情标题截断
changes.summary_en: Fix truncated bold emoji headers in fullscreen
changes.why_matters: 避免标题显示异常，提升全屏模式下的文本渲染稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents display glitches and improves text rendering stability in fullscreen mode.

changes.raw: Fixed server-managed settings policy not applying for enterprise/team users whose stored OAuth credentials lacked the `user:inference` scope
changes.summary: 修复企业策略未生效
changes.summary_en: Apply managed settings for enterprise users
changes.why_matters: 确保企业/团队的受管设置真正生效，避免策略失控和合规风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures managed settings actually apply for enterprise/team users, avoiding policy drift and compliance risk.

changes.raw: Fixed OAuth refresh race after wake-from-sleep that could log out all running sessions
changes.summary: 修复唤醒后OAuth刷新竞态
changes.summary_en: Fix OAuth refresh race after sleep
changes.why_matters: 防止系统唤醒后刷新竞态导致所有会话意外登出，保障持续工作不中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents a wake-from-sleep refresh race from logging out all sessions and interrupting work.

changes.raw: Fixed 1-hour prompt cache TTL being silently downgraded to 5 minutes
changes.summary: 修复缓存TTL被降级
changes.summary_en: Preserve 1-hour prompt cache TTL
changes.why_matters: 保持预期缓存时长，减少重复计算和响应延迟。
changes.why_matters_en: This preserves the intended cache duration, reducing recomputation and latency.

changes.raw: Fixed cache-miss warning appearing spuriously after `/clear` or compaction when changing `/effort` or `/model`
changes.summary: 修复清空后误报缓存警告
changes.summary_en: Remove false cache-miss warnings after /clear
changes.why_matters: 减少无意义告警，避免用户在切换模型或努力级别时被误导。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes noisy false warnings and avoids misleading users when changing model or effort settings.

changes.raw: Fixed `Bash(mkdir *)`, `Bash(touch *)` and similar allow rules not being honored for in-project paths
changes.summary: 修复项目内allow规则失效
changes.summary_en: Honor allow rules for in-project paths
changes.why_matters: 让目录创建和文件触碰等允许规则在项目内按预期执行，提升自动化可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes allow rules for mkdir/touch and similar commands work as expected inside projects, improving automation reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `deniedMcpServers` patterns with a `*://` scheme wildcard not matching mixed-case hostnames
changes.summary: 修复MCP服务器匹配大小写
changes.summary_en: Match mixed-case hosts in deniedMcpServers
changes.why_matters: 确保带通配符的 MCP 拒绝规则能正确拦截变体主机名，增强安全控制。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures wildcard MCP deny rules correctly block hostname variants, strengthening security controls.

changes.raw: Fixed harmless WebSocket warning being logged as an error in `--debug` during voice mode
changes.summary: 修复调试日志误报错误
changes.summary_en: Downgrade harmless WebSocket debug warning
changes.why_matters: 减少 voice 模式下调试日志噪音，避免把无害警告误判为故障。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces debug log noise in voice mode and avoids mistaking a harmless warning for a failure.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed `/clear` not clearing the conversation context and displayed transcript
changes.summary: 修复VSCode清空上下文失败
changes.summary_en: Make /clear clear VSCode context and transcript
changes.why_matters: 确保 VSCode 集成里 `/clear` 真正清掉上下文和转录内容，避免残留干扰后续对话。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures `/clear` in VSCode actually clears context and transcript, preventing stale state from affecting later chats.

signals.title: Claude Code refuses requests or charges extra if your commits mention "OpenClaw"
HERMES.md in commit messages causes requests to route to extra usage billing
DeepClaude – Claude Code agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro
Who owns the code Claude Code wrote?
Using Claude Code: The unreasonable effectiveness of HTML

changes.raw: Bare `/color` (no args) now picks a random session color
changes.summary: 空 /color 随机选会话色
changes.summary_en: Bare /color now picks a random session color
changes.why_matters: 让会话配色更方便，也增加了使用时的随机区分度。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes session coloring easier and adds quick visual variety.

changes.raw: `/mcp` now shows the tool count for connected servers and flags servers that connected with 0 tools
changes.summary: /mcp 显示工具数与空工具警告
changes.summary_en: /mcp now shows tool counts and warns on empty servers
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快判断 MCP 服务器是否正常提供工具，便于排查连接问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly tell whether an MCP server is actually providing tools, which helps diagnose connection issues.

changes.raw: `--plugin-dir` now accepts `.zip` plugin archives in addition to directories
changes.summary: 支持 zip 插件包导入
changes.summary_en: --plugin-dir now accepts zip plugin archives
changes.why_matters: 插件分发和安装更灵活，用户可以直接使用压缩包形式的插件。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin distribution and installation become more flexible by allowing zipped plugin archives.

changes.raw: `--channels` now works with console (API key) authentication — console orgs with managed settings must set `channelsEnabled: true` to enable
changes.summary: console 认证可用 channels
changes.summary_en: --channels now works with console auth
changes.why_matters: 使用 API key 登录的用户也能启用 channels，扩大了该功能的可用范围。
changes.why_matters_en: API-key-authenticated users can now use channels, expanding access to the feature.

changes.raw: Updated `/model` picker: collapsed duplicate Opus 4.7 entries, and current Opus now shows as "Opus" instead of "Opus 4.7"
changes.summary: /model 选择器去重并简化名称
changes.summary_en: Model picker dedupes Opus 4.7 and simplifies the label
changes.why_matters: 模型列表更清晰，减少重复项带来的选择困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: The model list is clearer and avoids confusion from duplicate entries.

changes.raw: Subprocesses (Bash, hooks, MCP, LSP) no longer inherit `OTEL_*` environment variables, so OTEL-instrumented apps run via the Bash tool no longer pick up the CLI's own OTLP endpoint
changes.summary: 子进程不再继承 OTEL 环境变量
changes.summary_en: Subprocesses no longer inherit OTEL_* env vars
changes.why_matters: 避免 Bash、hooks、MCP 和 LSP 误用 CLI 的 OTLP 配置，减少观测链路污染和故障。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents Bash, hooks, MCP, and LSP from inheriting the CLI's OTLP settings, avoiding telemetry misconfiguration and noise.

changes.raw: MCP: `workspace` is now a reserved server name — existing servers with that name will be skipped with a warning
changes.summary: workspace 成为保留 MCP 名称
changes.summary_en: "workspace" is now a reserved MCP server name
changes.why_matters: 已有同名服务器会被跳过，可能影响现有 MCP 配置的兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Existing servers with that name will be skipped, which may affect compatibility with current MCP setups.

changes.raw: Reconnecting MCP servers no longer flood the conversation with full tool-name lists on every reconnect — re-announced tools are summarized by server prefix
changes.summary: MCP 重连不再刷屏工具列表
changes.summary_en: MCP reconnects now summarize re-announced tools
changes.why_matters: 减少重连时的对话噪音，让上下文更简洁、更易读。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces conversation noise during reconnects, keeping context cleaner and easier to read.

changes.raw: SDK hosts now receive a persistent `localSettings` suggestion for Bash permission prompts, so "Always allow" writes to `.claude/settings.local.json`
changes.summary: Bash 永久允许写入本地设置
changes.summary_en: Bash prompts now persist "Always allow" to local settings
changes.why_matters: SDK 主机可以记住 Bash 权限选择，减少重复确认并提升自动化体验。
changes.why_matters_en: SDK hosts can remember Bash permission choices, reducing repeated prompts and improving automation flow.

changes.raw: `EnterWorktree` now creates the new branch from local HEAD as documented, instead of `origin/<default-branch>` — unpushed commits are no longer dropped
changes.summary: EnterWorktree 保留本地未推送提交
changes.summary_en: EnterWorktree now branches from local HEAD
changes.why_matters: 避免创建新分支时丢失本地未推送提交，这是重要的数据安全修复。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents losing local unpushed commits when creating a new branch, which is a critical data-safety fix.

changes.raw: Auto mode: when the classifier can't evaluate an action, the error now includes a hint (retry, `/compact`, or run with `--debug`)
changes.summary: 自动模式失败提示更可操作
changes.summary_en: Auto mode errors now include recovery hints
changes.why_matters: 当分类器无法判断动作时，用户更容易知道下一步该怎么处理。
changes.why_matters_en: When the classifier can't evaluate an action, users get clearer guidance on what to do next.

changes.raw: Fixed focus mode briefly dimming the previous response when submitting a new prompt
changes.summary: 修复焦点模式提交时变暗
changes.summary_en: Fixed focus mode briefly dimming prior response
changes.why_matters: 改善界面观感，减少提交新提示时的闪烁和视觉干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves UI polish by reducing flicker and visual distraction when submitting a new prompt.

changes.raw: Fixed stray "4;0;" desktop notification on every `/exit` in Kitty and other terminals that interpret OSC 9 as a notification
changes.summary: 退出时不再误发桌面通知
changes.summary_en: Fixed stray desktop notification on /exit
changes.why_matters: 避免在 Kitty 等终端中退出时出现无意义通知，提升使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents meaningless notifications on exit in Kitty and similar terminals, improving the user experience.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control showing an empty "Opening your options…" message on rate limit instead of actionable upsell options
changes.summary: 限流时显示可操作升级选项
changes.summary_en: Remote Control now shows actionable upsell options
changes.why_matters: 用户遇到限流时能看到明确下一步，而不是空白提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Users now see clear next steps when rate-limited instead of an empty message.

changes.raw: Fixed drag-and-drop image upload hanging on "Pasting text…" when the image read fails
changes.summary: 图片上传失败不再卡住
changes.summary_en: Image upload no longer hangs on read failure
changes.why_matters: 拖拽上传失败时流程能正常结束，避免界面卡死。
changes.why_matters_en: Failed drag-and-drop uploads now fail cleanly instead of hanging the interface.

changes.raw: Fixed crash loop when piping very large input (>10 MB) to `claude -p` via stdin
changes.summary: 修复大输入管道崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash loop on large stdin input
changes.why_matters: 避免大于 10MB 的标准输入导致 CLI 崩溃循环，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crash loops when piping large stdin input, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed long URLs not being individually clickable on every wrapped row in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 长链接可逐行点击
changes.summary_en: Make long URLs clickable on wrapped rows
changes.why_matters: 改善全屏模式下长 URL 的可点击性，提升终端交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves clickability of long URLs in fullscreen mode, making terminal interaction smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin` Components panel showing "Marketplace 'inline' not found" for plugins loaded via `--plugin-dir`
changes.summary: 修复插件面板来源识别
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin panel for --plugin-dir loads
changes.why_matters: 让通过 `--plugin-dir` 加载的插件能正常显示组件面板，避免误报缺失市场。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures plugins loaded via `--plugin-dir` show correctly in the Components panel instead of a false missing-marketplace error.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tool results dropping images when the server returns both structured content and content blocks
changes.summary: 保留 MCP 图片结果
changes.summary_en: Keep images in MCP tool results
changes.why_matters: 防止 MCP 工具返回结构化内容时丢失图片，保证结果完整可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents images from being dropped when MCP tools return structured content, preserving complete results.

changes.raw: Fixed fenced code blocks inside list items carrying leading whitespace into the clipboard on copy-paste
changes.summary: 复制代码块去除多余缩进
changes.summary_en: Remove extra indentation on copied code
changes.why_matters: 避免列表内代码块复制后带入前导空白，减少粘贴后的格式错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents leading whitespace from being copied with nested code blocks, reducing paste formatting issues.

changes.raw: Fixed tab navigation in `/config` stranding focus — the tab header now stays focused so arrows and Esc keep working
changes.summary: 修复配置页焦点导航
changes.summary_en: Fix focus navigation in /config
changes.why_matters: 让 `/config` 中的键盘导航持续可用，提升无鼠标操作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps keyboard navigation working in `/config`, improving mouse-free usability.

changes.raw: Fixed markdown link labels being lost on terminals without OSC 8 hyperlink support — links now render as `label (url)` instead of just the URL
changes.summary: 无超链终端保留链接文本
changes.summary_en: Show link labels without OSC 8 support
changes.why_matters: 在不支持 OSC 8 的终端中保留链接标签，避免只看到裸 URL。
changes.why_matters_en: Preserves link labels on terminals without OSC 8 support instead of showing only raw URLs.

changes.raw: Fixed sessions on 1M-context models with a smaller autocompact window being falsely blocked with "Prompt is too long" before reaching the actual API limit
changes.summary: 修复过早提示上下文过长
changes.summary_en: Fix premature prompt-too-long blocking
changes.why_matters: 避免 1M 上下文模型在未到真实 API 限制前被错误拦截，减少任务中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents 1M-context sessions from being blocked before the real API limit, reducing interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed parallel shell tool calls: a failing read-only command (grep, git diff, ls) no longer cancels sibling calls
changes.summary: 并行命令失败不再连坐
changes.summary_en: Keep sibling shell calls running
changes.why_matters: 单个只读命令失败时不再取消其他并行调用，提高并发执行效率。
changes.why_matters_en: A failing read-only command no longer cancels sibling parallel calls, improving concurrent execution efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed banner showing "with X effort" on models that don't support effort
changes.summary: 修复不支持 effort 的提示
changes.summary_en: Hide effort banner on unsupported models
changes.why_matters: 避免在不支持 effort 的模型上显示误导性状态信息。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids misleading effort status on models that do not support it.

changes.raw: Fixed `/fast` on 3P providers fuzzy-matching to an unrelated skill instead of showing "not available"
changes.summary: 3P 提供商禁用错误技能匹配
changes.summary_en: Stop fuzzy-matching /fast on 3P providers
changes.why_matters: 让不支持的 `/fast` 明确返回不可用，而不是误匹配到其他技能。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes unsupported `/fast` clearly report unavailable instead of matching an unrelated skill.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock default model resolving to `global.*` instead of the region-appropriate prefix
changes.summary: Bedrock 默认模型按区域解析
changes.summary_en: Resolve Bedrock default model by region
changes.why_matters: 确保 Bedrock 默认模型使用正确的区域前缀，减少调用失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures the Bedrock default model uses the correct region prefix, reducing request failures.

changes.raw: Fixed vim mode: `Space` in NORMAL mode now moves the cursor right, matching standard vi/vim behavior
changes.summary: vim 空格键符合标准行为
changes.summary_en: Make Space move right in vim NORMAL mode
changes.why_matters: 让 vim 模式更符合标准习惯，降低键位学习成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Aligns vim mode with standard behavior, lowering the learning curve.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal progress indicator (OSC 9;4) flickering off between tool calls — stays visible across the full turn
changes.summary: 进度指示器全程保持显示
changes.summary_en: Keep progress indicator visible across turn
changes.why_matters: 避免工具调用间进度条闪烁消失，提升任务状态可见性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the progress indicator from flickering off between tool calls, improving task visibility.

changes.raw: Fixed `/rename` without args failing on resumed sessions whose last entry is a compact boundary
changes.summary: 恢复重开会话的重命名
changes.summary_en: Fix /rename on resumed compacted sessions
changes.why_matters: 让恢复后的会话也能正常重命名，避免在压缩边界处失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows resumed sessions to be renamed correctly, avoiding failures at compact boundaries.

changes.raw: Fixed stale "remote-control is active" status lines from prior sessions appearing after `--resume`/`--continue`
changes.summary: 修复续会残留状态行
changes.summary_en: Fix stale status lines after resume
changes.why_matters: 避免旧会话的远程控制状态误导用户，提升续会话的可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stale remote-control status from confusing users after resuming a session.

changes.raw: Fixed stale `installed_plugins.json` entries pointing at deleted cache directories polluting PATH
changes.summary: 修复失效插件路径污染
changes.summary_en: Fix deleted plugin cache paths in PATH
changes.why_matters: 避免已删除缓存目录残留到 PATH 中导致插件解析和命令执行异常。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents deleted cache paths from polluting PATH and breaking plugin resolution or command execution.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP stdio servers receiving corrupted arguments when `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX` is set and an argument contains spaces or shell metacharacters
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 参数被破坏
changes.summary_en: Fix corrupted MCP stdio arguments
changes.why_matters: 当启用 shell 前缀时可正确传递带空格或特殊字符的参数，避免 MCP 服务启动失败或行为错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures arguments with spaces or shell metacharacters are passed correctly when a shell prefix is set, avoiding MCP server failures or misbehavior.

changes.raw: Fixed sub-agent progress summaries missing the prompt cache (~3× `cache_creation` reduction)
changes.summary: 修复子代理摘要缺少缓存
changes.summary_en: Fix sub-agent summaries missing prompt cache
changes.why_matters: 让子代理摘要更准确地反映缓存使用情况，帮助降低不必要的缓存创建开销。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes sub-agent summaries accurately reflect cache usage and helps reduce unnecessary cache creation overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin update` never detecting new versions of npm-sourced plugins
changes.summary: 修复插件更新检测失效
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin update version detection
changes.why_matters: 用户现在能正确发现 npm 插件的新版本，避免错过更新。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now correctly detect new versions of npm-sourced plugins and avoid missing updates.

changes.raw: Fixed sub-agent summaries firing repeatedly while a sub-agent's transcript is static, capping worst-case token cost on idle sub-agents
changes.summary: 减少空闲子代理重复摘要
changes.summary_en: Stop repeated summaries for idle sub-agents
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理静止时反复生成摘要，显著降低无效 token 消耗。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents repeated summaries while a sub-agent is idle, significantly reducing wasted token usage.

changes.raw: Headless `--output-format stream-json`: `init.plugin_errors` now includes `--plugin-dir` load failures in addition to dependency demotions
changes.summary: 输出插件加载失败详情
changes.summary_en: Expose plugin load failures in stream JSON
changes.why_matters: 头less 模式下能更完整地报告插件加载问题，便于自动化排障。
changes.why_matters_en: Headless mode now reports plugin loading issues more completely, making automated troubleshooting easier.

signals.title: Claude Code refuses requests or charges extra if your commits mention "OpenClaw"
HERMES.md in commit messages causes requests to route to extra usage billing
DeepClaude – Claude Code agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro
Who owns the code Claude Code wrote?
Using Claude Code: The unreasonable effectiveness of HTML

changes.raw: The `/model` picker now lists models from your gateway's `/v1/models` endpoint when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at an Anthropic-compatible gateway
changes.summary: 模型选择器支持网关模型列表
changes.summary_en: Model picker lists gateway models
changes.why_matters: 用户在接入兼容 Anthropic 的网关时，可以直接看到并选择可用模型，减少配置和猜测成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can directly see and choose available models from an Anthropic-compatible gateway, reducing setup friction and guesswork.

changes.raw: - Added `claude project purge [path]` to delete all Claude Code state for a project (transcripts, tasks, file history, config entry) — supports `--dry-run`, `-y/--yes`, `-i/--interactive`, and `--all`
changes.summary: 新增项目清理命令
changes.summary_en: Add project purge command
changes.why_matters: 用户可以一键清除某个项目的 Claude Code 状态，便于重置环境、清理遗留数据和释放空间。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can wipe a project's Claude Code state in one command, making it easier to reset, clean up leftovers, and free space.

changes.raw: `--dangerously-skip-permissions` now bypasses prompts for writes to `.claude/`, `.git/`, `.vscode/`, shell config files, and other previously-protected paths (catastrophic removal commands still prompt as a safety net)
changes.summary: 跳过权限覆盖更多写入路径
changes.summary_en: Skip-permissions covers more writes
changes.why_matters: 在明确关闭权限检查时，工具对常见配置和仓库路径的写入更顺畅，减少不必要的中断。
changes.why_matters_en: When permission checks are intentionally bypassed, writes to common config and repo paths proceed more smoothly with fewer interruptions.

changes.raw: `claude auth login` now accepts the OAuth code pasted into the terminal when the browser callback can't reach localhost (WSL2, SSH, containers)
changes.summary: 登录支持终端粘贴 OAuth 码
changes.summary_en: Login accepts pasted OAuth code
changes.why_matters: 在 WSL2、SSH 或容器等无法回调本机的环境里，用户仍能完成登录流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can still complete login in WSL2, SSH, or container environments where the browser callback cannot reach localhost.

changes.raw: `claude_code.skill_activated` OpenTelemetry event now fires for user-typed slash commands and carries a new `invocation_trigger` attribute (`"user-slash"`, `"claude-proactive"`, or `"nested-skill"`)
changes.summary: 技能激活事件记录触发来源
changes.summary_en: Skill event adds trigger source
changes.why_matters: 埋点现在能区分用户手动、Claude 主动和嵌套技能触发，便于分析使用模式。
changes.why_matters_en: Telemetry can now distinguish user-typed, proactive, and nested skill triggers, improving usage analysis.

changes.raw: Auto mode: the spinner now turns red when a permission check stalls, instead of looking like the tool is running
changes.summary: 卡住时自动模式转红提示
changes.summary_en: Auto mode spinner turns red on stall
changes.why_matters: 当权限检查卡住时，界面会更明确地提示异常状态，避免用户误以为工具仍在正常运行。
changes.why_matters_en: When a permission check stalls, the UI now clearly signals an abnormal state instead of looking like normal progress.

changes.raw: Host-managed deployments (`CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST`) no longer auto-disable analytics on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry
changes.summary: 托管部署不再误关分析
changes.summary_en: Managed deployments keep analytics on
changes.why_matters: 使用主机托管的 Bedrock、Vertex 或 Foundry 时，分析数据不会被错误关闭，便于可观测性和诊断。
changes.why_matters_en: Analytics are no longer incorrectly disabled for host-managed Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry deployments, preserving observability and diagnostics.

changes.raw: Windows: PowerShell 7 installed via the Microsoft Store, MSI without PATH, or `.NET global tool` is now detected
changes.summary: Windows 识别更多 PowerShell 安装
changes.summary_en: Windows detects more PowerShell installs
changes.why_matters: Windows 用户在更多安装方式下都能被正确识别 PowerShell，减少环境兼容问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Windows users get correct PowerShell detection across more installation methods, reducing environment compatibility issues.

changes.raw: Windows: when the PowerShell tool is enabled, Claude now treats PowerShell as the primary shell instead of defaulting to Bash
changes.summary: Windows 优先使用 PowerShell
changes.summary_en: Windows prefers PowerShell as shell
changes.why_matters: 启用 PowerShell 工具后，Claude 会使用更符合 Windows 习惯的默认 shell，提升命令执行一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: With the PowerShell tool enabled, Claude uses a more Windows-native default shell, improving command execution consistency.

changes.raw: Read tool: removed the per-file malware-assessment reminder that could cause spurious refusals and "this is not malware" commentary on legacy models
changes.summary: 移除读工具误报恶意软件提示
changes.summary_en: Remove false malware reminder in Read
changes.why_matters: 减少旧模型在读取文件时的误拒绝和无关说明，让代码阅读更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces spurious refusals and irrelevant commentary from legacy models when reading files, making code inspection smoother.

changes.raw: **Security:** Fixed `allowManagedDomainsOnly` / `allowManagedReadPathsOnly` being ignored when a higher-priority managed-settings source lacked a `sandbox` block
changes.summary: 修复受管域名限制失效
changes.summary_en: Fix managed domain/path restrictions
changes.why_matters: 修复后，受管域名和只读路径限制不会因配置优先级问题被绕过，避免越权访问风险。
changes.why_matters_en: The fix prevents managed domain and read-path restrictions from being bypassed due to config precedence issues, reducing unauthorized access risk.

changes.raw: Fixed pasting an image larger than 2000px breaking the session — images are now downscaled on paste, and oversized images in history are automatically removed and the request retried
changes.summary: 大图粘贴不再中断会话
changes.summary_en: Large pasted images no longer break sessions
changes.why_matters: 用户粘贴超大图片时会自动缩放并重试，避免会话失败和手动重来。
changes.why_matters_en: Oversized pasted images are now downscaled and retried automatically, preventing session failures and manual retries.

changes.raw: Fixed showing the login screen for "OAuth not allowed for organization" errors — now shows guidance to contact your admin
changes.summary: OAuth 组织禁用时给出指引
changes.summary_en: OAuth org-disabled errors show guidance
changes.why_matters: 当组织禁止 OAuth 登录时，用户会看到明确的下一步说明，而不是困惑的登录页。
changes.why_matters_en: When an organization blocks OAuth login, users now get clear next-step guidance instead of a confusing login screen.

changes.raw: Fixed OAuth login failing with timeout on slow or proxied connections, in IPv6-only devcontainers, and when the browser callback can't reach localhost
changes.summary: 修复慢网路 OAuth 登录超时
changes.summary_en: Fix OAuth login timeouts on slow networks
changes.why_matters: 在慢网、代理、IPv6-only 容器或本机回调不可达时，登录成功率更高。
changes.why_matters_en: Login succeeds more reliably on slow networks, proxies, IPv6-only containers, or when localhost callbacks are unreachable.

changes.raw: Fixed a rare race where a concurrent credential write could clear a valid OAuth refresh token
changes.summary: 修复凭据写入清空刷新令牌
changes.summary_en: Fix credential writes clearing refresh token
changes.why_matters: 避免并发写入意外丢失有效 OAuth 刷新令牌，防止用户被迫重新登录。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents concurrent writes from accidentally erasing a valid OAuth refresh token and forcing users to log in again.

changes.raw: Fixed API retry countdown sticking at "0s" instead of counting down between attempts
changes.summary: 修复重试倒计时显示
changes.summary_en: Fix retry countdown display
changes.why_matters: 让用户能正确看到重试间隔，减少对请求状态的误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see the real retry delay, reducing confusion about request state.

changes.raw: Fixed "Stream idle timeout" error after waking Mac from sleep mid-request
changes.summary: 修复唤醒后超时误报
changes.summary_en: Fix timeout after sleep wake
changes.why_matters: 避免 Mac 休眠唤醒后请求被错误中断，提升长请求稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents requests from being wrongly interrupted after Mac sleep, improving long-request reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed background and remote sessions falsely aborting with "Stream idle timeout" during long model thinking pauses
changes.summary: 修复长思考误判超时
changes.summary_en: Fix false timeout on long thinking
changes.why_matters: 减少后台和远程会话在模型长时间推理时被误终止。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces false aborts in background and remote sessions during long model reasoning pauses.

changes.raw: Fixed a hang where the assistant could finish thinking but show no output after a run of empty turns
changes.summary: 修复空轮次后无输出卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix no-output hang after empty turns
changes.why_matters: 避免助手思考完成却不显示结果，防止工作流卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the assistant from finishing silently, avoiding workflow stalls.

changes.raw: Fixed overly fast trackpad scrolling in Cursor and VS Code 1.92–1.104 integrated terminals
changes.summary: 修复集成终端滚动过快
changes.summary_en: Fix overly fast terminal scrolling
changes.why_matters: 改善 Cursor 和 VS Code 集成终端的滚动体验，减少误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves scrolling behavior in integrated terminals and reduces accidental overscroll.

changes.raw: Fixed claude.ai MCP connectors being suppressed by manual servers stuck in needs-auth state
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 连接器被屏蔽
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP connectors being suppressed
changes.why_matters: 确保可用连接器不会因手动服务器异常状态而被隐藏。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures available connectors are not hidden by a stuck manual server auth state.

changes.raw: Fixed Japanese/Korean/Chinese text rendering as garbled characters on Windows in no-flicker mode
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 乱码显示
changes.summary_en: Fix garbled CJK text on Windows
changes.why_matters: 提升 Windows 下中文、日文、韩文文本的可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves readability of Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed `Ctrl+L` clearing the prompt input — it now only forces a screen redraw, matching readline behavior
changes.summary: Ctrl+L 仅重绘不清空输入
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+L redraws without clearing input
changes.why_matters: 符合 readline 习惯，避免用户误丢正在输入的内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Matches readline behavior and prevents accidental loss of typed input.

changes.raw: Fixed deferred tools (WebSearch, WebFetch, etc.) not being available to skills with `context: fork` and other subagents on their first turn
changes.summary: 修复子代理首轮工具缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix missing deferred tools in subagents
changes.why_matters: 让技能和子代理首轮就能使用 WebSearch、WebFetch 等工具。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets skills and subagents use tools like WebSearch and WebFetch on their first turn.

changes.raw: Fixed plan-mode tools being unavailable in interactive sessions launched with `--channels`
changes.summary: 修复计划模式工具不可用
changes.summary_en: Fix plan-mode tools unavailable
changes.why_matters: 保证通过 --channels 启动的交互会话也能正常使用计划模式工具。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures interactive sessions launched with --channels can still use plan-mode tools.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin` Uninstall reporting "Enabled" instead of "Uninstalled"
changes.summary: 修复插件卸载状态显示
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin uninstall status display
changes.why_matters: 让用户能准确确认插件已卸载，减少状态混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives users an accurate uninstall status and avoids confusion.

changes.raw: Bounded total size of file-modified reminders when a linter touches many files at once
changes.summary: 限制修改提醒总大小
changes.summary_en: Bound total reminder size
changes.why_matters: 防止大量文件被检查时提醒内容过大，保持响应更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents reminder payloads from growing too large when many files are linted, keeping responses stable.

changes.raw: Fixed `/remote-control` retries appearing stuck on "connecting…" — each retry now shows its result
changes.summary: 修复远控重试状态卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix remote-control retry status
changes.why_matters: 让每次远程控制重试都能显示结果，便于排查连接问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows the result of each remote-control retry, making connection issues easier to diagnose.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control failure notification not showing the error reason for initial connection failures
changes.summary: 修复远控失败原因不显示
changes.summary_en: Fix missing remote-control error reason
changes.why_matters: 初次连接失败时能看到具体错误，提升排障效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Displays the actual error on initial connection failure, improving troubleshooting.

changes.raw: Windows: clipboard writes no longer expose copied content in process command-line arguments visible to EDR/SIEM telemetry; also fixes >22KB selections not reaching the clipboard
changes.summary: 修复剪贴板泄露与大文本失败
changes.summary_en: Fix clipboard leakage and large copy
changes.why_matters: 避免复制内容暴露到进程参数和安全遥测中，并修复大文本复制失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents copied content from leaking into process arguments and telemetry, and fixes large clipboard copies.

changes.raw: PowerShell tool: bare `--` (e.g. `git diff -- file`) is no longer mis-flagged as the `--%` stop-parsing token
changes.summary: 修复 PowerShell 参数误判
changes.summary_en: Fix PowerShell arg parsing
changes.why_matters: 避免把普通的 `--` 误识别为停止解析标记，减少 PowerShell 下命令执行错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents normal `--` from being mistaken for the stop-parsing token, reducing command errors in PowerShell.

changes.raw: Fixed Agent SDK hang when the model emits a malformed tool name in a parallel tool call batch
changes.summary: 修复并行工具调用卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix Agent SDK parallel-call hang
changes.why_matters: 当模型输出错误工具名时不再卡住，提升 Agent SDK 的稳定性和可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids hangs when the model emits a malformed tool name, improving Agent SDK stability and usability.

signals.title: Claude Code refuses requests or charges extra if your commits mention "OpenClaw"
HERMES.md in commit messages causes requests to route to extra usage billing
An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
DeepClaude – Claude Code agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro
Who owns the code Claude Code wrote?

changes.raw: Fixed OAuth authentication failing with a 401 retry loop when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1` is set
changes.summary: 修复OAuth 401重试死循环
changes.summary_en: Fix OAuth 401 retry loop
changes.why_matters: 避免在关闭实验性 beta 时认证失败并反复重试，提升登录稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents auth failures and endless retries when experimental betas are disabled, improving login stability.

signals.title: Claude Code refuses requests or charges extra if your commits mention "OpenClaw"
HERMES.md in commit messages causes requests to route to extra usage billing
An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
DeepClaude – Claude Code agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro
Who owns the code Claude Code wrote?

changes.raw: Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER` environment variable to select a Bedrock service tier (`default`, `flex`, or `priority`), sent as the `X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier` header
changes.summary: 支持选择Bedrock服务层级
changes.summary_en: Select Bedrock service tier via env
changes.why_matters: 用户可以按需选择不同的 Bedrock 服务层级，便于控制性能、延迟和成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can choose the Bedrock service tier they need, helping balance performance, latency, and cost.

changes.raw: Pasting a PR URL into the `/resume` search box now finds the session that created that PR (GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, and Bitbucket)
changes.summary: 粘贴PR链接可找回会话
changes.summary_en: Paste PR URL to find its session
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接通过 PR 链接定位创建该 PR 的会话，减少手动搜索成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can locate the session that created a PR directly from its URL, reducing manual search effort.

changes.raw: `/mcp` now shows claude.ai connectors hidden by a manually-added server with the same URL, with a hint to remove the duplicate
changes.summary: /mcp显示重复连接提示
changes.summary_en: /mcp shows duplicate connector hint
changes.why_matters: 这能帮助用户发现被手动同地址服务器遮蔽的 claude.ai 连接器，避免配置混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users notice claude.ai connectors hidden by duplicate servers and avoid configuration confusion.

changes.raw: Clarified the `/mcp` message shown when an MCP server is still unauthorized after the browser sign-in flow
changes.summary: 优化MCP未授权提示
changes.summary_en: Clearer MCP unauthorized message
changes.why_matters: 更清晰的提示能帮助用户判断浏览器登录后仍未授权的原因并继续排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearer messaging helps users understand why an MCP server remains unauthorized after browser sign-in.

changes.raw: OpenTelemetry: numeric attributes on `api_request`/`api_error` log events are now emitted as numbers, not strings
changes.summary: OpenTelemetry数值属性改为数值
changes.summary_en: Emit numeric OTel attributes as numbers
changes.why_matters: 这让可观测性数据类型更准确，便于查询、聚合和告警分析。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes observability data types accurate, improving querying, aggregation, and alerting.

changes.raw: OpenTelemetry: added `claude_code.at_mention` log event for `@`-mention resolution
changes.summary: 新增@提及解析日志事件
changes.summary_en: Add OTel event for @-mention resolution
changes.why_matters: 新增事件可帮助追踪 @ 提及解析流程，提升调试和可观测性。
changes.why_matters_en: The new event helps trace @-mention resolution, improving debugging and observability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/branch` producing forks that fail with "tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks" when the source session contained entries from rewound timelines
changes.summary: 修复/branch生成失效分支
changes.summary_en: Fix /branch forks from rewound timelines
changes.why_matters: 这避免从回退时间线创建的分支出现工具调用结构错误，保证分支可继续使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents forks from rewound timelines from breaking tool-call structure, keeping branches usable.

changes.raw: Fixed `/model` not showing the Effort option for Bedrock application inference profile ARNs, and those ARNs not receiving `output_config.effort`
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock模型努力度选项
changes.summary_en: Fix Effort option for Bedrock ARNs
changes.why_matters: 用户在 Bedrock 应用推理配置下可正确设置 Effort，避免模型行为与预期不符。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can correctly set Effort for Bedrock application inference profiles, avoiding unexpected model behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed Vertex AI / Bedrock returning `invalid_request_error: output_config: Extra inputs are not permitted` on session-title generation and other structured-output queries
changes.summary: 修复Vertex/Bedrock结构化输出报错
changes.summary_en: Fix structured output errors on Vertex/Bedrock
changes.why_matters: 这解决了会话标题生成等结构化输出请求失败的问题，恢复核心功能可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes failures in structured-output requests like session-title generation, restoring core functionality.

changes.raw: Fixed Vertex AI `count_tokens` endpoint returning 400 errors for users behind proxy gateways
changes.summary: 修复Vertex计数接口代理报错
changes.summary_en: Fix Vertex count_tokens behind proxies
changes.why_matters: 代理环境下的用户现在可以正常统计 token，避免因 400 错误影响使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Users behind proxy gateways can now count tokens normally without 400 errors disrupting usage.

changes.raw: Fixed `spinnerTipsOverride.excludeDefault` not suppressing the time-based spinner tips
changes.summary: 修复spinner提示关闭失效
changes.summary_en: Fix spinner tip exclusion setting
changes.why_matters: 这让用户配置的提示排除选项真正生效，减少不想看到的提示干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes the user’s tip exclusion setting actually work, reducing unwanted spinner-tip interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed ToolSearch missing MCP tools that connected after session start in nonblocking mode
changes.summary: 修复非阻塞MCP工具搜索遗漏
changes.summary_en: Fix ToolSearch missing late MCP tools
changes.why_matters: 会话开始后连接的 MCP 工具现在也能被发现，避免工具不可见导致功能缺失。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP tools that connect after session start are now discoverable, preventing missing-tool failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `!exit` / `!quit` in bash mode terminating the CLI instead of running as a shell command
changes.summary: 修复bash模式下!exit误退出
changes.summary_en: Fix !exit in bash mode
changes.why_matters: 用户在 bash 模式下输入 `!exit`/`!quit` 时不再意外退出 CLI，避免中断工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Typing `!exit`/`!quit` in bash mode no longer exits the CLI unexpectedly, avoiding workflow interruption.

changes.raw: Fixed images sent to newer models being resized to 2576px per side instead of the correct 2000px maximum
changes.summary: 修复新模型图片缩放过大
changes.summary_en: Fix image resize limit for newer models
changes.why_matters: 图片会按正确上限处理，减少因过大尺寸导致的兼容性和质量问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Images are now resized to the correct limit, reducing compatibility and quality issues from oversized inputs.

changes.raw: Fixed remote control session idle status redrawing twice per second, which could flood `tmux -CC` control pipes and pause the terminal
changes.summary: 修复远程控制状态刷新过频
changes.summary_en: Fix overly frequent remote status redraws
changes.why_matters: 这能减少 tmux 控制管道被刷爆的风险，避免终端卡顿或暂停。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces the risk of flooding tmux control pipes, preventing terminal lag or pauses.

changes.raw: Fixed assistant messages appearing blank in some sessions due to a stale view preference
changes.summary: 修复部分会话助手消息空白
changes.summary_en: Fix blank assistant messages in some sessions
changes.why_matters: 避免因旧视图偏好导致助手回复不显示，提升对话可用性和可信度。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents assistant replies from disappearing due to stale view preferences, improving chat reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed a malformed hooks entry in `settings.json` no longer invalidating the entire file
changes.summary: 修复坏 hooks 不再毁掉配置
changes.summary_en: Malformed hooks no longer invalidate settings
changes.why_matters: 单个 hooks 配置错误不再让整个 settings.json 失效，降低配置损坏风险。
changes.why_matters_en: A bad hooks entry no longer breaks the entire settings.json file, reducing configuration risk.

changes.raw: Voice mode: keybindings bound to Caps Lock now show an error since terminals don't deliver Caps Lock as a key event
changes.summary: 语音模式提示 Caps Lock 不可用
changes.summary_en: Voice mode now warns on Caps Lock bindings
changes.why_matters: 让用户知道终端无法传递 Caps Lock 事件，避免语音模式快捷键误配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users avoid misconfiguring voice mode shortcuts by warning that terminals do not emit Caps Lock events.

signals.title: Claude Code refuses requests or charges extra if your commits mention "OpenClaw"

An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
Claude Code to be removed from Anthropic's Pro plan?
