changes.raw: Added `alwaysLoad` option to MCP server config — when `true`, all tools from that server skip tool-search deferral and are always available
changes.summary: MCP工具可常驻可用
changes.summary_en: Always load MCP tools
changes.why_matters: 让指定 MCP 服务器的工具无需延迟搜索即可直接可用，减少调用等待并提升工作流顺畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes tools from selected MCP servers immediately available, reducing lookup delay and smoothing workflows.

changes.raw: Added `claude plugin prune` to remove orphaned auto-installed plugin dependencies; `plugin uninstall --prune` cascades
changes.summary: 清理孤儿插件依赖
changes.summary_en: Prune orphaned plugin deps
changes.why_matters: 可以移除自动安装插件留下的无用依赖，减少环境污染并简化插件卸载维护。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes leftover dependencies from auto-installed plugins, keeping the environment cleaner and uninstalls simpler.

changes.raw: Added a type-to-filter search box to `/skills` so you can find a skill in long lists without scrolling
changes.summary: 技能列表可搜索筛选
changes.summary_en: Filter skills with typing
changes.why_matters: 在长技能列表中快速定位目标技能，减少滚动查找成本。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users quickly find a skill in long lists without excessive scrolling.

changes.raw: PostToolUse hooks can now replace tool output for all tools via `hookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput` (previously MCP-only)
changes.summary: 钩子可改写工具输出
changes.summary_en: Hooks can rewrite tool output
changes.why_matters: 让后置钩子能统一替换所有工具输出，增强自动化处理和结果规范化能力。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets post-tool hooks replace output for any tool, improving automation and output normalization.

changes.raw: Fullscreen mode: typing into the prompt no longer jumps scroll back to the bottom after you've scrolled up to read earlier output
changes.summary: 修复全屏滚动跳回底部
changes.summary_en: Fix scroll jumping in fullscreen
changes.why_matters: 阅读历史输出时不会被输入打断回到底部，提升长对话可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Typing no longer yanks the view back to the bottom, making long outputs easier to read.

changes.raw: Dialogs that overflow the terminal are now scrollable with arrow keys, PgUp/PgDn, home/end, and mouse wheel in both fullscreen and non-fullscreen modes
changes.summary: 溢出对话可滚动查看
changes.summary_en: Scrollable overflow dialogs
changes.why_matters: 终端内容超出窗口时也能完整浏览，避免信息被截断。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can fully inspect dialogs that exceed terminal size instead of losing content off-screen.

changes.raw: Clicking any line of a long URL that wraps across rows in fullscreen mode now opens the full URL
changes.summary: 长链接换行可点击
changes.summary_en: Clickable wrapped long URLs
changes.why_matters: 即使链接跨行显示，也能直接打开完整 URL，减少误点和复制步骤。
changes.why_matters_en: Wrapped URLs remain clickable, reducing friction when opening long links.

changes.raw: SDK and `claude -p`: `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1` now works in non-interactive sessions
changes.summary: 非交互会话支持子代理
changes.summary_en: Fork subagent in non-interactive
changes.why_matters: SDK 和 `claude -p` 在非交互模式下也能使用子代理分叉能力，扩展自动化脚本场景。
changes.why_matters_en: SDK and `claude -p` can now fork subagents in non-interactive sessions, broadening automation use cases.

changes.raw: `--dangerously-skip-permissions` no longer prompts for writes to `.claude/skills/`, `.claude/agents/`, and `.claude/commands/`
changes.summary: 跳过权限时放行技能目录
changes.summary_en: Skip permission prompts for skill dirs
changes.why_matters: 在危险跳过权限模式下减少不必要提示，让技能、代理和命令的安装更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes unnecessary prompts in skip-permissions mode, making skill, agent, and command installs smoother.

changes.raw: `/terminal-setup` now enables iTerm2's "Applications in terminal may access clipboard" setting so `/copy` works, including from tmux
changes.summary: 一键启用剪贴板权限
changes.summary_en: Enable clipboard access in iTerm2
changes.why_matters: 让 `/copy` 在 iTerm2 和 tmux 中更可靠地工作，减少手动改设置。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes `/copy` work more reliably in iTerm2 and tmux with less manual setup.

changes.raw: MCP servers that hit a transient error during startup now auto-retry up to 3 times instead of staying disconnected
changes.summary: MCP启动失败自动重试
changes.summary_en: Auto-retry transient MCP startup errors
changes.why_matters: 临时启动错误会自动重试，降低服务器断连带来的中断和手动恢复成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Transient startup failures now retry automatically, reducing disconnects and manual recovery.

changes.raw: The terminal tab session title is now generated in your configured `language` setting
changes.summary: 会话标题使用语言设置
changes.summary_en: Session titles use configured language
changes.why_matters: 终端标签标题会按用户语言生成，更一致也更易读。
changes.why_matters_en: Terminal tab titles now match the configured language, improving consistency and readability.

changes.raw: Claude.ai connectors with the same upstream URL are now deduplicated instead of appearing as duplicates
changes.summary: 同源连接器自动去重
changes.summary_en: Deduplicate same-URL connectors
changes.why_matters: 避免 Claude.ai 连接器重复显示，减少配置混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents duplicate Claude.ai connectors from cluttering the UI.

changes.raw: Vertex AI: support X.509 certificate-based Workload Identity Federation (mTLS ADC)
changes.summary: 支持X.509联邦身份
changes.summary_en: Support X.509 WIF for Vertex AI
changes.why_matters: 为 Vertex AI 提供基于证书的身份联合认证，适配企业级安全登录方式。
changes.why_matters_en: This adds certificate-based workload identity federation for Vertex AI, fitting enterprise authentication setups.

changes.raw: Faster startup after upgrading: removed the Recent Activity panel from the release-notes splash
changes.summary: 升级后启动更快
changes.summary_en: Faster startup after upgrade
changes.why_matters: 移除不必要的启动面板，缩短升级后的等待时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Removing an unnecessary splash panel speeds up startup after upgrading.

changes.raw: LSP diagnostic summaries now expand on click/ctrl+o and show the expand hint
changes.summary: LSP诊断可点击展开
changes.summary_en: LSP diagnostics expand on click
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更快查看完整诊断详情，减少在编辑器里来回切换的成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can inspect full diagnostic details faster without extra navigation.

changes.raw: SDK: `mcp_authenticate` now supports `redirectUri` for custom scheme completion and claude.ai connectors
changes.summary: mcp_authenticate支持redirectUri
changes.summary_en: mcp_authenticate supports redirectUri
changes.why_matters: 这让自定义 scheme 回调和 claude.ai 连接器认证流程能够正常完成。
changes.why_matters_en: This enables custom-scheme callbacks and claude.ai connector auth flows to complete.

changes.raw: OpenTelemetry: added `stop_reason`, `gen_ai.response.finish_reasons`, and `user_system_prompt` (gated behind `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`) to LLM request spans
changes.summary: LLM埋点增加结束原因
changes.summary_en: LLM spans add finish reason fields
changes.why_matters: 更丰富的 OpenTelemetry 数据有助于排查请求行为和分析模型输出结果。
changes.why_matters_en: Richer OpenTelemetry data helps debug request behavior and analyze model outputs.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Voice dictation now respects the `accessibility.voice.speechLanguage` setting when no Claude Code language is configured
changes.summary: 语音听写跟随系统语言
changes.summary_en: Voice dictation follows system language
changes.why_matters: 在未配置 Claude Code 语言时，语音输入会更符合系统无障碍设置。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice input better matches system accessibility settings when no app language is set.

changes.raw: [VSCode] `/context` now opens a native token usage dialog
changes.summary: 上下文打开原生用量对话框
changes.summary_en: /context opens native usage dialog
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更直观地查看 token 用量，提升配额和成本感知。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can view token usage more clearly, improving quota and cost awareness.

changes.raw: Fixed unbounded memory growth (multi-GB RSS) when processing many images in a session
changes.summary: 修复图片处理内存暴涨
changes.summary_en: Fix multi-image memory growth
changes.why_matters: 这能避免会话中处理大量图片时占用数 GB 内存并拖垮系统。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents multi-GB memory growth when handling many images in a session.

changes.raw: Fixed `/usage` leaking up to ~2GB of memory on machines with large transcript histories
changes.summary: 修复usage命令内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix /usage memory leak
changes.why_matters: 在长历史记录机器上查看用量不再导致高达数 GB 的内存泄漏。
changes.why_matters_en: Viewing usage no longer leaks up to gigabytes of memory on large transcripts.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak when long-running tools fail to emit a clear progress event
changes.summary: 修复长工具失败内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix leak when tools miss progress
changes.why_matters: 长时间运行工具异常时不会持续泄漏内存，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Long-running tool failures no longer leak memory, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash tool becoming permanently unusable when the directory Claude was started in is deleted or moved mid-session
changes.summary: Bash工具目录丢失后可恢复
changes.summary_en: Bash tool recovers if cwd is removed
changes.why_matters: 工作目录被删除或移动后，Bash 工具不再永久失效，避免会话中断。
changes.why_matters_en: The Bash tool no longer becomes permanently unusable if its start directory disappears.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` crashing on startup in external builds
changes.summary: 修复外部构建resume崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix --resume crash in external builds
changes.why_matters: 外部构建环境下恢复会话时不再在启动阶段崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Resuming sessions in external builds no longer crashes on startup.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` failing on large sessions when a transcript line was corrupted by an unclean shutdown — the corrupt line is now skipped
changes.summary: 损坏转录行可跳过继续恢复
changes.summary_en: Skip corrupted transcript lines on resume
changes.why_matters: 非正常关闭后即使有损坏记录，长会话也更容易成功恢复。
changes.why_matters_en: Long sessions can still resume successfully even if a transcript line is corrupted.

changes.raw: Fixed `thinking.type.enabled is not supported` error when using Bedrock application inference profile ARNs
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock推理配置报错
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock inference profile error
changes.why_matters: 使用 Bedrock 应用推理配置 ARN 时不再出现不支持的参数错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Bedrock application inference profile ARNs no longer trigger unsupported parameter errors.

changes.raw: Fixed Microsoft 365 MCP OAuth failing with duplicate or unsupported `prompt` parameter
changes.summary: 修复M365 OAuth参数冲突
changes.summary_en: Fix Microsoft 365 OAuth prompt issue
changes.why_matters: Microsoft 365 MCP 登录流程更稳定，不会因重复或不支持的参数失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Microsoft 365 MCP auth is more reliable and no longer fails on bad prompt params.

changes.raw: Fixed scrollback duplication when pressing Ctrl+L or triggering a redraw in non-fullscreen mode on tmux, GNOME Terminal, Windows Terminal, and Konsole
changes.summary: 修复终端重绘重复滚屏
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate scrollback on redraw
changes.why_matters: 在多种终端和 tmux 中刷新界面时，历史输出不会重复堆叠。
changes.why_matters_en: Redrawing in various terminals no longer duplicates scrollback output.

changes.raw: Fixed claude.ai MCP connectors silently disappearing when the connector-list fetch hits a transient auth error at startup
changes.summary: 修复claude.ai连接器消失
changes.summary_en: Fix disappearing claude.ai connectors
changes.why_matters: 启动时遇到临时认证错误也不会让连接器列表静默消失。
changes.why_matters_en: Transient auth errors at startup no longer make claude.ai connectors vanish silently.

changes.raw: Fixed "Always allow" rules for built-in tools in remote sessions not surviving worker restarts
changes.summary: 远程会话规则重启后保留
changes.summary_en: Keep allow rules across worker restarts
changes.why_matters: 避免远程会话中已授权的内置工具权限在重启后丢失，减少重复确认和中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents approved built-in tool permissions from being lost after worker restarts, reducing repeated prompts and interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed `NO_PROXY` not being respected for all HTTP clients when set via `managed-settings.json` under the native build
changes.summary: 修复代理设置对所有客户端生效
changes.summary_en: Respect NO_PROXY across all HTTP clients
changes.why_matters: 确保通过托管设置配置的代理绕过规则对所有网络请求一致生效，避免连接异常。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures proxy bypass rules from managed settings apply consistently to all network requests and avoid connectivity issues.

changes.raw: Fixed managed settings approval prompt exiting the session even when accepted — now applies settings and continues
changes.summary: 接受托管设置后继续会话
changes.summary_en: Apply managed settings without exiting
changes.why_matters: 用户接受管理设置后不再被强制退出，会话可无缝继续。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can accept managed settings without being kicked out, so the session continues smoothly.

changes.raw: Fixed `/usage` returning "rate limited" after a stale OAuth token — now refreshes automatically
changes.summary: 过期 OAuth 后自动刷新用量
changes.summary_en: Auto-refresh stale OAuth for /usage
changes.why_matters: 避免因旧令牌导致 `/usage` 误报限流，提升状态查询可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents `/usage` from falsely reporting rate limits due to stale tokens and improves status query reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed invalid legacy enum values in `settings.json` invalidating the entire settings file
changes.summary: 旧枚举值不再毁掉配置文件
changes.summary_en: Ignore invalid legacy enum values
changes.why_matters: 兼容旧配置，避免单个过时值导致整个 `settings.json` 失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves backward compatibility so one outdated value does not invalidate the entire `settings.json` file.

changes.raw: Fixed `/usage` dialog content being clipped when no-flicker mode is off
changes.summary: 修复用量弹窗内容被截断
changes.summary_en: Prevent clipped /usage dialog content
changes.why_matters: 让 `/usage` 信息完整可见，减少查看配额时的阅读障碍。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps `/usage` information fully visible and reduces readability issues when checking quotas.

changes.raw: Fixed `/focus` showing "Unknown command" when the fullscreen renderer is off — now explains how to enable it
changes.summary: 关闭全屏渲染时提示启用焦点
changes.summary_en: Explain how to enable /focus
changes.why_matters: 当功能不可用时给出明确指引，减少用户困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Provides clear guidance when the feature is unavailable, reducing user confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed embedded grep/find/rg shell wrappers failing when the running binary is deleted mid-session — now falls back to installed tools
changes.summary: 删除二进制后回退到已装工具
changes.summary_en: Fallback to installed tools if binary is deleted
changes.why_matters: 避免会话中工具包装器因运行时二进制被删而失效，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents shell wrappers from failing if the running binary is deleted mid-session, improving stability.

changes.raw: Reduced peak file descriptor usage during `find` in the Bash tool on large directory trees
changes.summary: 大目录下减少文件句柄占用
changes.summary_en: Reduce file descriptor usage in find
changes.why_matters: 在大型目录树中降低资源消耗，减少因句柄耗尽导致的失败风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Lowers resource usage on large directory trees and reduces the risk of failures from descriptor exhaustion.

signals.title: Claude Code refuses requests or charges extra if your commits mention "OpenClaw"
HERMES.md in commit messages causes requests to route to extra usage billing
An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
Claude Code to be removed from Anthropic's Pro plan?
DeepClaude – Claude Code agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro

changes.raw: Windows: Git for Windows (Git Bash) is no longer required — when absent, Claude Code uses PowerShell as the shell tool
changes.summary: 无Git Bash也可用PowerShell
changes.summary_en: Use PowerShell when Git Bash is absent
changes.why_matters: 在 Windows 上减少了对 Git for Windows 的依赖，降低了安装门槛并提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes a Windows dependency, making Claude Code easier to use out of the box.

changes.raw: Added `claude ultrareview [target]` subcommand to run `/ultrareview` non-interactively from CI or scripts — prints findings to stdout (`--json` for raw output) and exits 0 on completion or 1 on failure
changes.summary: 新增非交互式超审查命令
changes.summary_en: Add non-interactive ultrareview command
changes.why_matters: 可以在 CI 或脚本中自动运行审查并获取结果，提升自动化代码评审能力。
changes.why_matters_en: It enables automated review in CI or scripts, improving code-review automation.

changes.raw: Skills can now reference the current effort level with `${CLAUDE_EFFORT}` in their content
changes.summary: 技能可引用当前努力级别
changes.summary_en: Skills can reference current effort level
changes.why_matters: 技能内容可以根据当前 effort 动态调整行为，更灵活地适配不同任务强度。
changes.why_matters_en: Skills can adapt behavior dynamically based on effort level, making them more flexible.

changes.raw: Set `AI_AGENT` environment variable for subprocesses so `gh` can attribute traffic to Claude Code
changes.summary: 子进程可标记AI代理身份
changes.summary_en: Mark subprocesses as AI_AGENT
changes.why_matters: 让 gh 等工具能识别流量来源，便于生态集成与归因统计。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets tools like gh attribute traffic correctly, improving ecosystem integration and attribution.

changes.raw: Spinner tips that recommend installing the desktop app or creating skills/agents are now hidden when you already have them
changes.summary: 隐藏已拥有的推荐提示
changes.summary_en: Hide tips for features you already have
changes.why_matters: 减少重复和无关提示，让界面更清爽、干扰更少。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces redundant tips and keeps the UI less distracting.

changes.raw: Show a "use PgUp/PgDn to scroll" hint when the terminal sends arrow keys instead of scroll events
changes.summary: 箭头滚动时提示翻页键
changes.summary_en: Show PgUp/PgDn hint for arrow-key terminals
changes.why_matters: 帮助终端环境下的用户更容易发现正确的滚动方式。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users discover the right scrolling keys in terminals that send arrow events.

changes.raw: Faster session start when you have many claude.ai connectors configured but not authorized
changes.summary: 加快未授权连接启动
changes.summary_en: Faster startup with many unauthorized connectors
changes.why_matters: 在配置了很多未授权连接器时减少启动等待，提升整体响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces startup latency when many configured connectors are not authorized.

changes.raw: The auto mode denial message now links to the configuration docs
changes.summary: 自动模式拒绝提示加文档链接
changes.summary_en: Auto-mode denial now links to docs
changes.why_matters: 用户遇到拒绝时可以直接查看配置说明，更快完成排障和调整。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can jump straight to the configuration docs, making troubleshooting faster.

changes.raw: `claude plugin validate` now accepts `$schema`, `version`, and `description` at the top level of `marketplace.json` and `$schema` in `plugin.json`
changes.summary: 插件校验支持更多顶层字段
changes.summary_en: Plugin validation accepts more top-level fields
changes.why_matters: 避免合法的 marketplace.json 和 plugin.json 被误判为无效，提升插件兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents valid plugin manifests from being rejected, improving compatibility.

changes.raw: Auto-compact in auto mode now displays `auto` (lowercase, no token count) instead of a misleading token value
changes.summary: 自动压缩显示更准确
changes.summary_en: Auto-compact shows a clearer label
changes.why_matters: 修正误导性的 token 显示，让用户更准确理解当前状态。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes a misleading token count and makes the status easier to understand.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing Esc during a stdio MCP tool call closing the entire server connection (regression in 2.1.105)
changes.summary: Esc不再断开stdio MCP
changes.summary_en: Esc no longer closes stdio MCP server
changes.why_matters: 避免一次误按导致整个 MCP 连接中断，显著提升工具调用稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents an accidental keypress from dropping the whole MCP connection, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/rewind` and other interactive overlays not responding to keyboard input after launching with `claude --resume`
changes.summary: 恢复会话后覆盖层可输入
changes.summary_en: Interactive overlays work after resume
changes.why_matters: 修复恢复会话后无法操作交互层的问题，保证继续编辑和回退流程可用。
changes.why_matters_en: It restores keyboard interaction after resuming a session, keeping overlays usable.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal scrollback duplication in non-fullscreen mode (resize, dialog dismiss, long sessions)
changes.summary: 修复非全屏滚动回显重复
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate scrollback in non-fullscreen mode
changes.why_matters: 减少长会话和窗口变化时的显示错乱，提升终端可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents display corruption during long sessions and resize events, improving readability.

changes.raw: Fixed `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` / `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` not suppressing usage metrics telemetry for API and enterprise users
changes.summary: 禁用遥测后不再上报指标
changes.summary_en: Telemetry disable now suppresses usage metrics
changes.why_matters: 确保隐私和合规设置真正生效，避免在禁用后仍发送使用数据。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures privacy and compliance settings actually stop usage data from being sent.

changes.raw: Fixed false-positive "Dangerous rm operation" permission prompts in auto mode for multi-line bash commands containing both a pipe and a redirect
changes.summary: 减少误报危险rm提示
changes.summary_en: Reduce false dangerous rm prompts
changes.why_matters: 降低自动模式下的误拦截，避免多行命令被不必要地打断。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces false blocks in auto mode, preventing unnecessary interruptions to valid commands.

changes.raw: Fixed long selection menus clipping below the terminal in fullscreen mode — the focused option now stays on screen as you scroll
changes.summary: 修复全屏菜单滚动裁切
changes.summary_en: Fix fullscreen menu clipping
changes.why_matters: 长菜单在全屏下不再被截断，用户浏览和选择选项时更稳定顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Long menus no longer clip in fullscreen, making option browsing and selection smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed Write tool output collapsing instead of expanding when clicking "+N lines" in fullscreen
changes.summary: 展开写入输出不再折叠
changes.summary_en: Write output expands correctly
changes.why_matters: 点击“+N lines”后内容会正确展开，便于查看完整修改结果。
changes.why_matters_en: Clicking "+N lines" now expands content properly, making it easier to inspect full changes.

changes.raw: Fixed slash command picker jumping while typing, and improved highlight to only match contiguous substrings in blue
changes.summary: 修复斜杠命令选择器跳动
changes.summary_en: Fix slash command picker jumping
changes.why_matters: 输入时界面不再抖动，且高亮匹配更准确，提升命令选择体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Typing no longer causes UI jumping, and matching is clearer for a better command-picking experience.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin` marketplace failing to load when one entry uses an unrecognized source format — that entry is shown but installing it prompts you to update
changes.summary: 插件市场异常源可继续加载
changes.summary_en: Plugin marketplace loads with bad entries
changes.why_matters: 单个异常插件源不会阻塞整个市场加载，用户仍可查看并按提示更新。
changes.why_matters_en: One malformed plugin source no longer blocks the whole marketplace, so users can still browse and update as prompted.

changes.raw: [VSCode] `/usage` now opens the native Account & Usage dialog instead of returning plain-text session cost
changes.summary: VSCode中使用量打开原生对话框
changes.summary_en: VSCode /usage opens native dialog
changes.why_matters: 在 VSCode 里查看账户与用量更直接，减少文本信息切换成本。
changes.why_matters_en: In VSCode, account and usage details open more directly, reducing friction from plain-text output.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Voice dictation now respects the `language` setting in `~/.claude/settings.json`
changes.summary: 语音听写遵循语言设置
changes.summary_en: Voice dictation follows language setting
changes.why_matters: 语音输入会按配置语言识别，提升非默认语言用户的准确率。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice dictation now respects the configured language, improving accuracy for non-default language users.

changes.raw: Fixed `find` in the Bash tool exhausting open file descriptors on large directory trees, causing host-wide crashes (macOS/Linux native builds)
changes.summary: 修复find句柄泄漏致崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix find FD leak causing crashes
changes.why_matters: 大目录下不再耗尽文件描述符并引发主机级崩溃，显著提升稳定性与安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: Large directory scans no longer exhaust file descriptors and crash the host, greatly improving stability and safety.

signals.title: Claude Code refuses requests or charges extra if your commits mention "OpenClaw"
HERMES.md in commit messages causes requests to route to extra usage billing
An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
Measuring Claude 4.7's tokenizer costs
Claude Code to be removed from Anthropic's Pro plan?

changes.raw: `/config` settings (theme, editor mode, verbose, etc.) now persist to `~/.claude/settings.json` and participate in project/local/policy override precedence
changes.summary: 配置持久化并支持覆盖优先级
changes.summary_en: Persist config with override precedence
changes.why_matters: 用户的界面和编辑器偏好现在能稳定保存，并且符合项目、全局和策略的覆盖规则。
changes.why_matters_en: User preferences now persist reliably and follow the expected project, global, and policy override order.

changes.raw: Added `prUrlTemplate` setting to point the footer PR badge at a custom code-review URL instead of github.com
changes.summary: 自定义 PR 徽标链接
changes.summary_en: Custom PR badge review URL
changes.why_matters: 可以把输出中的 PR 跳转指向企业自定义代码评审系统，而不是固定到 GitHub。
changes.why_matters_en: PR links can now point to a custom code review system instead of being fixed to GitHub.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD` environment variable to hide the working directory in the startup logo
changes.summary: 隐藏启动时工作目录
changes.summary_en: Hide working directory in startup logo
changes.why_matters: 在共享屏幕或日志中可以减少暴露当前路径信息。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces exposure of the current path in shared screens or logs.

changes.raw: `--from-pr` now accepts GitLab merge-request, Bitbucket pull-request, and GitHub Enterprise PR URLs
changes.summary: 支持更多平台的 PR 导入
changes.summary_en: Support more PR import URLs
changes.why_matters: 可以直接从 GitLab、Bitbucket 和 GitHub Enterprise 的合并请求链接开始工作。
changes.why_matters_en: You can start from merge or pull request URLs across GitLab, Bitbucket, and GitHub Enterprise.

changes.raw: `--print` mode now honors the agent's `tools:` and `disallowedTools:` frontmatter, matching interactive-mode behavior
changes.summary: 打印模式遵循工具权限配置
changes.summary_en: Print mode respects tool permissions
changes.why_matters: 非交互模式现在和交互模式一致，避免因权限规则不生效而产生行为差异。
changes.why_matters_en: Non-interactive runs now match interactive behavior, avoiding permission-related inconsistencies.

changes.raw: `--agent <name>` now honors the agent definition's `permissionMode` for built-in agents
changes.summary: 内置代理遵循权限模式
changes.summary_en: Built-in agents honor permission mode
changes.why_matters: 内置 agent 的执行权限现在更符合其定义，减少意外的权限偏差。
changes.why_matters_en: Built-in agent execution now follows its definition more closely, reducing unexpected permission drift.

changes.raw: PowerShell tool commands can now be auto-approved in permission mode, matching Bash behavior
changes.summary: PowerShell 工具可自动批准
changes.summary_en: Auto-approve PowerShell tool commands
changes.why_matters: Windows/PowerShell 用户在相同权限模式下能获得与 Bash 一致的自动批准体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Windows and PowerShell users now get the same auto-approval experience as Bash under permission mode.

changes.raw: Hooks: `PostToolUse` and `PostToolUseFailure` hook inputs now include `duration_ms` (tool execution time, excluding permission prompts and PreToolUse hooks)
changes.summary: 钩子新增工具耗时字段
changes.summary_en: Hooks now include tool duration
changes.why_matters: 钩子可以更准确地分析工具执行耗时，便于监控和优化。
changes.why_matters_en: Hooks can now measure tool execution time more accurately for monitoring and optimization.

changes.raw: Subagent and SDK MCP server reconfiguration now connects servers in parallel instead of serially
changes.summary: MCP 服务器并行重连
changes.summary_en: Reconnect MCP servers in parallel
changes.why_matters: 重新配置子代理和 SDK MCP 服务器时会更快完成，减少等待时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Reconfiguring subagents and SDK MCP servers now finishes faster with less waiting.

changes.raw: Plugins pinned by another plugin's version constraint now auto-update to the highest satisfying git tag
changes.summary: 插件依赖自动升到最优版本
changes.summary_en: Pinned plugins auto-update to best tag
changes.why_matters: 被版本约束固定的插件会自动选择最高可满足的 git tag，减少手动维护。
changes.why_matters_en: Pinned plugins now automatically move to the highest satisfying git tag, reducing manual upkeep.

changes.raw: Vim mode: Esc in INSERT no longer pulls a queued message back into the input; press Esc again to interrupt
changes.summary: Vim 模式 Esc 行为修正
changes.summary_en: Fix Esc behavior in Vim insert mode
changes.why_matters: 避免 Esc 意外把队列消息拉回输入框，提升 Vim 输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Esc no longer unexpectedly restores queued messages into the input, improving Vim-mode editing.

changes.raw: Slash command suggestions now highlight the characters that matched your query
changes.summary: 高亮匹配的斜杠命令
changes.summary_en: Highlight matched slash command text
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快看出搜索结果为何匹配，提升命令选择效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see why a command matched more quickly, making command selection easier.

changes.raw: Slash command picker now wraps long descriptions onto a second line instead of truncating
changes.summary: 长命令描述自动换行
changes.summary_en: Wrap long slash command descriptions
changes.why_matters: 命令列表更易读，长描述不会被截断。
changes.why_matters_en: The command picker is easier to read because long descriptions are no longer truncated.

changes.raw: `owner/repo#N` shorthand links in output now use your git remote's host instead of always pointing at github.com
changes.summary: 输出链接使用远程仓库域名
changes.summary_en: Use remote host for repo shorthand links
changes.why_matters: 在企业 Git 远程上生成的 `owner/repo#N` 链接会指向正确的主机。
changes.why_matters_en: Shorthand issue links now point to the correct host for your remote Git provider.

changes.raw: Security: `blockedMarketplaces` now correctly enforces `hostPattern` and `pathPattern` entries
changes.summary: Marketplace 屏蔽规则修复
changes.summary_en: Fix blocked marketplace pattern checks
changes.why_matters: 修复后 `blockedMarketplaces` 能正确拦截指定主机和路径，避免策略绕过。
changes.why_matters_en: The fix ensures `blockedMarketplaces` correctly blocks specified hosts and paths, preventing policy bypass.

changes.raw: OpenTelemetry: `tool_result` and `tool_decision` events now include `tool_use_id`; `tool_result` also includes `tool_input_size_bytes`
changes.summary: 工具事件增加追踪字段
changes.summary_en: Add tool trace fields to OTel events
changes.why_matters: 便于在观测系统中把工具调用、结果和输入大小关联起来，提升排查与分析能力。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes it easier to correlate tool calls, results, and input sizes in observability systems for better debugging and analysis.

changes.raw: Status line: stdin JSON now includes `effort.level` and `thinking.enabled`
changes.summary: 状态栏上报思考配置
changes.summary_en: Expose effort and thinking in status JSON
changes.why_matters: 让外部集成能读取当前推理强度和思考开关，便于同步展示和自动化控制。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets integrations read the current effort level and thinking state for synchronized display and automation.

changes.raw: Fixed pasting CRLF content (Windows clipboards, Xcode console) inserting an extra blank line between every line
changes.summary: 修复 CRLF 粘贴多空行
changes.summary_en: Fix extra blank lines on CRLF paste
changes.why_matters: Windows 剪贴板和部分控制台粘贴时不再被插入多余空行，避免代码格式被破坏。
changes.why_matters_en: Pasting from Windows clipboards and some consoles no longer inserts extra blank lines, preserving code formatting.

changes.raw: Fixed multi-line paste losing newlines in terminals using kitty keyboard protocol sequences inside bracketed paste
changes.summary: 修复多行粘贴丢换行
changes.summary_en: Fix lost newlines in multi-line paste
changes.why_matters: 在 kitty 协议终端中粘贴多行内容时能正确保留换行，避免命令或代码被拼坏。
changes.why_matters_en: Multi-line pastes now preserve newlines in kitty-protocol terminals, preventing broken commands or code.

changes.raw: Fixed Glob and Grep tools disappearing on native macOS/Linux builds when the Bash tool is denied via permissions
changes.summary: 受限 Bash 下保留搜索工具
changes.summary_en: Keep Glob/Grep when Bash is denied
changes.why_matters: 即使禁用 Bash 工具，Glob 和 Grep 仍可在原生 macOS/Linux 构建中使用，减少能力缺失。
changes.why_matters_en: Glob and Grep remain available on native macOS/Linux builds even when Bash is denied, avoiding capability loss.

changes.raw: Fixed scrolling up in fullscreen mode snapping back to the bottom every time a tool finishes
changes.summary: 修复全屏滚动回弹底部
changes.summary_en: Fix fullscreen scroll snapping to bottom
changes.why_matters: 查看历史输出时不会因工具结束而被强制跳回底部，阅读长日志更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: You can review earlier output without being forced back to the bottom when tools finish, making long logs easier to read.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP HTTP connections failing with "Invalid OAuth error response" when servers returned non-JSON bodies for OAuth discovery requests
changes.summary: 修复 MCP OAuth 发现失败
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP OAuth discovery on non-JSON bodies
changes.why_matters: 当服务器返回非 JSON 的 OAuth 发现响应时不再报错，提升 MCP HTTP 连接兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP HTTP connections no longer fail when OAuth discovery returns non-JSON bodies, improving compatibility.

changes.raw: Fixed Rewind overlay showing "(no prompt)" for messages with image attachments
changes.summary: 回溯层显示图片提示词
changes.summary_en: Show prompts for image messages in Rewind
changes.why_matters: 带图片附件的消息在回溯界面中能正确显示提示词，便于回看上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: Messages with image attachments now show their prompt text correctly in Rewind, improving context review.

changes.raw: Fixed auto mode overriding plan mode with conflicting "Execute immediately" instructions
changes.summary: 修复自动模式覆盖计划模式
changes.summary_en: Fix auto mode overriding plan mode
changes.why_matters: 避免“立即执行”指令错误覆盖计划模式，减少不符合预期的自动执行风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents “Execute immediately” instructions from incorrectly overriding plan mode, reducing unintended automation risk.

changes.raw: Fixed async `PostToolUse` hooks that emit no response payload writing empty entries to the session transcript
changes.summary: 修复空响应钩子写空记录
changes.summary_en: Fix empty transcript entries from hooks
changes.why_matters: 异步 PostToolUse 钩子即使不返回内容也不会污染会话记录，保持转录更干净。
changes.why_matters_en: Async PostToolUse hooks that return no payload no longer add empty transcript entries, keeping sessions clean.

changes.raw: Fixed spinner staying on when a subagent task notification is orphaned in the queue
changes.summary: 修复子代理卡住转圈
changes.summary_en: Fix spinner stuck on orphaned subagent
changes.why_matters: 子代理通知丢失时不会让界面一直显示加载中，减少假死感。
changes.why_matters_en: If a subagent notification is orphaned, the UI no longer stays stuck spinning, reducing the appearance of a hang.

changes.raw: Tool search is now disabled by default on Vertex AI to avoid an unsupported beta header error (opt in with `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH`)
changes.summary: Vertex AI 默认关闭工具搜索
changes.summary_en: Disable tool search by default on Vertex AI
changes.why_matters: 默认避免触发不支持的 beta header 错误，只有需要时再手动开启工具搜索。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids unsupported beta header errors by default, while still allowing tool search to be enabled manually.

changes.raw: Fixed `@`-file Tab completion replacing the entire prompt when used inside a slash command with an absolute path
changes.summary: 修复 @ 文件补全误替换
changes.summary_en: Fix @-file completion replacing prompt
changes.why_matters: 在斜杠命令里使用绝对路径补全时，不会再把整段提示词误覆盖。
changes.why_matters_en: Using @-file completion inside slash commands with absolute paths no longer replaces the entire prompt.

changes.raw: Fixed a stray `p` character appearing at the prompt on startup in macOS Terminal.app via Docker or SSH
changes.summary: 修复启动时多余字符
changes.summary_en: Fix stray startup character
changes.why_matters: 启动时不会再在提示符前出现多余字符，改善终端显示体验。
changes.why_matters_en: A stray character no longer appears at startup, improving terminal display polish.

changes.raw: Fixed `${ENV_VAR}` placeholders in `headers` for HTTP/SSE/WebSocket MCP servers not being substituted before requests
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 头部变量替换
changes.summary_en: Fix env var substitution in MCP headers
changes.why_matters: HTTP/SSE/WebSocket MCP 请求中的环境变量会正确展开，避免连接配置失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Environment variables in HTTP/SSE/WebSocket MCP headers are now substituted correctly, preventing broken connection configs.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP OAuth client secret stored via `--client-secret` not being sent during token exchange for servers requiring `client_secret_post`
changes.summary: 修复 MCP OAuth 令牌交换
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP OAuth token exchange
changes.why_matters: 确保需要 client_secret_post 的服务器能正常完成认证，避免 MCP 连接失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures servers requiring client_secret_post can authenticate successfully, preventing MCP connection failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `/skills` Enter key closing the dialog instead of pre-filling `/<skill-name>` in the prompt
changes.summary: 修复 /skills 回车填充提示
changes.summary_en: Fix /skills Enter to prefill prompt
changes.why_matters: 让用户更快插入技能命令，减少误关闭对话框的操作成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users insert skill commands faster and avoids accidentally closing the dialog.

changes.raw: Fixed `/agents` detail view mislabeling built-in tools unavailable to subagents as "Unrecognized"
changes.summary: 修复 /agents 工具标注错误
changes.summary_en: Fix /agents tool labeling
changes.why_matters: 避免把内置但对子代理不可用的工具误标为未识别，减少配置排查困扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents built-in but unavailable tools from being mislabeled as unrecognized, reducing confusion during setup.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP servers from plugins not spawning on Windows when the plugin cache was incomplete
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 插件 MCP 启动
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin MCP startup on Windows
changes.why_matters: 确保 Windows 用户在插件缓存不完整时仍能正常启动插件提供的 MCP 服务。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures Windows users can still start plugin-provided MCP servers even with an incomplete plugin cache.

changes.raw: Fixed `/export` showing the current default model instead of the model the conversation actually used
changes.summary: 修复 /export 模型显示错误
changes.summary_en: Fix /export showing wrong model
changes.why_matters: 导出内容会准确反映实际使用的模型，避免审计和复盘信息失真。
changes.why_matters_en: Exports now reflect the model actually used, avoiding inaccurate audit and review records.

changes.raw: Fixed verbose output setting not persisting after restart
changes.summary: 修复详细输出设置不保存
changes.summary_en: Fix verbose setting persistence
changes.why_matters: 重启后仍能保留用户偏好，减少重复配置。
changes.why_matters_en: User preferences persist across restarts, reducing repeated setup.

changes.raw: Fixed `/usage` progress bars overlapping with their "Resets …" labels
changes.summary: 修复 /usage 进度条重叠
changes.summary_en: Fix /usage progress bar overlap
changes.why_matters: 提升使用统计界面的可读性，避免标签被遮挡。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves readability of usage stats by preventing labels from overlapping.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin MCP servers failing when `${user_config.*}` references an optional field left blank
changes.summary: 修复空可选字段的插件引用
changes.summary_en: Fix blank optional plugin refs
changes.why_matters: 允许插件配置中可选字段留空而不导致 MCP 服务启动失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows optional plugin fields to remain blank without breaking MCP server startup.

changes.raw: Fixed list items containing a sentence-final number wrapping the number onto its own line
changes.summary: 修复列表末尾数字换行
changes.summary_en: Fix list item number wrapping
changes.why_matters: 改善文档排版，避免句末数字被单独折行。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves document formatting by preventing sentence-final numbers from wrapping alone.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plan` and `/plan open` not acting on the existing plan when entering plan mode
changes.summary: 修复 /plan 进入计划模式行为
changes.summary_en: Fix /plan behavior in plan mode
changes.why_matters: 确保进入计划模式时能正确作用于现有计划，避免计划流程中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures plan mode operates on the existing plan correctly, preventing workflow interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed skills invoked before auto-compaction being re-executed against the next user message
changes.summary: 修复自动压缩前技能重复执行
changes.summary_en: Fix skill re-execution after compaction
changes.why_matters: 避免技能在压缩后对下一条消息重复执行，防止意外重复操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents skills from re-running on the next user message after compaction, avoiding duplicate actions.

changes.raw: Fixed `/reload-plugins` and `/doctor` reporting load errors for disabled plugins
changes.summary: 修复禁用插件误报加载错误
changes.summary_en: Fix disabled plugin load errors
changes.why_matters: 让诊断输出只关注真正有问题的插件，减少噪音。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps diagnostics focused on real plugin issues by reducing noise from disabled plugins.

changes.raw: Fixed Agent tool with `isolation: "worktree"` reusing stale worktrees from prior sessions
changes.summary: 修复 worktree 复用旧工作区
changes.summary_en: Fix stale worktree reuse
changes.why_matters: 避免隔离任务误用上次会话的旧工作区，提升任务隔离可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents isolated tasks from reusing stale worktrees, improving workspace isolation reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed disabled MCP servers appearing as "failed" in `/status`
changes.summary: 修复禁用 MCP 状态误显示
changes.summary_en: Fix disabled MCP status display
changes.why_matters: 禁用的服务器不再被误标为失败，状态页更准确。
changes.why_matters_en: Disabled servers are no longer mislabeled as failed, making the status page more accurate.

changes.raw: Fixed `TaskList` returning tasks in arbitrary filesystem order instead of sorted by ID
changes.summary: 修复 TaskList 任务排序
changes.summary_en: Fix TaskList ordering
changes.why_matters: 任务按 ID 排序后更稳定，便于查看和比较结果。
changes.why_matters_en: Sorting tasks by ID makes results stable and easier to review and compare.

changes.raw: Fixed spurious "GitHub API rate limit exceeded" hints when `gh` output contained PR titles mentioning "rate limit"
changes.summary: 修复误报 GitHub 限流提示
changes.summary_en: Fix false GitHub rate-limit hints
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在正常 PR 输出中看到误导性的限流警告，减少排查噪音。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misleading rate-limit warnings from normal PR output and reduces debugging noise.

changes.raw: Fixed SDK/bridge `read_file` not correctly enforcing size cap on growing files
changes.summary: 修复增长文件读取越界
changes.summary_en: Enforce file size cap on growing files
changes.why_matters: 确保读取文件时严格遵守大小上限，避免性能问题和意外的大文件读取。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures file reads respect size limits, avoiding performance issues and unexpected large reads.

changes.raw: Fixed PR not linked to session when working in a git worktree
changes.summary: 修复 worktree 下 PR 关联
changes.summary_en: Link PRs correctly in git worktrees
changes.why_matters: 让在 git worktree 中工作的会话也能正确关联 PR，保持上下文连续。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps session context intact by correctly linking PRs when working in git worktrees.

changes.raw: Fixed `/doctor` warning about MCP server entries overridden by a higher-precedence scope
changes.summary: 修复 /doctor 误报 MCP 覆盖
changes.summary_en: Fix /doctor false MCP override warning
changes.why_matters: 减少诊断命令中的误报，帮助用户更准确判断 MCP 配置状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces false positives in diagnostics so users can assess MCP configuration more accurately.

changes.raw: Windows: removed false-positive "Windows requires 'cmd /c' wrapper" MCP config warning
changes.summary: 修复 Windows MCP 配置误警告
changes.summary_en: Remove false Windows MCP config warning
changes.why_matters: 消除 Windows 上不必要的配置警告，降低跨平台使用时的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Eliminates unnecessary configuration warnings on Windows and reduces cross-platform confusion.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed voice dictation's first recording producing nothing on macOS while the microphone permission prompt is showing
changes.summary: 修复 macOS 语音首录无输出
changes.summary_en: Fix first voice dictation on macOS
changes.why_matters: 让首次语音输入在 macOS 上正常工作，提升 VSCode 语音交互可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes first voice input work on macOS, improving VSCode voice interaction usability.

signals.title: Claude Code refuses requests or charges extra if your commits mention "OpenClaw"
HERMES.md in commit messages causes requests to route to extra usage billing
An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
Measuring Claude 4.7's tokenizer costs
Claude Code to be removed from Anthropic's Pro plan?

changes.raw: Added vim visual mode (`v`) and visual-line mode (`V`) with selection, operators, and visual feedback
changes.summary: 新增 Vim 可视模式支持
changes.summary_en: Add Vim visual and visual-line modes
changes.why_matters: 让熟悉 Vim 的用户能更高效地进行文本选择和批量操作。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves editing speed and precision for users who prefer Vim workflows.

changes.raw: Merged `/cost` and `/stats` into `/usage` — both remain as typing shortcuts that open the relevant tab
changes.summary: 合并用量命令入口
changes.summary_en: Merge /cost and /stats into /usage
changes.why_matters: 减少命令记忆负担，并把相关信息集中到一个入口。
changes.why_matters_en: This simplifies the command surface and centralizes usage information.

changes.raw: Create and switch between named custom themes from `/theme`, or hand-edit JSON files in `~/.claude/themes/`; plugins can also ship themes via a `themes/` directory
changes.summary: 支持自定义主题与插件主题
changes.summary_en: Create custom themes and ship plugin themes
changes.why_matters: 用户和插件作者可以更灵活地定制界面外观。
changes.why_matters_en: This gives users and plugin authors more control over the CLI appearance.

changes.raw: Hooks can now invoke MCP tools directly via `type: "mcp_tool"`
changes.summary: Hook 可直接调用 MCP 工具
changes.summary_en: Hooks can invoke MCP tools directly
changes.why_matters: 让自动化钩子能直接触发外部工具，扩展工作流能力。
changes.why_matters_en: This enables hooks to drive external tools directly and expand automation workflows.

changes.raw: Added `DISABLE_UPDATES` env var to completely block all update paths including manual `claude update` — stricter than `DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER`
changes.summary: 新增彻底禁用更新开关
changes.summary_en: Add a hard block for all updates
changes.why_matters: 在受管或高安全环境中可完全阻止任何更新路径。
changes.why_matters_en: This provides stricter update control for managed or security-sensitive environments.

changes.raw: WSL on Windows can now inherit Windows-side managed settings via the `wslInheritsWindowsSettings` policy key
changes.summary: WSL 可继承 Windows 管理设置
changes.summary_en: WSL can inherit Windows managed settings
changes.why_matters: 减少双环境配置差异，提升 Windows/WSL 一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces configuration drift between Windows and WSL environments.

changes.raw: Auto mode: include `"$defaults"` in `autoMode.allow`, `autoMode.soft_deny`, or `autoMode.environment` to add custom rules alongside the built-in list instead of replacing it
changes.summary: 自动模式支持追加默认规则
changes.summary_en: Allow adding rules alongside auto defaults
changes.why_matters: 用户可在保留内置规则的同时叠加自定义策略。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets users extend built-in auto mode rules without replacing them.

changes.raw: Added a "Don't ask again" option to the auto mode opt-in prompt
changes.summary: 自动模式新增不再询问
changes.summary_en: Add a Don't ask again option for auto mode
changes.why_matters: 减少重复确认，降低启用自动模式的摩擦。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces repeated prompts and makes auto mode easier to adopt.

changes.raw: Added `claude plugin tag` to create release git tags for plugins with version validation
changes.summary: 支持插件发布标签命令
changes.summary_en: Add plugin release tag creation command
changes.why_matters: 帮助插件发布流程更规范，并校验版本一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes plugin releases more reliable by validating versions before tagging.

changes.raw: `--continue`/`--resume` now find sessions that added the current directory via `/add-dir`
changes.summary: 续会话可识别已加目录
changes.summary_en: Resume sessions that added the current dir
changes.why_matters: 让继续会话更准确，避免找不到相关历史上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves session recovery by finding the right prior context more reliably.

changes.raw: `/color` now syncs the session accent color to claude.ai/code when Remote Control is connected
changes.summary: 远控同步会话强调色
changes.summary_en: Sync session accent color with Remote Control
changes.why_matters: 让本地与远程界面保持一致，提升使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps local and remote UI state aligned for a smoother experience.

changes.raw: The `/model` picker now honors `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL_NAME`/`_DESCRIPTION` overrides when using a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway
changes.summary: 模型选择器支持网关覆盖
changes.summary_en: Honor model overrides with custom gateways
changes.why_matters: 使用自定义网关时也能正确显示和选择默认模型信息。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures model selection works correctly with custom gateways and overrides.

changes.raw: When auto-update skips a plugin due to another plugin's version constraint, the skip now appears in `/doctor` and the `/plugin` Errors tab
changes.summary: 插件跳过原因可见
changes.summary_en: Show plugin skip reasons in doctor and errors
changes.why_matters: 便于排查自动更新时插件被跳过的原因。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes it easier to diagnose why a plugin was skipped during auto-update.

changes.raw: Fixed `/mcp` menu hiding OAuth Authenticate/Re-authenticate actions for servers configured with `headersHelper`, and HTTP/SSE MCP servers with custom headers being stuck in "needs authentication" after a transient 401
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 认证菜单显示
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP auth actions visibility and 401 state
changes.why_matters: 避免 MCP 服务器认证操作被隐藏，并修复临时 401 后的错误状态。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores missing auth actions and fixes broken auth state after transient 401s.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP servers whose OAuth token response omits `expires_in` requiring re-authentication every hour
changes.summary: 修复 OAuth 过期误判
changes.summary_en: Fix OAuth tokens reauthing when expires_in is missing
changes.why_matters: 避免因响应字段缺失而频繁重新认证，减少中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents unnecessary re-authentication when OAuth responses omit expires_in.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP step-up authorization silently refreshing instead of prompting for re-consent when the server's `insufficient_scope` 403 names a scope the current token already has
changes.summary: 修复MCP授权续签误跳过同意
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP reauth prompting on scope mismatch
changes.why_matters: 避免在需要重新授权时静默续签，确保权限变更能被用户明确确认。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents silent reauth when consent should be re-requested, so permission changes are explicitly approved.

changes.raw: Fixed an unhandled promise rejection when an MCP server's OAuth flow times out or is cancelled
changes.summary: 修复MCP OAuth超时崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix unhandled rejection on OAuth timeout
changes.why_matters: 避免授权超时或取消时出现未处理异常，提升流程稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes when OAuth times out or is cancelled, improving flow reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP OAuth refresh proceeding without its cross-process lock under contention
changes.summary: 修复MCP刷新锁竞争问题
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP token refresh lock contention
changes.why_matters: 确保并发刷新时不会绕过锁导致令牌状态混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures concurrent refreshes stay serialized so token state does not become inconsistent.

changes.raw: Fixed macOS keychain race where a concurrent MCP token refresh could overwrite a freshly-refreshed OAuth token, causing unexpected "Please run /login" prompts
changes.summary: 修复macOS钥匙串令牌覆盖
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS keychain token overwrite race
changes.why_matters: 防止新刷新令牌被旧并发写入覆盖，避免用户被误要求重新登录。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents a freshly refreshed token from being overwritten, avoiding unexpected re-login prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed OAuth token refresh failing when the server revokes a token before its local expiry time
changes.summary: 修复被撤销令牌刷新失败
changes.summary_en: Fix refresh when server revokes token early
changes.why_matters: 即使服务端提前撤销令牌，也能正确处理刷新并恢复登录状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Handles early token revocation correctly so refresh can recover the session.

changes.raw: Fixed credential save crash on Linux/Windows corrupting `~/.claude/.credentials.json`
changes.summary: 修复凭据保存导致配置损坏
changes.summary_en: Fix credential save crash corrupting config
changes.why_matters: 避免保存凭据时损坏本地配置文件，防止登录和会话数据丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents credential saves from corrupting local config, avoiding login and session data loss.

changes.raw: Fixed `/login` having no effect in a session launched with `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` — the env token is now cleared so disk credentials take effect
changes.summary: 修复/login不清除环境令牌
changes.summary_en: Fix /login ignoring env OAuth token
changes.why_matters: 确保登录后使用磁盘凭据而不是继续被环境变量覆盖。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures /login switches to disk credentials instead of being overridden by the env token.

changes.raw: Fixed unreadable text in the "new messages" scroll pill and `/plugin` badges
changes.summary: 修复新消息与插件徽标可读性
changes.summary_en: Fix unreadable new-message pill and badges
changes.why_matters: 改善界面文字可读性，让状态提示和插件标识更清晰。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves UI readability so status indicators and plugin badges are easier to understand.

changes.raw: Fixed plan acceptance dialog offering "auto mode" instead of "bypass permissions" when running with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`
changes.summary: 修复计划确认文案错误
changes.summary_en: Fix plan dialog wording for skip-permissions
changes.why_matters: 避免在危险模式下给出错误选项，减少误操作风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids showing the wrong option in dangerous mode, reducing the chance of misuse.

changes.raw: Fixed agent-type hooks failing with "Messages are required for agent hooks" when configured for events other than `Stop` or `SubagentStop`
changes.summary: 修复agent hooks事件兼容性
changes.summary_en: Fix agent hooks for non-stop events
changes.why_matters: 让 agent 类型 hooks 在更多事件上正常工作，提升自动化扩展能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows agent-type hooks to work across more events, improving automation extensibility.

changes.raw: Fixed `prompt` hooks re-firing on tool calls made by an agent-hook verifier subagent
changes.summary: 修复prompt hook重复触发
changes.summary_en: Fix prompt hooks retriggering on verifier calls
changes.why_matters: 避免验证子代理的工具调用引发重复 hook 执行，减少意外副作用。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents verifier subagent tool calls from retriggering hooks and causing duplicate side effects.

changes.raw: Fixed `/fork` writing the full parent conversation to disk per fork — now writes a pointer and hydrates on read
changes.summary: 优化/fork存储方式更省空间
changes.summary_en: Optimize /fork storage with pointers
changes.why_matters: 减少每个分叉写入完整对话的磁盘开销，提升性能和存储效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces disk usage by storing pointers instead of full conversations for each fork.

changes.raw: Fixed Alt+K / Alt+X / Alt+^ / Alt+_ freezing keyboard input
changes.summary: 修复快捷键导致输入冻结
changes.summary_en: Fix keyboard shortcuts freezing input
changes.why_matters: 恢复快捷键可用性，避免键盘输入被卡住影响编辑效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores shortcut usability so keyboard input does not freeze during editing.

changes.raw: Fixed connecting to a remote session overwriting your local `model` setting in `~/.claude/settings.json`
changes.summary: 修复远程会话覆盖本地模型设置
changes.summary_en: Fix remote session overwriting local model
changes.why_matters: 防止连接远程会话时意外改写本地配置，保持模型偏好一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents remote sessions from overwriting local settings, preserving model preferences.

changes.raw: Fixed typeahead showing "No commands match" error when pasting file paths that start with `/`
changes.summary: 修复以/开头路径误判命令
changes.summary_en: Fix pasted paths starting with /
changes.why_matters: 让粘贴文件路径时不再被误识别为命令，提高输入容错性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents pasted file paths from being mistaken for commands, improving input robustness.

changes.raw: Fixed `plugin install` on an already-installed plugin not re-resolving a dependency installed at the wrong version
changes.summary: 修复插件依赖版本未重解析
changes.summary_en: Re-resolve plugin deps on reinstall
changes.why_matters: 避免已安装插件在重装时继续使用错误版本的依赖，保证插件行为一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents reinstalled plugins from keeping a wrong dependency version, keeping behavior consistent.

changes.raw: Fixed unhandled errors from file watcher on invalid paths or fd exhaustion
changes.summary: 修复文件监视器异常崩溃
changes.summary_en: Handle file watcher errors safely
changes.why_matters: 避免无效路径或文件描述符耗尽时出现未处理错误，提高 CLI 稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unhandled errors on invalid paths or fd exhaustion, improving CLI stability.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control sessions getting archived on transient CCR initialization blips during JWT refresh
changes.summary: 修复远程会话误归档问题
changes.summary_en: Avoid archiving sessions on JWT blips
changes.why_matters: 减少 JWT 刷新期间的短暂初始化失败导致会话被错误归档，避免工作中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents transient JWT refresh issues from wrongly archiving remote sessions and interrupting work.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents resumed via `SendMessage` not restoring the explicit `cwd` they were spawned with
changes.summary: 修复子代理恢复cwd丢失
changes.summary_en: Restore subagent cwd on resume
changes.why_matters: 确保通过 SendMessage 恢复的子代理回到正确工作目录，避免上下文错乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures resumed subagents return to the correct working directory, avoiding context drift.

signals.title: HERMES.md in commit messages causes requests to route to extra usage billing

changes.raw: Forked subagents can now be enabled on external builds by setting `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1`
changes.summary: 外部构建可启用 fork 子代理
changes.summary_en: Enable forked subagents on external builds
changes.why_matters: 让更多构建环境可以使用 fork 子代理能力，提升自动化与并行处理灵活性。
changes.why_matters_en: This expands forked subagent support to more build environments, improving automation and parallel task flexibility.

changes.raw: Agent frontmatter `mcpServers` are now loaded for main-thread agent sessions via `--agent`
changes.summary: 主线程会加载 agent 的 MCP 配置
changes.summary_en: Load agent MCP servers for --agent sessions
changes.why_matters: 主线程 agent 会自动获得所需 MCP 连接，减少手动配置和会话差异。
changes.why_matters_en: Main-thread agent sessions can now automatically use their MCP connections, reducing manual setup and session drift.

changes.raw: Improved `/model`: selections now persist across restarts even when the project pins a different model, and the startup header shows when the active model comes from a project or managed-settings pin
changes.summary: /model 选择可跨重启保留
changes.summary_en: Persist /model selection across restarts
changes.why_matters: 用户重启后仍能保持模型选择，并清楚知道当前模型来源，减少混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: Users keep their model choice across restarts and can see where the active model comes from, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: The `/resume` command now offers to summarize stale, large sessions before re-reading them, matching the existing `--resume` behavior
changes.summary: /resume 先提示总结旧会话
changes.summary_en: Offer summary for stale sessions in /resume
changes.why_matters: 在重读大型旧会话前先摘要，能更快恢复上下文并降低阅读成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Summarizing stale large sessions before re-reading them helps restore context faster and lowers review cost.

changes.raw: Faster startup when both local and claude.ai MCP servers are configured (concurrent connect now default)
changes.summary: 本地与云 MCP 并发连接更快启动
changes.summary_en: Faster startup with concurrent MCP connects
changes.why_matters: 并发连接减少启动等待时间，让配置了多个 MCP 的用户更快进入工作状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Concurrent connections reduce startup latency, helping users with multiple MCP servers get to work sooner.

changes.raw: `plugin install` on an already-installed plugin now installs any missing dependencies instead of stopping at "already installed"
changes.summary: 已安装插件可补装缺失依赖
changes.summary_en: Install missing deps for existing plugins
changes.why_matters: 避免插件已安装却因缺依赖而无法正常使用，提升安装流程的容错性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents already-installed plugins from failing due to missing dependencies, making installs more resilient.

changes.raw: Plugin dependency errors now say "not installed" with an install hint, and `claude plugin marketplace add` now auto-resolves missing dependencies from configured marketplaces
changes.summary: 插件依赖提示更清晰并可自动补齐
changes.summary_en: Clearer plugin dependency hints and auto-resolve
changes.why_matters: 更明确的错误信息和自动解析能减少插件安装失败，降低用户排障成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearer errors and auto-resolution reduce plugin install failures and lower troubleshooting effort.

changes.raw: Managed-settings `blockedMarketplaces` and `strictKnownMarketplaces` are now enforced on plugin install, update, refresh, and autoupdate
changes.summary: 受管设置强制限制插件市场
changes.summary_en: Enforce marketplace restrictions in managed settings
changes.why_matters: 确保组织策略在插件安装与更新全流程中生效，降低供应链和合规风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures org policies are enforced across plugin install and update flows, reducing supply-chain and compliance risk.

changes.raw: Advisor Tool (experimental): dialog now carries an "experimental" label, learn-more link, and startup notification when enabled; sessions no longer get stuck with "Advisor tool result content could not be processed" errors on every prompt and `/compact`
changes.summary: Advisor Tool 试验版不再卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix Advisor Tool experimental session hangs
changes.why_matters: 修复后实验功能可稳定使用，不会因结果处理错误导致每次提示和压缩都失败。
changes.why_matters_en: The experimental feature becomes usable reliably instead of failing on every prompt and compact due to processing errors.

changes.raw: The `cleanupPeriodDays` retention sweep now also covers `~/.claude/tasks/`, `~/.claude/shell-snapshots/`, and `~/.claude/backups/`
changes.summary: 清理周期覆盖更多本地缓存目录
changes.summary_en: Cleanup now covers more local Claude dirs
changes.why_matters: 能更完整地回收过期数据，减少磁盘占用并保持本地环境整洁。
changes.why_matters_en: This more completely reclaims expired data, reducing disk usage and keeping the local environment tidy.

changes.raw: OpenTelemetry: `user_prompt` events now include `command_name` and `command_source` for slash commands; `cost.usage`, `token.usage`, `api_request`, and `api_error` now include an `effort` attribute when the model supports effort levels. Custom/MCP command names are redacted unless `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` is set
changes.summary: OTel 记录命令来源与 effort
changes.summary_en: OTel adds command source and effort data
changes.why_matters: 更丰富的遥测有助于分析使用行为和模型成本，同时对工具名做脱敏更安全。
changes.why_matters_en: Richer telemetry helps analyze usage and model cost, while redacting tool names improves safety.

changes.raw: Native builds on macOS and Linux: the `Glob` and `Grep` tools are replaced by embedded `bfs` and `ugrep` available through the Bash tool — faster searches without a separate tool round-trip (Windows and npm-installed builds unchanged)
changes.summary: 原生构建搜索更快
changes.summary_en: Faster searches in native builds
changes.why_matters: 用更快的底层搜索工具减少搜索耗时，提升日常代码查找效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Replacing search tools with faster embedded ones reduces search time and improves everyday code lookup speed.

changes.raw: Windows: cached `where.exe` executable lookups per process for faster subprocess launches
changes.summary: Windows 缓存 where.exe 查找
changes.summary_en: Cache where.exe lookups on Windows
changes.why_matters: 减少重复可执行文件查找开销，加快子进程启动。
changes.why_matters_en: This cuts repeated executable lookup overhead and speeds up subprocess launches.

changes.raw: Default effort for Pro/Max subscribers on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 is now `high` (was `medium`)
changes.summary: Pro/Max 默认 effort 提升为高
changes.summary_en: Default effort raised to high for Pro/Max
changes.why_matters: 默认更高推理力度可带来更稳健的回答质量，适合高阶订阅用户。
changes.why_matters_en: A higher default effort can improve answer quality and robustness for premium subscribers.

changes.raw: Fixed Plain-CLI OAuth sessions dying with "Please run /login" when the access token expires mid-session — the token is now refreshed reactively on 401
changes.summary: OAuth 过期后自动刷新不中断
changes.summary_en: Refresh OAuth tokens on 401 automatically
changes.why_matters: 避免会话因令牌过期而中断，减少重新登录和工作流打断。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents sessions from breaking when tokens expire, reducing re-login friction and workflow interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed `WebFetch` hanging on very large HTML pages by truncating input before HTML-to-markdown conversion
changes.summary: 修复大页WebFetch卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix WebFetch hangs on huge pages
changes.why_matters: 避免在超大网页上抓取内容时卡住，提高网页读取稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents hangs when fetching very large pages, improving web-reading reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash when a proxy returns HTTP 204 No Content — now surfaces a clear error instead of a `TypeError`
changes.summary: 代理204返回清晰错误
changes.summary_en: Show clear error for proxy 204 responses
changes.why_matters: 避免代理返回无内容时直接崩溃，帮助用户更快定位网络问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids crashes on empty proxy responses and makes network issues easier to diagnose.

changes.raw: Fixed `/login` having no effect when launched with `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` env var and that token expires
changes.summary: 登录过期后可重新生效
changes.summary_en: Make /login work after expired OAuth token
changes.why_matters: 修复令牌过期后无法重新登录的问题，避免用户被卡在失效会话中。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes re-login after token expiry so users are not stuck with a dead session.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt-input undo (`Ctrl+_`) doing nothing immediately after typing, and skipping a state on each undo step
changes.summary: 修复输入撤销失效
changes.summary_en: Fix prompt undo after immediate typing
changes.why_matters: 让撤销操作按预期工作，提升命令行输入编辑体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores expected undo behavior and improves prompt editing usability.

changes.raw: Fixed `NO_PROXY` not being respected for remote API requests when running under Bun
changes.summary: Bun下遵守NO_PROXY
changes.summary_en: Respect NO_PROXY under Bun
changes.why_matters: 确保远程API请求按环境变量走直连或代理，符合用户网络配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures remote API requests honor proxy settings and match user network configuration.

changes.raw: Fixed rare spurious escape/return triggers when key names arrive as coalesced text over slow connections
changes.summary: 修复慢连接误触发退出
changes.summary_en: Fix false escape/return triggers on slow links
changes.why_matters: 减少慢网络下的误操作，避免输入被意外中断或提交。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces accidental input interruptions on slow connections.

changes.raw: Fixed SDK `reload_plugins` reconnecting all user MCP servers serially
changes.summary: 插件重载并发重连MCP
changes.summary_en: Reconnect MCP servers in parallel on reload
changes.why_matters: 缩短插件重载后的等待时间，提升多服务器场景的恢复速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Speeds up plugin reloads by reconnecting multiple MCP servers faster.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock application-inference-profile requests failing with 400 when backed by Opus 4.7 with thinking disabled
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock Opus 4.7报错
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock Opus 4.7 inference-profile 400s
changes.why_matters: 恢复特定Bedrock配置下的模型调用，避免高阶模型不可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores model calls for a specific Bedrock setup so advanced models remain usable.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP `elicitation/create` requests auto-cancelling in print/SDK mode when the server finishes connecting mid-turn
changes.summary: 打印模式不再误取消MCP
changes.summary_en: Stop auto-canceling MCP elicitation in print mode
changes.why_matters: 避免SDK/打印模式下的中途连接导致请求被错误取消，提升自动化稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents mid-turn connection timing from wrongly canceling requests in SDK/print mode.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents running a different model than the main agent incorrectly flagging file reads with a malware warning
changes.summary: 子代理文件读取误报修复
changes.summary_en: Fix malware false positives for subagent file reads
changes.why_matters: 避免不同模型的子代理读取文件时被误判为恶意行为，减少工作流中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents false malware warnings when subagents read files, avoiding workflow disruption.

changes.raw: Fixed idle re-render loop when background tasks are present, reducing memory growth on Linux
changes.summary: 修复后台任务空转重绘
changes.summary_en: Fix idle rerender loop with background tasks
changes.why_matters: 减少Linux上的内存增长和无效刷新，提升长时间运行稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces memory growth and unnecessary rerenders on Linux for better long-running stability.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed "Manage Plugins" panel breaking when multiple large marketplaces are configured
changes.summary: VSCode插件面板不再崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix VSCode Manage Plugins panel crash
changes.why_matters: 让多市场插件配置下的管理面板保持可用，改善编辑器集成体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the plugin management panel usable with multiple marketplaces configured.

changes.raw: Fixed Opus 4.7 sessions showing inflated `/context` percentages and autocompacting too early — Claude Code was computing against a 200K context window instead of Opus 4.7's native 1M
changes.summary: 修正Opus 4.7上下文计算
changes.summary_en: Fix Opus 4.7 context window calculation
changes.why_matters: 避免上下文百分比虚高和过早压缩，减少长会话中信息丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents inflated context usage and premature compaction, reducing information loss in long sessions.

changes.raw: `/resume` on large sessions is significantly faster (up to 67% on 40MB+ sessions) and handles sessions with many dead-fork entries more efficiently
changes.summary: /resume 大会话更快
changes.summary_en: /resume is much faster on large sessions
changes.why_matters: 大幅缩短大型会话恢复时间，提升长上下文工作的连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: It greatly reduces resume time for large sessions, improving continuity in long-running work.

changes.raw: Faster MCP startup when multiple stdio servers are configured; `resources/templates/list` is now deferred to first `@`-mention
changes.summary: MCP 启动更快
changes.summary_en: Faster MCP startup with many servers
changes.why_matters: 多服务器场景下启动更快，减少等待并改善工具接入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces startup latency in multi-server setups and improves tool availability.

changes.raw: Smoother fullscreen scrolling in VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf terminals — `/terminal-setup` now configures the editor's scroll sensitivity
changes.summary: 终端滚动更顺滑
changes.summary_en: Smoother terminal scrolling in editors
changes.why_matters: 改善 VS Code 等编辑器终端的滚动手感，提升日常使用舒适度。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes terminal scrolling feel smoother in common editors, improving day-to-day usability.

changes.raw: Thinking spinner now shows progress inline ("still thinking", "thinking more", "almost done thinking"), replacing the separate hint row
changes.summary: 思考状态更直观
changes.summary_en: Inline thinking progress is clearer
changes.why_matters: 将思考进度直接显示在主界面，减少干扰并更清楚地反馈模型状态。
changes.why_matters_en: It surfaces thinking progress inline, reducing clutter and making model state clearer.

changes.raw: `/config` search now matches option values (e.g. searching "vim" finds the Editor mode setting)
changes.summary: /config 搜索更准
changes.summary_en: /config search matches option values
changes.why_matters: 用户可以通过配置值快速定位选项，查找设置更高效。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can find settings by value as well as name, making configuration lookup faster.

changes.raw: `/doctor` can now be opened while Claude is responding, without waiting for the current turn to finish
changes.summary: 响应中可开 doctor
changes.summary_en: /doctor can open while Claude responds
changes.why_matters: 无需等待当前回复结束即可诊断问题，排障更及时。
changes.why_matters_en: You can diagnose issues without waiting for the current turn to finish, speeding up troubleshooting.

changes.raw: `/reload-plugins` and background plugin auto-update now auto-install missing plugin dependencies from marketplaces you've already added
changes.summary: 插件依赖自动安装
changes.summary_en: Auto-install missing plugin deps
changes.why_matters: 减少插件更新和启用时的手动操作，让扩展生态更顺畅可用。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes manual steps when updating or enabling plugins, making the extension ecosystem smoother.

changes.raw: Bash tool now surfaces a hint when `gh` commands hit GitHub's API rate limit, so agents can back off instead of retrying
changes.summary: GitHub 限流提示
changes.summary_en: Shows hint on GitHub API rate limits
changes.why_matters: 帮助代理识别限流并停止重试，减少无效请求和失败循环。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps agents recognize rate limits and back off instead of retrying uselessly.

changes.raw: The Usage tab in Settings now shows your 5-hour and weekly usage immediately and no longer fails when the usage endpoint is rate-limited
changes.summary: 用量页立即可见
changes.summary_en: Usage tab loads usage immediately
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快看到 5 小时和周用量，且在限流时也更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see 5-hour and weekly usage immediately, with better reliability under rate limiting.

changes.raw: Agent frontmatter `hooks:` now fire when running as a main-thread agent via `--agent`
changes.summary: 主线程 agent 触发 hooks
changes.summary_en: Hooks fire for main-thread agents
changes.why_matters: 让 `--agent` 模式也能执行前置/后置钩子，行为与其他运行方式一致。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes `--agent` mode honor hooks too, keeping behavior consistent across agent modes.

changes.raw: Slash command menu now shows "No commands match" when your filter has zero results, instead of disappearing
changes.summary: 无结果时显示提示
changes.summary_en: Slash menu shows no-results message
changes.why_matters: 过滤为空时给出明确反馈，避免菜单“消失”带来的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: It gives clear feedback when filters match nothing, avoiding a confusing empty menu.

changes.raw: Security: sandbox auto-allow no longer bypasses the dangerous-path safety check for `rm`/`rmdir` targeting `/`, `$HOME`, or other critical system directories
changes.summary: 危险删除保护修复
changes.summary_en: Dangerous delete safety check restored
changes.why_matters: 防止自动允许的沙箱绕过关键目录删除保护，避免严重数据或系统破坏。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents sandbox auto-allow from bypassing critical delete protections, avoiding severe data or system damage.

changes.raw: Claude Code and installer now use `https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases` instead of `https://storage.googleapis.com/claude-code-dist-86c565f3-f756-42ad-8dfa-d59b1c096819/claude-code-releases`
changes.summary: 下载源切换更稳定
changes.summary_en: Installer uses a new download source
changes.why_matters: 改用新的官方下载地址可提升分发稳定性并减少依赖旧存储源的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Switching to the new official download host improves distribution reliability and reduces dependence on the old storage source.

changes.raw: Fixed Devanagari and other Indic scripts rendering with broken column alignment in the terminal UI
changes.summary: 印地文对齐修复
changes.summary_en: Fix Indic script column alignment
changes.why_matters: 终端 UI 在多语言文本下显示更正确，减少排版错乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Terminal UI renders multilingual text more correctly, reducing layout corruption.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+- not triggering undo in terminals using the Kitty keyboard protocol (iTerm2, Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm, Windows Terminal)
changes.summary: Ctrl+- 撤销可用
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+- undo works in Kitty protocol terminals
changes.why_matters: 修复常见终端中的撤销快捷键，改善编辑操作一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: It restores a common undo shortcut in popular terminals, improving editing consistency.

changes.raw: Fixed Cmd+Left/Right not jumping to line start/end in terminals that use the Kitty keyboard protocol (Warp fullscreen, kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm)
changes.summary: 修复终端快捷键跳转
changes.summary_en: Fix terminal line-jump shortcuts
changes.why_matters: 让 Cmd+Left/Right 在更多终端里正确跳到行首/行尾，提升编辑效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Cmd+Left/Right now works correctly in more terminals, improving editing efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+Z hanging the terminal when Claude Code is launched via a wrapper process (e.g. `npx`, `bun run`)
changes.summary: 修复 Ctrl+Z 卡死终端
changes.summary_en: Fix Ctrl+Z terminal hang
changes.why_matters: 避免通过 npx、bun run 等包装器启动时终端挂起，保证可正常挂起/恢复进程。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents terminal hangs when launched via wrappers like npx or bun run, preserving normal suspend/resume behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed scrollback duplication in inline mode where resizing the terminal or large output bursts would repeat earlier conversation history
changes.summary: 修复滚动回显重复
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicated scrollback history
changes.why_matters: 防止调整窗口或输出突增时重复显示旧对话，避免上下文混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents repeated old conversation history during resize or output bursts, avoiding context confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed modal search dialogs overflowing the screen at short terminal heights, hiding the search box and keyboard hints
changes.summary: 修复短终端搜索框溢出
changes.summary_en: Fix search dialog overflow
changes.why_matters: 在较矮终端中也能完整看到搜索框和快捷键提示，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the search box and key hints visible in short terminals, improving usability.

changes.raw: Fixed scattered blank cells and disappearing composer chrome in the VS Code integrated terminal during scrolling
changes.summary: 修复 VS Code 终端滚动异常
changes.summary_en: Fix VS Code terminal scrolling artifacts
changes.why_matters: 减少集成终端滚动时的空白格和界面消失问题，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces blank cells and disappearing UI in the VS Code integrated terminal during scrolling.

changes.raw: Fixed an intermittent API 400 error related to cache control TTL ordering that could occur when a parallel request completed during request setup
changes.summary: 修复并发请求 400 错误
changes.summary_en: Fix intermittent API 400 error
changes.why_matters: 降低请求初始化阶段因并发完成顺序导致的偶发失败，提高调用可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents intermittent failures caused by request ordering during setup, improving API reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/branch` rejecting conversations with transcripts larger than 50MB
changes.summary: /branch 支持更大对话
changes.summary_en: Allow larger transcripts in /branch
changes.why_matters: 允许分支更大的会话记录，避免因 50MB 限制而无法继续工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows branching larger conversation transcripts, avoiding a 50MB limit that blocked work.

changes.raw: Fixed `/resume` silently showing an empty conversation on large session files instead of reporting the load error
changes.summary: /resume 显示加载错误
changes.summary_en: Show load errors in /resume
changes.why_matters: 大会话文件加载失败时不再静默空白，便于及时发现和处理问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Large session load failures are no longer silent, making issues easier to detect and fix.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin` Installed tab showing the same item twice when it appears under Needs attention or Favorites
changes.summary: 修复插件列表重复显示
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate plugin entries
changes.why_matters: 避免插件安装页重复条目，减少查找和管理插件时的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents duplicate items in the plugin install view, reducing confusion when managing plugins.

changes.raw: Fixed `/update` and `/tui` not working after entering a worktree mid-session
changes.summary: 修复工作树后更新失效
changes.summary_en: Fix /update and /tui after worktree switch
changes.why_matters: 进入 worktree 后仍可正常更新和打开界面，保证会话不中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps /update and /tui working after switching to a worktree, preventing session disruption.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash in the permission dialog when an agent teams teammate requested tool permission
changes.summary: 修复权限弹窗崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix permission dialog crash
changes.why_matters: 避免在队友请求工具权限时界面崩溃，提升协作过程的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the UI from crashing when a teammate requests tool permission, improving collaboration stability.
