changes.raw: Changed the CLI to spawn a native Claude Code binary (via a per-platform optional dependency) instead of bundled JavaScript
changes.summary: 改为原生二进制启动
changes.summary_en: Spawn native Claude Code binary
changes.why_matters: CLI 启动方式改为依赖原生二进制，可能影响安装、兼容性和运行环境。
changes.why_matters_en: Changing startup to a native binary can affect installation, compatibility, and runtime behavior.

changes.raw: Added `sandbox.network.deniedDomains` setting to block specific domains even when a broader `allowedDomains` wildcard would otherwise permit them
changes.summary: 支持域名黑名单拦截
changes.summary_en: Block denied domains in sandbox
changes.why_matters: 即使通配允许，仍可显式阻止敏感域名，减少网络外联风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets users explicitly block sensitive domains even when broader allow rules exist, reducing network exfiltration risk.

changes.raw: Fullscreen mode: Shift+↑/↓ now scrolls the viewport when extending a selection past the visible edge
changes.summary: 全屏选择可继续滚动
changes.summary_en: Scroll when selection reaches edge
changes.why_matters: 在扩展选区时能继续滚动视口，避免选择长内容时操作中断。
changes.why_matters_en: It keeps selection usable at the viewport edge, preventing interruptions when selecting long content.

changes.raw: `Ctrl+A` and `Ctrl+E` now move to the start/end of the current logical line in multiline input, matching readline behavior
changes.summary: 多行输入支持行首行尾
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+A/E move by logical line
changes.why_matters: 让多行编辑更符合 readline 习惯，提升输入效率和可预测性。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes multiline editing behave like readline, improving speed and predictability.

changes.raw: Windows: `Ctrl+Backspace` now deletes the previous word
changes.summary: Windows 支持删前词
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+Backspace deletes previous word
changes.why_matters: 补齐常用快捷键，提升 Windows 上的文本编辑体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It restores a common shortcut, improving text editing on Windows.

changes.raw: Long URLs in responses and bash output stay clickable when they wrap across lines (in terminals with OSC 8 hyperlinks)
changes.summary: 长链接换行仍可点击
changes.summary_en: Wrapped URLs stay clickable
changes.why_matters: 即使 URL 换行也能保持可点击，减少复制粘贴和误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Wrapped URLs remain clickable, reducing copy-paste friction and misclicks.

changes.raw: Improved `/loop`: pressing Esc now cancels pending wakeups, and wakeups display as "Claude resuming /loop wakeup" for clarity
changes.summary: /loop 取消更明确
changes.summary_en: Esc cancels /loop wakeups
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更直接地取消待处理唤醒，并更清楚地理解状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can cancel pending wakeups more directly and understand the state more clearly.

changes.raw: `/extra-usage` now works from Remote Control (mobile/web) clients
changes.summary: 移动端可查额外用量
changes.summary_en: Remote clients can use /extra-usage
changes.why_matters: 远程控制客户端也能查看额外用量，方便随时监控消耗。
changes.why_matters_en: Remote Control clients can now check extra usage, making consumption easier to monitor on the go.

changes.raw: Remote Control clients can now query `@`-file autocomplete suggestions
changes.summary: 远程端支持文件补全
changes.summary_en: Remote clients can query @-file autocomplete
changes.why_matters: 移动/网页端也能获取文件补全建议，提升远程协作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Mobile and web clients can now get file autocomplete suggestions, improving remote collaboration.

changes.raw: Improved `/ultrareview`: faster launch with parallelized checks, diffstat in the launch dialog, and animated launching state
changes.summary: /ultrareview 启动更快
changes.summary_en: Faster /ultrareview launch
changes.why_matters: 并行检查和更清晰的启动信息让审查流程更快、更易理解。
changes.why_matters_en: Parallel checks and clearer launch info make review startup faster and easier to follow.

changes.raw: Subagents that stall mid-stream now fail with a clear error after 10 minutes instead of hanging silently
changes.summary: 卡住子代理会超时失败
changes.summary_en: Stalled subagents fail after 10 min
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理无声挂起，提升任务可靠性和故障可见性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents silent hangs and improves reliability and failure visibility for delegated tasks.

changes.raw: Bash tool: multi-line commands whose first line is a comment now show the full command in the transcript, closing a UI-spoofing vector
changes.summary: 修复注释伪装命令展示
changes.summary_en: Show full multiline bash commands
changes.why_matters: 完整展示多行命令可防止通过首行注释隐藏真实执行内容的 UI 欺骗。
changes.why_matters_en: Showing the full multiline command prevents UI spoofing by hiding real execution behind a comment line.

changes.raw: Running `cd <current-directory> && git …` no longer triggers a permission prompt when the `cd` is a no-op
changes.summary: 无效 cd 不再触发权限
changes.summary_en: No prompt for no-op cd && git
changes.why_matters: 减少对无实际变更命令的误报权限提示，降低工作流打断。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes false permission prompts for no-op commands, reducing workflow interruptions.

changes.raw: Security: on macOS, `/private/{etc,var,tmp,home}` paths are now treated as dangerous removal targets under `Bash(rm:*)` allow rules
changes.summary: 危险删除路径识别增强
changes.summary_en: Treat macOS private paths as dangerous
changes.why_matters: 防止在 macOS 上误删关键系统路径，降低高风险破坏操作。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps prevent accidental deletion of critical macOS system paths, reducing high-risk destructive actions.

changes.raw: Security: Bash deny rules now match commands wrapped in `env`/`sudo`/`watch`/`ionice`/`setsid` and similar exec wrappers
changes.summary: 拒绝规则识别包装命令
changes.summary_en: Deny rules match wrapped commands
changes.why_matters: 即使命令被 env、sudo 等包装也能命中拒绝规则，堵住绕过安全策略的漏洞。
changes.why_matters_en: Deny rules still apply when commands are wrapped by tools like env or sudo, closing a policy bypass gap.

changes.raw: Security: `Bash(find:*)` allow rules no longer auto-approve `find -exec`/`-delete`
changes.summary: 阻止find危险参数自动放行
changes.summary_en: Stop auto-approving dangerous find flags
changes.why_matters: 避免 `find -exec` 和 `-delete` 在自动放行规则下被误执行，降低命令注入和误删风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents `find -exec` and `-delete` from being auto-approved, reducing command injection and accidental deletion risk.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP concurrent-call timeout handling where a message for one tool call could silently disarm another call's watchdog
changes.summary: 修复MCP并发超时误触发
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP concurrent timeout watchdog mix-up
changes.why_matters: 避免一个工具调用的消息错误影响另一个调用的超时监控，提升并发稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents one tool call from interfering with another call's timeout watchdog, improving concurrent reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed Cmd-backspace / `Ctrl+U` to once again delete from the cursor to the start of the line
changes.summary: 恢复Ctrl+U整行删除
changes.summary_en: Restore Ctrl+U line deletion behavior
changes.why_matters: 让常用编辑快捷键重新符合用户预期，提升命令输入效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores a familiar editing shortcut, improving command-entry efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed markdown tables breaking when a cell contains an inline code span with a pipe character
changes.summary: 修复表格内代码管道符解析
changes.summary_en: Fix markdown tables with pipe in code spans
changes.why_matters: 避免 Markdown 表格在渲染时错位或断裂，保证输出可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents markdown tables from breaking during rendering, preserving readability.

changes.raw: Fixed session recap auto-firing while composing unsent text in the prompt
changes.summary: 修复草稿输入时误触回顾
changes.summary_en: Stop recap from firing while typing
changes.why_matters: 避免用户正在输入时被自动回顾打断，减少内容丢失和上下文干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents recap from interrupting active typing, reducing lost input and context disruption.

changes.raw: Fixed `/copy` "Full response" not aligning markdown table columns for pasting into GitHub, Notion, or Slack
changes.summary: 修复复制表格对齐问题
changes.summary_en: Fix copied markdown table alignment
changes.why_matters: 让复制到 GitHub、Notion 或 Slack 的表格保持整齐，便于直接使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps copied tables aligned in GitHub, Notion, or Slack for immediate reuse.

changes.raw: Fixed messages typed while viewing a running subagent being hidden from its transcript and misattributed to the parent AI
changes.summary: 修复子代理消息归属错误
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent message attribution
changes.why_matters: 确保在运行中的子代理里输入的消息能正确记录到对应会话，避免审计和上下文混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures messages typed in a running subagent are recorded in the right transcript, avoiding audit and context confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash `dangerouslyDisableSandbox` running commands outside the sandbox without a permission prompt
changes.summary: 修复沙箱外命令无提示执行
changes.summary_en: Require prompt for sandbox escape commands
changes.why_matters: 防止 `dangerouslyDisableSandbox` 绕过权限提示直接执行沙箱外命令，降低高危操作风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents `dangerouslyDisableSandbox` from running outside the sandbox without a prompt, reducing high-risk execution.

changes.raw: Fixed `/effort auto` confirmation — now says "Effort level set to max" to match the status bar label
changes.summary: 统一Effort确认文案
changes.summary_en: Align effort confirmation wording
changes.why_matters: 只是修正文案不一致，减少用户对设置结果的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: This is a wording fix that reduces confusion about the applied setting.

changes.raw: Fixed the "copied N chars" toast overcounting emoji and other multi-code-unit characters
changes.summary: 修复复制字符数统计错误
changes.summary_en: Fix copied character count for emoji
changes.why_matters: 让复制提示的字符统计更准确，尤其对 emoji 等多字节字符更可靠。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes the copy toast count more accurate, especially for emoji and other multi-code-unit characters.

changes.raw: Fixed `/insights` crashing with `EBUSY` on Windows
changes.summary: 修复Windows上insights崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix /insights crash on Windows
changes.why_matters: 避免 Windows 用户在使用 `/insights` 时直接崩溃，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents `/insights` from crashing on Windows, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed exit confirmation dialog mislabeling one-shot scheduled tasks as recurring — now shows a countdown
changes.summary: 修复退出确认任务标注
changes.summary_en: Fix exit dialog task labeling
changes.why_matters: 让退出确认更准确地显示一次性任务和倒计时，减少误解。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes the exit confirmation dialog accurately show one-shot tasks and countdowns.

changes.raw: Fixed slash/@ completion menu not sitting flush against the prompt border in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 修复全屏补全菜单边距
changes.summary_en: Fix fullscreen completion menu alignment
changes.why_matters: 改善全屏模式下的界面贴合度，提升视觉体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves visual alignment in fullscreen mode for a cleaner UI.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY` `output_config.effort` causing 400 errors on subagent calls to models that don't support effort and on Vertex AI
changes.summary: 修复子代理effort参数报错
changes.summary_en: Fix effort config errors for subagent calls
changes.why_matters: 避免不支持 effort 的模型和 Vertex AI 子代理调用因配置错误返回 400。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents 400 errors when subagent calls send effort settings to unsupported models or Vertex AI.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt cursor disappearing when `NO_COLOR` is set
changes.summary: 修复NO_COLOR下光标消失
changes.summary_en: Fix hidden prompt cursor with NO_COLOR
changes.why_matters: 确保禁用颜色时仍能看到输入光标，避免命令行交互受阻。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the prompt cursor visible when colors are disabled, preserving CLI usability.

changes.raw: Fixed `ToolSearch` ranking so pasted MCP tool names surface the actual tool instead of description-matching siblings
changes.summary: 工具搜索更准，直达目标工具
changes.summary_en: Tool search surfaces the right tool
changes.why_matters: 粘贴 MCP 工具名时能直接命中真实工具，减少误选和查找成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Pasted MCP tool names now resolve to the actual tool, reducing misselection and lookup friction.

changes.raw: Fixed compacting a resumed long-context session failing with "Extra usage is required for long context requests"
changes.summary: 恢复长上下文压缩失败问题
changes.summary_en: Fix resumed long-context compaction
changes.why_matters: 恢复后的长上下文会话现在可以正常压缩，避免因额外用量报错而中断工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Resumed long-context sessions can now compact successfully instead of failing with usage errors.

changes.raw: Fixed `plugin install` succeeding when a dependency version conflicts with an already-installed plugin — now reports `range-conflict`
changes.summary: 插件依赖冲突时正确报错
changes.summary_en: Plugin install now reports conflicts
changes.why_matters: 当依赖版本与已安装插件冲突时会明确提示，避免表面安装成功却留下不可用状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Dependency version conflicts are now reported clearly, preventing false-success installs and broken setups.

changes.raw: Fixed "Refine with Ultraplan" not showing the remote session URL in the transcript
changes.summary: 远程会话转写显示链接
changes.summary_en: Show remote session URL in transcript
changes.why_matters: 转写中显示远程会话 URL，方便用户回到对应会话继续协作。
changes.why_matters_en: Showing the remote session URL in the transcript makes it easier to return to the right session.

changes.raw: Fixed SDK image content blocks that fail to process crashing the session — now degrade to a text placeholder
changes.summary: 图片块失败不再导致会话崩溃
changes.summary_en: Bad image blocks no longer crash sessions
changes.why_matters: SDK 中无法处理的图片内容现在会降级为文本占位符，提升会话稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Unprocessable SDK image blocks now degrade to text placeholders, improving session stability.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control sessions not streaming subagent transcripts
changes.summary: 远控会话可流式查看子代理转写
changes.summary_en: Remote Control streams subagent transcripts
changes.why_matters: 用户能实时看到子代理的执行过程，便于理解、排查和协同。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now follow subagent activity in real time, improving visibility and debugging.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control sessions not being archived when Claude Code exits
changes.summary: 退出时自动归档远控会话
changes.summary_en: Remote Control sessions archive on exit
changes.why_matters: Claude Code 退出后远控会话会被正确归档，避免会话记录丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Remote Control sessions are now archived on exit, preventing loss of session history.

changes.raw: Fixed `thinking.type.enabled is not supported` 400 error when using Opus 4.7 via a Bedrock Application Inference Profile ARN
changes.summary: 修复 Bedrock Opus 4.7 400 错误
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock Opus 4.7 400 error
changes.why_matters: 使用 Bedrock Application Inference Profile ARN 时不再因不支持的 thinking 配置而请求失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Requests using a Bedrock Application Inference Profile ARN no longer fail on unsupported thinking settings.

changes.raw: Fixed "claude-opus-4-7 is temporarily unavailable" for auto mode
changes.summary: 修复自动模式模型不可用提示
changes.summary_en: Fix auto mode model unavailable error
changes.why_matters: 减少自动模式下因模型临时不可用导致的中断，提升使用连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces interruptions in auto mode when a model is temporarily unavailable, improving continuity.

signals.title: An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
Pro Max 5x quota exhausted in 1.5 hours despite moderate usage
Claude Code Routines
Measuring Claude 4.7's tokenizer costs
Claude Code to be removed from Anthropic's Pro plan?

changes.raw: Claude Opus 4.7 xhigh is now available! Use /effort to tune speed vs. intelligence
changes.summary: 新增 Opus 4.7 xhigh 力度
changes.summary_en: Add Opus 4.7 xhigh effort level
changes.why_matters: 让用户能更细致地在速度和智能之间取舍，提升大模型调用的可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: It gives users finer control over the speed-intelligence tradeoff for model calls.

changes.raw: Auto mode is now available for Max subscribers when using Opus 4.7
changes.summary: Max 用户可用 Auto 模式
changes.summary_en: Enable Auto mode for Max subscribers
changes.why_matters: 订阅用户可以更自动化地选择合适模型，减少手动切换成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Subscribers can automate model selection and reduce manual switching overhead.

changes.raw: Added `xhigh` effort level for Opus 4.7, sitting between `high` and `max`. Available via `/effort`, `--effort`, and the model picker; other models fall back to `high`
changes.summary: 新增 xhigh 推理力度选项
changes.summary_en: Add xhigh effort option for Opus 4.7
changes.why_matters: 提供介于 high 和 max 之间的新档位，帮助用户更精细地控制质量与速度。
changes.why_matters_en: It adds a middle tier between high and max for finer control over quality and speed.

changes.raw: `/effort` now opens an interactive slider when called without arguments, with arrow-key navigation between levels and Enter to confirm
changes.summary: /effort 支持滑块交互选择
changes.summary_en: /effort opens an interactive slider
changes.why_matters: 用户无需记忆参数即可快速调整力度，交互更直观。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can adjust effort more intuitively without memorizing arguments.

changes.raw: Added "Auto (match terminal)" theme option that matches your terminal's dark/light mode — select it from `/theme`
changes.summary: 新增终端同步主题模式
changes.summary_en: Add terminal-matching theme option
changes.why_matters: 主题可自动跟随终端明暗模式，减少手动切换并提升一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: The theme can follow terminal dark/light mode automatically for a more consistent experience.

changes.raw: Added `/less-permission-prompts` skill — scans transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls and proposes a prioritized allowlist for `.claude/settings.json`
changes.summary: 新增降权限提示优化技能
changes.summary_en: Add /less-permission-prompts skill
changes.why_matters: 帮助生成更合理的白名单，减少不必要的权限弹窗和中断。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps build a better allowlist and reduces unnecessary permission prompts and interruptions.

changes.raw: Added `/ultrareview` for running comprehensive code review in the cloud using parallel multi-agent analysis and critique — invoke with no arguments to review your current branch, or `/ultrareview <PR#>` to fetch and review a specific GitHub PR
changes.summary: 新增云端超强代码审查
changes.summary_en: Add /ultrareview cloud code review
changes.why_matters: 通过并行多代理审查提升代码评审深度，帮助更早发现问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Parallel multi-agent review improves review depth and helps catch issues earlier.

changes.raw: Auto mode no longer requires `--enable-auto-mode`
changes.summary: Auto 模式免开关即可使用
changes.summary_en: Auto mode no longer needs enable flag
changes.why_matters: 减少启用步骤，让自动模式更容易上手和使用。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes an extra setup step, making Auto mode easier to use.

changes.raw: Windows: PowerShell tool is progressively rolling out. Opt in or out with `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL`. On Linux and macOS, enable with `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=1` (requires `pwsh` on PATH)
changes.summary: PowerShell 工具逐步开放
changes.summary_en: Roll out PowerShell tool support
changes.why_matters: Windows 用户可获得更原生的命令执行体验，跨平台一致性更好。
changes.why_matters_en: Windows users get a more native command execution experience and better cross-platform consistency.

changes.raw: Read-only bash commands with glob patterns (e.g. `ls *.ts`) and commands starting with `cd <project-dir> &&` no longer trigger a permission prompt
changes.summary: 减少常见只读命令误拦截
changes.summary_en: Stop prompting for common read-only commands
changes.why_matters: 降低无意义权限提示，提升日常浏览和检查代码时的流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces pointless permission prompts and makes routine code inspection smoother.

changes.raw: Suggest the closest matching subcommand when `claude <word>` is invoked with a near-miss typo (e.g. `claude udpate` → "Did you mean `claude update`?")
changes.summary: 近似子命令自动纠错提示
changes.summary_en: Suggest closest matching subcommand
changes.why_matters: 用户输入拼写错误时能更快找到正确命令，减少挫败感。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can recover from typos faster and find the right command with less frustration.

changes.raw: Plan files are now named after your prompt (e.g. `fix-auth-race-snug-otter.md`) instead of purely random words
changes.summary: 计划文件按提示自动命名
changes.summary_en: Name plan files from the prompt
changes.why_matters: 文件名更可读、更易检索，方便后续回顾和管理计划。
changes.why_matters_en: Plan files become more readable and easier to find and manage later.

changes.raw: Improved `/setup-vertex` and `/setup-bedrock` to show the actual `settings.json` path when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set, seed model candidates from existing pins on re-run, and offer a "with 1M context" option for supported models
changes.summary: 设置向导更懂配置路径
changes.summary_en: Improve setup flows for config paths
changes.why_matters: 在自定义配置目录下也能正确引导，并减少重复选择模型的麻烦。
changes.why_matters_en: It guides users correctly with custom config dirs and reduces repeated model selection work.

changes.raw: `/skills` menu now supports sorting by estimated token count — press `t` to toggle
changes.summary: 技能列表可按 token 排序
changes.summary_en: Sort skills by estimated token count
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更快挑选更省上下文的技能，优化 token 使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can choose more context-efficient skills and optimize token usage faster.

changes.raw: `Ctrl+U` now clears the entire input buffer (previously: delete to start of line); press `Ctrl+Y` to restore
changes.summary: Ctrl+U 改为清空整行输入
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+U now clears the whole input
changes.why_matters: 键盘编辑行为更符合常见终端习惯，输入清理更直接。
changes.why_matters_en: The keybinding matches common terminal habits and makes clearing input more direct.

changes.raw: `Ctrl+L` now forces a full screen redraw in addition to clearing the prompt input
changes.summary: Ctrl+L强制全屏重绘
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+L now forces a full redraw
changes.why_matters: 清屏时同时重绘可减少界面残影和显示不同步问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Redrawing on clear reduces stale UI artifacts and display desync.

changes.raw: Transcript view footer now shows `[` (dump to scrollback) and `v` (open in editor) shortcuts
changes.summary: 脚注显示滚动回放快捷键
changes.summary_en: Transcript footer shows scrollback/editor shortcuts
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快发现并使用转储和编辑会话内容的操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can more easily discover shortcuts for dumping or editing transcripts.

changes.raw: The "+N lines" marker for truncated long pastes is now a full-width rule for easier scanning
changes.summary: 长粘贴截断标记更醒目
changes.summary_en: Truncated paste marker is easier to scan
changes.why_matters: 更清晰的分隔线让用户更容易识别被截断的输入内容。
changes.why_matters_en: A clearer divider makes truncated pasted input easier to spot.

changes.raw: Headless `--output-format stream-json` now includes `plugin_errors` on the init event when plugins are demoted for unsatisfied dependencies
changes.summary: stream-json补充插件错误
changes.summary_en: stream-json now includes plugin_errors
changes.why_matters: 头less模式能更完整暴露插件依赖问题，便于自动化排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Headless runs now surface plugin dependency issues more completely for debugging.

changes.raw: Added `OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES` environment variable to emit full API request and response bodies as OpenTelemetry log events for debugging
changes.summary: 可记录完整API请求响应
changes.summary_en: Can log full API request/response bodies
changes.why_matters: 调试时可直接查看原始请求响应，显著提升定位问题效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Full request and response bodies make API debugging much easier.

changes.raw: Suppressed spurious decompression, network, and transient error messages that could appear in the TUI during normal operation
changes.summary: 减少正常运行时误报错误
changes.summary_en: Suppresses spurious normal-operation errors
changes.why_matters: 减少无关错误提示能降低噪音，让用户更专注真实问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Fewer false error messages reduce noise and help users focus on real issues.

changes.raw: Reverted the v2.1.110 cap on non-streaming fallback retries — it traded long waits for more outright failures during API overload
changes.summary: 恢复非流式重试上限
changes.summary_en: Restores non-streaming fallback retries
changes.why_matters: 在API拥塞时可提高成功率，减少任务因临时故障直接失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves success rates during API overload and reduces outright failures.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal display tearing (random characters, drifting input) in iTerm2 + tmux setups when terminal notifications are sent
changes.summary: 修复iTerm2+tmux显示撕裂
changes.summary_en: Fixes display tearing in iTerm2 + tmux
changes.why_matters: 终端界面更稳定，避免通知触发时出现乱码和输入漂移。
changes.why_matters_en: The terminal UI stays stable and avoids garbled output or drifting input.

changes.raw: Fixed `@` file suggestions re-scanning the entire project on every turn in non-git working directories, and showing only config files in freshly-initialized git repos with no tracked files
changes.summary: @文件建议不再全项目重扫
changes.summary_en: File suggestions stop rescanning whole project
changes.why_matters: 减少每轮交互的额外扫描，提升非git目录和新仓库中的响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces unnecessary rescans and speeds up suggestions in non-git and fresh repos.

changes.raw: Fixed LSP diagnostics from before an edit appearing after it, causing the model to re-read files it just edited
changes.summary: 修复编辑前诊断回流
changes.summary_en: Fixes stale diagnostics after edits
changes.why_matters: 避免模型被过期诊断误导而重复读取刚修改过的文件。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents stale diagnostics from causing unnecessary rereads of edited files.

changes.raw: Fixed tab-completing `/resume` immediately resuming an arbitrary titled session instead of showing the session picker
changes.summary: /resume补全不再直接恢复
changes.summary_en: Tab-completing /resume no longer auto-resumes
changes.why_matters: 防止用户在选择会话前被意外恢复到错误的历史会话。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids accidentally resuming the wrong session before the picker appears.

changes.raw: Fixed `/context` grid rendering with extra blank lines between rows
changes.summary: /context网格间距修复
changes.summary_en: Fixes extra blank lines in /context grid
changes.why_matters: 让上下文视图更紧凑整洁，提升可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: The context view becomes cleaner and easier to read.

changes.raw: Fixed `/clear` dropping the session name set by `/rename`, causing statusline output to lose `session_name`
changes.summary: /clear后保留会话名
changes.summary_en: Keeps session name after /clear
changes.why_matters: 清空内容后仍保留会话标识，状态栏信息不会丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Session identity remains intact after clearing, so status info is preserved.

changes.raw: Improved plugin error handling: dependency errors now distinguish conflicting, invalid, and overly complex version requirements; fixed stale resolved versions after `plugin update`; `plugin install` now recovers from interrupted prior installs
changes.summary: 插件错误提示更准确
changes.summary_en: Plugin errors are more specific
changes.why_matters: 更细分的错误类型和更稳健的安装流程能显著改善插件管理体验。
changes.why_matters_en: More specific errors and a more robust install flow improve plugin management.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude calling a non-existent `commit` skill and showing "Unknown skill: commit" for users without a custom `/commit` command
changes.summary: 修复不存在的commit技能
changes.summary_en: Fixes unknown commit skill error
changes.why_matters: 避免没有自定义命令时出现误导性的技能不存在报错。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents misleading unknown-skill errors when no custom commit command exists.

changes.raw: Fixed 429 rate-limit errors on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry referencing status.claude.com (it only covers Anthropic-operated providers)
changes.summary: 修正非Anthropic限流误导
changes.summary_en: Fix misleading 429 rate-limit guidance
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 出现 429 时被错误引导去查看不适用的状态页。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents users from being misdirected to an irrelevant status page when 429s occur on Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry.

changes.raw: Fixed feedback surveys appearing back-to-back after dismissing one
changes.summary: 避免反馈问卷连着弹出
changes.summary_en: Prevent back-to-back feedback surveys
changes.why_matters: 减少重复打扰，让用户关闭一次问卷后不会立刻再次被弹出。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces repeated interruptions by ensuring dismissing one survey does not immediately trigger another.

changes.raw: Fixed bare URLs in bash/PowerShell/MCP tool output being unclickable when the terminal wraps them across lines
changes.summary: 终端换行URL可点击
changes.summary_en: Make wrapped URLs clickable in terminal output
changes.why_matters: 提升在 bash、PowerShell 和 MCP 工具输出中打开链接的可用性，减少复制粘贴成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves link usability in bash, PowerShell, and MCP tool output, reducing copy-paste friction.

changes.raw: Windows: `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` and SessionStart hook environment files now apply (previously a no-op)
changes.summary: Windows环境文件现已生效
changes.summary_en: Windows env files now apply correctly
changes.why_matters: 修复 Windows 上 `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` 和 SessionStart 环境文件无效的问题，使会话配置真正生效。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes Windows so `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` and SessionStart env files actually take effect for session setup.

changes.raw: Windows: permission rules with drive-letter paths are now correctly root-anchored, and paths differing only by drive-letter case are recognized as the same path
changes.summary: 修正Windows路径规则匹配
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows drive-letter path matching
changes.why_matters: 确保带盘符的权限规则能正确锚定到根路径，并把仅盘符大小写不同的路径视为同一路径。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures drive-letter permission rules anchor correctly and treats paths differing only by drive-letter case as identical.

signals.title: An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
Pro Max 5x quota exhausted in 1.5 hours despite moderate usage
Claude Code Routines
Measuring Claude 4.7's tokenizer costs
Claude Code to be removed from Anthropic's Pro plan?

changes.raw: Added `/tui` command and `tui` setting — run `/tui fullscreen` to switch to flicker-free rendering in the same conversation
changes.summary: 新增 /tui 无闪烁全屏渲染
changes.summary_en: Add /tui fullscreen flicker-free rendering
changes.why_matters: 让同一对话在全屏模式下更流畅，减少界面闪烁带来的干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes fullscreen conversations smoother and reduces distracting flicker.

changes.raw: Added push notification tool — Claude can send mobile push notifications when Remote Control and "Push when Claude decides" config are enabled
changes.summary: 支持 Claude 手机推送通知
changes.summary_en: Claude can send mobile push notifications
changes.why_matters: 在远程控制场景下可及时提醒用户任务进展或完成状态。
changes.why_matters_en: It keeps users informed about progress or completion during remote sessions.

changes.raw: Changed `Ctrl+O` to toggle between normal and verbose transcript only; focus view is now toggled separately with the new `/focus` command
changes.summary: 拆分对话显示与专注视图切换
changes.summary_en: Separate transcript toggle from focus view
changes.why_matters: 减少快捷键歧义，让用户更明确地控制不同视图状态。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes shortcut ambiguity and gives clearer control over view modes.

changes.raw: Added `autoScrollEnabled` config to disable conversation auto-scroll in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 全屏模式可关闭自动滚动
changes.summary_en: Disable auto-scroll in fullscreen mode
changes.why_matters: 避免长对话中视图被自动拉动，提升阅读和审阅体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents unwanted scrolling in long conversations and improves review comfort.

changes.raw: Added option to show Claude's last response as commented context in the `Ctrl+G` external editor (enable via `/config`)
changes.summary: 外部编辑器可附带注释上下文
changes.summary_en: Show last response as commented context
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户在 IDE 中编辑时保留模型上下文，减少来回切换。
changes.why_matters_en: It preserves model context in the IDE and reduces back-and-forth switching.

changes.raw: Improved `/plugin` Installed tab — items needing attention and favorites appear at the top, disabled items are hidden behind a fold, and `f` favorites the selected item
changes.summary: 插件列表更易处理待关注项
changes.summary_en: Prioritize attention-needed plugins
changes.why_matters: 让用户更快找到需要处理的插件并管理收藏项。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users quickly find plugins that need attention and manage favorites.

changes.raw: Improved `/doctor` to warn when an MCP server is defined in multiple config scopes with different endpoints
changes.summary: 检测 MCP 配置冲突更及时
changes.summary_en: Warn on conflicting MCP config scopes
changes.why_matters: 可及早发现不同配置层中的重复定义，避免连接到错误的服务器。
changes.why_matters_en: It catches duplicate definitions across config scopes early and avoids connecting to the wrong server.

changes.raw: `--resume`/`--continue` now resurrects unexpired scheduled tasks
changes.summary: 恢复未过期的计划任务
changes.summary_en: Resurrect unexpired scheduled tasks
changes.why_matters: 续会话时不会丢失仍有效的计划任务，提升自动化连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: It preserves still-valid scheduled tasks when resuming sessions, improving automation continuity.

changes.raw: `/context`, `/exit`, and `/reload-plugins` now work from Remote Control (mobile/web) clients
changes.summary: 远程控制可用更多会话命令
changes.summary_en: More session commands work in Remote Control
changes.why_matters: 移动端或网页端可直接查看上下文、退出或重载插件，操作更完整。
changes.why_matters_en: Mobile and web clients can now inspect context, exit, or reload plugins directly.

changes.raw: Write tool now informs the model when you edit the proposed content in the IDE diff before accepting
changes.summary: 编辑差异会反馈给模型
changes.summary_en: Model sees edits to proposed content
changes.why_matters: 模型能感知用户在 IDE 中修改了建议内容，从而更准确地继续协作。
changes.why_matters_en: The model can tell when you edit suggested content, enabling more accurate collaboration.

changes.raw: Bash tool now enforces the documented maximum timeout instead of accepting arbitrarily large values
changes.summary: 限制 Bash 超时上限
changes.summary_en: Enforce Bash timeout maximum
changes.why_matters: 防止命令被设置为过长超时而拖垮会话或造成资源占用。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents excessively long command timeouts from stalling sessions or consuming resources.

changes.raw: SDK/headless sessions now read `TRACEPARENT`/`TRACESTATE` from the environment for distributed trace linking
changes.summary: 支持分布式链路追踪关联
changes.summary_en: Link SDK sessions with trace context
changes.why_matters: 便于在分布式系统中追踪会话调用链，提升可观测性。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves observability by linking session activity into distributed traces.

changes.raw: Session recap is now enabled for users with telemetry disabled (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`). Opt out via `/config` or `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY=0`.
changes.summary: 禁用遥测也可生成会话回顾
changes.summary_en: Session recap works with telemetry off
changes.why_matters: 在不启用遥测的环境里仍能获得会话总结，同时保留退出选项。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can still get session recaps even when telemetry is disabled, with an opt-out available.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tool calls hanging indefinitely when the server connection drops mid-response on SSE/HTTP transports
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 断连后工具卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP tool hangs after transport drop
changes.why_matters: 避免服务器中途断开时工具调用无限等待，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents tool calls from hanging indefinitely when the server disconnects mid-response.

changes.raw: Fixed non-streaming fallback retries causing multi-minute hangs when the API is unreachable
changes.summary: 修复 API 不可达时长时间卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix long hangs when API is unreachable
changes.why_matters: 在网络或服务异常时能更快失败返回，减少用户等待。
changes.why_matters_en: It fails faster when the API is unreachable, reducing user wait time during outages.

changes.raw: Fixed session recap, local slash-command output, and other system status lines not appearing in focus mode
changes.summary: 修复焦点模式状态行缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix status lines missing in focus mode
changes.why_matters: 让用户在专注模式下仍能看到关键会话状态，避免信息丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps important session status visible in focus mode so users do not miss context.

changes.raw: Fixed high CPU usage in fullscreen when text is selected while a tool is running
changes.summary: 修复全屏选中文本高CPU
changes.summary_en: Fix high CPU in fullscreen selection
changes.why_matters: 减少工具运行时的异常资源占用，提升大屏交互流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces abnormal CPU usage and improves fullscreen responsiveness during tool runs.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin install not honoring dependencies declared in `plugin.json` when the marketplace entry omits them; `/plugin` install now lists auto-installed dependencies
changes.summary: 修复插件依赖自动安装
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin dependency auto-install
changes.why_matters: 确保插件安装时依赖被正确处理，避免功能缺失或安装失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures plugin dependencies are installed correctly, preventing broken installs or missing features.

changes.raw: Fixed skills with `disable-model-invocation: true` failing when invoked via `/<skill>` mid-message
changes.summary: 修复技能命令中途调用失败
changes.summary_en: Fix skill command invocation mid-message
changes.why_matters: 让禁用模型调用的技能在消息中途触发时也能正常工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows skills with model invocation disabled to work correctly when triggered mid-message.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` sometimes showing the first prompt instead of the `/rename` name for sessions still running or exited uncleanly
changes.summary: 修复恢复会话标题显示错误
changes.summary_en: Fix wrong title shown on resume
changes.why_matters: 恢复会话时能显示正确名称，方便用户识别和继续工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows the correct session name on resume, making it easier to identify and continue work.

changes.raw: Fixed queued messages briefly appearing twice during multi-tool-call turns
changes.summary: 修复多工具轮次消息重复
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate queued messages
changes.why_matters: 避免消息短暂重复显示，减少交互中的混乱感。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents brief duplicate message display and reduces confusion during multi-tool turns.

changes.raw: Fixed session cleanup not removing the full session directory including subagent transcripts
changes.summary: 修复会话清理不彻底
changes.summary_en: Fix incomplete session cleanup
changes.why_matters: 确保结束后清理完整，避免残留子代理记录占用空间。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures full cleanup after sessions, preventing leftover subagent transcripts from consuming space.

changes.raw: Fixed dropped keystrokes after the CLI relaunches (e.g. `/tui`, provider setup wizards)
changes.summary: 修复重启后按键丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix dropped keystrokes after relaunch
changes.why_matters: 提升重启流程可靠性，避免用户输入在关键设置步骤中丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves relaunch reliability so user input is not lost during setup flows.

changes.raw: Fixed garbled startup rendering in macOS Terminal.app and other terminals that don't support synchronized output
changes.summary: 修复终端启动乱码
changes.summary_en: Fix garbled startup rendering
changes.why_matters: 让不支持同步输出的终端也能正常显示启动界面。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes startup rendering work correctly in terminals without synchronized output support.

changes.raw: Hardened "Open in editor" actions against command injection from untrusted filenames
changes.summary: 加固编辑器打开防注入
changes.summary_en: Harden editor open against injection
changes.why_matters: 防止不可信文件名触发命令注入，降低本地安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents command injection from untrusted filenames and reduces local security risk.

changes.raw: Fixed `PermissionRequest` hooks returning `updatedInput` not being re-checked against `permissions.deny` rules; `setMode:'bypassPermissions'` updates now respect `disableBypassPermissionsMode`
changes.summary: 修复权限回调绕过校验
changes.summary_en: Fix permission hook revalidation
changes.why_matters: 确保权限更新仍受拒绝规则约束，避免绕过安全策略。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures permission updates still respect deny rules and cannot bypass security policy.

changes.raw: Fixed `PreToolUse` hook `additionalContext` being dropped when the tool call fails
changes.summary: 修复工具失败时上下文丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix lost additional context on failure
changes.why_matters: 让失败的工具调用仍保留额外上下文，便于诊断和重试。
changes.why_matters_en: Preserves extra context even when a tool call fails, improving debugging and retries.

changes.raw: Fixed stdio MCP servers that print stray non-JSON lines to stdout being disconnected on the first stray line (regression in 2.1.105)
changes.summary: 修复MCP异常输出断连
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP disconnect on stray stdout
changes.why_matters: 提高MCP集成容错性，避免非JSON输出导致服务意外断开。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves MCP integration resilience so stray non-JSON output does not disconnect servers.

changes.raw: Fixed headless/SDK session auto-title firing an extra Haiku request when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` is set
changes.summary: 修复自动标题额外请求
changes.summary_en: Fix extra auto-title request
changes.why_matters: 减少无必要模型请求，降低离线或受限环境下的额外流量。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids unnecessary model requests and reduces extra traffic in restricted or headless environments.

changes.raw: Fixed potential excessive memory allocation when piped (non-TTY) Ink output contains a single very wide line
changes.summary: 修复超宽行内存暴涨
changes.summary_en: Fix excessive memory on wide lines
changes.why_matters: 防止管道输出遇到超宽文本时占用过多内存，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents excessive memory use when piped output contains very wide lines, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/skills` menu not scrolling when the list overflows the modal in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 修复全屏技能菜单滚动
changes.summary_en: Fix scrolling in fullscreen skills menu
changes.why_matters: 当技能列表超出弹窗时，用户现在可以正常滚动并选择所需项，避免界面卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now scroll and select items when the skills list overflows, avoiding a stuck UI.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control sessions showing a generic error instead of prompting for re-login when the session is too old
changes.summary: 旧远程会话提示重新登录
changes.summary_en: Prompt re-login for stale remote sessions
changes.why_matters: 会话过期时改为引导重新登录，减少无意义的通用报错并提升恢复效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Expired sessions now guide users to re-login, reducing generic errors and speeding recovery.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control session renames from claude.ai not persisting the title to the local CLI session
changes.summary: 同步远程重命名到本地标题
changes.summary_en: Persist remote rename to local session title
changes.why_matters: 远程端改名后本地 CLI 会话标题也会更新，避免会话名称不一致造成混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: Renaming on the remote side now updates the local CLI session title, preventing confusing mismatches.

changes.raw: Improved the extended-thinking indicator with a rotating progress hint
changes.summary: 增强扩展思考中的进度提示
changes.summary_en: Improved extended-thinking progress hint
changes.why_matters: 让用户在扩展思考时更清楚地感知当前进度，减少等待时的不确定感。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives users clearer feedback during extended thinking and reduces uncertainty while waiting.

signals.title: Pro Max 5x quota exhausted in 1.5 hours despite moderate usage
Claude Code Routines
Measuring Claude 4.7's tokenizer costs
Claude Code to be removed from Anthropic's Pro plan?
Anthropic downgraded cache TTL on March 6th

changes.raw: Added `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H` env var to opt into 1-hour prompt cache TTL on API key, Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry (`ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H_BEDROCK` is deprecated but still honored), and `FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M` to force 5-minute TTL
changes.summary: 支持1小时提示缓存TTL
changes.summary_en: Support 1-hour prompt cache TTL
changes.why_matters: 用户可以通过环境变量启用更长的提示缓存，减少重复计算并提升响应效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can opt into a longer prompt cache TTL, reducing repeated computation and improving response efficiency.

changes.raw: Added recap feature to provide context when returning to a session, configurable in `/config` and manually invocable with `/recap`; force with `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY` if telemetry disabled.
changes.summary: 新增回顾摘要，续会更有上下文
changes.summary_en: Add recap summaries for session return
changes.why_matters: 用户回到会话时能快速恢复上下文，减少重新解释背景的成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly regain context when returning to a session, reducing the need to restate background.

changes.raw: The model can now discover and invoke built-in slash commands like `/init`, `/review`, and `/security-review` via the Skill tool
changes.summary: 可通过Skill调用内置斜杠命令
changes.summary_en: Invoke built-in slash commands via Skill
changes.why_matters: 模型可以自动触发常用命令，减少手动操作并提升工作流自动化。
changes.why_matters_en: The model can trigger common commands automatically, reducing manual steps and improving workflow automation.

changes.raw: `/undo` is now an alias for `/rewind`
changes.summary: /undo 变为 /rewind 别名
changes.summary_en: /undo becomes an alias for /rewind
changes.why_matters: 这只是命令兼容性增强，降低用户记忆成本。
changes.why_matters_en: This is a compatibility improvement that lowers the mental overhead of remembering commands.

changes.raw: Improved `/model` to warn before switching models mid-conversation, since the next response re-reads the full history uncached
changes.summary: 切换模型前先提醒重读历史
changes.summary_en: Warn before switching models mid-chat
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户理解切换模型的代价，避免意外增加延迟和缓存失效。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users understand the cost of switching models and avoid unexpected latency and cache misses.

changes.raw: Improved `/resume` picker to default to sessions from the current directory; press `Ctrl+A` to show all projects
changes.summary: 恢复会话默认当前目录项目
changes.summary_en: Resume picker defaults to current project
changes.why_matters: 用户更容易找到当前工作目录相关会话，减少筛选成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can more easily find sessions for the current working directory, reducing filtering effort.

changes.raw: Improved error messages: server rate limits are now distinguished from plan usage limits; 5xx/529 errors show a link to status.claude.com; unknown slash commands suggest the closest match
changes.summary: 错误提示更清晰更可行动
changes.summary_en: Clearer, more actionable error messages
changes.why_matters: 更准确的错误信息能帮助用户快速判断问题来源并采取下一步操作。
changes.why_matters_en: More precise errors help users quickly identify the source of a problem and take the next step.

changes.raw: Reduced memory footprint for file reads, edits, and syntax highlighting by loading language grammars on demand
changes.summary: 按需加载语法树降低内存
changes.summary_en: Load grammars on demand to cut memory
changes.why_matters: 减少文件处理时的内存占用，让大项目和长会话更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Lower memory usage during file handling makes large projects and long sessions more stable.

changes.raw: Added "verbose" indicator when viewing the detailed transcript (`Ctrl+O`)
changes.summary: 详细转录新增verbose标记
changes.summary_en: Add verbose indicator in detailed transcript
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快识别当前查看的是更详细的输出。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can more quickly tell when they are viewing a more detailed output.

changes.raw: Added a warning at startup when prompt caching is disabled via `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING*` environment variables
changes.summary: 启动时提示已关闭提示缓存
changes.summary_en: Warn at startup when prompt caching is off
changes.why_matters: 让用户及时发现性能相关配置问题，避免无意中降低效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users notice performance-related configuration issues before they unintentionally slow things down.

changes.raw: Fixed paste not working in the `/login` code prompt (regression in 2.1.105)
changes.summary: 修复登录码输入粘贴失效
changes.summary_en: Fix paste in /login code prompt
changes.why_matters: 用户现在可以顺利粘贴登录验证码，避免认证流程中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now paste login codes successfully, avoiding interruptions in the authentication flow.

changes.raw: Fixed subscribers who set `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` falling back to 5-minute prompt cache TTL instead of 1 hour
changes.summary: 禁用遥测仍保留1小时缓存
changes.summary_en: Keep 1-hour cache with telemetry off
changes.why_matters: 修复后，关闭遥测的订阅用户仍能获得预期的更长缓存收益。
changes.why_matters_en: After the fix, subscribers with telemetry disabled still get the expected longer cache benefit.

changes.raw: Fixed Agent tool prompting for permission in auto mode when the safety classifier's transcript exceeded its context window
changes.summary: 自动模式下减少误触权限弹窗
changes.summary_en: Reduce spurious permission prompts in auto mode
changes.why_matters: 避免工具在自动模式下因上下文溢出而错误打断执行，提升自动化可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents unnecessary interruptions in auto mode when context overflows, improving automation reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash tool producing no output when `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` (e.g. `~/.zprofile`) ends with a `#` comment line
changes.summary: 修复Bash工具无输出问题
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash tool producing no output
changes.why_matters: 用户的 shell 命令结果能正常返回，避免脚本和环境配置失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Shell command results now return correctly, avoiding broken scripts and environment setups.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --resume <session-id>` losing the session's custom name and color set via `/rename`
changes.summary: 恢复会话保留自定义名称颜色
changes.summary_en: Preserve custom name and color on resume
changes.why_matters: 恢复会话时不会丢失个性化标识，便于区分和管理会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Resumed sessions keep their custom labels, making them easier to distinguish and manage.

changes.raw: Fixed session titles showing placeholder example text when the first message is a short greeting
changes.summary: 修复短问候标题占位文本
changes.summary_en: Fix placeholder titles for short greetings
changes.why_matters: 避免会话标题显示错误占位内容，提升界面专业度和可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents incorrect placeholder titles from showing up and improves UI clarity.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal escape codes appearing as garbage text in the prompt input after `--teleport`
changes.summary: 修复 teleport 后乱码输入
changes.summary_en: Fix garbled prompt input after teleport
changes.why_matters: 避免终端输入被转义码污染，保证远程接管后的交互可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents escape codes from corrupting terminal input and keeps remote sessions usable.

changes.raw: Fixed `/feedback` retry: pressing Enter to resubmit after a failure now works without first editing the description
changes.summary: 修复反馈重试回车可直接提交
changes.summary_en: Fix Enter-to-resubmit for /feedback retry
changes.why_matters: 减少失败后重复编辑的摩擦，让反馈重提更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces friction when resubmitting failed feedback and makes retries smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed `--teleport` and `--resume <id>` precondition errors (e.g. dirty git tree, session not found) exiting silently instead of showing the error message
changes.summary: 修复预条件错误静默退出
changes.summary_en: Fix silent exits on teleport/resume errors
changes.why_matters: 让用户能看到失败原因，便于排查脏工作区或会话不存在等问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Surfaces failure reasons so users can diagnose dirty trees or missing sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control session titles set in the web UI being overwritten by auto-generated titles after the third message
changes.summary: 修复远控标题被自动覆盖
changes.summary_en: Fix remote control titles being overwritten
changes.why_matters: 保留用户在网页端设置的标题，避免会话标识被意外改写。
changes.why_matters_en: Preserves titles set in the web UI instead of overwriting them unexpectedly.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` truncating sessions when the transcript contained a self-referencing message
changes.summary: 修复 resume 截断会话
changes.summary_en: Fix resume truncation on self-references
changes.why_matters: 防止恢复会话时丢失历史内容，保障上下文完整性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents transcript loss during resume and preserves conversation context.

changes.raw: Fixed transcript write failures (e.g., disk full) being silently dropped instead of being logged
changes.summary: 修复转录写入失败有日志
changes.summary_en: Log transcript write failures
changes.why_matters: 让磁盘满等存储问题可见，避免数据丢失却无人察觉。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes storage failures visible so transcript loss does not go unnoticed.

changes.raw: Fixed diacritical marks (accents, umlauts, cedillas) being dropped from responses when the `language` setting is configured
changes.summary: 修复语言设置丢失重音符号
changes.summary_en: Fix dropped accents in localized output
changes.why_matters: 保证多语言回复字符完整，提升国际化输出质量。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps localized responses character-complete and improves internationalization quality.

changes.raw: Fixed policy-managed plugins never auto-updating when running from a different project than where they were first installed
changes.summary: 修复插件跨项目不自动更新
changes.summary_en: Fix policy plugins not auto-updating
changes.why_matters: 确保策略管理插件在不同项目间仍能及时更新，减少版本漂移。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures policy-managed plugins keep updating across projects and reduces version drift.

changes.raw: Show thinking hints sooner during long operations
changes.summary: 长任务更早显示思考提示
changes.summary_en: Show thinking hints earlier on long tasks
changes.why_matters: 让用户在长时间操作中更早看到进度提示，减少等待时的不确定感。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get earlier progress cues during long operations, reducing uncertainty while waiting.
