changes.raw: Added `path` parameter to the `EnterWorktree` tool to switch into an existing worktree of the current repository
changes.summary: EnterWorktree支持指定路径切换
changes.summary_en: EnterWorktree can switch by path
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接进入当前仓库的已有 worktree，减少手动查找和切换成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can jump into an existing worktree in the current repo, reducing manual lookup and switching overhead.

changes.raw: Added PreCompact hook support: hooks can now block compaction by exiting with code 2 or returning `{"decision":"block"}`
changes.summary: PreCompact可阻止压缩
changes.summary_en: PreCompact hooks can block compaction
changes.why_matters: 插件现在能在压缩前拦截流程，避免在不适合压缩时丢失上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins can now stop compaction before it happens, preventing context loss when compaction is unsafe.

changes.raw: Added background monitor support for plugins via a top-level `monitors` manifest key that auto-arms at session start or on skill invoke
changes.summary: 插件支持后台监控器
changes.summary_en: Plugins can define background monitors
changes.why_matters: 插件可在会话开始或技能调用时自动启用监控，增强持续自动化能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins can auto-arm monitors at session start or skill invoke, improving continuous automation.

changes.raw: `/proactive` is now an alias for `/loop`
changes.summary: /proactive改为/loop别名
changes.summary_en: /proactive is now an alias for /loop
changes.why_matters: 这是命令别名调整，主要提升使用一致性和记忆便利性。
changes.why_matters_en: This is a command alias change that mainly improves consistency and ease of recall.

changes.raw: Improved stalled API stream handling: streams now abort after 5 minutes of no data and retry non-streaming instead of hanging indefinitely
changes.summary: 卡住流自动超时重试
changes.summary_en: Stalled streams now timeout and retry
changes.why_matters: 避免 API 流长时间无响应导致任务挂死，显著提升稳定性和可恢复性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents tasks from hanging indefinitely on stalled API streams, greatly improving reliability and recovery.

changes.raw: Improved network error messages: connection errors now show a retry message immediately instead of a silent spinner
changes.summary: 网络错误立即提示重试
changes.summary_en: Network errors now show retry prompts
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快知道连接失败并采取重试操作，减少等待和困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get immediate feedback on connection failures and can retry sooner, reducing waiting and confusion.

changes.raw: Improved file write display: long single-line writes (e.g. minified JSON) are now truncated in the UI instead of paginating across many screens
changes.summary: 长单行写入改为截断显示
changes.summary_en: Long single-line writes are truncated
changes.why_matters: 界面不再被超长内容刷屏，提升可读性和操作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: The UI no longer gets flooded by very long lines, improving readability and efficiency.

changes.raw: Improved `/doctor` layout with status icons; press `f` to have Claude fix reported issues
changes.summary: /doctor界面更清晰可修复
changes.summary_en: /doctor layout improved with fix action
changes.why_matters: 诊断结果更易读，并可直接触发修复，降低排障成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Diagnostics are easier to read and can be fixed directly, lowering troubleshooting effort.

changes.raw: Improved `/config` labels and descriptions for clarity
changes.summary: /config标签说明更清楚
changes.summary_en: /config labels and descriptions clarified
changes.why_matters: 配置项更易理解，减少误配和查找成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Configuration options are easier to understand, reducing misconfiguration and lookup effort.

changes.raw: Improved skill description handling: raised the listing cap from 250 to 1,536 characters and added a startup warning when descriptions are truncated
changes.summary: 技能描述支持更长文本
changes.summary_en: Skill descriptions can now be much longer
changes.why_matters: 更长的技能说明可保留关键信息，避免因截断导致能力展示不完整。
changes.why_matters_en: Longer skill descriptions preserve important details and avoid incomplete capability display due to truncation.

changes.raw: Improved `WebFetch` to strip `<style>` and `<script>` contents from fetched pages so CSS-heavy pages no longer exhaust the content budget before reaching actual text
changes.summary: WebFetch过滤样式脚本内容
changes.summary_en: WebFetch strips style and script content
changes.why_matters: 抓取网页时能更专注正文，减少无关内容占用上下文预算。
changes.why_matters_en: Fetched pages focus more on actual text, reducing irrelevant content that consumes context budget.

changes.raw: Improved stale agent worktree cleanup to remove worktrees whose PR was squash-merged instead of keeping them indefinitely
changes.summary: 清理已合并的旧工作树
changes.summary_en: Stale squash-merged worktrees are cleaned up
changes.why_matters: 自动清理无用 worktree，减少磁盘占用和仓库混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Unused worktrees are cleaned up automatically, reducing disk usage and repo clutter.

changes.raw: Improved MCP large-output truncation prompt to give format-specific recipes (e.g. `jq` for JSON, computed Read chunk sizes for text)
changes.summary: 大输出截断提示更实用
changes.summary_en: Large-output truncation prompts are more helpful
changes.why_matters: 当输出过大时，用户能更快选择合适的处理方式，减少试错。
changes.why_matters_en: When output is too large, users can choose a better handling method faster with less trial and error.

changes.raw: Fixed images attached to queued messages (sent while Claude is working) being dropped
changes.summary: 修复队列消息图片丢失
changes.summary_en: Queued message images are no longer dropped
changes.why_matters: 保证等待中的消息附件能正确发送，避免信息缺失影响任务执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures attachments in queued messages are preserved, preventing missing information from affecting work.

changes.raw: Fixed screen going blank when the prompt input wraps to a second line in long conversations
changes.summary: 长对话输入换行不再黑屏
changes.summary_en: Wrapped prompt input no longer blanks screen
changes.why_matters: 修复长对话中的严重界面故障，避免用户在输入时丢失可见内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes a serious UI failure in long conversations, preventing users from losing visible context while typing.

changes.raw: Fixed leading whitespace getting copied when selecting multi-line assistant responses in fullscreen mode
changes.summary: 修复多行回复复制空白
changes.summary_en: Fix copied leading whitespace
changes.why_matters: 避免复制助手多行回复时带入多余缩进，提升可用性和排版准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents extra indentation when copying multi-line assistant replies, improving usability and formatting accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed leading whitespace being trimmed from assistant messages, breaking ASCII art and indented diagrams
changes.summary: 保留助手消息缩进格式
changes.summary_en: Preserve assistant message indentation
changes.why_matters: 避免 ASCII 艺术和缩进图表被破坏，确保代码与文本展示正确。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents ASCII art and indented diagrams from being broken, keeping code and text display correct.

changes.raw: Fixed garbled bash output when commands print clickable file links (e.g. Python `rich`/`loguru` logging)
changes.summary: 修复 bash 可点击链接乱码
changes.summary_en: Fix garbled bash clickable links
changes.why_matters: 让终端日志中的文件链接正常显示，避免输出混乱影响排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps file links in terminal logs readable, avoiding garbled output during debugging.

changes.raw: Fixed alt+enter not inserting a newline in terminals using ESC-prefix alt encoding, and Ctrl+J not inserting a newline (regression in 2.1.100)
changes.summary: 修复 Alt+Enter 换行失效
changes.summary_en: Fix Alt+Enter and Ctrl+J newline
changes.why_matters: 恢复常用快捷键换行能力，减少输入长提示时的操作阻碍。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores common newline shortcuts, reducing friction when entering long prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed duplicate "Creating worktree" text in EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree tool display
changes.summary: 去重工作树显示文本
changes.summary_en: Remove duplicate worktree text
changes.why_matters: 让工具输出更简洁，减少界面噪音。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes tool output cleaner and reduces UI noise.

changes.raw: Fixed queued user prompts disappearing from focus mode
changes.summary: 修复焦点模式队列提示丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix queued prompts disappearing
changes.why_matters: 避免用户排队输入在焦点模式下丢失，防止交互中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents queued user input from being lost in focus mode, avoiding interaction breaks.

changes.raw: Fixed one-shot scheduled tasks re-firing repeatedly when the file watcher missed the post-fire cleanup
changes.summary: 修复定时任务重复触发
changes.summary_en: Fix one-shot tasks refiring repeatedly
changes.why_matters: 防止一次性任务被重复执行，避免意外自动化行为和资源浪费。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents one-shot tasks from running repeatedly, avoiding unintended automation and wasted resources.

changes.raw: Fixed inbound channel notifications being silently dropped after the first message for Team/Enterprise users
changes.summary: 修复入站通知丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix dropped inbound notifications
changes.why_matters: 确保团队和企业用户不会错过后续通知，提升协作可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures Team and Enterprise users do not miss later notifications, improving collaboration reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed marketplace plugins with `package.json` and lockfile not having dependencies installed automatically after install/update
changes.summary: 自动安装插件依赖
changes.summary_en: Auto-install marketplace dependencies
changes.why_matters: 让市场插件安装后即可正常运行，减少手动补依赖的麻烦。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures marketplace plugins work after install without manual dependency setup.

changes.raw: Fixed marketplace auto-update leaving the official marketplace in a broken state when a plugin process holds files open during the update
changes.summary: 修复插件自动更新损坏
changes.summary_en: Fix broken marketplace auto-update
changes.why_matters: 避免插件更新后官方市场进入损坏状态，保障扩展生态稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the official marketplace from breaking during plugin updates, protecting ecosystem stability.

changes.raw: Fixed "Resume this session with..." hint not printing on exit after `/resume`, `--worktree`, or `/branch`
changes.summary: 退出时显示续会提示
changes.summary_en: Show resume hint on exit
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户更容易恢复会话，提升连续工作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users resume sessions more easily, improving continuity of work.

changes.raw: Fixed feedback survey shortcut keys firing when typed at the end of a longer prompt
changes.summary: 修复反馈快捷键误触发
changes.summary_en: Fix feedback shortcut misfires
changes.why_matters: 避免在长提示末尾输入时误触反馈快捷键，减少打断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental feedback shortcut activation while typing at the end of long prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed stdio MCP server emitting malformed (non-JSON) output hanging the session instead of failing fast with "Connection closed"
changes.summary: MCP 异常输出快速失败
changes.summary_en: Fail fast on malformed MCP output
changes.why_matters: 让损坏的 MCP 连接及时报错而不是卡住会话，提高稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes malformed MCP connections fail fast instead of hanging the session, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tools missing on the first turn of headless/remote-trigger sessions when MCP servers connect asynchronously
changes.summary: 首轮可见 MCP 工具
changes.summary_en: Show MCP tools on first turn
changes.why_matters: 确保远程或无头会话一开始就能使用 MCP 工具，不错过首轮能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures MCP tools are available on the first turn in headless or remote-triggered sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed `/model` picker on AWS Bedrock in non-US regions persisting invalid `us.*` model IDs to `settings.json` when inference profile discovery is still in-flight
changes.summary: 修复 Bedrock 模型 ID 误存
changes.summary_en: Fix invalid Bedrock model IDs saved
changes.why_matters: 避免在非美区保存无效模型配置，减少后续模型选择和启动失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents invalid model settings from being saved in non-US regions, reducing later selection and startup failures.

changes.raw: Fixed 429 rate-limit errors showing a raw JSON dump instead of a clean message for API-key, Bedrock, and Vertex users
changes.summary: 429错误显示友好提示
changes.summary_en: Show clean 429 rate-limit errors
changes.why_matters: 避免用户看到原始JSON报错，提升限流场景下的可读性和排障体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids exposing raw JSON dumps and makes rate-limit failures easier to understand and debug.

changes.raw: Fixed crash on resume when session contains malformed text blocks
changes.summary: 恢复会话崩溃修复
changes.summary_en: Fix crash when resuming sessions
changes.why_matters: 防止恢复历史会话时因坏数据直接崩溃，保障核心工作流稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes when resuming sessions with malformed content, protecting a core workflow.

changes.raw: Fixed `/help` dropping the tab bar, Shortcuts heading, and footer at short terminal heights
changes.summary: /help短屏显示修复
changes.summary_en: Fix /help layout on short terminals
changes.why_matters: 在小终端高度下保持帮助页完整可读，避免关键信息被截断。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the help screen readable on short terminals so key UI elements are not dropped.

changes.raw: Fixed malformed keybinding entry values in `keybindings.json` being silently loaded instead of rejected with a clear error
changes.summary: 无效按键配置拒绝加载
changes.summary_en: Reject malformed keybinding entries
changes.why_matters: 让错误配置尽早暴露并给出明确提示，减少静默失效带来的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Surfaces bad configuration early with a clear error instead of silently accepting it.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` in one project's settings permanently disabling usage metrics for all projects on the machine
changes.summary: 修复项目间遥测泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix per-project traffic setting leakage
changes.why_matters: 避免一个项目的设置影响整机所有项目，防止使用统计被意外永久关闭。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents one project's setting from affecting all projects on the machine and disabling metrics globally.

changes.raw: Fixed washed-out 16-color palette when using Ghostty, Kitty, Alacritty, WezTerm, foot, rio, or Contour over SSH/mosh
changes.summary: SSH终端色彩显示修复
changes.summary_en: Fix washed-out 16-color palettes
changes.why_matters: 改善远程终端中的颜色显示一致性，提升可读性和界面体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves color fidelity over SSH/mosh for a more consistent and readable terminal UI.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash tool suggesting `acceptEdits` permission mode when exiting plan mode would downgrade from a higher permission level
changes.summary: 计划模式权限建议修正
changes.summary_en: Fix permission suggestion on plan exit
changes.why_matters: 避免在权限回退时误导用户接受更高风险的编辑权限，减少权限管理错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misleading permission guidance when exiting plan mode would lower privileges.

signals.title: Issue: Claude Code is unusable for complex engineering tasks with Feb updates
Pro Max 5x quota exhausted in 1.5 hours despite moderate usage
Claude Code Routines
Measuring Claude 4.7's tokenizer costs
Anthropic downgraded cache TTL on March 6th

changes.raw: Added `/team-onboarding` command to generate a teammate ramp-up guide from your local Claude Code usage
changes.summary: 新增团队上手指南命令
changes.summary_en: Add team onboarding guide command
changes.why_matters: 帮助团队快速把个人使用经验转成可共享的入门文档，降低协作上手成本。
changes.why_matters_en: It turns local usage into a shareable ramp-up guide, reducing onboarding friction for teammates.

changes.raw: Added OS CA certificate store trust by default, so enterprise TLS proxies work without extra setup (set `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE=bundled` to use only bundled CAs)
changes.summary: 默认信任系统CA证书
changes.summary_en: Trust OS CA store by default
changes.why_matters: 企业代理和内网 TLS 环境可直接使用，减少证书配置障碍。
changes.why_matters_en: Enterprise TLS proxies work out of the box, avoiding extra certificate setup.

changes.raw: `/ultraplan` and other remote-session features now auto-create a default cloud environment instead of requiring web setup first
changes.summary: 远程会话自动建云环境
changes.summary_en: Auto-create cloud env for remote sessions
changes.why_matters: 用户无需先去网页完成初始化，就能更快开始远程计划和会话功能。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can start remote-session features immediately without pre-creating a cloud environment.

changes.raw: Improved brief mode to retry once when Claude responds with plain text instead of a structured message
changes.summary: 简洁模式自动重试结构化回复
changes.summary_en: Retry brief mode on plain-text replies
changes.why_matters: 减少模型偶发输出格式不对导致的失败，提高简洁模式稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces failures caused by malformed responses and improves brief mode reliability.

changes.raw: Improved focus mode: Claude now writes more self-contained summaries since it knows you only see its final message
changes.summary: 专注模式输出更自洽摘要
changes.summary_en: Make focus mode summaries more self-contained
changes.why_matters: 当用户只看最终消息时，摘要更完整，理解和执行都更容易。
changes.why_matters_en: Since users only see the final message, the summary is easier to understand and act on.

changes.raw: Improved tool-not-available errors to explain why and how to proceed when the model calls a tool that exists but isn't available in the current context
changes.summary: 工具不可用报错更清晰
changes.summary_en: Explain unavailable tool errors better
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快判断是上下文限制还是工具缺失，并采取正确操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly tell whether the issue is context-related or a missing tool and respond appropriately.

changes.raw: Improved rate-limit retry messages to show which limit was hit and when it resets instead of an opaque seconds countdown
changes.summary: 限流重试提示更具体
changes.summary_en: Show clearer rate-limit retry messages
changes.why_matters: 明确是哪种限流以及何时恢复，便于用户决定等待还是调整用法。
changes.why_matters_en: It shows which limit was hit and when it resets, helping users decide whether to wait or adjust usage.

changes.raw: Improved refusal error messages to include the API-provided explanation when available
changes.summary: 拒绝错误显示详细原因
changes.summary_en: Include API refusal details in errors
changes.why_matters: 用户能看到更具体的拒绝原因，减少排查和重复尝试成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get a more specific refusal reason, reducing debugging and repeated retries.

changes.raw: Improved `claude -p --resume <name>` to accept session titles set via `/rename` or `--name`
changes.summary: 恢复会话支持重命名标题
changes.summary_en: Resume sessions by renamed titles
changes.why_matters: 用户可以用更符合记忆的会话名恢复任务，提升会话管理体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can resume work using the session name they remember, improving session management.

changes.raw: Improved settings resilience: an unrecognized hook event name in `settings.json` no longer causes the entire file to be ignored
changes.summary: 配置文件容错更强
changes.summary_en: Make settings parsing more resilient
changes.why_matters: 单个未知 hook 配置不再拖垮整个 settings 文件，减少因小错误导致的功能失效。
changes.why_matters_en: One unknown hook entry no longer breaks the whole settings file, preventing avoidable outages.

changes.raw: Improved plugin hooks from plugins force-enabled by managed settings to run when `allowManagedHooksOnly` is set
changes.summary: 受管插件钩子可正常执行
changes.summary_en: Run managed plugin hooks correctly
changes.why_matters: 在受管设置下，强制启用的插件钩子不会被误拦截，保证策略生效。
changes.why_matters_en: Force-enabled plugin hooks now run under managed settings, ensuring policy enforcement works.

changes.raw: Improved `/plugin` and `claude plugin update` to show a warning when the marketplace could not be refreshed, instead of silently reporting a stale version
changes.summary: 插件更新提示市场刷新失败
changes.summary_en: Warn when plugin marketplace refresh fails
changes.why_matters: 用户不会被静默的过期版本误导，能更快判断更新信息是否可信。
changes.why_matters_en: Users are no longer misled by stale versions and can tell when update data may be outdated.

changes.raw: Improved plan mode to hide the "Refine with Ultraplan" option when the user's org or auth setup can't reach Claude Code on the web
changes.summary: 计划模式按可用性隐藏选项
changes.summary_en: Hide Ultraplan when web access is unavailable
changes.why_matters: 避免展示用户当前无法使用的入口，减少困惑和无效点击。
changes.why_matters_en: It avoids showing an option the user cannot access, reducing confusion and dead ends.

changes.raw: Improved beta tracing to honor `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`, `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS`, and `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT`; sensitive span attributes are no longer emitted unless opted in
changes.summary: 遥测默认减少敏感日志
changes.summary_en: Reduce sensitive tracing data by default
changes.why_matters: 默认不再发送敏感提示和工具内容，降低隐私与合规风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Sensitive prompts and tool content are no longer emitted by default, reducing privacy and compliance risk.

changes.raw: Improved SDK `query()` to clean up subprocess and temp files when consumers `break` from `for await` or use `await using`
changes.summary: SDK中断时自动清理资源
changes.summary_en: Clean up SDK resources on early exit
changes.why_matters: 消费者提前退出迭代时也能释放子进程和临时文件，避免资源泄漏。
changes.why_matters_en: Subprocesses and temp files are cleaned up even on early exit, preventing resource leaks.

changes.raw: Fixed a command injection vulnerability in the POSIX `which` fallback used by LSP binary detection
changes.summary: 修复LSP二进制注入漏洞
changes.summary_en: Fix command injection in LSP binary lookup
changes.why_matters: 这可以防止通过二进制检测路径执行恶意命令，避免本地代码执行风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents malicious command execution during binary detection and reduces local code execution risk.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak where long sessions retained dozens of historical copies of the message list in the virtual scroller
changes.summary: 修复长会话内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix memory leak in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 这能减少长时间使用时的内存占用和卡顿，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces memory growth and lag in long-running sessions, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume`/`--continue` losing conversation context on large sessions when the loader anchored on a dead-end branch instead of the live conversation
changes.summary: 修复续会丢失上下文
changes.summary_en: Fix context loss on resume/continue
changes.why_matters: 这能让大会话恢复到正确的对话状态，避免续会后需要重新说明背景。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores the correct conversation state for large sessions and avoids losing context after resume.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` chain recovery bridging into an unrelated subagent conversation when a subagent message landed near a main-chain write gap
changes.summary: 修复续会串入无关子代理
changes.summary_en: Fix resume chain crossing into wrong subagent
changes.why_matters: 这能防止恢复链错误拼接到别的子代理对话，避免上下文污染。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents resume chains from merging into unrelated subagent conversations and avoids context corruption.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash on `--resume` when a persisted Edit/Write tool result was missing its `file_path`
changes.summary: 修复续会时编辑结果缺失崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix resume crash on missing file_path
changes.why_matters: 这能避免恢复历史会话时直接崩溃，提高对损坏记录的容错性。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids crashes when resuming historical sessions and improves tolerance for corrupted records.

changes.raw: Fixed a hardcoded 5-minute request timeout that aborted slow backends (local LLMs, extended thinking, slow gateways) regardless of `API_TIMEOUT_MS`
changes.summary: 修复慢后端超时被误杀
changes.summary_en: Fix hardcoded timeout killing slow backends
changes.why_matters: 这让本地模型和慢网关能按配置运行，避免长任务被错误中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets slow backends follow the configured timeout instead of being aborted too early.

changes.raw: Fixed `permissions.deny` rules not overriding a PreToolUse hook's `permissionDecision: "ask"` — previously the hook could downgrade a deny into a prompt
changes.summary: 修复拒绝权限被提示覆盖
changes.summary_en: Fix deny rules overriding ask prompts
changes.why_matters: 这确保明确拒绝规则始终生效，防止本应禁止的操作被意外放行。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures explicit deny rules always win and prevents forbidden actions from being accidentally allowed.

changes.raw: Fixed `--setting-sources` without `user` causing background cleanup to ignore `cleanupPeriodDays` and delete conversation history older than 30 days
changes.summary: 修复历史清理误删问题
changes.summary_en: Fix cleanup ignoring retention settings
changes.why_matters: 这能按用户保留策略清理历史，避免过度删除会话记录。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes cleanup respect retention settings and prevents over-deleting conversation history.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock SigV4 authentication failing with 403 when `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `apiKeyHelper`, or `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` set an Authorization header
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock认证403失败
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock SigV4 auth 403 failures
changes.why_matters: 这恢复了带自定义认证头的 Bedrock 连接，避免请求被拒绝。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores Bedrock connectivity when custom auth headers are present and prevents rejected requests.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude -w <name>` failing with "already exists" after a previous session's worktree cleanup left a stale directory
changes.summary: 修复工作树残留导致创建失败
changes.summary_en: Fix stale worktree blocking new session
changes.why_matters: 这避免旧目录残留阻止新工作树创建，提升工作流连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents stale directories from blocking new worktree creation and keeps workflows moving.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents not inheriting MCP tools from dynamically-injected servers
changes.summary: 修复子代理继承MCP工具失败
changes.summary_en: Fix subagents missing injected MCP tools
changes.why_matters: 这让子代理能使用动态注入的工具，增强多工具协作能力。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets subagents use dynamically injected tools and improves multi-tool collaboration.

changes.raw: Fixed sub-agents running in isolated worktrees being denied Read/Edit access to files inside their own worktree
changes.summary: 修复子代理工作树读写被拒
changes.summary_en: Fix subagents denied access to own worktree
changes.why_matters: 这让子代理能正常访问自己的隔离工作树，避免任务执行受阻。
changes.why_matters_en: This allows subagents to access their isolated worktrees and prevents task execution from being blocked.

changes.raw: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `mktemp: No such file or directory` after a fresh boot
changes.summary: 修复沙箱Bash缺少mktemp
changes.summary_en: Fix sandboxed Bash mktemp path failure
changes.why_matters: 这避免新启动环境下基础命令失败，提升沙箱可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents basic command failures in fresh environments and improves sandbox reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude mcp serve` tool calls failing with "Tool execution failed" in MCP clients that validate `outputSchema`
changes.summary: 修复MCP工具输出校验失败
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP tool calls failing outputSchema checks
changes.why_matters: 这提高了与严格校验的 MCP 客户端兼容性，减少工具调用失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves compatibility with strict MCP clients and reduces tool call failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `RemoteTrigger` tool's `run` action sending an empty body and being rejected by the server
changes.summary: 修复RemoteTrigger空请求体
changes.summary_en: Fix RemoteTrigger run sending empty body
changes.why_matters: 这让远程触发操作能被服务器正确接受，恢复自动化调用链路。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets remote trigger actions be accepted by the server and restores the automation path.

changes.raw: Fixed several `/resume` picker issues: narrow default view hiding sessions from other projects, unreachable preview on Windows Terminal, incorrect cwd in worktrees, session-not-found errors not surfacing in stderr, terminal title not being set, and resume hint overlapping the prompt input
changes.summary: 修复 /resume 选择器多项问题
changes.summary_en: Fix multiple /resume picker issues
changes.why_matters: 让会话恢复更可靠，避免用户找不到历史会话或在不同终端/工作区中恢复失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes session resumption more reliable and prevents users from losing access to prior sessions across terminals and worktrees.

changes.raw: Fixed Grep tool ENOENT when the embedded ripgrep binary path becomes stale (VS Code extension auto-update, macOS App Translocation); now falls back to system `rg` and self-heals mid-session
changes.summary: Grep 失效时自动回退系统 rg
changes.summary_en: Fallback to system rg when embedded one breaks
changes.why_matters: 当内置 ripgrep 路径失效时仍能继续搜索，减少扩展更新或 macOS 转移导致的中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Search keeps working even if the embedded ripgrep path goes stale, reducing interruptions from updates or macOS translocation.

changes.raw: Fixed `/btw` writing a copy of the entire conversation to disk on every use
changes.summary: /btw 不再重复写整段对话
changes.summary_en: /btw no longer writes full convo each time
changes.why_matters: 避免频繁写入造成磁盘浪费和性能开销。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids unnecessary disk writes and performance overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed `/context` Free space and Messages breakdown disagreeing with the header percentage
changes.summary: /context 空间统计更一致
changes.summary_en: /context space stats now match header
changes.why_matters: 让上下文剩余空间显示更准确，减少用户对可用额度的误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes remaining context display more accurate and reduces confusion about available space.

changes.raw: Fixed several plugin issues: slash commands resolving to the wrong plugin with duplicate `name:` frontmatter, `/plugin update` failing with `ENAMETOOLONG`, Discover showing already-installed plugins, directory-source plugins loading from a stale version cache, and skills not honoring `context: fork` and `agent` frontmatter fields
changes.summary: 修复插件解析与更新问题
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin resolution and update issues
changes.why_matters: 提升插件、技能和命令加载的正确性，避免重复安装、更新失败和旧缓存导致的错误行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves correctness of plugin, skill, and command loading, avoiding duplicate installs, update failures, and stale-cache bugs.

changes.raw: Fixed the `/mcp` menu offering OAuth-specific actions for MCP servers configured with `headersHelper`; Reconnect is now offered instead to re-invoke the helper script
changes.summary: /mcp 菜单改为重连助手脚本
changes.summary_en: /mcp now offers reconnect for helper-based servers
changes.why_matters: 对使用 headersHelper 的 MCP 服务器提供正确操作，避免错误地暴露 OAuth 流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows the right action for MCP servers using headersHelper and avoids exposing the wrong OAuth flow.

changes.raw: Fixed `ctrl+]`, `ctrl+\`, and `ctrl+^` keybindings not firing in terminals that send raw C0 control bytes (Terminal.app, default iTerm2, xterm)
changes.summary: 修复终端控制键绑定失效
changes.summary_en: Fix control keybindings in raw-byte terminals
changes.why_matters: 让常用终端快捷键在更多终端中正常工作，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores common terminal shortcuts across more terminal emulators, improving usability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/login` OAuth URL rendering with padding that prevented clean mouse selection
changes.summary: /login OAuth 链接更易选中
changes.summary_en: /login OAuth URL is easier to select
changes.why_matters: 改善登录授权链接的鼠标选择体验，减少复制链接时的误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves mouse selection of the authorization link and reduces copy/paste mistakes.

changes.raw: Fixed rendering issues: flicker in non-fullscreen mode when content above the visible area changed, terminal scrollback being wiped during long sessions in non-fullscreen mode, and mouse-scroll escape sequences occasionally leaking into the prompt as text
changes.summary: 修复非全屏渲染与滚动问题
changes.summary_en: Fix non-fullscreen rendering and scroll issues
changes.why_matters: 减少闪烁、滚动回退丢失和文本串入提示符的问题，显著提升长会话稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces flicker, lost scrollback, and prompt corruption, significantly improving long-session stability.

changes.raw: Fixed crash when `settings.json` env values are numbers instead of strings
changes.summary: 修复数字类型 env 导致崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash from numeric env values
changes.why_matters: 避免配置格式不一致直接导致 CLI 崩溃，提升启动可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents malformed config values from crashing the CLI and improves startup reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed in-app settings writes (e.g. `/add-dir --remember`, `/config`) not refreshing the in-memory snapshot, preventing removed directories from being revoked mid-session
changes.summary: 设置变更后立即刷新内存状态
changes.summary_en: Refresh in-memory settings after writes
changes.why_matters: 确保会话中移除的目录等设置能及时生效，避免权限或上下文状态不同步。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures settings changes take effect immediately, preventing stale permissions or context state during a session.

changes.raw: Fixed custom keybindings (`~/.claude/keybindings.json`) not loading on Bedrock, Vertex, and other third-party providers
changes.summary: 第三方模型也能加载自定义按键
changes.summary_en: Custom keybindings now load on all providers
changes.why_matters: 让 Bedrock、Vertex 等提供商也能使用自定义快捷键，保持一致的操作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets Bedrock, Vertex, and other providers use custom shortcuts for a consistent experience.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude --continue -p` not correctly continuing sessions created by `-p` or the SDK
changes.summary: 继续旧会话更准确
changes.summary_en: Continue sessions more accurately
changes.why_matters: 确保命令行和 SDK 创建的会话都能被正确续接，减少上下文丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures sessions created by the CLI or SDK can be resumed correctly, reducing context loss.

changes.raw: Fixed several Remote Control issues: worktrees removed on session crash, connection failures not persisting in the transcript, spurious "Disconnected" indicator in brief mode for local sessions, and `/remote-control` failing over SSH when only `CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID` is set
changes.summary: 修复 Remote Control 多项问题
changes.summary_en: Fix multiple Remote Control issues
changes.why_matters: 提升远程控制在崩溃、断连和 SSH 场景下的可靠性，避免工作树和会话状态丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves Remote Control reliability across crashes, disconnects, and SSH usage, preventing loss of worktrees and session state.

changes.raw: Fixed `/insights` sometimes omitting the report file link from its response
changes.summary: /insights 更稳定返回报告链接
changes.summary_en: /insights now reliably includes report link
changes.why_matters: 让用户更容易打开生成的分析报告，减少结果可发现性问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes it easier for users to open the generated report and improves result discoverability.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed the file attachment below the chat input not clearing when the last editor tab is closed
changes.summary: 关闭最后标签页后清除附件
changes.summary_en: Clear file attachment when last tab closes
changes.why_matters: 避免聊天输入下方残留过期附件，减少误提交和界面混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents stale attachments from lingering under the chat input, reducing confusion and accidental submission.

signals.title: Issue: Claude Code is unusable for complex engineering tasks with Feb updates
Tell HN: Anthropic no longer allowing Claude Code subscriptions to use OpenClaw
Pro Max 5x quota exhausted in 1.5 hours despite moderate usage
Claude Code Routines
Measuring Claude 4.7's tokenizer costs

changes.raw: Added interactive Google Vertex AI setup wizard accessible from the login screen when selecting "3rd-party platform", guiding you through GCP authentication, project and region configuration, credential verification, and model pinning
changes.summary: Vertex AI登录向导
changes.summary_en: Interactive Vertex AI setup wizard
changes.why_matters: 让用户能在登录时更顺畅地完成 Vertex AI 接入、认证和模型配置，降低上手门槛。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes Vertex AI onboarding, auth, and model setup much easier from the login flow.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE` env var: when set, Edit/Write/NotebookEdit fail on read-only files with a `p4 edit` hint instead of silently overwriting them
changes.summary: 只读文件防误写保护
changes.summary_en: Fail on read-only files in Perforce mode
changes.why_matters: 避免在 Perforce 只读文件上静默覆盖，减少误改和版本控制冲突风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents silent overwrites of read-only Perforce files and reduces version-control mistakes.

changes.raw: Added Monitor tool for streaming events from background scripts
changes.summary: 新增后台脚本事件监控
changes.summary_en: Monitor tool for background script events
changes.why_matters: 让用户可以实时查看后台脚本事件，提升可观测性和调试效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves observability and debugging by streaming events from background scripts.

changes.raw: Added subprocess sandboxing with PID namespace isolation on Linux when `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` is set, and `CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS` env var to limit per-session script invocations
changes.summary: Linux脚本沙箱隔离
changes.summary_en: Linux subprocess sandboxing and caps
changes.why_matters: 通过进程隔离和调用次数限制降低脚本执行的越权与滥用风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces abuse and privilege-risk from script execution through isolation and invocation limits.

changes.raw: Added `--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections` flag to print mode for improved cross-user prompt caching
changes.summary: 优化打印模式缓存
changes.summary_en: Improve print-mode prompt caching
changes.why_matters: 减少动态提示词差异，提升跨用户缓存命中率和响应效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces prompt variability to improve cross-user cache hits and efficiency.

changes.raw: Added `workspace.git_worktree` to the status line JSON input, set whenever the current directory is inside a linked git worktree
changes.summary: 工作树状态信息
changes.summary_en: Expose git worktree status info
changes.why_matters: 让状态栏更准确地反映当前是否处于关联工作树中，便于上下文判断。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes the status line more accurate by showing when the current directory is in a linked worktree.

changes.raw: Added W3C `TRACEPARENT` env var to Bash tool subprocesses when OTEL tracing is enabled, so child-process spans correctly parent to Claude Code's trace tree
changes.summary: 子进程链路追踪传递
changes.summary_en: Propagate traceparent to Bash subprocesses
changes.why_matters: 让子进程的链路追踪能正确关联到主会话，便于排查和性能分析。
changes.why_matters_en: It correctly links child-process traces to the main session for debugging and performance analysis.

changes.raw: LSP: Claude Code now identifies itself to language servers via `clientInfo` in the initialize request
changes.summary: 语言服务器身份识别
changes.summary_en: Identify Claude Code to language servers
changes.why_matters: 帮助语言服务器识别客户端来源，提升兼容性和诊断能力。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps language servers recognize the client for better compatibility and diagnostics.

changes.raw: Fixed a Bash tool permission bypass where a backslash-escaped flag could be auto-allowed as read-only and lead to arbitrary code execution
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 逃逸提权漏洞
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash permission bypass via escaped flags
changes.why_matters: 修复可导致任意代码执行的权限绕过漏洞，直接提升执行安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: It fixes a permission bypass that could lead to arbitrary code execution, directly improving safety.

changes.raw: Fixed compound Bash commands bypassing forced permission prompts for safety checks and explicit ask rules in auto and bypass-permissions modes
changes.summary: 修复复合命令绕过提示
changes.summary_en: Fix compound Bash prompt bypass
changes.why_matters: 防止复合 Bash 命令绕过强制确认，避免在自动模式下误执行危险操作。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents compound Bash commands from bypassing required prompts and avoids unsafe auto-execution.

changes.raw: Fixed read-only commands with env-var prefixes not prompting unless the var is known-safe (`LANG`, `TZ`, `NO_COLOR`, etc.)
changes.summary: 环境变量前缀提示修复
changes.summary_en: Prompt on unsafe env-var prefixes
changes.why_matters: 避免未识别的环境变量前缀被静默放行，减少命令注入和误执行风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It stops unknown env-var prefixes from being silently allowed, reducing injection and misuse risk.

changes.raw: Fixed redirects to `/dev/tcp/...` or `/dev/udp/...` not prompting instead of auto-allowing
changes.summary: 修复TCP/UDP重定向绕过
changes.summary_en: Fix /dev/tcp and /dev/udp redirect bypass
changes.why_matters: 阻止通过特殊重定向绕过权限提示，避免网络相关的危险命令被自动允许。
changes.why_matters_en: It blocks permission bypasses via special redirects and prevents unsafe network commands from auto-allowing.

changes.raw: Fixed stalled streaming responses timing out instead of falling back to non-streaming mode
changes.summary: 流式响应超时回退
changes.summary_en: Fallback to non-streaming on stalled streams
changes.why_matters: 当流式输出卡住时能自动切换到非流式模式，减少请求失败和等待。
changes.why_matters_en: It falls back to non-streaming when streams stall, reducing failures and wait time.

changes.raw: Fixed 429 retries burning all attempts in ~13s when the server returns a small `Retry-After` — exponential backoff now applies as a minimum
changes.summary: 429重试退避优化
changes.summary_en: Improve 429 retry backoff
changes.why_matters: 避免在短 Retry-After 场景下过快耗尽重试次数，提高请求恢复成功率。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents retries from being exhausted too quickly and improves recovery from rate limits.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP OAuth `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` config override not being honored on token refresh after restart, affecting ADFS and similar IdPs
changes.summary: MCP OAuth刷新配置修复
changes.summary_en: Honor MCP OAuth metadata override on refresh
changes.why_matters: 确保重启后刷新令牌仍使用正确的身份提供方配置，避免 ADFS 等登录失败。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures token refresh uses the correct IdP config after restart, preventing ADFS-like login failures.

changes.raw: Fixed capital letters being dropped to lowercase on xterm and VS Code integrated terminal when the kitty keyboard protocol is active
changes.summary: 修复终端大小写丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix uppercase letters preserved in terminals
changes.why_matters: 避免在特定终端和键盘协议下输入内容被错误改写，保证代码和命令准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents typed input from being altered in specific terminals, keeping commands and code accurate.

changes.raw: Fixed macOS text replacements deleting the trigger word instead of inserting the substitution
changes.summary: 修复 macOS 文本替换
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS text replacement insertion
changes.why_matters: 确保系统文本替换能正确插入替换内容，避免编辑时丢失原始触发词以外的预期结果。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures macOS text replacements insert the intended substitution correctly during editing.

changes.raw: Fixed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` being silently downgraded to accept-edits mode after approving a write to a protected path via Bash
changes.summary: 修复危险跳过权限降级
changes.summary_en: Fix skip-permissions mode downgrade
changes.why_matters: 这会防止高权限模式在写入受保护路径后被意外降级，避免用户误以为仍处于更宽松的安全状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents a high-trust mode from silently downgrading after protected writes, avoiding unsafe permission assumptions.

changes.raw: Fixed managed-settings allow rules remaining active after an admin removed them, until process restart
changes.summary: 修复管理权限规则残留
changes.summary_en: Fix stale managed allow rules
changes.why_matters: 管理员移除规则后应立即生效，否则会留下意外的持续访问权限。
changes.why_matters_en: Removed admin rules should stop applying immediately to avoid lingering unintended access.

changes.raw: Fixed `permissions.additionalDirectories` changes not applying mid-session — removed directories lose access immediately and added ones work without restart
changes.summary: 修复目录权限即时生效
changes.summary_en: Make additionalDirectories update live
changes.why_matters: 用户修改目录白名单后无需重启即可立即获得或失去访问权限，提升可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: Directory allowlist changes now apply immediately without restart, improving control and predictability.

changes.raw: Fixed removing a directory from `additionalDirectories` revoking access to the same directory passed via `--add-dir`
changes.summary: 修复额外目录移除联动
changes.summary_en: Fix add-dir and additionalDirectories sync
changes.why_matters: 避免同一目录因不同配置入口不同步而出现权限残留或误撤销。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents inconsistent access when the same directory is configured through multiple permission paths.

changes.raw: Fixed `Bash(cmd:*)` and `Bash(git commit *)` wildcard permission rules failing to match commands with extra spaces or tabs
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 通配权限匹配
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash wildcard permission matching
changes.why_matters: 让命令权限规则能正确匹配带多余空格或制表符的命令，减少误拦截。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures Bash permission rules match commands with extra whitespace, reducing false denials.

changes.raw: Fixed `Bash(...)` deny rules being downgraded to a prompt for piped commands that mix `cd` with other segments
changes.summary: 修复管道 Bash 拒绝规则
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash deny rules for piped commands
changes.why_matters: 防止本应被拒绝的复合管道命令被降级为询问，从而绕过预期限制。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents denied piped commands from being downgraded to prompts, preserving intended restrictions.

changes.raw: Fixed false Bash permission prompts for `cut -d /`, `paste -d /`, `column -s /`, `awk '{print $1}' file`, and filenames containing `%`
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 误报权限提示
changes.summary_en: Fix false Bash permission prompts
changes.why_matters: 减少常见命令和特殊字符导致的误提示，降低工作流中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces spurious permission prompts from common commands and special characters, improving flow.

changes.raw: Fixed permission rules with names matching JavaScript prototype properties (e.g. `toString`) causing `settings.json` to be silently ignored
changes.summary: 修复 settings.json 被忽略
changes.summary_en: Fix settings.json being ignored
changes.why_matters: 避免某些规则名触发 JavaScript 原型污染式冲突，确保配置能被正确读取。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents prototype-property name collisions from causing configuration to be silently ignored.

changes.raw: Fixed agent team members not inheriting the leader's permission mode when using `--dangerously-skip-permissions`
changes.summary: 修复团队权限模式继承
changes.summary_en: Fix team permission mode inheritance
changes.why_matters: 让协作成员与领导者保持一致的权限策略，避免团队中出现意外的安全差异。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps team members aligned with the leader's permission mode, avoiding inconsistent security behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash in fullscreen mode when hovering over MCP tool results
changes.summary: 修复全屏悬停崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix fullscreen hover crash
changes.why_matters: 避免在查看 MCP 工具结果时应用崩溃，提升全屏模式稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes while hovering MCP tool results in fullscreen mode, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed copying wrapped URLs in fullscreen mode inserting spaces at line breaks
changes.summary: 修复全屏复制 URL 断行
changes.summary_en: Fix wrapped URL copy in fullscreen
changes.why_matters: 复制链接时不会把换行处的空格带进去，避免粘贴后 URL 失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps copied wrapped URLs intact so pasted links do not break.

changes.raw: Fixed file-edit diffs disappearing from the UI on `--resume` when the edited file was larger than 10KB
changes.summary: 修复大文件 diff 丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix missing diffs on resume
changes.why_matters: 恢复会话时仍能看到大文件的编辑差异，便于继续审查和修改。
changes.why_matters_en: Preserves diffs for larger files after resume so edits remain reviewable.

changes.raw: Fixed several `/resume` picker issues: `--resume <name>` opening uneditable, filter reload wiping search state, empty list swallowing arrow keys, cross-project staleness, and transient task-status text replacing conversation summaries
changes.summary: 修复 /resume 选择器问题
changes.summary_en: Fix multiple /resume picker issues
changes.why_matters: 让恢复会话更可靠，避免搜索状态丢失、列表卡死和摘要被临时状态覆盖。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes session resume more reliable by fixing search loss, navigation issues, and stale summaries.

changes.raw: Fixed `/export` not honoring absolute paths and `~`, and silently rewriting user-supplied extensions to `.txt`
changes.summary: 修复导出路径与扩展名
changes.summary_en: Fix /export path and extension handling
changes.why_matters: 用户导出内容时会得到错误路径或被强制改成 .txt，影响文件保存与后续使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Users could get wrong paths or forced .txt extensions when exporting, which breaks file saving and reuse.

changes.raw: Fixed `/effort max` being denied for unknown or future model IDs
changes.summary: 修复未知模型努力级别拒绝
changes.summary_en: Allow /effort max on unknown models
changes.why_matters: 未知或新模型不应被误拦截，否则会限制用户在新模型上的正常配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Unknown or future models should not be blocked, or users cannot configure new models normally.

changes.raw: Fixed slash command picker breaking when a plugin's frontmatter `name` is a YAML boolean keyword
changes.summary: 修复插件命令选择器解析
changes.summary_en: Fix slash command picker YAML name parsing
changes.why_matters: 插件命令名若被误判为布尔值，会导致命令选择器失效，影响插件可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: If a plugin command name is misread as a boolean, the command picker can break and make plugins unusable.

changes.raw: Fixed rate-limit upsell text being hidden after message remounts
changes.summary: 修复限流提示重挂载隐藏
changes.summary_en: Keep rate-limit upsell visible after remount
changes.why_matters: 提示文案不应在界面重挂载后消失，否则用户可能错过限流升级信息。
changes.why_matters_en: The upsell text should not disappear after remounts, or users may miss rate-limit upgrade info.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tools with `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` not bypassing the token-based persist layer
changes.summary: 修复MCP结果大小绕过持久层
changes.summary_en: Bypass token persistence for large MCP results
changes.why_matters: 大结果应按配置直接返回，避免被错误截断或重复持久化影响工具输出。
changes.why_matters_en: Large results should return as configured to avoid incorrect truncation or extra persistence overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode leaking dozens of space characters into the input when re-holding the push-to-talk key while the previous transcript is still processing
changes.summary: 修复语音模式输入空格泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix stray spaces in voice mode input
changes.why_matters: 多余空格会污染用户输入，影响提示词质量和后续命令解析。
changes.why_matters_en: Extra spaces pollute user input and can hurt prompt quality and command parsing.

changes.raw: Fixed `DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER` not fully suppressing the npm registry version check and symlink modification on npm-based installs
changes.summary: 修复禁用自动更新未生效
changes.summary_en: Fully honor DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER
changes.why_matters: 禁用自动更新应彻底生效，避免在受控环境中发生意外联网或文件修改。
changes.why_matters_en: Disabling auto-updates must fully work to prevent unexpected network access or file changes in controlled environments.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak where Remote Control permission handler entries were retained for the lifetime of the session
changes.summary: 修复远程控制权限内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix Remote Control permission memory leak
changes.why_matters: 会话期间持续保留权限记录会增加内存占用，长期运行时可能导致性能下降。
changes.why_matters_en: Retaining permission records for the whole session increases memory use and can hurt long-running performance.

changes.raw: Fixed background subagents that fail with an error not reporting partial progress to the parent agent
changes.summary: 子代理失败也回传部分进度
changes.summary_en: Report partial progress from failed subagents
changes.why_matters: 即使子代理失败，父代理也能利用已完成工作，减少重复劳动并提升协作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Even when a subagent fails, the parent can reuse completed work, reducing rework and improving coordination.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt-type Stop/SubagentStop hooks failing on long sessions, and hook evaluator API errors showing "JSON validation failed" instead of the real message
changes.summary: 修复长会话Hook与报错提示
changes.summary_en: Fix long-session hooks and real error messages
changes.why_matters: 长会话中的钩子失败会中断自动化流程，而真实错误信息有助于快速定位问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Hook failures in long sessions can break automation, and real errors help users diagnose issues quickly.

changes.raw: Fixed feedback survey rendering when dismissed
changes.summary: 修复反馈问卷关闭后渲染
changes.summary_en: Fix feedback survey rendering after dismiss
changes.why_matters: 关闭问卷后界面仍应正常渲染，避免影响后续使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: The UI should still render correctly after dismissing the survey, so normal use is not disrupted.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash `grep -f FILE` / `rg -f FILE` not prompting when reading a pattern file outside the working directory
changes.summary: 修复外部模式文件提示缺失
changes.summary_en: Prompt for pattern files outside cwd
changes.why_matters: 读取工作目录外的模式文件时应提示用户，避免意外访问不期望的文件。
changes.why_matters_en: Users should be prompted when reading pattern files outside the working directory to avoid unexpected file access.

changes.raw: Fixed stale subagent worktree cleanup removing worktrees that contain untracked files
changes.summary: 修复子代理工作树误删
changes.summary_en: Avoid deleting worktrees with untracked files
changes.why_matters: 误删包含未跟踪文件的工作树会造成数据丢失，影响开发安全。
changes.why_matters_en: Deleting worktrees that contain untracked files can cause data loss and harm developer safety.

changes.raw: Fixed `sandbox.network.allowMachLookup` not taking effect on macOS
changes.summary: 修复macOS沙箱网络权限
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS sandbox network allowMachLookup
changes.why_matters: 沙箱网络权限未生效会导致在 macOS 上无法正常访问所需系统服务。
changes.why_matters_en: If the sandbox network permission does not take effect, required system services may be inaccessible on macOS.

changes.raw: Improved `/resume` filter hint labels and added project/worktree/branch names in the filter indicator
changes.summary: 优化恢复筛选提示与标识
changes.summary_en: Improve /resume filter hints and labels
changes.why_matters: 更清晰的筛选提示和上下文标识能帮助用户更快找到要恢复的会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearer filter hints and context labels help users find the right session to resume faster.

changes.raw: Improved footer indicators (Focus, notifications) to stay on the mode-indicator row instead of wrapping at narrow terminal widths
changes.summary: 窄屏页脚指示不再换行
changes.summary_en: Footer indicators stay on one row
changes.why_matters: 在窄终端下界面更稳定，避免页脚信息被挤乱影响操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the UI stable on narrow terminals so footer info remains readable.

changes.raw: Improved `/agents` with a tabbed layout: a Running tab shows live subagents, and the Library tab adds Run agent and View running instance actions
changes.summary: /agents 增加运行与库视图
changes.summary_en: /agents adds Running and Library tabs
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更直观地查看运行中的子代理并直接执行相关操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can inspect live subagents and act on them more directly.

changes.raw: Improved `/reload-plugins` to pick up plugin-provided skills without requiring a restart
changes.summary: 重载插件可立即获取技能
changes.summary_en: Reload plugins picks up new skills
changes.why_matters: 插件新增的技能无需重启即可生效，提升迭代效率。
changes.why_matters_en: New plugin-provided skills take effect without restarting, speeding iteration.

changes.raw: Improved Accept Edits mode to auto-approve filesystem commands prefixed with safe env vars or process wrappers
changes.summary: 安全环境命令可自动放行
changes.summary_en: Accept Edits auto-approves safe env commands
changes.why_matters: 减少对明显安全命令的重复确认，让编辑流程更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces unnecessary confirmations for clearly safe commands and streamlines editing.

changes.raw: Improved Vim mode: `j`/`k` in NORMAL mode now navigate history and select the footer pill at the input boundary
changes.summary: Vim 模式支持历史与页脚切换
changes.summary_en: Vim mode j/k navigate history and footer
changes.why_matters: 提升键盘操作连贯性，让熟悉 Vim 的用户更高效地使用 CLI。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves keyboard flow for Vim users, making the CLI faster to use.

changes.raw: Improved hook errors in the transcript to include the first line of stderr for self-diagnosis without `--debug`
changes.summary: Hook 报错显示首行便于排查
changes.summary_en: Hook errors show first stderr line
changes.why_matters: 即使不启用调试模式，也能更快定位 hook 失败原因。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes hook failures easier to diagnose even without debug mode.

changes.raw: Improved OTEL tracing: interaction spans now correctly wrap full turns under concurrent SDK calls, and headless turns end spans per-turn
changes.summary: OTEL 跟踪覆盖完整会话
changes.summary_en: OTEL spans now cover full turns
changes.why_matters: 并发调用和无头会话的链路追踪更准确，便于监控与排障。
changes.why_matters_en: Tracing is more accurate for concurrent and headless sessions, improving observability.

changes.raw: Improved transcript entries to carry final token usage instead of streaming placeholders
changes.summary: 转录记录最终 token 用量
changes.summary_en: Transcript records final token usage
changes.why_matters: 日志中的用量数据更准确，便于成本分析和审计。
changes.why_matters_en: Usage data in logs is now accurate for cost analysis and auditing.

changes.raw: Updated the `/claude-api` skill to cover Managed Agents alongside Claude API
changes.summary: /claude-api 兼容 Managed Agents
changes.summary_en: /claude-api skill now covers Managed Agents
changes.why_matters: 技能说明更完整，帮助用户正确使用相关 API 能力。
changes.why_matters_en: The skill guidance is more complete, helping users use the API correctly.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed false-positive "requires git-bash" error on Windows when `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` is set or Git is installed at a default location
changes.summary: Windows 下 Git Bash 检测修正
changes.summary_en: Fix false Git Bash requirement on Windows
changes.why_matters: 减少 Windows 用户的误报，避免不必要的环境配置阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents false positives on Windows and avoids unnecessary setup blockers.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` to honor `DISABLE_COMPACT` when it is set.
changes.summary: 禁用压缩时遵循上下文上限
changes.summary_en: Max context respects DISABLE_COMPACT
changes.why_matters: 当用户明确关闭压缩时，相关上下文策略会保持一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Context handling now stays consistent when the user disables compaction.

changes.raw: Dropped `/compact` hints when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set.
changes.summary: 禁用压缩时不再提示压缩
changes.summary_en: Drop /compact hints when disabled
changes.why_matters: 避免在已关闭压缩功能时出现误导性提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids misleading compaction prompts when the feature is disabled.

signals.title: Issue: Claude Code is unusable for complex engineering tasks with Feb updates
Tell HN: Anthropic no longer allowing Claude Code subscriptions to use OpenClaw
Pro Max 5x quota exhausted in 1.5 hours despite moderate usage
Claude Code Routines
Anthropic downgraded cache TTL on March 6th

changes.raw: Added focus view toggle (`Ctrl+O`) in `NO_FLICKER` mode showing prompt, one-line tool summary with edit diffstats, and final response
changes.summary: 新增专注视图切换
changes.summary_en: Added focus view toggle
changes.why_matters: 让用户在无闪烁模式下更清楚地查看提示、工具摘要和最终回复，提升长任务可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes long-running sessions easier to read by showing the prompt, tool summary, and final response in no-flicker mode.

changes.raw: Added `refreshInterval` status line setting to re-run the status line command every N seconds
changes.summary: 状态栏支持定时刷新
changes.summary_en: Status line can refresh periodically
changes.why_matters: 状态信息可按固定间隔自动更新，适合展示会变化的环境或上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: Status information can update automatically at a fixed interval, which is useful for dynamic environments.

changes.raw: Added `workspace.git_worktree` to the status line JSON input, set when the current directory is inside a linked git worktree
changes.summary: 状态栏显示工作树信息
changes.summary_en: Status line shows git worktree info
changes.why_matters: 让状态栏能识别当前是否在 git worktree 中，便于工具和脚本做更准确的上下文展示。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets the status line detect linked git worktrees so tools and scripts can present context more accurately.

changes.raw: Added `● N running` indicator in `/agents` next to agent types with live subagent instances
changes.summary: Agents 显示运行中数量
changes.summary_en: Agents show live running count
changes.why_matters: 用户能直接看到各类子代理的实时数量，更容易判断并行进度和负载。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see live subagent counts at a glance, making parallel progress and load easier to understand.

changes.raw: Added syntax highlighting for Cedar policy files (`.cedar`, `.cedarpolicy`)
changes.summary: 新增 Cedar 语法高亮
changes.summary_en: Added Cedar syntax highlighting
changes.why_matters: 提升 Cedar 策略文件的可读性和编辑体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves readability and editing experience for Cedar policy files.

changes.raw: Fixed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` being silently downgraded to accept-edits mode after approving a write to a protected path
changes.summary: 修复跳过权限模式降级
changes.summary_en: Fixed permission-skip mode downgrade
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在选择跳过权限检查后被悄悄降级为更严格模式，防止意外阻断或权限行为不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents the tool from silently downgrading a skip-permissions session into a stricter mode, avoiding unexpected blocking and inconsistent permission behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed and hardened Bash tool permissions, tightening checks around env-var prefixes and network redirects, and reducing false prompts on common commands
changes.summary: 强化 Bash 工具权限检查
changes.summary_en: Hardened Bash tool permission checks
changes.why_matters: 减少 Bash 命令误放行和误提示，降低环境变量与网络重定向带来的安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces false approvals and prompts while lowering security risk from env-var prefixes and network redirects.

changes.raw: Fixed permission rules with names matching JavaScript prototype properties (e.g. `toString`) causing `settings.json` to be silently ignored
changes.summary: 修复同名规则被忽略
changes.summary_en: Fixed rules matching prototype names
changes.why_matters: 确保像 toString 这类规则名不会导致 settings.json 被静默忽略，避免权限配置失效。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures rule names like toString do not cause settings.json to be silently ignored, preventing broken permission config.

changes.raw: Fixed managed-settings allow rules remaining active after an admin removed them until process restart
changes.summary: 管理员移除规则立即生效
changes.summary_en: Managed settings removals now apply
changes.why_matters: 管理员删除的允许规则不再需要重启才失效，权限收回更及时。
changes.why_matters_en: Removed allow rules now stop applying immediately without a restart, so permission revocation is timely.

changes.raw: Fixed `permissions.additionalDirectories` changes in settings not applying mid-session
changes.summary: 目录权限可会话中更新
changes.summary_en: Additional directories update mid-session
changes.why_matters: 修改 additionalDirectories 后无需重启即可生效，减少配置变更等待。
changes.why_matters_en: Changes to additionalDirectories now take effect without restarting, reducing config-change friction.

changes.raw: Fixed removing a directory from `settings.permissions.additionalDirectories` revoking access to the same directory passed via `--add-dir`
changes.summary: 移除目录不再误收回别名权限
changes.summary_en: Removing a dir no longer revokes alias access
changes.why_matters: 避免从 settings 中移除目录时，误把通过 --add-dir 授予的同目录访问也一起撤销。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents removing a directory from settings from accidentally revoking the same directory granted via --add-dir.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP HTTP/SSE connections accumulating ~50 MB/hr of unreleased buffers when servers reconnect
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 连接内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed MCP reconnect buffer leak
changes.why_matters: 减少 MCP HTTP/SSE 重连时的内存持续增长，提升长时间运行稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It stops memory from steadily growing during MCP HTTP/SSE reconnects, improving long-running stability.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP OAuth `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` not being honored on token refresh after restart, fixing ADFS and similar IdPs
changes.summary: 修复 OAuth 刷新元数据
changes.summary_en: Fixed OAuth refresh metadata handling
changes.why_matters: 重启后刷新 token 时能正确使用授权服务器元数据，避免 ADFS 等身份提供方登录失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Token refresh after restart now honors auth server metadata, preventing login failures with ADFS and similar IdPs.

changes.raw: Fixed 429 retries burning all attempts in ~13 seconds when the server returns a small `Retry-After` — exponential backoff now applies as a minimum
changes.summary: 429 重试更稳健
changes.summary_en: 429 retries now back off properly
changes.why_matters: 当服务端返回短 Retry-After 时，不会过快耗尽重试次数，提升限流场景成功率。
changes.why_matters_en: Short Retry-After responses no longer burn through retries too quickly, improving success under rate limits.

changes.raw: Fixed rate-limit upgrade options disappearing after context compaction
changes.summary: 压缩后保留升级选项
changes.summary_en: Rate-limit upgrade options persist
changes.why_matters: 上下文压缩后仍能看到限流升级选项，避免用户错过恢复路径。
changes.why_matters_en: Rate-limit upgrade options remain visible after compaction, so users do not lose the recovery path.

changes.raw: Fixed several `/resume` picker issues: `--resume <name>` opening uneditable, Ctrl+A reload wiping search, empty list swallowing navigation, task-status text replacing conversation summary, and cross-project staleness
changes.summary: 修复 /resume 选择器多项问题
changes.summary_en: Fix multiple /resume picker issues
changes.why_matters: 提升会话恢复的可用性，避免搜索、导航和摘要显示异常影响继续工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves session resume reliability so search, navigation, and summaries work correctly.

changes.raw: Fixed file-edit diffs disappearing on `--resume` when the edited file was larger than 10KB
changes.summary: 修复大文件恢复后 diff 丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix missing diffs on large-file resume
changes.why_matters: 确保恢复会话时仍能看到文件修改差异，避免编辑上下文丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Preserves edit diffs after resume so file-change context is not lost.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` cache misses and lost mid-turn input from attachment messages not being saved to the transcript
changes.summary: 修复恢复缓存与附件输入丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix resume cache misses and lost inputs
changes.why_matters: 防止恢复失败和对话中途输入丢失，直接影响会话连续性与数据完整性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents resume failures and lost mid-turn input, protecting session continuity and data integrity.

changes.raw: Fixed messages typed while Claude is working not being persisted to the transcript
changes.summary: 修复工作中消息未写入记录
changes.summary_en: Fix messages not saved during work
changes.why_matters: 确保用户在 Claude 处理时发送的消息不会丢失，避免对话断档。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures messages sent while Claude is working are retained, preventing conversation gaps.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt-type `Stop`/`SubagentStop` hooks failing on long sessions, and hook evaluator API errors displaying "JSON validation failed" instead of the actual message
changes.summary: 修复长会话 Hook 与错误提示
changes.summary_en: Fix long-session hooks and error messages
changes.why_matters: 让 Hook 在长会话中稳定运行，并显示真实错误便于排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps hooks reliable in long sessions and shows the real error for easier debugging.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents with worktree isolation or `cwd:` override leaking their working directory back to the parent session's Bash tool
changes.summary: 修复子代理目录泄漏到父会话
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent cwd leaking to parent session
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理的工作目录污染父会话，防止后续命令在错误路径执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents subagent working directories from contaminating the parent session and misrouting later commands.

changes.raw: Fixed compaction writing duplicate multi-MB subagent transcript files on prompt-too-long retries
changes.summary: 修复压缩重试重复写入子代理记录
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate subagent transcripts on retry
changes.why_matters: 减少重复的大文件写入，降低磁盘浪费和重试时的性能负担。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids duplicate large-file writes, reducing disk waste and retry overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude plugin update` reporting "already at the latest version" for git-based marketplace plugins when the remote had newer commits
changes.summary: 修复插件更新版本判断错误
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin update version check
changes.why_matters: 让 Git 插件更新提示准确，避免用户错过可用的新提交。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes plugin update checks accurate so users do not miss newer commits.

changes.raw: Fixed slash command picker breaking when a plugin's frontmatter `name` is a YAML boolean keyword
changes.summary: 修复插件命令选择器解析错误
changes.summary_en: Fix slash command picker parsing
changes.why_matters: 避免某些插件命令因 YAML 布尔值名称而无法正常显示或选择。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents plugin commands from breaking when frontmatter names look like YAML booleans.

changes.raw: Fixed copying wrapped URLs in `NO_FLICKER` mode inserting spaces at line breaks
changes.summary: 修复换行 URL 复制空格问题
changes.summary_en: Fix spaces when copying wrapped URLs
changes.why_matters: 保证复制出的链接可直接使用，不会因换行插入空格而失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps copied URLs usable by preventing spaces from being inserted at line breaks.

changes.raw: Fixed scroll rendering artifacts in `NO_FLICKER` mode when running inside zellij
changes.summary: 修复 zellij 中滚动渲染异常
changes.summary_en: Fix scroll artifacts in zellij
changes.why_matters: 改善终端界面稳定性，减少滚动时的视觉残影和错乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves terminal UI stability by removing scroll-related rendering artifacts.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash in `NO_FLICKER` mode when hovering over MCP tool results
changes.summary: 修复 NO_FLICKER 悬停崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix NO_FLICKER hover crash
changes.why_matters: 避免在查看 MCP 工具结果时直接崩溃，提升界面可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes while hovering MCP tool results, improving UI reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed a `NO_FLICKER` mode memory leak where API retries left stale streaming state
changes.summary: 修复 NO_FLICKER 内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix NO_FLICKER memory leak
changes.why_matters: 减少重试后残留状态导致的内存增长，提升长时间运行稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Stops stale retry state from leaking memory, improving long-running stability.

changes.raw: Fixed slow mouse-wheel scrolling in `NO_FLICKER` mode on Windows Terminal
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 终端滚轮过慢
changes.summary_en: Fix slow mouse-wheel scrolling
changes.why_matters: 提升 Windows Terminal 中的浏览体验，让长输出更容易查看。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves browsing experience in Windows Terminal for long outputs.

changes.raw: Fixed custom status line not displaying in `NO_FLICKER` mode on terminals shorter than 24 rows
changes.summary: 修复短终端状态栏不显示
changes.summary_en: Fix status line on short terminals
changes.why_matters: 让自定义状态栏在小屏终端也能正常显示，信息更完整。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures the custom status line appears even on short terminals, keeping key info visible.

changes.raw: Fixed Shift+Enter and Alt/Cmd+arrow shortcuts not working in Warp with `NO_FLICKER` mode
changes.summary: 修复 Warp 快捷键失效
changes.summary_en: Fix Warp shortcut keys
changes.why_matters: 这让 Warp 终端中的常用快捷键在无闪烁模式下恢复可用，提升输入效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores common shortcuts in Warp under no-flicker mode, improving input efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed Korean/Japanese/Unicode text becoming garbled when copied in no-flicker mode on Windows
changes.summary: 修复无闪烁复制乱码
changes.summary_en: Fix garbled copy in no-flicker mode
changes.why_matters: 这避免了 Windows 上复制日韩文和 Unicode 文本时内容损坏，保证文本可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents copied Korean, Japanese, and Unicode text from becoming corrupted on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock SigV4 authentication failing when `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` or `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` are set to empty strings (as GitHub Actions does for unset inputs)
changes.summary: 修复 Bedrock 空值认证失败
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock auth with empty env vars
changes.why_matters: 这修复了在 CI 等环境中未设置变量被置为空字符串时的认证失败，避免连接中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes auth failures when unset variables are passed as empty strings in CI-like environments.

changes.raw: Improved Accept Edits mode to auto-approve filesystem commands prefixed with safe env vars or process wrappers (e.g. `LANG=C rm foo`, `timeout 5 mkdir out`)
changes.summary: 自动批准安全前缀命令
changes.summary_en: Auto-approve safe prefixed commands
changes.why_matters: 这减少了 Accept Edits 模式下对安全命令的重复确认，让常见文件操作更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces repeated confirmations for safe commands in Accept Edits mode, making common file operations smoother.

changes.raw: Improved auto mode and bypass-permissions mode to auto-approve sandbox network access prompts
changes.summary: 自动模式放行沙箱网络
changes.summary_en: Auto-approve sandbox network prompts
changes.why_matters: 这让自动模式和绕过权限模式在需要网络时更少被打断，提升任务连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces interruptions in auto and bypass-permissions modes when network access is needed.

changes.raw: Improved sandbox: `sandbox.network.allowMachLookup` now takes effect on macOS
changes.summary: macOS 沙箱网络配置生效
changes.summary_en: Make macOS sandbox network setting work
changes.why_matters: 这确保 macOS 上的网络沙箱配置真正生效，提升权限控制的一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures sandbox network settings actually take effect on macOS, improving permission consistency.

changes.raw: Improved image handling: pasted and attached images are now compressed to the same token budget as images read via the Read tool
changes.summary: 图片压缩计入同等预算
changes.summary_en: Count pasted images against same budget
changes.why_matters: 这让粘贴和附件图片的 token 消耗与读取图片一致，避免上下文预算被意外吃满。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes pasted and attached images consume the same token budget as read images, avoiding unexpected context exhaustion.

changes.raw: Improved slash command and `@`-mention completion to trigger after CJK sentence punctuation, so Japanese/Chinese input no longer requires a space before `/` or `@`
changes.summary: 中文日文标点后可补全命令
changes.summary_en: Trigger completions after CJK punctuation
changes.why_matters: 这让中文和日文输入时无需额外空格即可触发补全，提升本地化输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets completions trigger after Chinese and Japanese punctuation without an extra space, improving localized input flow.

changes.raw: Improved Bridge sessions to show the local git repo, branch, and working directory on the claude.ai session card
changes.summary: Bridge 会话显示本地仓库信息
changes.summary_en: Show local repo info in Bridge sessions
changes.why_matters: 这让会话卡片直接展示仓库、分支和工作目录，方便快速识别上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: This shows repo, branch, and working directory on the session card for faster context recognition.

changes.raw: Improved footer layout: indicators (Focus, notifications) now stay on the mode-indicator row instead of wrapping below
changes.summary: 底栏指示器不再换行
changes.summary_en: Keep footer indicators on one row
changes.why_matters: 这改善了底栏布局，减少界面拥挤和视觉跳动。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves footer layout and reduces clutter and visual wrapping.

changes.raw: Improved context-low warning to show as a transient footer notification instead of a persistent row
changes.summary: 上下文不足提示改为通知
changes.summary_en: Show low-context as transient notice
changes.why_matters: 这避免持续占用界面空间，让低上下文提醒更轻量且不干扰工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids permanently occupying UI space and makes the low-context warning less disruptive.

changes.raw: Improved markdown blockquotes to show a continuous left bar across wrapped lines
changes.summary: 引用块左边线更连续
changes.summary_en: Make blockquote left bar continuous
changes.why_matters: 这提升了 Markdown 渲染的可读性，让长引用更清晰。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves Markdown readability by making wrapped blockquotes easier to follow.

changes.raw: Improved session transcript size by skipping empty hook entries and capping stored pre-edit file copies
changes.summary: 会话记录更省空间
changes.summary_en: Reduce transcript storage size
changes.why_matters: 这通过跳过空 hook 和限制文件副本来减少会话记录体积，降低存储开销。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces transcript size by skipping empty hooks and capping file copies, lowering storage overhead.

changes.raw: Improved transcript accuracy: per-block entries now carry the final token usage instead of the streaming placeholder
changes.summary: 转录记录更准确
changes.summary_en: Store final token usage in transcript
changes.why_matters: 这让每个块的 token 统计更准确，便于审计和成本分析。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes per-block token accounting accurate for auditing and cost analysis.

changes.raw: Improved Bash tool OTEL tracing: subprocesses now inherit a W3C `TRACEPARENT` env var when tracing is enabled
changes.summary: Bash 子进程继承追踪标识
changes.summary_en: Propagate TRACEPARENT to Bash subprocesses
changes.why_matters: 这让 Bash 工具的子进程也能接入分布式追踪，提升可观测性。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets Bash subprocesses participate in distributed tracing, improving observability.

changes.raw: Updated `/claude-api` skill to cover Managed Agents alongside the Claude API
changes.summary: 技能支持托管代理与Claude API
changes.summary_en: Skill now covers Managed Agents and Claude API
changes.why_matters: 让该技能同时覆盖托管代理和 Claude API，提升在不同调用方式下的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This expands the skill to cover both Managed Agents and the Claude API, improving usability across invocation modes.
