changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock requests failing with `403 "Authorization header is missing"` when using `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` or `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_BEDROCK_AUTH` (regression in 2.1.94)
changes.summary: 修复 Bedrock 认证头缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix missing Bedrock auth header
changes.why_matters: 修复后可避免 Bedrock 请求因认证头缺失而失败，恢复相关用户的正常使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents Bedrock requests from failing due to a missing auth header and restores normal use for affected users.

signals.title: Issue: Claude Code is unusable for complex engineering tasks with Feb updates
Claude Code Unpacked : A visual guide
Tell HN: Anthropic no longer allowing Claude Code subscriptions to use OpenClaw
Pro Max 5x quota exhausted in 1.5 hours despite moderate usage
Claude Code Routines

changes.raw: Added support for Amazon Bedrock powered by Mantle, set `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1`
changes.summary: 支持 Mantle 版 Bedrock
changes.summary_en: Add Mantle-powered Bedrock support
changes.why_matters: 让更多用户可以通过 Mantle 连接 Amazon Bedrock，扩展了可用模型与部署选择。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets more users connect to Amazon Bedrock via Mantle, expanding model and deployment options.

changes.raw: Changed default effort level from medium to high for API-key, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, Team, and Enterprise users (control this with `/effort`)
changes.summary: 默认提升推理强度
changes.summary_en: Raise default effort level
changes.why_matters: 默认更高的 effort 有助于获得更稳健的回答，减少用户手动调参。
changes.why_matters_en: A higher default effort can improve answer quality and reduce manual tuning.

changes.raw: Added compact `Slacked #channel` header with a clickable channel link for Slack MCP send-message tool calls
changes.summary: Slack 消息头更清晰
changes.summary_en: Add compact Slack channel header
changes.why_matters: 在 Slack 发送消息时能更直观地看到目标频道并快速跳转。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes the target Slack channel clearer and easier to open when sending messages.

changes.raw: Added `keep-coding-instructions` frontmatter field support for plugin output styles
changes.summary: 插件输出支持保留指令
changes.summary_en: Support keep-coding instructions
changes.why_matters: 插件可以更好地保留编码约束，提升输出一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins can preserve coding constraints better, improving output consistency.

changes.raw: Added `hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle` to `UserPromptSubmit` hooks for setting the session title
changes.summary: 支持设置会话标题
changes.summary_en: Allow setting session title in hooks
changes.why_matters: 钩子可以自动命名会话，方便整理和回顾对话上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: Hooks can auto-name sessions, making conversations easier to organize and review.

changes.raw: Plugin skills declared via `"skills": ["./"]` now use the skill's frontmatter `name` for the invocation name instead of the directory basename, giving a stable name across install methods
changes.summary: 技能调用名更稳定
changes.summary_en: Use stable skill invocation names
changes.why_matters: 技能在不同安装方式下保持一致名称，减少引用失效和混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: Skills keep a consistent name across install methods, reducing broken references and confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed agents appearing stuck after a 429 rate-limit response with a long Retry-After header — the error now surfaces immediately instead of silently waiting
changes.summary: 429 限流错误立即提示
changes.summary_en: Surface 429 rate-limit errors immediately
changes.why_matters: 遇到限流时不再假死等待，用户能更快知道问题并采取行动。
changes.why_matters_en: Users no longer see a silent hang on rate limits and can react sooner.

changes.raw: Fixed Console login on macOS silently failing with "Not logged in" when the login keychain is locked or its password is out of sync — the error is now surfaced and `claude doctor` diagnoses the fix
changes.summary: macOS 登录错误可见
changes.summary_en: Show macOS login keychain errors
changes.why_matters: 登录失败原因会直接暴露并可诊断，减少排障时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Login failures are now visible and diagnosable, reducing troubleshooting time.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin skill hooks defined in YAML frontmatter being silently ignored
changes.summary: 修复 YAML 技能钩子失效
changes.summary_en: Fix YAML skill hooks being ignored
changes.why_matters: 插件技能定义终于能按预期生效，避免自动化逻辑失灵。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin skill definitions now work as expected, preventing automation from silently failing.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin hooks failing with "No such file or directory" when `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` was not set
changes.summary: 修复插件钩子路径错误
changes.summary_en: Fix missing CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT path
changes.why_matters: 未设置环境变量时插件钩子也能正常运行，减少部署依赖。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin hooks work even without the env var, reducing deployment dependencies.

changes.raw: Fixed `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` resolving to the marketplace source directory instead of the installed cache for local-marketplace plugins on startup
changes.summary: 本地市场插件路径修正
changes.summary_en: Fix local marketplace plugin root
changes.why_matters: 插件启动时能正确解析安装后的资源路径，避免引用到错误目录。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins now resolve the installed cache path correctly instead of the source directory.

changes.raw: Fixed scrollback showing the same diff repeated and blank pages in long-running sessions
changes.summary: 长会话滚动区重复修复
changes.summary_en: Fix repeated diffs and blank pages
changes.why_matters: 长时间使用时的显示问题被修复，阅读历史输出更可靠。
changes.why_matters_en: Long-running session display issues are fixed, making history easier to read.

changes.raw: Fixed multiline user prompts in the transcript indenting wrapped lines under the `❯` caret instead of under the text
changes.summary: 多行提示缩进修复
changes.summary_en: Fix multiline prompt indentation
changes.why_matters: 转录内容排版更整齐，长提示更容易阅读和编辑。
changes.why_matters_en: Transcript formatting is cleaner, making long prompts easier to read and edit.

changes.raw: Fixed Shift+Space inserting the literal word "space" instead of a space character in search inputs
changes.summary: 修复 Shift+Space 输入空格
changes.summary_en: Fix Shift+Space inserting text
changes.why_matters: 避免搜索框输入异常，提升键盘操作准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents incorrect input in search fields and improves keyboard accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed hyperlinks opening two browser tabs when clicked inside tmux running in an xterm.js-based terminal (VS Code, Hyper, Tabby)
changes.summary: 修复 tmux 链接双开
changes.summary_en: Fix double-opening links in tmux
changes.why_matters: 点击链接只会打开一次，减少误操作和浏览器标签页污染。
changes.why_matters_en: Links open only once, reducing accidental duplicate tabs and misclicks.

changes.raw: Fixed an alt-screen rendering bug where content height changes mid-scroll could leave compounding ghost lines
changes.summary: 修复滚动残影叠加
changes.summary_en: Fix ghost lines during scroll
changes.why_matters: 内容高度变化时不再产生叠加残影，提升终端显示准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Content height changes no longer leave compounded ghost lines, improving terminal rendering accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed `FORCE_HYPERLINK` environment variable being ignored when set via `settings.json` `env`
changes.summary: 修复环境变量链接失效
changes.summary_en: Honor FORCE_HYPERLINK from settings env
changes.why_matters: 通过 settings.json 注入的环境变量现在会生效，避免链接显示行为不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Environment variables set via settings.json now take effect, avoiding inconsistent hyperlink behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed native terminal cursor not tracking the selected tab in dialogs, so screen readers and magnifiers can follow tab navigation
changes.summary: 修复无障碍标签焦点跟踪
changes.summary_en: Keep terminal cursor on selected tab
changes.why_matters: 终端光标会跟随当前标签页，方便屏幕阅读器和放大镜正确读取界面。
changes.why_matters_en: The terminal cursor now follows the selected tab, helping screen readers and magnifiers track navigation.

changes.raw: Fixed Bedrock invocation of Sonnet 3.5 v2 by using the `us.` inference profile ID
changes.summary: 修复Bedrock Sonnet调用
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock Sonnet 3.5 v2 invocation
changes.why_matters: Sonnet 3.5 v2 在 Bedrock 上可正常调用，避免模型请求失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Sonnet 3.5 v2 can now be invoked correctly on Bedrock, preventing model request failures.

changes.raw: Fixed SDK/print mode not preserving the partial assistant response in conversation history when interrupted mid-stream
changes.summary: 保留中断的部分回复
changes.summary_en: Preserve partial assistant replies
changes.why_matters: 中断流式输出后，部分回复会保存在历史中，便于继续查看上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: Interrupted streaming responses are now preserved in history, so context is not lost.

changes.raw: Improved `--resume` to resume sessions from other worktrees of the same repo directly instead of printing a `cd` command
changes.summary: 跨工作区直接恢复会话
changes.summary_en: Resume sessions from other worktrees
changes.why_matters: 恢复会话时无需再手动切换目录，跨 worktree 续接更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: You can resume sessions from another worktree directly, making continuation across worktrees smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed CJK and other multibyte text being corrupted with U+FFFD in stream-json input/output when chunk boundaries split a UTF-8 sequence
changes.summary: 修复UTF-8分片乱码
changes.summary_en: Fix UTF-8 corruption in stream-json
changes.why_matters: 流式 JSON 输入输出在分片边界不会再把多字节字符弄坏，避免中文乱码。
changes.why_matters_en: Stream JSON I/O no longer corrupts multibyte characters at chunk boundaries, preventing text garbling.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Reduced cold-open subprocess work on starting a session
changes.summary: 减少VSCode冷启动开销
changes.summary_en: Reduce VSCode cold-open work
changes.why_matters: 启动会话更快，降低 VSCode 冷启动时的额外进程开销。
changes.why_matters_en: Sessions start faster by reducing subprocess work during VSCode cold open.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed dropdown menus selecting the wrong item when the mouse was over the list while typing or using arrow keys
changes.summary: 修复下拉菜单误选
changes.summary_en: Fix wrong dropdown selection in VSCode
changes.why_matters: 鼠标悬停时输入或按键不会再选错项，提升菜单操作准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Typing or using arrow keys while hovering no longer selects the wrong item, improving menu accuracy.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added a warning banner when `settings.json` files fail to parse, so users know their permission rules are not being applied
changes.summary: 配置解析失败时提示
changes.summary_en: Warn when settings.json fails to parse
changes.why_matters: 用户能及时发现 settings.json 解析失败，避免权限规则未生效却不自知。
changes.why_matters_en: Users are warned when settings.json fails to parse, so they know permission rules are not being applied.

signals.title: Claude Code's source code has been leaked via a map file in their NPM registry
The Claude Code Source Leak: fake tools, frustration regexes, undercover mode
Issue: Claude Code is unusable for complex engineering tasks with Feb updates
Claude Code Unpacked : A visual guide
Tell HN: Anthropic no longer allowing Claude Code subscriptions to use OpenClaw

changes.raw: Added `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` policy setting: when set, the CLI blocks startup until remote managed settings are freshly fetched, and exits if the fetch fails (fail-closed)
changes.summary: 远程设置强制刷新更安全
changes.summary_en: Force fresh remote settings before startup
changes.why_matters: 确保受管配置必须成功拉取后才启动，避免使用过期或未验证的远程设置。
changes.why_matters_en: It blocks startup until fresh managed settings are fetched, preventing the CLI from running with stale or unverified remote policy.

changes.raw: Added interactive Bedrock setup wizard accessible from the login screen when selecting "3rd-party platform" — guides you through AWS authentication, region configuration, credential verification, and model pinning
changes.summary: 新增 Bedrock 引导配置
changes.summary_en: Interactive Bedrock setup wizard
changes.why_matters: 让用户更容易完成 AWS 认证、区域和模型配置，降低接入第三方平台的门槛。
changes.why_matters_en: It simplifies onboarding to Bedrock by guiding users through auth, region, credential checks, and model pinning.

changes.raw: Added per-model and cache-hit breakdown to `/cost` for subscription users
changes.summary: /cost 显示模型与缓存明细
changes.summary_en: Show per-model and cache-hit cost breakdown
changes.why_matters: 帮助订阅用户更清楚地了解费用构成和缓存命中带来的节省。
changes.why_matters_en: It gives subscription users better visibility into cost drivers and cache savings.

changes.raw: `/release-notes` is now an interactive version picker
changes.summary: /release-notes 可交互选版本
changes.summary_en: Interactive version picker for release notes
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更快查看特定版本的更新内容，提升查找效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes it easier to jump to a specific version's notes and find relevant changes faster.

changes.raw: Remote Control session names now use your hostname as the default prefix (e.g. `myhost-graceful-unicorn`), overridable with `--remote-control-session-name-prefix`
changes.summary: 远控会话名默认用主机名
changes.summary_en: Default remote control session names from hostname
changes.why_matters: 默认名称更可识别，便于区分不同机器上的远程控制会话。
changes.why_matters_en: The default naming is more recognizable, making remote control sessions easier to distinguish across machines.

changes.raw: Pro users now see a footer hint when returning to a session after the prompt cache has expired, showing roughly how many tokens the next turn will send uncached
changes.summary: 缓存过期时提示未缓存代价
changes.summary_en: Warn about uncached tokens after cache expiry
changes.why_matters: 让用户在继续会话前预估下一轮的未缓存 token 成本，减少意外消耗。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users estimate the uncached token cost of the next turn after cache expiry.

changes.raw: Fixed subagent spawning permanently failing with "Could not determine pane count" after tmux windows are killed or renumbered during a long-running session
changes.summary: 修复 tmux 子代理启动失败
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent spawn after tmux pane changes
changes.why_matters: 避免长会话中 tmux 窗口被杀死或重排后，子代理永久无法启动。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents subagent spawning from permanently failing after tmux windows are killed or renumbered.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt-type Stop hooks incorrectly failing when the small fast model returns `ok:false`, and restored `preventContinuation:true` semantics for non-Stop prompt-type hooks
changes.summary: 修复 Stop hook 语义错误
changes.summary_en: Fix Stop hook handling and preventContinuation
changes.why_matters: 确保钩子返回值和停止语义按预期工作，避免自动化流程被错误中断或放行。
changes.why_matters_en: It restores correct hook semantics so automation flows are neither blocked nor continued incorrectly.

changes.raw: Fixed tool input validation failures when streaming emits array/object fields as JSON-encoded strings
changes.summary: 修复流式输入字段校验失败
changes.summary_en: Fix validation for JSON-encoded streamed fields
changes.why_matters: 避免流式输出把数组或对象字段编码成字符串时触发输入校验错误。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents validation failures when streamed array/object fields arrive as JSON-encoded strings.

changes.raw: Fixed an API 400 error that could occur when extended thinking produced a whitespace-only text block alongside real content
changes.summary: 修复扩展思考导致 400 错误
changes.summary_en: Fix 400 error from whitespace-only text blocks
changes.why_matters: 减少扩展思考与真实内容并存时触发的 API 请求失败。
changes.why_matters_en: It avoids API 400 failures when extended thinking emits whitespace-only text alongside real content.

changes.raw: Fixed accidental feedback survey submissions from auto-pilot keypresses and consecutive-prompt digit collisions
changes.summary: 修复自动驾驶误触反馈提交
changes.summary_en: Fix accidental feedback submissions
changes.why_matters: 避免自动操作或数字键冲突导致用户误提交反馈。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents accidental feedback submissions caused by autopilot keypresses or digit collisions.

changes.raw: Fixed misleading "esc to interrupt" hint appearing alongside "esc to clear" when a text selection exists in fullscreen mode during processing
changes.summary: 修复全屏提示文案冲突
changes.summary_en: Fix conflicting fullscreen interrupt hint
changes.why_matters: 在有文本选区时显示正确快捷键提示，减少操作误解。
changes.why_matters_en: It shows the correct shortcut hint when text is selected, reducing user confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed Homebrew install update prompts to use the cask's release channel (`claude-code` → stable, `claude-code@latest` → latest)
changes.summary: 修复 Homebrew 更新通道
changes.summary_en: Fix Homebrew update channel prompts
changes.why_matters: 让不同 cask 对应正确的更新通道，避免装到错误版本。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures each cask points to the correct release channel and avoids updating to the wrong version.

changes.raw: Fixed `ctrl+e` jumping to the end of the next line when already at end of line in multiline prompts
changes.summary: 修复多行输入光标跳行
changes.summary_en: Fix Ctrl+E cursor jump in multiline prompts
changes.why_matters: 改善多行输入编辑体验，避免光标跳到下一行末尾。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves multiline editing by preventing the cursor from jumping to the next line's end.

changes.raw: Fixed an issue where the same message could appear at two positions when scrolling up in fullscreen mode (iTerm2, Ghostty, and other terminals with DEC 2026 support)
changes.summary: 修复全屏滚动重复消息
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate message positions while scrolling
changes.why_matters: 避免在支持 DEC 2026 的终端中滚动时出现重复消息显示。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents duplicate message rendering while scrolling in terminals with DEC 2026 support.

changes.raw: Fixed idle-return "/clear to save X tokens" hint showing cumulative session tokens instead of current context size
changes.summary: 修正清理提示的节省令牌数
changes.summary_en: Fix token-savings hint accuracy
changes.why_matters: 提示现在显示当前上下文大小，避免误导用户对可节省令牌数的判断。
changes.why_matters_en: The hint now reflects current context size, avoiding misleading token-savings estimates.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin MCP servers stuck "connecting" on session start when they duplicate a claude.ai connector that is unauthenticated
changes.summary: 修复插件 MCP 启动卡连接
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP servers stuck connecting
changes.why_matters: 会话启动时不再因未认证的重复连接器而卡住，提升插件可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Session startup no longer hangs on unauthenticated duplicate connectors, improving plugin reliability.

changes.raw: Improved Write tool diff computation speed for large files (60% faster on files with tabs/`&`/`$`)
changes.summary: 大文件写入差异计算更快
changes.summary_en: Faster diff computation for large files
changes.why_matters: 大文件编辑时生成差异更快，减少等待时间并提升交互流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Diff generation is faster for large-file edits, reducing wait time and improving responsiveness.

changes.raw: Removed `/tag` command
changes.summary: 移除 /tag 命令
changes.summary_en: Remove the /tag command
changes.why_matters: 依赖该命令的用户需要改用其他流程，现有工作流可能受影响。
changes.why_matters_en: Users relying on this command must switch workflows, so existing setups may be affected.

changes.raw: Added `disableSkillShellExecution` setting to disable inline shell execution in skills, custom slash commands, and plugin commands

changes.raw: Plugins can now ship executables under `bin/` and invoke them as bare commands from the Bash tool

changes.raw: Fixed transcript chain breaks on `--resume` that could lose conversation history when async transcript writes fail silently

changes.raw: Fixed `cmd+delete` not deleting to start of line on iTerm2, kitty, WezTerm, Ghostty, and Windows Terminal
changes.summary: 修复终端退格到行首
changes.summary_en: Fix delete-to-line-start in terminals
changes.why_matters: 这改善了常用终端里的编辑体验，减少输入操作障碍。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves editing behavior in common terminals and reduces friction while typing.

changes.raw: Fixed plan mode in remote sessions losing track of the plan file after a container restart, which caused permission prompts on plan edits and an empty plan-approval modal
changes.summary: 远程计划模式重启后可继续
changes.summary_en: Remote plan mode survives restarts
changes.why_matters: 这避免容器重启后计划文件丢失，减少错误权限提示并保持审批流程正常。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents plan-file loss after container restarts, avoiding गलत permission prompts and keeping approvals working.

changes.raw: Fixed JSON schema validation for `permissions.defaultMode: "auto"` in settings.json
changes.summary: 修复auto权限模式校验
changes.summary_en: Fix validation for auto permission mode
changes.why_matters: 这让设置文件中的权限配置能正确通过校验，避免配置被误判为无效。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures permission settings validate correctly, preventing valid configs from being rejected.

changes.raw: Fixed Windows version cleanup not protecting the active version's rollback copy
changes.summary: Windows清理保留当前回滚副本
changes.summary_en: Windows cleanup preserves active rollback copy
changes.why_matters: 这避免误删当前版本的回滚文件，降低升级/回退失败风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids deleting the active version's rollback copy, reducing upgrade and rollback failure risk.

changes.raw: `/feedback` now explains why it's unavailable instead of disappearing from the slash menu
changes.summary: 反馈菜单显示不可用原因
changes.summary_en: Feedback menu explains unavailability

changes.why_matters_en: This tells users why feedback is unavailable, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Improved `/claude-api` skill guidance for agent design patterns including tool surface decisions, context management, and caching strategy
changes.summary: 增强API技能设计指引
changes.summary_en: Better API skill design guidance
changes.why_matters: 这帮助用户更好地设计代理模式、上下文管理和缓存策略，提升技能质量。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users design better agent patterns, context handling, and caching strategies, improving skill quality.

changes.raw: Improved performance: faster `stripAnsi` on Bun by routing through `Bun.stripANSI`
changes.summary: Bun下ANSI清理更快
changes.summary_en: Faster ANSI stripping on Bun
changes.why_matters: 这减少了日志处理开销，让输出处理更快。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces log-processing overhead and speeds up output handling.

changes.raw: Edit tool now uses shorter `old_string` anchors, reducing output tokens
changes.summary: 编辑工具输出更省token
changes.summary_en: Edit tool uses fewer output tokens
changes.why_matters: 这降低了编辑操作的输出成本，并可能提升长任务效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This lowers the output cost of edit operations and can improve efficiency in long tasks.

changes.raw: Added `.husky` to protected directories (acceptEdits mode)

changes.raw: Fixed an infinite loop where the rate-limit options dialog would repeatedly auto-open after hitting your usage limit, eventually crashing the session
changes.summary: 修复限额弹窗死循环崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix rate-limit dialog auto-open crash loop

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` causing a full prompt-cache miss on the first request for users with deferred tools, MCP servers, or custom agents (regression since v2.1.69)

changes.raw: Fixed `Edit`/`Write` failing with "File content has changed" when a PostToolUse format-on-save hook rewrites the file between consecutive edits
changes.summary: 修复格式化后编辑冲突

changes.raw: Fixed `PreToolUse` hooks that emit JSON to stdout and exit with code 2 not correctly blocking the tool call
changes.summary: 修复 PreToolUse 阻止失效

changes.raw: Fixed collapsed search/read summary badge appearing multiple times in fullscreen scrollback when a CLAUDE.md file auto-loads during a tool call

changes.raw: Fixed auto mode not respecting explicit user boundaries ("don't push", "wait for X before Y") even when the action would otherwise be allowed

changes.why_matters_en: Makes autonomous actions respect explicit user boundaries and avoid overreach.

changes.raw: Fixed click-to-expand hover text being nearly invisible on light terminal themes
changes.summary: 修复浅色主题悬浮文字过淡

changes.why_matters_en: Improves text readability on light terminal themes.

changes.raw: Fixed UI crash when malformed tool input reached the permission dialog
changes.summary: 修复权限弹窗输入崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix permission dialog crash on malformed input
changes.why_matters: 避免异常工具输入导致界面崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents malformed tool input from crashing the permission UI.

changes.raw: Fixed headers disappearing when scrolling `/model`, `/config`, and other selection screens
changes.summary: 修复选择页滚动时标题消失
changes.summary_en: Fix headers disappearing on selection screens
changes.why_matters: 让模型和配置等选择界面更易浏览。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes model/config selection screens easier to navigate.

changes.raw: Hardened PowerShell tool permission checks: fixed trailing `&` background job bypass, `-ErrorAction Break` debugger hang, archive-extraction TOCTOU, and parse-fail fallback deny-rule degradation
changes.summary: 强化 PowerShell 权限检查
changes.summary_en: Harden PowerShell tool permission checks
changes.why_matters: 修复多种绕过与挂起问题，显著降低命令执行风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes multiple bypasses and hangs, significantly reducing command execution risk.

changes.raw: Improved performance: eliminated per-turn JSON.stringify of MCP tool schemas on cache-key lookup
changes.summary: 减少 MCP schema 序列化开销
changes.summary_en: Remove per-turn MCP schema stringify cost
changes.why_matters: 降低每轮开销，提升整体响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces per-turn overhead and improves overall responsiveness.

changes.raw: Improved performance: SSE transport now handles large streamed frames in linear time (was quadratic)
changes.summary: SSE 大帧传输改为线性时间

changes.why_matters: 大流式输出时更快更稳，避免性能退化。

changes.raw: Improved performance: SDK sessions with long conversations no longer slow down quadratically on transcript writes
changes.summary: 长会话转写写入更快

changes.raw: Improved `/resume` all-projects view to load project sessions in parallel, improving load times for users with many projects
changes.summary: /resume 加载更快

changes.raw: Changed `--resume` picker to no longer show sessions created by `claude -p` or SDK invocations
changes.summary: 恢复列表更聚焦交互会话
changes.summary_en: Resume picker shows interactive sessions only

changes.raw: Removed `Get-DnsClientCache` and `ipconfig /displaydns` from auto-allow (DNS cache privacy)
changes.summary: 减少 DNS 缓存自动放行

changes.raw: Added `"defer"` permission decision to `PreToolUse` hooks — headless sessions can pause at a tool call and resume with `-p --resume` to have the hook re-evaluate
changes.summary: 可暂停工具调用并续跑
changes.summary_en: Pause tool calls and resume later
changes.why_matters: 让无头会话在权限决策处暂停并续跑，提升自动化流程的可控性与连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets headless sessions pause at permission checks and resume cleanly, improving control and continuity.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1` environment variable to opt into flicker-free alt-screen rendering with virtualized scrollback
changes.summary: 支持无闪烁终端渲染
changes.summary_en: Enable flicker-free terminal rendering
changes.why_matters: 可减少终端闪烁并改善长会话滚动体验，提升日常使用舒适度。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces terminal flicker and improves scrolling comfort in long sessions.

changes.raw: Added `PermissionDenied` hook that fires after auto mode classifier denials — return `{retry: true}` to tell the model it can retry
changes.summary: 拒绝后可重试自动模式
changes.summary_en: Allow retry after auto-mode denial
changes.why_matters: 模型在自动模式被拒后可重新尝试，减少误拒带来的中断。
changes.why_matters_en: The model can retry after an auto-mode denial, reducing interruptions from false rejections.

changes.raw: Added named subagents to `@` mention typeahead suggestions
changes.summary: @ 提及补全支持子代理名
changes.summary_en: Typeahead now includes named subagents
changes.why_matters: 更容易发现并选择子代理，提升协作与指派效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes subagents easier to discover and select, improving delegation efficiency.

changes.raw: Added `MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=true` for `-p` mode to skip the MCP connection wait entirely, and bounded `--mcp-config` server connections at 5s instead of blocking on the slowest server
changes.summary: 缩短 MCP 连接等待时间
changes.summary_en: Reduce MCP connection wait time
changes.why_matters: 在 `-p` 模式下更快开始执行，避免被慢速 MCP 服务器拖住启动。
changes.why_matters_en: It starts `-p` mode faster by avoiding slow MCP servers from blocking startup.

changes.raw: Auto mode: denied commands now show a notification and appear in `/permissions` → Recent tab where you can retry with `r`
changes.summary: 拒绝命令可通知并重试
changes.summary_en: Denied commands now notify and retry
changes.why_matters: 用户能及时看到被拒命令并快速重试，减少权限流程中的来回切换。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can immediately see denied commands and retry them quickly, reducing friction in permission flows.

changes.raw: Fixed `Edit(//path/**)` and `Read(//path/**)` allow rules to check the resolved symlink target, not just the requested path
changes.summary: 符号链接权限检查更准确
changes.summary_en: Permission rules now resolve symlinks
changes.why_matters: 避免通过符号链接绕过允许规则，提升路径权限判断的正确性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents symlink-based bypasses and makes path permission checks more accurate.

changes.raw: Fixed voice push-to-talk not activating for some modifier-combo bindings, and voice mode on Windows failing with "WebSocket upgrade rejected with HTTP 101"
changes.summary: 修复语音按键与 Windows 语音
changes.summary_en: Fix push-to-talk and Windows voice mode
changes.why_matters: 恢复语音输入可用性，避免快捷键失效和 Windows 端连接失败。
changes.why_matters_en: It restores voice input usability by fixing broken hotkeys and Windows connection failures.

changes.raw: Fixed Edit/Write tools doubling CRLF on Windows and stripping Markdown hard line breaks (two trailing spaces)
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 换行写入问题
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows CRLF and hard-break writes
changes.why_matters: 保证 Windows 上编辑结果与 Markdown 格式正确，避免文件内容被意外改坏。
changes.why_matters_en: It keeps edits and Markdown formatting correct on Windows, preventing unintended file corruption.

changes.raw: Fixed `StructuredOutput` schema cache bug causing ~50% failure rate when using multiple schemas
changes.summary: 修复结构化输出缓存失败
changes.summary_en: Fix StructuredOutput schema cache bug
changes.why_matters: 显著降低多 schema 场景下的输出失败率，提高结构化生成稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It greatly reduces failures when using multiple schemas, improving structured output reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak where large JSON inputs were retained as LRU cache keys in long-running sessions
changes.summary: 修复大 JSON 输入内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix memory leak from large JSON inputs
changes.why_matters: 长时间运行时更省内存，减少会话变慢或被系统回收的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It lowers memory usage in long-running sessions and reduces the risk of slowdown or OOM issues.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash when removing a message from very large session files (over 50MB)
changes.summary: 修复超大会话删除崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash when editing huge sessions
changes.why_matters: 让超大会话文件的消息管理更稳定，避免删除消息时直接崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes message management stable for very large session files and prevents crashes on deletion.

changes.raw: Fixed LSP server zombie state after crash — server now restarts on next request instead of failing until session restart
changes.summary: LSP 崩溃后可自动重启
changes.summary_en: Restart LSP server after crash
changes.why_matters: 编辑体验更连续，避免语言服务器挂死后只能重启整个会话。
changes.why_matters_en: It keeps the editing workflow continuous by recovering from LSP crashes without restarting the session.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt history entries containing CJK or emoji being silently dropped when they fall on a 4KB boundary in `~/.claude/history.jsonl`
changes.summary: 修复历史记录丢失 CJK/emoji
changes.summary_en: Fix dropped CJK and emoji history entries
changes.why_matters: 避免提示历史静默丢失，确保多语言和表情输入都能被可靠保存。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents silent loss of prompt history, ensuring CJK and emoji inputs are saved reliably.

changes.raw: Fixed `/stats` undercounting tokens by excluding subagent usage, and losing historical data beyond 30 days when the stats cache format changes
changes.summary: 统计包含子代理用量
changes.summary_en: Stats now include subagent usage
changes.why_matters: 让 token 统计更准确，并保留更完整的历史数据，便于成本和使用分析。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes token stats more accurate and preserves more historical data for usage analysis.

changes.raw: Fixed `-p --resume` hangs when the deferred tool input exceeds 64KB or no deferred marker exists, and `-p --continue` not resuming deferred tools
changes.summary: 修复续跑卡死与续接失败
changes.summary_en: Fix resume hangs and deferred tool resume
changes.why_matters: 这能避免长会话在续跑时卡住，并确保延迟工具能正确继续执行。

changes.raw: Fixed `claude-cli://` deep links not opening on macOS
changes.summary: 修复 macOS 深链无法打开
changes.summary_en: Fix claude-cli deep links on macOS
changes.why_matters: 这让 macOS 上的 Claude Code 深链接可以正常唤起应用。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores the ability to open Claude Code from deep links on macOS.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tool errors truncating to only the first content block when the server returns multi-element error content
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 错误内容被截断

changes.why_matters: 这能保留服务器返回的完整错误信息，便于排查问题。
changes.why_matters_en: This preserves full server error details for easier debugging.

changes.raw: Fixed skill reminders and other system context being dropped when sending messages with images via the SDK
changes.summary: 修复图片消息丢失系统上下文
changes.summary_en: Fix lost system context with image SDK messages
changes.why_matters: 这避免 SDK 发送图片时丢失技能提醒等关键上下文，减少回答偏差。

changes.raw: Fixed PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks to receive `file_path` as an absolute path for Write/Edit/Read tools, matching the documented behavior
changes.summary: 修复钩子文件路径为绝对路径

changes.raw: Fixed autocompact thrash loop — now detects when context refills to the limit immediately after compacting three times in a row and stops with an actionable error instead of burning API calls
changes.summary: 修复自动压缩死循环
changes.summary_en: Fix autocompact thrash loop
changes.why_matters: 这能防止上下文反复压缩导致 API 费用浪费，并给出可操作报错。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents repeated compaction from burning API calls and returns an actionable error.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt cache misses in long sessions caused by tool schema bytes changing mid-session
changes.summary: 修复长会话提示缓存失效
changes.summary_en: Fix prompt cache misses in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 这减少长会话中的重复计算和延迟，提升稳定性与效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces recomputation and latency in long sessions, improving stability and efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed nested CLAUDE.md files being re-injected dozens of times in long sessions that read many files
changes.summary: 修复 CLAUDE.md 重复注入
changes.summary_en: Fix repeated CLAUDE.md reinjection
changes.why_matters: 这避免长会话中上下文膨胀，减少噪音和性能损耗。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids context bloat in long sessions and reduces noise and performance overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` crash when transcript contains a tool result from an older CLI version or interrupted write
changes.summary: 修复旧版转录续跑崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix resume crash on older transcripts
changes.why_matters: 这让 `--resume` 能兼容旧版本或中断写入的历史记录，提升可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes `--resume` compatible with older transcripts and interrupted writes, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed misleading "Rate limit reached" message when the API returned an entitlement error — now shows the actual error with actionable hints
changes.summary: 修复限流提示误导
changes.summary_en: Fix misleading rate limit message
changes.why_matters: 这会显示真实的配额/权限错误并给出提示，帮助用户快速处理。
changes.why_matters_en: This shows the real entitlement error with hints so users can resolve it faster.

changes.raw: Fixed hooks `if` condition filtering not matching compound commands (`ls && git push`) or commands with env-var prefixes (`FOO=bar git push`)
changes.summary: 修复 hooks 条件匹配命令
changes.summary_en: Fix hook if-condition command matching
changes.why_matters: 这让复杂命令和环境变量前缀命令也能正确触发钩子。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures hooks trigger correctly for compound commands and env-prefixed commands.

changes.raw: Fixed collapsed search/read group badges duplicating in terminal scrollback during heavy parallel tool use
changes.summary: 修复终端徽章重复显示
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate scrollback badges
changes.why_matters: 这改善终端输出可读性，减少并发工具使用时的视觉干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves terminal readability and reduces visual clutter during heavy parallel tool use.

changes.raw: Fixed notification `invalidates` not clearing the currently-displayed notification immediately
changes.summary: 修复通知不立即失效
changes.summary_en: Fix notification invalidation delay
changes.why_matters: 这让当前通知能及时更新，避免用户看到过期状态。
changes.why_matters_en: This updates the displayed notification immediately so users do not see stale state.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt briefly disappearing after submit when background messages arrived during processing
changes.summary: 修复提交后提示闪退
changes.summary_en: Fix prompt disappearing after submit
changes.why_matters: 这改善交互稳定性，避免后台消息到来时输入区短暂消失。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves interaction stability when background messages arrive during processing.

changes.raw: Fixed Devanagari and other combining-mark text being truncated in assistant output
changes.summary: 修复组合字符输出截断
changes.summary_en: Fix truncation of combining-mark text
changes.why_matters: 这保证多语言文本显示完整，避免助手输出被截断。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps multilingual assistant output intact and prevents text truncation.

changes.raw: Fixed rendering artifacts on main-screen terminals after layout shifts
changes.summary: 修复布局切换后主屏渲染异常
changes.summary_en: Fix main-screen rendering artifacts after layout shifts
changes.why_matters: 减少界面闪烁和错位，提升终端使用稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces visual glitches and keeps the terminal UI stable.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode failing to request microphone permission on macOS Apple Silicon
changes.summary: 修复语音模式麦克风权限请求
changes.summary_en: Fix mic permission prompt in voice mode on macOS
changes.why_matters: 让语音功能在 Apple Silicon 的 macOS 上可正常启动。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores voice mode functionality on macOS Apple Silicon.

changes.raw: Fixed Shift+Enter submitting instead of inserting a newline on Windows Terminal Preview 1.25
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 终端换行提交问题
changes.summary_en: Fix Shift+Enter newline behavior in Windows Terminal Preview
changes.why_matters: 避免误提交消息，改善 Windows 终端输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents accidental submits and improves input behavior on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed periodic UI jitter during streaming in iTerm2 when running inside tmux
changes.summary: 修复 tmux 中流式输出界面抖动
changes.summary_en: Fix UI jitter during streaming in iTerm2 with tmux
changes.why_matters: 减少流式输出时的抖动，提升长对话可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes streaming output smoother and easier to read.

changes.raw: Fixed PowerShell tool incorrectly reporting failures when commands like `git push` wrote progress to stderr on Windows PowerShell 5.1
changes.summary: 修复 PowerShell 误报命令失败
changes.summary_en: Fix false failures in PowerShell when stderr has progress
changes.why_matters: 避免像 `git push` 这类正常命令被错误判定为失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents valid commands from being misreported as failed.

changes.raw: Fixed a potential out-of-memory crash when the Edit tool was used on very large files (>1 GiB)
changes.summary: 修复超大文件编辑内存崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix potential OOM crash when editing very large files
changes.why_matters: 防止编辑超大文件时崩溃，保障大项目可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents crashes on huge files and improves reliability for large codebases.

changes.raw: Improved collapsed tool summary to show "Listed N directories" for `ls`/`tree`/`du` instead of "Read N files"
changes.summary: 折叠摘要更准确显示目录列表
changes.summary_en: Improve collapsed summaries for directory listings
changes.why_matters: 让工具摘要更贴近实际操作，便于快速理解上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes tool summaries more accurate and easier to scan.

changes.raw: Improved Bash tool to warn when a formatter/linter command modifies files you have previously read, preventing stale-edit errors
changes.summary: 格式化后提醒避免编辑过期
changes.summary_en: Warn when formatter changes previously read files
changes.why_matters: 减少因文件被外部修改而导致的过期编辑错误。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps avoid stale-edit errors after files are modified by tools.

changes.raw: Improved `@`-mention typeahead to rank source files above MCP resources with similar names
changes.summary: @提及补全优先源码文件
changes.summary_en: Rank source files above MCP resources in @-mentions
changes.why_matters: 让补全结果更符合开发者常用目标，提高选择效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes typeahead suggestions more relevant for coding workflows.

changes.raw: Improved PowerShell tool prompt with version-appropriate syntax guidance (5.1 vs 7+)
changes.summary: PowerShell 提示更贴合版本
changes.summary_en: Add version-aware syntax guidance for PowerShell
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户按 5.1 或 7+ 正确编写命令，减少报错。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces command errors by guiding users with the right PowerShell syntax.

changes.raw: Changed `Edit` to work on files viewed via `Bash` with `sed -n` or `cat`, without requiring a separate `Read` call first
changes.summary: 支持从 Bash 视图直接编辑文件
changes.summary_en: Allow Edit on files viewed via Bash without extra Read
changes.why_matters: 减少重复读取步骤，让编辑流程更顺畅高效。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes an extra step and speeds up the edit workflow.

changes.raw: Changed hook output over 50K characters to be saved to disk with a file path + preview instead of being injected directly into context
changes.summary: 超长 hook 输出改为落盘保存
changes.summary_en: Save oversized hook output to disk with preview
changes.why_matters: 避免超大输出直接注入上下文，降低性能和安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids injecting huge outputs into context, reducing performance and safety risks.

changes.raw: Changed `cleanupPeriodDays: 0` in settings.json to be rejected with a validation error — it previously silently disabled transcript persistence
changes.summary: 禁止无效清理天数配置
changes.summary_en: Reject invalid cleanupPeriodDays: 0 setting
changes.why_matters: 防止用户误配导致转录持久化被静默关闭。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents a misconfiguration from silently disabling transcript persistence.

changes.raw: Changed thinking summaries to no longer be generated by default in interactive sessions — set `showThinkingSummaries: true` in settings.json to restore
changes.summary: 默认关闭思考摘要生成
changes.summary_en: Thinking summaries are no longer generated by default
changes.why_matters: 会改变交互输出内容，可能影响依赖该摘要的工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: This changes default interactive output and may affect workflows that rely on summaries.

changes.raw: Documented `TaskCreated` hook event and its blocking behavior
changes.summary: 补充 TaskCreated 钩子文档
changes.summary_en: Document TaskCreated hook event and blocking behavior
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户正确理解钩子事件及其阻塞语义。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users understand the hook event and its blocking behavior.

changes.raw: Preserved task notifications when backgrounding a running command with Ctrl+B
changes.summary: 后台运行时保留任务通知
changes.summary_en: Keep task notifications when backgrounded
changes.why_matters: 用户切换到后台后仍能及时看到任务状态，减少错过完成提醒。
changes.why_matters_en: Users still get timely task status updates after backgrounding, reducing missed completion alerts.

changes.raw: PowerShell tool on Windows: external-command arguments containing both a double-quote and whitespace now prompt instead of auto-allowing (PS 5.1 argument-splitting hardening)
changes.summary: PowerShell外部命令参数加固
changes.summary_en: Harden PowerShell external args handling
changes.why_matters: 这能防止包含引号和空白的参数被自动放行，降低 Windows 上的命令注入风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents auto-allowing quoted whitespace arguments and reduces command-injection risk on Windows.

changes.raw: `/env` now applies to PowerShell tool commands (previously only affected Bash)
changes.summary: /env支持PowerShell命令
changes.summary_en: Apply /env to PowerShell commands
changes.why_matters: 用户现在可以用同一套环境配置影响 PowerShell 工具命令，跨 shell 行为更一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now apply the same environment settings to PowerShell tool commands for more consistent shell behavior.

changes.raw: `/usage` now hides redundant "Current week (Sonnet only)" bar for Pro and Enterprise plans
changes.summary: 简化/usage周统计显示
changes.summary_en: Hide redundant /usage weekly bar
changes.why_matters: 减少重复信息，让 Pro 和 Enterprise 用户更快看懂用量面板。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes duplicate information so Pro and Enterprise users can read usage stats more easily.

changes.raw: Image paste no longer inserts a trailing space
changes.summary: 图片粘贴不再多出空格
changes.summary_en: Stop trailing space after image paste
changes.why_matters: 避免粘贴图片后破坏提示词格式，减少额外清理工作。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids formatting glitches after pasting images and saves users from cleanup.

changes.raw: Pasting `!command` into an empty prompt now enters bash mode, matching typed `!` behavior
changes.summary: 空提示粘贴!命令进入bash模式
changes.summary_en: Paste !command enters bash mode
changes.why_matters: 粘贴和手动输入的行为一致，减少用户在 shell 模式切换上的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Pasted and typed input now behave consistently, reducing confusion around shell mode switching.

changes.raw: `/buddy` is here for April 1st — hatch a small creature that watches you code
changes.summary: 新增愚人节小宠物功能
changes.summary_en: April Fools pet companion
changes.why_matters: 这是一个节日彩蛋，主要提供趣味体验而非生产力提升。
changes.why_matters_en: This is a holiday easter egg meant for fun rather than productivity.

changes.raw: Fixed messages in Cowork Dispatch not getting delivered
changes.summary: 修复 Cowork Dispatch 消息未送达
changes.summary_en: Fix Cowork Dispatch message delivery
changes.why_matters: 确保协作消息能正常送达，避免任务沟通中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures collaboration messages are delivered reliably, preventing communication breakdowns.

The Claude Code Source Leak: fake tools, frustration regexes, undercover mode
Claude Code Unpacked : A visual guide
