changes.raw: Added `X-Claude-Code-Session-Id` header to API requests so proxies can aggregate requests by session without parsing the body
changes.summary: 请求加会话ID便于代理聚合
changes.summary_en: Add session ID header for proxy grouping
changes.why_matters: 代理可以按会话聚合请求，提升可观测性和分析效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Proxies can group requests by session, improving observability and analysis.

changes.raw: Added `.jj` and `.sl` to VCS directory exclusion lists so Grep and file autocomplete don't descend into Jujutsu or Sapling metadata
changes.summary: 忽略更多VCS元数据目录
changes.summary_en: Ignore more VCS metadata directories
changes.why_matters: 减少无关目录被遍历，提升搜索和补全体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It avoids traversing irrelevant metadata, improving search and autocomplete.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` failing with "tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks" on sessions created before v2.1.85
changes.summary: 修复旧会话续接失败
changes.summary_en: Fix resume for pre-v2.1.85 sessions
changes.why_matters: 用户可以继续使用旧版本创建的会话，不会因升级而中断工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can resume sessions created before the upgrade without workflow interruption.

changes.raw: Fixed Write/Edit/Read failing on files outside the project root (e.g., `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`) when conditional skills or rules are configured
changes.summary: 修复根目录外文件读写
changes.summary_en: Fix file access outside project root
changes.why_matters: 允许规则和技能正常访问用户配置文件等项目外资源，避免核心功能失效。
changes.why_matters_en: It restores access to user config files and other out-of-root resources, preventing core features from breaking.

changes.raw: Fixed unnecessary config disk writes on every skill invocation that could cause performance issues and config corruption on Windows
changes.summary: 减少技能调用的磁盘写入
changes.summary_en: Reduce config writes on skill calls
changes.why_matters: 降低性能开销并避免 Windows 上的配置损坏风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces overhead and avoids config corruption risk on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed potential out-of-memory crash when using `/feedback` on very long sessions with large transcript files
changes.summary: 修复长会话反馈内存崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix OOM crash in /feedback on long sessions
changes.why_matters: 防止在长对话中提交反馈时崩溃，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents crashes when sending feedback in long conversations, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `--bare` mode dropping MCP tools in interactive sessions and silently discarding messages enqueued mid-turn
changes.summary: 修复bare模式丢失MCP工具
changes.summary_en: Fix bare mode dropping MCP tools
changes.why_matters: 确保交互会话中工具和消息不会被静默丢弃，避免任务中断。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures tools and queued messages are not silently dropped, preventing interrupted tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed the `c` shortcut copying only ~20 characters of the OAuth login URL instead of the full URL
changes.summary: 修复复制OAuth链接不完整
changes.summary_en: Fix copying full OAuth login URL
changes.why_matters: 用户可以正确复制完整登录链接，减少认证失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can copy the full login link correctly, reducing authentication failures.

changes.raw: Fixed masked input (e.g., OAuth code paste) leaking the start of the token when wrapping across multiple lines on narrow terminals
changes.summary: 修复窄终端下令牌泄露
changes.summary_en: Fix token leakage on narrow terminals
changes.why_matters: 避免在换行显示时泄露敏感认证信息。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents sensitive authentication data from leaking when wrapped across lines.

changes.raw: Fixed official marketplace plugin scripts failing with "Permission denied" on macOS/Linux since v2.1.83
changes.summary: 修复插件脚本权限错误
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin script permission errors
changes.why_matters: 官方插件在 macOS 和 Linux 上可以正常安装和运行。
changes.why_matters_en: Official plugins can install and run correctly on macOS and Linux.

changes.raw: Fixed statusline showing another session's model when running multiple Claude Code instances and using `/model` in one of them
changes.summary: 修复多实例状态栏串会话
changes.summary_en: Fix statusline session/model mix-up
changes.why_matters: 多开 Claude Code 时状态显示更准确，减少误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Status information stays accurate when running multiple Claude Code instances.

changes.raw: Fixed scroll not following new messages after wheel scroll or click-to-select at the bottom of a long conversation
changes.summary: 修复滚动不跟随新消息
changes.summary_en: Fix auto-scroll after manual scrolling
changes.why_matters: 长对话中阅读最新消息更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes following new messages in long conversations smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin` uninstall dialog: pressing `n` now correctly uninstalls the plugin while preserving its data directory
changes.summary: 修复卸载插件保留数据目录
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin uninstall preserving data dir
changes.why_matters: 卸载插件时不会误删用户数据，降低数据丢失风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Uninstalling a plugin no longer risks deleting user data, reducing data loss.

changes.raw: Fixed a regression where pressing Enter after clicking could leave the transcript blank until the response arrived
changes.summary: 修复点击后回车空白回显
changes.summary_en: Fix blank transcript after click+Enter
changes.why_matters: 改善交互稳定性，避免用户误以为消息丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves interaction reliability and avoids the impression that messages were lost.

changes.raw: Fixed `ultrathink` hint lingering after deleting the keyword
changes.summary: 修复ultrathink提示残留
changes.summary_en: Fix lingering ultrathink hint
changes.why_matters: 删除关键词后界面提示会及时消失，减少干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: The hint disappears promptly after deleting the keyword, reducing UI clutter.

changes.raw: Fixed memory growth in long sessions from markdown/highlight render caches retaining full content strings
changes.summary: 修复长会话内存增长
changes.summary_en: Fix memory growth in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 避免长时间使用时内存持续上涨，提升稳定性并减少卡顿或崩溃风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents memory from growing over long sessions, improving stability and reducing lag or crashes.

changes.raw: Reduced startup event-loop stalls when many claude.ai MCP connectors are configured (macOS keychain cache extended from 5s to 30s)
changes.summary: 减少多连接启动卡顿
changes.summary_en: Reduce startup stalls with many connectors
changes.why_matters: 在配置大量 MCP 连接器时启动更快，减少界面和事件循环阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: Startup is faster and the event loop blocks less when many MCP connectors are configured.

changes.raw: Reduced token overhead when mentioning files with `@` — raw string content no longer JSON-escaped
changes.summary: 降低@文件引用令牌开销
changes.summary_en: Lower token cost for @ file mentions
changes.why_matters: 减少文件引用带来的上下文消耗，让可用 token 更集中在实际任务上。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces context overhead from file mentions so more tokens remain for the actual task.

changes.raw: Improved prompt cache hit rate for Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry users by removing dynamic content from tool descriptions
changes.summary: 提升工具描述缓存命中
changes.summary_en: Improve prompt cache hits for tool descriptions
changes.why_matters: 让 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 用户更容易复用缓存，降低重复提示成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry users reuse cache more often, lowering repeated prompt cost.

changes.raw: Memory filenames in the "Saved N memories" notice now highlight on hover and open on click
changes.summary: 记忆文件可悬停点击打开
changes.summary_en: Memory filenames now hover and open
changes.why_matters: 让“已保存记忆”提示更易交互，方便快速查看相关文件。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes the saved-memory notice more interactive and easier to inspect related files.

changes.raw: Skill descriptions in the `/skills` listing are now capped at 250 characters to reduce context usage
changes.summary: 限制技能描述长度
changes.summary_en: Cap skill descriptions to save context
changes.why_matters: 减少 `/skills` 列表占用的上下文，提升可用 token 效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces context usage in `/skills`, improving token efficiency.

changes.raw: Changed `/skills` menu to sort alphabetically for easier scanning
changes.summary: 技能菜单按字母排序
changes.summary_en: Sort the skills menu alphabetically
changes.why_matters: 让技能列表更容易扫描和查找，提升日常使用效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes the skills list easier to scan and find items in daily use.

changes.raw: Auto mode now shows "unavailable for your plan" when disabled by plan restrictions (was "temporarily unavailable")
changes.summary: 明确计划限制不可用状态
changes.summary_en: Show plan-restricted unavailable state
changes.why_matters: 更清楚地说明 Auto mode 受套餐限制，减少误解和排查时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Clarifies that Auto mode is blocked by plan limits, reducing confusion and troubleshooting time.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed extension incorrectly showing "Not responding" during long-running operations
changes.summary: 修复VSCode长任务误报未响应
changes.summary_en: Fix VSCode false 'Not responding' status
changes.why_matters: 避免长时间操作时扩展误报异常状态，减少用户误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the extension from falsely reporting a bad state during long operations.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed extension defaulting Max plan users to Sonnet after the OAuth token refreshes (8 hours after login)
changes.summary: 修复刷新后计划模型回退
changes.summary_en: Fix model fallback after token refresh
changes.why_matters: 避免 Max 计划用户在 OAuth 刷新后被错误切到 Sonnet，防止工作流中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents Max plan users from being incorrectly switched to Sonnet after OAuth refresh.

changes.raw: Read tool now uses compact line-number format and deduplicates unchanged re-reads, reducing token usage
changes.summary: 精简Read输出减少令牌
changes.summary_en: Compact Read output to reduce tokens
changes.why_matters: 降低读取文件时的上下文开销，并减少重复重读带来的浪费。
changes.why_matters_en: Cuts context cost when reading files and avoids waste from repeated unchanged reads.

signals.title: Claude Code's source code has been leaked via a map file in their NPM registry
The Claude Code Source Leak: fake tools, frustration regexes, undercover mode
Claude Code Unpacked : A visual guide
Tell HN: Anthropic no longer allowing Claude Code subscriptions to use OpenClaw
Claude Code Cheat Sheet

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_NAME` and `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_URL` environment variables to MCP `headersHelper` scripts, allowing one helper to serve multiple servers
changes.summary: MCP头部脚本支持多服务器复用
changes.summary_en: MCP headersHelper can serve multiple servers
changes.why_matters: 同一个头部脚本现在可以通过环境变量区分不同服务器，减少重复配置并提升可维护性。
changes.why_matters_en: One headersHelper script can now distinguish servers via env vars, reducing duplicate setup and improving maintainability.

changes.raw: Added conditional `if` field for hooks using permission rule syntax (e.g., `Bash(git *)`) to filter when they run, reducing process spawning overhead
changes.summary: Hook支持条件过滤减少开销
changes.summary_en: Hooks can now be conditionally filtered
changes.why_matters: 可按权限规则决定 hook 是否运行，减少不必要的进程启动和执行成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Hooks can now be gated by permission-style rules, reducing unnecessary process spawning and runtime overhead.

changes.raw: Added timestamp markers in transcripts when scheduled tasks (`/loop`, `CronCreate`) fire
changes.summary: 转录记录计划任务触发时间
changes.summary_en: Transcripts now mark scheduled task triggers
changes.why_matters: 在回放和排查自动任务时，时间标记能帮助用户更容易理解任务何时触发。
changes.why_matters_en: Timestamp markers make it easier to understand when scheduled tasks fired during replay or debugging.

changes.raw: Added trailing space after `[Image #N]` placeholder when pasting images
changes.summary: 粘贴图片占位符补空格
changes.summary_en: Image paste placeholder now adds trailing space
changes.why_matters: 避免图片占位符与后续文本粘连，提升输入格式正确性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents the image placeholder from merging with following text, improving input formatting.

changes.raw: Deep link queries (`claude-cli://open?q=…`) now support up to 5,000 characters, with a "scroll to review" warning for long pre-filled prompts
changes.summary: 深链支持更长预填内容
changes.summary_en: Deep links now support longer prefilled prompts
changes.why_matters: 用户可以通过链接预填更长的提示词，并在过长时获得审阅提醒，减少截断风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can prefill longer prompts via deep links and get a review warning when content is lengthy, reducing truncation risk.

changes.raw: MCP OAuth now follows RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata discovery to find the authorization server
changes.summary: MCP OAuth支持资源元数据发现
changes.summary_en: MCP OAuth now uses resource metadata discovery
changes.why_matters: 自动发现授权服务器让 MCP OAuth 配置更标准化，减少手动配置和接入失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Automatic authorization-server discovery makes MCP OAuth setup more standard and reduces manual configuration failures.

changes.raw: Plugins blocked by organization policy (`managed-settings.json`) can no longer be installed or enabled, and are hidden from marketplace views
changes.summary: 受策略限制插件禁止安装启用
changes.summary_en: Policy-blocked plugins can no longer be installed
changes.why_matters: 组织策略现在能真正阻止受限插件被安装或启用，降低供应链和合规风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Organization policy now truly prevents restricted plugins from being installed or enabled, reducing supply-chain and compliance risk.

changes.raw: PreToolUse hooks can now satisfy `AskUserQuestion` by returning `updatedInput` alongside `permissionDecision: "allow"`, enabling headless integrations that collect answers via their own UI
changes.summary: PreToolUse可代答用户问题
changes.summary_en: PreToolUse can answer AskUserQuestion headlessly
changes.why_matters: 外部集成可以用自己的界面收集答案并回填，支持无头自动化工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: External integrations can collect answers in their own UI and feed them back, enabling headless automation workflows.

changes.raw: `tool_parameters` in OpenTelemetry tool_result events are now gated behind `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`
changes.summary: OTel工具参数默认隐藏
changes.summary_en: OTel tool parameters are now opt-in
changes.why_matters: 默认不再导出敏感工具参数，降低遥测日志中泄露细节的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Sensitive tool parameters are no longer exported by default, reducing the risk of leaking details in telemetry logs.

changes.raw: Fixed `/compact` failing with "context exceeded" when the conversation has grown too large for the compact request itself to fit
changes.summary: compact不再因上下文过大失败
changes.summary_en: /compact no longer fails on oversized context
changes.why_matters: 当对话很长时，压缩命令现在更可靠，避免用户在整理上下文时中断。
changes.why_matters_en: The compact command is now more reliable on long conversations, avoiding interruptions when users need context reduction.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin enable` and `/plugin disable` failing when a plugin's install location differs from where it's declared in settings
changes.summary: 插件启停支持不同安装路径
changes.summary_en: /plugin enable/disable works across install paths
changes.why_matters: 插件即使安装位置与配置声明不同，也能正确启用或禁用，减少管理失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins can now be enabled or disabled correctly even when their install location differs from the declared settings path.

changes.raw: Fixed `--worktree` exiting with an error in non-git repositories before the `WorktreeCreate` hook could run
changes.summary: 非Git仓库也能先跑worktree钩子
changes.summary_en: --worktree no longer errors before hook
changes.why_matters: 在非 Git 仓库中也能先触发 WorktreeCreate hook，避免过早报错影响自动化流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Non-git repositories can now reach the WorktreeCreate hook instead of failing early, improving automation flow reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `deniedMcpServers` setting not blocking claude.ai MCP servers
changes.summary: claude.ai MCP封禁设置生效
changes.summary_en: deniedMcpServers now blocks claude.ai MCP servers
changes.why_matters: 被禁止的 MCP 服务器现在会被正确拦截，强化了访问控制和策略执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Denied MCP servers are now properly blocked, strengthening access control and policy enforcement.

changes.raw: Fixed `switch_display` in the computer-use tool returning "not available in this session" on multi-monitor setups
changes.summary: 多屏下可切换显示器
changes.summary_en: switch_display works on multi-monitor setups
changes.why_matters: 电脑控制工具在多显示器环境下更稳定，提升远程操作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: The computer-use tool is more reliable in multi-monitor environments, improving remote control usability.

changes.raw: Fixed crash when `OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER`, `OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER`, or `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER` is set to `none`
changes.summary: OTel导出器设为none不再崩溃
changes.summary_en: No crash when OTel exporters are set to none
changes.why_matters: 禁用日志、指标或追踪导出时不再导致崩溃，提升生产环境稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Disabling logs, metrics, or traces exporters no longer crashes the app, improving production stability.

changes.raw: Fixed diff syntax highlighting not working in non-native builds
changes.summary: 修复非原生构建差异高亮
changes.summary_en: Fix diff highlighting in non-native builds
changes.why_matters: 让非原生构建下的差异显示恢复正常，提升代码审阅体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores diff highlighting in non-native builds, improving code review usability.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP step-up authorization failing when a refresh token exists — servers requesting elevated scopes via `403 insufficient_scope` now correctly trigger the re-authorization flow
changes.summary: 修复MCP提权重认证失败
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP re-auth on insufficient scope
changes.why_matters: 当服务器请求更高权限时能正确触发重新授权，避免功能因权限不足而中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures elevated-scope requests correctly re-trigger authorization instead of failing.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak in remote sessions when a streaming response is interrupted
changes.summary: 修复远程会话流中断内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix memory leak in interrupted remote streams
changes.why_matters: 减少远程会话在异常中断时的资源泄漏，提升稳定性和长期运行可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents resource leaks when remote streams are interrupted, improving stability over time.

changes.raw: Fixed persistent ECONNRESET errors during edge connection churn by using a fresh TCP connection on retry
changes.summary: 修复边缘连接重试断连
changes.summary_en: Fix ECONNRESET on edge connection retries
changes.why_matters: 在连接抖动时使用新TCP连接重试，降低持续断连导致的任务失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Using a fresh TCP connection on retry reduces failures during edge connection churn.

changes.raw: Fixed prompts getting stuck in the queue after running certain slash commands, with up-arrow unable to retrieve them
changes.summary: 修复命令后提示词卡队列
changes.summary_en: Fix prompts stuck after slash commands
changes.why_matters: 避免执行某些斜杠命令后输入队列卡住，保证继续交互和历史回溯正常。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the prompt queue from getting stuck after slash commands, keeping input flow usable.

changes.raw: Fixed Python Agent SDK: `type:'sdk'` MCP servers passed via `--mcp-config` are no longer dropped during startup
changes.summary: 修复MCP配置启动丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP servers dropped on startup
changes.why_matters: 确保通过启动参数配置的MCP服务器能被正确加载，避免集成能力缺失。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures MCP servers passed via startup config are preserved, avoiding missing integrations.

changes.raw: Fixed raw key sequences appearing in the prompt when running over SSH or in the VS Code integrated terminal
changes.summary: 修复SSH终端原始按键串
changes.summary_en: Fix raw key sequences in SSH terminals
changes.why_matters: 避免在SSH或VS Code终端中显示乱码按键序列，提升终端输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents raw key sequences from appearing in SSH or VS Code terminals, improving input UX.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control session status staying stuck on "Requires Action" after a permission is resolved
changes.summary: 修复远控权限后状态不更新
changes.summary_en: Fix remote control status after permission
changes.why_matters: 权限问题解决后状态能及时恢复，避免会话一直停留在需要处理的假死状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps remote control session status in sync after permissions are resolved, avoiding stale state.

changes.raw: Fixed shift+enter and meta+enter being intercepted by typeahead suggestions instead of inserting newlines
changes.summary: 修复补全误拦截换行键
changes.summary_en: Fix autocomplete intercepting newlines
changes.why_matters: 让Shift+Enter和Meta+Enter能正常换行，减少输入被补全建议抢占的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows Shift+Enter and Meta+Enter to insert newlines instead of being swallowed by suggestions.

changes.raw: Fixed stale content bleeding through when scrolling up during streaming
changes.summary: 修复滚动时流式内容残影
changes.summary_en: Fix stale content during streaming scroll
changes.why_matters: 改善流式输出滚动时的显示正确性，减少旧内容残留造成的视觉混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves rendering correctness during streaming scroll, reducing visual artifacts.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal left in enhanced keyboard mode after exit in Ghostty, Kitty, WezTerm, and other terminals supporting the Kitty keyboard protocol — Ctrl+C and Ctrl+D now work correctly after quitting
changes.summary: 修复退出后终端键盘模式残留
changes.summary_en: Fix terminal keyboard mode after exit
changes.why_matters: 退出后恢复正常键盘行为，避免Ctrl+C/Ctrl+D失效影响终端控制。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores normal terminal key handling after exit so Ctrl+C and Ctrl+D work correctly.

changes.raw: Improved @-mention file autocomplete performance on large repositories
changes.summary: 提升大仓库文件补全速度
changes.summary_en: Speed up file autocomplete in large repos
changes.why_matters: 在大型仓库中补全更快，减少等待时间并提升日常使用效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes @-mention file autocomplete faster in large repositories, reducing wait time.

changes.raw: Improved PowerShell dangerous command detection
changes.summary: 增强PowerShell危险命令检测
changes.summary_en: Improve dangerous command detection in PowerShell
changes.why_matters: 更好地识别高风险命令，降低误执行带来的安全和操作风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves detection of risky commands, reducing the chance of unsafe execution.

changes.raw: Improved scroll performance with large transcripts by replacing WASM yoga-layout with a pure TypeScript implementation
changes.summary: 提升大日志滚动性能
changes.summary_en: Improve scrolling performance for large transcripts
changes.why_matters: 大输出场景下滚动更流畅，减少卡顿并改善长会话可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes scrolling smoother for large transcripts, reducing lag in long sessions.

changes.raw: Reduced UI stutter when compaction triggers on large sessions
changes.summary: 减少大会话压缩卡顿
changes.summary_en: Reduce stutter during compaction on large sessions
changes.why_matters: 在大会话触发压缩时界面更顺滑，提升复杂任务中的交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces UI stutter when compaction runs on large sessions, improving responsiveness.

signals.title: Claude Code's source code has been leaked via a map file in their NPM registry
The Claude Code Source Leak: fake tools, frustration regexes, undercover mode
Claude Code Unpacked : A visual guide
Claude Code Cheat Sheet
Push events into a running session with channels

changes.raw: Added PowerShell tool for Windows as an opt-in preview. Learn more at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference#powershell-tool
changes.summary: 新增 Windows PowerShell 工具预览
changes.summary_en: Add PowerShell tool preview on Windows
changes.why_matters: 让 Windows 用户可以在预览中使用 PowerShell 工具，提升跨平台自动化能力。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets Windows users try the PowerShell tool, improving cross-platform automation.

changes.raw: Added `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL_SUPPORTS` env vars to override effort/thinking capability detection for pinned default models for 3p (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry), and `_MODEL_NAME`/`_DESCRIPTION` to customize the `/model` picker label
changes.summary: 可自定义默认模型能力标识
changes.summary_en: Customize default model capability labels
changes.why_matters: 支持第三方模型更准确地显示推理/思考能力，减少模型选择误导。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets third-party models show more accurate reasoning labels, reducing confusion in model selection.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` env var to configure the streaming idle watchdog threshold (default 90s)
changes.summary: 可配置流式空闲超时阈值
changes.summary_en: Configurable streaming idle timeout
changes.why_matters: 用户可按网络环境调整流式等待超时，减少误判卡住的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can tune streaming timeouts for their network, reducing false stuck detections.

changes.raw: Added `TaskCreated` hook that fires when a task is created via `TaskCreate`
changes.summary: 新增任务创建钩子
changes.summary_en: Add TaskCreated hook
changes.why_matters: 允许在任务创建时触发自动化流程，便于扩展工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: It enables automation when tasks are created, making workflows easier to extend.

changes.raw: Added `WorktreeCreate` hook support for `type: "http"` — return the created worktree path via `hookSpecificOutput.worktreePath` in the response JSON
changes.summary: HTTP 工作树钩子返回路径
changes.summary_en: HTTP worktree hook returns path
changes.why_matters: HTTP 钩子现在能把创建结果回传给 CLI，方便后续自动化接续处理。
changes.why_matters_en: HTTP hooks can now return the created worktree path, enabling smoother follow-up automation.

changes.raw: Added `allowedChannelPlugins` managed setting for team/enterprise admins to define a channel plugin allowlist
changes.summary: 团队可配置频道插件白名单
changes.summary_en: Admin allowlist for channel plugins
changes.why_matters: 管理员可控制可用插件范围，提升团队治理与安全性。
changes.why_matters_en: Admins can control which plugins are allowed, improving governance and safety.

changes.raw: Added `x-client-request-id` header to API requests for debugging timeouts
changes.summary: 请求增加超时排查 ID
changes.summary_en: Add request ID for timeout debugging
changes.why_matters: 便于定位 API 超时问题，加快排障和支持响应。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes API timeout issues easier to trace, speeding up debugging and support.

changes.raw: Added idle-return prompt that nudges users returning after 75+ minutes to `/clear`, reducing unnecessary token re-caching on stale sessions
changes.summary: 久未返回时提示清理会话
changes.summary_en: Prompt to clear stale sessions
changes.why_matters: 减少长时间离开后重新缓存 token 的浪费，提升会话效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces wasted token re-caching after long idle periods, improving session efficiency.

changes.raw: Deep links (`claude-cli://`) now open in your preferred terminal instead of whichever terminal happens to be first in the detection list
changes.summary: claude-cli 深链优先打开常用终端
changes.summary_en: Deep links open in preferred terminal
changes.why_matters: 点击深链时会打开用户偏好的终端，减少跳转到错误应用的困扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Deep links now open in the user's preferred terminal, avoiding the wrong app.

changes.raw: Rules and skills `paths:` frontmatter now accepts a YAML list of globs
changes.summary: 规则与技能支持 globs 列表
changes.summary_en: Rules and skills accept glob lists
changes.why_matters: frontmatter 可用 YAML 列表表达多个路径模式，配置更灵活。
changes.why_matters_en: Frontmatter can now express multiple path patterns with YAML lists, making configuration more flexible.

changes.raw: MCP tool descriptions and server instructions are now capped at 2KB to prevent OpenAPI-generated servers from bloating context
changes.summary: 限制 MCP 描述长度防止膨胀
changes.summary_en: Cap MCP descriptions to prevent bloat
changes.why_matters: 避免 OpenAPI 生成的 MCP 说明占用过多上下文，提升整体可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents OpenAPI-generated MCP text from bloating context, improving overall usability.

changes.raw: MCP servers configured both locally and via claude.ai connectors are now deduplicated — the local config wins
changes.summary: 本地与云端 MCP 自动去重
changes.summary_en: Deduplicate local and cloud MCP servers
changes.why_matters: 减少重复服务器配置带来的混乱，且本地配置优先生效。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes duplicate server entries and ensures local config takes precedence.

changes.raw: Background bash tasks that appear stuck on an interactive prompt now surface a notification after ~45 seconds
changes.summary: 卡住的后台任务会提醒
changes.summary_en: Notify on stuck background tasks
changes.why_matters: 交互式卡住时能及时提醒用户，减少无响应等待。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get notified when a background task seems stuck, reducing silent waiting.

changes.raw: Token counts ≥1M now display as "1.5m" instead of "1512.6k"
changes.summary: 百万级 token 显示更易读
changes.summary_en: Improve large token count display
changes.why_matters: 让超大 token 数量显示更简洁，提升可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Large token counts are displayed more cleanly, improving readability.

changes.raw: Global system-prompt caching now works when `ToolSearch` is enabled, including for users with MCP tools configured
changes.summary: 启用 ToolSearch 也支持缓存
changes.summary_en: Global prompt caching works with ToolSearch
changes.why_matters: 在启用 ToolSearch 和 MCP 工具时仍能使用全局系统提示缓存，降低延迟和成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Global system-prompt caching now works with ToolSearch and MCP tools, reducing latency and cost.

changes.raw: Fixed voice push-to-talk: holding the voice key no longer leaks characters into the text input, and transcripts now insert at the correct position
changes.summary: 修复语音输入串字与插入位置
changes.summary_en: Fix voice input leakage and insertion
changes.why_matters: 语音转文字不会再污染输入框，且内容会插到正确位置，提升语音输入可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice dictation no longer corrupts the prompt and inserts at the right cursor position.

changes.raw: Fixed up/down arrow keys being unresponsive when a footer item is focused
changes.summary: 修复方向键在页脚失效
changes.summary_en: Fix arrow keys when footer is focused
changes.why_matters: 当焦点在页脚项时，用户可以正常用上下键导航，不会卡住界面操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can navigate footer-focused UI items with arrow keys again.

changes.raw: Fixed `Ctrl+U` (kill-to-line-start) being a no-op at line boundaries in multiline input, so repeated `Ctrl+U` now clears across lines
changes.summary: 修复多行输入 Ctrl+U 清除
changes.summary_en: Fix Ctrl+U clearing across lines
changes.why_matters: 在多行输入里，Ctrl+U 现在能按预期连续清除内容，减少编辑阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: Ctrl+U now clears multiline input correctly across line boundaries.

changes.raw: Fixed null-unbinding a default chord binding (e.g. `"ctrl+x ctrl+k": null`) still entering chord-wait mode instead of freeing the prefix key
changes.summary: 修复解绑快捷键仍进入等待
changes.summary_en: Fix null-unbound chords freeing prefixes
changes.why_matters: 被显式解绑的前缀键不再误进入组合键等待模式，快捷键配置更符合预期。
changes.why_matters_en: Explicitly unbound chord prefixes now behave as freed keys instead of waiting for chords.

changes.raw: Fixed mouse events inserting literal "mouse" text into transcript search input
changes.summary: 修复鼠标事件污染搜索框
changes.summary_en: Fix mouse events leaking into search input
changes.why_matters: 鼠标操作不会再把无意义文本写进搜索框，避免干扰检索。
changes.why_matters_en: Mouse interactions no longer inject stray text into transcript search.

changes.raw: Fixed workflow subagents failing with API 400 when the outer session uses `--json-schema` and the subagent also specifies a schema
changes.summary: 修复子代理 JSON Schema 400
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent 400 with nested schemas
changes.why_matters: 外层会话和子代理同时使用 schema 时不再报 400，工作流子代理可正常运行。
changes.why_matters_en: Subagents now work when both parent and child sessions use JSON Schema.

changes.raw: Fixed missing background color behind certain emoji in user message bubbles on some terminals
changes.summary: 修复表情背景色缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix missing emoji bubble backgrounds
changes.why_matters: 部分终端里消息气泡显示更完整，表情周围不会出现异常空白。
changes.why_matters_en: Message bubbles render more consistently around emoji on affected terminals.

changes.raw: Fixed the "allow Claude to edit its own settings for this session" permission option not sticking for users with `Edit(.claude)` allow rules
changes.summary: 修复会话设置权限不生效
changes.summary_en: Fix session settings permission sticking
changes.why_matters: 允许 Claude 修改本会话设置的权限现在能正确保存，减少重复授权。
changes.why_matters_en: The permission to let Claude edit session settings now persists correctly.

changes.raw: Fixed a hang when generating attachment snippets for large edited files
changes.summary: 修复大文件附件片段卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix hang generating large file snippets
changes.why_matters: 生成大编辑文件的附件摘要时不再挂起，提升大项目处理稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Snippet generation for large edited files no longer hangs.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tool/resource cache leak on server reconnect
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 重连缓存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP cache leak on reconnect
changes.why_matters: 服务器重连后不会持续泄漏资源，长期运行更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Reconnects no longer leak MCP tool/resource cache entries.

changes.raw: Fixed a startup performance issue where partial clone repositories (Scalar/GVFS) triggered mass blob downloads
changes.summary: 修复部分克隆启动暴量下载
changes.summary_en: Fix partial-clone startup blob downloads
changes.why_matters: Scalar/GVFS 仓库启动更快，不会因误触发大量 blob 下载而拖慢初始化。
changes.why_matters_en: Startup is faster for partial-clone repos because mass blob downloads are avoided.

changes.raw: Fixed native terminal cursor not tracking the text input caret, so IME composition (CJK input) now renders inline and screen readers can follow the input position
changes.summary: 修复光标与输入法位置不同步
changes.summary_en: Fix cursor tracking for IME and screen readers
changes.why_matters: 原生终端光标能跟随输入位置，CJK 输入法联想和读屏辅助都更准确。
changes.why_matters_en: The terminal cursor now tracks the caret, improving IME composition and screen reader accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed spurious "Not logged in" errors on macOS caused by transient keychain read failures
changes.summary: 修复 macOS 假性未登录提示
changes.summary_en: Fix false not-logged-in macOS errors
changes.why_matters: 钥匙串短暂读取失败时不再误报未登录，减少登录状态误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Transient keychain read failures no longer trigger false not-logged-in errors.

changes.raw: Fixed cold-start race where core tools could be deferred without their bypass active, causing Edit/Write to fail with InputValidationError on typed parameters
changes.summary: 修复冷启动工具失效报错
changes.summary_en: Fix cold-start tool bypass race
changes.why_matters: 核心工具不会在绕过机制未生效时被延迟，避免 Edit/Write 因参数校验失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Core tools are no longer deferred without bypass protection, preventing Edit/Write validation failures.

changes.raw: Improved detection for dangerous removals of Windows drive roots (`C:\`, `C:\Windows`, etc.)
changes.summary: 增强 Windows 根目录删除检测
changes.summary_en: Improve detection of dangerous Windows root removals
changes.why_matters: 对 C:\ 等危险路径的删除会更早被识别，降低误删系统目录的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Dangerous deletions of Windows root paths are detected more reliably to reduce accidental data loss.

changes.raw: Improved interactive startup by ~30ms by running `setup()` in parallel with slash command and agent loading
changes.summary: 并行启动更快
changes.summary_en: Faster interactive startup
changes.why_matters: 并行加载减少了交互启动等待时间，让用户更快开始工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Parallel loading reduces interactive startup latency so users can begin sooner.

changes.raw: Improved startup for `claude "prompt"` with MCP servers — the REPL now renders immediately instead of blocking until all servers connect
changes.summary: MCP启动不再阻塞
changes.summary_en: REPL renders before MCP connects
changes.why_matters: 即使有多个 MCP 服务器，界面也能先显示，避免启动时卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: The REPL appears immediately even with MCP servers, avoiding a blocked startup.

changes.raw: Improved Remote Control to show a specific reason when blocked instead of a generic "not yet enabled" message
changes.summary: 阻止原因更明确
changes.summary_en: Clearer blocked Remote Control reason
changes.why_matters: 用户能直接看到被阻止的具体原因，更容易排查权限或配置问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see the exact reason Remote Control is blocked, making issues easier to diagnose.

changes.raw: Improved p90 prompt cache rate
changes.summary: 提示缓存命中更高
changes.summary_en: Better prompt cache hit rate
changes.why_matters: 更高的缓存命中率可以减少重复计算，提升响应速度并降低成本。
changes.why_matters_en: A higher cache hit rate reduces repeated work, improving speed and lowering cost.

changes.raw: Reduced scroll-to-top resets in long sessions by making the message window immune to compaction and grouping changes
changes.summary: 长会话少回到顶部
changes.summary_en: Fewer scroll-to-top resets
changes.why_matters: 长对话中滚动位置更稳定，阅读和回看内容不会被打断。
changes.why_matters_en: Scroll position stays stable in long sessions, so reading and reviewing are less disruptive.

changes.raw: Reduced terminal flickering when animated tool progress scrolls above the viewport
changes.summary: 减少终端闪烁
changes.summary_en: Less terminal flicker
changes.why_matters: 动画进度显示更平滑，提升终端使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Animated progress displays more smoothly, improving the terminal experience.

changes.raw: Changed issue/PR references to only become clickable links when written as `owner/repo#123` — bare `#123` is no longer auto-linked
changes.summary: 仅链接规范引用
changes.summary_en: Only link owner/repo#123 refs
changes.why_matters: 减少误链接，避免普通编号被错误识别为可点击链接。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces accidental links by preventing plain issue numbers from being auto-linked.

changes.raw: Slash commands unavailable for the current auth setup (`/voice`, `/mobile`, `/chrome`, `/upgrade`, etc.) are now hidden instead of shown
changes.summary: 隐藏不可用斜杠命令
changes.summary_en: Hide unavailable slash commands
changes.why_matters: 用户只看到当前可用命令，减少困惑和无效尝试。
changes.why_matters_en: Users only see commands they can actually use, reducing confusion and failed attempts.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added rate limit warning banner with usage percentage and reset time
changes.summary: VSCode显示限额提醒
changes.summary_en: VSCode rate limit warning banner
changes.why_matters: 用户能及时了解配额使用情况和重置时间，便于控制使用节奏。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see usage and reset timing, helping them manage consumption proactively.

changes.raw: Stats screenshot (Ctrl+S in /stats) now works in all builds and is 16× faster
changes.summary: 统计截图更快可用
changes.summary_en: Stats screenshot works and is faster
changes.why_matters: 截图功能在所有构建中都可用且更快，方便分享和排查问题。
changes.why_matters_en: The screenshot feature now works in all builds and is much faster, making sharing and debugging easier.

signals.title: Claude Code's source code has been leaked via a map file in their NPM registry
The Claude Code Source Leak: fake tools, frustration regexes, undercover mode
Claude Code Unpacked : A visual guide
Claude Code Cheat Sheet
Push events into a running session with channels

changes.raw: Added `managed-settings.d/` drop-in directory alongside `managed-settings.json`, letting separate teams deploy independent policy fragments that merge alphabetically
changes.summary: 支持分层管理策略配置
changes.summary_en: Support layered managed policy fragments
changes.why_matters: 让不同团队可以独立部署和合并策略配置，降低集中管理冲突。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets separate teams deploy and merge policy fragments independently, reducing central config conflicts.

changes.raw: Added `CwdChanged` and `FileChanged` hook events for reactive environment management (e.g., direnv)
changes.summary: 新增目录变更响应钩子
changes.summary_en: Add hooks for cwd and file changes
changes.why_matters: 可在目录或文件变化时自动更新环境，适合 direnv 等动态工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: It enables automatic environment updates on directory or file changes, fitting reactive workflows like direnv.

changes.raw: Added `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` setting to exit with an error when sandbox is enabled but cannot start, instead of running unsandboxed
changes.summary: 沙箱不可用时直接报错退出
changes.summary_en: Fail if sandbox cannot start
changes.why_matters: 避免沙箱启用失败后意外以非沙箱模式运行，减少安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents accidental unsandboxed execution when sandbox startup fails, reducing security risk.

changes.raw: Added `disableDeepLinkRegistration` setting to prevent `claude-cli://` protocol handler registration
changes.summary: 可禁用深链协议注册
changes.summary_en: Allow disabling deep link registration
changes.why_matters: 可避免注册 `claude-cli://` 协议处理器，减少系统级集成带来的暴露面。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets users avoid registering the `claude-cli://` protocol handler, reducing exposure from system integration.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1` to strip Anthropic and cloud provider credentials from subprocess environments (Bash tool, hooks, MCP stdio servers)
changes.summary: 子进程自动清理敏感环境变量
changes.summary_en: Scrub credentials from subprocess envs
changes.why_matters: 可防止凭据泄露到 Bash、hooks 和 MCP 子进程中，显著降低密钥外泄风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents credentials from leaking into Bash, hooks, and MCP subprocesses, significantly reducing secret exposure risk.

changes.raw: Added transcript search — press `/` in transcript mode (`Ctrl+O`) to search, `n`/`N` to step through matches
changes.summary: 支持会话转录搜索
changes.summary_en: Add transcript search in session view
changes.why_matters: 可以快速定位历史对话内容，提高长会话中的检索效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps quickly locate past conversation content, improving retrieval in long sessions.

changes.raw: Added `Ctrl+X Ctrl+E` as an alias for opening the external editor (readline-native binding; `Ctrl+G` still works)
changes.summary: 新增外部编辑器快捷键
changes.summary_en: Add Ctrl+X Ctrl+E editor shortcut
changes.why_matters: 提供更顺手的快捷键，提升编辑器打开效率和键盘操作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It offers a more convenient shortcut, improving editor access speed and keyboard workflow.

changes.raw: Pasted images now insert an `[Image #N]` chip at the cursor so you can reference them positionally in your prompt
changes.summary: 粘贴图片可按序引用
changes.summary_en: Pasted images get positional chips
changes.why_matters: 让用户能在提示词中按位置引用图片，提升多图输入的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets users reference pasted images positionally in prompts, improving multi-image usability.

changes.raw: Agents can now declare `initialPrompt` in frontmatter to auto-submit a first turn
changes.summary: 代理支持自动首轮提示
changes.summary_en: Agents can auto-submit an initial prompt
changes.why_matters: 可让代理启动后自动进入预设任务，减少手动交互步骤。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets agents start with a preset first turn, reducing manual setup steps.

changes.raw: `chat:killAgents` and `chat:fastMode` are now rebindable via `~/.claude/keybindings.json`
changes.summary: 快捷键可重新绑定
changes.summary_en: Make chat shortcuts rebindable
changes.why_matters: 用户可以按自己的习惯调整关键操作，提升可定制性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can tailor key actions to their preferences, improving customization.

changes.raw: Fixed mouse tracking escape sequences leaking to shell prompt after exit
changes.summary: 修复退出后鼠标序列泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix mouse tracking escape leakage
changes.why_matters: 避免退出后污染 shell 提示符，改善终端兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents shell prompt corruption after exit, improving terminal compatibility.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude Code hanging on exit on macOS
changes.summary: 修复 macOS 退出卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix hang on exit on macOS
changes.why_matters: 解决退出时挂起问题，避免用户被迫强制结束进程。
changes.why_matters_en: It resolves exit hangs and avoids forcing users to kill the process.

changes.raw: Fixed screen flashing blank after being idle for a few seconds
changes.summary: 修复空闲后屏幕闪白
changes.summary_en: Fix blank screen flashing after idle
changes.why_matters: 改善长时间空闲后的界面稳定性，减少视觉干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves UI stability after idle periods and reduces visual disruption.

changes.raw: Fixed a hang when diffing very large files with few common lines — diffs now time out after 5 seconds and fall back gracefully
changes.summary: 大文件 diff 超时回退
changes.summary_en: Timeout huge diffs and fall back
changes.why_matters: 避免超大 diff 导致卡死，让大文件比较更稳定可用。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents hangs on huge diffs and makes large-file comparison more reliable.

changes.raw: Fixed a 1–8 second UI freeze on startup when voice input was enabled, caused by eagerly loading the native audio module
changes.summary: 修复语音输入导致启动卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix startup freeze from voice input
changes.why_matters: 减少启用语音输入时的启动延迟，提升整体响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces startup latency when voice input is enabled, improving overall responsiveness.

changes.raw: Fixed a startup regression where Claude Code would wait ~3s for claude.ai MCP config fetch before proceeding
changes.summary: 启动更快，跳过MCP等待
changes.summary_en: Faster startup by skipping MCP wait
changes.why_matters: 减少启动时的无谓等待，让用户更快进入可用状态。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes unnecessary startup delay so users can begin working sooner.

changes.raw: Fixed `--mcp-config` CLI flag bypassing `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` managed policy enforcement
changes.summary: 强制策略不再被绕过
changes.summary_en: Managed MCP policy can no longer be bypassed
changes.why_matters: 确保受管策略始终生效，避免未授权的 MCP 服务器被启用。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures managed policy enforcement always applies and prevents unauthorized MCP servers from being enabled.

changes.raw: Fixed claude.ai MCP connectors (Slack, Gmail, etc.) not being available in single-turn `--print` mode
changes.summary: print模式可用MCP连接器
changes.summary_en: MCP connectors now work in --print mode
changes.why_matters: 让单轮输出模式也能访问 Slack、Gmail 等连接器，提升自动化可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets single-turn output mode access connectors like Slack and Gmail, improving automation usefulness.

changes.raw: Fixed `caffeinate` process not properly terminating when Claude Code exits, preventing Mac from sleeping
changes.summary: 退出后不再阻止Mac睡眠
changes.summary_en: Caffeinate now exits cleanly on app quit
changes.why_matters: 避免进程残留导致电脑无法休眠，减少电量和系统资源浪费。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents a lingering process from blocking sleep and wasting battery and system resources.

changes.raw: Fixed bash mode not activating when tab-accepting `!`-prefixed command suggestions
changes.summary: Tab补全可正确切换bash模式
changes.summary_en: Tab-accepted ! commands now enter bash mode
changes.why_matters: 让命令补全后的执行模式更符合预期，减少误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes execution mode behave as expected after tab completion, reducing mistakes.

changes.raw: Fixed stale slash command selection showing wrong highlighted command after navigating suggestions
changes.summary: 斜杠命令高亮不再错位
changes.summary_en: Slash command highlight stays in sync
changes.why_matters: 修复候选项高亮错误，提升命令选择的准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: It fixes incorrect highlighting so command selection is more accurate.

changes.raw: Fixed `/config` menu showing both the search cursor and list selection at the same time
changes.summary: /config搜索与选择不冲突
changes.summary_en: /config no longer shows cursor and selection together
changes.why_matters: 界面状态更清晰，减少在配置菜单中误判当前焦点。
changes.why_matters_en: The UI is clearer, reducing confusion about focus in the config menu.

changes.raw: Fixed background subagents becoming invisible after context compaction, which could cause duplicate agents to be spawned
changes.summary: 压缩后后台子代理仍可见
changes.summary_en: Background subagents stay visible after compaction
changes.why_matters: 避免重复创建代理，保证后台任务状态一致。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents duplicate agents and keeps background task state consistent.

changes.raw: Fixed background agent tasks staying stuck in "running" state when git or API calls hang during cleanup
changes.summary: 卡住的后台任务可正常结束
changes.summary_en: Hung background tasks now finish cleanly
changes.why_matters: 防止任务一直显示运行中，提升后台执行的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents tasks from getting stuck in running state and improves background execution reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `--channels` showing "Channels are not currently available" on first launch after upgrade
changes.summary: 升级后channels可正常显示
changes.summary_en: --channels works correctly after upgrade
changes.why_matters: 修复首次启动误报不可用的问题，减少升级后的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes a false unavailable message on first launch after upgrade, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed uninstalled plugin hooks continuing to fire until the next session
changes.summary: 卸载插件后钩子立即失效
changes.summary_en: Uninstalled plugin hooks stop firing immediately
changes.why_matters: 避免已卸载插件继续影响会话行为，提升插件管理一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: It stops removed plugins from affecting behavior and makes plugin management consistent.

changes.raw: Fixed queued commands flickering during streaming responses
changes.summary: 流式输出时队列不再闪烁
changes.summary_en: Queued commands no longer flicker while streaming
changes.why_matters: 改善流式响应期间的视觉稳定性，阅读体验更好。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves visual stability during streaming responses for a better reading experience.

changes.raw: Fixed slash commands being sent to the model as text when submitted while a message is processing
changes.summary: 处理中提交斜杠命令不再发给模型
changes.summary_en: Slash commands no longer become plain text
changes.why_matters: 确保命令被正确执行而不是误传给模型，避免流程中断。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures commands are executed properly instead of being sent as text to the model, avoiding workflow breaks.

changes.raw: Fixed scrollback jumping when collapsed read/search groups finish after scrolling offscreen
changes.summary: 滚动后折叠组不再跳动
changes.summary_en: Scrollback no longer jumps when groups finish
changes.why_matters: 减少历史输出区域的意外位移，提升浏览稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces unexpected movement in scrollback and improves browsing stability.

changes.raw: Fixed scrollback jumping to top when the model starts or stops thinking
changes.summary: 思考状态切换不再顶到顶部
changes.summary_en: Scrollback no longer jumps to top on thinking changes
changes.why_matters: 避免界面突然回到顶部，减少阅读和上下文跟踪中断。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents sudden jumps to the top, reducing interruptions while reading and tracking context.

changes.raw: Fixed SDK session history loss on resume caused by hook progress/attachment messages forking the parentUuid chain
changes.summary: 修复恢复会话历史丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix session history loss on resume
changes.why_matters: 避免恢复 SDK 会话时丢失历史记录，保证上下文连续性和可恢复性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents SDK session history from disappearing on resume, preserving continuity and recoverability.

changes.raw: Fixed copy-on-select not firing when you release the mouse outside the terminal window
changes.summary: 修复选中复制失效
changes.summary_en: Fix copy-on-select release behavior
changes.why_matters: 让用户在终端外松开鼠标时也能正常复制，提升基础交互可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures copy-on-select works even when the mouse is released outside the terminal, improving basic interaction reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed ghost characters appearing in height-constrained lists when items overflow
changes.summary: 修复列表溢出残影字符
changes.summary_en: Fix ghost characters in overflow lists
changes.why_matters: 避免受限高度列表显示错乱，提升界面清晰度和可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents visual corruption in height-constrained lists, improving UI clarity and readability.

changes.raw: Fixed `Ctrl+B` interfering with readline backward-char at an idle prompt — it now only fires when a foreground task can be backgrounded
changes.summary: 修复空闲时Ctrl+B冲突
changes.summary_en: Fix Ctrl+B conflict at idle prompt
changes.why_matters: 避免快捷键误触影响 readline 编辑，减少空闲提示符下的输入干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents shortcut conflicts with readline editing, reducing input interference at idle prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed tool result files never being cleaned up, ignoring the `cleanupPeriodDays` setting
changes.summary: 修复工具结果文件未清理
changes.summary_en: Fix tool result file cleanup
changes.why_matters: 确保按配置自动清理临时文件，避免磁盘占用持续增长。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures temporary files are cleaned up per configuration, preventing unbounded disk usage.

changes.raw: Fixed space key being swallowed for up to 3 seconds after releasing voice hold-to-talk
changes.summary: 修复语音后空格键卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix space key delay after voice hold
changes.why_matters: 减少语音模式结束后的输入延迟，让键盘操作更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces input lag after voice mode ends, making keyboard interaction smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed ALSA library errors corrupting the terminal UI when using voice mode on Linux without audio hardware (Docker, headless, WSL1)
changes.summary: 修复无音频硬件下语音报错
changes.summary_en: Fix voice UI corruption without audio HW
changes.why_matters: 避免在 Docker、无头环境或 WSL1 中语音模式破坏终端界面。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents voice mode from corrupting the terminal UI in Docker, headless setups, or WSL1.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode SoX detection on Termux/Android where spawning `which` is kernel-restricted
changes.summary: 修复Termux语音检测失败
changes.summary_en: Fix SoX detection on Termux/Android
changes.why_matters: 让 Android/Termux 环境下的语音功能更可靠，减少平台兼容问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes voice features more reliable on Android/Termux by avoiding platform-specific detection failures.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control sessions showing as Idle in the web session list while actively running
changes.summary: 修复远控会话空闲状态误报
changes.summary_en: Fix Remote Control idle status display
changes.why_matters: 让网页会话列表准确反映运行状态，便于监控活跃会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the web session list accurate so active Remote Control sessions are easy to monitor.

changes.raw: Fixed footer navigation selecting an invisible Remote Control pill in config-driven mode
changes.summary: 修复远控配置页不可见选项
changes.summary_en: Fix invisible Remote Control pill selection
changes.why_matters: 避免导航选中看不见的项，提升配置驱动模式下的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents navigation from selecting invisible items, improving usability in config-driven mode.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak in remote sessions where tool use IDs accumulate indefinitely
changes.summary: 修复远程会话内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix remote session memory leak
changes.why_matters: 防止远程会话中工具调用 ID 无限累积，降低长期运行风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents tool-use IDs from accumulating indefinitely in remote sessions, reducing long-running risk.

changes.raw: Improved Bedrock SDK cold-start latency by overlapping profile fetch with other boot work
changes.summary: 提升Bedrock冷启动速度
changes.summary_en: Improve Bedrock cold-start latency
changes.why_matters: 通过并行化启动步骤缩短等待时间，让首次使用更快。
changes.why_matters_en: Shortens startup wait time by overlapping boot work, making first use faster.

changes.raw: Improved `--resume` memory usage and startup latency on large sessions
changes.summary: 提升大会话恢复性能
changes.summary_en: Improve resume memory and startup speed
changes.why_matters: 让大型会话恢复更省内存、启动更快，改善重开长任务体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes large-session resume lighter and faster, improving the experience of reopening long tasks.

changes.raw: Improved plugin startup — commands, skills, and agents now load from disk cache without re-fetching
changes.summary: 插件启动改为读缓存
changes.summary_en: Load plugins from disk cache
changes.why_matters: 减少插件启动时的网络拉取，加快命令、技能和代理可用时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces network fetching at plugin startup, making commands, skills, and agents available sooner.

changes.raw: Improved Remote Control session titles: AI-generated titles now appear within seconds of the first message
changes.summary: 远控标题更快生成
changes.summary_en: Generate Remote Control titles faster
changes.why_matters: 让会话标题更快可见，帮助用户更早识别和管理会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows session titles sooner, helping users identify and manage sessions earlier.

changes.raw: Improved `WebFetch` to identify as `Claude-User` so site operators can recognize and allowlist Claude Code traffic via `robots.txt`
changes.summary: WebFetch标识为Claude-User
changes.summary_en: WebFetch identifies as Claude-User
changes.why_matters: 让站点运营者能识别并放行 Claude Code 的抓取流量，减少被误拦截的概率。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps site operators recognize and allowlist Claude Code traffic, reducing the chance of being blocked.

changes.raw: Reduced `WebFetch` peak memory usage for large pages
changes.summary: WebFetch大页更省内存
changes.summary_en: WebFetch uses less memory on large pages
changes.why_matters: 降低大页面抓取时的峰值内存占用，提升稳定性并减少资源压力。
changes.why_matters_en: This lowers peak memory usage on large page fetches, improving stability and reducing resource pressure.

changes.raw: Reduced scrollback resets in long sessions from once per turn to once per ~50 messages
changes.summary: 长会话滚屏重置更少
changes.summary_en: Fewer scrollback resets in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 减少长会话中的滚屏重置频率，让历史输出更容易查看和回溯。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces scrollback resets in long sessions, making past output easier to review.

changes.raw: Faster `claude -p` startup with unauthenticated HTTP/SSE MCP servers (~600ms saved)
changes.summary: claude -p 启动更快
changes.summary_en: Faster claude -p startup
changes.why_matters: 减少无认证 MCP 场景的启动等待时间，提升命令行交互效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This cuts startup latency for unauthenticated MCP setups, improving CLI responsiveness.

changes.raw: Bash ghost-text suggestions now include just-submitted commands immediately
changes.summary: Bash建议立即含新命令
changes.summary_en: Bash suggestions include submitted commands
changes.why_matters: 刚提交的命令会立刻出现在补全建议中，减少重复输入和等待。
changes.why_matters_en: Recently submitted commands now appear immediately in suggestions, reducing retyping and wait time.

changes.raw: Increased non-streaming fallback token cap (21k → 64k) and timeout (120s → 300s local) so fallback requests are less likely to be truncated
changes.summary: 非流式回退更不易截断
changes.summary_en: Non-streaming fallback is less likely to truncate
changes.why_matters: 提高回退请求的 token 上限和超时，减少长输出被截断或失败的情况。
changes.why_matters_en: Higher token limits and timeouts make fallback requests less likely to truncate or fail.

changes.raw: Interrupting a prompt before any response now automatically restores your input so you can edit and resubmit
changes.summary: 中断前输入可自动恢复
changes.summary_en: Interrupted input is auto-restored
changes.why_matters: 在响应前中断提示时能保留已输入内容，方便修改后重新提交。
changes.why_matters_en: If you interrupt before a response starts, your input is restored so you can edit and resubmit.

changes.raw: `/status` now works while Claude is responding, instead of being queued until the turn finishes
changes.summary: /status可在响应中使用
changes.summary_en: /status works while Claude responds
changes.why_matters: 状态查询不再被排队，用户可以在模型响应时即时查看当前状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Status checks are no longer queued, so you can inspect state while Claude is still responding.

changes.raw: Plugin MCP servers that duplicate an org-managed connector are now suppressed instead of running a second connection
changes.summary: 重复MCP连接被抑制
changes.summary_en: Duplicate MCP connections are suppressed
changes.why_matters: 避免插件和组织连接器重复运行，减少资源浪费和冲突。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents duplicate plugin and org connector connections, reducing waste and conflicts.

changes.raw: Linux: respect `XDG_DATA_HOME` when registering the `claude-cli://` protocol handler
changes.summary: Linux遵循XDG_DATA_HOME
changes.summary_en: Linux respects XDG_DATA_HOME
changes.why_matters: 在 Linux 上更符合系统规范，协议处理器注册位置更可预测。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes Linux behavior follow system conventions, making protocol handler registration more predictable.

changes.raw: Changed "stop all background agents" keybinding from `Ctrl+F` to `Ctrl+X Ctrl+K` to stop shadowing readline forward-char
changes.summary: 停止后台代理快捷键变更
changes.summary_en: Stop-background-agents shortcut changed
changes.why_matters: 快捷键从 Ctrl+F 改为新组合，可能影响已有习惯和脚本化操作。
changes.why_matters_en: The shortcut changed from Ctrl+F to a new chord, which may affect existing muscle memory and workflows.

changes.raw: Deprecated `TaskOutput` tool in favor of using `Read` on the background task's output file path
changes.summary: 弃用TaskOutput工具
changes.summary_en: TaskOutput tool is deprecated
changes.why_matters: 现有依赖 TaskOutput 的工作流需要迁移到新的输出文件读取方式。
changes.why_matters_en: Workflows depending on TaskOutput need to migrate to reading the background task output file path.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONSTREAMING_FALLBACK` env var to disable the non-streaming fallback when streaming fails
changes.summary: 可禁用非流式回退
changes.summary_en: Non-streaming fallback can be disabled
changes.why_matters: 提供环境变量开关，方便在需要严格流式行为时关闭回退机制。
changes.why_matters_en: An env var now lets users disable fallback when strict streaming behavior is desired.

changes.raw: Plugin options (`manifest.userConfig`) now available externally — plugins can prompt for configuration at enable time, with `sensitive: true` values stored in keychain (macOS) or protected credentials file (other platforms)
changes.summary: 插件可在启用时配置
changes.summary_en: Plugins can prompt for setup config
changes.why_matters: 插件现在能在启用时收集配置并安全存储敏感值，提升可用性和部署灵活性。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins can now collect setup-time config and securely store sensitive values, improving usability and deployment flexibility.

changes.raw: Claude can now reference the on-disk path of clipboard-pasted images for file operations
changes.summary: 可引用剪贴板图片路径
changes.summary_en: Clipboard image paths are referenceable
changes.why_matters: Claude 现在能直接使用剪贴板粘贴图片的本地路径进行文件操作，增强多模态工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Claude can now use the local path of pasted clipboard images for file operations, improving multimodal workflows.

changes.raw: `Ctrl+L` now clears the screen and forces a full redraw — use this to recover when Cmd+K leaves the UI partially blank. Use `Ctrl+U` or double-Esc to clear prompt input.
changes.summary: Ctrl+L强制重绘修复空白界面
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+L forces full redraw to recover blank UI
changes.why_matters: 当界面局部空白时，用户可以快速恢复可用状态，减少卡死感。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets users quickly recover from a partially blank UI and reduces the feeling of a stuck app.

changes.raw: `--bare -p` (SDK pattern) is ~14% faster to the API request
changes.summary: --bare -p请求更快
changes.summary_en: --bare -p makes API requests faster
changes.why_matters: SDK 常用调用路径更快，能降低等待时间并提升批量使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It speeds up a common SDK path, reducing wait time and improving batch usage.

changes.raw: Memory: `MEMORY.md` index now truncates at 25KB as well as 200 lines
changes.summary: MEMORY索引支持更小上限
changes.summary_en: MEMORY index now truncates by size too
changes.why_matters: 记忆索引更容易保持可控大小，减少过长内容带来的性能和上下文负担。
changes.why_matters_en: The memory index stays more manageable, reducing performance and context overhead from oversized content.

changes.raw: Disabled `AskUserQuestion` and plan-mode tools when `--channels` is active
changes.summary: --channels下禁用部分工具
changes.summary_en: Disables question and plan tools under --channels
changes.why_matters: 限制通道模式下可用工具，降低非预期交互和权限滥用风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Restricting tools in channel mode reduces unexpected interaction and misuse risk.

changes.raw: Fixed API 400 error when a pasted image was queued during a failing tool call
changes.summary: 修复粘贴图片导致400错误
changes.summary_en: Fixes 400 error when pasted image is queued
changes.why_matters: 避免在工具失败时因图片队列触发请求错误，减少中断和重试成本。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents request failures caused by queued pasted images during tool errors, reducing interruptions and retries.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tool calls hanging indefinitely when an SSE connection drops mid-call and exhausts its reconnection attempts
changes.summary: 修复MCP调用断连后卡死
changes.summary_en: Fixes MCP calls hanging after SSE disconnects
changes.why_matters: MCP 工具调用不再在断线场景下无限挂起，提升稳定性和可恢复性。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP tool calls no longer hang indefinitely on disconnects, improving stability and recoverability.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control session titles showing raw XML when a background agent completed before the first user message
changes.summary: 修复远程标题显示XML
changes.summary_en: Fixes raw XML in remote session titles
changes.why_matters: 会话标题显示正常后，更容易快速识别和管理远程会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Clean session titles make remote sessions easier to identify and manage.

changes.raw: Fixed remote sessions forgetting conversation history after a container restart due to progress-message gaps in the resumed transcript chain
changes.summary: 修复重启后远程会话丢历史
changes.summary_en: Fixes remote history loss after container restart
changes.why_matters: 恢复后的会话能保留上下文，避免重复说明并减少工作中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Resumed sessions keep context, avoiding repetition and reducing workflow disruption.

changes.raw: Fixed remote sessions requiring re-login on transient auth errors instead of retrying automatically
changes.summary: 远程登录错误改为自动重试
changes.summary_en: Remote auth errors now retry automatically
changes.why_matters: 临时认证故障不再迫使用户重新登录，提升远程使用连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Transient auth failures no longer force re-login, improving continuity in remote use.

changes.raw: Fixed `rg ... | wc -l` and similar piped commands hanging and returning `0` in sandbox mode on Linux
changes.summary: 修复Linux沙箱管道命令卡住
changes.summary_en: Fixes piped commands hanging in Linux sandbox
changes.why_matters: 常见管道命令可正常结束并返回结果，避免脚本和统计流程阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: Common piped commands now finish and return results, preventing script and counting workflows from blocking.

changes.raw: Fixed voice input hold-to-talk not activating when a CJK IME inserts a full-width space
changes.summary: 修复CJK输入法语音按住说失效
changes.summary_en: Fixes hold-to-talk with CJK IME full-width space
changes.why_matters: 中文等输入法下语音输入更可靠，减少交互失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice input becomes more reliable with CJK IMEs, reducing interaction failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `--worktree` hanging silently when the worktree name contained a forward slash
changes.summary: 修复worktree带斜杠卡死
changes.summary_en: Fixes --worktree hanging on slash names
changes.why_matters: 包含特殊命名的 worktree 也能正常使用，避免静默挂起。
changes.why_matters_en: Worktrees with special names now work normally instead of hanging silently.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Spinner now turns red with "Not responding" when the backend hasn't responded for 60 seconds
changes.summary: VSCode无响应时变红提示
changes.summary_en: VSCode spinner turns red after 60s no response
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快判断后端是否卡住，从而决定等待或重试。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can tell sooner whether the backend is stuck and decide whether to wait or retry.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed session history not loading correctly when reopening a session via URL or after restart
changes.summary: 修复VSCode会话历史加载
changes.summary_en: Fixes VSCode session history loading
changes.why_matters: 重新打开或重启后仍能看到正确历史，减少上下文丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Session history loads correctly after reopen or restart, reducing context loss.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added Esc-twice (or `/rewind`) to open a keyboard-navigable rewind picker
changes.summary: 新增Esc两次回退选择器
changes.summary_en: Adds Esc-twice rewind picker
changes.why_matters: 用户可以用键盘快速回退并选择历史状态，提升可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly rewind and choose a prior state with the keyboard, improving control.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed "Fork conversation from here" and rewind actions failing silently after the session cache goes stale
changes.summary: 修复会话缓存过期后分叉/回退失效
changes.summary_en: Fix fork/rewind after stale session cache
changes.why_matters: 避免在会话缓存失效后，用户无法继续分叉或回退对话而且没有任何提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents fork and rewind actions from silently failing when the session cache becomes stale.

changes.raw: Added `--bare` flag for scripted `-p` calls — skips hooks, LSP, plugin sync, and skill directory walks; requires `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an `apiKeyHelper` via `--settings` (OAuth and keychain auth disabled); auto-memory fully disabled
changes.summary: 脚本模式裸运行，禁用扩展
changes.summary_en: Add bare scripted mode with minimal side effects
changes.why_matters: 让脚本化调用更可控、更稳定，避免钩子、插件和自动记忆带来的额外开销或副作用。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes scripted runs more predictable by avoiding hooks, plugins, and auto-memory side effects.

changes.raw: Added `--channels` permission relay — channel servers that declare the permission capability can forward tool approval prompts to your phone
changes.summary: 通道服务器可转发审批到手机
changes.summary_en: Let channel servers relay approvals to phone
changes.why_matters: 把工具审批流扩展到手机端，能提升远程确认效率并减少中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This extends approval workflows to mobile, improving responsiveness and reducing interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed multiple concurrent Claude Code sessions requiring repeated re-authentication when one session refreshes its OAuth token
changes.summary: 多会话刷新后不再反复重登
changes.summary_en: Stop repeated re-auth across concurrent sessions
changes.why_matters: 避免多个会话互相干扰认证状态，提升并行使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents concurrent sessions from disrupting auth state and improves parallel usage.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode silently swallowing retry failures and showing a misleading "check your network" message instead of the actual error
changes.summary: 语音重试失败显示真实错误
changes.summary_en: Voice mode now shows the real retry error
changes.why_matters: 用户能直接看到真实失败原因，便于排障而不是被误导。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see the actual failure cause, making troubleshooting much easier.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode audio not recovering when the server silently drops the WebSocket connection
changes.summary: 语音断线后可自动恢复音频
changes.summary_en: Voice audio recovers after silent disconnects
changes.why_matters: 减少语音模式因隐性断连而失效，提高连续可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces voice-mode failures from silent disconnects and improves continuity.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` not suppressing the structured-outputs beta header, causing 400 errors on proxy gateways forwarding to Vertex/Bedrock
changes.summary: 禁用实验特性时不再发错头
changes.summary_en: Disable beta header when experimental betas are off
changes.why_matters: 避免代理网关因错误请求头返回 400，提升企业/代理环境兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids 400s from proxy gateways and improves compatibility in enterprise/proxied setups.

changes.raw: Fixed `--channels` bypass for Team/Enterprise orgs with no other managed settings configured
changes.summary: --channels 不再绕过组织限制
changes.summary_en: --channels no longer bypasses org-managed settings
changes.why_matters: 确保 Team/Enterprise 的管理策略始终生效，避免权限绕过。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures Team/Enterprise policies remain enforced and prevents permission bypasses.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash on Node.js 18
changes.summary: 修复 Node 18 崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash on Node.js 18
changes.why_matters: 直接恢复旧运行时上的可用性，影响面大且可能阻断使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores usability on an older runtime and can unblock affected users immediately.

changes.raw: Fixed unnecessary permission prompts for Bash commands containing dashes in strings
changes.summary: 含连字符 Bash 不再误触审批
changes.summary_en: Avoid false Bash approval prompts for dashed strings
changes.why_matters: 减少不必要的权限确认，提升命令执行流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces unnecessary approval prompts and makes command execution smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin hooks blocking prompt submission when the plugin directory is deleted mid-session
changes.summary: 插件目录删除不再卡住提交
changes.summary_en: Plugin hook deletion no longer blocks prompt submit
changes.why_matters: 避免会话中插件目录变化导致输入提交被阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents prompt submission from getting blocked when the plugin directory changes mid-session.

changes.raw: Fixed a race condition where background agent task output could hang indefinitely when the task completed between polling intervals
changes.summary: 后台任务输出不再无限卡住
changes.summary_en: Background task output no longer hangs forever
changes.why_matters: 修复后台代理任务完成后输出丢失/卡死的问题，保证结果可见。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes a hang that could hide completed background task output and block progress.

changes.raw: Resuming a session that was in a worktree now switches back to that worktree
changes.summary: 恢复会话时回到原工作树
changes.summary_en: Resume sessions in the original worktree
changes.why_matters: 让恢复后的上下文与原编辑环境一致，减少切换成本。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps resumed sessions aligned with the original workspace and reduces context switching.

changes.raw: Fixed `/btw` not including pasted text when used during an active response
changes.summary: /btw 现可带上粘贴文本
changes.summary_en: /btw now includes pasted text
changes.why_matters: 避免在响应中使用该命令时丢失用户刚粘贴的内容。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents pasted content from being lost when using the command during an active response.

changes.raw: Fixed a race where fast Cmd+Tab followed by paste could beat the clipboard copy under tmux
changes.summary: tmux 下剪贴板复制竞态修复
changes.summary_en: Fix clipboard race after Cmd+Tab in tmux
changes.why_matters: 减少快速切换窗口后粘贴内容出错的概率。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces the chance of pasting the wrong content after rapid window switching.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal tab title not updating with an auto-generated session description
changes.summary: 会话标题可正确更新
changes.summary_en: Session tab title updates correctly
changes.why_matters: 让终端标签更准确，便于识别当前会话。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps terminal tabs accurate and makes sessions easier to पहचान识别.

changes.raw: Fixed invisible hook attachments inflating the message count in transcript mode
changes.summary: 修正隐形挂钩计数错误
changes.summary_en: Fix invisible hook count inflation
changes.why_matters: 避免转录模式下消息数被错误抬高，减少用户对会话状态的误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents transcript mode from showing an inflated message count, reducing confusion about session state.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control sessions showing a generic title instead of deriving from the first prompt
changes.summary: 修正远控会话标题生成
changes.summary_en: Fix Remote Control title derivation
changes.why_matters: 让远程控制会话标题更准确，便于用户快速识别当前会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes Remote Control session titles more accurate so users can identify sessions faster.

changes.raw: Fixed `/rename` not syncing the title for Remote Control sessions
changes.summary: 修正远控重命名不同步
changes.summary_en: Fix Remote Control rename sync
changes.why_matters: 确保重命名后标题在各端一致，避免协作时出现信息不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps renamed titles in sync across clients, avoiding inconsistent collaboration state.

changes.raw: Fixed Remote Control `/exit` not reliably archiving the session
changes.summary: 修正远控退出归档不稳
changes.summary_en: Fix unreliable Remote Control exit archive
changes.why_matters: 提高会话结束后的归档可靠性，减少丢失记录的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves reliability of session archiving on exit, reducing the risk of lost records.

changes.raw: Improved MCP read/search tool calls to collapse into a single "Queried {server}" line (expand with Ctrl+O)
changes.summary: 压缩MCP查询显示
changes.summary_en: Collapse MCP queries into one line
changes.why_matters: 让输出更简洁，减少 MCP 工具调用在对话中的视觉噪音。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes output cleaner by reducing visual noise from MCP tool calls in chat.

changes.raw: Improved `!` bash mode discoverability — Claude now suggests it when you need to run an interactive command
changes.summary: 增强! bash模式可发现性
changes.summary_en: Improve discoverability of ! bash mode
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户更容易发现交互式命令的正确运行方式，降低使用门槛。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users discover the right way to run interactive commands, lowering the learning curve.

changes.raw: Improved plugin freshness — ref-tracked plugins now re-clone on every load to pick up upstream changes
changes.summary: 插件每次加载刷新
changes.summary_en: Re-clone ref-tracked plugins on load
changes.why_matters: 确保插件始终拉取上游最新变更，减少因缓存导致的过期行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures plugins pick up upstream changes on every load, reducing stale behavior from caching.

changes.raw: Improved Remote Control session titles to refresh after your third message
changes.summary: 远控标题第三条后刷新
changes.summary_en: Refresh Remote Control title after 3rd msg
changes.why_matters: 让会话标题更快反映真实主题，提升远程协作中的可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Updates titles sooner to reflect the real topic, improving readability in remote collaboration.

changes.raw: Updated MCP OAuth to support Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD / SEP-991) for servers without Dynamic Client Registration
changes.summary: 支持MCP CIMD认证
changes.summary_en: Support MCP CIMD OAuth metadata
changes.why_matters: 扩大了 MCP 服务器认证兼容性，使更多服务器无需 DCR 也能接入。
changes.why_matters_en: Expands MCP auth compatibility so more servers can connect without Dynamic Client Registration.

changes.raw: Changed plan mode to hide the "clear context" option by default (restore with `"showClearContextOnPlanAccept": true`)
changes.summary: 计划模式默认隐藏清空上下文
changes.summary_en: Hide clear-context by default in plan mode
changes.why_matters: 减少计划模式中的误操作风险，同时保留可配置恢复选项。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces accidental misuse in plan mode while keeping a configurable way to restore it.

changes.raw: Disabled line-by-line response streaming on Windows (including WSL in Windows Terminal) due to rendering issues
changes.summary: 禁用Windows逐行流式输出
changes.summary_en: Disable line-by-line streaming on Windows
changes.why_matters: 避免 Windows 终端渲染异常，提升输出稳定性和可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids rendering issues on Windows terminals, improving output stability and readability.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed Windows PATH inheritance for Bash tool when using Git Bash (regression in v2.1.78)
changes.summary: 修正Git Bash PATH继承
changes.summary_en: Fix Git Bash PATH inheritance on Windows
changes.why_matters: 恢复 Bash 工具在 Windows 下的环境变量继承，避免命令找不到的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores environment inheritance for the Bash tool on Windows, preventing missing-command issues.

signals.title: Claude Code Cheat Sheet

Show HN: Claude Code skills that build complete Godot games
Cook: A simple CLI for orchestrating Claude Code
