changes.raw: Added `rate_limits` field to statusline scripts for displaying Claude.ai rate limit usage (5-hour and 7-day windows with `used_percentage` and `resets_at`)
changes.summary: 状态栏显示限流用量
changes.summary_en: Show Claude.ai rate limit usage
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接在状态栏查看 Claude.ai 限流使用情况，便于判断何时会重置并避免超限。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see Claude.ai rate limit usage in the statusline and avoid hitting limits unexpectedly.

changes.raw: Added `source: 'settings'` plugin marketplace source — declare plugin entries inline in settings.json
changes.summary: 设置中内联声明插件
changes.summary_en: Declare plugins inline in settings
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接在 settings.json 中配置插件条目，简化插件分发和管理。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can declare plugin entries directly in settings.json, simplifying plugin distribution and management.

changes.raw: Added CLI tool usage detection to plugin tips, in addition to file pattern matching
changes.summary: 插件提示识别 CLI 用法
changes.summary_en: Plugin tips detect CLI usage
changes.why_matters: 插件提示能更准确识别命令行工具使用场景，减少误判并提升推荐质量。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin tips can better detect CLI usage patterns, reducing false matches and improving recommendations.

changes.raw: Added `effort` frontmatter support for skills and slash commands to override the model effort level when invoked
changes.summary: 技能和命令支持 effort
changes.summary_en: Support effort frontmatter override
changes.why_matters: 用户可为技能和斜杠命令指定模型努力级别，从而更精细地控制响应质量与成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can override model effort for skills and slash commands to better balance quality and cost.

changes.raw: Added `--channels` (research preview) — allow MCP servers to push messages into your session
changes.summary: 支持 MCP 推送消息
changes.summary_en: Allow MCP servers to push messages
changes.why_matters: MCP 服务器可以主动向会话推送消息，增强实时协作和自动化交互能力。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP servers can proactively push messages into sessions, enabling richer real-time automation and collaboration.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` dropping parallel tool results — sessions with parallel tool calls now restore all tool_use/tool_result pairs instead of showing `[Tool result missing]` placeholders
changes.summary: 恢复并行工具结果
changes.summary_en: Restore parallel tool results on resume
changes.why_matters: 恢复会话时不再丢失并行工具调用结果，避免上下文缺失和重复执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Resumed sessions now preserve parallel tool call results, preventing missing context and duplicate work.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode WebSocket failures caused by Cloudflare bot detection on non-browser TLS fingerprints
changes.summary: 修复语音模式连接失败
changes.summary_en: Fix voice mode WebSocket failures
changes.why_matters: 语音模式在受 Cloudflare 保护的环境中更稳定，减少连接失败导致的功能不可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice mode works more reliably in Cloudflare-protected environments, reducing connection failures.

changes.raw: Fixed 400 errors when using fine-grained tool streaming through API proxies, Bedrock, or Vertex
changes.summary: 修复代理流式工具错误
changes.summary_en: Fix fine-grained tool streaming errors
changes.why_matters: 通过 API 代理或云厂商平台使用细粒度工具流时不再报 400 错误，提升兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Fine-grained tool streaming now works through API proxies and cloud providers without 400 errors.

changes.raw: Fixed `/remote-control` appearing for gateway and third-party provider deployments where it cannot function
changes.summary: 隐藏不可用远程控制
changes.summary_en: Hide unavailable remote control
changes.why_matters: 在不支持的部署环境中不再显示 /remote-control，减少误导和无效操作。
changes.why_matters_en: The /remote-control command is hidden where it cannot function, reducing confusion and dead-end actions.

changes.raw: Fixed `/sandbox` tab switching not responding to Tab or arrow keys
changes.summary: 修复沙箱标签切换
changes.summary_en: Fix sandbox tab switching keys
changes.why_matters: 用户可以正常用 Tab 和方向键切换 /sandbox 标签页，提升键盘可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can switch /sandbox tabs with Tab and arrow keys again, improving keyboard usability.

changes.raw: Improved responsiveness of `@` file autocomplete in large git repositories
changes.summary: 大仓库补全更快
changes.summary_en: Faster @ file autocomplete in large repos
changes.why_matters: 在大型 git 仓库中使用 @ 文件补全时响应更快，减少等待时间。
changes.why_matters_en: File autocomplete with @ is more responsive in large git repos, reducing wait time.

changes.raw: Improved `/effort` to show what auto currently resolves to, matching the status bar indicator
changes.summary: effort 显示自动值
changes.summary_en: Show resolved auto effort value
changes.why_matters: 用户能看到 /effort 的 auto 最终解析结果，与状态栏保持一致，减少困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see the resolved auto effort value in /effort, matching the status bar and reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Improved `/permissions` — Tab and arrow keys now switch tabs from within a list
changes.summary: 权限页支持切换标签
changes.summary_en: Switch tabs in /permissions
changes.why_matters: 在权限列表中也能用 Tab 和方向键切换标签页，提升操作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Tab and arrow keys now switch tabs from within the permissions list, making navigation smoother.

changes.raw: Improved background tasks panel — left arrow now closes from the list view
changes.summary: 后台任务面板更易关闭
changes.summary_en: Close background tasks panel faster
changes.why_matters: 在列表视图中按左箭头即可关闭后台任务面板，减少额外操作。
changes.why_matters_en: The background tasks panel can now be closed from the list view with the left arrow, reducing friction.

changes.raw: Simplified plugin install tips to use a single `/plugin install` command instead of a two-step flow
changes.summary: 简化插件安装提示
changes.summary_en: Simplify plugin install tips
changes.why_matters: 插件安装只需一个命令即可完成，降低学习成本并减少操作步骤。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin installation now uses a single command, lowering the learning curve and cutting steps.

changes.raw: Reduced memory usage on startup in large repositories (~80 MB saved on 250k-file repos)
changes.summary: 大仓库启动内存占用降低
changes.summary_en: Lower startup memory in large repos
changes.why_matters: 在超大仓库中启动时可显著减少内存占用，提升稳定性并降低卡顿或崩溃风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This significantly reduces startup memory in very large repositories, improving stability and lowering the risk of lag or crashes.

changes.raw: Fixed managed settings (`enabledPlugins`, `permissions.defaultMode`, policy-set env vars) not being applied at startup when `remote-settings.json` was cached from a prior session
changes.summary: 缓存配置下启动仍应用管理设置
changes.summary_en: Apply managed settings even with cached startup
changes.why_matters: 修复后即使 `remote-settings.json` 被缓存，受管插件、权限和环境变量也能在启动时正确生效。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures managed plugins, permissions, and env vars are applied correctly at startup even when `remote-settings.json` is cached.

changes.raw: Added `--console` flag to `claude auth login` for Anthropic Console (API billing) authentication
changes.summary: 支持Console登录认证
changes.summary_en: Add Console login auth support
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接用 Anthropic Console 进行 API 计费认证，登录方式更灵活。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can authenticate with Anthropic Console for API billing, making login more flexible.

changes.raw: Added "Show turn duration" toggle to the `/config` menu
changes.summary: 可显示单轮耗时
changes.summary_en: Show turn duration toggle
changes.why_matters: 用户可以在配置里查看每轮耗时，便于观察和优化交互效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can display per-turn duration to better observe and optimize interaction efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude -p` hanging when spawned as a subprocess without explicit stdin (e.g. Python `subprocess.run`)
changes.summary: 修复子进程卡死问题
changes.summary_en: Fix subprocess hang in -p mode
changes.why_matters: 避免 `claude -p` 在无显式 stdin 的子进程中挂起，提升脚本自动化可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents `claude -p` from hanging in subprocesses without stdin, improving automation reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+C not working in `-p` (print) mode
changes.summary: 修复打印模式中断失效
changes.summary_en: Fix Ctrl+C in print mode
changes.why_matters: 用户可以正常中断 `-p` 模式，避免任务失控或长时间占用资源。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now interrupt `-p` mode properly, avoiding runaway tasks and wasted resources.

changes.raw: Fixed `/btw` returning the main agent's output instead of answering the side question when triggered during streaming
changes.summary: 修复侧问答返回错误输出
changes.summary_en: Fix /btw side question output
changes.why_matters: 在流式输出时，侧问答会返回正确答案而不是主代理输出，减少混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: During streaming, side questions now return the correct answer instead of the main agent output.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode not activating correctly on startup when `voiceEnabled: true` is set
changes.summary: 修复语音模式启动异常
changes.summary_en: Fix voice mode startup
changes.why_matters: 开启 `voiceEnabled` 后语音模式能正确启动，提升多模态体验一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice mode now starts correctly when `voiceEnabled` is set, improving multimodal consistency.

changes.raw: Fixed left/right arrow tab navigation in `/permissions`
changes.summary: 修复权限页左右切换
changes.summary_en: Fix tab navigation in permissions
changes.why_matters: 用户在 `/permissions` 中可以更顺畅地用左右键切换标签页。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can navigate tabs in `/permissions` more smoothly with left/right arrows.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` not preventing terminal title from being set on startup
changes.summary: 禁用终端标题设置生效
changes.summary_en: Respect terminal title disable flag
changes.why_matters: 设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` 后不会再改终端标题，符合用户偏好。
changes.why_matters_en: Setting `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` now prevents terminal title changes as expected.

changes.raw: Fixed custom status line showing nothing when workspace trust is blocking it
changes.summary: 受限工作区显示状态栏
changes.summary_en: Handle status line in restricted trust
changes.why_matters: 当工作区信任受限时，状态栏不会空白，界面反馈更清晰。
changes.why_matters_en: The custom status line no longer disappears when workspace trust blocks it, improving UI clarity.

changes.raw: Fixed enterprise users being unable to retry on rate limit (429) errors
changes.summary: 企业用户可重试429错误
changes.summary_en: Allow retry on 429 for enterprise
changes.why_matters: 企业用户遇到限流时可以重试，减少中断并提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Enterprise users can retry after rate limits, reducing interruptions and improving availability.

changes.raw: Fixed `SessionEnd` hooks not firing when using interactive `/resume` to switch sessions
changes.summary: 修复恢复会话钩子缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix SessionEnd hooks on resume
changes.why_matters: 切换会话时 `SessionEnd` 钩子会正常触发，保证自动化收尾逻辑执行。
changes.why_matters_en: `SessionEnd` hooks now fire when switching sessions via `/resume`, preserving cleanup logic.

changes.raw: Improved startup memory usage by ~18MB across all scenarios
changes.summary: 启动内存减少18MB
changes.summary_en: Reduce startup memory by 18MB
changes.why_matters: 启动更省内存，整体运行更轻量，尤其适合资源紧张环境。
changes.why_matters_en: Startup uses less memory, making the tool lighter and better for constrained environments.

changes.raw: Improved non-streaming API fallback with a 2-minute per-attempt timeout, preventing sessions from hanging indefinitely
changes.summary: 非流式回退防止卡死
changes.summary_en: Add timeout for non-streaming fallback
changes.why_matters: 为非流式 API 回退增加超时，避免会话无限挂起，提高稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: A per-attempt timeout prevents non-streaming fallback sessions from hanging indefinitely.

changes.raw: `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` now supports multiple seed directories separated by the platform path delimiter (`:` on Unix, `;` on Windows)
changes.summary: 插件种子目录支持多路径
changes.summary_en: Support multiple plugin seed dirs
changes.why_matters: 用户可以通过平台分隔符配置多个种子目录，插件分发更灵活。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can configure multiple seed directories with the platform path delimiter, making plugin setup more flexible.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added `/remote-control` — bridge your session to claude.ai/code to continue from a browser or phone
changes.summary: 支持远程接管会话
changes.summary_en: Add remote control session bridge
changes.why_matters: 用户可以把 VSCode 会话桥接到浏览器或手机继续操作，提升跨设备协作能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can bridge a VSCode session to claude.ai/code and continue from browser or phone, enabling cross-device continuity.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Session tabs now get AI-generated titles based on your first message
changes.summary: 会话标签自动生成标题
changes.summary_en: Auto-title session tabs from first message
changes.why_matters: 让用户更快识别和切换不同会话，减少手动整理成本。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users identify and switch sessions faster with less manual organization.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed the thinking pill showing "Thinking" instead of "Thought for Ns" after a response completes
changes.summary: 修复思考状态显示错误
changes.summary_en: Fix thinking pill status text
changes.why_matters: 修正响应完成后的状态展示，避免用户误以为模型仍在思考。
changes.why_matters_en: It corrects the post-response status display so users are not misled into thinking the model is still working.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed missing session diff button when opening sessions from the left sidebar
changes.summary: 修复会话差异按钮缺失
changes.summary_en: Restore missing session diff button
changes.why_matters: 恢复从侧边栏打开会话时的差异查看入口，方便对比和审查改动。
changes.why_matters_en: It restores access to session diffs when opening from the sidebar, making it easier to review changes.

changes.raw: Added `StopFailure` hook event that fires when the turn ends due to an API error (rate limit, auth failure, etc.)
changes.summary: 新增失败停止钩子事件
changes.summary_en: Add StopFailure hook event
changes.why_matters: 让插件能在 API 错误导致回合结束时做出响应，提升自动化处理能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets plugins react when a turn ends due to API errors, improving automation handling.

changes.raw: Added `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}` variable for plugin persistent state that survives plugin updates; `/plugin uninstall` prompts before deleting it
changes.summary: 插件持久数据可跨更新保留
changes.summary_en: Persistent plugin data survives updates
changes.why_matters: 插件更新后仍能保留状态，减少数据丢失并支持更稳定的长期使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin state now survives updates, reducing data loss and enabling stable long-term use.

changes.raw: Added `effort`, `maxTurns`, and `disallowedTools` frontmatter support for plugin-shipped agents
changes.summary: 插件代理支持更多前置配置
changes.summary_en: Plugin agents support more frontmatter
changes.why_matters: 插件作者可以更细致地配置代理行为，提升可控性和适配性。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin authors can configure agent behavior more precisely, improving control and fit.

changes.raw: Terminal notifications (iTerm2/Kitty/Ghostty popups, progress bar) now reach the outer terminal when running inside tmux with `set -g allow-passthrough on`
changes.summary: tmux 中通知可透传到外层终端
changes.summary_en: Terminal notifications pass through tmux
changes.why_matters: 在 tmux 环境下也能正常看到通知，减少错过关键进度提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Notifications now appear outside tmux too, reducing missed progress updates.

changes.raw: Response text now streams line-by-line as it's generated
changes.summary: 回复内容按行实时流式输出
changes.summary_en: Stream response text line by line
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快看到生成结果，交互延迟更低，体验更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Users see generated output sooner, lowering perceived latency and improving UX.

changes.raw: Fixed `git log HEAD` failing with "ambiguous argument" inside sandboxed Bash on Linux, and stub files polluting `git status` in the working directory
changes.summary: 修复 Linux 沙箱 git log 与状态污染
changes.summary_en: Fix git log and status pollution in sandbox
changes.why_matters: 避免常用 Git 命令在沙箱中报错，并防止工作区被无关文件污染。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents common Git commands from failing in sandbox and avoids workspace pollution.

changes.raw: Fixed `cc log` and `--resume` silently truncating conversation history on large sessions (>5 MB) that used subagents
changes.summary: 修复大会话历史被截断
changes.summary_en: Fix history truncation in large sessions
changes.why_matters: 长会话和子代理记录能完整保留，避免恢复和审计时丢失上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: Long sessions and subagent history are preserved, avoiding context loss on resume.

changes.raw: Fixed infinite loop when API errors triggered stop hooks that re-fed blocking errors to the model
changes.summary: 修复停止钩子导致死循环
changes.summary_en: Fix infinite loop from stop hooks
changes.why_matters: 防止 API 错误触发后反复重试卡死，避免任务无法结束。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents API-error stop hooks from looping indefinitely and hanging tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed `deny: ["mcp__servername"]` permission rules not removing MCP server tools before sending to the model, allowing it to see and attempt blocked tools
changes.summary: 修复被禁 MCP 工具仍可见
changes.summary_en: Fix blocked MCP tools still being exposed
changes.why_matters: 确保权限规则真正阻止模型看到和尝试被禁工具，降低越权风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures permission rules truly hide blocked tools from the model, reducing privilege risk.

changes.raw: Fixed `sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite` not working with absolute paths (previously required `//` prefix)
changes.summary: 修复绝对路径写入权限失效
changes.summary_en: Fix absolute-path write permissions
changes.why_matters: 允许按预期写入指定绝对路径，减少因路径格式导致的配置失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows intended writes to absolute paths and avoids path-format-related config failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `/sandbox` Dependencies tab showing Linux prerequisites on macOS instead of macOS-specific info
changes.summary: 修复 /sandbox 依赖页平台信息错误
changes.summary_en: Fix wrong platform info in /sandbox deps tab
changes.why_matters: macOS 用户能看到正确的依赖说明，减少安装和排障误导。
changes.why_matters_en: macOS users now see correct dependency guidance, reducing setup confusion.

changes.raw: **Security:** Fixed silent sandbox disable when `sandbox.enabled: true` is set but dependencies are missing — now shows a visible startup warning
changes.summary: 缺依赖时不再静默关闭沙箱
changes.summary_en: Sandbox no longer silently disables on missing deps
changes.why_matters: 启动时会明确提示沙箱未启用，避免用户误以为安全隔离已生效。
changes.why_matters_en: Startup now warns visibly when sandboxing is unavailable, preventing false security assumptions.

changes.raw: Fixed `.git`, `.claude`, and other protected directories being writable without a prompt in `bypassPermissions` mode
changes.summary: 保护目录写入需确认
changes.summary_en: Protected directories now require confirmation
changes.why_matters: 防止在绕过权限模式下误改关键目录，降低破坏性操作风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental writes to critical directories in bypass mode, reducing destructive risk.

changes.raw: Fixed ctrl+u in normal mode scrolling instead of readline kill-line (ctrl+u/ctrl+d half-page scroll moved to transcript mode only)
changes.summary: 修复正常模式 Ctrl+U 行删除
changes.summary_en: Fix Ctrl+U line kill in normal mode
changes.why_matters: 恢复符合预期的快捷键行为，减少编辑和导航时的误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores expected shortcut behavior and reduces accidental navigation mistakes.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode modifier-combo push-to-talk keybindings (e.g. ctrl+k) requiring a hold instead of activating immediately
changes.summary: 修复语音模式组合键按下即触发
changes.summary_en: Fix voice mode combo keybindings
changes.why_matters: 语音模式快捷键更符合预期，避免误触发和操作不稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice-mode shortcuts now behave as expected, avoiding accidental triggers.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode not working on WSL2 with WSLg (Windows 11); WSL1/Win10 users now get a clear error
changes.summary: 修复WSL2语音模式
changes.summary_en: Fix voice mode on WSL2
changes.why_matters: 让 Windows 11 的 WSL2/WSLg 用户能正常使用语音模式，并为不支持的环境提供明确提示。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores voice mode for Windows 11 WSL2/WSLg users and gives clear feedback on unsupported setups.

changes.raw: Fixed `--worktree` flag not loading skills and hooks from the worktree directory
changes.summary: worktree加载技能与钩子
changes.summary_en: Load skills and hooks from worktree
changes.why_matters: 确保在 worktree 场景下也能正确加载项目扩展能力，避免行为不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures worktree sessions load project extensions correctly and behave consistently.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` and `includeGitInstructions` setting not suppressing the git status section in the system prompt
changes.summary: 隐藏Git状态提示
changes.summary_en: Hide git status prompt section
changes.why_matters: 让用户配置的 Git 提示抑制选项真正生效，减少不必要的上下文噪音。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes the git-instruction suppression settings actually work and reduces prompt noise.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash tool not finding Homebrew and other PATH-dependent binaries when VS Code is launched from Dock/Spotlight
changes.summary: 修复VS Code路径问题
changes.summary_en: Fix PATH binaries in VS Code
changes.why_matters: 避免从 Dock/Spotlight 启动时找不到 Homebrew 等命令，提升工具可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents PATH-dependent tools like Homebrew from being missed when VS Code is launched from Dock or Spotlight.

changes.raw: Fixed washed-out Claude orange color in VS Code/Cursor/code-server terminals that don't advertise truecolor support
changes.summary: 修正终端Claude橙色显示
changes.summary_en: Fix Claude orange color in terminals
changes.why_matters: 改善在不支持真彩色的终端中的显示效果，提升视觉一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves visual consistency in terminals that do not advertise truecolor support.

changes.raw: Added `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION` env var to add a custom entry to the `/model` picker, with optional `_NAME` and `_DESCRIPTION` suffixed vars for display
changes.summary: 支持自定义模型入口
changes.summary_en: Add custom model picker entry
changes.why_matters: 允许用户把自定义模型直接加入模型选择器，扩展可用模型配置。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets users add custom models directly to the model picker and expand available model options.

changes.raw: Fixed `ANTHROPIC_BETAS` environment variable being silently ignored when using Haiku models
changes.summary: 修复Haiku忽略Betas
changes.summary_en: Fix ANTHROPIC_BETAS on Haiku
changes.why_matters: 确保环境变量配置在 Haiku 模型下也会生效，避免功能开关失效。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures environment-based feature flags work correctly for Haiku models too.

changes.raw: Fixed queued prompts being concatenated without a newline separator
changes.summary: 队列提示自动换行
changes.summary_en: Separate queued prompts with newline
changes.why_matters: 避免多个排队提示被粘连在一起，减少解析错误和阅读混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents queued prompts from merging together and reduces parsing and readability issues.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage and startup time when resuming large sessions
changes.summary: 大会话恢复更快更省内存
changes.summary_en: Lower memory and faster session resume
changes.why_matters: 让大型会话恢复更快、占用更少资源，提升长期使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes resuming large sessions faster and less memory-intensive for better long-running use.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed a brief flash of the login screen when opening the sidebar while already authenticated
changes.summary: 修复侧边栏登录闪屏
changes.summary_en: Fix login flash in VSCode sidebar
changes.why_matters: 减少已登录用户打开侧边栏时的短暂闪烁，提升界面稳定感。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes a brief flash for already-authenticated users and makes the UI feel smoother.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed "API Error: Rate limit reached" when selecting Opus — model dropdown no longer offers 1M context variant to subscribers whose plan tier is unknown
changes.summary: 修复Opus速率限制报错
changes.summary_en: Fix Opus rate limit error
changes.why_matters: 避免向不适用的订阅用户展示 1M 上下文版本，减少误选和报错。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents users from selecting an unsupported Opus variant and hitting avoidable rate-limit errors.

signals.title: Claude Code Cheat Sheet
Agents that run while I sleep
Push events into a running session with channels
Show HN: Claude Code skills that build complete Godot games
Cook: A simple CLI for orchestrating Claude Code

changes.raw: Increased default maximum output token limits for Claude Opus 4.6 to 64k tokens, and the upper bound for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 models to 128k tokens
changes.summary: 提升默认输出上限
changes.summary_en: Higher default output token limits
changes.why_matters: 可一次生成更长内容，减少被截断和反复续写。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can generate longer outputs in one shot, reducing truncation and follow-up prompts.

changes.raw: Added `allowRead` sandbox filesystem setting to re-allow read access within `denyRead` regions
changes.summary: 支持只读例外放行
changes.summary_en: Allow read access exceptions in denyRead
changes.why_matters: 可在受限目录中精细恢复只读访问，提升沙箱配置灵活性。
changes.why_matters_en: This enables finer-grained sandbox control by restoring read access in restricted paths.

changes.raw: `/copy` now accepts an optional index: `/copy N` copies the Nth-latest assistant response
changes.summary: 复制指定历史回复
changes.summary_en: Copy a specific recent assistant reply
changes.why_matters: 用户可直接复制指定轮次的回答，减少翻找和重复操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can copy a specific prior reply directly, saving time and effort.

changes.raw: Fixed "Always Allow" on compound bash commands (e.g. `cd src && npm test`) saving a single rule for the full string instead of per-subcommand, leading to dead rules and repeated permission prompts
changes.summary: 修复复合命令授权规则
changes.summary_en: Fix Always Allow rules for compound bash commands
changes.why_matters: 避免权限规则失效和重复弹窗，减少命令执行阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents dead permission rules and repeated prompts that block command execution.

changes.raw: Fixed auto-updater starting overlapping binary downloads when the slash-command overlay repeatedly opened and closed, accumulating tens of gigabytes of memory
changes.summary: 修复更新器内存暴涨
changes.summary_en: Fix overlapping auto-updater downloads
changes.why_matters: 避免长时间占用大量内存和磁盘资源，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents massive memory and disk usage, improving long-running stability.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` silently truncating recent conversation history due to a race between memory-extraction writes and the main transcript
changes.summary: 修复续会历史截断
changes.summary_en: Fix truncated history on resume
changes.why_matters: 可保留完整对话上下文，避免续会后丢失关键信息。
changes.why_matters_en: This preserves full conversation context and avoids losing important history after resume.

changes.raw: Fixed PreToolUse hooks returning `"allow"` bypassing `deny` permission rules, including enterprise managed settings
changes.summary: 修复钩子绕过拒绝规则
changes.summary_en: Fix hooks bypassing deny permission rules
changes.why_matters: 防止企业和本地拒绝策略被绕过，增强安全控制。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents bypassing deny policies, strengthening security and enterprise controls.

changes.raw: Fixed Write tool silently converting line endings when overwriting CRLF files or creating files in CRLF directories
changes.summary: 修复写入时换行被改动
changes.summary_en: Fix CRLF line endings on write
changes.why_matters: 避免破坏 Windows 文件格式，减少无意代码差异。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids breaking Windows file formatting and prevents unintended diffs.

changes.raw: Fixed memory growth in long-running sessions from progress messages surviving compaction
changes.summary: 修复压缩后进度消息泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix progress messages surviving compaction
changes.why_matters: 降低长会话内存增长，提升持续使用时的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces memory growth in long sessions and improves stability over time.

changes.raw: Fixed cost and token usage not being tracked when the API falls back to non-streaming mode
changes.summary: 修复离线计费统计缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix cost and token tracking in fallback mode
changes.why_matters: 让费用和用量统计更准确，便于监控与审计。
changes.why_matters_en: This keeps cost and usage tracking accurate for monitoring and auditing.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` not stripping beta tool-schema fields, causing proxy gateways to reject requests
changes.summary: 修复代理兼容字段问题
changes.summary_en: Fix beta schema fields for proxy gateways
changes.why_matters: 避免代理网关拒绝请求，提升企业环境兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents proxy gateways from rejecting requests, improving enterprise compatibility.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash tool reporting errors for successful commands when the system temp directory path contains spaces
changes.summary: 修复临时目录带空格报错
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash errors with spaced temp paths
changes.why_matters: 减少 Bash 工具误报，提升命令执行可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces false Bash errors and improves command execution reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed paste being lost when typing immediately after pasting
changes.summary: 修复粘贴后输入丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix lost paste when typing immediately
changes.why_matters: 避免输入内容被覆盖或丢失，提升编辑体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents pasted text from being lost and improves the typing experience.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+D in `/feedback` text input deleting forward instead of the second press exiting the session
changes.summary: 修复反馈框 Ctrl+D 行为
changes.summary_en: Fix Ctrl+D behavior in feedback input
changes.why_matters: 让快捷键行为符合预期，减少误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes the shortcut behave as expected and reduces accidental input loss.

changes.raw: Fixed API error when dragging a 0-byte image file into the prompt
changes.summary: 修复拖入空图报错
changes.summary_en: Fix error when dragging in empty image
changes.why_matters: 避免无效图片输入导致报错，提升多模态输入鲁棒性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents errors from invalid image input and improves multimodal robustness.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude Desktop sessions incorrectly using the terminal CLI's configured API key instead of OAuth
changes.summary: 修正桌面会话API认证错误
changes.summary_en: Fix Desktop sessions using wrong auth
changes.why_matters: 避免 Claude Desktop 错用终端 API key，确保不同登录方式的会话隔离与安全。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents Claude Desktop from using the terminal API key, preserving proper auth isolation and security.

changes.raw: Fixed `git-subdir` plugins at different subdirectories of the same monorepo commit colliding in the plugin cache
changes.summary: 修正子目录插件缓存冲突
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin cache collisions in monorepos
changes.why_matters: 同一 monorepo 不同子目录的插件不再互相覆盖，减少插件加载异常。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins in different subdirectories of the same monorepo no longer collide, reducing loading issues.

changes.raw: Fixed ordered list numbers not rendering in terminal UI
changes.summary: 修正终端列表编号显示
changes.summary_en: Fix ordered list numbers in terminal UI
changes.why_matters: 让终端界面中的有序列表正确显示，提升可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Ordered lists now render correctly in the terminal UI, improving readability.

changes.raw: Fixed a race condition where stale-worktree cleanup could delete an agent worktree just resumed from a previous crash
changes.summary: 修正工作树清理误删
changes.summary_en: Fix stale cleanup deleting resumed worktrees
changes.why_matters: 避免崩溃恢复后刚恢复的 agent worktree 被误删，防止任务丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents a resumed agent worktree from being deleted during cleanup, avoiding lost work.

changes.raw: Fixed input deadlock when opening `/mcp` or similar dialogs while the agent is running
changes.summary: 修正对话框打开时输入卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix input deadlock when opening dialogs
changes.why_matters: 在 agent 运行时打开 /mcp 等对话框不再卡死，保证交互不中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Opening /mcp-like dialogs while the agent runs no longer deadlocks input, keeping interaction responsive.

changes.raw: Fixed Backspace and Delete keys not working in vim NORMAL mode
changes.summary: 修正vim普通模式退格删除
changes.summary_en: Fix Backspace/Delete in vim NORMAL mode
changes.why_matters: 让 vim NORMAL 模式下的基础按键恢复可用，提升编辑体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores basic key behavior in vim NORMAL mode, improving the editing experience.

changes.raw: Fixed status line not updating when vim mode is toggled on or off
changes.summary: 修正vim模式状态栏刷新
changes.summary_en: Fix status line updates on vim mode toggle
changes.why_matters: 切换 vim 模式时状态栏能及时反映当前状态，减少误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: The status line now updates when vim mode changes, reducing confusion and mistakes.

changes.raw: Fixed hyperlinks opening twice on Cmd+click in VS Code, Cursor, and other xterm.js-based terminals
changes.summary: 修正链接双重打开问题
changes.summary_en: Fix links opening twice on Cmd+click
changes.why_matters: 避免在支持 xterm.js 的终端里点击链接时重复打开。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents links from opening twice when Cmd+clicking in xterm.js-based terminals.

changes.raw: Fixed background colors rendering as terminal-default inside tmux with default configuration
changes.summary: 修正tmux下背景色显示
changes.summary_en: Fix background colors in tmux
changes.why_matters: 在 tmux 默认配置下界面颜色更准确，减少视觉错乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Background colors render correctly in tmux by default, reducing visual glitches.

changes.raw: Fixed iTerm2 session crash when selecting text inside tmux over SSH
changes.summary: 修正tmux里iTerm2选区崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix iTerm2 crash selecting text in tmux
changes.why_matters: 避免在 tmux over SSH 场景中选择文本导致会话崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents session crashes when selecting text in iTerm2 over SSH inside tmux.

changes.raw: Fixed clipboard copy silently failing in tmux sessions; copy toast now indicates whether to paste with `⌘V` or tmux `prefix+]`
changes.summary: 改进tmux复制提示
changes.summary_en: Improve clipboard copy feedback in tmux
changes.why_matters: 复制失败时会明确提示 tmux 场景的粘贴方式，降低使用门槛。
changes.why_matters_en: Copy feedback now tells users how to paste in tmux, making clipboard use clearer.

changes.raw: Fixed `←`/`→` accidentally switching tabs in settings, permissions, and sandbox dialogs while navigating lists
changes.summary: 修正设置页左右键误切页
changes.summary_en: Fix arrow keys switching tabs accidentally
changes.why_matters: 在列表导航时不会误切换设置、权限和沙箱标签页。
changes.why_matters_en: Arrow-key navigation no longer accidentally switches tabs in settings, permissions, or sandbox dialogs.

changes.raw: Fixed IDE integration not auto-connecting when Claude Code is launched inside tmux or screen
changes.summary: 修正tmux/screen下IDE自动连接
changes.summary_en: Fix IDE auto-connect in tmux or screen
changes.why_matters: 在 tmux 或 screen 中启动时 IDE 集成能自动连接，减少手动操作。
changes.why_matters_en: IDE integration now auto-connects when launched inside tmux or screen, reducing manual setup.

changes.raw: Fixed CJK characters visually bleeding into adjacent UI elements when clipped at the right edge
changes.summary: 修正CJK字符裁切溢出
changes.summary_en: Fix clipped CJK text bleeding
changes.why_matters: 改善右侧裁切时的中文显示，提升界面整洁度。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves CJK rendering at clipped edges, making the UI cleaner.

changes.raw: Fixed teammate panes not closing when the leader exits
changes.summary: 修正队友面板退出不关闭
changes.summary_en: Fix teammate panes not closing on exit
changes.why_matters: 领导者退出时相关协作面板会正确关闭，避免残留界面。
changes.why_matters_en: Teammate panes now close properly when the leader exits, preventing stale UI.

changes.raw: Fixed iTerm2 auto mode not detecting iTerm2 for native split-pane teammates
changes.summary: 修复 iTerm2 分屏识别
changes.summary_en: Fix iTerm2 detection for split panes
changes.why_matters: 这能让 macOS 上的分屏协作和终端集成按预期工作，减少启动后不可用的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores expected terminal integration for split-pane workflows on macOS.

changes.raw: Faster startup on macOS (~60ms) by reading keychain credentials in parallel with module loading
changes.summary: 提升 macOS 启动速度
changes.summary_en: Faster macOS startup via parallel keychain read
changes.why_matters: 更快启动能减少等待时间，让用户更快进入编码工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Faster startup reduces wait time and gets users into their workflow sooner.

changes.raw: Faster `--resume` on fork-heavy and very large sessions — up to 45% faster loading and ~100-150MB less peak memory
changes.summary: 加速大会话恢复
changes.summary_en: Faster resume for huge fork-heavy sessions
changes.why_matters: 恢复长会话更快且更省内存，能明显改善大项目和复杂历史的使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Resuming large sessions is faster and uses less memory, improving reliability on big projects.

changes.raw: Improved Esc to abort in-flight non-streaming API requests
changes.summary: 优化 Esc 中断请求
changes.summary_en: Improved Esc to abort in-flight requests
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更及时地停止不需要的请求，提升交互控制感。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can stop unwanted requests more reliably, improving interactive control.

changes.raw: Improved `claude plugin validate` to check skill, agent, and command frontmatter plus `hooks/hooks.json`, catching YAML parse errors and schema violations
changes.summary: 增强插件校验覆盖
changes.summary_en: Stronger plugin validation for schemas and YAML
changes.why_matters: 更早发现配置和格式错误，能减少插件发布和运行时故障。
changes.why_matters_en: Catching config and schema issues earlier reduces plugin failures at install or runtime.

changes.raw: Background bash tasks are now killed if output exceeds 5GB, preventing runaway processes from filling disk
changes.summary: 限制后台任务占用磁盘
changes.summary_en: Kill runaway background tasks over 5GB output
changes.why_matters: 这能防止异常任务写满磁盘，避免影响系统稳定性和数据安全。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents runaway jobs from filling disk and harming system stability.

changes.raw: Sessions are now auto-named from plan content when you accept a plan
changes.summary: 接受计划后自动命名会话
changes.summary_en: Auto-name sessions from accepted plan content
changes.why_matters: 更清晰的会话命名有助于后续查找和管理历史记录。
changes.why_matters_en: Better session names make past work easier to find and manage.

changes.raw: Improved headless mode plugin installation to compose correctly with `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR`
changes.summary: 修复无头模式插件安装
changes.summary_en: Fix headless plugin install with seed dir
changes.why_matters: 这让自动化环境中的插件安装路径组合正确，减少部署失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes plugin installation work correctly in automated headless setups.

changes.raw: Show a notice when `apiKeyHelper` takes longer than 10s, preventing it from blocking the main loop
changes.summary: 提示慢速 apiKeyHelper
changes.summary_en: Warn when apiKeyHelper blocks too long
changes.why_matters: 及时提示慢操作可帮助用户定位卡顿原因，避免主循环被长时间阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: A warning helps users identify stalls before the main loop is blocked too long.

changes.raw: The Agent tool no longer accepts a `resume` parameter — use `SendMessage({to: agentId})` to continue a previously spawned agent
changes.summary: 移除 Agent 的 resume 参数
changes.summary_en: Agent tool no longer accepts resume parameter
changes.why_matters: 这会影响现有调用方式，使用者需要迁移到新的继续会话接口。
changes.why_matters_en: This breaks existing calls and requires migration to the new continuation pattern.

changes.raw: `SendMessage` now auto-resumes stopped agents in the background instead of returning an error
changes.summary: SendMessage 自动恢复代理
changes.summary_en: SendMessage auto-resumes stopped agents
changes.why_matters: 用户无需手动重启代理即可继续任务，减少中断和操作成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can continue work without manually restarting agents, reducing friction.

changes.raw: Renamed `/fork` to `/branch` (`/fork` still works as an alias)
changes.summary: 重命名 /fork 为 /branch
changes.summary_en: Rename /fork to /branch with alias support
changes.why_matters: 新名称更贴近语义，且保留别名可降低迁移成本。
changes.why_matters_en: The new name is clearer, while the alias keeps migration low-risk.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Improved plan preview tab titles to use the plan's heading instead of "Claude's Plan"
changes.summary: 优化 VSCode 计划标题
changes.summary_en: Better VSCode plan preview titles
changes.why_matters: 更准确的标题能提升预览可读性，帮助用户快速识别计划内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearer titles improve readability and help users identify plans faster.

changes.raw: [VSCode] When option+click doesn't trigger native selection on macOS, the footer now points to the `macOptionClickForcesSelection` setting
changes.summary: 提示 macOS 选区设置
changes.summary_en: Point to macOptionClickForcesSelection setting
changes.why_matters: 这能帮助用户更快修复 Option+点击选择问题，减少排障时间。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users fix Option-click selection issues faster with less troubleshooting.

signals.title: Claude Code Cheat Sheet
No, it doesn't cost Anthropic $5k per Claude Code user
Agents that run while I sleep
Push events into a running session with channels
Show HN: Claude Code skills that build complete Godot games

changes.raw: Added MCP elicitation support — MCP servers can now request structured input mid-task via an interactive dialog (form fields or browser URL)
changes.summary: 支持MCP交互式补充输入
changes.summary_en: Interactive MCP elicitation support
changes.why_matters: MCP服务器可在任务中途请求结构化输入，提升复杂流程的交互能力与自动化程度。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP servers can request structured input mid-task, improving interactive workflows and automation.

changes.raw: Added new `Elicitation` and `ElicitationResult` hooks to intercept and override responses before they're sent back
changes.summary: 可拦截并改写补充输入
changes.summary_en: Hooks to intercept elicitation replies
changes.why_matters: 允许在返回给MCP前检查和覆盖响应，便于集成自定义策略与治理控制。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets users inspect and override responses before they are sent back, enabling custom policies and governance.

changes.raw: Added `-n` / `--name <name>` CLI flag to set a display name for the session at startup
changes.summary: 会话启动可设显示名
changes.summary_en: Set session display name at startup
changes.why_matters: 启动时可直接命名会话，方便区分多个任务和提升可管理性。
changes.why_matters_en: You can name sessions at startup, making multiple tasks easier to distinguish and manage.

changes.raw: Added `worktree.sparsePaths` setting for `claude --worktree` in large monorepos to check out only the directories you need via git sparse-checkout
changes.summary: 大仓库支持稀疏检出工作树
changes.summary_en: Sparse checkout for worktree in monorepos
changes.why_matters: 在大型单体仓库中只检出需要的目录，可显著减少磁盘占用和初始化成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Checking out only needed directories in large monorepos reduces disk usage and setup cost.

changes.raw: Added `PostCompact` hook that fires after compaction completes
changes.summary: 压缩后可触发钩子
changes.summary_en: Post-compaction hook added
changes.why_matters: 压缩完成后可自动执行后续逻辑，便于构建更完整的工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: It enables follow-up automation after compaction, supporting more complete workflows.

changes.raw: Added `/effort` slash command to set model effort level
changes.summary: 新增/effort调节模型力度
changes.summary_en: New /effort command for model effort
changes.why_matters: 用户可快速调整模型推理力度，在速度与质量之间更灵活取舍。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly tune model effort, balancing speed and quality more flexibly.

changes.raw: Added session quality survey — enterprise admins can configure the sample rate via the `feedbackSurveyRate` setting
changes.summary: 新增会话质量调查
changes.summary_en: Session quality survey added
changes.why_matters: 企业可通过采样反馈了解使用体验并持续改进产品。
changes.why_matters_en: Enterprises can sample feedback to understand user experience and improve the product.

changes.raw: Fixed deferred tools (loaded via `ToolSearch`) losing their input schemas after conversation compaction, causing array and number parameters to be rejected with type errors
changes.summary: 修复压缩后延迟工具丢失schema
changes.summary_en: Fix deferred tools losing schemas after compaction
changes.why_matters: 避免数组和数字参数被误判为类型错误，保证延迟加载工具在长对话中可用。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents array and number parameters from being rejected, keeping deferred tools usable in long conversations.

changes.raw: Fixed slash commands showing "Unknown skill"
changes.summary: 修复斜杠命令误报未知技能
changes.summary_en: Fix slash commands showing unknown skill
changes.why_matters: 减少命令解析误报，避免用户在使用斜杠命令时产生困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces command parsing false alarms and avoids confusion when using slash commands.

changes.raw: Fixed plan mode asking for re-approval after the plan was already accepted
changes.summary: 修复计划模式重复要审批
changes.summary_en: Fix plan mode re-approval loop
changes.why_matters: 已批准的计划不再反复要求确认，减少中断并提升工作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Approved plans no longer trigger repeated approvals, reducing interruptions and improving productivity.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode swallowing keypresses while a permission dialog or plan editor was open
changes.summary: 修复语音模式吞键问题
changes.summary_en: Fix voice mode swallowing keypresses
changes.why_matters: 在权限弹窗或计划编辑器打开时仍能正常输入，提升交互可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Keyboard input remains reliable while permission dialogs or plan editors are open.

changes.raw: Fixed `/voice` not working on Windows when installed via npm
changes.summary: 修复Windows下npm版语音不可用
changes.summary_en: Fix /voice on Windows npm installs
changes.why_matters: Windows用户通过npm安装后也能正常使用语音功能，减少平台差异问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Windows users can use voice features after npm installation, reducing platform-specific issues.

changes.raw: Fixed spurious "Context limit reached" when invoking a skill with `model:` frontmatter on a 1M-context session
changes.summary: 修复1M上下文技能误报超限
changes.summary_en: Fix false context-limit errors with skills
changes.why_matters: 避免在超大上下文会话中出现错误的容量提示，提升长上下文稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It avoids false capacity warnings in 1M-context sessions, improving long-context stability.

changes.raw: Fixed "adaptive thinking is not supported on this model" error when using non-standard model strings
changes.summary: 修复非标准模型名的思考报错
changes.summary_en: Fix adaptive-thinking errors for custom model strings
changes.why_matters: 使用非标准模型字符串时不再误报不支持，提升兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Non-standard model strings no longer trigger false unsupported errors, improving compatibility.

changes.raw: Fixed `Bash(cmd:*)` permission rules not matching when a quoted argument contains `#`
changes.summary: 修复带#引号参数的Bash权限匹配
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash permission matching with quoted # args
changes.why_matters: 权限规则能正确匹配特殊参数，减少误拦截并提升命令执行可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Permission rules now match special arguments correctly, reducing false blocks and improving command reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed "don't ask again" in the Bash permission dialog showing the full raw command for pipes and compound commands
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 权限提示误显示命令
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash permission dialog raw command
changes.why_matters: 避免在管道和复合命令场景下泄露过多命令细节，提升权限确认的准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents overexposing command details in pipe and compound-command prompts, improving permission confirmation accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed auto-compaction retrying indefinitely after consecutive failures — a circuit breaker now stops after 3 attempts
changes.summary: 修复自动压缩无限重试
changes.summary_en: Fix endless auto-compaction retries
changes.why_matters: 加入熔断机制可避免失败后持续重试占用资源并影响会话稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: A circuit breaker prevents repeated failures from consuming resources and destabilizing the session.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP reconnect spinner persisting after successful reconnection
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 重连转圈不消失
changes.summary_en: Fix stuck MCP reconnect spinner
changes.why_matters: 重连成功后及时清除状态提示，避免用户误以为连接仍未恢复。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearing the spinner after recovery avoids misleading users into thinking the connection is still down.

changes.raw: Fixed LSP plugins not registering servers when the LSP Manager initialized before marketplaces were reconciled
changes.summary: 修复 LSP 插件服务器注册失败
changes.summary_en: Fix LSP servers not registering
changes.why_matters: 确保插件在初始化时能正确发现并注册语言服务器，恢复相关编辑能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures plugins can discover and register language servers correctly, restoring editor capabilities.

changes.raw: Fixed clipboard copying in tmux over SSH — now attempts both direct terminal write and tmux clipboard integration
changes.summary: 修复 tmux SSH 复制剪贴板
changes.summary_en: Fix clipboard copy in tmux over SSH
changes.why_matters: 让远程 tmux 场景下的复制功能更可靠，减少手动转存文本的麻烦。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes copying reliable in remote tmux sessions, reducing manual text transfer work.

changes.raw: Fixed `/export` showing only the filename instead of the full file path in the success message
changes.summary: 修复 /export 成功提示路径缺失
changes.summary_en: Fix /export success message path
changes.why_matters: 显示完整路径能帮助用户快速定位导出的文件。
changes.why_matters_en: Showing the full path helps users quickly locate exported files.

changes.raw: Fixed transcript not auto-scrolling to new messages after selecting text
changes.summary: 修复选中文本后不自动滚动
changes.summary_en: Fix transcript auto-scroll after selection
changes.why_matters: 恢复消息流自动滚动，便于持续跟进最新输出。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores auto-scrolling so users can keep up with the latest output.

changes.raw: Fixed Escape key not working to exit the login method selection screen
changes.summary: 修复 Esc 无法退出登录选择
changes.summary_en: Fix Esc on login method screen
changes.why_matters: 改善键盘可用性，让用户能更顺畅地取消登录流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves keyboard usability so users can cancel the login flow more smoothly.

changes.raw: Fixed several Remote Control issues: sessions silently dying when the server reaps an idle environment, rapid messages being queued one-at-a-time instead of batched, and stale work items causing redelivery after JWT refresh
changes.summary: 修复远控会话与消息队列问题
changes.summary_en: Fix remote control session and queue issues
changes.why_matters: 提升远程控制的可靠性，避免会话静默失效、消息延迟和重复派发。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves remote control reliability by preventing silent session loss, message lag, and duplicate delivery.

changes.raw: Fixed bridge sessions failing to recover after extended WebSocket disconnects
changes.summary: 修复桥接会话断连后无法恢复
changes.summary_en: Fix bridge session recovery after disconnect
changes.why_matters: 增强长时间网络中断后的恢复能力，减少会话中断带来的工作损失。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves recovery after long disconnects, reducing work loss from interrupted sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed slash commands not found when typing the exact name of a soft-hidden command
changes.summary: 修复软隐藏命令无法匹配
changes.summary_en: Fix hidden slash command lookup
changes.why_matters: 让用户输入精确命令名时也能正常找到命令，减少“找不到”的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures exact command names resolve correctly, reducing confusing not-found errors.

changes.raw: Improved `--worktree` startup performance by reading git refs directly and skipping redundant `git fetch` when the remote branch is already available locally
changes.summary: 提升 worktree 启动速度
changes.summary_en: Speed up worktree startup
changes.why_matters: 减少启动时的 Git 网络请求和重复检查，明显缩短进入工作状态的时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Cuts startup time by avoiding redundant Git fetches and checks, getting users to work faster.

changes.raw: Improved background agent behavior — killing a background agent now preserves its partial results in the conversation context
changes.summary: 保留后台代理未完成结果
changes.summary_en: Preserve partial background agent results
changes.why_matters: 即使终止后台代理，也能保留已完成的部分成果，减少信息丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps partial progress even if a background agent is killed, reducing lost work.

changes.raw: Improved model fallback notifications — now always visible instead of hidden behind verbose mode, with human-friendly model names
changes.summary: 模型回退提示更醒目易懂
changes.summary_en: Make model fallback notices clearer
changes.why_matters: 让用户更容易察觉模型切换，并理解当前使用的是哪个模型。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes model switches more visible and easier to understand for users.

changes.raw: Improved blockquote readability on dark terminal themes — text is now italic with a left bar instead of dim
changes.summary: 提升深色主题引用块可读性
changes.summary_en: Improve blockquote readability on dark themes
changes.why_matters: 改善终端视觉呈现，降低深色主题下阅读引用内容的负担。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves terminal readability and reduces strain when reading quotes on dark themes.

changes.raw: Improved stale worktree cleanup — worktrees left behind after an interrupted parallel run are now automatically cleaned up
changes.summary: 中断后自动清理残留工作区
changes.summary_en: Auto-clean stale worktrees after interruption
changes.why_matters: 并行运行中断后会自动清理残留工作区，减少手动整理和磁盘/状态污染。
changes.why_matters_en: Interrupted parallel runs now clean up leftover worktrees automatically, reducing manual cleanup and state clutter.

changes.raw: Improved Remote Control session titles — now derived from your first prompt instead of showing "Interactive session"
changes.summary: 会话标题改为首条提示生成
changes.summary_en: Session titles now use the first prompt
changes.why_matters: 远程控制会话标题更贴近实际任务，便于识别和管理会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Remote Control session titles now reflect the actual task, making sessions easier to पहचान and manage.

changes.raw: Improved `/voice` to show your dictation language on enable and warn when your `language` setting isn't supported for voice input
changes.summary: 语音模式显示语言并提示不支持
changes.summary_en: Voice shows language and warns on support
changes.why_matters: 启用语音时可直接确认听写语言，并提前发现不受支持的语言设置。
changes.why_matters_en: You can confirm the dictation language on enable and catch unsupported language settings before using voice input.

changes.raw: Updated `--plugin-dir` to only accept one path to support subcommands — use repeated `--plugin-dir` for multiple directories
changes.summary: 插件目录参数改为单路径
changes.summary_en: Plugin dir now accepts only one path
changes.why_matters: 该参数行为变更可能影响现有脚本，需要改用重复传参来指定多个目录。
changes.why_matters_en: This behavior change may break existing scripts and requires repeated flags to specify multiple directories.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed gitignore patterns containing commas silently excluding entire filetypes from the @-mention file picker
changes.summary: 修复 VSCode 文件选择误过滤
changes.summary_en: Fix VSCode file picker over-filtering
changes.why_matters: 修复逗号分隔的 gitignore 模式误排除整类文件的问题，避免文件选择器漏文件。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes comma-containing gitignore patterns from wrongly excluding whole file types in the file picker.

signals.title: Tell HN: I'm 60 years old. Claude Code has re-ignited a passion
No, it doesn't cost Anthropic $5k per Claude Code user

changes.raw: Added 1M context window for Opus 4.6 by default for Max, Team, and Enterprise plans (previously required extra usage)
changes.summary: 默认提供百万上下文
changes.summary_en: 1M context now included by default
changes.why_matters: 大幅提升长代码库和长对话的处理能力，且无需额外用量即可使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This greatly improves handling of large codebases and long conversations without extra usage charges.

changes.raw: Added `/color` command for all users to set a prompt-bar color for your session
changes.summary: 可设置会话提示栏颜色
changes.summary_en: Add /color to customize session bar
changes.why_matters: 让用户更容易区分不同会话，提升使用体验和可视化辨识度。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes sessions easier to distinguish and improves the overall user experience.

changes.raw: Added session name display on the prompt bar when using `/rename`
changes.summary: 提示栏显示会话名
changes.summary_en: Show session name in the prompt bar
changes.why_matters: 用户能更直观地确认当前会话，减少在多会话切换时的混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can more easily confirm the active session, reducing confusion when switching between sessions.

changes.raw: Added last-modified timestamps to memory files, helping Claude reason about which memories are fresh vs. stale
changes.summary: 记忆文件显示更新时间
changes.summary_en: Memory files now show last-modified time
changes.why_matters: 帮助 Claude 判断记忆新旧，提升引用记忆时的相关性和准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps Claude judge which memories are fresh, improving relevance and accuracy when using memory.

changes.raw: Added hook source display (settings/plugin/skill) in permission prompts when a hook requires confirmation
changes.summary: 权限提示显示钩子来源
changes.summary_en: Permission prompts show hook source
changes.why_matters: 用户能更清楚知道触发确认的来源，便于判断是否信任该钩子。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can better understand what triggered the confirmation and decide whether to trust the hook.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode not activating correctly on fresh installs without toggling `/voice` twice
changes.summary: 修复新装语音模式失效
changes.summary_en: Fix voice mode on fresh installs
changes.why_matters: 避免新用户首次使用语音功能时无法正常启用，减少上手障碍。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents first-time users from being blocked when trying to use voice mode.

changes.raw: Fixed the Claude Code header not updating the displayed model name after switching models with `/model` or Option+P
changes.summary: 切模型后标题同步更新
changes.summary_en: Header updates model name after switch
changes.why_matters: 界面显示与实际模型保持一致，减少误判当前运行模型的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: The UI stays consistent with the active model, reducing confusion about what is currently running.

changes.raw: Fixed session crash when an attachment message computation returns undefined values
changes.summary: 修复附件计算导致崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash from undefined attachment calc
changes.why_matters: 避免在处理附件消息时直接崩溃，提升会话稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents session crashes when processing attachment messages, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash tool mangling `!` in piped commands (e.g., `jq 'select(.x != .y)'` now works correctly)
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 管道感叹号转义
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash tool mangling ! in pipes
changes.why_matters: 让常见 shell 命令和过滤表达式能正确执行，减少脚本失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures common shell commands and filters run correctly, reducing script failures.

changes.raw: Fixed managed-disabled plugins showing up in the `/plugin` Installed tab — plugins force-disabled by your organization are now hidden
changes.summary: 隐藏组织禁用插件
changes.summary_en: Hide org-disabled plugins in Installed
changes.why_matters: 避免用户误以为这些插件可用，减少管理策略带来的混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents users from thinking force-disabled plugins are available, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed token estimation over-counting for thinking and `tool_use` blocks, preventing premature context compaction
changes.summary: 修正 token 估算过高
changes.summary_en: Fix token overcount for thinking/tool_use
changes.why_matters: 减少过早触发上下文压缩，帮助保留更多有效上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids premature context compaction and helps preserve more useful context.

changes.raw: Fixed corrupted marketplace config path handling
changes.summary: 修复市场配置路径损坏
changes.summary_en: Fix corrupted marketplace config path
changes.why_matters: 确保插件/市场配置能正确读取和保存，避免集成失效。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures marketplace and plugin configuration can be read and saved correctly.

changes.raw: Fixed `/resume` losing session names after resuming a forked or continued session
changes.summary: 恢复会话名在续接后保留
changes.summary_en: Preserve session names after /resume
changes.why_matters: 让续接或分叉后的会话更易识别，提升会话管理体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes resumed or forked sessions easier to identify and manage.

changes.raw: Fixed Esc not closing the `/status` dialog after visiting the Config tab
changes.summary: 修复 Esc 关闭状态对话框
changes.summary_en: Fix Esc closing /status dialog
changes.why_matters: 改善键盘交互一致性，避免用户卡在状态页面。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves keyboard interaction consistency and prevents users from getting stuck in the status dialog.

changes.raw: Fixed input handling when accepting or rejecting a plan
changes.summary: 修复计划确认输入异常
changes.summary_en: Fix input handling for plan accept/reject
changes.why_matters: 确保用户能可靠地接受或拒绝计划，避免交互流程中断。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures users can reliably accept or reject plans without the interaction flow breaking.

changes.raw: Fixed footer hint in agent teams showing "↓ to expand" instead of the correct "shift + ↓ to expand"
changes.summary: 修正团队页脚展开提示
changes.summary_en: Fix agent team expand hint
changes.why_matters: 让用户看到正确的快捷键提示，避免误操作和困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Users see the correct shortcut hint, avoiding confusion and misclicks.

changes.raw: Improved startup performance on macOS non-MDM machines by skipping unnecessary subprocess spawns
changes.summary: 提升 macOS 启动速度
changes.summary_en: Improve macOS startup speed
changes.why_matters: 减少不必要的子进程启动，能让非 MDM Mac 更快进入可用状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Skipping unnecessary subprocesses makes non-MDM Macs ready faster.

changes.raw: Suppressed async hook completion messages by default (visible with `--verbose` or transcript mode)
changes.summary: 默认隐藏异步完成消息
changes.summary_en: Hide async hook completion by default
changes.why_matters: 减少默认输出噪音，让终端界面更清爽，必要时仍可通过详细模式查看。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces default output noise while still allowing visibility in verbose or transcript mode.

changes.raw: Breaking change: Removed deprecated Windows managed settings fallback at `C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json` — use `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json`
changes.summary: 移除旧版 Windows 配置回退
changes.summary_en: Remove legacy Windows settings fallback
changes.why_matters: 旧路径不再生效，用户需要迁移到新位置以避免配置失效。
changes.why_matters_en: The old path no longer works, so users must move settings to the new location to avoid breakage.

changes.raw: Added actionable suggestions to `/context` command — identifies context-heavy tools, memory bloat, and capacity warnings with specific optimization tips
changes.summary: /context给出优化建议
changes.summary_en: Actionable /context optimization tips
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户快速发现上下文膨胀和内存占用问题，并给出可执行的优化方向。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users spot context bloat and memory pressure, with concrete optimization guidance.

changes.raw: Added `autoMemoryDirectory` setting to configure a custom directory for auto-memory storage
changes.summary: 支持自定义自动记忆目录
changes.summary_en: Custom auto-memory directory setting
changes.why_matters: 让用户可以把自动记忆数据放到指定位置，便于管理和隔离项目数据。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users choose where auto-memory data is stored, improving organization and isolation.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak where streaming API response buffers were not released when the generator was terminated early, causing unbounded RSS growth on the Node.js/npm code path
changes.summary: 修复流式响应内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix streaming response buffer leak
changes.why_matters: 避免 Node.js/npm 路径下 RSS 持续增长导致进程内存耗尽或崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unbounded RSS growth on the Node.js/npm path, avoiding memory exhaustion and crashes.

changes.raw: Fixed managed policy `ask` rules being bypassed by user `allow` rules or skill `allowed-tools`
changes.summary: 修复策略规则被绕过
changes.summary_en: Fix managed policy rule bypass
changes.why_matters: 确保受管策略中的拒绝规则真正生效，防止权限被用户规则意外放宽。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures managed deny rules are enforced and not accidentally overridden by user permissions.

changes.raw: Fixed full model IDs (e.g., `claude-opus-4-5`) being silently ignored in agent frontmatter `model:` field and `--agents` JSON config — agents now accept the same model values as `--model`
changes.summary: 代理模型ID现可正常识别
changes.summary_en: Agents now accept full model IDs
changes.why_matters: 避免代理配置中的模型字段被静默忽略，减少配置错误和行为不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents agent model settings from being silently ignored, reducing misconfiguration and surprises.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP OAuth authentication hanging when the callback port is already in use
changes.summary: 修复MCP OAuth回调端口卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP OAuth callback port hang
changes.why_matters: 当回调端口被占用时，认证流程不再无响应，提升连接成功率。
changes.why_matters_en: OAuth no longer hangs when the callback port is busy, improving connection reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP OAuth refresh never prompting for re-auth after the refresh token expires, for OAuth servers that return errors with HTTP 200 (e.g. Slack)
changes.summary: 刷新令牌过期可重新授权
changes.summary_en: Prompt re-auth when refresh token expires
changes.why_matters: 避免 OAuth 失效后一直卡在错误状态，尤其适用于返回 200 错误的服务。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents OAuth from getting stuck after expiry, especially for servers that return errors with HTTP 200.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode silently failing on the macOS native binary for users whose terminal had never been granted microphone permission — the binary now includes the `audio-input` entitlement so macOS prompts correctly
changes.summary: macOS语音模式权限提示修复
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS voice mode mic permission
changes.why_matters: 让首次未授权麦克风的用户能正确收到系统权限提示并正常使用语音功能。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures users without prior mic permission get the proper macOS prompt and can use voice mode.

changes.raw: Fixed `SessionEnd` hooks being killed after 1.5 s on exit regardless of `hook.timeout` — now configurable via `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS`
changes.summary: SessionEnd钩子超时可配置
changes.summary_en: Configurable SessionEnd hook timeout
changes.why_matters: 允许长一点的退出钩子完成清理工作，减少被强制终止带来的数据丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets longer exit hooks finish cleanup, reducing data loss from forced termination.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin install` failing inside the REPL for marketplace plugins with local sources
changes.summary: 修复REPL内插件安装失败
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin install in REPL
changes.why_matters: 让用户在交互式环境中也能顺利安装本地来源的市场插件。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows marketplace plugins with local sources to install successfully inside the REPL.

changes.raw: Fixed marketplace update not syncing git submodules — plugin sources in submodules no longer break after update
changes.summary: 更新插件时同步子模块
changes.summary_en: Sync git submodules on plugin update
changes.why_matters: 避免插件更新后因子模块未同步而损坏或无法正常使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents plugins from breaking after updates when their git submodules are not synced.

changes.raw: Fixed unknown slash commands with arguments silently dropping input — now shows your input as a warning
changes.summary: 未知斜杠命令保留参数
changes.summary_en: Warn on unknown slash command args
changes.why_matters: 用户输入不会再悄悄丢失，减少命令拼写错误带来的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: User input is no longer silently dropped, reducing confusion from mistyped commands.

changes.raw: Fixed Hebrew, Arabic, and other RTL text not rendering correctly in Windows Terminal, conhost, and VS Code integrated terminal
changes.summary: 修复Windows终端RTL显示
changes.summary_en: Fix RTL text rendering on Windows
changes.why_matters: 提升希伯来语、阿拉伯语等右到左语言在 Windows 终端中的可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves readability for Hebrew, Arabic, and other RTL languages in Windows terminals.

changes.raw: Fixed LSP servers not working on Windows due to malformed file URIs
changes.summary: 修复Windows上LSP失效
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows LSP file URI handling
changes.why_matters: 让 Windows 上的语言服务器能正常工作，恢复代码补全和诊断能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores LSP functionality on Windows, bringing back completions and diagnostics.

changes.raw: Changed `--plugin-dir` so local dev copies now override installed marketplace plugins with the same name (unless that plugin is force-enabled by managed settings)
changes.summary: 本地插件可覆盖同名市场插件
changes.summary_en: Local plugin dirs override marketplace
changes.why_matters: 方便开发者用本地副本调试插件，并在同名冲突时获得更符合预期的加载结果。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes it easier to test local plugin copies and get predictable precedence on name conflicts.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed delete button not working for Untitled sessions
changes.summary: 修复未命名会话删除按钮失效
changes.summary_en: Fix delete button for Untitled sessions
changes.why_matters: 用户可以正常删除未命名会话，避免界面操作失效带来的困扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can delete Untitled sessions normally, avoiding a broken UI action.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Improved scroll wheel responsiveness in the integrated terminal with terminal-aware acceleration
changes.summary: 增强终端滚轮滚动响应
changes.summary_en: Improve terminal scroll wheel responsiveness
changes.why_matters: 集成终端滚动更顺滑，提升长输出浏览时的使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: The integrated terminal scrolls more smoothly, improving the experience when browsing long output.

changes.raw: Added `modelOverrides` setting to map model picker entries to custom provider model IDs (e.g. Bedrock inference profile ARNs)
changes.summary: 支持模型映射自定义ID
changes.summary_en: Map picker models to custom IDs
changes.why_matters: 用户可以把模型选择器里的条目映射到自定义提供商模型ID，提升跨云和企业模型接入灵活性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can map picker entries to custom provider model IDs, improving flexibility for enterprise and multi-cloud model access.

changes.raw: Added actionable guidance when OAuth login or connectivity checks fail due to SSL certificate errors (corporate proxies, `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`)
changes.summary: SSL失败提示更可操作
changes.summary_en: Better guidance for SSL login failures
changes.why_matters: 当 OAuth 登录或连通性检查因证书问题失败时，用户能更快定位企业代理或 CA 配置问题。
changes.why_matters_en: When OAuth login or connectivity checks fail due to certificate issues, users can quickly diagnose proxy or CA configuration problems.

changes.raw: Fixed freezes and 100% CPU loops triggered by permission prompts for complex bash commands
changes.summary: 修复权限提示卡死和高CPU
changes.summary_en: Fix permission prompt freezes and CPU loops
changes.why_matters: 复杂 bash 命令触发权限提示时不再卡死或占满 CPU，避免严重阻塞工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Complex bash permission prompts no longer freeze or spin CPU, preventing major workflow stalls.

changes.raw: Fixed a deadlock that could freeze Claude Code when many skill files changed at once (e.g. during `git pull` in a repo with a large `.claude/skills/` directory)
changes.summary: 修复技能文件变更死锁
changes.summary_en: Fix deadlock on many skill file changes
changes.why_matters: 大量 skill 文件同时变更时不会再冻结 Claude Code，提升大型仓库中的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Claude Code no longer freezes when many skill files change at once, improving stability in large repos.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash tool output being lost when running multiple Claude Code sessions in the same project directory
changes.summary: 修复多会话Bash输出丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix lost Bash output across sessions
changes.why_matters: 同一项目目录下运行多个会话时，Bash 工具输出不再丢失，便于并行使用和排障。
changes.why_matters_en: Bash tool output is preserved when multiple sessions run in the same project, aiding parallel use and debugging.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents with `model: opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku` being silently downgraded to older model versions on Bedrock, Vertex, and Microsoft Foundry
changes.summary: 修复子代理模型被降级
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent model downgrades on cloud
changes.why_matters: 子代理在 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上会正确使用指定模型版本，避免能力下降。
changes.why_matters_en: Subagents now use the intended model versions on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, avoiding capability regressions.

changes.raw: Fixed background bash processes spawned by subagents not being cleaned up when the agent exits
changes.summary: 修复子代理后台进程残留
changes.summary_en: Fix orphaned background Bash processes
changes.why_matters: 子代理退出时会清理其后台 bash 进程，减少资源泄漏和残留任务。
changes.why_matters_en: Background Bash processes are cleaned up when subagents exit, reducing resource leaks and stray tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed `/resume` showing the current session in the picker
changes.summary: /resume不再显示当前会话
changes.summary_en: Hide current session from /resume picker
changes.why_matters: 会话选择器更准确，用户不会误选当前会话。
changes.why_matters_en: The session picker is more accurate, so users won't accidentally select the current session.

changes.raw: Fixed `/ide` crashing with `onInstall is not defined` when auto-installing the extension
changes.summary: /ide自动安装不再崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix /ide crash during auto-install
changes.why_matters: 自动安装 IDE 扩展时不再因缺少函数而崩溃，提升编辑器集成可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Auto-installing the IDE extension no longer crashes due to a missing function, improving editor integration reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed `/loop` not being available on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry and when telemetry was disabled
changes.summary: /loop在更多平台可用
changes.summary_en: Enable /loop on more providers
changes.why_matters: Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 以及关闭遥测时也能使用 /loop，减少功能缺失。
changes.why_matters_en: /loop is now available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and with telemetry disabled, reducing feature gaps.

changes.raw: Fixed SessionStart hooks firing twice when resuming a session via `--resume` or `--continue`
changes.summary: 恢复会话钩子只触发一次
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate SessionStart hooks
changes.why_matters: 通过 --resume 或 --continue 恢复会话时，SessionStart 钩子不再重复执行，避免副作用。
changes.why_matters_en: SessionStart hooks no longer run twice when resuming with --resume or --continue, preventing side effects.

changes.raw: Fixed JSON-output hooks injecting no-op system-reminder messages into the model's context on every turn
changes.summary: 修复JSON钩子污染上下文
changes.summary_en: Fix JSON hooks adding no-op reminders
changes.why_matters: JSON 输出钩子不再向模型上下文注入无效消息，减少上下文污染和额外开销。
changes.why_matters_en: JSON-output hooks no longer inject no-op messages into model context, reducing context pollution and overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode session corruption when a slow connection overlaps a new recording
changes.summary: 修复语音模式会话损坏
changes.summary_en: Fix voice session corruption on overlap
changes.why_matters: 慢连接与新录音重叠时，语音模式不会再损坏会话，提升交互稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice mode sessions no longer corrupt when a slow connection overlaps a new recording, improving interaction stability.

changes.raw: Fixed Linux sandbox failing to start with "ripgrep (rg) not found" on native builds
changes.summary: 修复Linux沙箱缺少rg
changes.summary_en: Fix Linux sandbox missing rg
changes.why_matters: 原生 Linux 构建上的沙箱可以正常启动，避免因缺少 ripgrep 而无法使用。
changes.why_matters_en: The Linux sandbox now starts correctly on native builds, avoiding failures caused by missing ripgrep.

changes.raw: Fixed Linux native modules not loading on Amazon Linux 2 and other glibc 2.26 systems
changes.summary: 修复老glibc系统模块加载
changes.summary_en: Fix native modules on older glibc
changes.why_matters: Amazon Linux 2 等较旧 glibc 系统可以正常加载原生模块，扩大可运行环境。
changes.why_matters_en: Native modules now load on older glibc systems like Amazon Linux 2, expanding supported environments.

changes.raw: Fixed "media_type: Field required" API error when receiving images via Remote Control
changes.summary: 修复远程控制图片上传报错
changes.summary_en: Fix image upload error in Remote Control
changes.why_matters: 避免远程控制接收图片时因接口字段缺失而失败，提升图像输入可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents image input failures in Remote Control due to a missing API field.

changes.raw: Fixed `/heapdump` failing on Windows with `EEXIST` error when the Desktop folder already exists
changes.summary: 修复 Windows /heapdump 失败
changes.summary_en: Fix /heapdump failure on Windows
changes.why_matters: 避免桌面目录已存在时命令报错，提升 Windows 上的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents command errors when the Desktop folder already exists, improving Windows reliability.

changes.raw: Improved Up arrow after interrupting Claude — now restores the interrupted prompt and rewinds the conversation in one step
changes.summary: 中断后上箭头一键恢复输入
changes.summary_en: Up arrow restores interrupted prompt
changes.why_matters: 让用户中断后能快速恢复未完成输入并回退对话，减少重复操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users quickly restore interrupted input and rewind the conversation with less friction.

changes.raw: Improved IDE detection speed at startup
changes.summary: 启动时 IDE 识别更快
changes.summary_en: Faster IDE detection at startup
changes.why_matters: 缩短启动等待时间，让工具更快进入可用状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces startup wait time and gets the tool ready sooner.

changes.raw: Improved clipboard image pasting performance on macOS
changes.summary: macOS 剪贴板图片粘贴更快
changes.summary_en: Faster clipboard image pasting on macOS
changes.why_matters: 提升图片粘贴响应速度，改善多模态输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves responsiveness when pasting images, making multimodal input smoother.

changes.raw: Improved `/effort` to work while Claude is responding, matching `/model` behavior
changes.summary: 响应中也可调节推理强度
changes.summary_en: Adjust effort while Claude is responding
changes.why_matters: 用户无需等待当前回复结束即可调整推理强度，交互更灵活。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can adjust reasoning effort without waiting for the current response to finish.

changes.raw: Improved voice mode to automatically retry transient connection failures during rapid push-to-talk re-press
changes.summary: 语音模式自动重试连接失败
changes.summary_en: Voice mode retries transient failures
changes.why_matters: 在快速连按说话时减少临时连接失败带来的中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces interruptions from transient connection failures during rapid push-to-talk use.

changes.raw: Improved the Remote Control spawn mode selection prompt with better context
changes.summary: 远程控制模式选择提示更清晰
changes.summary_en: Better context in Remote Control prompt
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户更容易理解并选择合适的启动模式。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users understand and choose the right spawn mode more easily.

changes.raw: Changed default Opus model on Bedrock, Vertex, and Microsoft Foundry to Opus 4.6 (was Opus 4.1)
changes.summary: 默认模型升级到 Opus 4.6
changes.summary_en: Default Opus model updated to 4.6
changes.why_matters: 默认模型变更可能影响输出风格、成本和兼容性，需要用户留意。
changes.why_matters_en: A default model change can affect output style, cost, and compatibility, so users should be aware.

changes.raw: Deprecated `/output-style` command — use `/config` instead. Output style is now fixed at session start for better prompt caching
changes.summary: /output-style 废弃改用 /config
changes.summary_en: /output-style deprecated; use /config
changes.why_matters: 旧命令不再推荐使用，用户需要迁移到新配置方式以避免后续失效。
changes.why_matters_en: The old command is no longer recommended, so users need to migrate to the new configuration flow.

changes.raw: VSCode: Fixed HTTP 400 errors for users behind proxies or on Bedrock/Vertex with Claude 4.5 models
changes.summary: 修复 VSCode 代理/Bedrock 400 错误
changes.summary_en: Fix VSCode HTTP 400 behind proxies
changes.why_matters: 解决特定网络和模型环境下的请求失败，提升 VSCode 集成可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes request failures in specific network and model setups, improving VSCode integration reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed tool search to activate even with `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` as long as `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` is set.
changes.summary: 支持自定义基址下工具搜索
changes.summary_en: Tool search works with custom base URL
changes.why_matters: 即使使用自定义 API 基址，也能正常启用工具搜索，减少配置受限带来的功能缺失。
changes.why_matters_en: Tool search now works even with a custom API base URL, avoiding a feature gap in non-default setups.

changes.raw: Added `w` key in `/copy` to write the focused selection directly to a file, bypassing the clipboard (useful over SSH)
changes.summary: 复制内容可直接写入文件
changes.summary_en: Write copied selection directly to file
changes.why_matters: 在 SSH 等没有剪贴板的环境里，可以直接把选中内容保存成文件，更方便远程使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets users save a selection to a file directly, which is especially useful in SSH sessions without a clipboard.

changes.raw: Added optional description argument to `/plan` (e.g., `/plan fix the auth bug`) that enters plan mode and immediately starts
changes.summary: 计划模式可直接带描述启动
changes.summary_en: Start plan mode with an inline prompt
changes.why_matters: 用户可以用一句话直接进入并启动计划流程，减少额外一步输入。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can enter and start plan mode in one step, reducing friction.

changes.raw: Added `ExitWorktree` tool to leave an `EnterWorktree` session
changes.summary: 新增退出工作树工具
changes.summary_en: Added tool to exit a worktree session
changes.why_matters: 让用户能更顺畅地离开工作树会话，完善工作流闭环。
changes.why_matters_en: This gives users a clean way to leave a worktree session and complete the workflow.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON` environment variable to immediately stop scheduled cron jobs mid-session
changes.summary: 可立即停用定时任务
changes.summary_en: Stop scheduled cron jobs mid-session
changes.why_matters: 用户可以在会话中及时停止自动任务，避免不必要的后台执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can stop scheduled automation immediately during a session, preventing unwanted background activity.

changes.raw: Added `lsof`, `pgrep`, `tput`, `ss`, `fd`, and `fdfind` to the bash auto-approval allowlist, reducing permission prompts for common read-only operations
changes.summary: 常用只读命令免确认
changes.summary_en: Allow common read-only commands by default
changes.why_matters: 减少常见只读命令的权限提示，能显著提升日常终端操作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Reducing prompts for common read-only commands makes everyday terminal use much smoother.

changes.raw: Restored the `model` parameter on the Agent tool for per-invocation model overrides
changes.summary: Agent 支持单次模型覆盖
changes.summary_en: Agent tool supports per-call model override
changes.why_matters: 用户可针对不同任务临时切换模型，提升灵活性和任务适配能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can override the model per call for better task-specific flexibility.

changes.raw: Simplified effort levels to low/medium/high (removed max) with new symbols (○ ◐ ●) and a brief notification instead of a persistent icon. Use `/effort auto` to reset to default
changes.summary: 思考强度档位更简洁
changes.summary_en: Simplified effort levels and indicators
changes.why_matters: 更清晰的档位和提示能降低配置理解成本，让用户更容易选择合适的思考强度。
changes.why_matters_en: Clearer effort levels and indicators reduce configuration complexity and make choices easier.

changes.raw: Improved `/config` — Escape now cancels changes, Enter saves and closes, Space toggles settings
changes.summary: 配置界面键盘操作更顺手
changes.summary_en: Better keyboard controls in /config
changes.why_matters: Escape、Enter、Space 的行为更符合直觉，提升配置修改效率。
changes.why_matters_en: More intuitive Escape, Enter, and Space behavior makes configuration faster and easier.

changes.raw: Improved up-arrow history to show current session's messages first when running multiple concurrent sessions
changes.summary: 并发会话历史更易查找
changes.summary_en: History shows current session first
