changes.why_matters: 在多个会话并行时，更容易先看到当前会话内容，减少翻找成本。
changes.why_matters_en: When multiple sessions run concurrently, current-session messages are easier to find first.

changes.raw: Improved voice input transcription accuracy for repo names and common dev terms (regex, OAuth, JSON)
changes.summary: 语音输入更懂开发术语
changes.summary_en: Better voice transcription for dev terms
changes.why_matters: 对仓库名和常见技术词的识别更准，能减少语音输入后的纠错。
changes.why_matters_en: Improved recognition of repo names and dev terms reduces correction work after voice input.

changes.raw: Improved bash command parsing by switching to a native module — faster initialization and no memory leak
changes.summary: bash 解析更快更稳定
changes.summary_en: Faster, leak-free bash parsing
changes.why_matters: 启动更快且避免内存泄漏，能提升长期运行时的稳定性和响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Faster startup and no memory leak improve stability and responsiveness over long sessions.

changes.raw: Reduced bundle size by ~510 KB
changes.summary: 安装包体积大幅缩小
changes.summary_en: Reduced bundle size by about 510 KB
changes.why_matters: 更小的包体积通常意味着更快的分发、安装和更新体验。
changes.why_matters_en: A smaller bundle usually means faster distribution, installation, and updates.

changes.raw: Changed CLAUDE.md HTML comments (`<!-- ... -->`) to be hidden from Claude when auto-injected. Comments remain visible when read with the Read tool
changes.summary: 自动注入注释对 Claude 隐藏
changes.summary_en: Hide HTML comments from auto-injected context
changes.why_matters: 减少无关注释进入模型上下文，能让自动注入的指令更干净、更聚焦。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeping comments out of auto-injected context makes the prompt cleaner and more focused.

changes.raw: Fixed slow exits when background tasks or hooks were slow to respond
changes.summary: 后台任务慢也能快速退出
changes.summary_en: Faster exit even with slow background tasks
changes.why_matters: 退出不再被慢任务或 hooks 卡住，提升整体交互流畅度和可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Exits are no longer blocked by slow tasks or hooks, improving responsiveness and reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed agent task progress stuck on "Initializing…"
changes.summary: 修复任务进度卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix task progress stuck on initializing
changes.why_matters: 避免代理任务看似卡死，提升长任务执行的可见性和信任感。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents agent tasks from appearing stuck and improves trust in long-running work.

changes.raw: Fixed skill hooks firing twice per event when a hooks-enabled skill is invoked by the model
changes.summary: 修复技能钩子重复触发
changes.summary_en: Fix skill hooks firing twice
changes.why_matters: 避免同一事件被重复处理，减少副作用和意外行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents duplicate event handling and reduces side effects.

changes.raw: Fixed several voice mode issues: occasional input lag, false "No speech detected" errors after releasing push-to-talk, and stale transcripts re-filling the prompt after submission
changes.summary: 修复语音模式输入问题
changes.summary_en: Fix voice mode lag and transcript bugs
changes.why_matters: 提升语音交互稳定性，避免误报和文本回填打断使用流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves voice interaction reliability and avoids disruptive false errors or transcript glitches.

changes.raw: Fixed `--continue` not resuming from the most recent point after `--compact`
changes.summary: 修复继续会话恢复位置
changes.summary_en: Fix continue resuming from latest point
changes.why_matters: 确保压缩后继续会话能回到最新上下文，避免丢失进度。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures continue resumes from the latest context after compaction and avoids lost progress.

changes.raw: Fixed bash security parsing edge cases
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 安全解析边界
changes.summary_en: Fix Bash security parsing edge cases
changes.why_matters: 降低命令解析漏洞风险，防止不安全输入被错误放行。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces command parsing risk and prevents unsafe input from being mishandled.

changes.raw: Added support for marketplace git URLs without `.git` suffix (Azure DevOps, AWS CodeCommit)
changes.summary: 支持无 .git 的仓库地址
changes.summary_en: Support marketplace URLs without .git
changes.why_matters: 让更多托管平台的仓库链接可直接使用，减少配置摩擦。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes more repository URLs work directly and reduces setup friction.

changes.raw: Improved marketplace clone failure messages to show diagnostic info even when git produces no stderr
changes.summary: 增强克隆失败诊断信息
changes.summary_en: Improve clone failure diagnostics
changes.why_matters: 即使 git 不输出错误，也能更快定位市场仓库克隆失败原因。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps diagnose marketplace clone failures faster even when git emits no stderr.

changes.raw: Fixed several plugin issues: installation failing on Windows with `EEXIST` error in OneDrive folders, marketplace blocking user-scope installs when a project-scope install exists, `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR` creating literal `~` directories, and `plugin.json` with marketplace-only fields failing to load
changes.summary: 修复插件安装与加载问题
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin install and loading issues
changes.why_matters: 提升插件在不同系统和安装范围下的可用性，减少安装失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves plugin reliability across systems and install scopes, reducing failures.

changes.raw: Fixed feedback survey appearing too frequently in long sessions
changes.summary: 降低反馈调查弹出频率
changes.summary_en: Reduce feedback survey frequency
changes.why_matters: 减少长会话中的打扰，让用户更专注于编码任务。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces interruptions in long sessions so users can stay focused on coding.

changes.raw: Fixed `--effort` CLI flag being reset by unrelated settings writes on startup
changes.summary: 修复 effort 选项被重置
changes.summary_en: Fix effort flag being reset
changes.why_matters: 确保启动参数能稳定生效，避免用户配置被意外覆盖。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures startup flags persist correctly and prevents accidental config overrides.

changes.raw: Fixed backgrounded Ctrl+B queries losing their transcript or corrupting the new conversation after `/clear`
changes.summary: 修复后台查询内容丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix background query transcript loss
changes.why_matters: 避免后台提问在清空会话后丢失或污染新对话。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents background queries from being lost or corrupting new conversations after clear.

changes.raw: Fixed `/clear` killing background agent/bash tasks — only foreground tasks are now cleared
changes.summary: 清空仅影响前台任务
changes.summary_en: Clear only foreground tasks
changes.why_matters: 防止误删后台代理和 bash 任务，保留正在运行的工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental deletion of background agent and bash tasks while preserving running work.

changes.raw: Fixed worktree isolation issues: Task tool resume not restoring cwd, and background task notifications missing `worktreePath` and `worktreeBranch`
changes.summary: 修复工作区隔离信息
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree isolation metadata
changes.why_matters: 确保恢复任务时目录正确，并让通知携带完整工作区信息。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures resumed tasks restore the correct directory and notifications include full worktree context.

changes.raw: Fixed `/model` not displaying results when run while Claude is working
changes.summary: 修复模型切换结果不显示
changes.summary_en: Fix /model results not showing
changes.why_matters: 让用户在忙碌时切换模型也能及时看到结果，减少操作不确定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users see model-switch results even while Claude is busy, reducing uncertainty.

changes.raw: Fixed digit keys selecting menu options instead of typing in plan mode permission prompt's text input
changes.summary: 修复计划模式数字键输入
changes.summary_en: Fix digit keys in plan mode prompt
changes.why_matters: 避免数字键误触菜单选择，提升权限提示输入的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents digit keys from accidentally selecting menu items and improves prompt input usability.

changes.raw: Fixed sandbox permission issues: certain file write operations incorrectly allowed without prompting, and output redirections to allowlisted directories (like `/tmp/claude/`) prompting unnecessarily
changes.summary: 修复沙箱权限误判
changes.summary_en: Fix sandbox permission misbehavior
changes.why_matters: 避免未提示就写入敏感位置，同时减少对允许目录的误拦截，提升安全性和可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unauthorized writes while reducing false prompts for allowed paths, improving safety and usability.

changes.raw: Improved CPU utilization in long sessions
changes.summary: 长会话更省 CPU
changes.summary_en: Improve CPU usage in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 长时间运行时更省资源，降低卡顿和电量/成本消耗。
changes.why_matters_en: Uses fewer resources in long-running sessions, reducing lag and power/cost usage.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt cache invalidation in SDK `query()` calls, reducing input token costs up to 12x
changes.summary: 修复缓存失效降成本
changes.summary_en: Fix cache invalidation to cut token cost
changes.why_matters: 减少 SDK 查询的输入 token 消耗，直接降低使用成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Cuts input token usage in SDK queries, directly reducing cost.

changes.raw: Fixed Escape key becoming unresponsive after cancelling a query
changes.summary: 修复取消后 Esc 失灵
changes.summary_en: Fix Escape key after cancelling a query
changes.why_matters: 恢复键盘交互响应，避免用户被卡在取消后的状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores keyboard responsiveness so users are not stuck after cancelling.

changes.raw: Fixed double Ctrl+C not exiting when background agents or tasks are running
changes.summary: 修复双击 Ctrl+C 退出
changes.summary_en: Fix double Ctrl+C exit behavior
changes.why_matters: 在后台任务运行时也能可靠退出，避免进程难以终止。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures reliable exit even with background work running, preventing stuck processes.

changes.raw: Fixed team agents to inherit the leader's model
changes.summary: 团队代理继承主模型
changes.summary_en: Make team agents inherit leader model
changes.why_matters: 保证团队代理与主代理一致，减少模型配置不一致带来的行为差异。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps team agents aligned with the leader, reducing behavior drift from model mismatch.

changes.raw: Fixed "Always Allow" saving permission rules that never match again
changes.summary: 修复始终允许规则失效
changes.summary_en: Fix broken Always Allow rule saving
changes.why_matters: 让已授权规则真正生效，减少重复确认和权限管理混乱。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes saved allow rules actually work, reducing repeated prompts and permission confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed several hooks issues: `transcript_path` pointing to the wrong directory for resumed/forked sessions, agent `prompt` being silently deleted from settings.json on every settings write, PostToolUse block reason displaying twice, async hooks not receiving stdin with bash `read -r`, and validation error message showing an example that fails validation
changes.summary: 修复多项 hooks 问题
changes.summary_en: Fix several hooks issues
changes.why_matters: 提升 hooks 在恢复会话、异步输入和配置写入中的可靠性，避免静默数据丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves hook reliability across resumed sessions, async input, and config writes, avoiding silent data loss.

changes.raw: Fixed session crashes in Desktop/SDK when Read returned files containing U+2028/U+2029 characters
changes.summary: 修复含特殊字符崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crashes on files with special chars
changes.why_matters: 避免 Desktop/SDK 在读取特定文件内容时崩溃，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents Desktop/SDK crashes when reading certain file contents, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal title being cleared on exit even when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` was set
changes.summary: 退出时保留终端标题
changes.summary_en: Preserve terminal title on exit
changes.why_matters: 尊重禁用终端标题设置，减少退出时的意外界面改动。
changes.why_matters_en: Respects the terminal title disable setting and avoids unexpected UI changes on exit.

changes.raw: Fixed several permission rule matching issues: wildcard rules not matching commands with heredocs, embedded newlines, or no arguments; `sandbox.excludedCommands` failing with env var prefixes; "always allow" suggesting overly broad prefixes for nested CLI tools; and deny rules not applying to all command forms
changes.summary: 修复权限规则匹配
changes.summary_en: Fix permission rule matching
changes.why_matters: 让通配、环境变量和拒绝规则按预期生效，减少误放行或误拦截。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes wildcard, env-prefixed, and deny rules behave correctly, reducing false allows and blocks.

changes.raw: Fixed oversized and truncated images from Bash data-URL output
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 图片输出异常
changes.summary_en: Fix oversized or truncated Bash images
changes.why_matters: 确保通过 data URL 输出的图片能正确显示，避免内容损坏。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures images emitted via data URLs render correctly instead of being oversized or truncated.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash when resuming sessions that contained Bedrock API errors
changes.summary: 修复恢复会话崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash when resuming error sessions
changes.why_matters: 让包含 API 错误的历史会话也能安全恢复，提升容错性。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows sessions with prior API errors to resume safely, improving fault tolerance.

changes.raw: Fixed intermittent "expected boolean, received string" validation errors on Edit, Bash, and Grep tool inputs
changes.summary: 修复工具输入校验报错
changes.summary_en: Fix intermittent tool input validation errors
changes.why_matters: 减少 Edit、Bash、Grep 等常用工具的随机失败，提高工作流稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces random failures in common tools like Edit, Bash, and Grep, improving workflow stability.

changes.raw: Fixed multi-line session titles when forking from a conversation whose first message contained newlines
changes.summary: 修复分叉标题换行问题
changes.summary_en: Fix multiline forked session titles
changes.why_matters: 让会话标题更整洁，避免因换行导致的显示异常。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps session titles clean and avoids display issues caused by newlines.

changes.raw: Fixed queued messages not showing attached images, and images being lost when pressing ↑ to edit a queued message
changes.summary: 修复队列消息图片丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix queued image attachments
changes.why_matters: 避免排队消息中的图片在编辑或显示时丢失，提升多模态输入的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents images in queued messages from disappearing when edited or displayed, improving multimodal input reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed parallel tool calls where a failed Read/WebFetch/Glob would cancel its siblings — only Bash errors now cascade
changes.summary: 修复并行工具失败连锁取消
changes.summary_en: Fix sibling tool calls canceling
changes.why_matters: 减少单个工具失败对其他并行任务的连带影响，提升并行执行的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces cascading failures across parallel tasks, improving the stability of concurrent execution.

changes.raw: VSCode: Fixed scroll speed in integrated terminals not matching native terminals
changes.summary: 修复终端滚动速度不一致
changes.summary_en: Fix terminal scroll speed mismatch
changes.why_matters: 让集成终端的滚动体验与原生终端一致，减少使用时的不适感。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes integrated terminal scrolling feel consistent with native terminals, reducing friction.

changes.raw: VSCode: Fixed Shift+Enter submitting input instead of inserting a newline for users with older keybindings
changes.summary: 修复旧快捷键换行失效
changes.summary_en: Fix Shift+Enter newline behavior
changes.why_matters: 避免旧键位设置下误提交输入，保证编辑多行内容时的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental submits with older keybindings and preserves reliable multiline input.

changes.raw: VSCode: Added effort level indicator on the input border
changes.summary: 输入框显示努力等级
changes.summary_en: Show effort level indicator
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户更直观地了解当前输入/执行的努力级别状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users more clearly see the current effort level state.

changes.raw: VSCode: Added `vscode://anthropic.claude-code/open` URI handler to open a new Claude Code tab programmatically, with optional `prompt` and `session` query parameters
changes.summary: 支持URI打开新Claude Code标签
changes.summary_en: Add URI handler to open Claude Code
changes.why_matters: 允许外部程序自动打开新会话并传入提示词或会话信息，增强自动化集成能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets external apps open new sessions and pass prompts or session data, improving automation and integration.

signals.title: Tell HN: I'm 60 years old. Claude Code has re-ignited a passion
No, it doesn't cost Anthropic $5k per Claude Code user
Agents that run while I sleep
Anthropic Cowork feature creates 10GB VM bundle on macOS without warning
Show HN: Claude Code skills that build complete Godot games

changes.raw: Added `/loop` command to run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. `/loop 5m check the deploy`)
changes.summary: 支持循环执行提示
changes.summary_en: Add recurring prompt loop command
changes.why_matters: 用户可以自动重复执行提示或命令，适合持续监控和定时检查任务。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can automatically repeat prompts or commands for ongoing checks and monitoring.

changes.raw: Added cron scheduling tools for recurring prompts within a session
changes.summary: 会话内支持定时调度
changes.summary_en: Add cron scheduling for prompts
changes.why_matters: 用户能在同一会话中按计划触发重复任务，提升自动化效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can trigger recurring tasks on a schedule within a session, improving automation efficiency.

changes.raw: Added `voice:pushToTalk` keybinding to make the voice activation key rebindable in `keybindings.json` (default: space) — modifier+letter combos like `meta+k` have zero typing interference
changes.summary: 语音按键可重绑定
changes.summary_en: Make voice push-to-talk rebindable
changes.why_matters: 用户可以避开输入冲突，按自己的习惯配置语音快捷键。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can avoid typing conflicts and configure the voice shortcut to fit their workflow.

changes.raw: Added `fmt`, `comm`, `cmp`, `numfmt`, `expr`, `test`, `printf`, `getconf`, `seq`, `tsort`, and `pr` to the bash auto-approval allowlist
changes.summary: 扩展自动批准白名单
changes.summary_en: Expand bash auto-approval allowlist
changes.why_matters: 更多常用命令可免确认执行，减少频繁打断。
changes.why_matters_en: More common commands can run without confirmation, reducing interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed stdin freeze in long-running sessions where keystrokes stop being processed but the process stays alive
changes.summary: 修复长会话输入冻结
changes.summary_en: Fix stdin freeze in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 避免长时间运行时键盘失灵，防止会话卡死影响工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents keyboard input from stalling in long-running sessions, avoiding disruptive hangs.

changes.raw: Fixed a 5–8 second startup freeze for users with voice mode enabled, caused by CoreAudio initialization blocking the main thread after system wake
changes.summary: 修复语音模式启动卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix voice-mode startup freeze
changes.why_matters: 语音模式启动更快更稳定，减少系统唤醒后的明显卡顿。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice mode starts faster and more reliably, reducing noticeable freezes after wake.

changes.raw: Fixed startup UI freeze when many claude.ai proxy connectors refresh an expired OAuth token simultaneously
changes.summary: 修复代理刷新导致界面卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix UI freeze on token refresh
changes.why_matters: 大量连接器同时刷新时不会阻塞主界面，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: The main UI no longer blocks when many connectors refresh at once, improving responsiveness.

changes.raw: Fixed forked conversations (`/fork`) sharing the same plan file, which caused plan edits in one fork to overwrite the other
changes.summary: 修复分叉计划文件冲突
changes.summary_en: Fix shared plan file in forks
changes.why_matters: 分叉会话的计划互不覆盖，避免编辑丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Forked conversations no longer overwrite each other's plans, preventing lost edits.

changes.raw: Fixed the Read tool putting oversized images into context when image processing failed, breaking subsequent turns in long image-heavy sessions
changes.summary: 修复大图占满上下文
changes.summary_en: Fix oversized images in context
changes.why_matters: 图片处理失败时不会污染上下文，减少后续对话被破坏的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Failed image processing no longer pollutes context, reducing the risk of breaking later turns.

changes.raw: Fixed false-positive permission prompts for compound bash commands containing heredoc commit messages
changes.summary: 修复 heredoc 误触发授权
changes.summary_en: Fix false permission prompts for heredoc
changes.why_matters: 减少不必要的权限弹窗，让复杂 bash 命令更顺畅执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces unnecessary permission prompts so complex bash commands run more smoothly.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin installations being lost when running multiple Claude Code instances
changes.summary: 修复多实例插件丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin loss across instances
changes.why_matters: 同时运行多个实例时插件配置不会丢失，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin configuration no longer disappears when multiple instances run at once, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed claude.ai connectors failing to reconnect after OAuth token refresh
changes.summary: 修复连接器重连失败
changes.summary_en: Fix connector reconnect after refresh
changes.why_matters: OAuth 刷新后连接器能自动恢复，减少手动重连。
changes.why_matters_en: Connectors recover automatically after OAuth refresh, reducing manual reconnection.

changes.raw: Fixed claude.ai MCP connector startup notifications appearing for every org-configured connector instead of only previously connected ones
changes.summary: 修复连接器通知过多
changes.summary_en: Fix excessive connector startup notices
changes.why_matters: 只提示真正需要关注的连接器，减少通知噪音。
changes.why_matters_en: Only relevant connectors trigger notices, reducing notification noise.

changes.raw: Fixed background agent completion notifications missing the output file path, which made it difficult for parent agents to recover agent results after context compaction
changes.summary: 补全后台代理结果路径
changes.summary_en: Include output path in agent notices
changes.why_matters: 父代理更容易找回子代理结果，降低上下文压缩后的恢复成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Parent agents can recover child results more easily, lowering recovery cost after compaction.

changes.raw: Fixed duplicate output in Bash tool error messages when commands exit with non-zero status
changes.summary: 修复 Bash 错误重复输出
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate Bash error output
changes.why_matters: 错误信息更简洁，便于快速定位命令失败原因。
changes.why_matters_en: Error output is cleaner, making command failures easier to diagnose.

changes.raw: Fixed Chrome extension auto-detection getting permanently stuck on "not installed" after running on a machine without local Chrome
changes.summary: 修复 Chrome 扩展误判卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix Chrome extension detection stuck
changes.why_matters: 避免在无本地 Chrome 的机器上误判为未安装后永久卡住，提升扩展检测可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents extension detection from getting stuck as not installed on machines without local Chrome.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin marketplace update` failing with merge conflicts when the marketplace is pinned to a branch/tag ref
changes.summary: 修复插件更新分支冲突
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin update on pinned refs
changes.why_matters: 让固定到分支或标签的插件市场更新正常工作，减少合并冲突导致的失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps marketplace updates working for branch- or tag-pinned refs without merge conflict failures.

changes.raw: Fixed `/plugin marketplace add owner/repo@ref` incorrectly parsing `@` — previously only `#` worked as a ref separator, causing undiagnosable errors with `strictKnownMarketplaces`
changes.summary: 修复插件引用符号解析
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin ref parsing with @
changes.why_matters: 正确解析 `owner/repo@ref`，避免严格市场配置下出现难以诊断的安装错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Correctly parses `owner/repo@ref`, avoiding hard-to-diagnose install errors under strict marketplace settings.

changes.raw: Fixed duplicate entries in `/permissions` Workspace tab when the same directory is added with and without a trailing slash
changes.summary: 修复权限页目录重复显示
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate workspace permissions
changes.why_matters: 避免同一目录因尾随斜杠不同而重复出现，提升权限页面可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the same directory from appearing twice due to trailing-slash differences, improving permissions UI clarity.

changes.raw: Fixed `--print` hanging forever when team agents are configured — the exit loop no longer waits on long-lived `in_process_teammate` tasks
changes.summary: 修复 print 模式无限挂起
changes.summary_en: Fix --print hanging with team agents
changes.why_matters: 确保 `--print` 能正常退出，不再因团队代理的长任务而无限等待。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures `--print` exits properly instead of waiting forever on long-lived team agent tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed "❯ Tool loaded." appearing in the REPL after every `ToolSearch` call
changes.summary: 移除 REPL 工具加载噪音
changes.summary_en: Remove REPL tool loaded noise
changes.why_matters: 减少每次 ToolSearch 后的无关输出，让交互更干净。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes noisy output after each ToolSearch call, making the REPL cleaner.

changes.raw: Fixed prompting for `cd <cwd> && git ...` on Windows when the model uses a mingw-style path
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 路径提示错误
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows cd path prompt
changes.why_matters: 避免在 Windows 上使用 mingw 风格路径时生成错误的 `cd && git` 提示。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents incorrect `cd && git` prompts on Windows when mingw-style paths are used.

changes.raw: Improved startup time by deferring native image processor loading to first use
changes.summary: 延迟加载图像处理器提速
changes.summary_en: Speed up startup by lazy-loading image processor
changes.why_matters: 通过按需加载原生图像处理器缩短启动时间，提升日常使用响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces startup time by loading the native image processor only when needed.

changes.raw: Improved bridge session reconnection to complete within seconds after laptop wake from sleep, instead of waiting up to 10 minutes
changes.summary: 睡眠后更快恢复桥接会话
changes.summary_en: Reconnect bridge sessions faster after sleep
changes.why_matters: 让笔记本唤醒后几秒内恢复连接，显著减少等待时间和中断感。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores bridge connections within seconds after wake, greatly reducing wait time and interruption.

changes.raw: Improved `/plugin uninstall` to disable project-scoped plugins in `.claude/settings.local.json` instead of modifying `.claude/settings.json`, so changes don't affect teammates
changes.summary: 插件卸载改为本地禁用
changes.summary_en: Uninstall plugins by disabling locally
changes.why_matters: 把项目级插件变更限制在本地配置中，避免影响团队成员的设置。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps project-scoped plugin changes in local config so teammates are not affected.

changes.raw: Improved plugin-provided MCP server deduplication — servers that duplicate a manually-configured server (same command/URL) are now skipped, preventing duplicate connections and tool sets. Suppressions are shown in the `/plugin` menu.
changes.summary: 去重插件 MCP 服务连接
changes.summary_en: Deduplicate plugin MCP servers
changes.why_matters: 跳过与手动配置重复的 MCP 服务，减少重复连接和重复工具集。
changes.why_matters_en: Skips plugin MCP servers that duplicate manual configs, preventing duplicate connections and tool sets.

changes.raw: Updated `/debug` to toggle debug logging on mid-session, since debug logs are no longer written by default
changes.summary: 支持会话中开启调试日志
changes.summary_en: Enable debug logging mid-session
changes.why_matters: 因为默认不再写调试日志，运行中可随时打开更方便排查问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Since debug logs are no longer written by default, you can now turn them on during a session for troubleshooting.

changes.raw: Removed startup notification noise for unauthenticated org-registered claude.ai connectors
changes.summary: 减少未认证连接启动通知
changes.summary_en: Reduce startup noise for unauthenticated connectors
changes.why_matters: 降低无关启动提示干扰，让未认证连接的启动体验更安静。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes unnecessary startup notifications, making unauthenticated connector startup quieter.

signals.title: Tell HN: I'm 60 years old. Claude Code has re-ignited a passion
MCP server that reduces Claude Code context consumption by 98%
No, it doesn't cost Anthropic $5k per Claude Code user
Agents that run while I sleep
Anthropic Cowork feature creates 10GB VM bundle on macOS without warning

changes.raw: Fixed API 400 errors when using `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` with a third-party gateway — tool search now correctly detects proxy endpoints and disables `tool_reference` blocks
changes.summary: 修复代理网关API 400错误
changes.summary_en: Fix 400 errors with proxy gateways
changes.why_matters: 使用第三方网关时工具搜索可正常工作，避免请求失败影响日常开发。
changes.why_matters_en: Tool search now works with third-party gateways, avoiding failed requests in daily development.

changes.raw: Fixed `API Error: 400 This model does not support the effort parameter` when using custom Bedrock inference profiles or other model identifiers not matching standard Claude naming patterns
changes.summary: 修复自定义模型努力参数报错
changes.summary_en: Fix effort-parameter errors for custom models
changes.why_matters: 自定义 Bedrock 或其他模型标识现在可正常使用，减少兼容性故障。
changes.why_matters_en: Custom Bedrock and other model IDs now work correctly, reducing compatibility failures.

changes.raw: Fixed empty model responses immediately after `ToolSearch` — the server renders tool schemas with system-prompt-style tags at the prompt tail, which could confuse models into stopping early
changes.summary: 修复工具搜索后空回复
changes.summary_en: Fix empty replies after ToolSearch
changes.why_matters: 模型不再因工具 schema 位置干扰而过早停止，提升输出稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Models no longer stop early due to tool-schema placement, improving response stability.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt-cache bust when an MCP server with `instructions` connects after the first turn
changes.summary: 修复MCP后接入缓存失效
changes.summary_en: Fix prompt-cache bust after late MCP connect
changes.why_matters: 后续连接 MCP 服务器时仍能保留缓存，减少重复推理和延迟。
changes.why_matters_en: Prompt cache now survives late MCP connections, reducing repeated inference and latency.

changes.raw: Fixed Enter inserting a newline instead of submitting when typing over a slow SSH connection
changes.summary: 修复慢SSH下回车换行问题
changes.summary_en: Fix Enter inserting newline over slow SSH
changes.why_matters: 远程慢连接下输入体验更可靠，避免误换行导致提交失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Input is more reliable over slow remote connections, avoiding accidental newlines and failed submits.

changes.raw: Fixed clipboard corrupting non-ASCII text (CJK, emoji) on Windows/WSL by using PowerShell `Set-Clipboard`
changes.summary: 修复Windows剪贴板乱码
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows clipboard corruption for non-ASCII
changes.why_matters: 中文、表情等文本复制粘贴不再损坏，提升跨平台可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Copy/paste of CJK and emoji text no longer breaks, improving cross-platform usability.

changes.raw: Fixed extra VS Code windows opening at startup on Windows when running from the VS Code integrated terminal
changes.summary: 修复Windows启动多开VS Code
changes.summary_en: Fix extra VS Code windows on Windows startup
changes.why_matters: 减少启动时的多余窗口，避免打断工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids extra startup windows, reducing disruption to the workflow.

changes.raw: Fixed voice mode failing on Windows native binary with "native audio module could not be loaded"
changes.summary: 修复Windows原生语音模块加载失败
changes.summary_en: Fix native audio module loading on Windows
changes.why_matters: Windows 原生语音模式可正常启用，恢复语音交互能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Voice mode now works on Windows native builds, restoring voice interaction.

changes.raw: Fixed push-to-talk not activating on session start when `voiceEnabled: true` was set in settings
changes.summary: 修复会话开始时按住说话失效
changes.summary_en: Fix push-to-talk not starting on session begin
changes.why_matters: 开启语音后可立即使用按住说话，减少首次交互失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Push-to-talk works immediately when voice is enabled, reducing first-use failures.

changes.raw: Fixed markdown links containing `#NNN` references incorrectly pointing to the current repository instead of the linked URL
changes.summary: 修复Markdown链接锚点跳错
changes.summary_en: Fix markdown links with # anchors
changes.why_matters: 带锚点的链接会正确跳转到目标 URL，避免误导用户。
changes.why_matters_en: Markdown links with anchors now open the correct target URL, avoiding misnavigation.

changes.raw: Fixed repeated "Model updated to Opus 4.6" notification when a project's `.claude/settings.json` has a legacy Opus model string pinned
changes.summary: 修复旧模型名重复更新提示
changes.summary_en: Fix repeated model-updated notifications
changes.why_matters: 减少无意义通知，避免用户被重复提示干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces noisy notifications so users are not repeatedly interrupted.

changes.raw: Fixed plugins showing as inaccurately installed in `/plugin`
changes.summary: 修复插件安装状态显示错误
changes.summary_en: Fix incorrect plugin installed status
changes.why_matters: 插件状态更准确，便于判断是否可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin status is now accurate, making it easier to know what is available.

changes.raw: Fixed plugins showing "not found in marketplace" errors on fresh startup by auto-refreshing after marketplace installation
changes.summary: 修复新装插件市场未刷新
changes.summary_en: Fix marketplace refresh after plugin install
changes.why_matters: 安装后能及时识别插件，减少“未找到”误报。
changes.why_matters_en: Installed plugins are recognized promptly, reducing false “not found” errors.

changes.raw: Fixed `/security-review` command failing with `unknown option merge-base` on older git versions
changes.summary: 修复旧Git下安全审查失败
changes.summary_en: Fix /security-review on older git versions
changes.why_matters: 旧版 Git 环境也能运行安全审查命令，提升兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: The security review command now works on older Git versions, improving compatibility.

changes.raw: Fixed `/color` command having no way to reset back to the default color — `/color default`, `/color gray`, `/color reset`, and `/color none` now restore the default
changes.summary: 支持重置默认颜色
changes.summary_en: Add ways to reset to default color
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更方便地恢复默认主题颜色，减少误配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can now easily restore the default theme color, reducing misconfiguration.

changes.raw: Fixed a performance regression in the `AskUserQuestion` preview dialog that re-ran markdown rendering on every keystroke in the notes input
changes.summary: 修复预览对话框输入卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix preview dialog re-render slowdown
changes.why_matters: 避免每次输入都重复渲染 Markdown，提升问答预览的响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids rerendering Markdown on every keystroke, making the Q&A preview more responsive.

changes.raw: Fixed feature flags read during early startup never refreshing their disk cache, causing stale values to persist across sessions
changes.summary: 修复早期启动缓存过期
changes.summary_en: Fix stale feature flags cache on startup
changes.why_matters: 确保功能开关能在跨会话后刷新，避免旧配置长期生效。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures feature flags refresh across sessions instead of staying stale from disk cache.

changes.raw: Fixed `permissions.defaultMode` settings values other than `acceptEdits` or `plan` being applied in Claude Code Remote environments — they are now ignored
changes.summary: 修复远程环境权限配置失效
changes.summary_en: Ignore unsupported remote permission modes
changes.why_matters: 防止远程环境误应用不支持的权限模式，减少权限行为异常和潜在风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unsupported permission modes from being applied in remote environments, reducing unexpected behavior and risk.

changes.raw: Fixed skill listing being re-injected on every `--resume` (~600 tokens saved per resume)
changes.summary: 修复续会重复注入技能列表
changes.summary_en: Stop reinjecting skills on resume
changes.why_matters: 减少每次恢复会话时的上下文浪费，节省 token 并降低成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces context bloat on resume, saving tokens and lowering cost.

changes.raw: Fixed teleport marker not rendering in VS Code teleported sessions
changes.summary: 修复 VS Code 传送标记不显示
changes.summary_en: Fix teleport marker in VS Code sessions
changes.why_matters: 让远程传送会话的状态提示正常显示，避免用户误判当前连接状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores the teleport marker so users can correctly see session state in VS Code.

changes.raw: Improved error message when microphone captures silence to distinguish from "no speech detected"
changes.summary: 优化静音录音报错提示
changes.summary_en: Improve silence-capture error message
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户区分静音和未检测到语音，便于更快排查麦克风问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users distinguish silence from no-speech detection, making microphone issues easier to diagnose.

changes.raw: Improved compaction to preserve images in the summarizer request, allowing prompt cache reuse for faster and cheaper compaction
changes.summary: 压缩时保留图片提升复用
changes.summary_en: Preserve images for faster compaction
changes.why_matters: 保留图片可提高提示缓存复用率，让压缩更快且更省成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeping images improves prompt cache reuse, making compaction faster and cheaper.

changes.raw: Improved `/rename` to work while Claude is processing, instead of being silently queued
changes.summary: 改进重命名支持处理中操作
changes.summary_en: Allow rename while Claude is working
changes.why_matters: 用户无需等待当前处理结束即可重命名，提高交互连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can rename without waiting for processing to finish, improving workflow continuity.

changes.raw: Reduced prompt input re-renders during turns by ~74%
changes.summary: 减少轮次中的输入重渲染
changes.summary_en: Reduce input rerenders during turns
changes.why_matters: 降低界面抖动和 CPU 开销，让对话过程更流畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Cuts UI churn and CPU overhead, making turns feel smoother.

changes.raw: Reduced startup memory by ~426KB for users without custom CA certificates
changes.summary: 降低启动内存占用
changes.summary_en: Reduce startup memory usage
changes.why_matters: 减少无自定义证书用户的启动资源消耗，提升轻量性。
changes.why_matters_en: Lowers startup resource usage for users without custom CA certificates.

changes.raw: Reduced Remote Control `/poll` rate to once per 10 minutes while connected (was 1–2s), cutting server load ~300×. Reconnection is unaffected — transport loss immediately wakes fast polling.
changes.summary: 大幅降低远程轮询频率
changes.summary_en: Cut remote polling load by 300x
changes.why_matters: 显著减少服务器负载，同时保持断线时的快速恢复能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Greatly reduces server load while preserving fast recovery when transport is lost.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added spark icon in VS Code activity bar that lists all Claude Code sessions, with sessions opening as full editors
changes.summary: VS Code 活动栏新增会话入口
changes.summary_en: Add VS Code activity bar session list
changes.why_matters: 让用户能在编辑器里直接查看并打开所有 Claude Code 会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users browse and open all Claude Code sessions directly from VS Code.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added full markdown document view for plans in VS Code, with support for adding comments to provide feedback
changes.summary: VS Code 支持计划文档视图
changes.summary_en: Add markdown plan view with comments
changes.why_matters: 把计划以原生文档形式展示并支持评论反馈，便于协作审阅。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows plans as native documents with comments, making review and feedback easier.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added native MCP server management dialog — use `/mcp` in the chat panel to enable/disable servers, reconnect, and manage OAuth authentication without switching to the terminal
changes.summary: 新增 MCP 服务器管理界面
changes.summary_en: Add native MCP server management dialog
changes.why_matters: 可在聊天面板中直接管理 MCP 服务器和 OAuth，无需切换到终端。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows managing MCP servers and OAuth directly in the chat panel without switching to the terminal.

signals.title: Tell HN: I'm 60 years old. Claude Code has re-ignited a passion
MCP server that reduces Claude Code context consumption by 98%
No, it doesn't cost Anthropic $5k per Claude Code user
Agents that run while I sleep
Anthropic Cowork feature creates 10GB VM bundle on macOS without warning

changes.raw: Added the `/claude-api` skill for building applications with the Claude API and Anthropic SDK
changes.summary: 新增 Claude API 开发技能
changes.summary_en: Add /claude-api skill for app building
changes.why_matters: 让用户更直接地用 Claude API 和 Anthropic SDK 开发应用，降低上手成本。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes it easier to build apps with the Claude API and Anthropic SDK, lowering the barrier to entry.

changes.raw: Added Ctrl+U on an empty bash prompt (`!`) to exit bash mode, matching `escape` and `backspace`
changes.summary: 空 bash 提示可用 Ctrl+U 退出
changes.summary_en: Ctrl+U exits bash mode on empty prompt
changes.why_matters: 为退出 bash 模式提供了更顺手的快捷键，减少误操作和切换成本。
changes.why_matters_en: It adds a more convenient shortcut to exit bash mode, reducing friction and mistakes.

changes.raw: Added numeric keypad support for selecting options in Claude's interview questions (previously only the number row above QWERTY worked)
changes.summary: 支持小键盘选择面试选项
changes.summary_en: Numpad now works for interview choices
changes.why_matters: 让数字输入更符合用户习惯，提升交互效率和可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves usability by letting users answer with the numeric keypad they already expect to use.

changes.raw: Added optional name argument to `/remote-control` and `claude remote-control` (`/remote-control My Project` or `--name "My Project"`) to set a custom session title visible in claude.ai/code
changes.summary: 远程控制可自定义会话标题
changes.summary_en: Custom session title for remote control
changes.why_matters: 便于在 claude.ai/code 中识别和管理不同会话，提升协作可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users identify and manage sessions in claude.ai/code more easily, improving collaboration clarity.

changes.raw: Added Voice STT support for 10 new languages (20 total) — Russian, Polish, Turkish, Dutch, Ukrainian, Greek, Czech, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian
changes.summary: 语音识别新增 10 种语言
changes.summary_en: Voice STT adds 10 more languages
changes.why_matters: 扩大了语音输入可用范围，让更多非英语用户能更自然地使用 Claude Code。
changes.why_matters_en: It broadens voice input support so more non-English users can use Claude Code naturally.

changes.raw: Added effort level display (e.g., "with low effort") to the logo and spinner, making it easier to see which effort setting is active
changes.summary: 界面显示当前 effort 等级
changes.summary_en: Logo and spinner show effort level
changes.why_matters: 让用户更容易确认当前推理强度设置，减少配置不确定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes the active effort setting visible, reducing uncertainty about configuration.

changes.raw: Added agent name display in terminal title when using `claude --agent`
changes.summary: 终端标题显示代理名称
changes.summary_en: Terminal title shows agent name
changes.why_matters: 在同时运行多个代理时更容易区分当前上下文，提升操作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes it easier to distinguish active contexts when multiple agents are running.

changes.raw: Added `sandbox.enableWeakerNetworkIsolation` setting (macOS only) to allow Go programs like `gh`, `gcloud`, and `terraform` to verify TLS certificates when using a custom MITM proxy with `httpProxyPort`
changes.summary: 支持弱网络隔离以验 TLS
changes.summary_en: Weaker network isolation for TLS checks
changes.why_matters: 解决自定义 MITM 代理下 Go 工具无法校验证书的问题，避免工作流中断。
changes.why_matters_en: It fixes TLS verification failures for Go tools behind custom MITM proxies, preventing workflow breakage.

changes.raw: Added `includeGitInstructions` setting (and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` env var) to remove built-in commit and PR workflow instructions from Claude's system prompt
changes.summary: 可关闭内置 Git 工作流提示
changes.summary_en: Option to disable built-in Git prompts
changes.why_matters: 允许团队按自己的流程定制系统提示，减少与现有 Git/PR 规范冲突。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets teams tailor the system prompt to their own workflow and avoid conflicts with existing Git/PR practices.

changes.raw: Added `/reload-plugins` command to activate pending plugin changes without restarting
changes.summary: 新增插件热重载命令
changes.summary_en: Reload plugins without restarting
changes.why_matters: 插件变更可立即生效，减少重启等待并加快迭代。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin changes can take effect immediately, reducing restart overhead and speeding iteration.

changes.raw: Added a one-time startup prompt suggesting Claude Code Desktop on macOS and Windows (max 3 showings, dismissible)
changes.summary: 启动时推荐桌面版应用
changes.summary_en: Startup prompt recommends desktop app
changes.why_matters: 帮助更多用户发现桌面端入口，提升产品触达和迁移体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users discover the desktop app, improving product adoption and migration experience.

changes.raw: Added `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}` variable for skills to reference their own directory in SKILL.md content
changes.summary: 技能可引用自身目录变量
changes.summary_en: Skills can reference their own directory
changes.why_matters: 让技能编写更灵活，便于组织相对路径和资源文件。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes skill authoring more flexible by simplifying relative paths and bundled resources.

changes.raw: Added `InstructionsLoaded` hook event that fires when CLAUDE.md or `.claude/rules/*.md` files are loaded into context
changes.summary: 新增指令加载 Hook 事件
changes.summary_en: New InstructionsLoaded hook event
changes.why_matters: 外部自动化可以在规则加载后及时响应，增强可扩展性。
changes.why_matters_en: External automation can react when instructions are loaded, improving extensibility.

changes.raw: Added `agent_id` (for subagents) and `agent_type` (for subagents and `--agent`) to hook events
changes.summary: Hook 增加子代理标识字段
changes.summary_en: Hooks now include subagent IDs/types
changes.why_matters: 让钩子能区分不同代理来源，便于精细化自动化和审计。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets hooks distinguish different agent sources, enabling finer-grained automation and auditing.

changes.raw: Added `worktree` field to status line hook commands with name, path, branch, and original repo directory when running in a `--worktree` session
changes.summary: 状态栏 Hook 增加 worktree 信息
changes.summary_en: Status hooks now include worktree info
changes.why_matters: 在多工作区场景下可更准确识别仓库上下文，减少操作混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves context awareness in multi-worktree setups, reducing confusion during operations.

changes.raw: Added `pluginTrustMessage` in managed settings to append organization-specific context to the plugin trust warning shown before installation
changes.summary: 增强插件信任提示上下文
changes.summary_en: Add org context to plugin trust warning
changes.why_matters: 让组织可以在插件安装前补充自定义说明，帮助用户更准确判断信任风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets organizations add custom context to plugin install warnings so users can judge trust more accurately.

changes.raw: Added policy limit fetching (e.g., remote control restrictions) for Team plan OAuth users, not just Enterprise
changes.summary: Team OAuth支持策略限制
changes.summary_en: Fetch policy limits for Team OAuth users
changes.why_matters: Team 计划的 OAuth 用户也能获取策略限制，减少权限行为不一致的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Team plan OAuth users can now receive policy limits, reducing inconsistent permission behavior.

changes.raw: Added `pathPattern` to `strictKnownMarketplaces` for regex-matching file/directory marketplace sources alongside `hostPattern` restrictions
changes.summary: 市场源支持路径正则匹配
changes.summary_en: Add regex path matching for marketplaces
changes.why_matters: 可按目录或文件路径精确限制 marketplace 来源，提升来源控制灵活性。
changes.why_matters_en: Marketplace sources can now be constrained by file or directory path patterns for finer control.

changes.raw: Added plugin source type `git-subdir` to point to a subdirectory within a git repo
changes.summary: 支持git子目录插件源
changes.summary_en: Support git subdir plugin sources
changes.why_matters: 插件可以直接指向仓库中的子目录，减少额外仓库拆分和配置成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins can point directly to a subdirectory in a git repo, reducing setup overhead.

changes.raw: Added `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` config option for MCP servers to specify a custom OAuth metadata discovery URL when standard discovery fails
changes.summary: MCP支持自定义OAuth元数据
changes.summary_en: Allow custom OAuth metadata URL for MCP
changes.why_matters: 当标准发现失败时，MCP 服务器可指定备用元数据地址，提高接入成功率。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP servers can specify a fallback metadata URL when standard discovery fails, improving connectivity.

changes.raw: Fixed a security issue where nested skill discovery could load skills from gitignored directories like `node_modules`
changes.summary: 修复忽略目录技能加载漏洞
changes.summary_en: Fix skill loading from gitignored dirs
changes.why_matters: 避免从 gitignored 目录意外加载技能，降低本地环境被误用或注入的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents skills from being loaded out of gitignored directories, reducing accidental or malicious injection risk.

changes.raw: Fixed trust dialog silently enabling all `.mcp.json` servers on first run. You'll now see the per-server approval dialog as expected
changes.summary: 修复首次信任弹窗异常
changes.summary_en: Fix first-run trust dialog for MCP servers
changes.why_matters: 首次启用时会按服务器逐个确认，避免无意间一次性放行所有 MCP 服务。
changes.why_matters_en: Users now approve MCP servers one by one on first run, preventing accidental blanket trust.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude remote-control` crashing immediately on npm installs with "bad option: --sdk-url" (anthropics/claude-code#28334)
changes.summary: 修复remote-control启动崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix remote-control crash on npm install
changes.why_matters: 解决 npm 安装后立即崩溃的问题，恢复远程控制功能可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes an immediate crash after npm install, restoring remote-control usability.

changes.raw: Fixed `--model claude-opus-4-0` and `--model claude-opus-4-1` resolving to deprecated Opus versions instead of current
changes.summary: 修复Opus模型解析错误
changes.summary_en: Fix wrong resolution for Opus model flags
changes.why_matters: 确保指定的模型版本与预期一致，避免使用过时模型影响结果。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures the requested model resolves correctly instead of falling back to deprecated versions.

changes.raw: Fixed macOS keychain corruption when using multiple OAuth MCP servers. Large OAuth metadata blobs could overflow the `security -i` stdin buffer, silently leaving stale credentials behind and causing repeated `/login` prompts.
changes.summary: 修复多OAuth钥匙串损坏
changes.summary_en: Fix keychain corruption with multiple OAuth MCPs
changes.why_matters: 防止凭据残留和反复登录，避免认证状态损坏影响多个 MCP 服务。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stale credentials and repeated login prompts caused by corrupted keychain writes.

changes.raw: Fixed `.credentials.json` losing `subscriptionType` (showing "Claude API" instead of "Claude Pro"/"Claude Max") when the profile endpoint transiently fails during token refresh (anthropics/claude-code#30185)
changes.summary: 修复订阅类型丢失显示
changes.summary_en: Preserve subscription type on refresh failure
changes.why_matters: 即使刷新时短暂失败，也能正确显示用户订阅类型，减少账户状态误判。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the correct subscription type visible even if profile refresh briefly fails.

changes.raw: Fixed ghost dotfiles (`.bashrc`, `HEAD`, etc.) appearing as untracked files in the working directory after sandboxed Bash commands on Linux
changes.summary: 修复沙箱Bash产生幽灵文件
changes.summary_en: Fix ghost dotfiles after sandboxed Bash
changes.why_matters: 避免工作区被错误标记为有未跟踪文件，减少噪音和误操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents spurious untracked files from appearing in the workspace after sandboxed Bash commands.

changes.raw: Fixed Shift+Enter printing `[27;2;13~` instead of inserting a newline in Ghostty over SSH
changes.summary: 修复Ghostty SSH换行异常
changes.summary_en: Fix Shift+Enter newline in Ghostty over SSH
changes.why_matters: 恢复远程终端中的正常换行输入，提升交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores normal newline input in remote terminal sessions for a smoother experience.

changes.raw: Fixed stash (Ctrl+S) being cleared when submitting a message while Claude is working
changes.summary: 修复提交时stash被清空
changes.summary_en: Fix stash clearing on message submit
changes.why_matters: 在 Claude 处理任务时提交消息不会丢失暂存内容，减少上下文和工作进度损失。
changes.why_matters_en: Submitting a message while Claude is working no longer clears the stash, preserving progress and context.

changes.raw: Fixed ctrl+o (transcript toggle) freezing for many seconds in long sessions with lots of file edits
changes.summary: 修复长会话转录切换卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix transcript toggle freeze in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 在长会话和大量文件编辑场景下切换转录更流畅，减少界面卡死。
changes.why_matters_en: Transcript toggling stays responsive in long, edit-heavy sessions, reducing UI freezes.

changes.raw: Fixed plan mode feedback input not supporting multi-line text entry (backslash+Enter and Shift+Enter now insert newlines)
changes.summary: 修复计划模式多行输入
changes.summary_en: Fix multiline input in plan mode
changes.why_matters: 让用户在计划模式下能正常输入多行内容，提升编辑长反馈的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users enter multiline feedback in plan mode, improving usability for longer inputs.

changes.raw: Fixed cursor not moving down into blank lines at the top of the input box
changes.summary: 修复输入框顶部光标下移
changes.summary_en: Fix cursor moving into blank lines
changes.why_matters: 避免光标在空行处无法正确移动，改善输入框编辑体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents cursor navigation glitches in blank lines and improves input editing.

changes.raw: Fixed `/stats` crash when transcript files contain entries with missing or malformed timestamps
changes.summary: 修复统计命令崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix /stats crash on bad timestamps
changes.why_matters: 避免日志格式异常时统计功能直接崩溃，提升工具稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps /stats working even with malformed transcript data, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed a brief hang after a streaming error on long sessions (the transcript was being fully rewritten to drop one line; it is now truncated in place)
changes.summary: 修复流式错误后的卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix hang after streaming errors
changes.why_matters: 减少长会话中出错后的明显卡顿，提升交互流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces noticeable stalls after errors in long sessions, improving responsiveness.

changes.raw: Fixed `--setting-sources user` not blocking dynamically discovered project skills
changes.summary: 修复用户级设置源限制
changes.summary_en: Fix user setting source restrictions
changes.why_matters: 确保用户配置能真正阻止动态发现的项目技能，强化配置控制。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures user settings can block dynamically discovered project skills as intended.

changes.raw: Fixed duplicate CLAUDE.md, slash commands, agents, and rules when running from a worktree nested inside its main repo (e.g. `claude -w`)
changes.summary: 修复 worktree 重复加载配置
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate config in nested worktree
changes.why_matters: 避免在嵌套 worktree 中重复加载规则和命令，减少混乱和误执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents duplicate rules and commands in nested worktrees, reducing confusion and mistakes.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin Stop/SessionEnd/etc hooks not firing after any `/plugin` operation
changes.summary: 修复插件操作后钩子失效
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin hooks after plugin ops
changes.why_matters: 保证插件生命周期钩子在操作后继续生效，维持自动化流程完整。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps plugin lifecycle hooks firing after plugin operations, preserving automation flows.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin hooks being silently dropped when two plugins use the same `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/...` command template
changes.summary: 修复插件钩子被静默丢弃
changes.summary_en: Fix silently dropped plugin hooks
changes.why_matters: 避免同模板命令导致插件钩子丢失，提升插件系统可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents hook loss when plugins share a command template, improving plugin reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak in long-running SDK/CCR sessions where conversation messages were retained unnecessarily
changes.summary: 修复长会话内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix memory leak in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 降低长时间运行时的内存占用，避免 SDK/CCR 会话逐渐变慢或失稳。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces memory growth in long-running sessions and helps prevent slowdowns or instability.

changes.raw: Fixed API 400 errors in forked agents (autocompact, summarization) when resuming sessions that were interrupted mid-tool-batch
changes.summary: 修复中断恢复时 API 400
changes.summary_en: Fix API 400 on interrupted resume
changes.why_matters: 让恢复被中断的会话更稳定，避免自动压缩和总结流程报错。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes resuming interrupted sessions more reliable and avoids errors in compaction and summarization.

changes.raw: Fixed "unexpected tool_use_id found in tool_result blocks" error when resuming conversations that start with an orphaned tool result
changes.summary: 修复孤立工具结果恢复报错
changes.summary_en: Fix orphaned tool result resume error
changes.why_matters: 避免恢复历史对话时因异常工具结果而失败，提升会话连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents resume failures caused by orphaned tool results, improving conversation continuity.

changes.raw: Fixed teammates accidentally spawning nested teammates via the Agent tool's `name` parameter
changes.summary: 修复 Agent 嵌套生成问题
changes.summary_en: Fix nested teammate spawning
changes.why_matters: 防止 Agent 误创建嵌套队友，避免任务结构失控。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the Agent tool from accidentally creating nested teammates and losing task structure.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` being ignored during conversation compaction
changes.summary: 修复压缩时输出上限失效
changes.summary_en: Fix max output tokens in compaction
changes.why_matters: 确保压缩过程遵守输出限制，减少意外超长输出和成本风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures compaction respects output limits, reducing unexpected long outputs and cost risk.

changes.raw: Fixed `/compact` summary rendering as a user bubble in SDK consumers (Claude Code Remote web UI, VSCode extension)
changes.summary: 修复压缩摘要显示样式
changes.summary_en: Fix compact summary display style
changes.why_matters: 让 SDK 和相关 UI 中的压缩摘要显示更符合预期，减少界面误解。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes compact summaries render correctly in SDK UIs, reducing visual confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed voice space bar getting stuck after a failed voice activation (module loading race, cold GrowthBook)
changes.summary: 修复语音空格键卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix stuck spacebar in voice mode
changes.why_matters: 避免语音激活失败后键盘输入异常，改善语音交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents keyboard input from getting stuck after voice activation failures, improving voice UX.

changes.raw: Fixed worktree file copy on Windows
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 工作区文件复制
changes.summary_en: Fix worktree file copy on Windows
changes.why_matters: 避免 Windows 用户在工作区文件复制时出错，提升跨平台可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents file copy failures for Windows users and improves cross-platform reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed global `.claude` folder detection on Windows
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 全局 .claude 识别
changes.summary_en: Fix global .claude detection on Windows
changes.why_matters: 确保 Windows 上能正确找到全局配置目录，避免配置失效。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures the global config directory is found correctly on Windows so settings work as expected.

changes.raw: Fixed symlink bypass where writing new files through a symlinked parent directory could escape the working directory in `acceptEdits` mode
changes.summary: 修复符号链接越权写入漏洞
changes.summary_en: Fix symlink escape on file writes
changes.why_matters: 防止通过符号链接绕过工作目录限制写入敏感位置，避免越权访问。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents symlink-based escapes from the working directory and blocks unauthorized file writes.

changes.raw: Fixed sandbox prompting users to approve non-allowed domains when `allowManagedDomainsOnly` is enabled in managed settings — non-allowed domains are now blocked automatically with no bypass
changes.summary: 修复受管域名自动拦截
changes.summary_en: Auto-block disallowed managed domains
changes.why_matters: 在受管设置下自动阻止非允许域名，减少误放行带来的安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Automatically blocks non-allowed domains in managed settings to reduce the risk of accidental approval.

changes.raw: Fixed interactive tools (e.g., `AskUserQuestion`) being silently auto-allowed when listed in a skill's allowed-tools, bypassing the permission prompt and running with empty answers
changes.summary: 修复交互工具误自动放行
changes.summary_en: Fix interactive tools auto-allowed
changes.why_matters: 避免需要人工确认的交互工具被静默放行，防止权限绕过和错误执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents interactive tools from bypassing permission prompts and running with unintended empty answers.

changes.raw: Fixed multi-GB memory spike when committing with large untracked binary files in the working tree
changes.summary: 修复大文件提交内存暴涨
changes.summary_en: Fix memory spike on large commits
changes.why_matters: 减少提交大体积未跟踪二进制文件时的内存占用，避免卡顿或崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces memory usage when committing large untracked binaries and helps avoid freezes or crashes.

changes.raw: Fixed Escape not interrupting a running turn when the input box has draft text. Use Up arrow to pull queued messages back for editing, or Ctrl+U to clear the input line.
changes.summary: 修复 Escape 中断输入问题
changes.summary_en: Fix Escape interrupt behavior
changes.why_matters: 让用户能更可靠地中断当前轮次并管理输入，提升交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes it easier to interrupt a running turn and manage queued input, improving the chat experience.

changes.raw: Fixed Android app crash when running local slash commands (`/voice`, `/cost`) in Remote Control sessions
changes.summary: 修复 Android 远控命令崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix Android crash on local slash commands
changes.why_matters: 避免 Android 远程控制会话中执行本地命令时崩溃，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes when running local commands in Android remote control sessions, improving stability.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak where old message array versions accumulated in React Compiler `memoCache` over long sessions
changes.summary: 修复消息缓存内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix message cache memory leak
changes.why_matters: 减少长会话中消息缓存持续增长导致的内存占用。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents message cache growth from consuming memory over long sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak where REPL render scopes accumulated over long sessions (~35MB over 1000 turns)
changes.summary: 修复 REPL 渲染内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix REPL render scope leak
changes.why_matters: 降低长时间使用 REPL 时的内存累积，提升持续运行稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces memory buildup during long REPL sessions and improves long-running stability.

changes.raw: Fixed memory retention in in-process teammates where the parent's full conversation history was pinned for the teammate's lifetime, preventing GC after `/clear` or auto-compact
changes.summary: 修复 teammate 历史占用内存
changes.summary_en: Fix teammate history memory retention
changes.why_matters: 避免子代理长期持有父会话历史，减少清空后仍无法释放内存的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents teammates from pinning the parent conversation history and blocking garbage collection.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak in interactive mode where hook events could accumulate unboundedly during long sessions
changes.summary: 修复交互模式事件泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix interactive hook event leak
changes.why_matters: 防止长会话中 hook 事件无限累积，降低内存风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents hook events from accumulating without bound during long interactive sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed hang when `--mcp-config` points to a corrupted file
changes.summary: 修复损坏 MCP 配置卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix hang on corrupted MCP config
changes.why_matters: 避免配置文件损坏时启动或加载流程卡住，提高容错性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents hangs when a corrupted config file is encountered, improving resilience.

changes.raw: Fixed slow startup when many skills/plugins are installed
changes.summary: 提升大量技能插件启动速度
changes.summary_en: Speed up startup with many skills
changes.why_matters: 在安装大量技能或插件时缩短启动等待时间，改善可扩展性体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces startup time when many skills or plugins are installed, improving scalability.

changes.raw: Fixed `cd <outside-dir> && <cmd>` permission prompt to surface the chained command instead of only showing "Yes, allow reading from <dir>/"
changes.summary: 显示完整链式命令提示
changes.summary_en: Show full chained command in prompt
changes.why_matters: 让权限提示更清楚地展示实际执行命令，帮助用户做出更准确的授权判断。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes permission prompts clearer by showing the actual chained command for better approval decisions.

changes.raw: Fixed conditional `.claude/rules/*.md` files (with `paths:` frontmatter) and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading in print mode (`claude -p`)
changes.summary: 修复打印模式规则加载
changes.summary_en: Fix rule loading in print mode
changes.why_matters: 确保 `claude -p` 能正确加载条件规则和嵌套配置，避免打印模式下行为不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures `claude -p` loads conditional rules and nested configs correctly, avoiding inconsistent print-mode behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed `/clear` not fully clearing all session caches, reducing memory retention in long sessions
changes.summary: 清理会话缓存更彻底
changes.summary_en: Clear session caches more fully
changes.why_matters: 减少长会话中的内存残留，让 `/clear` 更符合用户预期并提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces memory retention in long sessions so `/clear` behaves as expected and stays stable.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal flicker caused by animated elements at the scrollback boundary
changes.summary: 减少滚动边界闪烁
changes.summary_en: Reduce scrollback boundary flicker
changes.why_matters: 改善终端显示体验，减少动画元素在滚动边界处造成的视觉闪烁。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves terminal UX by reducing visual flicker from animated elements at the scrollback boundary.

changes.raw: Fixed UI frame drops on macOS when using MCP servers with OAuth (regression from 2.1.x)
changes.summary: 修复 macOS MCP 帧卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS frame drops with MCP OAuth
changes.why_matters: 恢复使用带 OAuth 的 MCP 服务时的界面流畅度，避免 macOS 上明显掉帧。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores UI smoothness when using OAuth-enabled MCP servers and avoids noticeable frame drops on macOS.

changes.raw: Fixed occasional frame stalls during typing caused by synchronous debug log flushes
changes.summary: 修复输入时偶发卡顿
changes.summary_en: Fix typing stalls from log flushes
changes.why_matters: 减少调试日志同步刷新导致的输入停顿，让编辑和交互更顺滑。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces input stalls caused by synchronous debug log flushes, making interaction smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed `TeammateIdle` and `TaskCompleted` hooks to support `{"continue": false, "stopReason": "..."}` to stop the teammate, matching `Stop` hook behavior
changes.summary: 支持停止队友的钩子返回
changes.summary_en: Support stopping teammate from hooks
changes.why_matters: 让相关 hook 能像 Stop 一样终止 teammate，增强自动化控制能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets these hooks stop a teammate like Stop hooks do, improving automation control.

changes.raw: Fixed `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` plugin hooks being silently ignored
changes.summary: 修复工作区钩子失效
changes.summary_en: Fix ignored worktree hooks
changes.why_matters: 确保创建和移除 worktree 的插件钩子真正生效，避免扩展逻辑被静默跳过。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures worktree create/remove plugin hooks actually run instead of being silently skipped.

changes.raw: Fixed skill descriptions with colons (e.g., "Triggers include: X, Y, Z") failing to load from SKILL.md frontmatter
changes.summary: 修复带冒号技能描述加载
changes.summary_en: Fix skill descriptions with colons
changes.why_matters: 避免 SKILL.md frontmatter 中包含冒号时技能加载失败，提升技能配置兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents SKILL.md frontmatter with colons from breaking skill loading, improving config compatibility.

changes.raw: Fixed project skills without a `description:` frontmatter field not appearing in Claude's available skills list
changes.summary: 无描述技能也能显示
changes.summary_en: Show skills even without description
changes.why_matters: 让未填写 description 的项目技能仍可出现在可用列表中，减少配置遗漏带来的不可见问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps project skills visible in the available list even without a description field, avoiding hidden configs.

changes.raw: Fixed `/context` showing identical token counts for all MCP tools from a server
changes.summary: 修正 MCP 工具 token 统计
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP tool token counts in /context
changes.why_matters: 让 `/context` 显示更准确的工具占用信息，便于判断上下文预算。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes `/context` show accurate tool token usage so users can judge context budget better.

changes.raw: Fixed literal `nul` file creation on Windows when the model uses CMD-style `2>nul` redirection in Git Bash
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 误建 nul 文件
changes.summary_en: Fix accidental nul file creation on Windows
changes.why_matters: 避免在 Windows/Git Bash 中因重定向语法误生成文件，防止污染工作区。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental file creation from redirection syntax on Windows/Git Bash, keeping the workspace clean.

changes.raw: Fixed extra blank lines appearing below each tool call in the expanded subagent transcript view (Ctrl+O)
changes.summary: 去掉子代理转录多余空行
changes.summary_en: Remove extra blank lines in subagent transcript
changes.why_matters: 改善展开后的子代理转录可读性，让工具调用记录更紧凑。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves readability of expanded subagent transcripts by removing unnecessary spacing.

changes.raw: Fixed Tab/arrow keys not cycling Settings tabs when `/config` search box is focused but empty
changes.summary: 修复设置页标签切换
changes.summary_en: Fix Settings tab cycling with empty search
changes.why_matters: 让搜索框为空时仍可用 Tab/方向键切换设置页，提升键盘操作体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows Tab/arrow navigation between Settings tabs when the search box is empty, improving keyboard UX.

changes.raw: Fixed service key OAuth sessions (CCR containers) spamming `[ERROR]` logs with 403s from profile-scoped endpoints
changes.summary: 修复 OAuth 403 日志刷屏
changes.summary_en: Fix OAuth 403 log spam
changes.why_matters: 减少服务密钥 OAuth 会话中的错误日志噪音，便于排查真正问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces noisy error logs in service-key OAuth sessions, making real issues easier to spot.

changes.raw: Fixed inconsistent color for "Remote Control active" status indicator
changes.summary: 统一远程控制状态颜色
changes.summary_en: Make Remote Control status color consistent
changes.why_matters: 提升状态提示的一致性和界面美观度。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves consistency and visual polish of the status indicator.

changes.raw: Fixed Voice waveform cursor covering the first suffix letter when dictating mid-input
changes.summary: 修复语音光标遮挡首字母
changes.summary_en: Fix voice cursor covering first letter
changes.why_matters: 避免口述输入时首字母被遮住，提升语音编辑的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the first letter from being obscured during dictation, improving voice editing usability.

changes.raw: Fixed Voice input showing all 5 spaces during warmup instead of capping at ~2 (aligning with the "keep holding…" hint)
changes.summary: 修复语音热身空格过多
changes.summary_en: Fix voice warmup showing too many spaces
changes.why_matters: 让语音输入的热身反馈更符合预期，减少界面误导。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes voice warmup feedback match expectations and reduces UI confusion.

changes.raw: Improved spinner performance by isolating the 50ms animation loop from the surrounding shell, reducing render and CPU overhead during turns
changes.summary: 优化转圈动画性能
changes.summary_en: Improve spinner animation performance
changes.why_matters: 降低转轮动画对渲染和 CPU 的占用，提升交互流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces render and CPU overhead from the spinner, making turns feel smoother.

changes.raw: Improved UI rendering performance in native binaries with React Compiler
changes.summary: 提升原生二进制渲染性能
changes.summary_en: Improve rendering performance in native binaries
changes.why_matters: 让原生版本界面响应更快，减少卡顿。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes the native UI more responsive and reduces stutter.

changes.raw: Improved `--worktree` startup by eliminating a git subprocess on the startup path
changes.summary: 加快 worktree 启动
changes.summary_en: Speed up --worktree startup
changes.why_matters: 减少启动路径上的 Git 开销，让进入工作区更快。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes Git overhead from startup, so worktree sessions begin faster.

changes.raw: Improved macOS startup by eliminating redundant settings-file reloads when managed settings resolve
changes.summary: 加快 macOS 启动
changes.summary_en: Speed up macOS startup
changes.why_matters: 减少配置重载带来的启动延迟，提升 macOS 上的打开速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Cuts startup delay from redundant settings reloads on macOS.

changes.raw: Improved macOS startup for Claude.ai enterprise/team users by skipping an unnecessary keychain lookup
changes.summary: 加快企业版 macOS 启动
changes.summary_en: Speed up macOS startup for enterprise users
changes.why_matters: 跳过不必要的钥匙串查询，缩短企业/团队用户启动时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Skips an unnecessary keychain lookup, reducing startup time for enterprise and team users.

changes.raw: Improved MCP `-p` startup by pipelining claude.ai config fetch with local connections and using a concurrency pool instead of sequential batching
changes.summary: 加快 MCP -p 启动
changes.summary_en: Speed up MCP -p startup
changes.why_matters: 通过并行化配置获取和连接建立，显著缩短启动等待。
changes.why_matters_en: Parallelizes config fetching and connections to reduce startup wait time.

changes.raw: Improved voice startup by removing imperceptible warmup pulse animations that were causing re-render stutter
changes.summary: 优化语音启动流畅度
changes.summary_en: Smooth voice startup
changes.why_matters: 去掉无感知的脉冲动画，减少重渲染抖动，让语音启动更顺滑。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes imperceptible pulse animations that caused re-render stutter during voice startup.

changes.raw: Improved MCP binary content handling: tools returning PDFs, Office documents, or audio now save decoded bytes to disk with the correct file extension instead of dumping raw base64 into the conversation context. WebFetch also saves binary responses alongside its summary.
changes.summary: 二进制工具结果自动落盘
changes.summary_en: Save binary tool outputs to disk
changes.why_matters: PDF、Office、音频等二进制结果会正确保存为文件，避免污染对话上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: PDFs, Office docs, and audio outputs are saved as proper files instead of raw base64 in chat context.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage in long sessions by stabilizing `onSubmit` across message updates
changes.summary: 降低长会话内存占用
changes.summary_en: Reduce memory use in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 稳定提交回调可减少长会话中的内存增长，提升持续使用稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Stabilizing submit handlers reduces memory growth in long sessions and improves stability.

changes.raw: Improved LSP tool rendering and memory context building to no longer read entire files
changes.summary: LSP 渲染不再整文件读取
changes.summary_en: Avoid reading whole files for LSP rendering
changes.why_matters: 减少大文件读取，提升工具渲染和记忆上下文构建效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids full-file reads, improving tool rendering and memory-context construction efficiency.

changes.raw: Improved session upload and memory sync to avoid reading large files into memory before size/binary checks
changes.summary: 上传与同步避免大文件入内存
changes.summary_en: Avoid loading large files into memory
changes.why_matters: 在大小和二进制检查前不再整文件读入，显著降低上传和同步时的内存压力。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents loading large files before size/binary checks, reducing memory pressure during upload and sync.

changes.raw: Improved file operation performance by avoiding reading file contents for existence checks (6 sites)
changes.summary: 文件检查不再读内容
changes.summary_en: Avoid reading file contents for existence checks
changes.why_matters: 减少多处不必要的文件读取，提升文件操作速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Removes unnecessary file reads across multiple sites, speeding up file operations.

changes.raw: Improved documentation to clarify that `--append-system-prompt-file` and `--system-prompt-file` work in interactive mode (the docs previously said print mode only)
changes.summary: 澄清系统提示文件用法
changes.summary_en: Clarify system prompt file usage
changes.why_matters: 修正文档说明，帮助用户正确在交互模式下使用相关参数。
changes.why_matters_en: Corrects the docs so users know these flags work in interactive mode.

changes.raw: Reduced baseline memory by ~16MB by deferring Yoga WASM preloading
changes.summary: 减少基础内存占用
changes.summary_en: Reduce baseline memory usage
changes.why_matters: 降低启动和常驻内存开销，能让工具在更多环境下更轻量、更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Lower startup and resident memory overhead makes the tool lighter and more stable in more environments.

changes.raw: Reduced memory footprint for SDK and CCR sessions using stream-json output
changes.summary: 降低会话内存占用
changes.summary_en: Reduce session memory footprint
changes.why_matters: 减少 SDK 和会话的内存压力，有助于长时间运行和大项目场景。
changes.why_matters_en: Reducing SDK and session memory pressure helps in long-running and large-project scenarios.

changes.raw: Reduced memory usage when resuming large sessions (including compacted history)
changes.summary: 恢复大会话更省内存
changes.summary_en: Use less memory when resuming large sessions
changes.why_matters: 让恢复大型历史会话更可靠，避免因内存峰值导致卡顿或失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes restoring large historical sessions more reliable and avoids stalls or failures from memory spikes.

changes.raw: Reduced token usage on multi-agent tasks with more concise subagent final reports
changes.summary: 多代理任务更省 token
changes.summary_en: Use fewer tokens in multi-agent tasks
changes.why_matters: 减少子代理汇报的 token 消耗，能降低成本并提升复杂任务效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Reducing subagent report token usage lowers cost and improves efficiency in complex tasks.

changes.raw: Changed Sonnet 4.5 users on Pro/Max/Team Premium to be automatically migrated to Sonnet 4.6
changes.summary: 自动升级到 Sonnet 4.6
changes.summary_en: Auto-migrate eligible users to Sonnet 4.6
changes.why_matters: 让符合条件的用户自动获得更新模型，无需手动切换。
changes.why_matters_en: Eligible users automatically get the newer model without manual switching.

changes.raw: Changed the `/resume` picker to show your most recent prompt instead of the first one. This also resolves some titles appearing as `(session)`.
changes.summary: 恢复列表显示最近提示
changes.summary_en: Show the most recent prompt in resume picker
changes.why_matters: 更容易快速找到最近的工作上下文，减少误选和查找成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes it easier to find the latest work context and reduces misselection and search effort.

changes.raw: Changed claude.ai MCP connector failures to show a notification instead of silently disappearing from the tool list
changes.summary: MCP 连接失败改为提示通知
changes.summary_en: Show a notification for MCP connector failures
changes.why_matters: 避免连接失败被静默隐藏，帮助用户及时发现并排查集成问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents connector failures from disappearing silently and helps users notice and debug integration issues.

changes.raw: Changed example command suggestions to be generated deterministically instead of calling Haiku
changes.summary: 示例命令建议改为确定性生成
changes.summary_en: Generate example command suggestions deterministically
changes.why_matters: 让建议结果更稳定可复现，减少不必要的模型调用和波动。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes suggestions stable and reproducible while avoiding unnecessary model calls and variability.

changes.raw: Changed resuming after compaction to no longer produce a preamble recap before continuing
changes.summary: 压缩后续聊不再重复回顾
changes.summary_en: Skip recap after resuming from compaction
changes.why_matters: 减少恢复后的冗余输出，让用户更快继续原本的工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces redundant output after resuming so users can get back to work faster.

changes.raw: [SDK] Changed task creation to no longer require the `activeForm` field — the spinner falls back to the task subject
changes.summary: SDK 创建任务无需 activeForm
changes.summary_en: SDK task creation no longer requires activeForm
changes.why_matters: 简化 SDK 接口，降低创建任务时的接入门槛和出错概率。
changes.why_matters_en: Simplifies the SDK API and lowers the chance of errors when creating tasks.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added compaction display as a collapsible "Compacted chat" card with the summary inside
changes.summary: VSCode 显示压缩聊天卡片
changes.summary_en: Show compacted chat as a collapsible card
changes.why_matters: 让压缩后的上下文更直观可展开，提升在编辑器中的会话可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes compacted context easier to inspect and improves session readability in the editor.

changes.raw: [VSCode] The permission mode picker now respects `permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode` from your effective Claude Code settings (including managed/policy settings) — when set to `disable`, bypass permissions mode is hidden from the picker
changes.summary: 权限模式选择器遵循设置
changes.summary_en: Permission picker now respects effective settings
changes.why_matters: 确保受策略管理的权限限制真正生效，避免用户误选被禁用的模式。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures policy-managed permission restrictions are actually enforced and prevents users from selecting disabled modes.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed RTL text (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian) rendering reversed in the chat panel (regression in v2.1.63)
changes.summary: 修复 RTL 聊天文本反向显示
changes.summary_en: Fix reversed RTL text rendering in chat
changes.why_matters: 改善阿拉伯语、希伯来语等语言的可用性，避免聊天内容难以阅读。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves usability for Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian users by preventing unreadable chat text.

changes.raw: Re-introduced the "ultrathink" keyword to enable high effort for the next turn

changes.summary_en: Re-enable ultrathink for high effort

changes.raw: Removed Opus 4 and 4.1 from Claude Code on the first-party API — users with these models pinned are automatically moved to Opus 4.6

changes.why_matters: 已固定旧模型的用户会被自动切换到新版本，可能影响原有行为但避免继续使用已移除模型。
changes.why_matters_en: Users pinned to older models are automatically moved to the new version, which may change behavior but avoids using removed models.

changes.raw: Reduced spurious error logging
changes.summary: 减少误报错误日志
changes.summary_en: Reduce spurious error logging
changes.why_matters: 降低无意义错误日志，帮助用户更快定位真正问题。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces noisy logs so users can focus on real issues faster.
