changes.raw: Added `/simplify` and `/batch` bundled slash commands
changes.summary: 新增简化与批量斜杠命令
changes.summary_en: Added bundled /simplify and /batch commands
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更快地调用常用工作流，减少重复输入和操作步骤。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can trigger common workflows faster with less repetitive typing and fewer steps.

changes.raw: Fixed local slash command output like /cost appearing as user-sent messages instead of system messages in the UI
changes.summary: 修复本地命令输出显示问题
changes.summary_en: Fixed local slash command output shown as user messages
changes.why_matters: 系统输出不再被误显示为用户消息，界面更准确也更易理解。
changes.why_matters_en: System output is no longer misclassified as user messages, making the UI clearer and more accurate.

changes.raw: Project configs & auto memory now shared across git worktrees of the same repository
changes.summary: 工作树共享配置与记忆
changes.summary_en: Project configs and auto memory shared across worktrees
changes.why_matters: 同一仓库的多个工作树能保持一致上下文，减少重复配置和记忆丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Multiple worktrees in the same repo now share context, reducing duplicate setup and lost memory.

changes.raw: Added `ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false` env var to opt out from making claude.ai MCP servers available
changes.summary: 支持关闭 Claude.ai MCP 服务器
changes.summary_en: Added env var to opt out of Claude.ai MCP servers
changes.why_matters: 用户可以选择不暴露相关 MCP 服务器，提升可控性与安全边界。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can opt out of exposing Claude.ai MCP servers, improving control and security boundaries.

changes.raw: Improved `/model` command to show the currently active model in the slash command menu
changes.summary: 模型菜单显示当前模型
changes.summary_en: Model menu now shows the active model
changes.why_matters: 用户能更直观地确认当前使用的模型，减少误选和切换成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can more easily confirm the active model, reducing mistakes and switching overhead.

changes.raw: Added HTTP hooks, which can POST JSON to a URL and receive JSON instead of running a shell command
changes.summary: 新增 HTTP Hooks
changes.summary_en: Added HTTP hooks with JSON POST/response
changes.why_matters: 可直接通过 HTTP 集成外部系统，扩展自动化能力而不依赖 shell 命令。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can integrate external systems over HTTP, expanding automation without shell commands.

changes.raw: Fixed listener leak in bridge polling loop
changes.summary: 修复桥接轮询监听泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed listener leak in bridge polling loop
changes.why_matters: 减少资源泄漏，避免长期运行时出现性能下降或异常。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces resource leaks and helps prevent performance degradation in long-running sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed listener leak in MCP OAuth flow cleanup
changes.summary: 修复 MCP OAuth 清理泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed listener leak in MCP OAuth cleanup
changes.why_matters: 认证流程更稳定，避免重复监听导致的内存或事件问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Authentication becomes more stable by avoiding memory or event issues from leaked listeners.

changes.raw: Added manual URL paste fallback during MCP OAuth authentication. If the automatic localhost redirect doesn't work, you can paste the callback URL to complete authentication.
changes.summary: 支持手动粘贴 OAuth 回调
changes.summary_en: Added manual URL paste fallback for MCP OAuth
changes.why_matters: 当自动回调失败时仍可完成认证，提高接入成功率。
changes.why_matters_en: Authentication can still complete when automatic redirect fails, improving setup success rates.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak when navigating hooks configuration menu
changes.summary: 修复 hooks 菜单内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed memory leak in hooks config menu
changes.why_matters: 减少界面操作时的内存增长，提升长期使用稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces memory growth during UI navigation and improves long-term stability.

changes.raw: Fixed listener leak in interactive permission handler during auto-approvals
changes.summary: 修复自动批准监听泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed listener leak in auto-approval handler
changes.why_matters: 自动授权流程更可靠，避免重复事件处理带来的异常。
changes.why_matters_en: Auto-approval becomes more reliable by avoiding duplicate event handling issues.

changes.raw: Fixed file count cache ignoring glob ignore patterns
changes.summary: 修复文件计数忽略规则
changes.summary_en: Fixed file count cache respecting ignore globs
changes.why_matters: 文件统计更准确，避免把应忽略的文件算进去影响分析结果。
changes.why_matters_en: File counts are now accurate, preventing ignored files from skewing analysis results.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak in bash command prefix cache
changes.summary: 修复 bash 前缀缓存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed memory leak in bash prefix cache
changes.why_matters: 减少内存占用，提升命令执行相关功能的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This lowers memory usage and improves stability for command execution features.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tool/resource cache leak on server reconnect
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 缓存重连泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed MCP cache leak on server reconnect
changes.why_matters: MCP 服务器重连后不会持续泄漏资源，集成更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP integrations stay stable without leaking resources after server reconnects.

changes.raw: Fixed IDE host IP detection cache incorrectly sharing results across ports
changes.summary: 修复 IDE 主机 IP 缓存串用
changes.summary_en: Fixed IDE host IP cache sharing across ports
changes.why_matters: 不同端口的 IDE 连接不会互相污染，避免连接到错误主机。
changes.why_matters_en: IDE connections on different ports no longer interfere, preventing wrong-host detection.

changes.raw: Fixed WebSocket listener leak on transport reconnect
changes.summary: 修复重连时 WebSocket 监听泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed WebSocket listener leak on reconnect
changes.why_matters: 避免重连后监听器累积导致资源泄漏和异常行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents listener buildup after reconnects, avoiding leaks and unstable behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak in git root detection cache that could cause unbounded growth in long-running sessions
changes.summary: 修复 Git 根目录缓存内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed unbounded git root cache growth
changes.why_matters: 长时间运行时可防止缓存无限增长并占用过多内存。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents unbounded cache growth and excessive memory use in long-running sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak in JSON parsing cache that grew unbounded over long sessions
changes.summary: 修复 JSON 解析缓存内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed unbounded JSON parse cache growth
changes.why_matters: 减少长会话中的内存持续上涨，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces memory growth over long sessions and improves stability.

changes.raw: VSCode: Fixed remote sessions not appearing in conversation history
changes.summary: 修复 VSCode 远程会话历史缺失
changes.summary_en: Fixed missing remote sessions in history
changes.why_matters: 让远程会话能正常出现在历史记录中，便于继续上下文。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures remote sessions appear in history so users can resume context.

changes.raw: Fixed a race condition in the REPL bridge where new messages could arrive at the server interleaved with historical messages during the initial connection flush, causing message ordering issues.
changes.summary: 修复 REPL 桥接消息乱序问题
changes.summary_en: Fixed REPL bridge message ordering race
changes.why_matters: 避免初始连接时历史消息与新消息交错，保证对话顺序正确。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents historical and new messages from interleaving during connect, preserving order.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak where long-running teammates retained all messages in AppState even after conversation compaction
changes.summary: 修复队友状态消息内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fixed AppState message retention leak
changes.why_matters: 避免压缩后仍保留全部消息，降低长期协作场景的内存压力。
changes.why_matters_en: Stops all messages from being retained after compaction, reducing memory pressure in long sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak where MCP server fetch caches were not cleared on disconnect, causing growing memory usage with servers that reconnect frequently
changes.summary: 修复 MCP 断开后缓存未清理
changes.summary_en: Fixed MCP fetch cache not cleared on disconnect
changes.why_matters: 防止频繁重连的 MCP 服务持续累积缓存占用内存。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents memory growth from fetch caches when MCP servers reconnect frequently.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage in long sessions with subagents by stripping heavy progress message payloads during context compaction
changes.summary: 压缩时精简子代理进度消息
changes.summary_en: Reduced subagent progress payloads on compaction
changes.why_matters: 在长会话中减少上下文体积，提升内存使用效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces context size in long sessions and improves memory efficiency.

changes.raw: Added "Always copy full response" option to the `/copy` picker. When selected, future `/copy` commands will skip the code block picker and copy the full response directly.
changes.summary: 新增始终复制完整回复选项
changes.summary_en: Added always copy full response option
changes.why_matters: 让常用复制操作更快捷，减少手动选择代码块的步骤。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes copying faster by skipping the picker and copying the full response directly.

changes.raw: VSCode: Added session rename and remove actions to the sessions list
changes.summary: VSCode 会话列表支持重命名删除
changes.summary_en: Added rename and remove actions in VSCode sessions
changes.why_matters: 提升会话管理效率，方便整理和清理历史会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves session management by making it easier to organize and clean up sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed `/clear` not resetting cached skills, which could cause stale skill content to persist in the new conversation
changes.summary: 修复清空后技能缓存未重置
changes.summary_en: Fixed /clear not resetting cached skills
changes.why_matters: 避免新对话继续使用旧技能内容，保证上下文干净准确。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stale skill content from leaking into new conversations after /clear.

changes.raw: Claude automatically saves useful context to auto-memory. Manage with /memory
changes.summary: 自动保存有用上下文到记忆
changes.summary_en: Auto-save useful context to memory
changes.why_matters: 减少重复输入，让 Claude Code 更容易延续上下文并保持工作连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces repeated input and helps Claude Code retain context across sessions.

changes.raw: Added `/copy` command to show an interactive picker when code blocks are present, allowing selection of individual code blocks or the full response.
changes.summary: 代码块可交互复制
changes.summary_en: Interactive copy picker for code blocks
changes.why_matters: 当回复里有多个代码块时，用户可以更精确地复制需要的内容。
changes.why_matters_en: When a response has multiple code blocks, users can copy exactly the snippet they need.

changes.raw: Improved "always allow" prefix suggestions for compound bash commands (e.g. `cd /tmp && git fetch && git push`) to compute smarter per-subcommand prefixes instead of treating the whole command as one
changes.summary: 更智能的命令放行前缀
changes.summary_en: Smarter allow prefixes for compound commands
changes.why_matters: 对复合 bash 命令按子命令判断放行，能减少误判并提升执行效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Evaluating compound bash commands per subcommand reduces false matches and improves execution flow.

changes.raw: Improved ordering of short task lists
changes.summary: 优化短任务列表排序
changes.summary_en: Improved ordering of short task lists
changes.why_matters: 让短任务展示更合理，提升浏览和选择任务时的可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes short task lists easier to scan and choose from.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage in multi-agent sessions by releasing completed subagent task state
changes.summary: 多代理会话更省内存
changes.summary_en: Lower memory use in multi-agent sessions
changes.why_matters: 释放已完成子代理状态可降低资源占用，让长会话更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Releasing completed subagent state lowers resource usage and makes long sessions more stable.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP OAuth token refresh race condition when running multiple Claude Code instances simultaneously
changes.summary: 修复多实例 OAuth 刷新竞态
changes.summary_en: Fix OAuth token refresh race across instances
changes.why_matters: 避免多个 Claude Code 实例同时运行时认证失效，保障持续可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents auth failures when multiple Claude Code instances run at once, preserving availability.

changes.raw: Fixed shell commands not showing a clear error message when the working directory has been deleted
changes.summary: 工作目录删除时提示更清晰
changes.summary_en: Clearer error when working directory is deleted
changes.why_matters: 当目录被删除时能快速定位问题，减少命令失败后的排查成本。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users quickly identify the issue and reduces debugging time after command failures.

changes.raw: Fixed config file corruption that could wipe authentication when multiple Claude Code instances ran simultaneously
changes.summary: 修复多实例配置损坏导致掉登
changes.summary_en: Fix config corruption that could wipe auth
changes.why_matters: 防止并发运行时配置损坏导致认证信息丢失，避免严重的登录和数据风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents concurrent runs from corrupting config and wiping auth, avoiding serious login and data risk.

changes.raw: Fixed a UI flicker where user input would briefly disappear after submission before the message rendered
changes.summary: 修复提交后输入闪烁消失
changes.summary_en: Fix input flicker after submit

changes.raw: Fixed bulk agent kill (ctrl+f) to send a single aggregate notification instead of one per agent, and to properly clear the command queue

changes.raw: Fixed graceful shutdown sometimes leaving stale sessions when using Remote Control by parallelizing teardown network calls
changes.summary: 远程控制关闭更彻底
changes.summary_en: Make Remote Control shutdown cleaner
changes.why_matters: 避免优雅关闭后残留会话，提升远程控制场景的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stale sessions after shutdown and improves reliability in Remote Control workflows.

changes.raw: Fixed `--worktree` sometimes being ignored on first launch
changes.summary: 首次启动正确应用工作树
changes.summary_en: Apply worktree correctly on first launch
changes.why_matters: 确保首次启动时就进入正确工作目录，减少配置失效带来的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures the correct worktree is used on first launch and avoids confusing setup failures.

changes.raw: Fixed a panic ("switch on corrupted value") on Windows
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 崩溃与异常

changes.why_matters_en: Removes a severe crash condition and improves Windows reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash that could occur when spawning many processes on Windows
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 多进程崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows crash when spawning many processes
changes.why_matters: 避免高并发进程创建时崩溃，保障重负载任务稳定运行。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes under heavy process spawning and keeps demanding workloads stable.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash in the WebAssembly interpreter on Linux x64 & Windows x64
changes.summary: 修复 Linux/Windows WASM 崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix WASM interpreter crash on Linux/Windows
changes.why_matters: 修复核心运行时崩溃，避免在关键平台上影响工具可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes a runtime crash that could break the tool on major platforms.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred after 2 minutes on Windows ARM64
changes.summary: 修复 Windows ARM64 随机崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix intermittent Windows ARM64 crash
changes.why_matters: 减少长时间运行后的随机崩溃，提升 ARM64 设备上的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces intermittent long-run crashes and improves stability on ARM64 devices.

changes.raw: Added `claude remote-control` subcommand for external builds, enabling local environment serving for all users.
changes.summary: 新增远程控制子命令
changes.summary_en: Add remote-control subcommand
changes.why_matters: 让外部构建场景可以直接复用本地环境，提升自动化和远程协作能力。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets external builds use the local environment directly, improving automation and remote workflows.

changes.raw: Updated plugin marketplace default git timeout from 30s to 120s and added `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS` to configure.
changes.summary: 插件拉取超时可配置
changes.summary_en: Make plugin git timeout configurable
changes.why_matters: 默认超时更长并可配置，能减少插件安装失败并适配慢网络环境。
changes.why_matters_en: A longer default timeout with configuration reduces plugin install failures on slow networks.

changes.raw: Added support for custom npm registries and specific version pinning when installing plugins from npm sources
changes.summary: 支持npm插件源与版本锁定
changes.summary_en: Support npm registries and version pinning
changes.why_matters: 用户可以从自定义源安装并锁定版本，提升供应链可控性和部署一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can install from custom sources and pin versions, improving supply-chain control and consistency.

changes.raw: BashTool now skips login shell (`-l` flag) by default when a shell snapshot is available, improving command execution performance. Previously this required setting `CLAUDE_BASH_NO_LOGIN=true`.
changes.summary: 有快照时跳过登录shell
changes.summary_en: Skip login shell when snapshot exists
changes.why_matters: 减少不必要的 shell 启动开销，能让命令执行更快。
changes.why_matters_en: It removes unnecessary shell startup overhead and makes command execution faster.

changes.raw: Fixed a security issue where `statusLine` and `fileSuggestion` hook commands could execute without workspace trust acceptance in interactive mode.
changes.summary: 修复未授权钩子执行漏洞
changes.summary_en: Fix unauthorized hook execution
changes.why_matters: 避免在未获得工作区信任时执行敏感命令，防止潜在的本地安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents sensitive commands from running before workspace trust is granted, reducing local security risk.

changes.raw: Tool results larger than 50K characters are now persisted to disk (previously 100K). This reduces context window usage and improves conversation longevity.
changes.summary: 大结果落盘减少上下文占用
changes.summary_en: Persist large tool results to disk
changes.why_matters: 减少上下文窗口占用，能让长对话和复杂任务持续更久。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces context window usage, helping long conversations and complex tasks continue longer.

changes.raw: Fixed a bug where duplicate `control_response` messages (e.g. from WebSocket reconnects) could cause API 400 errors by pushing duplicate assistant messages into the conversation.
changes.summary: 修复重复响应导致400错误
changes.summary_en: Fix 400 errors from duplicate responses
changes.why_matters: 避免重连后消息重复写入导致请求失败，提升会话稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents reconnect-related duplicate messages from breaking requests, improving session stability.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID`, `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID` environment variables for SDK callers to provide account info synchronously, eliminating a race condition where early telemetry events lacked account metadata.
changes.summary: 新增账号信息环境变量
changes.summary_en: Add account info environment variables
changes.why_matters: SDK 调用方可同步提供账号信息，避免早期遥测丢失元数据。
changes.why_matters_en: SDK callers can provide account info synchronously, avoiding missing metadata in early telemetry.

changes.raw: Fixed slash command autocomplete crashing when a plugin's SKILL.md description is a YAML array or other non-string type
changes.summary: 修复补全崩溃问题
changes.summary_en: Fix autocomplete crash
changes.why_matters: 避免插件描述格式异常时命令补全直接崩溃，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents autocomplete from crashing on malformed plugin descriptions, improving reliability.

changes.raw: The `/model` picker now shows human-readable labels (e.g., "Sonnet 4.5") instead of raw model IDs for pinned model versions, with an upgrade hint when a newer version is available.
changes.summary: /model显示更友好标签
changes.summary_en: Show friendly labels in /model picker
changes.why_matters: 用户更容易识别固定模型版本，并及时发现可升级版本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can more easily recognize pinned model versions and spot available upgrades.

changes.raw: Managed settings can now be set via macOS plist or Windows Registry. Learn more at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#settings-files
changes.summary: 支持系统级托管设置
changes.summary_en: Support managed settings via OS config
changes.why_matters: 管理员可通过系统配置统一下发设置，便于企业管理和标准化部署。
changes.why_matters_en: Admins can centrally manage settings through OS configuration, simplifying enterprise rollout and governance.

changes.raw: Added support for `startupTimeout` configuration for LSP servers
changes.summary: 支持LSP启动超时配置
changes.summary_en: Support LSP startup timeout config
changes.why_matters: 用户可以为 LSP 服务器设置启动超时，减少卡住或启动过慢带来的等待问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can set startup timeouts for LSP servers, reducing hangs and slow-start frustration.

changes.raw: Added `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` hook events, enabling custom VCS setup and teardown when agent worktree isolation creates or removes worktrees.
changes.summary: 支持工作树创建/移除钩子
changes.summary_en: Add worktree create/remove hooks
changes.why_matters: 工作树隔离时可以自动执行 VCS 初始化和清理，方便定制化工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Worktree isolation can now trigger custom VCS setup and teardown automatically.

changes.raw: Fixed a bug where resumed sessions could be invisible when the working directory involved symlinks, because the session storage path was resolved at different times during startup. Also fixed session data loss on SSH disconnect by flushing session data before hooks and analytics in the graceful shutdown sequence.
changes.summary: 修复符号链接下会话不可见
changes.summary_en: Fix hidden resumed sessions with symlinks
changes.why_matters: 在包含符号链接的目录中恢复会话时不再丢失可见性，并避免 SSH 断开导致的会话数据丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Resumed sessions stay visible in symlinked paths, and session data is preserved on SSH disconnect.

changes.raw: Linux: Fixed native modules not loading on systems with glibc older than 2.30 (e.g., RHEL 8)
changes.summary: 修复旧版glibc下原生模块加载
changes.summary_en: Fix native modules on older glibc
changes.why_matters: Linux 旧环境如 RHEL 8 现在可以正常加载原生模块，提升兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Native modules now load correctly on older Linux environments like RHEL 8.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak in agent teams where completed teammate tasks were never garbage collected from session state
changes.summary: 修复团队任务内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix teammate task memory leak
changes.why_matters: 完成的队友任务会被及时回收，长会话中内存占用更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Completed teammate tasks are now garbage collected, keeping long-session memory stable.

changes.raw: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE` to fully strip down skills, session memory, custom agents, and CLAUDE.md token counting
changes.summary: SIMPLE模式彻底精简能力
changes.summary_en: Fully strip CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE mode
changes.why_matters: 简单模式会更彻底地关闭多余功能，提供更纯净、可控的最小体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Simple mode now removes more features for a cleaner, more minimal experience.

changes.raw: Fixed `/mcp reconnect` freezing the CLI when given a server name that doesn't exist
changes.summary: 修复不存在服务器的重连卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix reconnect freeze for missing server
changes.why_matters: 当重连目标不存在时，CLI 不再冻结，避免操作被阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: The CLI no longer freezes when reconnecting to a non-existent server.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak where completed task state objects were never removed from AppState
changes.summary: 修复AppState任务内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix AppState task memory leak
changes.why_matters: 已完成任务状态会被移除，减少长时间运行时的内存增长。
changes.why_matters_en: Completed task state objects are removed, reducing memory growth in long runs.

changes.raw: Added support for `isolation: worktree` in agent definitions, allowing agents to declaratively run in isolated git worktrees.
changes.summary: 支持代理使用隔离工作树
changes.summary_en: Support worktree isolation for agents
changes.why_matters: 代理可以声明式地在独立 git worktree 中运行，降低任务间互相干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Agents can run in isolated git worktrees, reducing interference between tasks.

changes.raw: `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE` mode now also disables MCP tools, attachments, hooks, and CLAUDE.md file loading for a fully minimal experience.
changes.summary: SIMPLE模式禁用更多外部能力
changes.summary_en: Disable more tools in SIMPLE mode
changes.why_matters: 简单模式进一步关闭 MCP、附件、hooks 和 CLAUDE.md 加载，确保最小化运行。
changes.why_matters_en: Simple mode now also disables MCP, attachments, hooks, and CLAUDE.md loading for a minimal setup.

changes.raw: Fixed bug where MCP tools were not discovered when tool search is enabled and a prompt is passed in as a launch argument
changes.summary: 修复MCP工具发现失败
changes.summary_en: Fix MCP tool discovery with launch prompt
changes.why_matters: 带启动参数时也能正确发现 MCP 工具，避免工具不可用。
changes.why_matters_en: MCP tools are now discovered correctly even when a launch prompt is provided.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage during long sessions by clearing internal caches after compaction
changes.summary: 压缩后清理缓存省内存
changes.summary_en: Clear caches after compaction
changes.why_matters: 长会话中内部缓存会在压缩后清理，降低内存占用。
changes.why_matters_en: Internal caches are cleared after compaction to reduce memory usage in long sessions.

changes.raw: Added `claude agents` CLI command to list all configured agents
changes.summary: 新增agents列表命令
changes.summary_en: Add claude agents list command
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接查看所有已配置代理，便于管理和排查。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can list all configured agents directly for easier management and troubleshooting.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage during long sessions by clearing large tool results after they have been processed
changes.summary: 处理后清理大工具结果
changes.summary_en: Clear large tool results after use
changes.why_matters: 长会话中大结果不再长期占用内存，提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Large tool results no longer linger in memory, improving long-session stability.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak where LSP diagnostic data was never cleaned up after delivery, causing unbounded memory growth in long sessions
changes.summary: 修复LSP诊断数据泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix LSP diagnostic memory leak
changes.why_matters: 诊断数据会在发送后清理，避免长会话内存无限增长。
changes.why_matters_en: LSP diagnostic data is now cleaned up after delivery, preventing unbounded memory growth.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak where completed task output was not freed from memory, reducing memory usage in long sessions with many tasks
changes.summary: 修复任务输出内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix task output memory leak
changes.why_matters: 长会话中完成任务后不再占用多余内存，降低内存压力并提升稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Completed tasks no longer keep unnecessary memory in long sessions, improving stability and reducing memory pressure.

changes.raw: Improved startup performance for headless mode (`-p` flag) by deferring Yoga WASM and UI component imports
changes.summary: 加快无界面启动速度
changes.summary_en: Speed up headless startup
changes.why_matters: 通过延后加载重组件，命令行无界面模式启动更快，等待时间更短。
changes.why_matters_en: Deferring heavy imports makes headless CLI startup faster and reduces waiting time.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt suggestion cache regression that reduced cache hit rates
changes.summary: 修复提示建议缓存回归
changes.summary_en: Fix prompt suggestion cache regression
changes.why_matters: 缓存命中率恢复后，提示建议响应更稳定，减少重复计算。
changes.why_matters_en: Restoring cache hit rates makes prompt suggestions more consistent and reduces repeated computation.

changes.raw: Fixed unbounded memory growth in long sessions by capping file history snapshots
changes.summary: 限制长会话文件历史增长
changes.summary_en: Cap file history growth in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 避免长时间运行时内存持续上涨，减少卡顿和崩溃风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents memory from growing without bound in long-running sessions, reducing lag and crash risk.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` environment variable to disable 1M context window support
changes.summary: 支持关闭百万上下文窗口
changes.summary_en: Add env var to disable 1M context
changes.why_matters: 用户可按需关闭超大上下文能力，便于兼容或控制资源消耗。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can disable the large context window when needed for compatibility or resource control.

changes.raw: Opus 4.6 (fast mode) now includes the full 1M context window
changes.summary: Opus 4.6 支持百万上下文
changes.summary_en: Opus 4.6 gets full 1M context
changes.why_matters: 模型可处理更长输入和更多历史信息，适合复杂大型任务。
changes.why_matters_en: The model can handle much longer inputs and more history, which helps with complex large tasks.

changes.raw: VSCode: Added `/extra-usage` command support in VS Code sessions
changes.summary: VS Code 支持额外用量命令
changes.summary_en: Add /extra-usage in VS Code
changes.why_matters: 在 VS Code 会话中可直接查看额外用量信息，提升可见性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can view extra usage information directly in VS Code sessions for better visibility.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak where TaskOutput retained recent lines after cleanup
changes.summary: 修复 TaskOutput 清理泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix TaskOutput cleanup leak
changes.why_matters: 清理后不再保留最近输出，减少长会话中的内存占用。
changes.why_matters_en: Cleanup no longer retains recent output, reducing memory usage in long sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak in CircularBuffer where cleared items were retained in the backing array
changes.summary: 修复循环缓冲区残留内存
changes.summary_en: Fix CircularBuffer retained items
changes.why_matters: 已清除的数据不再被数组持有，降低持续运行时的内存浪费。
changes.why_matters_en: Cleared items are no longer kept alive in the backing array, reducing memory waste in long-running use.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak in shell command execution where ChildProcess and AbortController references were retained after cleanup
changes.summary: 修复 shell 执行引用泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix shell execution reference leak
changes.why_matters: 命令执行结束后相关对象可被释放，减少后台资源占用。
changes.why_matters_en: Related objects can be released after command execution, lowering background resource usage.

signals.title: What Claude Code chooses
Claude Code Remote Control
Show HN: Emdash – Open-source agentic development environment
Implementing a Z80 / ZX Spectrum emulator with Claude Code
Show HN: Claude-File-Recovery, recover files from your ~/.claude sessions

changes.raw: Improved MCP OAuth authentication with step-up auth support and discovery caching, reducing redundant network requests during server connections
changes.summary: 优化MCP OAuth认证与缓存
changes.summary_en: Improve MCP OAuth auth and caching
changes.why_matters: 减少服务器连接时的重复网络请求，让认证更快、更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces redundant network requests during server connections, making auth faster and more reliable.

changes.raw: Added `--worktree` (`-w`) flag to start Claude in an isolated git worktree
changes.summary: 支持隔离git worktree启动
changes.summary_en: Start Claude in isolated git worktree
changes.why_matters: 让用户在隔离环境中安全并行工作，降低对主工作区的影响。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets users work in an isolated environment and reduces impact on the main workspace.

changes.raw: Subagents support `isolation: "worktree"` for working in a temporary git worktree
changes.summary: 子代理支持worktree隔离
changes.summary_en: Subagents can run in worktree isolation
changes.why_matters: 子代理可在临时工作树中执行任务，提升并行性和隔离性。
changes.why_matters_en: Subagents can run in temporary worktrees, improving parallelism and isolation.

changes.raw: Added Ctrl+F keybinding to kill background agents (two-press confirmation)
changes.summary: 新增快捷键终止后台代理
changes.summary_en: Add shortcut to kill background agents
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更快停止失控的后台代理，提升可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can stop runaway background agents faster, improving control.

changes.raw: Agent definitions support `background: true` to always run as a background task
changes.summary: 代理定义支持后台运行
changes.summary_en: Agent defs can always run in background
changes.why_matters: 让特定代理持续以后台任务运行，适合长时或异步工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets certain agents run as background tasks, fitting long-running or async workflows.

changes.raw: Plugins can ship `settings.json` for default configuration
changes.summary: 插件可携带默认设置
changes.summary_en: Plugins can ship default settings
changes.why_matters: 插件安装后可自动带入推荐配置，减少手动设置成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins can provide recommended defaults on install, reducing manual setup.

changes.raw: Fixed file-not-found errors to suggest corrected paths when the model drops the repo folder
changes.summary: 修复路径丢失提示错误
changes.summary_en: Fix missing-path error suggestions
changes.why_matters: 当模型丢失仓库目录时，用户能更快找到并修正文件路径。
changes.why_matters_en: When the model loses the repo folder, users get better path suggestions and recover faster.

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+C and ESC being silently ignored when background agents are running and the main thread is idle. Pressing twice within 3 seconds now kills all background agents.
changes.summary: 修复后台代理退出失灵
changes.summary_en: Fix ignored exit keys with background agents
changes.why_matters: 避免后台代理运行时按键无响应，提升紧急终止能力。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents unresponsive exit keys when background agents run, improving emergency stop behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt suggestion cache regression that reduced cache hit rates.
changes.summary: 修复提示建议缓存回退
changes.summary_en: Fix prompt suggestion cache regression
changes.why_matters: 提高缓存命中率，减少重复计算并让建议更快返回。
changes.why_matters_en: It restores cache hit rates, reducing recomputation and speeding up suggestions.

changes.raw: Fixed `plugin enable` and `plugin disable` to auto-detect the correct scope when `--scope` is not specified, instead of always defaulting to user scope
changes.summary: 插件启停自动识别作用域
changes.summary_en: Auto-detect plugin scope on enable/disable
changes.why_matters: 减少因作用域选错导致的插件管理错误。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces plugin management mistakes caused by choosing the wrong scope.

changes.raw: Simple mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE`) now includes the file edit tool in addition to the Bash tool, allowing direct file editing in simple mode.
changes.summary: 简单模式支持文件编辑
changes.summary_en: Simple mode now supports file editing
changes.why_matters: 简单模式不再只能执行命令，能直接修改文件，提升实用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Simple mode is no longer Bash-only and can edit files directly, making it more useful.

changes.raw: Permission suggestions are now populated when safety checks trigger an ask response, enabling SDK consumers to display permission options
changes.summary: 安全拦截时返回权限建议
changes.summary_en: Populate permission options on safety asks
changes.why_matters: SDK 调用方可以展示可选权限，帮助用户更顺畅地授权。
changes.why_matters_en: SDK consumers can show permission options, making authorization smoother for users.

changes.raw: Sonnet 4.5 with 1M context is being removed from the Max plan in favor of our frontier Sonnet 4.6 model, which now has 1M context. Please switch in /model.
changes.summary: Max计划模型切换到Sonnet 4.6
changes.summary_en: Max plan moves to Sonnet 4.6
changes.why_matters: 用户需要切换模型配置，否则可能无法继续使用原先的 1M 上下文模型。
changes.why_matters_en: Users need to switch models, or they may lose access to the previous 1M-context model.

changes.raw: Fixed verbose mode not updating thinking block display when toggled via `/config` — memo comparators now correctly detect verbose changes
changes.summary: 修复verbose切换不刷新
changes.summary_en: Fix verbose display not refreshing
changes.why_matters: 切换调试显示后界面能正确更新，避免状态不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: The UI now updates correctly after toggling verbose mode, avoiding stale state.

changes.raw: Fixed unbounded WASM memory growth during long sessions by periodically resetting the tree-sitter parser
changes.summary: 修复WASM内存持续增长
changes.summary_en: Fix unbounded WASM memory growth
changes.why_matters: 长会话更稳定，避免内存膨胀导致性能下降或崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Long sessions stay stable and avoid memory bloat that can hurt performance or crash the app.

changes.raw: Fixed potential rendering issues caused by stale yoga layout references
changes.summary: 修复渲染引用失效问题
changes.summary_en: Fix stale layout reference rendering
changes.why_matters: 避免界面渲染异常，提升使用稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents rendering glitches and improves UI stability.

changes.raw: Improved performance in non-interactive mode (`-p`) by skipping unnecessary API calls during startup
changes.summary: 非交互模式启动更快
changes.summary_en: Faster startup in non-interactive mode
changes.why_matters: 减少启动时不必要的 API 调用，提升批处理场景效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Cuts unnecessary startup API calls and speeds up batch workflows.

changes.raw: Improved performance by caching authentication failures for HTTP and SSE MCP servers, avoiding repeated connection attempts to servers requiring auth
changes.summary: 缓存认证失败减少重试
changes.summary_en: Cache auth failures to avoid retries
changes.why_matters: 避免对需要认证的 MCP 服务器反复连接，减少等待和开销。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids repeated connection attempts to auth-required MCP servers, reducing delay and overhead.

changes.raw: Fixed unbounded memory growth during long-running sessions caused by Yoga WASM linear memory never shrinking
changes.summary: 修复长会话内存持续增长
changes.summary_en: Fix unbounded memory growth in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 防止长期运行时内存泄漏式增长，提升稳定性和可持续运行能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents leak-like memory growth in long-running sessions, improving stability and uptime.

changes.raw: SDK model info now includes `supportsEffort`, `supportedEffortLevels`, and `supportsAdaptiveThinking` fields so consumers can discover model capabilities.
changes.summary: 模型信息新增能力字段
changes.summary_en: Add model capability fields to SDK info
changes.why_matters: 让 SDK 消费者能发现模型支持的推理能力，便于做兼容性判断。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets SDK consumers discover model capabilities for better compatibility checks.

changes.raw: Added `ConfigChange` hook event that fires when configuration files change during a session, enabling enterprise security auditing and optional blocking of settings changes.
changes.summary: 新增配置变更审计钩子
changes.summary_en: Add config change hook for auditing
changes.why_matters: 支持企业审计和阻止敏感配置变更，增强治理与安全控制。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables enterprise auditing and blocking of config changes, strengthening governance and security.

changes.raw: Improved startup performance by caching MCP auth failures to avoid redundant connection attempts
changes.summary: 缓存 MCP 认证失败加速启动
changes.summary_en: Cache MCP auth failures for faster startup
changes.why_matters: 减少重复认证尝试，缩短启动等待时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces redundant auth attempts and shortens startup time.

changes.raw: Improved startup performance by reducing HTTP calls for analytics token counting
changes.summary: 减少分析令牌统计请求
changes.summary_en: Reduce analytics token-counting calls
changes.why_matters: 降低启动阶段网络请求数量，提升整体响应速度。
changes.why_matters_en: Lowers startup network traffic and improves overall responsiveness.

changes.raw: Improved startup performance by batching MCP tool token counting into a single API call
changes.summary: 批量统计 MCP 工具令牌
changes.summary_en: Batch MCP tool token counting
changes.why_matters: 通过合并 API 调用减少开销，加快启动流程。
changes.why_matters_en: Combines API calls to reduce overhead and speed up startup.

changes.raw: Fixed `disableAllHooks` setting to respect managed settings hierarchy — non-managed settings can no longer disable managed hooks set by policy (#26637)
changes.summary: 修复受管钩子禁用规则
changes.summary_en: Fix managed hook disable hierarchy
changes.why_matters: 确保策略管理的 hooks 不会被普通设置绕过，避免安全与合规风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures policy-managed hooks cannot be disabled by non-managed settings, reducing security and compliance risk.

changes.raw: Fixed `--resume` session picker showing raw XML tags for sessions that start with commands like `/clear`. Now correctly falls through to the session ID fallback.
changes.summary: 修复恢复会话选择器显示
changes.summary_en: Fix resume picker XML tag display
changes.why_matters: 避免会话列表显示异常，提升恢复会话时的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents display glitches in session selection and improves resume usability.

changes.raw: Improved permission prompts for path safety and working directory blocks to show the reason for the restriction instead of a bare prompt with no context
changes.summary: 权限提示显示阻止原因
changes.summary_en: Show reasons in permission prompts
changes.why_matters: 让用户更清楚为何被限制，减少困惑并帮助快速处理权限问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives users clearer context for restrictions, reducing confusion and helping resolve permission issues faster.

signals.title: What Claude Code chooses
Claude Code Remote Control
Show HN: Emdash – Open-source agentic development environment
Implementing a Z80 / ZX Spectrum emulator with Claude Code
Show HN: Context Mode – 315 KB of MCP output becomes 5.4 KB in Claude Code

changes.raw: Fixed FileWriteTool line counting to preserve intentional trailing blank lines instead of stripping them with `trimEnd()`.
changes.summary: 保留文件末尾空行
changes.summary_en: Preserve intentional trailing blank lines
changes.why_matters: 避免写入文件时误删用户刻意保留的空行，减少格式被破坏的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents intentional blank lines from being removed and preserves file formatting.

changes.raw: Fixed Windows terminal rendering bugs caused by `os.EOL` (`\r\n`) in display code — line counts now show correct values instead of always showing 1 on Windows.
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 行数显示
changes.summary_en: Fix line counts on Windows
changes.why_matters: 让 Windows 终端中的行数和渲染结果正确显示，避免误导用户判断内容长度。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes line counts render correctly on Windows instead of showing incorrect values.

changes.raw: Improved VS Code plan preview: auto-updates as Claude iterates, enables commenting only when the plan is ready for review, and keeps the preview open when rejecting so Claude can revise.
changes.summary: 计划预览自动同步迭代
changes.summary_en: Auto-update VS Code plan preview
changes.why_matters: 用户可以实时看到 Claude 的计划演进，并在可审阅时再评论，提升协作效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can follow plan changes live and review only when ready, improving collaboration flow.

changes.raw: Fixed a bug where bold and colored text in markdown output could shift to the wrong characters on Windows due to `\r\n` line endings.
changes.summary: 修复 Windows Markdown 高亮错位
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows markdown formatting offset
changes.why_matters: 避免 Windows 下 Markdown 的粗体和颜色标记错位，保证输出可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents bold and color formatting from shifting to the wrong characters on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed compaction failing when conversation contains many PDF documents by stripping document blocks alongside images before sending to the compaction API (anthropics/claude-code#26188)
changes.summary: 修复含 PDF 的压缩失败
changes.summary_en: Fix compaction with many PDFs
changes.why_matters: 让包含大量 PDF 的长对话也能正常压缩，避免会话中断或失败。
changes.why_matters_en: This allows compaction to succeed even when conversations contain many PDF documents.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage in long-running sessions by releasing API stream buffers, agent context, and skill state after use
changes.summary: 长会话内存占用更低
changes.summary_en: Reduce memory use in long sessions
changes.why_matters: 释放不再需要的流缓冲和上下文，能降低长时间运行时的内存压力。
changes.why_matters_en: Releasing unused buffers and context reduces memory pressure in long-running sessions.

changes.raw: Improved startup performance by deferring SessionStart hook execution, reducing time-to-interactive by ~500ms.
changes.summary: 启动更快，交互更早
changes.summary_en: Faster startup time-to-interactive
changes.why_matters: 延后钩子执行可缩短启动等待时间，让用户更快开始工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Deferring hook execution reduces startup latency and gets users interactive sooner.

changes.raw: Fixed an issue where bash tool output was silently discarded on Windows when using MSYS2 or Cygwin shells.
changes.summary: 修复 Windows bash 输出丢失
changes.summary_en: Fix bash output loss on Windows
changes.why_matters: 确保在 MSYS2 或 Cygwin 下运行 bash 工具时，输出不会被静默丢弃。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures bash tool output is not silently lost on Windows shells like MSYS2 or Cygwin.

changes.raw: Improved performance of `@` file mentions - file suggestions now appear faster by pre-warming the index on startup and using session-based caching with background refresh.
changes.summary: 文件补全建议更快
changes.summary_en: Speed up @ file suggestions
changes.why_matters: 通过预热索引和缓存加速文件建议出现，减少输入时的等待。
changes.why_matters_en: Pre-warming and caching make file suggestions appear faster and reduce typing delays.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage by trimming agent task message history after tasks complete
changes.summary: 任务后及时释放历史
changes.summary_en: Trim task history after completion
changes.why_matters: 减少已完成任务占用的内存，让长时间使用更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: Trimming completed task history lowers memory use and improves long-session stability.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage during long agent sessions by eliminating O(n²) message accumulation in progress updates
changes.summary: 减少进度更新内存膨胀
changes.summary_en: Avoid quadratic progress memory growth
changes.why_matters: 消除进度更新中的 O(n²) 累积，可显著改善长代理会话的性能和内存占用。
changes.why_matters_en: Removing O(n²) accumulation improves performance and memory use in long agent sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed the bash permission classifier to validate that returned match descriptions correspond to actual input rules, preventing hallucinated descriptions from incorrectly granting permissions
changes.summary: 权限分类更严格校验
changes.summary_en: Validate bash permission matches
changes.why_matters: 防止错误或幻觉式描述误授予权限，降低权限越权风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents hallucinated descriptions from incorrectly granting permissions and reduces privilege risk.

changes.raw: Fixed user-defined agents only loading one file on NFS/FUSE filesystems that report zero inodes (anthropics/claude-code#26044)
changes.summary: 修复 NFS/FUSE 代理加载
changes.summary_en: Fix agent loading on NFS/FUSE
changes.why_matters: 让在特殊文件系统上定义的用户代理能完整加载，不再只读到一个文件。
changes.why_matters_en: This ensures user-defined agents load correctly on filesystems like NFS/FUSE.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin agent skills silently failing to load when referenced by bare name instead of fully-qualified plugin name (anthropics/claude-code#25834)
changes.summary: 插件技能按名称可加载
changes.summary_en: Load plugin skills by bare name
changes.why_matters: 用户引用插件技能时不必写全限定名，减少配置错误和加载失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can reference plugin skills by bare name, avoiding load failures from naming issues.

changes.raw: Search patterns in collapsed tool results are now displayed in quotes for clarity
changes.summary: 折叠结果搜索词加引号
changes.summary_en: Quote search patterns in collapsed results
changes.why_matters: 让折叠后的工具结果更清晰，便于用户识别搜索模式。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes collapsed tool results clearer and easier to read.

changes.raw: Windows: Fixed CWD tracking temp files never being cleaned up, causing them to accumulate indefinitely (anthropics/claude-code#17600)
changes.summary: 清理 Windows 临时文件
changes.summary_en: Clean up Windows temp files
changes.why_matters: 避免临时文件无限堆积，占用磁盘并影响长期使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents temp files from piling up indefinitely and wasting disk space.

changes.raw: Use `ctrl+f` to kill all background agents instead of double-pressing ESC. Background agents now continue running when you press ESC to cancel the main thread, giving you more control over agent lifecycle.
changes.summary: ESC 仅取消主线程
changes.summary_en: ESC now cancels only the main thread
changes.why_matters: 让用户更精细地控制后台代理的停止与继续运行。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives users finer control over when background agents stop or keep running.

changes.raw: Fixed API 400 errors ("thinking blocks cannot be modified") that occurred in sessions with concurrent agents, caused by interleaved streaming content blocks preventing proper message merging.
changes.summary: 修复并发代理 400 错误
changes.summary_en: Fix 400 errors with concurrent agents
changes.why_matters: 避免并发会话因消息合并失败而中断，提升多代理稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents concurrent sessions from failing due to merge issues and improves multi-agent stability.

changes.raw: Simplified teammate navigation to use only Shift+Down (with wrapping) instead of both Shift+Up and Shift+Down.
changes.summary: 团队导航改为单键操作
changes.summary_en: Team navigation simplified to one key
changes.why_matters: 减少快捷键复杂度，让导航更容易记忆和使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces shortcut complexity and makes navigation easier to learn and use.

changes.raw: Fixed an issue where a single file write/edit error would abort all other parallel file write/edit operations. Independent file mutations now complete even when a sibling fails.
changes.summary: 并行文件操作互不阻断
changes.summary_en: Parallel file ops no longer block each other
changes.why_matters: 单个文件失败不再拖垮整批操作，提高批量编辑可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: One file failure no longer aborts the whole batch, improving reliability for parallel edits.

changes.raw: Added `last_assistant_message` field to Stop and SubagentStop hook inputs, providing the final assistant response text so hooks can access it without parsing transcript files.
changes.summary: Hook 可读最终助手消息
changes.summary_en: Hooks can read the final assistant message
changes.why_matters: 让钩子无需解析转录文件即可获取结束回复，集成更简单。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets hooks access the final reply without parsing transcript files, simplifying integrations.

changes.raw: Fixed custom session titles set via `/rename` being lost after resuming a conversation (anthropics/claude-code#23610)
changes.summary: 恢复后保留自定义标题
changes.summary_en: Keep custom titles after resume
changes.why_matters: 避免会话恢复后标题丢失，提升历史会话可识别性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents custom titles from disappearing after resume, improving session recognizability.

changes.raw: Fixed collapsed read/search hint text overflowing on narrow terminals by truncating from the start.
changes.summary: 窄终端提示文本不再溢出
changes.summary_en: Hint text no longer overflows on narrow terminals
changes.why_matters: 改善窄屏显示，避免界面内容被截断或错位。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves narrow-screen rendering and avoids clipped or misaligned UI text.

changes.raw: Fixed an issue where bash commands with backslash-newline continuation lines (e.g., long commands split across multiple lines with `\`) would produce spurious empty arguments, potentially breaking command execution.
changes.summary: 修复反斜杠换行命令解析
changes.summary_en: Fix backslash-newline command parsing
changes.why_matters: 防止长命令被错误拆分成空参数，避免命令执行失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents long commands from being split into empty args and breaking execution.

changes.raw: Fixed built-in slash commands (`/help`, `/model`, `/compact`, etc.) being hidden from the autocomplete dropdown when many user skills are installed (anthropics/claude-code#22020)
changes.summary: 内置斜杠命令可见性恢复
changes.summary_en: Built-in slash commands show in autocomplete
changes.why_matters: 确保常用内置命令在自动补全中可发现，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures common built-in commands remain discoverable in autocomplete.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP servers not appearing in the MCP Management Dialog after deferred loading
changes.summary: MCP 服务器管理页可见
changes.summary_en: MCP servers now appear in management dialog
changes.why_matters: 让延迟加载的 MCP 服务器能被正确管理和配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes deferred-loaded MCP servers visible for proper management and configuration.

changes.raw: Fixed session name persisting in status bar after `/clear` command (anthropics/claude-code#26082)
changes.summary: 清空后状态栏标题重置
changes.summary_en: Status bar title resets after /clear
changes.why_matters: 避免清空会话后仍显示旧标题造成混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stale titles from lingering after clearing a session.

changes.raw: Fixed crash when a skill's `name` or `description` in SKILL.md frontmatter is a bare number (e.g., `name: 3000`) — the value is now properly coerced to a string (anthropics/claude-code#25837)
changes.summary: 技能元数据数字值不再崩溃
changes.summary_en: Numeric skill metadata no longer crashes
changes.why_matters: 防止技能前置字段为数字时导致应用崩溃，提高兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents crashes when skill frontmatter uses numeric values, improving compatibility.

changes.raw: Fixed /resume silently dropping sessions when the first message exceeds 16KB or uses array-format content (anthropics/claude-code#25721)
changes.summary: 修复 /resume 丢失会话
changes.summary_en: Fix /resume dropping some sessions
changes.why_matters: 避免长首条消息或数组格式导致会话无法恢复，减少数据丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents sessions from being lost on resume due to large or array-form first messages.

changes.raw: Added `chat:newline` keybinding action for configurable multi-line input (anthropics/claude-code#26075)
changes.summary: 新增聊天换行按键绑定
changes.summary_en: Add configurable chat newline keybinding
changes.why_matters: 让多行输入更灵活，适配不同键盘和输入习惯。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes multi-line input more flexible for different keyboards and workflows.

changes.raw: Added `added_dirs` to the statusline JSON `workspace` section, exposing directories added via `/add-dir` to external scripts (anthropics/claude-code#26096)
changes.summary: 状态栏导出已添加目录
changes.summary_en: Expose /add-dir dirs in statusline JSON
changes.why_matters: 外部脚本现在能读取通过 `/add-dir` 添加的目录，便于自动化和集成。
changes.why_matters_en: External scripts can now see directories added via `/add-dir`, improving automation and integrations.

changes.raw: Fixed `claude doctor` misclassifying mise and asdf-managed installations as native installs (anthropics/claude-code#26033)
changes.summary: 修正 doctor 安装类型识别
changes.summary_en: Fix doctor misclassifying mise/asdf installs
changes.why_matters: 避免诊断结果误报为原生安装，减少排查环境问题的困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents false native-install reports and reduces confusion when diagnosing environment issues.

changes.raw: Fixed zsh heredoc failing with "read-only file system" error in sandboxed commands (anthropics/claude-code#25990)
changes.summary: 修复沙箱 zsh heredoc 报错
changes.summary_en: Fix zsh heredoc read-only sandbox error
changes.why_matters: 沙箱命令中的 heredoc 现在可正常运行，减少脚本执行失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Heredocs now work in sandboxed commands, reducing script execution failures.

changes.raw: Fixed agent progress indicator showing inflated tool use count (anthropics/claude-code#26023)
changes.summary: 修正进度条工具数显示
changes.summary_en: Fix inflated tool-use count in progress UI
changes.why_matters: 进度指示更准确，用户能更可靠地判断代理执行状态。
changes.why_matters_en: The progress indicator is now accurate, helping users better judge agent activity.

changes.raw: Fixed image pasting not working on WSL2 systems where Windows copies images as BMP format (anthropics/claude-code#25935)
changes.summary: 修复 WSL2 图片粘贴
changes.summary_en: Fix image paste on WSL2 BMP clipboard
changes.why_matters: 在 WSL2 上粘贴图片恢复可用，提升跨平台多模态体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Image pasting works again on WSL2, improving cross-platform multimodal use.

changes.raw: Fixed background agent results returning raw transcript data instead of the agent's final answer (anthropics/claude-code#26012)
changes.summary: 后台代理返回最终答案
changes.summary_en: Return final answer from background agents
changes.why_matters: 调用后台代理时不再拿到原始转录，结果更直接可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Background agent calls now return the final answer instead of raw transcripts, making outputs directly usable.

changes.raw: Fixed Warp terminal incorrectly prompting for Shift+Enter setup when it supports it natively (anthropics/claude-code#25957)
changes.summary: Warp 终端跳过重复提示
changes.summary_en: Skip redundant Shift+Enter prompt in Warp
changes.why_matters: 减少不必要的设置提示，让 Warp 用户更快开始使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes an unnecessary setup prompt, letting Warp users get started faster.

changes.raw: Fixed CJK wide characters causing misaligned timestamps and layout elements in the TUI (anthropics/claude-code#26084)
changes.summary: 修复 CJK 字符对齐问题
changes.summary_en: Fix CJK wide-char TUI misalignment
changes.why_matters: 中文等宽字符显示更整齐，提升终端界面可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: CJK text now aligns correctly, improving TUI readability.

changes.raw: Fixed custom agent `model` field in `.claude/agents/*.md` being ignored when spawning team teammates (anthropics/claude-code#26064)
changes.summary: 自定义代理模型配置生效
changes.summary_en: Honor custom agent model settings
changes.why_matters: 团队代理会按配置使用指定模型，避免能力和成本偏差。
changes.why_matters_en: Teammate agents now use the configured model, avoiding capability and cost mismatches.

changes.raw: Fixed plan mode being lost after context compaction, causing the model to switch from planning to implementation mode (anthropics/claude-code#26061)
changes.summary: 压缩后保留计划模式
changes.summary_en: Preserve plan mode after compaction
changes.why_matters: 上下文压缩后仍能保持规划状态，避免误切到实现阶段。
changes.why_matters_en: Plan mode now survives compaction, preventing accidental switches into implementation mode.

changes.raw: Fixed `alwaysThinkingEnabled: true` in settings.json not enabling thinking mode on Bedrock and Vertex providers (anthropics/claude-code#26074)
changes.summary: 思考模式设置对云模型生效
changes.summary_en: Enable thinking mode on Bedrock/Vertex
changes.why_matters: 配置项现在能在 Bedrock 和 Vertex 上正常启用思考模式。
changes.why_matters_en: The setting now correctly enables thinking mode on Bedrock and Vertex providers.

changes.raw: Fixed `tool_decision` OTel telemetry event not being emitted in headless/SDK mode (anthropics/claude-code#26059)
changes.summary: 补发 headless OTel 事件
changes.summary_en: Emit tool_decision OTel in headless mode
changes.why_matters: 无头和 SDK 场景下的遥测更完整，便于监控与分析。
changes.why_matters_en: Telemetry is now complete in headless and SDK modes, improving monitoring and analysis.

changes.raw: Fixed session name being lost after context compaction — renamed sessions now preserve their custom title through compaction (anthropics/claude-code#26121)
changes.summary: 压缩后保留会话标题
changes.summary_en: Keep renamed session titles after compaction
changes.why_matters: 自定义会话名不会丢失，恢复历史会话更容易。
changes.why_matters_en: Custom session names now persist, making resumed sessions easier to पहचान and manage.

changes.raw: Increased initial session count in resume picker from 10 to 50 for faster session discovery (anthropics/claude-code#26123)
changes.summary: 恢复列表显示更多会话
changes.summary_en: Show more sessions in resume picker
changes.why_matters: 一次能看到更多历史会话，查找目标会话更快。
changes.why_matters_en: More sessions are visible at once, making it faster to find the right one.

changes.raw: Windows: fixed worktree session matching when drive letter casing differs (anthropics/claude-code#26123)
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 工作树匹配
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows worktree matching by drive case
changes.why_matters: Windows 上恢复和匹配工作树会话更稳定，减少找错会话。
changes.why_matters_en: Worktree session matching is now more reliable on Windows, reducing resume mismatches.

changes.raw: Fixed `/resume <session-id>` failing to find sessions whose first message exceeds 16KB (anthropics/claude-code#25920)
changes.summary: 修复大首条消息会话可恢复
changes.summary_en: Fix /resume for large first messages
changes.why_matters: 避免长会话无法从 /resume 找回，提升会话续接可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents long sessions from disappearing from /resume, improving resume reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed "Always allow" on multiline bash commands creating invalid permission patterns that corrupt settings (anthropics/claude-code#25909)
changes.summary: 修复“始终允许”权限规则损坏
changes.summary_en: Fix invalid Always allow permission rules
changes.why_matters: 防止权限配置被破坏，避免后续命令授权异常。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents permission settings from being corrupted and causing later authorization issues.

changes.raw: Fixed React crash (error #31) when a skill's `argument-hint` in SKILL.md frontmatter uses YAML sequence syntax (e.g., `[topic: foo | bar]`) — the value is now properly coerced to a string (anthropics/claude-code#25826)
changes.summary: 修复技能参数提示崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash from skill argument hints
changes.why_matters: 让带 YAML 语法的技能元数据能正常解析，减少运行时崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows skill metadata with YAML syntax to parse correctly and avoids runtime crashes.

changes.raw: Fixed crash when using `/fork` on sessions that used web search — null entries in search results from transcript deserialization are now handled gracefully (anthropics/claude-code#25811)
changes.summary: 修复 /fork 处理网页搜索会话崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix /fork crash on web-search sessions
changes.why_matters: 确保含网页搜索的历史会话可以正常分叉继续使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures sessions with web search can be forked and continued safely.

changes.raw: Fixed read-only git commands triggering FSEvents file watcher loops on macOS by adding --no-optional-locks flag (anthropics/claude-code#25750)
changes.summary: 修复只读 Git 命令触发监听循环
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS watcher loops from git reads
changes.why_matters: 减少 macOS 上无意义的文件监听循环，提升稳定性和性能。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces pointless file-watcher loops on macOS, improving stability and performance.

changes.raw: Fixed custom agents and skills not being discovered when running from a git worktree — project-level `.claude/agents/` and `.claude/skills/` from the main repository are now included (anthropics/claude-code#25816)
changes.summary: 修复 worktree 下技能代理发现
changes.summary_en: Fix agent and skill discovery in worktrees
changes.why_matters: 让工作树环境也能正确加载项目级代理和技能，避免功能缺失。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures project-level agents and skills load correctly in worktrees, avoiding missing features.

changes.raw: Fixed non-interactive subcommands like `claude doctor` and `claude plugin validate` being blocked inside nested Claude sessions (anthropics/claude-code#25803)
changes.summary: 修复嵌套会话阻塞非交互命令
changes.summary_en: Fix nested sessions blocking noninteractive commands
changes.why_matters: 使诊断和校验类命令可在嵌套会话中正常运行。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows diagnostic and validation commands to run properly inside nested sessions.

changes.raw: Windows: Fixed the same CLAUDE.md file being loaded twice when drive letter casing differs between paths (anthropics/claude-code#25756)
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 上 CLAUDE.md 重复加载
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate CLAUDE.md loading on Windows
changes.why_matters: 避免因路径大小写差异导致配置重复应用。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents configuration from being applied twice due to path casing differences.

changes.raw: Fixed inline code spans in markdown being incorrectly parsed as bash commands (anthropics/claude-code#25792)
changes.summary: 修复行内代码被误识别为命令
changes.summary_en: Fix inline code misparsed as bash commands
changes.why_matters: 减少 Markdown 解析错误，避免误执行或误提示命令。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces Markdown parsing errors and avoids false command execution or prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed teammate spinners not respecting custom spinnerVerbs from settings (anthropics/claude-code#25748)
changes.summary: 修复队友加载动画文案不生效
changes.summary_en: Fix teammate spinner verb settings
changes.why_matters: 让自定义加载文案按设置显示，提升一致性和可配置性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes custom spinner text respect settings for better consistency and configurability.

changes.raw: Fixed shell commands permanently failing after a command deletes its own working directory (anthropics/claude-code#26136)
changes.summary: 修复删除工作目录后命令失效
changes.summary_en: Fix commands after self-deleting cwd
changes.why_matters: 防止命令在工作目录被删除后永久失败，提升任务恢复能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents commands from failing permanently after their working directory is deleted.

changes.raw: Fixed hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse) silently failing to execute on Windows by using Git Bash instead of cmd.exe (anthropics/claude-code#25981)
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 钩子无法执行
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows hooks execution
changes.why_matters: 确保 PreToolUse 和 PostToolUse 钩子在 Windows 上可靠运行。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks run reliably on Windows.

changes.raw: Fixed LSP `findReferences` and other location-based operations returning results from gitignored files (e.g., `node_modules/`, `venv/`) (anthropics/claude-code#26051)
changes.summary: 修复 LSP 结果包含忽略文件
changes.summary_en: Fix LSP results from gitignored files
changes.why_matters: 避免从 node_modules 等忽略目录返回无关引用结果。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents irrelevant references from ignored directories like node_modules.

changes.raw: Moved config backup files from home directory root to `~/.claude/backups/` to reduce home directory clutter (anthropics/claude-code#26130)
changes.summary: 配置备份移至专用目录
changes.summary_en: Move config backups to ~/.claude/backups
changes.why_matters: 减少家目录杂乱，让备份文件更集中易管理。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps the home directory cleaner and backup files easier to manage.

changes.raw: Fixed sessions with large first prompts (>16KB) disappearing from the /resume list (anthropics/claude-code#26140)
changes.summary: 修复大首条提示会话从列表消失
changes.summary_en: Fix /resume list for large first prompts
changes.why_matters: 确保长首条提示的会话仍能出现在恢复列表中。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures sessions with large first prompts still appear in the resume list.

changes.raw: Fixed shell functions with double-underscore prefixes (e.g., `__git_ps1`) not being preserved across shell sessions (anthropics/claude-code#25824)
changes.summary: 保留双下划线 shell 函数
changes.summary_en: Preserve double-underscore shell functions
changes.why_matters: 避免常用 shell 函数在会话间丢失，减少环境配置被破坏的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents common shell functions from disappearing between sessions, avoiding broken shell setups.

changes.raw: Fixed spinner showing "0 tokens" counter before any tokens have been received (anthropics/claude-code#26105)
changes.summary: 修正 0 token 计数显示
changes.summary_en: Fix premature 0-token spinner display
changes.why_matters: 让状态显示更准确，避免用户误以为任务已经开始消耗 token。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes status display accurate so users are not misled into thinking tokens are already being consumed.

changes.raw: VSCode: Fixed conversation messages appearing dimmed while the AskUserQuestion dialog is open (anthropics/claude-code#26078)
changes.summary: 修正 VSCode 对话变暗
changes.summary_en: Fix dimmed VSCode conversation messages
changes.why_matters: 改善对话可读性，避免在弹窗打开时消息看起来像被禁用。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves readability by preventing conversation messages from appearing disabled while the dialog is open.

changes.raw: Fixed background tasks failing in git worktrees due to remote URL resolution reading from worktree-specific gitdir instead of the main repository config (anthropics/claude-code#26065)
changes.summary: 修复 worktree 后台任务失败
changes.summary_en: Fix background tasks in git worktrees
changes.why_matters: 确保在 git worktree 场景下后台任务能正常解析远程地址并执行。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures background tasks can resolve remotes and run correctly in git worktree setups.

changes.raw: Fixed Right Alt key leaving visible `[25~` escape sequence residue in the input field on Windows/Git Bash terminals (anthropics/claude-code#25943)
changes.summary: 修复 Windows Alt 键残留
changes.summary_en: Fix Right Alt escape residue on Windows
changes.why_matters: 减少终端输入污染，提升 Windows/Git Bash 下的输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents terminal input corruption and improves the typing experience on Windows/Git Bash.

changes.raw: The `/rename` command now updates the terminal tab title by default (anthropics/claude-code#25789)
changes.summary: 重命名自动更新标签页标题
changes.summary_en: Auto-update terminal tab title on rename
changes.why_matters: 让终端标签更及时反映当前会话名称，便于多任务管理。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps terminal tabs in sync with the current session name, making multitasking easier.

changes.raw: Fixed Edit tool silently corrupting Unicode curly quotes (\u201c\u201d \u2018\u2019) by replacing them with straight quotes when making edits (anthropics/claude-code#26141)
changes.summary: 修复 Unicode 引号被破坏
changes.summary_en: Fix Unicode curly quotes corruption
changes.why_matters: 避免编辑时悄悄改坏文本内容，防止代码和文档出现隐蔽错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents silent text corruption during edits, avoiding subtle bugs in code and documents.

changes.raw: Fixed OSC 8 hyperlinks only being clickable on the first line when link text wraps across multiple terminal lines.
changes.summary: 修复换行链接可点击范围
changes.summary_en: Fix wrapped OSC 8 link clickability
changes.why_matters: 让跨行超链接在终端中都能正常点击，提升可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes wrapped terminal hyperlinks clickable across all lines, improving usability.

signals.title: Claude Code Remote Control
Show HN: Emdash – Open-source agentic development environment
Implementing a Z80 / ZX Spectrum emulator with Claude Code
Show HN: Context Mode – 315 KB of MCP output becomes 5.4 KB in Claude Code

changes.raw: Fixed orphaned CC processes after terminal disconnect on macOS
changes.summary: 修复断线后残留进程
changes.summary_en: Fix orphaned processes after disconnect
changes.why_matters: 避免终端断开后 Claude Code 进程残留占用资源或继续运行。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents Claude Code processes from lingering and consuming resources after terminal disconnect.

changes.raw: Added support for using claude.ai MCP connectors in Claude Code
changes.summary: 支持 claude.ai MCP 连接器
changes.summary_en: Support claude.ai MCP connectors
changes.why_matters: 让 Claude Code 可以接入 claude.ai 的 MCP 连接器，扩展可用工具和集成能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets Claude Code use claude.ai MCP connectors, expanding available tools and integrations.

changes.raw: Added support for Claude Sonnet 4.6
changes.summary: 支持 Claude Sonnet 4.6
changes.summary_en: Added support for Claude Sonnet 4.6
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接使用更新的模型能力，获得更好的生成效果和兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can use the newer model for better output quality and compatibility.

changes.raw: Added support for reading `enabledPlugins` and `extraKnownMarketplaces` from `--add-dir` directories
changes.summary: 支持目录读取插件配置
changes.summary_en: Read plugin settings from add-dir
changes.why_matters: 用户可通过附加目录自动加载插件市场配置，减少手动配置步骤。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can load plugin marketplace settings from added directories without extra setup.

changes.raw: Added `spinnerTipsOverride` setting to customize spinner tips — configure `tips` with an array of custom tip strings, and optionally set `excludeDefault: true` to show only your custom tips instead of the built-in ones
changes.summary: 可自定义启动提示语
changes.summary_en: Customize spinner tips
changes.why_matters: 用户可以按需调整启动提示内容，让界面更符合个人或团队偏好。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can tailor startup tips to better fit their preferences or team style.

changes.raw: Added `SDKRateLimitInfo` and `SDKRateLimitEvent` types to the SDK, enabling consumers to receive rate limit status updates including utilization, reset times, and overage information
changes.summary: SDK新增限流状态事件
changes.summary_en: Add SDK rate limit status events
changes.why_matters: SDK 消费者可以实时感知限流状态，便于做重试、告警和流控。
changes.why_matters_en: SDK consumers can react to rate limit status in real time for retries, alerts, and throttling.

changes.raw: Fixed Agent Teams teammates failing on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry by propagating API provider environment variables to tmux-spawned processes (anthropics/claude-code#23561)
changes.summary: 修复团队代理云端环境变量
changes.summary_en: Fix env vars for Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry
changes.why_matters: 背景进程能正确继承云厂商环境变量，避免团队代理在这些平台上失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Background processes now inherit cloud provider env vars, preventing teammate failures on those platforms.

changes.raw: Fixed sandbox "operation not permitted" errors when writing temporary files on macOS by using the correct per-user temp directory (anthropics/claude-code#21654)
changes.summary: 修复 macOS 沙箱临时文件错误
changes.summary_en: Fix macOS sandbox temp file errors
changes.why_matters: 在 macOS 沙箱中写临时文件不再报权限错误，提升可用性和稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Writing temp files on macOS sandbox now works correctly, improving reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed Task tool (backgrounded agents) crashing with a `ReferenceError` on completion (anthropics/claude-code#22087)
changes.summary: 修复后台任务完成崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix Task tool completion crash
changes.why_matters: 后台代理完成时不再崩溃，避免任务中断和结果丢失。
changes.why_matters_en: Background agents no longer crash on completion, avoiding interrupted tasks and lost results.

changes.raw: Fixed autocomplete suggestions not being accepted on Enter when images are pasted in the input
changes.summary: 修复粘贴图片后回车补全
changes.summary_en: Fix Enter acceptance after pasted images
changes.why_matters: 输入体验更顺畅，避免在粘贴图片后无法用回车接受补全建议。
changes.why_matters_en: Typing flow is smoother because Enter now accepts autocomplete after pasted images.

changes.raw: Fixed skills invoked by subagents incorrectly appearing in main session context after compaction
changes.summary: 修复子代理技能上下文污染
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent skills leaking into context
changes.why_matters: 压缩后主会话不会混入子代理技能内容，减少上下文混乱和误导。
changes.why_matters_en: Main session context stays clean after compaction, reducing confusion from leaked subagent skills.

changes.raw: Fixed excessive `.claude.json.backup` files accumulating on every startup
changes.summary: 减少启动备份文件堆积
changes.summary_en: Stop backup file buildup on startup
changes.why_matters: 避免启动时不断生成备份文件，减少磁盘杂乱和维护成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Startup no longer creates excessive backup files, reducing disk clutter and maintenance.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin-provided commands, agents, and hooks not being available immediately after installation without requiring a restart
changes.summary: 插件安装后立即可用
changes.summary_en: Make new plugin commands available instantly
changes.why_matters: 安装插件后无需重启即可使用命令、代理和钩子，提升工作流效率。
changes.why_matters_en: New plugin commands, agents, and hooks work immediately after install, improving workflow speed.

changes.raw: Improved startup performance by removing eager loading of session history for stats caching
changes.summary: 提升启动速度
changes.summary_en: Improve startup performance
changes.why_matters: 减少启动时的额外加载，用户能更快进入工作状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Less startup work means users can begin working faster.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage for shell commands that produce large output — RSS no longer grows unboundedly with command output size
changes.summary: 大输出命令更省内存
changes.summary_en: Reduce memory use for large command output
changes.why_matters: 处理大输出时内存不会无限增长，降低卡顿和崩溃风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Memory no longer grows unbounded with large command output, reducing lag and crash risk.
