changes.raw: Fixed `/resume` session picker showing raw XML markup instead of clean titles for sessions started with slash commands
changes.summary: 修复 /resume 会话标题乱码
changes.summary_en: Fix raw XML in /resume session titles
changes.why_matters: 这让会话恢复列表更易读，帮助用户快速找到目标会话。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes the resume picker readable so users can find the right session faster.

changes.raw: Improved error messages for API connection failures — now shows specific cause (e.g., ECONNREFUSED, SSL errors) instead of generic "Connection error"
changes.summary: 连接失败显示具体原因
changes.summary_en: Show specific API connection errors
changes.why_matters: 这帮助用户更快定位网络或证书问题，减少排障时间。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users diagnose network or SSL issues faster and reduces troubleshooting time.

changes.raw: Errors from invalid managed settings are now surfaced
changes.summary: 显示无效管理设置错误
changes.summary_en: Surface invalid managed settings errors
changes.why_matters: 这让配置问题更早暴露，避免用户在错误设置下继续使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This surfaces configuration problems earlier so users do not keep working with broken settings.

changes.raw: VSCode: Added support for remote sessions, allowing OAuth users to browse and resume sessions from claude.ai
changes.summary: VSCode 支持远程会话
changes.summary_en: Add remote session support in VSCode
changes.why_matters: 这让 OAuth 用户可在 VSCode 中浏览并恢复 claude.ai 会话，提升跨端连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets OAuth users browse and resume claude.ai sessions in VSCode, improving cross-device continuity.

changes.raw: VSCode: Added git branch and message count to the session picker, with support for searching by branch name
changes.summary: 会话选择器显示分支和消息数
changes.summary_en: Show branch and message count in picker
changes.why_matters: 这让用户更容易按分支筛选会话并判断上下文长度。
changes.why_matters_en: This helps users filter sessions by branch and gauge context size at a glance.

changes.raw: VSCode: Fixed scroll-to-bottom under-scrolling on initial session load and session switch
changes.summary: 修复 VSCode 会话底部滚动不足
changes.summary_en: Fix VSCode under-scrolling to bottom
changes.why_matters: 避免初次加载或切换会话时内容没有滚到底，提升阅读和跟随最新输出的体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the view from stopping short of the bottom on load or session switch, improving readability and follow-up on new output.

changes.raw: Claude Opus 4.6 is now available!
changes.summary: 新增 Opus 4.6 模型
changes.summary_en: Claude Opus 4.6 now available
changes.why_matters: 用户可以直接使用更强的新模型，提升代码生成与推理质量。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can use a stronger new model for better code generation and reasoning.

changes.raw: Added research preview agent teams feature for multi-agent collaboration (token-intensive feature, requires setting CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1)
changes.summary: 支持多代理团队协作
changes.summary_en: Added multi-agent team collaboration
changes.why_matters: 多代理协作可分工处理复杂任务，提高大项目处理效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Multi-agent collaboration helps split complex work and improves efficiency on large tasks.

changes.raw: Claude now automatically records and recalls memories as it works
changes.summary: 自动记录并回忆记忆
changes.summary_en: Claude now records and recalls memories
changes.why_matters: 工具能持续记住上下文与偏好，减少重复说明并提升连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: The tool can retain context and preferences over time, reducing repetition and improving continuity.

changes.raw: Added "Summarize from here" to the message selector, allowing partial conversation summarization.
changes.summary: 支持从此处摘要对话
changes.summary_en: Added summarize-from-here in selector
changes.why_matters: 用户可只总结部分对话，更方便截取关键上下文继续工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can summarize only part of a conversation, making it easier to continue from key context.

changes.raw: Skills defined in `.claude/skills/` within additional directories (`--add-dir`) are now loaded automatically.
changes.summary: 自动加载额外目录技能
changes.summary_en: Skills in added dirs load automatically
changes.why_matters: 扩展目录中的技能无需手动配置即可生效，使用更顺畅。
changes.why_matters_en: Skills in extra directories work automatically without manual setup, making usage smoother.

changes.raw: Fixed `@` file completion showing incorrect relative paths when running from a subdirectory
changes.summary: 修复子目录下路径补全
changes.summary_en: Fixed incorrect @ file paths from subdirs
changes.why_matters: 在子目录中补全文件路径会更准确，减少选错文件的风险。
changes.why_matters_en: File path completion is more accurate from subdirectories, reducing the chance of selecting the wrong file.

changes.raw: Updated --resume to re-use --agent value specified in previous conversation by default.
changes.summary: 恢复会话默认沿用代理
changes.summary_en: Resume now reuses previous agent by default
changes.why_matters: 恢复历史会话时能保持同一代理设置，减少重复配置。
changes.why_matters_en: Resuming a past conversation keeps the same agent by default, reducing repeated setup.

changes.raw: Fixed: Bash tool no longer throws "Bad substitution" errors when heredocs contain JavaScript template literals like `${index + 1}`, which previously interrupted tool execution
changes.summary: 修复 Bash heredoc 语法报错
changes.summary_en: Fixed Bash heredoc bad substitution errors
changes.why_matters: 避免工具因模板字符串误报错而中断，提升脚本执行稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents tool execution from being interrupted by false Bash errors, improving script reliability.

changes.raw: Skill character budget now scales with context window (2% of context), so users with larger context windows can see more skill descriptions without truncation
changes.summary: 技能描述预算随上下文扩展
changes.summary_en: Skill budget now scales with context window
changes.why_matters: 大上下文用户能看到更多技能说明，减少信息被截断。
changes.why_matters_en: Users with larger context windows can see more skill descriptions without truncation.

changes.raw: Fixed Thai/Lao spacing vowels (สระ า, ำ) not rendering correctly in the input field
changes.summary: 修复泰语老挝语元音显示
changes.summary_en: Fixed Thai/Lao vowel rendering in input
changes.why_matters: 输入框显示更正确，提升非拉丁文字用户的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Input rendering is now correct, improving usability for non-Latin script users.

changes.raw: VSCode: Fixed slash commands incorrectly being executed when pressing Enter with preceding text in the input field
changes.summary: 修复 VSCode 回车误触发命令
changes.summary_en: Fixed VSCode slash command misfire on Enter
changes.why_matters: 避免输入普通文本时误执行命令，减少编辑器内操作错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents accidental command execution while typing normal text, reducing editor mistakes.

changes.raw: VSCode: Added spinner when loading past conversations list
changes.summary: 会话列表加载显示转圈
changes.summary_en: Added spinner while loading past chats
changes.why_matters: 用户能更清楚知道列表正在加载，减少等待时的不确定感。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get clearer feedback that the list is loading, reducing uncertainty while waiting.

changes.raw: Added session resume hint on exit, showing how to continue your conversation later
changes.summary: 退出时提示续会话方式
changes.summary_en: Show resume hint on exit
changes.why_matters: 用户退出时能直接知道如何继续之前的对话，减少中断后的找回成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can quickly resume a previous conversation after exiting, reducing friction.

changes.raw: Added support for full-width (zenkaku) space input from Japanese IME in checkbox selection
changes.summary: 支持日文全角空格输入
changes.summary_en: Support full-width space input
changes.why_matters: 修复日文输入法在勾选选择中的输入问题，提升非英文用户可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes checkbox input for Japanese IME users and improves accessibility.

changes.raw: Fixed PDF too large errors permanently locking up sessions, requiring users to start a new conversation
changes.summary: PDF过大不再锁死会话
changes.summary_en: PDF oversize no longer locks sessions
changes.why_matters: 避免因一次大文件错误导致整个会话不可用，用户无需被迫重开对话。
changes.why_matters_en: A large PDF error no longer bricks the session, so users do not need to start over.

changes.raw: Fixed bash commands incorrectly reporting failure with "Read-only file system" errors when sandbox mode was enabled
changes.summary: 沙箱下bash失败误报已修复
changes.summary_en: Fix false bash failures in sandbox
changes.why_matters: 减少沙箱模式下命令结果误判，避免用户被错误失败信息误导。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents false failure reports in sandbox mode and avoids misleading users.

changes.raw: Fixed a crash that made sessions unusable after entering plan mode when project config in `~/.claude.json` was missing default fields
changes.summary: 缺省配置不再导致崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash with missing config fields
changes.why_matters: 避免计划模式在配置不完整时直接崩溃，保障会话稳定可继续使用。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents crashes when config defaults are missing, keeping sessions usable.

changes.raw: Fixed `temperatureOverride` being silently ignored in the streaming API path, causing all streaming requests to use the default temperature (1) regardless of the configured override
changes.summary: 流式API温度覆盖生效
changes.summary_en: Honor temperature override in streaming
changes.why_matters: 确保流式请求按配置运行，避免模型输出风格与预期不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Streaming requests now respect the configured temperature, matching expected behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed LSP shutdown/exit compatibility with strict language servers that reject null params
changes.summary: 兼容严格LSP关闭参数
changes.summary_en: Fix LSP shutdown compatibility
changes.why_matters: 提升与更严格语言服务器的兼容性，减少工具链退出时的报错。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves compatibility with strict language servers and reduces shutdown errors.

changes.raw: Improved system prompts to more clearly guide the model toward using dedicated tools (Read, Edit, Glob, Grep) instead of bash equivalents (`cat`, `sed`, `grep`, `find`), reducing unnecessary bash command usage
changes.summary: 更鼓励使用专用工具
changes.summary_en: Guide model toward dedicated tools
changes.why_matters: 减少不必要的 bash 调用，让编辑和检索更稳定、更可控。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces unnecessary bash usage and makes file operations more reliable.

changes.raw: Improved PDF and request size error messages to show actual limits (100 pages, 20MB)
changes.summary: 错误提示显示真实限制
changes.summary_en: Show actual PDF and request limits
changes.why_matters: 用户能更快理解失败原因并调整输入大小，减少反复试错。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see the real limits and adjust inputs faster, reducing trial and error.

changes.raw: Reduced layout jitter in the terminal when the spinner appears and disappears during streaming
changes.summary: 减少流式转圈布局抖动
changes.summary_en: Reduce spinner layout jitter
changes.why_matters: 终端界面更稳定，阅读输出时不会被频繁的布局变化打断。
changes.why_matters_en: The terminal UI feels steadier and is less distracting during streaming output.

changes.raw: Removed misleading Anthropic API pricing from model selector for third-party provider (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry) users
changes.summary: 第三方用户不再见Anthropic定价
changes.summary_en: Hide Anthropic pricing for third-party users
changes.why_matters: 避免向 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 用户展示无关价格信息，减少混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes irrelevant pricing for third-party provider users and reduces confusion.

changes.raw: Added `pages` parameter to the Read tool for PDFs, allowing specific page ranges to be read (e.g., `pages: "1-5"`). Large PDFs (>10 pages) now return a lightweight reference when `@` mentioned instead of being inlined into context.
changes.summary: PDF可按页读取，长文档引用更轻量
changes.summary_en: Read PDFs by page range; large PDFs stay lightweight
changes.why_matters: 用户可以只读取需要的页数，且大 PDF 不再把全文塞进上下文，显著节省 token 并提升处理效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can read only the needed pages, and large PDFs no longer flood context, saving tokens and improving efficiency.

changes.raw: Added pre-configured OAuth client credentials for MCP servers that don't support Dynamic Client Registration (e.g., Slack). Use `--client-id` and `--client-secret` with `claude mcp add`.
changes.summary: MCP支持预配置OAuth客户端凭据
changes.summary_en: MCP servers can use preconfigured OAuth credentials
changes.why_matters: 这让不支持动态注册的 MCP 服务也能顺利接入，降低集成门槛。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes it possible to connect MCP servers that lack dynamic registration, lowering integration friction.

changes.raw: Added `/debug` for Claude to help troubleshoot the current session
changes.summary: 新增/debug便于排查当前会话
changes.summary_en: Added /debug to troubleshoot the current session
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更快定位会话问题，减少来回试错和排障时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can diagnose session issues faster, reducing trial-and-error and troubleshooting time.

changes.raw: Added support for additional `git log` and `git show` flags in read-only mode (e.g., `--topo-order`, `--cherry-pick`, `--format`, `--raw`)
changes.summary: 只读模式支持更多git log/show参数
changes.summary_en: Read-only git log/show supports more flags
changes.why_matters: 这让 Claude 能更准确地查看 Git 历史和变更，适配更多常见工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets Claude inspect Git history and diffs more accurately, covering more common workflows.

changes.raw: Added token count, tool uses, and duration metrics to Task tool results
changes.summary: 任务结果新增耗时与用量指标
changes.summary_en: Task results now include usage and duration metrics
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更清楚地评估任务成本和效率，便于优化工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can better assess task cost and efficiency, helping optimize workflows.

changes.raw: Added reduced motion mode to the config
changes.summary: 新增减少动态效果模式
changes.summary_en: Added reduced motion mode
changes.why_matters: 这提升了对动画敏感用户的可用性和舒适度。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves usability and comfort for users sensitive to motion.

changes.raw: Fixed phantom "(no content)" text blocks appearing in API conversation history, reducing token waste and potential model confusion
changes.summary: 修复API历史中的空内容块
changes.summary_en: Fixed phantom empty content blocks in API history
changes.why_matters: 这能减少无效 token 消耗，并避免模型被错误的空块干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces wasted tokens and prevents the model from being confused by bogus empty blocks.

changes.raw: Fixed prompt cache not correctly invalidating when tool descriptions or input schemas changed, only when tool names changed
changes.summary: 修复工具变更后缓存未失效
changes.summary_en: Fixed prompt cache invalidation for tool schema changes
changes.why_matters: 工具描述或输入结构变化后能正确刷新缓存，避免使用过期提示导致错误行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Cache now refreshes when tool descriptions or schemas change, avoiding stale prompts and incorrect behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed 400 errors that could occur after running `/login` when the conversation contained thinking blocks
changes.summary: 修复登录后含思考块的400错误
changes.summary_en: Fixed 400 errors after /login with thinking blocks
changes.why_matters: 这避免了登录后会话直接报错，提升了流程稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents post-login session failures and improves workflow stability.

changes.raw: Fixed a hang when resuming sessions with corrupted transcript files containing `parentUuid` cycles
changes.summary: 修复损坏转录恢复时卡死
changes.summary_en: Fixed hang when resuming corrupted transcripts
changes.why_matters: 即使会话文件损坏，用户也能更可靠地恢复工作，不会被卡住。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can resume work more reliably even if session files are corrupted, without getting stuck.

changes.raw: Fixed rate limit message showing incorrect "/upgrade" suggestion for Max 20x users when extra-usage is unavailable
changes.summary: 修正Max 20x限流提示文案
changes.summary_en: Fixed incorrect rate-limit upgrade message for Max 20x
changes.why_matters: 这能避免误导用户去执行不适用的升级操作。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids misleading users into taking an irrelevant upgrade action.

changes.raw: Fixed permission dialogs stealing focus while actively typing
changes.summary: 修复权限弹窗抢占输入焦点
changes.summary_en: Fixed permission dialogs stealing typing focus
changes.why_matters: 用户在输入时不会被打断，减少误操作并提升交互流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Users are no longer interrupted while typing, reducing mistakes and improving interaction flow.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents not being able to access SDK-provided MCP tools because they were not synced to the shared application state
changes.summary: 修复子代理无法用共享MCP工具
changes.summary_en: Fixed subagents accessing shared MCP tools
changes.why_matters: 子代理现在能正确调用 SDK 提供的 MCP 工具，增强多代理协作能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Subagents can now correctly use SDK-provided MCP tools, improving multi-agent collaboration.

changes.raw: Fixed a regression where Windows users with a `.bashrc` file could not run bash commands
changes.summary: 修复Windows下bashrc导致命令失败
changes.summary_en: Fixed Windows bash commands failing with .bashrc
changes.why_matters: Windows 用户在存在 .bashrc 时也能正常执行 bash 命令，减少环境兼容问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Windows users can run bash commands normally even with a .bashrc file, reducing environment compatibility issues.

changes.raw: Improved memory usage for `--resume` (68% reduction for users with many sessions) by replacing the session index with lightweight stat-based loading and progressive enrichment
changes.summary: 恢复会话内存占用大幅降低
changes.summary_en: Greatly reduced memory use for session resume
changes.why_matters: 大量会话用户在恢复时更省内存、加载更快，整体体验明显提升。
changes.why_matters_en: Users with many sessions get much lower memory usage and faster resume performance, significantly improving experience.

changes.raw: Improved `TaskStop` tool to display the stopped command/task description in the result line instead of a generic "Task stopped" message
changes.summary: 停止任务结果显示具体描述
changes.summary_en: Show stopped task details in result
changes.why_matters: 让用户更清楚知道被停止的是哪个命令或任务，减少上下文混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes it clear which command or task was stopped, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Changed `/model` to execute immediately instead of being queued
changes.summary: /model 立即执行
changes.summary_en: Run /model immediately
changes.why_matters: 用户切换模型时无需再等待队列，交互更直接、响应更快。
changes.why_matters_en: Users no longer wait for the queue when switching models, making the interaction faster and more direct.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added multiline input support to the "Other" text input in question dialogs (use Shift+Enter for new lines)
changes.summary: 问题对话支持多行输入
changes.summary_en: Support multiline input in dialogs
changes.why_matters: 用户可以在对话框中输入更完整的问题或说明，提升表达能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can enter fuller questions or explanations in dialogs, improving expressiveness.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed duplicate sessions appearing in the session list when starting a new conversation
changes.summary: 修复会话列表重复显示
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate sessions in list
changes.why_matters: 避免新建对话时出现重复会话，提升会话列表的准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents duplicate sessions when starting a new conversation, improving list accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed startup performance issues when resuming sessions that have `saved_hook_context`
changes.summary: 修复恢复会话启动变慢
changes.summary_en: Fix slow startup when resuming sessions
changes.why_matters: 恢复带有 saved_hook_context 的会话时启动更快，减少等待时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Resuming sessions with saved_hook_context starts faster, reducing wait time.

changes.raw: Added tool call failures and denials to debug logs
changes.summary: 调试日志记录工具失败
changes.summary_en: Log tool call failures/denials
changes.why_matters: 便于排查工具调用被拒绝或失败的原因，提升调试效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes it easier to diagnose why tool calls fail or are denied.

changes.raw: Fixed context management validation error for gateway users, ensuring `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1` avoids the error
changes.summary: 修复网关用户上下文校验错误
changes.summary_en: Fix context validation for gateway users

changes.raw: Added `--from-pr` flag to resume sessions linked to a specific GitHub PR number or URL

changes.summary_en: Resume sessions from a PR
changes.why_matters: 可以直接回到某个 GitHub PR 关联的会话，提升跨任务续接效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This lets users resume the exact session tied to a GitHub PR, improving continuity.

changes.raw: Sessions are now automatically linked to PRs when created via `gh pr create`
changes.summary: 创建PR时自动关联会话
changes.summary_en: Auto-link sessions to created PRs
changes.why_matters: 减少手动关联步骤，让会话与代码审查流程自动对齐。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes manual linking and keeps sessions aligned with the PR workflow.

changes.raw: Fixed /context command not displaying colored output
changes.summary: 修复/context彩色输出显示
changes.summary_en: Fix colored output in /context
changes.why_matters: 让上下文信息更易读，改善命令行显示体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves readability of context output in the CLI.

changes.raw: Fixed status bar duplicating background task indicator when PR status was shown
changes.summary: 修复状态栏PR指示重复
changes.summary_en: Fix duplicate PR indicator in status bar
changes.why_matters: 避免状态栏信息重复，减少界面干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: This removes duplicate status indicators and reduces UI clutter.

changes.raw: Windows: Fixed bash command execution failing for users with `.bashrc` files
changes.summary: 修复Windows bash命令执行失败
changes.summary_en: Fix bash command execution on Windows
changes.why_matters: 解决带 .bashrc 的 Windows 用户无法执行 bash 命令的问题。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes bash command execution for Windows users with .bashrc files.

changes.raw: Windows: Fixed console windows flashing when spawning child processes
changes.summary: 修复Windows弹窗闪烁
changes.summary_en: Fix flashing console windows on Windows
changes.why_matters: 减少子进程启动时的视觉闪烁，提升 Windows 使用体验。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves the Windows experience by preventing flashing console windows.

changes.raw: VSCode: Fixed OAuth token expiration causing 401 errors after extended sessions
changes.summary: 修复VSCode OAuth过期401错误
changes.summary_en: Fix VSCode OAuth expiry causing 401s
changes.why_matters: 避免长会话中认证失效导致请求失败，保证持续可用。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents long sessions from failing due to expired OAuth tokens.

changes.raw: Fixed file write preview omitting empty lines

changes.raw: Fixed Ctrl+Z suspend not working in terminals using Kitty keyboard protocol (Ghostty, iTerm2, kitty, WezTerm)
changes.summary: 修复 Kitty 协议下暂停失效
changes.summary_en: Fix Ctrl+Z suspend in Kitty protocol terminals
changes.why_matters: 在支持 Kitty 键盘协议的终端中，暂停快捷键恢复正常，改善终端交互体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Suspend shortcuts work again in Kitty-protocol terminals, improving terminal interaction reliability.

changes.raw: Added `showTurnDuration` setting to hide turn duration messages (e.g., "Cooked for 1m 6s")
changes.summary: 可隐藏轮次耗时提示
changes.summary_en: Hide turn duration messages
changes.why_matters: 减少界面噪音，让用户更专注于实际输出内容。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces UI noise so users can focus on the actual output.

changes.raw: Added ability to provide feedback when accepting permission prompts
changes.summary: 接受权限时可反馈
changes.summary_en: Add feedback on permission accept
changes.why_matters: 让权限交互更可控，便于用户表达对提示的态度。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes permission interactions more controllable and lets users express feedback on prompts.

changes.raw: Added inline display of agent's final response in task notifications, making it easier to see results without reading the full transcript file
changes.summary: 任务通知直接显示结果
changes.summary_en: Show final task response in notifications
changes.why_matters: 用户无需打开完整记录文件就能快速看到任务结果。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see task results quickly without opening the full transcript file.

changes.raw: Fixed security vulnerability where wildcard permission rules could match compound commands containing shell operators
changes.summary: 修复通配权限绕过漏洞
changes.summary_en: Fix wildcard permission bypass vulnerability
changes.why_matters: 防止带 shell 操作符的复合命令绕过权限规则执行。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents compound commands with shell operators from bypassing permission rules.

changes.raw: Fixed false "file modified" errors on Windows when cloud sync tools, antivirus scanners, or Git touch file timestamps without changing content
changes.summary: 修复 Windows 误报文件修改
changes.summary_en: Fix false file-modified errors on Windows
changes.why_matters: 避免云同步、杀毒或 Git 触发的时间戳变化导致误报中断工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: It avoids workflow interruptions caused by timestamp-only changes from sync tools, antivirus, or Git.

changes.raw: Fixed orphaned tool_result errors when sibling tools fail during streaming execution
changes.summary: 修复流式执行残留结果错误
changes.summary_en: Fix orphaned tool_result streaming errors
changes.why_matters: 减少并发工具执行失败时的异常和输出损坏。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces errors and output corruption when sibling tools fail during concurrent execution.

changes.raw: Fixed context window blocking limit being calculated using the full context window instead of the effective context window (which reserves space for max output tokens)
changes.summary: 修正上下文窗口阻塞计算
changes.summary_en: Fix context window blocking calculation
changes.why_matters: 避免过早限制输入，提升长上下文任务的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents premature blocking and improves usability for long-context tasks.

changes.raw: Fixed spinner briefly flashing when running local slash commands like `/model` or `/theme`
changes.summary: 修复本地命令闪烁转圈
changes.summary_en: Fix spinner flash for local slash commands
changes.why_matters: 改善本地命令执行时的视觉体验。
changes.why_matters_en: It improves the visual experience when running local commands.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal title animation jitter by using fixed-width braille characters
changes.summary: 终端标题动画更平滑
changes.summary_en: Smooth terminal title animation
changes.why_matters: 减少标题动画抖动，让界面更稳定。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces jitter and makes the interface feel more stable.

changes.raw: Fixed plugins with git submodules not being fully initialized when installed
changes.summary: 修复含子模块插件初始化
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin submodule initialization
changes.why_matters: 确保带 Git 子模块的插件安装后可正常使用。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures plugins with Git submodules are ready to use after installation.

changes.raw: Fixed bash commands failing on Windows when temp directory paths contained characters like `t` or `n` that were misinterpreted as escape sequences
changes.summary: 修复 Windows Bash 转义错误
changes.summary_en: Fix Windows bash escape-sequence bug
changes.why_matters: 避免临时目录路径中的字符被误解析，导致命令失败。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents temp-path characters from being misread as escapes and breaking commands.

changes.raw: Improved typing responsiveness by reducing memory allocation overhead in terminal rendering
changes.summary: 提升终端输入响应速度
changes.summary_en: Improve terminal typing responsiveness
changes.why_matters: 减少渲染开销，让输入更流畅。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces rendering overhead and makes typing feel smoother.

changes.raw: Enabled MCP tool search auto mode by default for all users. When MCP tool descriptions exceed 10% of the context window, they are automatically deferred and discovered via the MCPSearch tool instead of being loaded upfront. This reduces context usage for users with many MCP tools configured. Users can disable this by adding `MCPSearch` to `disallowedTools` in their settings.
changes.summary: 默认启用 MCP 工具搜索
changes.summary_en: Enable MCP tool search by default
changes.why_matters: 在工具很多时节省上下文，提升大规模 MCP 配置的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: It saves context when many tools are configured and improves usability at scale.

changes.raw: Changed OAuth and API Console URLs from console.anthropic.com to platform.claude.com
changes.summary: OAuth 与控制台网址变更
changes.summary_en: Change OAuth and console URLs
changes.why_matters: 用户需要更新旧链接和书签以继续访问相关页面。
changes.why_matters_en: Users need to update old links and bookmarks to keep accessing the pages.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed `claudeProcessWrapper` setting passing the wrapper path instead of the Claude binary path
changes.summary: 修复 VSCode 包装器路径错误
changes.summary_en: Fix VSCode wrapper path bug
changes.why_matters: 确保 VSCode 集成能正确启动 Claude 二进制文件。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures the VSCode integration launches the Claude binary correctly.

signals.title: Cowork: Claude Code for the rest of your work
How to code Claude Code in 200 lines of code
Anthropic blocks third-party use of Claude Code subscriptions
Stop Doom Scrolling, Start Doom Coding: Build via the terminal from your phone

changes.raw: Added search functionality to `/config` command for quickly filtering settings
changes.summary: 配置命令支持搜索筛选
changes.summary_en: Add search filtering to /config
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更快找到并修改所需设置，减少在大量配置项中翻找的时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can find and adjust settings faster, reducing time spent searching through many options.

changes.raw: Added Updates section to `/doctor` showing auto-update channel and available npm versions (stable/latest)
changes.summary: 医生命令显示更新信息
changes.summary_en: Show update channel and npm versions
changes.why_matters: 用户能更清楚了解当前更新通道和可用版本，便于排查版本相关问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can see their update channel and available versions, making version-related troubleshooting easier.

changes.raw: Added date range filtering to `/stats` command - press `r` to cycle between Last 7 days, Last 30 days, and All time
changes.summary: 统计命令支持日期范围筛选
changes.summary_en: Add date range filters to /stats
changes.why_matters: 用户可以按时间范围查看使用统计，更方便分析近期或长期趋势。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can view stats by time range, making it easier to analyze recent or long-term trends.

changes.raw: Added automatic discovery of skills from nested `.claude/skills` directories when working with files in subdirectories
changes.summary: 自动发现子目录技能
changes.summary_en: Auto-discover skills in nested subdirs
changes.why_matters: 在子目录工作时也能自动加载相关技能，提升跨目录项目中的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Relevant skills are loaded automatically even in subdirectories, improving usability across nested projects.

changes.raw: Added `context_window.used_percentage` and `context_window.remaining_percentage` fields to status line input for easier context window display
changes.summary: 状态栏显示上下文百分比
changes.summary_en: Expose context window percentages
changes.why_matters: 用户能更直观地看到上下文剩余量，便于控制对话长度和避免超限。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can more easily see remaining context, helping manage conversation length and avoid limits.

changes.raw: Added an error display when the editor fails during Ctrl+G
changes.summary: 编辑器失败时显示错误
changes.summary_en: Show error when editor fails on Ctrl+G
changes.why_matters: 当外部编辑器启动失败时，用户能及时知道原因而不是无响应。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get immediate feedback when the external editor fails instead of seeing silent failure.

changes.raw: Fixed permission bypass via shell line continuation that could allow blocked commands to execute
changes.summary: 修复续行绕过命令拦截
changes.summary_en: Fix shell line-continuation bypass
changes.why_matters: 这修补了可能让被阻止命令执行的安全绕过，直接降低风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This closes a security bypass that could let blocked commands run, directly reducing risk.

changes.raw: Fixed false "File has been unexpectedly modified" errors when file watchers touch files without changing content
changes.summary: 修复误报文件被修改
changes.summary_en: Fix false modified-file warnings
changes.why_matters: 文件内容未变时不再误报，减少不必要的中断和困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Files no longer trigger false modification warnings when only touched, reducing interruptions and confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed text styling (bold, colors) getting progressively misaligned in multi-line responses
changes.summary: 修复多行样式错位
changes.summary_en: Fix misaligned multi-line styling
changes.why_matters: 多行回复的格式更稳定，提升可读性和界面一致性。
changes.why_matters_en: Multi-line responses render more consistently, improving readability and UI consistency.

changes.raw: Fixed the feedback panel closing unexpectedly when typing 'n' in the description field
changes.summary: 修复反馈面板误关闭
changes.summary_en: Fix feedback panel closing on 'n'
changes.why_matters: 用户输入描述时不会意外退出反馈流程，减少表单中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Users won't accidentally exit the feedback flow while typing, reducing form interruptions.

changes.raw: Fixed rate limit warning appearing at low usage after weekly reset (now requires 70% usage)
changes.summary: 修复限流警告误触发
changes.summary_en: Fix false rate-limit warnings after reset
changes.why_matters: 避免在低使用量时错误提示限流，让用户更准确判断真实状态。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misleading rate-limit warnings at low usage, helping users trust the status display.

changes.raw: Fixed rate limit options menu incorrectly auto-opening when resuming a previous session
changes.summary: 恢复会话不再误开菜单
changes.summary_en: Fix auto-opening rate-limit menu on resume
changes.why_matters: 恢复旧会话时界面行为更稳定，不会打断用户继续工作。
changes.why_matters_en: Resumed sessions behave more predictably and don't interrupt users with an unexpected menu.

changes.raw: Fixed numpad keys outputting escape sequences instead of characters in Kitty keyboard protocol terminals
changes.summary: 修复 Kitty 数字键输出
changes.summary_en: Fix numpad keys in Kitty protocol terminals
changes.why_matters: 在 Kitty 协议终端中数字小键盘可正常输入，提升终端兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: Numpad input works correctly in Kitty protocol terminals, improving terminal compatibility.

changes.raw: Fixed Option+Return not inserting newlines in Kitty keyboard protocol terminals
changes.summary: 修复 Kitty 下回车换行
changes.summary_en: Fix Option+Return newline in Kitty terminals
changes.why_matters: 在 Kitty 协议终端中可正常插入换行，减少输入受限问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Option+Return now inserts newlines correctly in Kitty protocol terminals, reducing input friction.

changes.raw: Fixed corrupted config backup files accumulating in the home directory (now only one backup is created per config file)
changes.summary: 修复配置备份文件堆积
changes.summary_en: Fix accumulating corrupted config backups
changes.why_matters: 避免主目录中不断生成损坏备份文件，减少磁盘杂乱和维护成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents corrupted backup files from piling up in the home directory, reducing clutter and maintenance.

changes.raw: Fixed `mcp list` and `mcp get` commands leaving orphaned MCP server processes
changes.summary: 修复 mcp 命令残留进程
changes.summary_en: Fix orphaned MCP server processes
changes.why_matters: 避免 `mcp list` 和 `mcp get` 后留下孤儿进程，减少资源泄漏和后台干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents orphaned processes after `mcp list` and `mcp get`, reducing leaks and background interference.

changes.raw: Fixed visual artifacts in ink2 mode when nodes become hidden via `display:none`
changes.summary: 修复隐藏节点渲染异常
changes.summary_en: Fix ink2 hidden-node visual artifacts
changes.why_matters: 修复节点被隐藏时的显示瑕疵，提升界面稳定性和可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Fixes display glitches when nodes are hidden, improving UI stability and readability.

changes.raw: Improved the external CLAUDE.md imports approval dialog to show which files are being imported and from where
changes.summary: 外部导入提示更清晰
changes.summary_en: Show imported files and sources
changes.why_matters: 让 CLAUDE.md 外部导入审批更透明，帮助用户更安全地判断是否允许导入。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes external CLAUDE.md import approval more transparent so users can judge imports more safely.

changes.raw: Improved the `/tasks` dialog to go directly to task details when there's only one background task running
changes.summary: /tasks 单任务直达详情
changes.summary_en: Open task details when only one task runs
changes.why_matters: 当只有一个后台任务时可直接进入详情，减少点击步骤并提升效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Opens task details directly when only one background task is running, reducing clicks and improving efficiency.

changes.raw: Improved @ autocomplete with icons for different suggestion types and single-line formatting
changes.summary: @补全更易识别
changes.summary_en: Improve @ autocomplete with icons
changes.why_matters: 通过图标和单行展示让补全建议更易区分，提升输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Icons and single-line formatting make autocomplete suggestions easier to distinguish and use.

changes.raw: Updated "Help improve Claude" setting fetch to refresh OAuth and retry when it fails due to a stale OAuth token
changes.summary: 过期 OAuth 自动重试
changes.summary_en: Refresh stale OAuth and retry fetch
changes.why_matters: 在 OAuth 令牌过期时自动刷新并重试，减少设置项失败和手动排障。
changes.why_matters_en: Automatically refreshes and retries when OAuth tokens are stale, reducing setting failures and manual recovery.

changes.raw: Changed task notification display to cap at 3 lines with overflow summary when multiple background tasks complete simultaneously
changes.summary: 任务通知更简洁
changes.summary_en: Cap task notifications at 3 lines
changes.why_matters: 多任务同时完成时限制通知长度，避免界面被长消息淹没。
changes.why_matters_en: Limits notification length when multiple tasks finish at once, preventing the UI from being overwhelmed.

changes.raw: Changed terminal title to "Claude Code" on startup for better window identification
changes.summary: 终端标题更易识别
changes.summary_en: Set terminal title to Claude Code
changes.why_matters: 启动时设置统一终端标题，方便在多个窗口中快速识别。
changes.why_matters_en: Sets a consistent terminal title on startup, making it easier to identify among multiple windows.

changes.raw: Removed ability to @-mention MCP servers to enable/disable - use `/mcp enable <name>` instead
changes.summary: 移除 @ 切换 MCP 服务器
changes.summary_en: Remove @-mention toggles for MCP servers
changes.why_matters: 原有通过 @ 直接启停 MCP 服务器的方式被移除，需要改用新命令。
changes.why_matters_en: The old @-mention flow for enabling/disabling MCP servers is removed and must be replaced with the new command.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed usage indicator not updating after manual compact
changes.summary: 修复 VSCode 额度指示
changes.summary_en: Fix VSCode usage indicator after compact
changes.why_matters: 手动 compact 后使用量指示能正确刷新，避免状态显示错误。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures the usage indicator refreshes correctly after manual compact, avoiding stale status display.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` environment variable to override the temp directory used for internal temp files, useful for environments with custom temp directory requirements
changes.summary: 可自定义内部临时目录
changes.summary_en: Override Claude Code temp directory
changes.why_matters: 允许在有特殊临时目录要求的环境中正常运行，提升部署兼容性。
changes.why_matters_en: It lets Claude Code run in environments with custom temp directory requirements, improving deployment compatibility.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS` environment variable to disable all background task functionality including auto-backgrounding and the Ctrl+B shortcut
changes.summary: 可关闭后台任务功能
changes.summary_en: Disable all background tasks
changes.why_matters: 用户可以通过环境变量彻底关闭自动后台运行和快捷键触发，便于控制资源和行为。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can fully disable auto-backgrounding and the shortcut trigger, giving them tighter control over behavior and resource use.

changes.raw: Fixed "Help improve Claude" setting fetch to refresh OAuth and retry when it fails due to a stale OAuth token
changes.summary: 修复帮助改进设置刷新
changes.summary_en: Retry help-improve setting fetch
changes.why_matters: 当 OAuth 令牌过期时会自动刷新并重试，减少设置加载失败。
changes.why_matters_en: It refreshes OAuth and retries when the token is stale, reducing failures when loading the setting.
