changes.raw: Merged slash commands and skills, simplifying the mental model with no change in behavior
changes.summary: 合并命令与技能，简化心智模型
changes.summary_en: Merged commands and skills for simpler model
changes.why_matters: 减少概念分裂，让用户更容易理解和使用 Claude Code。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces conceptual overhead and makes Claude Code easier to understand and use.

changes.raw: Added release channel (`stable` or `latest`) toggle to `/config`
changes.summary: 可切换稳定版或最新版本通道
changes.summary_en: Added stable/latest release channel toggle
changes.why_matters: 用户可以按需选择更稳妥或更前沿的更新节奏。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can choose between safer updates and newer features based on their needs.

changes.raw: Added detection and warnings for unreachable permission rules, with warnings in `/doctor` and after saving rules that include the source of each rule and actionable fix guidance
changes.summary: 提示无效权限规则并给出修复建议
changes.summary_en: Warn on unreachable permission rules with fixes
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户及时发现失效规则，避免权限配置误以为生效。
changes.why_matters_en: It helps users catch ineffective rules early and avoid assuming permissions are configured correctly.

changes.raw: Fixed plan files persisting across `/clear` commands, now ensuring a fresh plan file is used after clearing a conversation
changes.summary: 清空对话后重建计划文件
changes.summary_en: Fresh plan file after /clear
changes.why_matters: 避免旧计划残留影响新会话，保证上下文重置干净。
changes.why_matters_en: It prevents stale plans from affecting new conversations and keeps resets clean.

changes.raw: Fixed false skill duplicate detection on filesystems with large inodes (e.g., ExFAT) by using 64-bit precision for inode values
changes.summary: 修复大 inode 文件系统技能重复误报
changes.summary_en: Fix false duplicate skill detection on large inodes
changes.why_matters: 在特定文件系统上减少误报，避免技能加载异常。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces false positives on certain filesystems and prevents skill-loading issues.

changes.raw: Fixed mismatch between background task count in status bar and items shown in tasks dialog
changes.summary: 修复状态栏与任务列表数量不一致
changes.summary_en: Fix task count mismatch in status bar
changes.why_matters: 让界面显示更准确，减少对后台任务状态的误解。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes the UI more accurate and reduces confusion about background task status.

changes.raw: Fixed sub-agents using the wrong model during conversation compaction
changes.summary: 修复压缩对话时子代理模型错误
changes.summary_en: Fix wrong model used by sub-agents on compaction
changes.why_matters: 确保子代理在压缩后仍使用正确模型，避免能力下降或行为异常。
changes.why_matters_en: It ensures sub-agents keep using the correct model after compaction, avoiding degraded behavior.

changes.raw: Fixed web search in sub-agents using incorrect model
changes.summary: 修复子代理网页搜索模型错误
changes.summary_en: Fix wrong model for sub-agent web search
changes.why_matters: 保证子代理检索能力按预期工作，提升搜索结果质量。
changes.why_matters_en: It keeps sub-agent retrieval working as intended and improves search quality.

changes.raw: Fixed trust dialog acceptance when running from the home directory not enabling trust-requiring features like hooks during the session
changes.summary: 修复家目录信任后会话权限未生效
changes.summary_en: Fix trust acceptance not enabling session features
changes.why_matters: 用户在接受信任后可立即使用 hooks 等受限功能，减少权限困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: After trusting, users can immediately use restricted features like hooks without confusion.

changes.raw: Improved terminal rendering stability by preventing uncontrolled writes from corrupting cursor state
changes.summary: 提升终端渲染稳定性
changes.summary_en: Improve terminal rendering stability
changes.why_matters: 减少光标状态损坏和界面乱序，提升长时间使用可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: It reduces cursor corruption and display glitches, improving reliability during long sessions.

changes.raw: Improved slash command suggestion readability by truncating long descriptions to 2 lines
changes.summary: 缩短命令建议描述，提升可读性
changes.summary_en: Truncate slash command suggestions for readability
changes.why_matters: 让建议列表更清爽，便于快速浏览和选择命令。
changes.why_matters_en: It makes suggestion lists easier to scan and choose from quickly.

changes.raw: Changed tool hook execution timeout from 60 seconds to 10 minutes
changes.summary: 工具钩子超时延长到10分钟
changes.summary_en: Extend tool hook timeout to 10 minutes
changes.why_matters: 允许更耗时的钩子任务完成，减少因超时失败。
changes.why_matters_en: It allows longer-running hooks to finish and reduces failures from timeouts.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Added clickable destination selector for permission requests, allowing you to choose where settings are saved (this project, all projects, shared with team, or session only)
changes.summary: VSCode权限请求可选保存位置
changes.summary_en: Clickable permission save destination selector in VSCode
changes.why_matters: 用户可以更精细地控制权限保存范围，适配项目或团队场景。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can control where permissions are saved, fitting project, team, or session workflows.

signals.title: Cowork: Claude Code for the rest of your work
How to code Claude Code in 200 lines of code
Anthropic blocks third-party use of Claude Code subscriptions
Stop Doom Scrolling, Start Doom Coding: Build via the terminal from your phone
The creator of Claude Code's Claude setup

changes.raw: Added source path metadata to images dragged onto the terminal, helping Claude understand where images originated
changes.summary: 拖拽图片保留来源路径
changes.summary_en: Preserve source path for dragged images
changes.why_matters: 让 Claude 更容易理解图片来源，提升多模态输入的上下文准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: This gives Claude better context about where an image came from, improving multimodal understanding.

changes.raw: Added clickable hyperlinks for file paths in tool output in terminals that support OSC 8 (like iTerm)
changes.summary: 终端输出文件可点击
changes.summary_en: Clickable file links in terminal output
changes.why_matters: 支持直接点击文件路径可减少跳转成本，提高排查和编辑效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Clickable file paths reduce navigation friction and speed up debugging and editing.

changes.raw: Added support for Windows Package Manager (winget) installations with automatic detection and update instructions
changes.summary: 支持 winget 安装更新
changes.summary_en: Support winget installs and updates
changes.why_matters: 让 Windows 用户更容易安装、识别和更新 Claude Code，降低使用门槛。
changes.why_matters_en: This makes Claude Code easier to install, detect, and update on Windows, lowering adoption friction.

changes.raw: Added Shift+Tab keyboard shortcut in plan mode to quickly select "auto-accept edits" option
changes.summary: 计划模式快捷切换自动接受
changes.summary_en: Shift+Tab toggles auto-accept in plan mode
changes.why_matters: 提供更快的键盘操作路径，提升计划模式下的交互效率。
changes.why_matters_en: This adds a faster keyboard path and improves interaction efficiency in plan mode.

changes.raw: Added `FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS` environment variable to allow plugin autoupdate even when the main auto-updater is disabled
changes.summary: 插件可强制自动更新
changes.summary_en: Force plugin auto-updates
changes.why_matters: 即使主自动更新关闭，也能保持插件最新，减少兼容性问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugins can stay up to date even when main auto-update is disabled, reducing compatibility issues.

changes.raw: Added `agent_type` to SessionStart hook input, populated if `--agent` is specified
changes.summary: SessionStart 增加 agent 类型
changes.summary_en: SessionStart hook includes agent type
changes.why_matters: 钩子可获得更完整的会话上下文，便于自动化和集成逻辑分支处理。
changes.why_matters_en: Hooks get richer session context, enabling better automation and integration branching.

changes.raw: Fixed a command injection vulnerability in bash command processing where malformed input could execute arbitrary commands
changes.summary: 修复 bash 命令注入漏洞
changes.summary_en: Fix bash command injection vulnerability
changes.why_matters: 这是高危安全问题，可能导致恶意输入执行任意命令并危及系统。
changes.why_matters_en: This is a critical security issue that could let malformed input execute arbitrary commands and compromise the system.

changes.raw: Fixed a memory leak where tree-sitter parse trees were not being freed, causing WASM memory to grow unbounded over long sessions
changes.summary: 修复长会话内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix long-session memory leak
changes.why_matters: 避免 WASM 内存持续增长，提升长时间使用时的稳定性和可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents unbounded WASM memory growth and improves stability during long sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed binary files (images, PDFs, etc.) being accidentally included in memory when using `@include` directives in CLAUDE.md files
changes.summary: 避免把二进制文件写入记忆
changes.summary_en: Stop binary files from entering memory
changes.why_matters: 防止图片和 PDF 等无关内容污染上下文，提升记忆质量与性能。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents irrelevant binary content from polluting context, improving memory quality and performance.

changes.raw: Fixed updates incorrectly claiming another installation is in progress
changes.summary: 修复更新中安装占用误报
changes.summary_en: Fix false update-in-progress errors
changes.why_matters: 减少更新流程中的误报，避免用户被错误阻塞。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces false update-blocking errors and prevents users from being unnecessarily blocked.

changes.raw: Fixed crash when socket files exist in watched directories (defense-in-depth for EOPNOTSUPP errors)
changes.summary: 修复监视目录 socket 崩溃
changes.summary_en: Fix crash on socket files in watched dirs
changes.why_matters: 提升在复杂目录结构下的健壮性，避免因特殊文件导致崩溃。
changes.why_matters_en: This improves robustness in complex directory trees and avoids crashes from special files.

changes.raw: Fixed remote session URL and teleport being broken when using `/tasks` command
changes.summary: 修复 /tasks 远程会话链接
changes.summary_en: Fix remote session URL and teleport for /tasks
changes.why_matters: 恢复远程会话和跳转功能，保证任务协作流程可用。
changes.why_matters_en: This restores remote session and teleport behavior, keeping task collaboration workflows usable.

changes.raw: Fixed MCP tool names being exposed in analytics events by sanitizing user-specific server configurations
changes.summary: 清理分析事件中的工具名
changes.summary_en: Sanitize tool names in analytics events
changes.why_matters: 避免泄露用户特定的 MCP 配置细节，降低隐私风险。
changes.why_matters_en: This avoids leaking user-specific MCP configuration details and reduces privacy risk.

changes.raw: Improved Option-as-Meta hint on macOS to show terminal-specific instructions for native CSIu terminals like iTerm2, Kitty, and WezTerm
changes.summary: macOS Meta 提示更具体
changes.summary_en: Better macOS Option-as-Meta hint
changes.why_matters: 为不同终端提供更准确的按键说明，减少配置困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: This gives more accurate keybinding guidance across terminals and reduces setup confusion.

changes.raw: Improved error message when pasting images over SSH to suggest using `scp` instead of the unhelpful clipboard shortcut hint
changes.summary: SSH 贴图提示改为 scp
changes.summary_en: Suggest scp for SSH image pasting
changes.why_matters: 在不支持剪贴板的场景下给出更可行的替代方案，减少误导。
changes.why_matters_en: This offers a more practical alternative when clipboard pasting is unavailable, reducing confusion.

changes.raw: Improved permission explainer to not flag routine dev workflows (git fetch/rebase, npm install, tests, PRs) as medium risk
changes.summary: 降低常规命令误报风险
changes.summary_en: Reduce false risk flags for routine commands
changes.why_matters: 减少对常见开发流程的误报，让权限提示更准确、干扰更少。
changes.why_matters_en: This reduces false alarms on common dev workflows, making permission prompts more accurate and less disruptive.

changes.raw: Changed large bash command outputs to be saved to disk instead of truncated, allowing Claude to read the full content
changes.summary: 大 Bash 输出可完整读取
changes.summary_en: Keep large bash output fully readable
changes.why_matters: 避免长输出被截断，Claude 能读取完整结果以便更可靠地分析和继续操作。
changes.why_matters_en: This prevents truncation of long outputs so Claude can inspect the full result and act more reliably.

changes.raw: Changed large tool outputs to be persisted to disk instead of truncated, providing full output access via file references
changes.summary: 工具大输出改为落盘保留
changes.summary_en: Persist large tool outputs to disk
changes.why_matters: 大工具输出不再丢失，用户可通过文件引用查看完整内容，提升可追溯性。
changes.why_matters_en: Large tool outputs are no longer lost, and users can access the full content via file references for better traceability.

changes.raw: Changed `/plugins` installed tab to unify plugins and MCPs with scope-based grouping
changes.summary: 统一插件与 MCP 展示
changes.summary_en: Unify plugin and MCP listing
changes.why_matters: 将相关扩展按作用域统一分组，帮助用户更快理解已安装内容。
changes.why_matters_en: Grouping related extensions by scope helps users understand what is installed more quickly.

changes.raw: Deprecated Windows managed settings path `C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json` - administrators should migrate to `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json`
changes.summary: Windows 管理配置路径变更
changes.summary_en: Windows managed settings path changed
changes.why_matters: 管理员需要迁移配置路径，否则受管设置可能无法被正确读取。
changes.why_matters_en: Administrators must migrate the config path or managed settings may no longer be read correctly.

changes.raw: [SDK] Changed minimum zod peer dependency to ^4.0.0
changes.summary: SDK 依赖 zod 4 以上
changes.summary_en: SDK now requires zod v4+
changes.why_matters: 下游集成需要升级依赖版本，否则可能出现安装或运行兼容性问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Downstream integrations must upgrade dependencies or face potential install and runtime compatibility issues.

changes.raw: [VSCode] Fixed usage display not updating after manual compact
changes.summary: VSCode 用量显示可刷新
changes.summary_en: VSCode usage display updates after compact
changes.why_matters: 修复手动 compact 后显示不同步的问题，让用量信息更准确。
changes.why_matters_en: This fixes stale usage display after manual compact so the reported usage stays accurate.

signals.title: Cowork: Claude Code for the rest of your work
How to code Claude Code in 200 lines of code
Anthropic blocks third-party use of Claude Code subscriptions
Stop Doom Scrolling, Start Doom Coding: Build via the terminal from your phone
The creator of Claude Code's Claude setup

changes.raw: Added automatic skill hot-reload - skills created or modified in `~/.claude/skills` or `.claude/skills` are now immediately available without restarting the session
changes.summary: 技能自动热更新
changes.summary_en: Auto hot-reload skills instantly
changes.why_matters: 技能修改后无需重启即可生效，提升迭代效率和使用连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Skill changes take effect immediately without restarting, improving iteration speed and continuity.

changes.raw: Added support for running skills and slash commands in a forked sub-agent context using `context: fork` in skill frontmatter
changes.summary: 技能支持分叉子代理执行
changes.summary_en: Run skills in forked sub-agents
changes.why_matters: 可在独立子代理上下文中运行技能和命令，增强复杂任务的隔离与并行处理能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Skills and commands can run in isolated sub-agent contexts, improving separation and parallel handling of complex tasks.

changes.raw: Added support for `agent` field in skills to specify agent type for execution
changes.summary: 技能可指定执行代理类型
changes.summary_en: Choose agent type for skills
changes.why_matters: 允许按任务选择合适的代理执行技能，提高任务匹配度和效果。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users choose the right agent type for a skill, improving task fit and outcomes.

changes.raw: Added `language` setting to configure Claude's response language (e.g., language: "japanese")
changes.summary: 可设置回复语言
changes.summary_en: Set Claude response language
changes.why_matters: 可按偏好输出指定语言，提升本地化和使用舒适度。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can set the response language to match their preference, improving localization and comfort.

changes.raw: Changed Shift+Enter to work out of the box in iTerm2, WezTerm, Ghostty, and Kitty without modifying terminal configs
changes.summary: 终端快捷键开箱可用
changes.summary_en: Shift+Enter works by default
changes.why_matters: 减少终端配置成本，让常用输入快捷键在主流终端中直接可用。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces terminal setup friction by making a common input shortcut work in major terminals out of the box.

changes.raw: Added `respectGitignore` support in `settings.json` for per-project control over @-mention file picker behavior
changes.summary: 支持按项目忽略 gitignore
changes.summary_en: Respect gitignore per project
changes.why_matters: 可控制 @ 提及文件选择器是否遵循 gitignore，提升项目级文件暴露控制。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives per-project control over whether the @ file picker respects gitignore, improving file exposure control.

changes.raw: Added `IS_DEMO` environment variable to hide email and organization from the UI, useful for streaming or recording sessions
changes.summary: 演示模式隐藏身份信息
changes.summary_en: Hide identity in demo mode
changes.why_matters: 录屏或直播时可隐藏邮箱和组织信息，降低隐私泄露风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Hides email and organization during recordings or streams, reducing privacy exposure.

changes.raw: Fixed security issue where sensitive data (OAuth tokens, API keys, passwords) could be exposed in debug logs
changes.summary: 修复调试日志泄露敏感信息
changes.summary_en: Prevent sensitive data in debug logs
changes.why_matters: 避免 OAuth token、API key 和密码被写入日志，防止严重凭据泄露。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents OAuth tokens, API keys, and passwords from being written to logs, avoiding serious credential leaks.

changes.raw: Fixed files and skills not being properly discovered when resuming sessions with `-c` or `--resume`
changes.summary: 恢复会话时可正确发现文件
changes.summary_en: Fix file and skill discovery on resume
changes.why_matters: 使用恢复会话时不再丢失文件和技能发现，保证上下文连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Resuming sessions no longer loses file and skill discovery, preserving context continuity.

changes.raw: Fixed pasted content being lost when replaying prompts from history using up arrow or Ctrl+R search
changes.summary: 历史重放不再丢失粘贴内容
changes.summary_en: Keep pasted text in history replay
changes.why_matters: 用历史命令重放时可保留粘贴内容，减少输入丢失和重复编辑。
changes.why_matters_en: Pasted content is preserved when replaying history, reducing input loss and re-editing.

changes.raw: Fixed Esc key with queued prompts to only move them to input without canceling the running task
changes.summary: 队列提示下 Esc 不再中断任务
changes.summary_en: Esc no longer cancels running task
changes.why_matters: 在有排队提示时按 Esc 只会回到输入框，不会误取消正在运行的任务。
changes.why_matters_en: With queued prompts, Esc now returns to input instead of accidentally canceling the running task.

changes.raw: Reduced permission prompts for complex bash commands
changes.summary: 减少复杂命令权限弹窗
changes.summary_en: Fewer permission prompts for bash
changes.why_matters: 复杂 bash 命令触发更少确认，提升自动化执行效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Complex bash commands trigger fewer confirmations, improving automation efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed command search to prioritize exact and prefix matches on command names over fuzzy matches in descriptions
changes.summary: 命令搜索优先精确匹配
changes.summary_en: Command search prefers exact matches
changes.why_matters: 搜索命令时更容易找到正确结果，减少被描述模糊匹配干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Command search is more accurate, reducing noise from fuzzy description matches.

changes.raw: Fixed PreToolUse hooks to allow `updatedInput` when returning `ask` permission decision, enabling hooks to act as middleware while still requesting user consent
changes.summary: Hook 可返回更新输入并询问
changes.summary_en: Hooks can update input and ask
changes.why_matters: PreToolUse hooks 可像中间件一样修改输入并继续请求用户确认，增强工作流灵活性。
changes.why_matters_en: PreToolUse hooks can now act like middleware by modifying input while still requesting user consent.

changes.raw: Fixed plugin path resolution for file-based marketplace sources
changes.summary: 修复市场插件路径解析
changes.summary_en: Fix marketplace plugin path resolution
changes.why_matters: 文件型市场源的插件路径能正确解析，减少插件加载失败。
changes.why_matters_en: Plugin paths from file-based marketplace sources resolve correctly, reducing plugin load failures.

changes.raw: Fixed LSP tool being incorrectly enabled when no LSP servers were configured
changes.summary: 修复无LSP时误启用工具
changes.summary_en: Fix LSP tool enabling without servers
changes.why_matters: 避免在未配置 LSP 服务器时误暴露不可用工具，减少误操作和配置困惑。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents exposing unavailable tools when no LSP servers are configured, reducing confusion and misfires.

changes.raw: Fixed background tasks failing with "git repository not found" error for repositories with dots in their names
changes.summary: 修复点名仓库后台任务报错
changes.summary_en: Fix background tasks for dotted repos
changes.why_matters: 让带点号的仓库名也能正常执行后台任务，避免常见项目命名导致流程中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps background tasks working for repositories with dots in their names, avoiding workflow breaks.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude in Chrome support for WSL environments
changes.summary: 修复WSL下Chrome支持
changes.summary_en: Fix Claude in Chrome on WSL
changes.why_matters: 提升 Windows/WSL 用户在浏览器联动场景下的可用性，减少环境兼容问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves browser integration usability for Windows/WSL users by removing environment compatibility issues.

changes.raw: Fixed Windows native installer silently failing when executable creation fails
changes.summary: 修复Windows安装器静默失败
changes.summary_en: Fix silent Windows installer failures
changes.why_matters: 避免安装失败却无提示，帮助用户更快发现并解决安装问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents silent install failures so users can detect and resolve setup issues faster.

changes.raw: Improved CLI help output to display options and subcommands in alphabetical order for easier navigation
changes.summary: 帮助信息按字母排序
changes.summary_en: Alphabetize CLI help output
changes.why_matters: 让命令和选项更容易查找，提升日常使用效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes commands and options easier to find, improving everyday usability.

changes.raw: Added wildcard pattern matching for Bash tool permissions using `*` at any position in rules (e.g., `Bash(npm *)`, `Bash(* install)`, `Bash(git * main)`)
changes.summary: 支持Bash权限通配符匹配
changes.summary_en: Add wildcard Bash permission matching
changes.why_matters: 让权限规则更灵活，便于精细控制 Bash 工具可执行范围。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes permission rules more flexible for fine-grained control over Bash tool access.

changes.raw: Added unified Ctrl+B backgrounding for both bash commands and agents - pressing Ctrl+B now backgrounds all running foreground tasks simultaneously
changes.summary: Ctrl+B统一后台化任务
changes.summary_en: Unify Ctrl+B backgrounding for tasks
changes.why_matters: 可一键同时后台化命令和代理，减少中断并提升多任务处理效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users background commands and agents together in one keystroke, reducing interruption and improving multitasking.

changes.raw: Added support for MCP `list_changed` notifications, allowing MCP servers to dynamically update their available tools, prompts, and resources without requiring reconnection
changes.summary: 支持MCP动态变更通知
changes.summary_en: Support MCP list_changed notifications
changes.why_matters: MCP 服务器可动态更新工具与资源，无需重连即可保持能力最新。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows MCP servers to update tools and resources dynamically without reconnecting, keeping capabilities current.

changes.raw: Added `/teleport` and `/remote-env` slash commands for claude.ai subscribers, allowing them to resume and configure remote sessions
changes.summary: 新增远程会话恢复命令
changes.summary_en: Add /teleport and /remote-env commands
changes.why_matters: 方便订阅用户继续远程会话并配置环境，提升跨设备工作连续性。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps subscribers resume remote sessions and configure environments, improving continuity across devices.

changes.raw: Added support for disabling specific agents using `Task(AgentName)` syntax in settings.json permissions or the `--disallowedTools` CLI flag
changes.summary: 支持禁用指定Agent
changes.summary_en: Allow disabling specific agents
changes.why_matters: 让管理员或用户能限制特定 Agent 的使用，增强安全与控制。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets admins or users restrict specific agents, improving control and safety.

changes.raw: Added hooks support to agent frontmatter, allowing agents to define PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop hooks scoped to the agent's lifecycle
changes.summary: Agent支持生命周期Hooks
changes.summary_en: Add lifecycle hooks for agents
changes.why_matters: 可在 Agent 执行前后和停止时自动触发逻辑，增强自动化与可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: Enables automatic logic before, after, and on stop for agents, improving automation and control.

changes.raw: Added hooks support for skill and slash command frontmatter
changes.summary: 技能和命令支持Hooks
changes.summary_en: Add hooks for skills and slash commands
changes.why_matters: 让更多扩展点可接入自动化流程，提升定制能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Brings more extension points into automation flows, increasing customization.

changes.raw: Added new Vim motions: `;` and `,` to repeat f/F/t/T motions, `y` operator for yank with `yy`/`Y`, `p`/`P` for paste, text objects (`iw`, `aw`, `iW`, `aW`, `i"`, `a"`, `i'`, `a'`, `i(`, `a(`, `i[`, `a[`, `i{`, `a{`), `>>` and `<<` for indent/dedent, and `J` to join lines
changes.summary: 新增Vim编辑动作
changes.summary_en: Add richer Vim motions and operators
changes.why_matters: 显著增强终端内编辑效率，适合重度 Vim 用户进行快速文本操作。
changes.why_matters_en: Greatly improves in-terminal editing efficiency for power users who rely on Vim-style workflows.

changes.raw: Added `/plan` command shortcut to enable plan mode directly from the prompt
changes.summary: 新增/plan快捷命令
changes.summary_en: Add /plan shortcut command
changes.why_matters: 让用户更快进入计划模式，减少操作步骤并提升工作流效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Gets users into plan mode faster, reducing steps and streamlining the workflow.

changes.raw: Added slash command autocomplete support when `/` appears anywhere in input, not just at the beginning
changes.summary: 支持任意位置补全斜杠命令
changes.summary_en: Autocomplete slash commands anywhere
changes.why_matters: 在输入中途也能触发补全，提升命令发现和输入效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Autocomplete can trigger mid-input, improving command discovery and entry speed.

changes.raw: Added `--tools` flag support in interactive mode to restrict which built-in tools Claude can use during interactive sessions
changes.summary: 交互模式限制可用工具
changes.summary_en: Restrict tools in interactive mode
changes.why_matters: 让用户在交互会话中更精细地控制 Claude 可调用的内置工具，提升安全性和可控性。
changes.why_matters_en: Gives users finer control over which built-in tools Claude can use during interactive sessions, improving safety and control.

changes.raw: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` environment variable to override the default file read token limit
changes.summary: 可配置文件读取输出上限
changes.summary_en: Configurable file read output limit
changes.why_matters: 允许按环境调整文件读取返回的 token 上限，减少大文件读取时的截断问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users tune the token limit for file reads, reducing truncation issues on large files.

changes.raw: Added support for `once: true` config for hooks
changes.summary: 支持一次性 Hook 配置
changes.summary_en: Support once-only hook config
changes.why_matters: 让 hooks 能按一次性规则执行，增强自动化流程的表达能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows hooks to run only once, making automation workflows more expressive.

changes.raw: Added support for YAML-style lists in frontmatter `allowed-tools` field for cleaner skill declarations
changes.summary: 前置声明支持 YAML 列表
changes.summary_en: YAML lists for allowed-tools frontmatter
changes.why_matters: 让技能声明更简洁易读，降低配置编写和维护成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes skill declarations cleaner and easier to maintain.

changes.raw: Added support for prompt and agent hook types from plugins (previously only command hooks were supported)
changes.summary: 插件支持提示与代理 Hook
changes.summary_en: Plugin support for prompt and agent hooks
changes.why_matters: 扩展插件可接入的 hook 类型，提升生态集成和自动化能力。
changes.why_matters_en: Expands the hook types plugins can provide, improving ecosystem integration and automation.

changes.raw: Added Cmd+V support for image paste in iTerm2 (maps to Ctrl+V)
changes.summary: iTerm2 支持图片粘贴
changes.summary_en: Image paste support in iTerm2
changes.why_matters: 让用户在 iTerm2 中更方便地粘贴图片，提升多模态输入体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes it easier to paste images in iTerm2, improving multimodal input experience.

changes.raw: Added left/right arrow key navigation for cycling through tabs in dialogs
changes.summary: 对话框支持左右切换标签
changes.summary_en: Left/right tab navigation in dialogs
changes.why_matters: 改善键盘操作体验，让用户在对话框中切换标签更高效。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves keyboard usability by making tab switching in dialogs faster.

changes.raw: Added real-time thinking block display in Ctrl+O transcript mode
changes.summary: 实时显示思考块内容
changes.summary_en: Real-time thinking block display
changes.why_matters: 让用户在转录模式下更及时看到模型思考过程，增强可观察性。
changes.why_matters_en: Lets users see thinking blocks live in transcript mode, improving observability.

changes.raw: Added filepath to full output in background bash task details dialog
changes.summary: 后台任务显示完整路径
changes.summary_en: Show full output path in task details
changes.why_matters: 帮助用户更快定位后台 bash 任务的输出文件，减少查找成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users find background bash task outputs faster, reducing lookup effort.

changes.raw: Added Skills as a separate category in the context visualization
changes.summary: 上下文图新增 Skills 分类
changes.summary_en: Skills category in context visualization
changes.why_matters: 让上下文可视化更清晰，便于理解技能在会话中的作用。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes context visualization clearer and helps users understand how skills fit into the session.

changes.raw: Fixed OAuth token refresh not triggering when server reports token expired but local expiration check disagrees
changes.summary: 修复 OAuth 过期刷新失败
changes.summary_en: Fix OAuth refresh on expired tokens
changes.why_matters: 避免令牌已过期时无法自动刷新，减少登录中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents auth interruptions when tokens expire but refresh does not trigger correctly.

changes.raw: Fixed session persistence getting stuck after transient server errors by recovering from 409 conflicts when the entry was actually stored
changes.summary: 修复会话持久化卡住
changes.summary_en: Fix session persistence stuck on conflicts
changes.why_matters: 在临时服务错误后能恢复会话保存，降低会话丢失风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows session saving to recover after transient server errors, reducing session loss risk.

changes.raw: Fixed session resume failures caused by orphaned tool results during concurrent tool execution
changes.summary: 修复并发工具结果导致续会失败
changes.summary_en: Fix resume failures from orphaned tool results
changes.why_matters: 提升并发工具执行场景下的会话恢复可靠性，避免无法继续对话。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves resume reliability during concurrent tool execution, preventing broken sessions.

changes.raw: Fixed a race condition where stale OAuth tokens could be read from the keychain cache during concurrent token refresh attempts
changes.summary: 修复并发刷新读到旧 OAuth 令牌
changes.summary_en: Fix stale OAuth token reads during refresh
changes.why_matters: 避免并发刷新时使用过期凭据，减少认证失败和安全风险。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents stale credentials during concurrent refreshes, reducing auth failures and security risk.

changes.raw: Fixed AWS Bedrock subagents not inheriting EU/APAC cross-region inference model configuration, causing 403 errors when IAM permissions are scoped to specific regions
changes.summary: 修复 Bedrock 子代理区域配置
changes.summary_en: Fix Bedrock subagent region config inheritance
changes.why_matters: 确保子代理继承跨区域推理配置，避免因区域权限不匹配而报错。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures subagents inherit cross-region inference settings, avoiding region-scoped permission errors.

changes.raw: Fixed API context overflow when background tasks produce large output by truncating to 30K chars with file path reference
changes.summary: 修复后台输出截断溢出
changes.summary_en: Fix API context overflow from large output
changes.why_matters: 避免后台任务输出过大导致上下文溢出，提升长任务稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents large background output from overflowing context and improves long-task stability.

changes.raw: Fixed a hang when reading FIFO files by skipping symlink resolution for special file types
changes.summary: 修复FIFO读取卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix hang when reading FIFO files
changes.why_matters: 避免读取特殊文件时卡住，提升工具在系统文件上的可靠性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents hangs on special files and improves reliability on system file types.

changes.raw: Fixed terminal keyboard mode not being reset on exit in Ghostty, iTerm2, Kitty, and WezTerm
changes.summary: 修复退出时终端模式未重置
changes.summary_en: Reset terminal keyboard mode on exit
changes.why_matters: 避免退出后终端输入异常，减少对用户终端环境的影响。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents broken terminal input after exit and reduces side effects on the user’s shell.

changes.raw: Fixed Alt+B and Alt+F (word navigation) not working in iTerm2, Ghostty, Kitty, and WezTerm
changes.summary: 修复Alt快捷键词跳转
changes.summary_en: Fix Alt+B/Alt+F word navigation
changes.why_matters: 让终端内光标按词移动恢复正常，提升命令编辑效率。
changes.why_matters_en: Restores word-wise cursor movement and improves command editing efficiency.

changes.raw: Fixed `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` not being substituted in plugin `allowed-tools` frontmatter, which caused tools to incorrectly require approval
changes.summary: 修复插件工具白名单替换
changes.summary_en: Fix plugin tool allowlist substitution
changes.why_matters: 确保插件工具权限判断正确，避免不必要的审批阻塞工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures plugin tool permissions are evaluated correctly and avoids unnecessary approval prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed files created by the Write tool using hardcoded 0o600 permissions instead of respecting the system umask
changes.summary: 修复Write文件权限继承
changes.summary_en: Respect umask for Write tool files
changes.why_matters: 让新建文件遵循系统权限策略，避免权限过严或不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes created files follow system permission policy and avoids overly restrictive or inconsistent modes.

changes.raw: Fixed commands with `$()` command substitution failing with parse errors
changes.summary: 修复$()命令替换解析失败
changes.summary_en: Fix parse errors for $() substitution
changes.why_matters: 支持常见 Bash 语法，减少命令执行失败和误报。
changes.why_matters_en: Supports common Bash syntax and reduces command failures and false errors.

changes.raw: Fixed multi-line bash commands with backslash continuations being incorrectly split and flagged for permissions
changes.summary: 修复多行bash续行拆分错误
changes.summary_en: Fix multiline bash line-splitting
changes.why_matters: 正确识别多行命令，避免权限误判和执行中断。
changes.why_matters_en: Correctly recognizes multiline commands and avoids permission misclassification and execution breaks.

changes.raw: Fixed bash command prefix extraction to correctly identify subcommands after global options (e.g., `git -C /path log` now correctly matches `Bash(git log:*)` rules)
changes.summary: 修复bash前缀匹配子命令
changes.summary_en: Fix bash prefix matching for subcommands
changes.why_matters: 让命令规则匹配更准确，减少误拦截并提升审批体验。
changes.why_matters_en: Improves command rule matching accuracy and reduces false blocking during approvals.

changes.raw: Fixed slash commands passed as CLI arguments (e.g., `claude /context`) not being executed properly
changes.summary: 修复CLI参数slash命令执行
changes.summary_en: Fix slash commands passed as CLI args
changes.why_matters: 让通过命令行直接调用的 slash 命令能正常运行。
changes.why_matters_en: Allows slash commands invoked directly via CLI arguments to run properly.

changes.raw: Fixed pressing Enter after Tab-completing a slash command selecting a different command instead of submitting the completed one
changes.summary: 修复Tab补全后回车提交
changes.summary_en: Fix Enter after slash command completion
changes.why_matters: 避免补全后误选其他命令，提升交互输入准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents selecting the wrong command after completion and improves input accuracy.

changes.raw: Fixed slash command argument hint flickering and inconsistent display when typing commands with arguments
changes.summary: 修复slash参数提示闪烁
changes.summary_en: Fix flickering slash command hints
changes.why_matters: 让命令参数提示更稳定，减少界面干扰。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes command argument hints more stable and reduces UI distraction.

changes.raw: Fixed Claude sometimes redundantly invoking the Skill tool when running slash commands directly
changes.summary: 修复重复调用Skill工具
changes.summary_en: Fix redundant Skill tool invocation
changes.why_matters: 减少不必要的工具调用，提升执行效率并降低噪音。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces unnecessary tool calls, improving efficiency and lowering noise.

changes.raw: Fixed skill token estimates in `/context` to accurately reflect frontmatter-only loading
changes.summary: 修正技能token估算
changes.summary_en: Improve skill token estimates in /context
changes.why_matters: 让上下文成本预估更准确，帮助用户更好控制上下文使用。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes context cost estimates more accurate and helps users manage context usage better.

changes.raw: Fixed subagents sometimes not inheriting the parent's model by default
changes.summary: 修复子代理模型继承
changes.summary_en: Fix subagent model inheritance
changes.why_matters: 确保子代理默认使用父级模型，避免能力不一致。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures subagents inherit the parent model by default and avoids capability mismatches.

changes.raw: Fixed model picker showing incorrect selection for Bedrock/Vertex users using `--model haiku`
changes.summary: 修正 Bedrock/Vertex 模型选择
changes.summary_en: Fix model picker for Bedrock/Vertex
changes.why_matters: 避免用户在选择模型时看到错误结果，减少配置和执行混淆。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents users from seeing the wrong model selection and reduces configuration confusion.

changes.raw: Fixed duplicate Bash commands appearing in permission request option labels
changes.summary: 修正权限选项重复命令
changes.summary_en: Remove duplicate Bash commands in labels
changes.why_matters: 让权限请求更清晰，减少用户在授权时的阅读负担。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes permission prompts clearer and reduces cognitive load during approval.

changes.raw: Fixed noisy output when background tasks complete - now shows clean completion message instead of raw output
changes.summary: 后台任务完成输出更干净
changes.summary_en: Show clean background task completion
changes.why_matters: 避免完成通知被原始输出淹没，提升任务结束时的可读性。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps completion notices readable instead of being buried in raw output.

changes.raw: Fixed background task completion notifications to appear proactively with bullet point
changes.summary: 后台任务完成通知更主动
changes.summary_en: Proactively show task completion bullets
changes.why_matters: 让用户更快注意到后台任务已结束，减少漏看状态变化。
changes.why_matters_en: Helps users notice background task completion sooner and miss fewer status changes.

changes.raw: Fixed forked slash commands showing "AbortError" instead of "Interrupted" message when cancelled
changes.summary: 取消斜杠命令提示更友好
changes.summary_en: Show Interrupted instead of AbortError
changes.why_matters: 让取消操作显示更符合预期的消息，减少错误感知。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes cancellations show a more expected message and avoids misleading error noise.

changes.raw: Fixed cursor disappearing after dismissing permission dialogs
changes.summary: 修复权限弹窗后光标消失
changes.summary_en: Keep cursor visible after permission dialogs
changes.why_matters: 避免交互中断感，提升授权后继续输入的流畅度。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents the interaction from feeling broken and improves typing flow after approvals.

changes.raw: Fixed `/hooks` menu selecting wrong hook type when scrolling to a different option
changes.summary: 修正 /hooks 菜单选错类型
changes.summary_en: Fix /hooks menu selecting wrong hook type
changes.why_matters: 确保用户在滚动选择时不会误配钩子类型。
changes.why_matters_en: Ensures users do not accidentally configure the wrong hook type while scrolling.

changes.raw: Fixed images in queued prompts showing as "[object Object]" when pressing Esc to cancel
changes.summary: 取消队列提示时图片显示正常
changes.summary_en: Fix queued prompt images on Esc cancel
changes.why_matters: 避免图片在取消队列时变成无意义对象字符串，保持输入内容可理解。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents images from turning into meaningless object strings when cancelling queued prompts.

changes.raw: Fixed images being silently dropped when queueing messages while backgrounding a task
changes.summary: 后台排队时不丢失图片
changes.summary_en: Preserve images when queueing in background
changes.why_matters: 防止多模态输入在后台排队时丢失，避免任务信息不完整。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents multimodal inputs from being dropped while queueing in the background.

changes.raw: Fixed large pasted images failing with "Image was too large" error
changes.summary: 支持更大的粘贴图片
changes.summary_en: Handle larger pasted images
changes.why_matters: 减少大图粘贴失败，提升图像输入的可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces failures when pasting large images and improves image input usability.

changes.raw: Fixed extra blank lines in multiline prompts containing CJK characters (Japanese, Chinese, Korean)
changes.summary: 修复 CJK 多行提示空行
changes.summary_en: Fix extra blank lines in CJK prompts
changes.why_matters: 让中文、日文、韩文提示显示更整洁，减少排版问题。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps Chinese, Japanese, and Korean prompts neatly formatted and avoids layout glitches.

changes.raw: Fixed ultrathink keyword highlighting being applied to wrong characters when user prompt text wraps to multiple lines
changes.summary: 修正 ultrathink 高亮位置
changes.summary_en: Fix ultrathink highlight on wrapped text
changes.why_matters: 避免高亮错位影响阅读和提示识别。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents misaligned highlighting from hurting readability and keyword recognition.

changes.raw: Fixed collapsed "Reading X files…" indicator incorrectly switching to past tense when thinking blocks appear mid-stream
changes.summary: 思考块出现时保留读取状态
changes.summary_en: Keep reading indicator tense correct
changes.why_matters: 让文件读取状态更准确，减少流式输出中的状态误导。
changes.why_matters_en: Keeps file-reading status accurate and avoids misleading stream output.

changes.raw: Fixed Bash read commands (like `ls` and `cat`) not being counted in collapsed read/search groups, causing groups to incorrectly show "Read 0 files"
changes.summary: 读取分组正确统计 Bash 命令
changes.summary_en: Count Bash reads in collapsed groups
changes.why_matters: 避免分组显示错误的文件读取数量，提升执行摘要准确性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents collapsed groups from showing incorrect file counts and improves execution summaries.

changes.raw: Fixed spinner token counter to properly accumulate tokens from subagents during execution
changes.summary: 子代理令牌计数更准确
changes.summary_en: Accumulate subagent tokens correctly
changes.why_matters: 让执行过程中的 token 统计更准确，便于监控成本和用量。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes token accounting more accurate during execution, helping track cost and usage.

changes.raw: Fixed memory leak in git diff parsing where sliced strings retained large parent strings
changes.summary: 修复 git diff 内存泄漏
changes.summary_en: Fix memory leak in git diff parsing
changes.why_matters: 避免解析差异时占用过多内存，提升大仓库场景的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Prevents excessive memory use and improves stability on large repos.

changes.raw: Fixed race condition where LSP tool could return "no server available" during startup
changes.summary: 修复 LSP 启动竞态问题
changes.summary_en: Fix LSP startup race condition
changes.why_matters: 减少启动阶段误报“无可用服务器”，让语言服务更可靠。
changes.why_matters_en: Avoids false "no server available" errors during startup and improves reliability.

changes.raw: Fixed feedback submission hanging indefinitely when network requests timeout
changes.summary: 修复反馈提交卡死
changes.summary_en: Fix feedback submission hanging on timeout
changes.why_matters: 网络超时不再导致提交一直挂起，提升故障可恢复性。
changes.why_matters_en: Timeouts no longer leave submissions hanging indefinitely, improving recoverability.

changes.raw: Fixed search mode in plugin discovery and log selector views exiting when pressing up arrow
changes.summary: 修复搜索模式误退出
changes.summary_en: Fix search mode exiting on up arrow
changes.why_matters: 在插件发现和日志选择界面中，搜索操作更符合预期。
changes.why_matters_en: Search interactions in plugin discovery and log selection now behave as expected.

changes.raw: Fixed hook success message showing trailing colon when hook has no output
changes.summary: 修复 hook 成功提示多余冒号
changes.summary_en: Fix extra colon in hook success message
changes.why_matters: 改善无输出 hook 的提示显示，减少界面噪音。
changes.why_matters_en: Cleans up the success message for hooks with no output.

changes.raw: Multiple optimizations to improve startup performance
changes.summary: 提升启动速度
changes.summary_en: Improve startup performance
changes.why_matters: 让 Claude Code 更快可用，减少等待时间。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes Claude Code available faster and reduces waiting time.

changes.raw: Improved terminal rendering performance when using native installer or Bun, especially for text with emoji, ANSI codes, and Unicode characters
changes.summary: 提升终端渲染性能
changes.summary_en: Improve terminal rendering performance
changes.why_matters: 在复杂文本场景下显示更流畅，尤其适合带 emoji 和 Unicode 的输出。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes rendering smoother for complex text, especially emoji, ANSI, and Unicode output.

changes.raw: Improved performance when reading Jupyter notebooks with many cells
changes.summary: 提升 Jupyter 读取性能
changes.summary_en: Improve Jupyter notebook reading performance
changes.why_matters: 处理大量单元格的 notebook 更快，减少分析等待。
changes.why_matters_en: Speeds up handling notebooks with many cells and reduces analysis latency.

changes.raw: Improved reliability for piped input like `cat refactor.md | claude`
changes.summary: 提升管道输入可靠性
changes.summary_en: Improve reliability for piped input
changes.why_matters: 像 `cat refactor.md | claude` 这类用法更稳定，适合自动化工作流。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes piped workflows like `cat refactor.md | claude` more dependable.

changes.raw: Improved reliability for AskQuestion tool
changes.summary: 提升 AskQuestion 工具可靠性
changes.summary_en: Improve AskQuestion tool reliability
changes.why_matters: 减少交互式提问失败，提升任务推进的稳定性。
changes.why_matters_en: Reduces failures in interactive questioning and improves task continuity.

changes.raw: Improved sed in-place edit commands to render as file edits with diff preview
changes.summary: 让 sed 编辑显示差异预览
changes.summary_en: Show diff preview for sed edits
changes.why_matters: 把命令式修改更直观地呈现为文件编辑，便于审查变更。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes command-based edits easier to review by presenting them as file diffs.

changes.raw: Improved Claude to automatically continue when response is cut off due to output token limit, instead of showing an error message
changes.summary: 自动续写被截断回复
changes.summary_en: Auto-continue truncated responses
changes.why_matters: 当输出达到上限时能自动接续，减少中断和手动重试。
changes.why_matters_en: Automatically continues when output is cut off, reducing interruptions and retries.

changes.raw: Improved compaction reliability
changes.summary: 提升 compaction 可靠性
changes.summary_en: Improve compaction reliability
changes.why_matters: 压缩上下文更稳定，帮助长任务持续推进。
changes.why_matters_en: Makes context compaction more stable and supports longer-running tasks.

changes.raw: Improved subagents (Task tool) to continue working after permission denial, allowing them to try alternative approaches
changes.summary: 权限拒绝后继续尝试
changes.summary_en: Continue after permission denial
changes.why_matters: 子代理遇到权限拒绝后还能尝试替代方案，提高任务完成率。
changes.why_matters_en: Subagents can try alternative approaches after permission denial, improving completion rates.

changes.raw: Improved skills to show progress while executing, displaying tool uses as they happen
changes.summary: 技能执行显示进度
changes.summary_en: Show progress while skills run
changes.why_matters: 执行工具时能实时看到进展，增强可见性和信心。
changes.why_matters_en: Shows live progress during tool execution, improving visibility and confidence.

changes.raw: Improved skills from `/skills/` directories to be visible in the slash command menu by default (opt-out with `user-invocable: false` in frontmatter)
changes.summary: 技能默认显示到菜单
changes.summary_en: Show skills in slash menu by default
changes.why_matters: 用户更容易发现并直接使用可用技能，减少查找成本。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can discover and use available skills more easily, reducing friction.

changes.raw: Improved skill suggestions to prioritize recently and frequently used skills
changes.summary: 技能建议更贴近常用项
changes.summary_en: Prioritize recent and frequent skills
changes.why_matters: 推荐结果更符合用户习惯，能更快选到常用技能。
changes.why_matters_en: Suggestions better match user habits, making common skills faster to pick.

changes.raw: Improved spinner feedback when waiting for the first response token
changes.summary: 等待首 token 时反馈更好
changes.summary_en: Better spinner while waiting for first token
changes.why_matters: 在模型开始输出前，用户能获得更清晰的等待反馈。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get clearer feedback while waiting for the model to start responding.

changes.raw: Improved token count display in spinner to include tokens from background agents
changes.summary: 转圈显示包含后台 token
changes.summary_en: Spinner token count includes background agents
changes.why_matters: 令用户更准确了解整体消耗，便于判断任务规模。
changes.why_matters_en: Users get a more accurate view of total usage, helping them gauge task size.

changes.raw: Improved incremental output for async agents to give the main thread more control and visibility
changes.summary: 异步代理输出更及时
changes.summary_en: More incremental async agent output
changes.why_matters: 主线程能更早看到代理进展，交互更顺畅、控制更强。
changes.why_matters_en: The main thread sees agent progress sooner, improving control and responsiveness.

changes.raw: Improved permission prompt UX with Tab hint moved to footer, cleaner Yes/No input labels with contextual placeholders
changes.summary: 权限提示更清晰友好
changes.summary_en: Cleaner permission prompt UX
changes.why_matters: 用户更容易理解选项并快速做出安全决策。
changes.why_matters_en: Users can understand choices more easily and make safer decisions faster.

changes.raw: Improved the Claude in Chrome notification with shortened help text and persistent display until dismissed
changes.summary: Chrome 通知更易读
changes.summary_en: Improved Claude in Chrome notification
changes.why_matters: 通知信息更简洁且不易错过，提升提醒可用性。
changes.why_matters_en: Notifications are clearer and less likely to be missed, improving usability.

changes.raw: Improved macOS screenshot paste reliability with TIFF format support
changes.summary: Mac 截图粘贴更稳定
changes.summary_en: More reliable macOS screenshot paste
changes.why_matters: 减少截图粘贴失败，提升图像输入的稳定性。

highlights.highlight_summary:
v2.1.89 把 thinking summary 的默认渲染正式关闭——`showThinkingSummaries: true` 从默认行为变成需要显式开启。配合长会话、超大文件、自动压缩的一批稳定性修复，产品继续在可靠性上加固。

两天后，一份基于 6,852 份 session 日志、17,871 个 thinking block、234,760 次工具调用的社区分析登上 HN 头条——1,205 分、650 评论。数据给出了一条清晰的曲线：Read:Edit 比从 6.6 跌至 2.0，33% 的编辑发生在模型未曾读过的文件上，stop-hook 违规从 0 飙到每日 10 次。Claude Code 团队的 Boris Cherny 在 HN 评论区亲自回复，承认 adaptive thinking 在某些 turn 上分配了零推理预算，并给出 workaround：`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING=1`。原 issue 则被标记为 closed。
highlights.highlight_summary_en:
v2.1.89 makes the hidden thinking summary the new default — `showThinkingSummaries: true` flips from implicit to explicit opt-in. It ships alongside a batch of hardening for long sessions, oversized files, and the auto-compaction loop.

Two days later, a community analysis of 6,852 session logs, 17,871 thinking blocks and 234,760 tool calls hits the HN front page — 1,205 points, 650 comments. The curve is unmistakable: Read-to-Edit ratio collapses from 6.6 to 2.0, 33% of edits land on files the model never read, stop-hook violations climb from zero to ten a day. Claude Code's Boris Cherny replies in the HN thread himself, acknowledging that adaptive thinking under-allocates reasoning on certain turns and shipping a workaround: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING=1`. The original issue stays closed.

highlights.highlight_summary:
6 月 9 日，Claude Code 接入 Fable 5——第一个被 Anthropic 称为「Mythos 级」、并被判定可安全公开使用的模型。官方说法是：它的能力超过此前任何一个公开发布的模型，默认自带 1M 上下文。

这不是一次常规的型号更替。Mythos 级模型连数据留存政策都被单独拎出来约束，社区随之分裂为两种声音——一边追问能力边界，一边追问代价。一次塞进 patch 版本号里的发布，却是整条演进线上分量最重的一跳。
highlights.highlight_summary_en:
June 9: Claude Code gains access to Fable 5 — the first model Anthropic labels "Mythos-class" and deems safe for general use. Its capabilities, they say, exceed those of any model ever made generally available, and it ships with 1M context by default.

This is no routine model bump. Mythos-class models carry their own data-retention rules, and the community splits in two — one half probing the capability frontier, the other half the cost. A release crammed into a patch version number, yet the heaviest single jump on the whole arc.
highlights.highlight_why: 第一个 Mythos 级、可公开使用的模型落地——能力天花板被整体抬高了一档。
highlights.highlight_why_en: The first Mythos-class model cleared for general use — the capability ceiling moves up a whole tier.

highlights.highlight_summary_en: Plan mode no longer silently executes dangerous commands. Runaway search loops and subagent spawns hit hard caps. highlights.highlight_why: 这一版的意义不在于任何单一修复，而在于产品开始系统性地消灭静默失败——这是从开发者工具走向基础设施的必经成熟期。
